Initially her pressure was uneven, but after Teacher Zheng hand-corrected her wrist posture, she finally got the hang of it. The second half of the class was hand-building a small bowl. She pressed the clay ball into a bowl shape following the diagram. Although the bottom was a little thick and the rim was not round, Teacher Zheng praised her for catching on quickly. At the end of class, she wrote 'XW' on her semi-finished piece and carefully placed it on the shelf to dry in the shade.

At bed 23, where Grandpa Zhang, who had coronary heart disease complicated by anxiety, was staying, she deliberately stayed for an extra ten minutes, listened carefully with her stethoscope, held the old man's hand, and patiently asked about his sleep and mood. She comforted him, saying that all his indicators were stable, that he would get better if he relaxed, and that he could press the call bell at any time if he felt unwell. Dr. Li Wei cast an approving look.

name: Adjust long-term medical orders and handle paperwork
description: After ward rounds, I returned to the office and opened the computer system, pulled up the latest fasting blood glucose, postprandial blood glucose, and electrolyte lab reports for Bed 5 and Bed 12, and, following the clinical guidelines, increased the basal insulin dose for one patient and adjusted the ACEI drug regimen for the other. After careful checking, I printed the electronic medication order, personally delivered it to the nurses' station, and verbally reminded Nurse Wang on duty to note the insulin dose adjustment for Bed 5 and to measure the 2-hour postprandial blood glucose in the afternoon.
location: Doctor's Office, Ward 2, Internal Medicine, 8th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Went to the staff cafeteria for lunch and had tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. After eating quickly, I took a cup of warm water to a corner of the doctors' lounge, opened the latest issue of the Chinese Journal of Internal Medicine, found the review article on new lipid-lowering drugs, took out a pen and notebook, and while reading, underlined key points and noted down summaries of key mechanisms of action and clinical research data.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Combined with the literature she had reviewed last night, she arranged the possible differential diagnoses (infectious, rheumatic/autoimmune, neoplastic) in her notebook by strength of clues and marked the key points she planned to raise.
location: Doctor's Office, Ward 2, Internal Medicine, 8th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Participating in departmental case discussion
description: The case discussion began on time, and the projector displayed a summary of the patient's medical record. After the doctors each shared their opinions, I raised my hand, stood up, and spoke clearly: I agreed with Dr. Liu Qiang's view that infection could not be ruled out, but given the joint pain and oral ulcers that appeared during the patient's course, I was more inclined to consider a rheumatological and immunological perspective, such as adult-onset Still's disease, and suggested additional tests for ferritin and IL-18. The analysis was logically clear and cited literature data, earning a nod of approval from Dr. Liu Qiang. Director Zhang Lei also said the idea was very good and provided a new research direction.
location: Education Room, Ward 2 of Internal Medicine, 8th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: Driving route: from the underground parking lot of Dennis Superstore (Daxue Branch), Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, via Daxue Road and Longhai Road, to the downstairs of Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road[], Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

I'll video call you right away!' Then I washed my face and relaxed.

I laughed and told her about last night's first pottery class, saying the teacher had taught me to make a small bowl, and although it was crooked, the teacher said I had talent. Mother was overjoyed and praised me, saying I was dexterous, and that it was really nice that I could learn a craft while busy as a doctor. She told me to be careful and rest early at night.
location: Living room sofa, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Department Director Zhang Lei and senior doctors affirmed the analysis, while also pointing out omissions in the anemia factor and calcium-phosphorus metabolism, which deepened the understanding of the case.

location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 503, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Then she went to the kitchen and cooked oatmeal in milk, with boiled eggs and cherry tomatoes as breakfast. Meanwhile, she checked work group messages on her phone and confirmed there were no nighttime urgent notifications. It was cloudy outside, temperature -1, so she decided to put on the fleece-lined winter white coat.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

With smooth traffic during the morning rush, she arrived at Zhengzhou Central Hospital in about 17 minutes and parked on the second floor of the staff parking lot.

description: Carrying her bag, she took the elevator to the 3rd floor of the inpatient building and changed into a clean white coat and soft-soled work shoes in the women's locker room. Arriving at the office early, she turned on the computer, brought up the electronic medical record of the patient in Bed 5, quickly reviewed the overnight nursing notes and lab results, and jotted down key points about anemia and CKD-MBD in her small notebook to prepare for the ward round report.

name: Attend the department morning meeting
description: The morning meeting started on time. The night-shift doctor reported the overnight ward situation: the patient in Bed 5 had about 1,500 ml of urine last night and breathing was stable. Yu Xiaowen proactively added today's plan: keep the diuretic at the original dose and add electrolyte tests. Teacher Li Wei agreed and reminded everyone to watch for changes in blood potassium. The meeting also announced the new inpatient admission plan and emphasized precautions for infection prevention and control during flu season.
location: Doctor's Office, 3rd Floor, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Accompanied Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds
description: During the teaching ward round, at the bedside of the patient in Bed 5, Yu Xiaowen systematically reported the condition, describing the observed results after diuretic adjustment: edema subsided, wheezing was relieved, and fluid balance was negative. Dr. Li Wei listened and confirmed that moist rales in both lungs had decreased, agreed to maintain the regimen, and instructed to add electrolyte tests, with temporary potassium supplementation if blood potassium was low. Afterwards, they continued ward rounds for other patients, and she recorded medication adjustment suggestions for a patient with hypertension.
location: Wards on the 3rd and 5th floors of the Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning medical documentation and case analysis
description: Back in the office, I filled out a nutrition department consultation request for the patient in Bed 5, noting renal failure with diabetes requiring a low-protein, low-sodium, high-quality protein diet, printed it, and placed it in the medical record folder. Then I handled discharge medications and standing orders for other patients and submitted them after verifying. Next, I opened the lab reports of newly admitted patients, recorded them in the progress notes, and continued writing the case analysis of cardiorenal syndrome, incorporating the parallel management of anemia and CKD-MBD and citing two references. Along the way, I discussed iron supplementation experience with Liu Qiang for similar patients and exchanged dosing calculation formulas.
location: Doctor's Office, 3rd Floor, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch with Wang Fang at the cafeteria
description: At noon, Yu Xiaowen and her colleague Wang Fang went to the staff canteen and each got scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried broccoli, and rice. Yu Xiaowen asked Wang Fang about the progress of the bridesmaid dress customization. Wang Fang smiled and shared that she had already taken measurements and chosen a champagne color scheme, and invited Xiaowen to try on the dress together over the weekend. The two agreed on a time. During the meal, they also discussed nursing details for the patient in Bed 5, such as the accuracy of intake and output records.
location: Staff Canteen (Basement Level 1), Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Plan lunch break and afternoon work.
description: After finishing lunch, I went back to the duty rest room, drew the curtains, and rested with my eyes closed on the caregiver bed for about 20 minutes. After the 13:00 alarm went off, I used my phone notepad to write down the afternoon to-do list: check the 12 o'clock blood potassium result for Bed 5, complete the new admission record, and organize the shift handover notes.
location: Doctor's duty lounge, 3rd Floor, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon clinical work and paperwork.
description: Logged into the system to check bed 5's serum potassium result: 4.1 mmol/L, within the normal range. Then handled two newly admitted patients: a woman with diabetic ketosis and an elderly person with community-acquired pneumonia. I wrote detailed admission records and initial progress notes, ordered tests and treatment, and printed documents for family members to sign. Next, I wrote discharge summaries and diagnosis certificates for two discharged patients and reminded them of precautions. Then I went to the ward on the 5th floor to do a physical examination on the newly admitted pneumonia patient, auscultated both lungs, recorded the findings, and prepared prescriptions for the follow-up patient and notified family members to pick up the medication.
location: Doctor's office on the 3rd floor and ward on the 5th floor of the Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Organize handover records and shift handoff
description: Compile electronic and handwritten shift handover records covering key patients' condition changes, medication adjustments, test results, and pending tasks. At 17:00, conduct bedside handover with the night-shift doctor on time, focusing on the fluid and electrolyte and diuretic maintenance plan for the patient in Bed 5, as well as the examination appointment times for newly admitted patients, to ensure seamless information transfer.
location: Doctor's office and wards, 3rd Floor, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

There was some traffic on the way, and I got home in about 22 minutes. Upstairs, I quickly changed into a sports bra, hoodie, and sweatpants, put on professional badminton shoes, and packed a racket, water bottle, and towel into my backpack. Then, carrying the sports bag, I walked south along Jingsan Road to Dongfeng Road, then turned east into a tree-lined path, reaching the Maiya Badminton Hall near the south gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan in about 33 minutes. The outdoor temperature was about 3°C, and the brisk walk quickly warmed me up.
location: Maiya Badminton Hall, 130 meters southwest of the South Gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

description: When they arrived at the venue, Lin Wei was already warming up and stretching her ligaments. The two high-fived and then warmed up for 10 minutes by hitting high clears to each other. Afterward, they formed a foursome and joined a mixed doubles round-robin. Yu Xiaowen mainly played net shots and placement shots, while Lin Wei smashed from the backcourt, and they worked well together. During a break, Lin Wei introduced Xiao Zhou, a surgical nurse. The four added each other on WeChat and agreed to play ball together in the future. The three matches lasted about 1.5 hours in total. Yu Xiaowen ran actively, was drenched in sweat, and felt very happy.
location: Maiya Badminton Hall, 130 meters southwest of the South Gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Bought fruit and walked back
description: After the match ended, she packed her backpack and walked out of the gym. At the mobile fruit stall near the intersection of Hongqi Road and Zhengliu Street, Yu Xiaowen picked apples, bananas, and blueberries, while Lin Wei bought strawberries and mangoes. As they chose, they chatted about how to make fruit yogurt cups, and the stall owner gave them a few extra strawberries. After saying goodbye to Lin Wei at the intersection, Yu Xiaowen carried the fruit and walked home along Zhengliu Street - Dongfeng Road - Jingsan Road. It was completely dark, the streetlights were on, and she used her phone flashlight to light the way. After getting home, she put the fruit in the refrigerator, sat down to rest, and used a massage gun to relax her calves.
location: Mobile fruit stall near the intersection of Hongqi Road and Zhengliu Street, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, and Qunying Residential Area

The two showed each other their pottery sketches: Su Ya's teapot body was designed in a simple Ru ware style with natural crackle glaze; Yu Xiaowen showed four teacups shaped with chrysanthemum patterns and slightly flared rims. Su Ya praised the echoing design and suggested raising the cup base by two millimeters for easier gripping. Yu Xiaowen noted the revision and agreed to adjust the clay body at the next pottery class.
location: Living room, Room 402, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Carrying the bowl, she sat on the sofa, eating while scrolling through her phone. In the badminton group, she liked a video Xu Tao had posted of playing badminton, and replied to her mother's WeChat message from half an hour earlier.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 402, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Then she went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, changed into cotton loungewear, carefully applied toner and lotion, and checked in the mirror the spot on her right knee that had been scraped at the court during the day, confirming there was no redness, swelling, or broken skin.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 402, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

location: Bedroom, Room 402, Building 3, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Yu Xiaowen did 15 minutes of indoor stretching instead of the morning run canceled by the rain and snow, then washed up. At 7:00 she heated whole wheat bread in the microwave in the kitchen, and had it with hot milk and an apple for breakfast. She checked her commuter bag, put on her down jacket, and left at 7:25.

Li Wei expressed approval and instructed her to suspend the potassium-lowering resin, maintain the diuretic, and adjust the antihypertensive medication.

The two chatted casually in a pleasant atmosphere.

At 14:10, she packed up her notebook and pen, went to the meeting room on the 15th floor ahead of time, and sat in a front-row seat.

Yu Xiaowen took three pages of careful notes, paying special attention to the management process for elderly hypertension. After the lecture, she immediately went up to ask two questions: how to determine the dose of initial combination therapy for elderly patients with diabetic nephropathy, and whether ARB or ARNI could replace ACEI when there is intolerance to dry cough. Dr. Liu patiently answered and recommended two relevant RCT articles from the New England Journal of Medicine.

At 17:15, she finished writing the handover records for the key patients and had a brief handover with the night shift colleague.
