Then she went to the bathroom to wash up, carefully completed her evening skincare routine, and moisturized and nourished her skin.
location: Bedroom and bathroom of the rental unit, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Writing a diary and preparing for sleep.
description: Yu Xiaowen sat at her desk and opened her diary, recording the important moment of completing the first draft of the report, the patient's weight changes, Wang Fang's yogurt, and her parents' greetings. She wrote: "Today was a steady and efficient day. Although I'm tired, seeing the completed tasks fills my heart with satisfaction. Tomorrow is another day." Then she set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode and set an alarm for 6:30. Leaning against the headboard, she continued reading Better for a dozen or so minutes. When drowsiness set in, she turned off the light and lay down, briefly reviewing the important moments of the day, and fell into a deep sleep with a sense of fulfillment and anticipation for her new job.
location: Rental unit, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Waking up, washing up, and light stretching
description: Early in the morning, Yu Xiao was woken up by the alarm clock and felt some stiffness in her shoulders, a leftover from yesterday's long hours at the desk. After washing up in the bathroom, she did a simple 5-minute shoulder and neck stretch to loosen up, then weighed herself: 50.4 kg, the same as yesterday.
location: Room 202, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prepare for the commute and breakfast
description: Yu Xiao put on her dark green coat, tied her camel-colored scarf, and brewed Jin Jun Mei black tea in a thermos. She simply fried an egg, made a sandwich with two slices of whole wheat bread, and ate it while walking, taking care of breakfast.
location: Room 202, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commute by car
description: Yu Xiao picked up the car from the community underground garage and drove west along the Nongye Road elevated road toward the hospital. The morning rush hour traffic was heavy but smooth; it took about 16 minutes, and she arrived at Zhengzhou Central Hospital at 8:01.
location: From Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Department morning meeting and receiving comments.
description: After putting on her white coat, Yu Xiao attended the department morning meeting on time. After the meeting, Teacher Li Wei's assistant handed her a printed copy of the annotated case report. She quickly flipped through it and saw red pen annotations all over and an encouraging final comment, filling her heart with joy and motivation.
location: Doctors' office, Department of Cardiology, 3rd Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Daily ward rounds and patient management
description: Yu Xiao led the interns on routine ward rounds. She checked on a heart failure patient whose vital signs were stabilizing, and instructed adjustment of the diuretic dosage. She then went to see a newly admitted patient with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, communicated with the family in detail about the condition and treatment plan, and wrote medical orders.
location: Cardiology Ward, 5th Floor, Comprehensive Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Seeing new patients and paperwork
description: After ward rounds, Yu Xiao processed the medical records paperwork for the new patients. During this time, she saw a 40-year-old male patient who came in with chest tightness and looked nervous. Yu Xiao patiently reassured him, conducted an initial history and physical examination, and wrote up requests for an ECG and an echocardiogram. In a break between tasks, she again reviewed Dr. Li's annotations and listed the key revision points on scratch paper.
location: Doctors' office, Department of Cardiology, 3rd Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and initial literature review
description: Yu Xiao ordered a beef hand-pulled noodles takeout on her phone in the lounge and ate it quickly. While waiting and eating, she browsed several review articles on the ST2 heart failure marker on PubMed using her tablet, and searched for the updated summary of the 2024 KDIGO CKD guidelines, preparing for revising the report in the afternoon.
location: Doctor's lounge, 1st Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Focused on revising the case report
description: Yu Xiao sat back down at the computer and threw herself into revising the case report. She added the ST2 analysis section, citing the key recommendations from the 2024 Heart Failure Management Guidelines she had just looked up and domestic RCT research data; then, drawing on the KDIGO guidelines, she elevated the discussion of individualized medication. When her eyes felt dry, she applied eye drops and rested with her eyes closed for 5 minutes. After finishing, she saved the file as 'Final-Draft for Submission V2.docx'.
location: Doctors' office, Department of Cardiology, 3rd Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Brief rest and handling chores.
description: After revising the report, Yu Xiao stood up to stretch, went to the corridor to get a cup of hot water, and walked around to relax. Then she organized a consultation application form for a patient and replied to the email from the medical insurance office about a patient's expense issue.
location: Cardiology Department doctor's office and corridor, 3rd Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 North Tongbai Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Researching journals for submission and a call from a good friend
description: Yu Xiao used the hospital intranet to look up the hospital's reward measures for paper publication, and then logged into the Wanfang Database to compare the submission requirements, review cycles, and page charges of Henan Medical Research and the Chinese Journal of Internal Medicine. She basically decided to make Henan Medical Research her first choice. As she was getting ready to leave work, her good friend Sun Yue called. They chatted for about 20 minutes. Sun Yue mentioned that she wanted to bring some cured meat from her hometown and come over on Saturday. Yu Xiao gladly agreed, and they arranged to cook together at noon on Saturday.
location: Doctors' office, Department of Cardiology, 3rd Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-work commute and shopping on the way.
description: Yu Xiao drove home after work, navigating on the way to "Fengsheng Tobacco, Alcohol & Grocery Store" on Nanyang Road near the residential community, and bought 2 packs of instant coffee and a black hardcover notebook for recording reading and writing inspiration.
location: From Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16, Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, via Fengsheng Tobacco, Alcohol and Grocery Store, No. 68, Nanyang Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Dinner
description: After getting home, Yu Xiao changed out of her work clothes and cooked a bowl of plain noodle soup using greens, eggs, and half a tomato from the fridge, sprinkling it with seaweed and dried shrimp—simple and comforting. After eating, she quickly washed the dishes and chopsticks.
location: Room 202, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Immersive reading and reflective notes
description: After washing up, Yu Xiao made a cup of the instant coffee she had just bought, sat down at her desk, and opened The Doctor's Craft to chapters two and three. The content about communication among medical teams and lifelong learning coincided with the insights she had gained today from her teacher's comments. As she read, she copied three aphorisms into a new notebook and, at the end, wrote today's reflection: “Today made me realize that every time you refine a case, it is an opportunity for self-growth. Learn to extract nourishment from criticism.” She was so absorbed in her reading that when she looked up at the clock, it was already past ten.
location: Room 202, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and relaxation
description: Yu Xiao hung out the light blue shirt she would wear tomorrow, plugged in her phone and power bank to charge, then looked at the quiet night scene of the neighborhood through the curtain and completed her evening skincare routine to soothing piano music.
location: Room 202, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Going to bed
description: Yu Xiao turned off the bedside lamp and lay down, mentally reviewing today's approach to revising the report and plans for submission, feeling calm and full of anticipation. With the thought of continuing the plan tomorrow, she gradually fell asleep.
location: Room 202, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Early-morning run and stretching
description: At 6:10 in the morning, the alarm went off. Yu Xiaowen quickly got up, washed up, and changed into her winter sportswear. At 6:15, she left home, jogged along the roads in the residential community, crossed the streets, and arrived at Zhuchunyuan Park. In the damp, cold morning air, she completed a 5-kilometer morning run with an average pace of about 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, and her heart rate stayed steady at around 145 beats per minute. After the run, she did a serious 15-minute stretching session in the park, focusing on relaxing her neck, shoulders, and lower back. At about 7:00, she returned to her home in Qunying Community.
location: Zhuchunyuan Park, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road)

name: Returned to the apartment for a shower, breakfast, and commute preparation.
description: After returning home, she took a quick shower and changed into clean thermal underwear and outdoor clothes. Breakfast was simple: she heated a glass of milk in the microwave and ate a few whole-wheat crackers and a boiled egg. Then she checked her commuter backpack: making sure the stethoscope, notebook, power bank, and keys were all there, especially confirming that the USB drive with the final version of the paper was in the bag. At 7:35, she was neatly dressed and ready to leave for work.
location: Qunying Community, 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: During the commute by car
description: Yu Xiaowen walked to the community parking lot, got into her car, and drove along Qunying Road, turning onto Dongfeng Road and then onto Tongbai Road, heading to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The drive took about 15 minutes. While waiting at a red light, she unconsciously thought about the follow-up medication adjustment for yesterday's heart failure patient, and also had a fleeting worry about her family's health, but she quickly suppressed the thought and focused on driving. At 7:55, she arrived at the hospital parking lot.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning meeting and department catch-up
description: Yu Xiaowen arrived at 8 am and changed into her work uniform. At 8:05, she attended the morning meeting of the First Ward of the Department of Cardiology. The on-duty doctor reported the overnight situation, and Director Zhang Lei gave brief comments. After the meeting, her colleague Wang Fang pulled her aside and whispered, “Your patient's BNP dropped to 800 yesterday. That's really good.” Xiaowen nodded and silently confirmed the afternoon medication addition plan.
location: Doctors' Office, Ward 1, Department of Cardiovascular Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning ward rounds and clinical work.
description: Rounds began at 8:30. Yu Xiaowen paid special attention to a heart failure patient. The patient reported an improved appetite and was able to get out of bed today. After a careful physical exam, she talked with Wang Fang and confirmed that the pitting edema in the patient's right lower limb had clearly subsided. She wrote the order: add oral spironolactone 20 mg once daily. She then processed the admission records for two newly admitted patients and one consultation request. In between, she opened the final draft PDF of her paper again for one last read-through. After confirming it was correct, she renamed the file 'Final Draft-20250115-Submission Version' and copied it to a USB drive.
location: Cardiology ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Care between clinical consultations
description: After writing a medical record, Yu Xiaowen's eyes felt sore, so she walked to the window and looked down at the traffic on the street. She took out her phone and sent her mother a daily greeting: “Mom, it's colder today. You and Dad should drink plenty of warm water and not catch a cold.” After sending the message, she stared at the screen for a while but didn't see a reply, so she put down her phone and continued working.
location: Cardiovascular Medicine Ward 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 North Tongbai Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Received the bad news at lunch that my father had fallen ill
description: At 11:35, when her colleagues had all gone to the cafeteria, Yu Xiaowen took out the lunch she had prepared — stir-fried vegetables and rice — and ate alone in the duty room. At 12:13, her phone screen lit up with an incoming call from "Mom." When she answered, her mother's voice came through with a sob: "Wenwen, your dad... your dad suddenly can't move, and he can't talk clearly..." Her heart sank. Professional instinct forced her to calm down and she immediately asked, "Mom, what time did it start? Has he been taken to the hospital? Has thrombolysis been done?" After learning that her father had been sent to Luoyang Central Hospital within an hour and thrombolysis had begun, she let out a slight breath, but her hands were still trembling. She decided at once, "Mom, don't panic. I'm coming home right away!"
location: Doctor's duty room, 1st floor, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Emergency leave request and work handover.
description: After hanging up the phone, Yu Xiaowen rushed to the director's office. Seeing her anxious face, Director Zhang immediately put down his pen. With red-rimmed eyes and speaking rapidly, Xiaowen explained that her father had suddenly suffered a cerebral infarction. Director Zhang immediately approved her leave and reassured her: "Family matters are the most important. Go now, and don't worry about the hospital here!" When she returned to the office, Wang Fang and Liu Qiang also gathered around her with concern. She quickly made a list of the most important handover items: the follow-up medication plan for the heart failure patient had been written and posted at her workstation, the "Today's Important Matters" sticky note was on her desk, and the location of the paper submission files on her USB drive. Wang Fang said, "Go without worry. I'll keep an eye on the patients." Liu Qiang also told her to be safe on the way. Without time to say more, she took off her white coat, grabbed her backpack, and rushed out of the ward.
location: Doctors' Office, Ward 1, Department of Cardiovascular Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Emergency ticket purchase and rush to the high-speed rail station.
description: At the hospital entrance, Yu Xiaowen used a mobile app to grab the earliest available high-speed train ticket and was lucky enough to get a standing ticket for the 1:05 PM train from Zhengzhou East Station to Luoyang Longmen Station. At 12:42, she hailed a taxi and said urgently to the driver, "Sir, to East Station, as fast as possible!" In the car, she sent a voice message to her mother: "Mom, my train is at 1:05, and I can arrive before 2. Is Dad conscious now? You must stay calm." At the same time, she began searching on her phone for keywords such as "nursing after cerebral infarction thrombolysis," "golden period for hemiplegia rehabilitation," and "aphasia training methods," and took screenshots to save dozens of key points.
location: In a taxi, on the way from Zhengzhou Central Hospital to Zhengzhou East Railway Station.

name: Anxiety and information searching on the high-speed train
description: At 13:05, the G3187 high-speed train departed on time. She found a spot by the window where she could stand, put on her earphones, ignored the surrounding noise, and continued searching on her phone for "Luoyang Central Hospital Neurology Department," "secondary prevention medications for cerebral infarction," and "aphasia rehabilitation institutions," screenshotting all the information she saw. She also sent a WeChat message to her close friend Chen Siyu in Luoyang, briefly explaining the situation and asking if she knew anything about the Neurology Department at Luoyang Central Hospital. At 13:40, the high-speed train arrived on time at Luoyang Longmen Station, and she was the first one to rush out of the train.
location: High-speed train G3187 (from Zhengzhou East Station to Luoyang Longmen Station).

name: Heading straight to the hospital and praying on the way
description: At 13:45, Yu Xiaowen rushed out of the Luoyang Longmen Station exit, hailed a taxi, leaned forward, and said urgently: "Driver, Luoyang Central Hospital, Neurology Inpatient Department!" During the ride, she kept taking deep breaths, her fingers tightly gripping her phone, silently praying. At 14:28, the car stopped at the hospital entrance. She scanned the QR code to pay and then dashed into the hospital building.
location: In a taxi, on the way from Luoyang Longmen Station to Luoyang Central Hospital.

name: Ward visit and learning about father's condition
description: At 2:30 PM, Yu Xiaowen ran breathlessly to the door of the neurology ward. Her mother rushed over and burst into tears as soon as she saw her. She hugged her mother tightly, steadied herself with all her strength, and said softly, "Mom, it's okay, I'm here." She walked to the bedside and saw her father lying still in bed, his left arm and leg limp and powerless, the corner of his mouth slightly twisted, receiving an IV. She leaned down and called out tremblingly, "Dad, I'm back." Her father Yu Jianguo struggled to open his eyes, tears slid from the corners of his eyes, and he made vague sounds of "Ah... ah..." She bit her lip, turned to the attending physician, and asked in detail about his condition: CT confirmed a right thalamic lacunar infarction, thrombolysis was timely, vascular recanalization was good, vital signs were currently stable, but left hemiplegia and motor aphasia required observation and gradual rehabilitation. She followed up with professional questions about blood pressure control, lipid indicators, and the post-thrombolysis anticoagulation plan, and the attending physician answered them one by one.
location: Yu Jianguo's ward, Second Ward, Department of Neurology, Luoyang Central Hospital, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Discuss decisions and set up a family group
description: After fully communicating with the attending physician, Yu Xiaowen discussed the matter with her mother at the end of the corridor. They decided not to transfer to another hospital for now, but to stay at Luoyang Central Hospital for stable treatment, and to reassess the rehabilitation plan after the acute phase. She borrowed a computer in the doctors' office to look up the phone numbers and clinic schedules of neurology specialists at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, and made a note. Then she created a WeChat family group named Let Dad Stand Up, added her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng and her sister-in-law to the group, uploaded her father's latest physical examination report and CT image screenshots, and briefly described the current situation and the initial treatment plan. Her brother immediately replied that he would ask for leave right away and would arrive tomorrow or the day after. Xiaowen replied, telling him not to rush, to handle his work first before coming, and that she had things under control there. Seeing her brother's reply, her tense heart over the past few days finally felt a warm trace of support.
location: Neurology ward corridor and doctor's office, Luoyang Central Hospital, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Time with parents and a simple dinner.
description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen ordered dinner at the hospital cafeteria. She and her mother each got a bowl of porridge and some light dishes, and the two sat on the caregiver chairs in front of her father's bed and ate quickly. Her mother still had little appetite, so she kept comforting her in a low voice while occasionally helping her father turn over and massaging his paralyzed left side. Outside the window the sky was getting dark, and in the ward there was only the beeping of the monitor.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Keep in touch with family and friends.
description: While her mother was helping her father take his medicine, Yu Xiaowen walked to the end of the corridor. She called her colleague Wang Fang on her phone to reconfirm the work handover details. Wang Fang told her that the heart failure patient was in stable condition and told her to take care of her family with peace of mind. After hanging up, she left brief messages to relatives and friends such as her older female cousin and her best friend Chen Siyu, telling them about her father's condition and declining visits.
location: Corridor outside the Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Late-night care and emotional reflection
description: At 8:50 PM, after Yu Xiaowen's repeated persuasion, her mother finally agreed to go home and rest and come back the next morning. She washed her father's hands and face and straightened his quilt. Sitting alone in the caregiver chair, she turned on the small lamp her mother had brought and opened the book 'Better.' The words that used to attract her now could not hold her attention at all. She set the book aside, took out her diary, and after a long pause of her pen, wrote a full page of heavy words. Closing the notebook, she held her father's warm but weak hand and whispered, "Dad, you will definitely get better. I won't let you fall." The rhythmic beeping of the monitor was the only echo in this sleepless night.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Planning during nighttime care and falling asleep drowsily
description: She set an alarm on her phone, planning to get up every two hours to check on her father. Then she lay down fully clothed on the accompanying chair, closed her eyes, with the day's scenes still replaying in her mind. In extreme exhaustion and uncertainty about the future, at around 1 a.m., holding her father's hand, she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Got up early in the morning and checked on her father's condition.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, faint light came through the gap in the ward curtains. Yu Xiaowen woke up from the companion chair and first checked her father's monitor data, confirming blood pressure 135/85 mmHg, heart rate 72 beats/min, and oxygen saturation 98%. She gently checked his left limbs, found no abnormal spasms, and helped tidy the corner of his blanket. Her father could slightly open his eyes to respond, and the droop at the corner of his mouth had improved slightly. She went to the washroom and splashed cold water on her face to wake herself up.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Prepare for ward rounds, communicate with nurses, and do some stretching.
description: At 7 o'clock, the breakfast cart arrived. Yu Xiaowen ordered millet porridge and steamed egg custard for her father, and listed in her phone's memo the questions to discuss with the doctor today: key indicators after thrombolysis, the rehabilitation time window, and transfer evaluation. She walked to the end of the corridor and did chest stretches and torso twists to relieve lower back soreness. Passing by the nurses' station, she quietly asked the night-shift nurse about her father's condition during the night and confirmed that everything was normal.
location: Neurology ward corridor and nurse station, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Participated in the attending physician's ward rounds and discussions about the patient's condition.
description: At exactly 8:00, the attending physician Dr. Zhang led residents and nurses on ward rounds. Yu Xiaowen listened beside them to the evaluation of her father's neurological function, including questions, commands, and muscle strength tests (left hand grip strength grade 2, left lower limb muscle strength grade 3). The follow-up CT showed no hemorrhagic transformation, and thrombolysis had worked well. She then had a brief exchange with Dr. Zhang in the corridor, asking about the follow-up rehabilitation plan and consultation on transferring hospitals. Dr. Zhang suggested stabilizing in Luoyang for a week first before reassessing.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Read 'Better' and took notes.
description: After ward rounds, her father began an IV infusion. Yu Xiaowen sat in the companion chair and continued reading the chapters on clinical decision-making and uncertainty in Better, a gift from her friend Wang Lina. She copied key sentences and wrote reflections: systematically learning how to handle cardiovascular and cerebrovascular emergencies is both a professional requirement and a responsibility to protect her family. She hoped to arm herself with knowledge.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Lunchtime conversation with mother to comfort her
description: At 11:30 a.m., mother Li Xiuying brought millet porridge cooked by herself and light side dishes. Yu Xiaowen took advantage of her father's mealtime to talk with her mother on a rest bench in the corridor. She relayed Dr. Zhang's optimistic judgment, emphasized that his condition was stable, reassured her mother not to worry too much, urged her mother to take care of her health, and said she would handle the hospital affairs.
location: Rest area in the neurology ward corridor, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Brief lunch break
description: After lunch, her father took his medicine and fell asleep. Yu Xiaowen folded down the caregiver chair, covered herself with a coat, set a half-hour alarm, and rested with her eyes closed. The soreness in her lower back eased when she lay flat, and the brief rest soothed her tense nerves. She realized that taking care of herself was the only way to better take care of her father.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Companion care observation, communication with family and colleagues, and activities
description: In the afternoon, after her father woke up, he was lucid. Yu Xiaowen sent her brother Yu Xiaofeng a WeChat message detailing their father's recovery and attached photos. Her brother replied with relief and told her to take care of herself. Afterwards, she contacted Teacher Li Wei from the Zhengzhou hospital department, reported her leave status and that her father's condition was stable. Teacher Li reassured her. After sitting for a long time, she went to the corridor to stretch and relax her body.
location: 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, Neurology Ward and Corridor, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University

name: Picking up medication from the hospital and continuing to read.
description: At 4 p.m., her father's IV infusion ended. Yu Xiaowen went to the first-floor pharmacy to pick up the newly prescribed antiplatelet drug aspirin and the statin lipid-lowering drugs. After returning to the ward, she carefully checked the drug names, dosages, and usage instructions, compared them with the book's content on medication adherence, and recorded her father's medication plan and schedule. She then continued reading the passages on psychological resilience in the book and wrote down her thoughts: being at her father's bedside was the best lesson in professional growth.
location: No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province; Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University; first-floor pharmacy and neurology ward.

name: Dinner and contact with family and friends.
description: At 5:30 p.m., her mother called to say she was making the tomato sauce noodles her father loved. Yu Xiaowen fed her father porridge and vegetable puree, and ate bread and yogurt herself. At 6:30, her mother brought dinner. While her father rested, she sent a message to the family group chat and her close friends' WeChat group to report that she was safe, took a photo of the dusk sky outside the ward window, and wrote: Sunset by the Luo River, everything is fine. Zhang Jing and Wang Lina quickly replied with concern.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Evening care and summary of experience
description: At 7 p.m., Yu Xiaowen helped her father with his bedtime cleaning, wiping his face, hands, and feet with warm water, and massaging his left shoulder joint and fingers, performing passive range-of-motion exercises. While massaging, she recalled funny childhood memories of playing Chinese chess with her father. Afterwards, she sat by the bedside and wrote down today's reflection: from the panic when her father fell ill to today's calm response, she could see her own growth and had a clearer direction for her studies.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Video call with Mom and bedtime preparation
description: At 8:30, her mother video-called to see her father. Yu Xiaowen pointed the camera at her father, who was lying down, and asked him to wave. Seeing that he was in good spirits, her mother smiled and gave a few reminders. She then went to the utility room to wash up, soaked her feet in hot water to relieve fatigue, checked her father's nighttime medications and the monitor, adjusted the caregiver chair angle, and set her phone alarm to remind her every two hours.
location: Neurology ward and water room, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Getting settled before bed and preparing to rest.
description: At 10 p.m., the ward lights were dimmed. Yu Xiaowen did a final check that her father's oxygen tubing and monitor leads were secure; everything was normal. She lay back on the caregiver chair, put on her earphones, and listened to Schubert's Serenade. The soothing melody relaxed her nerves. Looking out the window at the lights of Luoyang, she felt calm and decided to encourage her father to do more active rehabilitation exercises tomorrow. Fully clothed, she lay down and fell asleep to the sound of the monitor before 11 p.m.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Morning care and status assessment
description: Waking up on the accompanying care chair, the faint winter morning light appeared outside the window. Yu Xiaowen stretched her numb neck and lower back, then observed her father Yu Jianguo. His breathing was even, and his complexion was rosier than yesterday. When she called to him softly, he blinked slowly, which was a positive sign. She recorded her father's vital signs and this morning's condition in her phone's memo app, starting a new day of care.
location: Father Yu Jianguo's ward, Neurology Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigu District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Assist with morning care and nurse handover
description: Yu Xiaowen assisted the duty nurse, Xiao Liu, in performing morning care for her father: changing his hospital gown, wiping his face, cleaning his mouth, and adjusting the monitor. The nurse praised her father's stable condition. Taking advantage of the corridor being less busy, Yu Xiaowen did a few simple stretches to relieve the soreness in her lower back, then ordered a light breakfast for her father (millet porridge and egg custard), and asked the nursing assistant to help feed him.
location: Neurology ward and corridor, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Participated in the attending physician's ward rounds
description: Dr. Zhang led the ward rounds, carefully reviewed the images, and assessed Father's condition, confirming that the thrombolysis had worked well with no risk of bleeding. He adjusted the rehabilitation plan, recommended adding once-daily language stimulation therapy, and prescribed new oral medication. Yu Xiaowen took careful notes and asked Dr. Zhang for specific details about the intensity and frequency of passive joint exercises for the left limbs.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Read 'Better'.
description: After her father fell asleep peacefully following the IV drip, Yu Xiaowen took out Better, turned to the chapter "Clinical Decision-Making and Uncertainty", and used a pencil to underline passages such as "How to communicate a poor prognosis with patients and families" and "The doctor's intuition and data analysis", writing short annotations beside them. She treated her father's current illness as a case study and wrote down her thoughts and confusions in the margins of the pages.
location: Companion chair in the Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Mother delivering meals and midday handover
description: Mother Li Xiuying arrived on time carrying a thermal lunch box, with stir-fried seasonal vegetables, crucian carp soup, and rice. Yu Xiaowen first fed her father some fish soup and egg custard, then ate lunch with her mother at the small table in the ward. She told her mother in detail about the good news from Dr. Zhang's ward round and the new rehabilitation plan. Her mother's brow relaxed a lot, and she said she would go home in the afternoon to rest and come back in the evening to take over the shift.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Took a short rest while my father was napping.
description: After her father took his afternoon nap, Yu Xiaowen leaned back in the caregiver chair and rested with her eyes closed. Although she couldn't sleep deeply, the brief rest relaxed her tense nerves a little and stored up energy for the afternoon.
location: Companion chair in the Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Stroll in the hospital courtyard garden.
description: While her father was sound asleep, Yu Xiaowen went downstairs alone to the garden in the inner courtyard on the first floor. The cold wind outdoors, at minus four degrees Celsius, hit her face, and the holly in the garden was lush green. She walked briskly for fifteen minutes, breathing fresh air and stretching her body after sitting for a long time, and felt somewhat more at ease.
location: Inner courtyard garden on the first floor, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Organized notes and contacted department colleagues
description: Back in the ward, her father was still sleeping. Yu Xiaowen took out a notepad and, using 'Father's case' as the starting point, sketched the framework for her first reading note, focusing on humanistic care in clinical decision-making. Then she sent a long WeChat message to Teacher Li Wei, reporting in detail on her father's recovery and thanking the department for their concern. She also replied to Wang Fang's greeting and asked her to help keep an eye on next week's department schedule.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Auditory stimulation and limb rehabilitation training
description: After her father woke up, he seemed to be in fairly good spirits. Yu Xiaowen took out the Bluetooth speaker her mother had brought and softly played Debussy's Clair de Lune. She noticed that his tightly knitted brow seemed to relax slightly. With the soothing melody, she began passive range-of-motion exercises for his left upper and lower limbs, massaging and gently guiding him as she went.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Reported her safety in the family group chat.
description: After the rehabilitation training, her father fell asleep again. Yu Xiaowen took out her phone, selected a few photos and short videos from this morning, after the ward rounds, and during rehabilitation, and sent them to the 'Yu Family, One Big Family' group chat with the message: 'Dad's indicators are improving across the board today, and his mental state is good. Don't worry.' Her brother and relatives immediately liked and replied with encouragement.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Mother delivering dinner and evening review
description: Her mother, Li Xiuying, came to the hospital with tomato beef noodles and dumplings. Yu Xiaowen shared with her mother the afternoon's rehabilitation training and the lively responses from the family group chat. Mother and daughter ate and chatted in a relaxed atmosphere. Her mother decided to stay overnight and told Yu Xiaowen to go home and get a good night's sleep.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Evening care routine and recording a progress video
description: Yu Xiaowen and her mother gave her father an evening cleaning and change of clothes, using a cotton swab dipped in water to gently moisten his cracked lips. To record progress, Yu Xiaowen guided her father to follow her lips and painstakingly mouth I—am—fine, then recorded a short video on her phone, planning to send it to her elder brother and also to encourage her father.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Handed over to her mother and left the hospital.
description: Yu Xiaowen had a video call with her grandmother via WeChat, showing her father's condition. Then she carefully went over the night care handover points with her mother and checked the emergency call bell, medications, and thermos. After confirming everything was in order, she put on her coat, said goodbye to her father and mother, and set off home alone.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Thoughts while walking home.
description: As she walked out of the hospital building, the biting cold wind refreshed Yu Xiaowen. She didn't take a taxi and chose to walk home. During the fifteen-minute walk, looking at the streetlights and sparse pedestrians, her feelings were mixed: worry about her father's condition, thoughts about her career path, and anticipation of soon returning to her own room, all intertwined.
location: Walking along Zhongzhou Middle Road toward No. 42 Kaixuan Road in Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Return home, clean up, and organize notes.
description: Back home after a long absence, Yu Xiaowen took a hot shower and changed into comfortable pajamas. Sitting at her desk, she opened her laptop, entered the reading note framework from the day's memo pad into OneNote, created a dedicated folder for the "Clinical Decision-Making and Humanistic Care" notes, and photographed and archived the annotations in the book.
location: Her bedroom at home: No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Listening to classical music before bed
description: Lying on her soft bed, Yu Xiaowen put on her earphones, opened the music app, and chose Debussy's 'Clair de Lune'. She closed her eyes and let the soothing melody flow into her mind, as the anxiety and exhaustion of recent days slowly subsided. She decided to keep the habit of listening to classical music even after her father was discharged from the hospital.
location: At home, in bed, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: In the lingering afterglow of 'Moonlight,' her inner restlessness gradually subsided. She remembered that today was Friday and that she would return to Zhengzhou next week to continue working. Although she still worried about her father, she also gained a bit more strength to face the future. Yu Xiaowen fell asleep peacefully.
location: At home, in bed, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Woke up in the early morning and assessed her father's condition
description: Awakened by the alarm on the accompanying bed, she softly called her father to confirm he was conscious, used a flashlight to check his pupil response, and observed the monitor data: blood pressure 128/75 mmHg, heart rate 78 beats/min, oxygen saturation 98%. Her father spoke unclearly but could try to grip her hand with his right hand. She helped him adjust to a semi-recumbent position, wiped his face and hands with a warm damp towel, completing the daily awakening ritual.
location: Bed 28, Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Assist with morning care and personal hygiene.
description: Nurse Xiao Liu pushed the morning care cart into the ward, and together they performed oral care for Father, changed him into clean hospital gown and bedsheets. Checked the skin over the sacrococcygeal area and left scapula, no redness was seen. Then went to the public restroom at the end of the corridor to quickly wash up, splashing cold water on face to wake up.
location: Neurology ward and the public restroom in the corridor, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Have breakfast with mother and discuss the day's plans
description: Mother Li Xiuying came to the ward with an insulated food container holding millet pumpkin porridge she had cooked herself, boiled eggs, and scallion pancakes. The mother and daughter ate breakfast at the small table by the hospital bed, talking quietly. Xiaowen told her mother the plan for the day: check the reimbursement policy for out-of-region medical insurance, organize the expense list, and call the medical insurance office for consultation. Her mother helped sort out the receipts scattered on the bedside table.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Handle cross-provincial medical insurance reimbursement matters
description: With her mother looking after her father, she sat in the companion chair near the window of the ward where the light was good, and used her phone to log on to the official website of the Henan Provincial Healthcare Security Administration, carefully reading the policies under the column on cross-region medical treatment. After understanding it, she took out all the daily itemized expense lists since her father's hospitalization, created a folder named "Cross-Region Medical Insurance Reimbursement - Father" in her phone memo, and entered the drug fees, examination fees, treatment fees, nursing fees, and material fees item by item, circling several items with uncertain out-of-pocket ratios on the paper lists. To avoid disturbing her father, she walked to the end of the corridor outside the ward where the signal was better, called the Medical Insurance Office of Luoyang Central Hospital, and explained that her father had Zhengzhou medical insurance and was hospitalized due to a cerebral infarction. The staff instructed that before discharge, they needed to bring his ID card, social security card, and diagnosis certificate to register for cross-region medical treatment, and settlement could be done directly at the window upon discharge. She recorded the details in a small notebook and confirmed them by repeating each item before hanging up.
location: Neurology ward and corridor, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Discussed the medical insurance results with my mother and interacted with my father
description: Returning to the ward, she shared the details of the medical insurance consultation with her mother and suggested that she prepare copies of her ID card and social security card after going home. Her mother felt much more relieved. She walked to her father's bedside, held his hand, and said softly, "Dad, I've sorted out the medical insurance issue. Just rest and recover; leave the rest to us." Her father looked at her, his Adam's apple moving slightly, as if in response.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Sharing lunch and commemorative coin memories
description: Mother brought tomato and egg noodles and garlic broccoli. Before eating, Mother took out a mottled tin biscuit box containing the Chinese zodiac commemorative coins collected in childhood. She picked them up one by one, from Rat to Horse, and childhood memories surged back. She picked out the Ox-year commemorative coin representing her own zodiac sign and placed it on Father's bedside table, hoping it would bring him strength. Father's gaze softened, and the corners of his mouth seemed to turn up slightly.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Personal study and stretching during my father's afternoon nap
description: After lunch, my father fell into a deep sleep. I quietly took out Better and my notebook, sat down in the companion chair by the bed, and, drawing on my father's course from emergency thrombolysis to stable recovery, wrote the first systematic reading notes, on the theme of 'Five Steps to Becoming a Better Doctor.' I also reflected on my dual responsibility as a doctor and a daughter. After finishing the notes, I felt soreness in my lower back, so I got up, walked to the corner of the ward, spread out my yoga mat, and did ten minutes of Cat-Cow and Child's Pose stretches. The soreness eased a little.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Play music for auditory stimulation and handle social messages
description: After Father woke up, he was in fairly good spirits. I took out the Bluetooth speaker and softly played Debussy's 'Clair de Lune', and found that classical music was very effective in stabilizing Father's mood. Amid the music, I handled WeChat messages: replied in detail to my elder brother Yu Xiaofeng about the attending physician's assessment and medical insurance situation; sent a message to Teacher Li Wei thanking him for his concern and attaching a photo of Father; sent a message to friend Wang Fang to let her know the situation was stable.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Performed passive joint range-of-motion exercises for father
description: She took turns with her mother performing rehabilitation training for her father. Sitting by her father's hospital bed, she talked to him softly while gently and slowly moving the joints on his left side—shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, and ankle—10 times for each joint. Her mother played clips of "Chaoyanggou," which he loved listening to in his youth, on her phone. She encouraged her father to hum along, even just one note.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Helped father with dinner and ate with him.
description: Her mother blended the brought carrot and Chinese yam paste and the lean meat and vegetable congee into a liquid diet with a food processor, then slowly fed the father in small portions using a disposable syringe. After feeding, she and her mother had a simple dinner on the hospital room's tea table with the remaining dishes and steamed rolls.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Evening care and family communication.
description: After the meal, she helped her mother wash and change her father and check his pressure areas. She took a short video of her father clenching his fist in a "keep it up" gesture and sent it to the family group chat with the caption "Dad did great today!" Then she and her mother agreed on the night care plan: her mother would take the first half of the night, she would sleep on the caregiver bed first, and they would switch shifts at about 2 a.m. for the second half.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Record the day's events and video call
description: Opened OneNote, created a new note titled "Luoyang Caregiver Diary - Day 4," and entered today's key points of the medical insurance policy I looked up, reading reflections, and stretching reminders. Then I started a video call with my brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen, letting him see Mom and Dad, and heard his encouragement on the other end.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Relaxation and pre-sleep preparation in the ward
description: After the video ended, she turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. She played a piece of Bach cello music again, letting the ward and herself grow quiet. She checked the monitor; everything was normal. She set the phone alarm to 2:00 AM, switched it to vibration mode, and put it by her hand.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and rest
description: Sat back down in the companion chair, didn't lie down to sleep directly. Opened my phone and browsed through the photos of the commemorative coin taken today, and a warm feeling welled up in my heart. Although my lower back was still a bit uncomfortable, today I completed the medical insurance consultation and reading notes and saw my father's progress, so I felt fulfilled and at peace. Listening to my father's steady breathing and the occasional beeps from the monitor, I leaned back in the chair and gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Early-morning patient companionship and paying the hospitalization fee.
description: At 2 a.m., Yu Xiaowen relieved her mother on schedule and went to her father's ward. She placed a small cushion on the caregiver chair, tucked in the edge of her father's quilt, and did a set of lower back stretches on the floor to relieve the fatigue of the past few days. Then she opened mobile banking, transferred 5,000 yuan from her own savings card to her father's hospitalization account as an advance payment, and notified everyone in the family WeChat group.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Nighttime care and emotional interaction.
description: Yu Xiaowen turned her father over and patted his back again. Her father woke up and signaled that he wanted water. She dipped a cotton swab in water and moistened his lips. Her father asked the time, and Yu Xiaowen softly told him that her brother would arrive in the morning. The corners of his mouth slightly lifted. She held his right hand and felt the strength of his returning grip.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Morning rest and preparation
description: As dawn broke, Yu Xiaowen leaned back in the caregiver chair and dozed for a while. After waking up, she wiped her face with a wet wipe, combed her hair, and felt at ease after confirming her brother's flight was on schedule. She tidied the caregiver bed and neatly arranged her father's water cup, towel, and other items.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Assist with morning care and mother-daughter breakfast
description: Nurse Xiao Liu came to give her father morning care. Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying helped wipe his face and clean his mouth. Afterward, they ordered chicken and vegetable congee for him. Then the mother and daughter went downstairs to the hospital staff cafeteria, each ordering a bowl of millet porridge, tea eggs, and a small steamed bun, chatting while eating. Yu Xiaowen comforted her mother, saying that once her brother arrived, she could sleep soundly.
location: Neurology Ward and Staff Cafeteria, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Organize hospitalization reimbursement receipts.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowen and her mother spread out all the receipts on the small table in the ward and checked the itemized list and total amount of the hospitalization expenses. Her mother sorted the copies of the diagnosis certificate, ID card, and social security card into categories and put them into sealed bags. Yu Xiaowen found that the date on a CT examination form was incorrect, and immediately marked it, planning to get it corrected later.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Waiting for brother and handling personal matters.
description: Yu Xiaowen intermittently contacted her older brother via WeChat and shared her location. While waiting, she added reading reflections on Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance in the memo app on her phone, and in connection with her father's case, thought about electronic medical record documentation. Her mother was quietly talking with her father nearby.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Family reunion and care handover
description: Her older brother Yu Xiaofeng arrived at the ward, and the family of four had a brief reunion. Yu Xiaowen quickly explained to her brother the changes in their father’s condition in recent days, the treatment plan of the attending physician Dr. Zhang, and the daily medication and rehabilitation schedule. The three of them agreed that her brother would stay overnight to keep watch.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: In-depth talk about the condition and family lunch.
description: Yu Xiaowen handed her handwritten "Caregiving Memo" to her older brother, explaining in detail the key points such as the use of oral medication, blood pressure measurement times, and rehabilitation exercises. The three then went to the "Shanghe Village Beef Soup Restaurant" near the hospital for lunch, ordering several bowls of beef soup, flatbread, and cold dishes. The atmosphere was a little relaxed, and Yu Xiaowen packed a portion of clear-broth lamb to bring back to her father.
location: Shanghe Village Beef Soup Restaurant near Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Catching up on sleep at noon and regrouping after waking up
description: After returning to the ward, her brother took over matters on his own initiative. Yu Xiaowen put on an eye mask and earplugs, lay down on the companion chair, and fell into a deep sleep. An hour later, she woke up naturally, feeling much refreshed. She drank some warm water, stretched her stiff neck and shoulders, and briefly replied to the greeting messages from her department colleagues.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Accompanied her father in doing rehabilitation exercises.
description: Yu Xiaowen asked her brother to study nearby, and skillfully performed passive range-of-motion exercises on her father's left limbs, while guiding him to make a fist with his right hand and then release it. Her father did it with more strength than yesterday. She took photos to encourage him, and her brother recorded a video on his phone.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Discussed the return trip and handled work matters.
description: Yu Xiaowen and her mother discussed the return to Zhengzhou in the hallway and decided to go back on Monday. She then used her phone memos to list the preparations needed before returning to Zhengzhou. Afterward, she took out her tablet, entered her reading notes for Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance into OneNote, wrote reflections on the key points of clinical decision-making in connection with her father's diagnosis and treatment, and sent a WeChat message to Li Wei, a senior doctor in her department, to report her planned itinerary.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Evening companionship and final handover.
description: Yu Xiaowen sat beside her father's bed and spoke softly, and her father's eyes followed her the whole time. She and her brother reconfirmed the key points of evening care, including the frequency of nighttime blood pressure monitoring and abnormal signs. She placed her father's favorite Year of the Ox commemorative coin beside his pillow.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Return home with mother by bus
description: Yu Xiaowen and her mother said goodbye to her father and brother and walked out of the hospital. Sparse snowflakes were drifting outside. She took her mother's arm and walked to the bus stop, then took Bus No. 18 home. On the bus, the mother and daughter chatted about amusing anecdotes of her father when he was young, and the mother's expression relaxed considerably.
location: Bus Route 18, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province (Central Hospital Station to Kaixuan Road & Qiyi Road Intersection Station)

name: Dinner at home and stretching to relax
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen changed out of her outer clothes, made two steaming bowls of noodles with tomatoes, eggs, and dried noodles, and had dinner with her mother. Half an hour after the meal, she spread a yoga mat in the living room and did a full-body stretch, focusing on relaxing her waist, neck, and shoulders to relieve the fatigue of recent days.
location: Home at No. 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Packed luggage and contacted family in the evening.
description: Yu Xiaowen opened her suitcase and tidied up her clothes and miscellaneous items, leaving space for the Luoyang specialties she planned to bring for her colleagues the next day. She then made a video call to her brother to check on their father's condition in the evening, asking him to keep an eye on their father when he got up at night. She felt relieved after learning that his blood pressure was normal.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Personal washing up and relaxation
description: Yu Xiaowen took a hot bath, changed into her pajamas, then lay on the bed, played Debussy's "Clair de Lune" on her phone, listened with her eyes closed for ten minutes, and let her thoughts drift.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Recorded mood and planned tomorrow.
description: Yu Xiaowen took out her diary and wrote down today's feelings: her brother's arrival was reassuring, and her father's fist grip was stronger. She confirmed the time to return to Zhengzhou, the plan communicated with Teacher Li, set the alarm for the next day, and checked the weather in both places.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Go to bed and rest
description: She turned off the bedside lamp and adjusted her sleeping position. Although her mind was still on the hospital, her family's support made her feel at ease. She took a deep breath and slowly drifted off to sleep, storing up strength for the next day.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Morning stretching, breakfast preparation, and family communication
description: Waking up at her parents' home, the weather outside was cloudy in Luoyang with relatively low temperatures. Yu Xiaowen first did a few minutes of simple shoulder, neck, and waist stretches by the bed to relax her stiff muscles. Then she went to the living room, took the warm water her mother handed her, and while drinking, confirmed the plan to return to Zhengzhou, mentioning the CT examination form with the incorrect date and asking her mother to keep it safe. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother prepare her father's nutritious rice paste and steamed egg custard, and discussed the division of labor for the day: she would go to the Central Hospital to take over from her brother, and her mother would tidy up at home and then go to the hospital to relieve her brother. The mother and daughter worked well together.
location: No. 7, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province (Kaixuan Road Primary School Family Compound)

name: Walk to the hospital for the handover with her brother.
description: Yu Xiaowen put on her backpack and went out with her mother, walking east along Kaixuan West Road for about 40 minutes, arriving at the neurology ward of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University. Seeing her older brother Yu Xiaofeng, she first went to her father's bedside, held his hand, and greeted him. After confirming that her father was in a stable mood, she and her brother went to the end of the corridor and thoroughly handed over details about their father's vital signs, rehabilitation training key points, medication times, and the early-morning WeChat group communication.
location: Room, Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Multiple tasks in the ward
description: After the handover was complete, while her father was being given his morning care, Yu Xiaowen sat in the corner of the ward and used Taobao on her phone to choose Spring Festival decorations. After comparing materials and sizes, she ordered Spring Festival couplets, a 'fu' character, and small lanterns, setting the delivery address to her hometown. She then called Aunt Zhao Xiulan, her mother's close friend, and asked her to receive the packages and help put them up. Aunt Zhao readily agreed. When her mother arrived, Yu Xiaowen took out a transparent file bag containing bills and documents, along with a reimbursement process chart she had drawn by hand. Together with her mother, she checked the hospitalization list, cost details, ID card, medical insurance card, and so on, and patiently explained the reimbursement procedure until her mother felt completely at ease. Afterward, she went back to her father's bedside, placed the Year of the Ox commemorative coin in his palm and encouraged him to grip it, and her father responded. Her brother played a selection of Henan opera on his phone, and the ward atmosphere was relaxed. Next, she had a video call in the hallway with her best friend Zhang Jing, sharing her father's progress and her plan to return to Zhengzhou. Zhang Jing told some office anecdotes to cheer her up. After hanging up, she dealt with a WeChat greeting from her calligraphy teacher Zheng Guodong, carefully replied with a long message expressing thanks and promising to resume learning soon.

name: Lunch and farewell

While eating, she and her brother agreed that he would drive her to Luoyang Longmen Station to take the high-speed train back to Zhengzhou. Her mother reminded her to be safe on the road. After lunch, she returned to the ward, walked over to her father's bed, gently held his hand, and said a quiet goodbye. In the corridor, she reluctantly bid farewell to her mother and brother, urging her brother to take good care of everything and her mother not to overwork herself.
location: Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province (Old Luoyang Noodle Restaurant near Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, and hospital ward corridor)

name: The journey back to Zhengzhou
description: Brother Yu Xiaofeng drove Yu Xiaowen to Luoyang Longmen Station. The road was clear, and they arrived after about 40 minutes. Yu Xiaowen had already purchased on her phone a second-class seat ticket for the next train, G652, to Zhengzhou East Station. The train departed on time at 13:50. There were few people on board. She replied to a few friend messages and then opened her e-reader to read part of Better. The train arrived at Zhengzhou East Station on time at 14:55.
location: From Luoyang Longmen Station, No. 19 Tongqu Road, Luolong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, via G652 high-speed train, to Zhengzhou East Station, No. 199 Xinyi Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

After arriving home, she briefly tidied up the luggage she brought back, put dirty clothes in the washing machine, and opened windows for ventilation. Feeling tired, she lay on the sofa to rest with her eyes closed, and sent WeChat messages to her mother and older brother to report that she was safe, asking about her father's condition in the afternoon. After learning everything was fine, she felt reassured.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

The air in the park was crisp in the deep winter, making her feel refreshed both physically and mentally. She then took a bus or taxi to the Yinhang Street Calligraphy and Painting Society near her workplace. She browsed the calligraphy copybook section carefully, remembered her father's rehabilitation advice, and finally bought Basic Chinese Calligraphy Tutorial (Running Script) and a hard-pen calligraphy practice book. She paid and left satisfied.

participant.name: Clerk at the painting and calligraphy studio.

While waiting for the rice to cook, she took out her white coat and doctor's license to check their condition, making preliminary preparations for returning to work the next day.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: After dinner was set on the table, Yu Xiaowen played Bach's Cello Suites on her phone and slowly enjoyed her home-cooked meal to the melodious music, savoring a rare moment of quiet solitude.
location: Dining room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Then she opened "Better" and organized the annotations and reading notes she had made in the hospital into OneNote, preparing to share her reflections on doctor-patient communication during the post-thrombolysis recovery period at the next morning meeting. After that, she sent her brother a WeChat message again to ask about her father's condition that evening and received a reply that he was doing fine.

After turning off the main light and turning on the bedside lamp, she flipped through the calligraphy copybook instructions to prepare for sleep. Finally, she sent a message on WeChat to her teaching mentor Li Wei to confirm the next day's schedule, said goodnight after receiving the work reminder, turned off the bedside lamp at 22:00, muted her phone, and soon fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Woke up early at her parents' home and saw a clear sky outside but a temperature of minus one degree Celsius. After lingering in bed briefly, she checked the family group chat and saw a message from her mother sent in the early hours to report that everyone was safe. After washing up, she completed 15 minutes of lower back stretching and bird-dog exercises on the yoga mat in the living room. After persisting for several days, the soreness in her lower back had noticeably eased, and she decided to keep the habit.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

Then I carried the breakfast and walked about 30 minutes to Luoyang Central Hospital.
location: From Yanjun Spicy Soup (Shachang North Road Store), Shachang North Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Had breakfast together in the ward and listened to the treatment plan
description: Carrying breakfast to the neurology ward, she greeted her mother and elder brother and invited them to eat, and fed her father the hospital's special soft food. At 08:30, she went with her brother to the office of Dr. Zhang, the attending physician, and was told that her father's nervous system was recovering well and that he could probably be discharged after a few more days of observation; he needed to continue secondary prevention medications and early rehabilitation training. She carefully recorded the timing of the antiplatelet drug, the arrangement of speech therapy and passive limb exercises, and the follow-up appointment one week later. After returning to the ward, she explained the key points to her mother in plain language and sent an electronic summary to the family group chat.
location: Neurology ward and doctors' office, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Briefly returned home to shower and freshen up.

After arriving home, she quickly took a hot shower, changed into clean loungewear, and tidied up her backpack items.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Walked back to the hospital and read and reflected in the ward.
description: She sent a message in advance to tell her family not to worry about lunch, then walked about 30 minutes back to the hospital. Sitting on a chair in the corner of the ward, she read Chapter 3, “Empathy in Diagnosis and Treatment,” of Better, and thought about how the doctor had explained the condition to the whole family that morning. She recorded in her phone memo her thoughts on “how to balance honesty and hope when telling patients about an illness.”
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Had lunch with my mother and older brother in the hospital cafeteria.

The conversation at the table centered on her father's rehabilitation progress. Her brother shared rehabilitation and recuperation information he had learned, and together they discussed the follow-up arrangements: Yu Xiaowen would return to Zhengzhou for work the next morning, and her brother would take annual leave to continue taking care of their father with their mother.
location: Staff Canteen, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

description: After lunch, Father was still in good spirits. I gently woke him and guided him through affected-side exercises such as making fists and wrist rotations. I observed that his strength had improved noticeably from previous days. I recorded it with my phone and encouraged him. Though his speech was not fluent, he tried hard to nod in response.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

location: Wangfujing Department Store West District Underground Supermarket, No. 429 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Accompanied my father in reminiscing about funny childhood stories.
description: After returning to the ward, she sat by her father's bed, massaged his right hand, and softly told him a funny story about learning to ride a bicycle as a child and falling into a haystack, imitating her embarrassed look. Her father listened attentively, a smile spreading across his lips, and her mother laughed along. The ward was filled with a warm and gentle atmosphere.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

description: We went to the cafeteria together for dinner and ordered millet porridge and stir-fried greens. My brother had already memorized the key nursing points, and my mother was also confident. We settled tomorrow's arrangement: Yu Xiaowen would return to Zhengzhou first, my brother would handle the day shift, and my mother would handle the night shift. We would consider next steps after my father became more stable.
location: Staff Canteen, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Walked home in the evening, stretched, and handled household chores
description: Said goodbye to the family and walked about 30 minutes back to her parents' home. After arriving, changed into workout clothes and completed 15 minutes of waist stretches and bridge exercises. Then handled some chores: confirmed the bank card deduction was normal, called Aunt Zhao in Qunying Community to thank her for accepting the Spring Festival decorations on her behalf, and sent WeChat messages to her brother and mother reiterating the father's medication schedule and key rehabilitation training points.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Pack luggage for returning to Zhengzhou and make a to-do list for the next day.
