location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Reading before bed and relaxing with music.
description: Leaning against the headboard, she played Debussy's 'Clair de Lune' on her phone and continued reading 'Better'. Comparing the afternoon's clinical thoughts with the cases in the book, she added reflections in her memo: her father's disease progression and communication with doctors gave her a deeper understanding of medicine and humanity.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Returned to the hospital ward to accompany and settle in for sleep
description: Although the home was warm, thinking that her brother had already been accompanying their father all day, she decided to return to the ward to take over for him. She put on a thick coat and walked about 30 minutes back to the hospital. She saw her mother tucking in her father's blanket and her brother lightly sleeping. She quietly sat down in the bedside care chair and gradually fell asleep in the peaceful atmosphere.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 7 a.m., I woke up in bed at my parents' home. Outside, the sky was faintly light and cloudy, and the temperature was very low. I got up, washed up, changed into warm loungewear, and did 10 minutes of simple lower-back stretches in the bedroom, feeling the soreness from the past few days ease. After washing up, I fixed my hair in the mirror and mentally planned today's trip back to Zhengzhou.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Had breakfast with my mother and discussed the itinerary
description: My mother, Li Xiuying, had prepared millet porridge, boiled eggs, and steamed buns. As we ate and chatted, I told my mother in detail about my plan to return to Zhengzhou today, including going to the hospital to visit my father in the morning, leaving at noon, and planning to learn how to make liquid food after returning to Zhengzhou in the evening. Mother listened carefully and suggested that we go to the supermarket together later to buy some Chinese yam and lean meat.
location: Parents' Home Restaurant, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: WeChat communication about work and study arrangements
description: After breakfast, I first sent a WeChat message to my supervising teacher Li Wei at Zhengzhou Central Hospital to confirm that I would be at work tomorrow as usual, told him that I would return to Zhengzhou this afternoon and could attend the morning meeting on time, and asked whether there were any changes to the duty schedule. Then I opened the chat with my pottery teacher Zheng Guodong, looked at the three clay-sculpting instructional videos he had sent, and replied: "Good morning, Teacher Zheng! I took a rough look at the videos; your explanations are very detailed. Regarding the makeup class after the holiday, Saturday mornings work well for me. Which Saturday do you think would be convenient to start?" After sending it, I added the videos to my favorites.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Went to the supermarket with her mother to do shopping.
description: Put on a down jacket and walked with her mother to the nearby Dazhang Supermarket. In the produce section, they selected iron stick yam, pork tenderloin, and carrots. I used my phone to search for "nutritious liquid food recipes for stroke patients" and noted several recommended combinations in my memo. At checkout, she also bought a pack of sugar-free protein powder.
location: Dazhang Supermarket (Shachang Branch), No. 30 Shachang South Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Walk to the hospital
description: After leaving the supermarket, carrying the protein powder she had just bought, she walked alone to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University. It was a cold, crisp midwinter morning. She walked quickly with her scarf wrapped tightly, thinking about her father's rehabilitation.
location: Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Hospital room visit and interaction with father.
description: Entering the ward, her brother Yu Xiaofeng was giving their father a limb massage. Father's eyes showed joy when he saw me. I first wiped Father's face and hands with a warm towel, then took out the yam paste I had brought and carefully fed him a few mouthfuls. Between feedings, I quietly told Father that I was going back to Zhengzhou and repeatedly urged him to listen to his brother and mother. Then I helped my brother perform 15 minutes of passive joint exercises for Father in bed.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Hand over with family and say goodbye
description: Walked out of the ward and had the final handover with my brother by the window at the end of the corridor. Took out a notebook from my bag, which detailed our father's medication schedule, key rehabilitation movements, and dietary precautions. Read them out item by item to my brother and confirmed he had noted them down. Emphasized the importance of providing language stimulation by reading the newspaper to Father or chatting with him every day. After a brief hug with my brother, returned to the ward to say goodbye to Father.
location: Corridor outside the neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Returned home to pack and grab a simple lunch
description: After quickly returning to my parents' home, I started packing. I checked items like the charger, cervical pillow, and portable stool, rearranged the clothes and toiletry bag neatly, and left room for the Luoyang specialties my mother had prepared—silver-strip root and fermented soybean noodles. After packing, I went to the kitchen, cooked a bowl of fine dried noodles with a poached egg, and quickly had lunch with pickled vegetables. While eating, I received a WeChat reply from Teacher Li Wei: "Got it. Normal shift tomorrow; morning meeting as usual." I replied, "OK, Teacher Li, got it!" and felt much more at ease.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Take a taxi to Luoyang Longmen Station and wait for the train.
description: Dragging a suitcase and carrying a backpack, she hailed a taxi at the entrance of her home and went to Luoyang Longmen Railway Station. Leaning back in the rear seat, she watched the street scenes outside the window, turned on Debussy's Clair de Lune on her phone, and closed her eyes for a moment. After arriving, she bought a G652 high-speed rail ticket at the self-service ticket machine (from Luoyang Longmen to Zhengzhou East, departing at 13:12, second-class seat, Car 07, Seat 04D). After passing through security check, she entered the waiting hall, sat down near the ticket gate, sent a screenshot of the liquid diet recipe to the family group, and added: "Mom, I'll be home tonight and we can video call and cook together. Bro, you can take a look first."
location: Luoyang Longmen Station, No. 19 Tongqu Road, Luolong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Took the high-speed rail back to Zhengzhou.
description: The train departed on time. I put on my earphones and listened to a medical humanities podcast. Fields and villages flashed past the window as I thought about how to present the doctor-patient communication case in tomorrow's morning meeting by drawing on my father's treatment experience. I took out my notebook and wrote down a few outline points.
location: High-speed train G652 (from Luoyang Longmen Station to Zhengzhou East Station)

name: Arrived at Zhengzhou East Station and transferred to the subway to go home.
description: The train arrived at Zhengzhou East Railway Station. She followed the crowd out of the station and scanned a code to enter the metro. She first took Line 1 to Wuyi Park Station, then transferred to Line 5 and got off at Shakou Road Station. The carriage was crowded, so she stood all the way and guarded her luggage. She exited from Gate D and walked about 5 minutes back to the residential community.
location: From Zhengzhou East Railway Station via Metro Line 1 and Line 5 to Shakou Road Station

name: Returned home to rest and refresh
description: Opening the door and walking in, a musty smell of a room not ventilated for a long time hit me. I put down my luggage, opened all the windows immediately to air the place out, tidied up the room briefly, and put the things from my suitcase back in place. After that, I sat on the sofa and drank some warm water. Feeling a bit tired, I decided to rest for half an hour.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Short midday rest
description: I set an alarm for 15:10 and lay on the sofa with my eyes closed to rest. Because I hadn't slept well last night in the hospital companion chair, I quickly fell into a light sleep. When the alarm went off, I rubbed my eyes and felt much more refreshed.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Organizing work notes and preparing the sharing session for the morning meeting.
description: She sat down at the desk, opened her laptop, and logged into OneNote, where she categorized the reading notes from 'Better' and the doctor-patient communication cases she had compiled while accompanying her father. She created a new page titled 'Tomorrow Morning Meeting Sharing: Doctor-Patient Communication in Stroke Rehabilitation from a Family Member's Perspective' and began writing an outline. Drawing on her father's hospitalization experience, she distilled key points such as 'fully informing about disease progress,' 'personalized communication of rehabilitation details,' and 'encouraging family participation in care,' and added her own experiences and reflections. She was fully focused and highly efficient.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Outdoor walking and relaxation
description: I put on comfortable casual shoes and walked to the nearby Zhuchunyuan Park. Even in winter, there were elderly people and young people playing chess in the park. I walked two slow laps along the trail, breathing the cold, fresh air, and felt my tense nerves relax. As I walked, I sent a voice message to my friend Zhang Jing: "Jingjing, I'm back from Luoyang. Let's grab a meal when you're free! Miss you!"
location: Zhuchun Garden Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video-called mother to learn how to make liquid food
description: After returning home from the walk, I changed into loungewear and went into the kitchen, propped my phone on the counter and video-called my mother. My mother had already prepared Chinese yam, pork tenderloin, and carrots. Under my guidance, she washed, cut, and steamed the ingredients, then put them into a food processor and blended them into a paste, adding half a scoop of protein powder. When my mother showed me the finished yam paste, I gave a thumbs-up in praise. Afterwards, I found the small blackboard in the kitchen and wrote in chalk: 'Post-stroke diet: low salt, low fat, easy to digest; avoid egg yolks and animal organs.' Then I hung it in a prominent place.
location: Kitchen at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Dinner alone
description: After the video ended, she ladled the cooked tomato-and-egg noodle soup into a big bowl and carried it to the dining table. While eating the noodles, she opened the first clay-sculpting tutorial video her pottery teacher had sent on her tablet and watched the teacher demonstrate how to shape a sunflower, finding it very relaxing.
location: Dining room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Balcony stretching and meditation

The movements were standard and flowing, coordinated with deep breathing. Then she sat cross-legged in silence, focused her attention on her breath, and meditated for 5 minutes. The faint sound of cars came through the window, and her mind gradually settled down.
location: balcony at home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Wash up and get ready for bed
description: After stretching, she went to the bathroom and took a comfortable hot shower to wash away the fatigue of the trip. After changing into cozy pajamas, she lay on the bed and wrote today's mood journal and tomorrow's to-do list in her phone's memo: 1. Arrive at the department before 7:40 tomorrow morning for the morning meeting and share; 2. Contact Zhang Jing to confirm the meeting time; 3. Read Chapter 3 of The Doctor's Improvement.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading before bed and getting ready for sleep
description: After finishing the notes, she turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp. Leaning against the headboard, she picked up "Better" and read Chapter 3, writing margin notes wherever she felt a connection. Half an hour later, feeling sleepy, she closed the book, set her phone to silent and placed it on the nightstand, confirmed the next morning's alarm (6:40), turned off the bedside lamp, lay flat, and adjusted her sleeping position to store up energy for the next day.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Wake up, morning stretching, and breakfast
description: At 6:45, Yu Xiaowen was woken by her phone alarm. Since the lower back soreness from the previous day had eased, she did five minutes of supine bridge activation and cat-cow stretching in bed. After getting up, she did a set of full-body stretches, focusing on relaxing her lumbosacral area, shoulders, and neck. Then she quickly washed up. In the kitchen, she used the toaster to toast two slices of whole-wheat bread, paired with a bottle of room-temperature milk and an apple as a simple breakfast. While eating, she mentally went over the outline for her morning meeting sharing.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Drove to the hospital
description: Yu Xiaowen changed into her work clothes, picked up her commuter bag and fruit for lunch, went downstairs to the community parking lot, and drove west along Qunying Road then turned onto Tongbai North Road, arriving at Zhengzhou Central Hospital in about 15 minutes.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Teacher Li Wei gave her affirmation and added some communication tips.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Neurology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Ward rounds and shift handover.

After the ward round, she had a brief handover with Liu Qiang and Wang Fang, learning in detail about the recent changes in the conditions of the patients under her charge, medication adjustments, and newly admitted patients.
location: Neurology Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handle clinical work in the morning.

First, she handled the morning's medical orders, prescribing routine post-thrombolysis examinations and antiplatelet drugs for the newly admitted patient with acute cerebral infarction. She then communicated with the families of several key patients about their conditions, patiently answered their questions, and began writing medical records and recording key indicators.
location: Neurology Ward and Doctor Workstation, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Midday rest and conversation over lunch.
description: After nearly three consecutive hours of work, Yu Xiaowen felt stiffness in her lower back and neck. She went back to the rest room just before the lunch break, filled her thermos with hot water, and, while holding her lower back, stretched her neck and shoulders by the window. Wang Fang asked with concern about her father's recovery, and Yu Xiaowen shared the good news that her father's left-hand grip strength had increased.
