In the corridor, Yu Xiaowen received a WeChat message from Wang Fang containing a screenshot of the department group chat and additional funny stories, which again relayed Li Wei's regards. Yu Xiaowen replied with thanks and discussed the current bed situation, learning that Liu Qiang was temporarily covering it for her, which left her both grateful and apologetic.
location: Doctor's rest room and staff cafeteria, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunchtime stroll and rest
description: To relieve lower back fatigue, Yu Xiaowen walked slowly for more than ten minutes in the small garden downstairs from the inpatient building, breathing the cold winter air to let her mind go blank. Then she returned to the lounge, leaned back on the sofa, closed her eyes, and rested for twenty minutes.
location: The small garden downstairs and the doctors' rest room at the inpatient building of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Search for literature on stroke rehabilitation.
description: After going to work in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen obtained the head nurse's consent, borrowed the public computer next to the nurses' station, logged into the hospital's medical database, searched with keywords such as 'early rehabilitation of ischemic stroke' and 'home rehabilitation training', browsed dozens of literature abstracts, and finally selected 3 Chinese clinical guidelines and 2 English review articles. She saved screenshots of key conclusions, training methods, and charts to her phone's memo, planning to read them carefully in the evening.
location: Public computer area beside the nurse station at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work, handling lower back discomfort, and preparing for shift handover
description: After finishing her literature search, Yu Xiaowen returned to the doctor's workstation to handle the afternoon's work. She reviewed the patients' latest lab reports and imaging results, organized medical orders, and prepared for the next day's shift handover. Sitting for a long time caused a dull pain in her lower back to return, so she paused her work and went to the break room. She applied a hot water bottle to her lumbosacral area and did a 5-minute stretch on the sofa. She rated the pain 4/10, and after feeling relieved, she resolved to strictly follow the rule of moving after no more than 40 minutes of sitting. After the hot compress, she continued writing the remaining medical records, checked the key points for tomorrow's handover, and had a brief pre-handover discussion with the doctor on duty.
location: No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, Neurology Department Doctor's Workstation and Rest Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: After work, drove home
description: Yu Xiaowen left work on time, took off her white coat, packed her things, and drove back along the same route, experiencing the rush-hour traffic flow and paying attention to driving safety.
location: From Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan to Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Simple dinner
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen washed her face and cooked herself a bowl of tomato and egg noodles with tomato, eggs, and greens. While eating, she browsed the literature abstracts she had saved that afternoon on her phone, thinking about how to turn them into her father's rehabilitation plan.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Home lower back rehabilitation and relaxation.
description: After finishing the noodles, Yu Xiaowen changed into loungewear and did targeted stretching on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on Cat Pose, Child's Pose, and spinal twists, holding each movement for 30 seconds. Then she placed a hot water bottle on her lower back for about 15 minutes and did additional core activation exercises. She resolved to strictly follow the principle of getting up to move around if she had been sitting for more than 45 minutes.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Formulated a home rehabilitation plan
description: After relaxing her body, Yu Xiaowen opened her laptop in the study, integrated the retrieved rehabilitation literature abstracts with previously noted key points, and drafted a detailed home rehabilitation plan for her father, covering specific movements and frequencies such as passive range-of-motion joint training, bedside sitting balance training, and Bobath hand-clasp exercises, supplemented with nutritional advice and safety precautions, and attached a progress record form. After finishing, she synced the PDF to the family WeChat group and @'d her brother and mother to ask for their opinions.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Read 'Better'.
description: Yu Xiaowen took *Better* from the bookshelf and read the chapter "How to Face Uncertainty in Medical Decisions." Drawing on the day's work and her father's condition, she wrote two insights in the margins: "When communicating, use 'we' more than 'you' to better build the physician-patient alliance," and "Translating medical knowledge into plain language is a key step in the family's rehabilitation plan."
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Wash up and soak feet.
description: She put down her book, took a bath to wash away the fatigue of the day, then soaked her feet in hot water while sending a WeChat message to her mother asking about her father’s mental state today and whether he could sit up. Her mother replied that her father was in good spirits and was trying to hold a spoon with his left hand. Yu Xiaowen felt warmed at heart.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Greet family on WeChat
description: After soaking her feet, Yu Xiaowen called her brother Yu Xiaofeng on WeChat voice. He described their father's rehabilitation in detail and praised her rehabilitation plan as professional and practical, saying he would coordinate with their mother to carry it out. Yu Xiaowen asked when his holiday would end, told him not to get too tired, and the siblings agreed to talk again tomorrow.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After hanging up, Yu Xiaowen prepared for tomorrow: she washed and boxed the fruit for lunch, took out the whole wheat bread for tomorrow's breakfast, and checked her commuter bag to confirm her keys, work badge, and charger. Then she set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning on her phone. Lying in bed, she reviewed the fulfilling day, feeling the groundedness that comes from connecting the way of work with family love, and slowly fell asleep to the sound of traffic outside the window.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Morning preparations and going to the hospital to accompany Father for breakfast.
description: At 6:50 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen woke up in the bedroom at her parents' home and first did lower back stretches to relieve discomfort. Then she walked to Yanjun Spicy Soup Shop on Shachang North Road and packed the liangchan her father liked, her mother's pan-fried buns, and scallion oil pancake. She then continued walking for about 30 minutes to the neurology ward of Luoyang Central Hospital, where she had breakfast with her mother at her father's bedside. The ward was filled with the warmth of family.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Assisted father with morning care and encouraged him
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowen helped her father with morning care, wiping his face and washing his hands, and patiently guided him to try to grip the cup with his affected hand. His fingers moved slightly, and Yu Xiaowen immediately and delightedly encouraged him, praising him that this was the best beginning.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Learned and assisted father with bedside rehabilitation exercises
description: Rehabilitation therapist Xiao Zhou arrived on time. Yu Xiaowen concentrated intently on learning the techniques for passive joint movement for her father, carefully recording the key points and repetition counts of each movement on her phone. Under the therapist's guidance, she personally performed flexion and extension of her father's upper limbs and ankle rotations, while using playful remarks to distract him. By the end of the training, her father's expression was clearly more relaxed.
location: Neurology ward and rehabilitation treatment area, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Father's rest, language stimulation, and personal intermittent activities
description: After the training, her father rested in bed. Yu Xiaowen played Debussy's 'Clair de Lune' for him, and holding up a world atlas, guided him to look at the location of Luoyang. Her father gently poked the map with his finger. Afterwards, she walked slowly in the corridor, did side-bend stretches to loosen her waist, and used her phone to time herself. During this period, she received a call from her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng and briefly talked about their father's condition.
location: Neurology ward and corridor, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Lunch at the hospital cafeteria.
description: At noon, Yu Xiaowen and her mother went to the staff canteen. She ordered a small bowl of beef noodles for her mother and chose mutton soup with flatbread for herself. The two chatted while eating, and her mother mentioned she would go home in the evening to pack a change of clothes for her father.
location: Staff Canteen, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Accompanied my father during his afternoon rest and rested with my eyes closed
description: After returning to the ward, her father was already drowsy. Yu Xiaowen adjusted his pillow, drew the curtains, and then sat on the caregiver's chair, put on an eye mask, and closed her eyes to rest, letting her mind briefly go blank.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Organize rehabilitation notes and synchronize updates with brother via video call
description: While her parents took their afternoon nap, Yu Xiaowen sat on a bench in the hallway and sketched the key points and movement diagrams from the morning's rehabilitation video into her notebook. Then she walked to the rest area, called her brother via video, described in detail her father's morning rehabilitation performance, and sent him the video. Her brother said he would try to return to Luoyang next weekend.
location: The corridor and rest area of the Neurology Department ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Walked home with her mother, doing some shopping along the way.
description: Yu Xiaowen and her mother said goodbye to her father and walked about 18 minutes to Dazhang Supermarket. Her mother bought the soft-bristled toothbrush and non-slip slippers her father needed, while Yu Xiaowen picked out a grip ball with a comfortable feel, planning to use it for her father's rehabilitation exercises. Then the two walked back to her parents' home.
location: Dazhang Supermarket (Shachang Store), No. 30 Shachang South Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, and parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road

name: Sorting out father's change of clothes with her mother
description: Back home, Yu Xiaowen and her mother sorted clothes in front of the bedroom wardrobe. Her mother pulled out her father's most comfortable cotton T-shirts and elastic-waist sweatpants, while Yu Xiaowen suggested bringing a reversible cardigan. As they folded clothes, her mother chattered about her father's quirks, and Yu Xiaowen jotted them down in her phone notes.
location: In front of the wardrobe in the master bedroom at the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Rested, stretched, packed personal items, and prepared books.
description: After organizing the clothes, Yu Xiaowen rested on the living room sofa, stretching her waist and legs to relieve fatigue. Then she went back to her room to pack thick coats and skincare products, and took out a bound volume of Readers and a world atlas from the bookshelf, planning to bring them to the hospital in the evening for her father's visual stimulation.
location: Living room and bedroom at the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Prepare dinner with mother and enjoy dinner together with conversation
description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen and her mother prepared dinner together in the kitchen. Her mother made millet pumpkin porridge, and Yu Xiaowen stir-fried tomatoes with eggs and garlic broccoli. During dinner, she mentioned the chapter about doctor-patient communication in Better, and remarked that communicating with her father also requires empathy. Her mother agreed and encouraged her to be more patient.
location: Parents' home kitchen and dining room at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Walk back to the hospital to visit her father
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowen changed into her coat, took her books and belongings, and walked alone for about 30 minutes back to the hospital. Pedestrians on the street gradually thinned out, and the cool breeze brushed against her face.
location: Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Visit father and check training results
description: Back in the ward, her father was awake. Yu Xiaowen took out the atlas again and showed it to him, feeling that his eyes seemed to light up. She checked his grip strength and felt it was a bit stronger than in the morning. During this time, she also confirmed with the nurse on duty the time of tomorrow's appointment with the rehabilitation therapist.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Take a taxi back to parents' home
description: After the visit, the night was cold. Yu Xiaowen called a ride-hailing car at the hospital entrance and returned to her parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road after about a 10-minute drive.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Washing up and soaking feet in hot water
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen washed up, deliberately filled a large basin with hot water to soak her feet, and played Clair de Lune on her phone, letting her nerves and lower back, tense all day, relax in the warm water.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: At-home lower back rehabilitation exercises.
description: After soaking her feet, Yu Xiaowen spread out her yoga mat in the bedroom and carefully completed 20 minutes of lower back stretching and core strength training, including glute bridges, bird-dog, and alternating supine leg raises. She felt the muscles in her lower back were in better condition than yesterday.
location: On the yoga mat in the bedroom at my parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Read 'Better' and organize the rehabilitation journal for sharing
description: Yu Xiaowen leaned against the headboard reading Chapter 6 of Better, and wrote her reflections beside the paragraph 'How to Face Treatment Failure.' Then she opened her laptop, organized today's rehabilitation notes and her father's small progress into a journal entry, and shared it in the family group chat with a caption encouraging her family.
location: At the bed and desk in the bedroom of my parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and going to bed.
description: Before bed, Yu Xiaowen turned off the desk lamp, put on earphones, closed her eyes, and meditated for 5 minutes, focusing on her breathing to drive away fatigue. Then she felt calm in body and mind. Reviewing the day, she was comforted by her father's cooperation and her family's understanding, and soon fell asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at the parents’ home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: At 7 a.m., Yu Xiaowen woke up in the bedroom at her parents' house as the alarm went off on time. The sky outside was cloudy, and the indoor heating was warm. She slipped into her pajamas, stood by the bed, and started her daily waist stretches and core training. After completing five sets of exercises, she felt her lower back and abdomen were stronger than yesterday, ready for a busy day.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Breakfast and preparing liquid food
description: After washing up, Yu Xiaowen went to the dining room. Her mother, Li Xiuying, had already made millet porridge and steamed buns. After the mother and daughter had a simple breakfast, they prepared liquid food for her father, Yu Jianguo, together: using a high-speed blender to puree cooked yam, carrot, and lean meat into a fine paste, then pouring it into a thermos cup. Yu Xiaowen made a point of testing the temperature to make sure it was not too hot before feeling relieved.
location: Parents' Home Restaurant, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Walk to the hospital
description: Yu Xiaowen put on her down jacket, hat, and gloves, took her thermos cup and backpack, and walked alone from her parents’ home to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University. The winter morning air was cold and crisp, and there were few pedestrians on the road. She quickly completed the familiar 8-minute walk along Kaixuan Road.
location: Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province (along the route from the parents' home to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University)

name: Nurse handover and morning care
description: After arriving at the ward, Yu Xiaowen briefly talked with the night-shift nurse about her father Yu Jianguo's sleep last night and vital signs. She then did morning care for her father together with her mother Li Xiuying: washing his face, helping him rinse his mouth, turning him over, and patting his back. She also carefully checked the passive range of motion of his left limbs and was delighted to find that his joints were a bit more flexible than yesterday.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Walked with father in the corridor for exercise
description: After the rehabilitation therapist arrived and assessed her father, he confirmed that he could attempt standing. Following the technique she learned yesterday, Yu Xiaowen had her father hold the handrail along the wall with his right hand, while she steadily supported his left hand and her mother guarded the other side. With the three of them working together, her father overcame the dizziness, slowly shuffled his feet, and walked about 50 meters with difficulty but determination. He did not complain of dizziness the whole time. Yu Xiaowen felt encouraged and, with tears in her eyes, took a photo of his back with her phone and sent it to the family group.
location: Neurology ward corridor, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Father rests and organizes rehabilitation notes
description: Father was helped back to bed to rest. Yu Xiaowen adjusted the backrest cushion for him and played his favorite light music on her phone. Then she sat by the bed, took out the rehabilitation notebook she carried with her, and recorded the details from the walking training just now—her father's gait, angle, support intensity, and so on—one by one, marking progress with a red pen. She then took a photo of the notes and shared it in the family group.
location: By the father's bedside in the Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Accompanying and assisting father in activities.
description: After finishing the notes, Yu Xiaowen returned to her father's bedside, took his hand, and guided him through simple fist-clenching and stretching exercises, gently encouraging him as they went. Her mother, Li Xiuying, sat nearby peeling fruit. Though the three of them didn't talk much, the ward was filled with a quiet sense of togetherness. Yu Xiaowen also massaged her father's calf muscles to promote circulation in his lower legs.
location: In the neurology ward of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Lunch at the hospital and accompanying father during his afternoon nap
description: Yu Xiaowen and her mother pushed the wheelchair together to the cafeteria and got light, nutritious food: a portion of stir-fried seasonal vegetables, mushroom chicken, and a bowl of tomato egg drop soup. The two ate and chatted. Her mother mentioned how her father was doing today, and her tone was much lighter than in previous days. After the meal, her father took his medicine and fell asleep. Yu Xiaowen sat in the caregiver chair, took out “Better” from her backpack, and read quietly in the soft light of the ward while keeping her father company during his nap.
location: Cafeteria and neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Relaxation and personal stretching
description: Her father was still taking an afternoon nap. Yu Xiaowen left the ward, paced back and forth in the spacious corridor, stretched her lower back that had been sitting for a long time, and did a few simple side stretches and relaxation movements, feeling the soreness in her waist greatly relieved.
location: Neurology ward corridor, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Accompanied her mother home and shopped at the supermarket
description: After asking the nurse to look after her father for a while, Yu Xiaowen walked home with her mother for a short rest, then accompanied her mother to Dazhang Supermarket near the residential community. The two pushed a shopping cart and bought Chinese yam, pork ribs, fresh vegetables, and some fruit. Her mother also specially bought Yu Xiaowen her favorite yogurt.
location: Parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, and the nearby Dazhang Supermarket (Kaixuan West Road Branch)

name: Ordered rehabilitation aids for my father
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen used her phone in the living room to compare several brands of non-slip slippers and bed rails on an e-commerce platform. She focused on anti-slip performance and installation convenience in user reviews, and finally ordered a pair of medical-grade non-slip rehabilitation slippers and a bed rail that requires no drilling, spending about 300 yuan in total, with a note for expedited shipping.
location: Living room of parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Tidied up the house and returned to the hospital.
description: After placing the order, Yu Xiaowen sorted and put away the purchased items, then took out her father's change of clothes from the cabinet and organized them. Then she put on an apron and helped her mother blanch the pork ribs and peel the Chinese yam to prepare for tomorrow's dinner. After finishing the chores, she changed clothes, picked up the packed clothing bag, and walked back to the hospital.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province — parents' home kitchen and living room, and the route walking to the hospital.

name: Visit father and check training outcomes.
description: Back in the hospital ward, her father had already woken up and was in good spirits. Yu Xiaowen helped him sit up, checked the grip strength of his left hand and the stability of his shoulder joint again, and compared them with the morning training data, finding a slight improvement in muscle strength. She carefully recorded these details in the rehabilitation log.
location: In the neurology ward of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Evening care and relaxing conversation
description: Yu Xiaowen wiped her father down, changed his clothes, and used a floor heating pad to apply a hot compress to his stiff left foot. As she did this, she softly talked with him about how today's walk had felt. He responded with his eyes and nods; although his speech was unclear, his expression was full of positive emotion.
location: In the neurology ward of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Hospital dinner.
description: After work, her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng rushed to the hospital, and the family had dinner together in the hospital cafeteria. Yu Xiaowen excitedly told her brother about their father's progress in taking steps today. Hearing this, her brother was very happy and praised her rehabilitation notes for being well done.
location: Canteen of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Walking around the neighborhood with my brother
description: After dinner, leaving her mother in the ward to look after her father, Yu Xiaowen and her older brother went for a walk in the community where their parents lived. They walked two laps around the central garden, discussing the progress of their father's rehabilitation and the next division of tasks. Yu Xiaowen mentioned that she had developed a strong interest in rehabilitation medicine, and her brother encouraged her to boldly try new directions. The 40-minute walk loosened up her waist and made her feel much more cheerful.
location: Inside Kaixuan Road Community, near No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Evening care, study, and reading
description: After returning from the walk, Yu Xiaowen went back to the ward, checked her father's daytime training records, and reconfirmed the rehabilitation therapist's schedule for the next day. Together with her mother, she did evening care for her father, checked the bedding, and made sure he was comfortable and ready for sleep. After her father and mother rested, she sat down in the rest area of the ward corridor, continued reading Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance, and wrote two pages of reading notes, focusing on the content about psychological support for patients' families. Thinking of her own experiences over the past few days, she was deeply moved.
location: Neurology ward and corridor rest area, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Organized today's rehabilitation log
description: Yu Xiaowen turned on her tablet and, sitting in the caregiver chair, organized today's rehabilitation log, recording in detail the specifics of her father's walking training, her own reflections, and next week's nursing points. When finished, she shared the log again to the family group and pinned it.
location: Caregiver chair in the Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Evening stretching, meditation, and bedtime
description: On the open space beside the companion chair, Yu Xiaowen laid out her yoga mat and did a gentle set of lower-back stretches and side-body relaxation movements to relieve the fatigue of a day of standing and walking. Then she used her phone to play guided meditation music, adjusted her breathing, and emptied her mind, while replaying in her head the step her father had taken today, feeling full of hope and strength. Warmed by these thoughts, she gradually grew drowsy. Finally, she turned off the music and her phone, covered herself with a blanket, and fell deeply asleep amid her father's steady breathing and the particular quiet of the hospital ward.
location: Beside the caregiver chair in the Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: After getting up, she did 15 minutes of lower back stretching in the bedroom, including Cat Pose, Child's Pose, and Bridge Pose, and felt that her morning stiffness had eased. Then she went to the kitchen and prepared breakfast with her mother, Li Xiuying: she peeled and steamed Chinese yam, while her mother warmed milk and steamed egg custard. After that, she put the steamed Chinese yam, egg whites from hard-boiled eggs, and a small amount of millet porridge into a food processor and blended them into a paste, then mashed the egg yolks and mixed them in to make a liquid diet for her father. During breakfast, she quickly ate millet porridge, a steamed roll, and cucumber salad, while putting her father's liquid diet and egg custard into an insulated bag. She checked her backpack and confirmed that she had her laptop, power bank, document pouch, and her father's ID card and medical insurance card.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Go to the hospital and assist father with morning care
description: She put on a down jacket, wrapped a scarf around her neck, and walked for about 12 minutes along Kaixuan West Road and Zhongzhou Middle Road to the Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University. After entering the neurology ward, she and her mother helped her father wash up, wipe his face, and change into a hospital gown. She gently massaged the paralyzed left side of her father's body and informed him of the day's arrangements. She then spoke with the nurse on duty and the rehabilitation therapist to confirm the discharge procedure for the next day (expected to be handled at 10:00 a.m.), and asked about the precautions for taking the antiplatelet medication among the discharge medications.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Contact a classmate to schedule community home rehabilitation guidance
description: Walked to the end of the corridor beside the neurology ward and contacted a college classmate via WeChat. My roommate Sun Lihua replied that she works at the Kaixuan East Road Community Health Service Center in Xigong District. After making a voice call, I explained my father's condition (54 years old, left-sided hemiplegia and aphasia after cerebral infarction, with grip strength and walking recovering, discharged on January 27). Sun Lihua said the center provides family doctor contract and home rehabilitation guidance services. After detailed communication, we successfully booked an in-home assessment and rehabilitation guidance for 9:00 a.m. on January 30 (the second day of Lunar New Year), and she promised to include my father's information in the chronic disease management file. After the call, I sent the appointment details to the family group chat.
location: Corridor beside the neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Ward companionship and limb mobility training
description: After returning to the ward, her father was awake. She told him the good news about the rehabilitation appointment, and he blinked and smiled. Then she performed routine bedside limb activities: massaging the muscles of his left arm and leg, guiding him to hold a grip ball with his right hand for fist-clenching and relaxation training; helping him sit up, saying short sentences slowly and clearly in his ear, pointing to the world map in the ward and naming a few countries to observe his reaction.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Lunch at the hospital cafeteria.
description: Her older brother Yu Xiaofeng rushed over, and the family decided to have lunch in the staff cafeteria. After feeding their father liquid food through a nasogastric tube, she and her brother went to the cafeteria and ordered two bowls of braised beef noodles, and brought back stir-fried vegetables and rice for their mother. Back in the ward, they sat around the small table eating, in a relaxed atmosphere. She shared how she had contacted an old classmate, and her brother said the bedside handrail frame he bought online had been shipped and was expected to arrive tomorrow.
location: Staff cafeteria and wards, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Walking in the ward corridor and organizing thoughts.
description: After the meal, she walked slowly back and forth alone in the neurology ward corridor for 20 minutes and used the memo on her phone to jot down thoughts on her father's rehabilitation plan: after the community rehabilitation therapist comes, she needs to confirm the specific methods for speech training and precautions for home environment modification.
location: Neurology ward corridor, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Organize rehabilitation notes and sync to the family group.
description: While her father was taking his afternoon nap, she sat in the companion chair, opened her laptop, and organized the key points from her phone memos into clearly structured rehabilitation notes. The notes included the number of times her father used the grip ball, his responses to language stimulation, and details of the scheduled community rehabilitation, with emphasis on the evaluation time on the second day of the Chinese New Year. After finishing, she synced the notes to the [Yu Family Health Guardian] family group, specifically @-mentioning her brother and mother.
location: Neurology ward caregiving area, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Organizing the discharge belongings checklist with her older brother
description: After her father woke from his afternoon nap, she received a notice from the nurse that he could be discharged the next day and collected several information sheets. She and her brother sorted things out separately: her brother inventoried the hospital daily necessities, while she classified documents—ID card, medical insurance card, deposit receipt, discharge summary, disease diagnosis certificate, and discharge medication prescriptions—by importance into a document folder. She also worked with her brother to make a 'tomorrow discharge to-do' list, which they wrote on a sticky note and pasted on the folder cover.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Went to a nearby convenience store to stock up on additional items.
description: To make tomorrow's discharge smoother, she walked out of the hospital alone and walked along Zhongzhou Middle Road for about 5 minutes to find Nuanyang Convenience Store. According to her memo, she bought a pack of individually wrapped soda crackers, two bottles of mineral water, and a box of tissues. Then she bought medical cotton swabs and medical tape at the pharmacy next door.
location: Nuanyang Convenience Store, Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, and the nearby pharmacy.

name: Confirm the discharge process and communicate with the doctor
description: When she returned to the hospital, her father was exercising his lower limbs under the guidance of the rehabilitation therapist, so she let her mother go rest first. Carrying a document folder, she went to the doctor's office and found the attending physician to confirm the discharge procedures: first go to the nurses' station to settle the discharge bill and pick up medication, then go to the first-floor lobby with the discharge summary to complete the formalities. The doctor instructed that her father continue taking the medication at home (including the specific dosage and times) and return for an outpatient follow-up one week later. She wrote down the doctor's orders and asked the doctor to make a note on the discharge summary.
location: Neurology ward and doctors' office, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Ward dinner
description: After finishing the hospital affairs, her brother went to the staff canteen to buy stir-fried broccoli, braised pork ribs, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and millet porridge. After feeding their father his special liquid food, the family sat around the small table in the ward and ate. Her mother mentioned that she would thoroughly clean the house tomorrow; her brother said he had already taken leave for tomorrow to help with the procedures. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Neurology ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Evening walk, stretching, and walking home
description: Politely declining my brother's offer to see me off, I first walked slowly for 20 minutes in the hospital's small garden, reviewing the past few days and thinking about the key points I needed to remind my family about for tomorrow's discharge. Then I did 15 minutes of stretching on a garden bench, focusing on relaxing my lower back. After stretching, it was already dark. I put on the down jacket hood and walked quickly back along Kaixuan West Road to my parents' home.
location: Small garden inside Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, and Kaixuan West Road

name: Organized today's rehabilitation journal and shared it.
description: She returned to the bedroom at home, washed her hands, sat at the desk, opened her laptop, and organized the day's observation records and insights into a complete rehabilitation log. She recorded in detail limb activity, language stimulation responses, community rehabilitation appointment details, the discharge checklist, and the doctor's instructions. Finally, she wrote words of encouragement and shared the log to the family group.
location: Parents’ home, own bedroom: No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Washing up and relaxing with a foot soak
description: Went into the bathroom to take a hot shower, filled a large basin with hot water and bath salts to soak my feet, and enjoyed a relaxing moment. My mother occasionally asked about tomorrow's plans from the living room while I soaked my feet and listened to classical music.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Read 'Better' and took notes.
description: Changed into pajamas and curled up in bed, read the chapter 'How to Communicate with Difficult Family Members' in 'Better'. Combining it with her own caregiving experience, she gained new insights and wrote down a few takeaways in her notebook, including the importance of empathy and perspective-taking.
location: Parents’ home, own bedroom: No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Check the items for tomorrow's discharge and set an alarm
description: She opened the document bag again to confirm that the ID card, medical insurance card, and deposit receipt were all inside. She helped set her mother's phone alarm for 7:00 tomorrow morning, and adjusted her own phone alarm to 6:50, to ensure everything was foolproof.
location: Parents’ home, own bedroom: No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Write in diary and go to sleep
description: She took the locked diary out of the drawer and wrote the day's summary, recording progress such as contacting community rehabilitation and organizing discharge items, expressing her reflections on growing in the dual role of doctor and daughter, as well as her anticipation and nervousness about her father coming home tomorrow. After writing the diary, she turned off the desk lamp, leaving only the night light, reviewed tomorrow's discharge procedures in her mind, and after confirming everything was accurate, slowly fell asleep.
location: Parents’ home, own bedroom: No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Wake up, wash up, and share the discharge breakfast
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen woke up in the old house in Luoyang. After washing up briefly, she saw that her older brother Yu Xiaofeng had already bought the tofu pudding from Wang Ji's that their father loved, along with fried dough sticks. The family sat around the dining table, checking the discharge procedures for the day while eating breakfast. Her mother filled a bowl of hot tofu pudding for Xiaowen, and Xiaowen felt her fatigue disappear and became much more at ease.
location: Henan Province, Luoyang City, Xigong District, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, old residence

name: Rechecked the discharge documents.
description: Yu Xiaowen and her brother checked the discharge checklist, examination reports, medical insurance reimbursement materials, and their father's ID card, medical insurance card, and other documents one by one again, and put them in a document folder. Xiaowen also checked the voice memo about home care precautions recorded on her phone yesterday. After confirming everything was correct, the two put on thick coats and took an empty backpack for the discharge supplies, ready to leave.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, living room of the old house

name: Walk to the hospital
description: The brother and sister walked to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University. The morning air in Luoyang was cool and crisp, with sunlight spilling onto the sidewalks. They crossed Kaixuan Road, walked west along Zhongzhou Middle Road, and reached the outpatient building after about 15 minutes.
location: Walk from No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University

name: Wait for ward rounds and confirm discharge
description: After arriving at the ward, her father Yu Jianguo had already washed up and was sitting on the bed. Xiaowen and her brother accompanied their father while waiting for the doctor's rounds. At 8:30, the attending physician made routine rounds, carefully asked about her father's condition, and checked his vital signs and limb mobility. The doctor confirmed that all indicators were stable and met the discharge criteria, issued a discharge notice, and again verbally explained the key points of home rehabilitation, including taking aspirin and statins consistently and doing rehabilitation exercises step by step. Xiaowen recorded the entire process and took brief notes.
location: Neurology ward, inpatient department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Complete hospital discharge procedures and collect medication.
description: After the doctor's rounds, Xiaowen and her brother divided up the tasks. Xiaowen took the hospitalization deposit receipt and medical insurance card to the inpatient billing window to settle the fees. After checking the bill, she paid the remaining balance with her debit card. Her brother went to the pharmacy and queued up to collect the discharge medications prescribed by the doctor: aspirin, atorvastatin, and two bottles of nerve-repair medicine. The two met up in the hospital corridor.
location: Inpatient Department payment window and pharmacy, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Tidied up the ward and prepared to return home.
description: Back in the ward, the brother and sister began packing their personal belongings. Xiaowen organized her father's clothes, toiletries, and medical records, sorted the discharge medications, and labeled them with usage and dosage using a marker. Her brother was responsible for carrying the lighter luggage. After confirming nothing was left behind, Xiaowen went to the nurse station to complete the final handover procedures.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Escorted my father home by car.
description: At 11:30 a.m., Xiaowen and her brother pushed their father to the hospital entrance in a wheelchair provided by the hospital. Xiaowen used a mobile app to book a spacious private car, and the driver arrived smoothly. The siblings carefully helped their father into the back seat. Xiaowen sat beside her father, carrying emergency medicine and an oxygen pack, comforting him attentively along the way and asking if he felt any discomfort. After about forty minutes, the car arrived steadily at the bottom of the old family house.
location: From the entrance of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, take a car to No. 42, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Came home, got settled, and discovered the Spring Festival couplet surprise.
description: Xiaowen and her elder brother helped their father through the front door of the ground-floor home. Her mother, Li Xiuying, had already laid out warm bedding. Xiaowen noticed that Aunt Zhao Xiulan had indeed kept her promise—on the front door she had put up brand-new red spring couplets with gold lettering and the character 'Fu', looking very festive. She supported her father as he slowly walked to the door. Seeing the couplets, her father broke into the first relaxed smile since his admission to the hospital. Xiaowen immediately took a photo of this precious moment and sent it to the family WeChat group.
location: 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, the old house's front gate and living room

name: Family lunch and rest
description: Her mother, Li Xiuying, prepared a light and delicious lunch: millet porridge, stir-fried vegetables, steamed egg, and fish that her father loved. The family sat around the dining table, eating and chatting in a relaxed atmosphere. Xiaowen reminded her father to take his medication on time and reviewed the key points of his rehabilitation exercises. After the meal, her father went to the bedroom for a nap. Xiaowen and her brother helped clear the table, and Xiaowen also helped her mother wipe clean the cane and wheelchair used for her father's daily care, placing them in a corner where they were easy to reach.
location: Dining room of the old family home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Tidy up the room and set out the commemorative coins.
description: After settling her father in, Xiaowen returned to her south-facing bedroom. She opened her suitcase, took out the zodiac commemorative coin collection box she had treasured for years, and gently placed it on the windowsill. She deliberately put the ox, representing her father's zodiac sign, and the sheep, representing her mother's, at the very front. After doing this, she stood quietly by the window for a while, watching the sunlight spill over the gleaming commemorative coins, feeling a long-lost sense of home and security.
location: Yu Xiaowen's bedroom in the old residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Consult on community rehabilitation guidance.
description: At 3 p.m., Xiaowen and her brother walked again to the community rehabilitation guidance center, about a 15-minute walk from home. They found the rehabilitation therapist they had previously booked an appointment with and asked about a specific daily functional training plan after discharge, including balance training, fine finger movement exercises, and assistance techniques for going up and down stairs. The therapist also demonstrated a few simple exercises that could be done at home. Xiaowen took detailed notes in her memo app again.
location: Community Rehabilitation Guidance Center, 1st Floor, Huaxia Plaza, Xigong District, Luoyang

name: Accompanied father in home rehabilitation exercises
description: After returning home, Xiaowen invited her father to do his first home rehabilitation in the living room and hallway. Following the rehabilitation therapist's guidance, she supported her father as he slowly walked back and forth along the hallway three times, and encouraged him to try some finger-grip exercises. She encouraged him throughout and patiently corrected his posture. Although her father moved slowly, he was very cooperative. After the walking, Xiaowen massaged her father's legs and told him they would continue tomorrow.
location: Old house living room hallway, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: Xiaowen went into the kitchen to help her mother. Her mother was preparing the first proper hometown-style dinner after her father was discharged from the hospital: spicy soup and hand-pulled noodles. Xiaowen was in charge of washing and cutting vegetables, and the mother and daughter chatted while working. Her older brother, meanwhile, accompanied their father in the living room watching TV, playing the opera program their father liked. The aroma from the kitchen and the laughter from the living room intertwined, filling the home with vitality again.
location: Old-house kitchen and living room, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Hearty dinner and family memories
description: Dinner was very rich; the hulatang made by mother was sour and spicy and appetizing, and the huimian noodles were chewy and smooth. The family chatted while eating, and the topic unconsciously turned to memories of Yu Xiaowen and her older brother spending the New Year in Luoyang as children. Father also became interested and recounted the fun stories of taking Xiaowen to set off fireworks on the street and buying zodiac commemorative coins. Xiaowen laughed and echoed, while carefully putting food on her father's plate and reminding him to eat slowly.
location: Dining room of the old family home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Video call with a good friend.
description: After dinner, Xiaowen sent video invitations respectively to her close friend Wang Lina, who was far away in Shenzhen, and her best friend Zhang Jing in Zhengzhou. She happily told them that her father had been smoothly discharged from the hospital today, and also let them see, through the screen, her father's mental state and the Spring Festival couplets at the entrance of the house. Wang Lina and Zhang Jing were both very happy and urged Xiaowen not to be too tired, saying they would celebrate for her after she returned to Zhengzhou. Xiaowen felt warm inside, feeling that her friends really cared about her.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, living room of the old family home (video call)

name: Relaxing stretches before bed
description: After washing up, Xiaowen returned to her room. Instead of going to bed immediately, she spread out her yoga mat and did the before-bed stretching she had been keeping up with recently. The 10-minute stretch relieved the soreness in her lower back and the day's fatigue. Afterward, rather than listening to classical music as usual, she opened her phone and watched for a while a new wheel-throwing teaching video that Master Zheng Guodong had posted in the group, warming up in advance for her pottery class after returning to Zhengzhou.
location: Yu Xiaowen's bedroom in the old residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Recorded rehabilitation diary and reflections.
description: Xiaowen took out her notebook and wrote down the important matters of her father's discharge today: daily medication times, key rehabilitation exercises, doctor's instructions, and so on. After writing, she looked at the row of commemorative coins on the windowsill and, moved by the moment, wrote a few lines at the end of her diary: "Dad's laughter is the best medicine. Home finally has the flavor of the New Year."
location: At the desk of the old residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: At exactly 10 p.m., Xiaowen turned off the desk lamp, and the room fell into silence. Listening to the occasional sound of traffic outside the window, she felt an unprecedented sense of peace and relaxation. Her father had made it home safely, and her family was all well — for her, that was the best New Year gift. With a settled heart, she fell into a deep sleep.
location: Old house bedroom, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Morning greeting to father
description: Fine snow was falling outside the window in the early morning. She woke up naturally in the down quilt at home and went downstairs to her father's room. Her father had just woken up. After greeting him softly, she helped him do ankle pump and fist clenching exercises in bed, and noted that his mental state was fairly good today.
location: Second-floor bedroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China.

name: Simple wash-up and tidying
description: She washed up quickly, changed into comfortable cotton loungewear, tied her hair into a bun, and blended into the warm family atmosphere in the best state.
location: Bathroom on the second floor of parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Chinese New Year's Eve breakfast and family chat
description: Mother prepared steaming hot hulatang and fried dough cakes, and the whole family sat around the table for the meal. My elder brother told an amusing story about winning a Switch at the Shenzhen company annual meeting. Father slowly drank his porridge, with a smile at the corners of his mouth. I finished a bowl of hulatang and half a fried dough cake, feeling especially grounded.
location: Dining room on the first floor of the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China.

name: New Year goods inventory and food ingredient check.
description: After the meal, she checked the New Year's goods in the refrigerator and storage cabinets together with her mother and older brother. Her mother took out a notebook, and she updated the list in her phone memo. They confirmed that the high-gluten flour for braised noodles, the lotus root for stewing ribs, and the yam and lean meat needed for her father's liquid diet were all ready.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Making Traditional Huimian Noodles
description: Under her mother's guidance, she learned to make huimian noodles. First, she mixed the dough, controlling the ratio of salted water, kneaded it into a smooth dough, and covered it with a damp cloth to rest. Half an hour later, she divided the dough into small pieces, brushed them with oil, and let them rest again. Finally, following her mother's example, she pulled the dough with both hands into wide, long noodles. Although some broke, she was encouraged and felt it was quite good for a first attempt.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Final sprint on preparing ingredients for the New Year's Eve dinner.
description: She took over the task of cooking yam and lean pork porridge for her father and simmered it over low heat. Her brother was assembling the newly bought storage rack in the living room, occasionally coming over to help their mother chop green onions. As she stirred the pot, she looked through the half-open door at her father watching TV on the living room sofa, and felt content.
location: Kitchen and living room of the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Simple lunch and a short break
description: At noon, the family had a simple meal of dumplings stuffed with pickled cabbage that Mother had wrapped that morning. After the meal, my brother volunteered to wash the dishes, and I leaned back on the living room sofa to rest for 20 minutes, nearly falling asleep listening to the opera channel.
location: Dining room and living room at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Assisting father with indoor rehabilitation walking
description: In the afternoon, sunlight briefly broke through the clouds. She and her brother supported their father on either side as he walked from the sofa to the balcony window and back. Father walked very slowly, but his steps were steadier than yesterday. She counted his steps to encourage him, and her brother teased that Father would soon be well enough to visit him in Shenzhen.
location: Living room of parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China

name: Preparing New Year's Eve dinner dishes and finishing the porridge.
description: After my father's afternoon nap, I did the final cooking prep with my mother and older brother. I was in charge of turning off the heat and keeping the Chinese yam and lean pork congee warm, preparing the braised noodles' topping soup base (lamb, daylily flowers, wood ear mushrooms, and dried tofu), and handling the sweet and sour pork tenderloin (cutting strips and marinating with cooking wine and egg white). My mother simmered pork rib and lotus root soup, while my brother peeled garlic and set the table. The kitchen was steaming and filled with aroma.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Send a short New Year greeting video
description: Taking advantage of the time before the meal, she picked up her phone and filmed a short video of everyone bustling in the kitchen. Facing the camera, she sent New Year wishes to her good friends Jingjing, Nana, and Sun Yue, hoping everyone would get better and better. She sent it to the WeChat group and soon received replies and a video call invitation. After a brief chat, she hung up.
location: Kitchen and living room of the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Set the table for the New Year's Eve dinner and sit down with family
description: Together with my brother, I brought the cooked dishes to the table. My brother took out my father's treasured Moutai, poured a small cup for himself, and let my father smell the aroma. I placed in front of my father his special yam and lean pork congee, stir-fried wax gourd, and sweet and sour pork strips with less oil and sugar. The colorful dishes filled the table, full of New Year atmosphere.
location: Parents' home dining room, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: New Year's Eve dinner and family reunion.
description: Outside, the sky was gradually darkening, and the lights made the dining room warm and bright. The whole family raised their glasses and wished one another a happy New Year, good health, and safety. I fed my father a spoonful of his favorite low-sugar sweet-and-sour pork, and his eyes became a little moist. During the meal, I told a case from my department in which resuscitation succeeded after a close call. My older brother suggested doing more to spread health knowledge, and my mother joked that next Spring Festival it would be my turn to bring a partner home.
location: Parents' home dining room, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Watch the CCTV Spring Festival Gala
description: After briefly clearing the table, the whole family moved to the sofa in the living room and turned on CCTV-1 for the Spring Festival Gala. Her mother roasted sunflower seeds and peeled tangerines. She snuggled up to her mother, while her father and older brother sat on the other side. When a sketch about medical staff came on, she remembered the hardships of the past half month, and her eyes reddened. Her mother gently patted her hand to comfort her.
location: Living room of parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China

name: Assisting Father with Mobility and Pre-Bedtime Preparation
description: Father was a little tired. I helped him stand up from the sofa and walk slowly twice around the living room to promote blood circulation. Then I helped him wash up, supported him back to the bedroom to lie down, covered him with the quilt, dimmed the bedside lamp, and told him I would wake him up at midnight to celebrate the New Year together.
location: Living room and father's bedroom at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China.

name: Family free time
description: After Dad rested, the TV was left on with the volume turned down. Mom, my brother, and I brewed tea and chatted. Meanwhile, I helped Mom wash and put away the kitchen dishes. Then we watched highlights of the Spring Festival Gala together. My brother connected the Switch to the TV and taught us to play the motion-sensing game Just Dance; our clumsy moves made everyone laugh heartily, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Parents' home living room and kitchen, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Staying up to see in the New Year and taking a family photo
description: Just before midnight, I woke up Dad. The whole family crowded around his bed in the bedroom. Sporadic firecrackers sounded outside the window, and the countdown was on TV. When midnight struck, everyone shouted 'Happy New Year' in unison. I immediately took out my phone and snapped a family photo; we were all squeezed together, beaming.
location: Father's bedroom on the second floor and the living room on the first floor of the parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China.

name: Exchanging good wishes and tidying up
description: She immediately sent the family photo to the family group and the friends group, with the message "Happy New Year, health is happiness!" Everyone replied with blessings. After that, her brother helped her father back to his room to rest, and she and her mother cleaned up the tea table and nut shells, covered the leftovers from the New Year's Eve dinner with plastic wrap, and put them in the refrigerator.
location: Dining room and kitchen at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China.

name: Pre-sleep relaxation, journaling, and bedtime
description: Back in my room, I did 10 minutes of full-body stretching on the yoga mat, focusing on relaxing my lower back. Then I wrote in my phone memo: New Year's Eve braised noodles were a success, father is well, family reunited, tired but worth it, full of hope. After setting the alarm for 9 a.m. the next day, I turned off the desk lamp and fell into a deep sleep listening to the firecrackers outside and the rustling of snow against the window.
location: Second-floor bedroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China.

name: Morning wake-up and morning stretch
description: Yu Xiaowen woke up naturally under the effect of her biological clock. Although she had stayed up until 1 a.m. for New Year's Eve, she was in good spirits. After washing up, she changed into comfortable loungewear and felt some stiffness in her lower back from sitting up late during the New Year's Eve vigil. Then she walked to the balcony, spread out her yoga mat, and in the cool but sunlit air began a 15-minute full-body stretch, paying special attention to her waist, shoulders, neck, and legs. Each movement was slow and deep. After stretching, she felt her body gradually loosen up and her spirits lift.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Family breakfast.
description: At the dining table, mother Li Xiuying had already prepared breakfast: steaming millet porridge, boiled eggs, homemade steamed red bean paste buns, and several small dishes of pickled vegetables. Father Yu Jianguo was in good spirits, sitting at the table and slowly drinking his porridge. Yu Xiaowen and her older brother Yu Xiaofeng chatted about the Spring Festival Gala sketches from last night. The family talked and laughed, enjoying the warmth of the holiday.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Making a review plan and coordinating with family.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowen went to the study and took out from her suitcase the review notes and textbooks for the attending physician exam, along with the book Better and her reading notebook. She opened the calendar on her phone, marked the 30th and 31st as “closed-door review days,” and made a detailed two-day plan: mornings focused on the respiratory system, afternoons on the cardiovascular system, with practice questions interspersed. Then she left the study, found her brother Yu Xiaofeng in the living room pouring water for their father, and told him about her two-day review plan. She asked him to take on more responsibility for caring for their father during the day to ensure that she could have at least 2 hours of uninterrupted study time each day. Her brother agreed readily and told her to focus on studying with peace of mind.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Accompanying father for a walk in the garden.
description: Yu Xiaowen supported her father and slowly walked out of the house to the community garden. The garden was decorated with lanterns and colorful banners, full of festive New Year atmosphere. Using a four-legged walking frame, her father walked steadily step by step. She stayed by his side, chatting while they walked about the red lanterns newly hung in the courtyard and about neighbors passing by exchanging New Year greetings. The walk lasted about 15 minutes. Her father felt a bit tired, so she helped him sit on a bench for a while.
location: Garden of No. 42 Residential Community, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Organize review materials.
description: Back home, Yu Xiaowen went into the study again. She sorted the review materials she had brought by system, put Better at the top to remind herself to finish a chapter, and wrote a list of the difficult points she needed to tackle over the next two days, sticking it to the corner of the desk. With everything ready, she felt full of anticipation for the next two days of study.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Send New Year greetings to elders via video call
description: Yu Xiaowen sat on the sofa, took out her phone, and started making video New Year's calls. She first connected with her cousin Li Yaqin in Hangzhou, telling her that her father was recovering very well, and her cousin also urged her to take care of herself. Then she called several other elders via video, sending each of them New Year greetings one by one, and conveyed her parents' gratitude.
