location: Own bedroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Getting up, morning care, and lower back activation.
description: Woke up naturally at 7:15 a.m.; the indoor heating felt as warm as spring. After basic washing up, changed into a loose set of loungewear. Especially did 5 minutes of cat stretch and child's pose relaxation on the bedroom carpet, focusing on relieving the soreness and tightness in the lower back from standing for a long time while accompanying father yesterday. Opened the curtains; it was a cloudy day outside, temperature above zero but not windy, suitable for going out.
location: Parents' home bedroom, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Help prepare breakfast and family meals
description: When she walked out of the bedroom, her mother was busy in the kitchen. Her mother added the pre-soaked red dates and goji berries to the bubbling millet porridge and steamed the handmade buns bought yesterday. The family of four sat around the dining table. With the help of his wife, her father tried to hold a spoon steadily with his left hand to drink porridge; it was difficult but he was in a good mood. Her older brother, Yu Xiaofeng, shared interesting stories from Shenzhen, saying that a colleague went to Hainan during the Spring Festival and was blown around by the sea wind, making everyone laugh heartily. Her mother peeled a boiled egg for Xiaowen and told her to eat more since studying for the exam required energy.
location: Dining room at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Tidying up and preparing to go out
description: After breakfast, she cleaned up the dishes with her brother and wiped the table. She put the review materials for the attending physician exam she had organized the night before and her father's compartmentalized pillbox into her canvas backpack. Her brother changed shoes at the entrance and reminded her to dress warmly because it was cold. Xiaowen put on her long down jacket, wrapped a scarf around her neck, and left the house with her brother.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province; parents' home living room and foyer.

name: Walk to the hospital
description: The siblings walked west along Kaixuan Road. Along the way, they saw red paper reading 'Welcoming the God of Wealth' still pasted on many shop doors, and occasional sporadic firecracker sounds—the New Year atmosphere still lingered. As they walked and chatted, the elder brother talked about the newly formed project team; the overseas-returned team members' active thinking put pressure on him but he could learn a lot. Xiaowen shared several typical cases she had encountered during her rotations. The two chatted engrossed. After 15 minutes, they walked through the gate of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University.
location: On the walking route from No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University at No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road.

name: Hospital caregiving and rehabilitation training.
description: When she entered the ward at 8:45, her father had already finished washing up and was sitting on the edge of the bed. She first assisted the duty nurse in turning her father over and patting his back, with gentle and professional movements. Around 9:00, the rehabilitation therapist arrived. Under the therapist's guidance, Xiaowen and her brother stood on either side of her father, propped up his affected arm with a soft pillow, and then guided him to hold the affected wrist with his healthy hand and slowly lift it upward for passive stretching. Xiaowen softly counted the rhythm: 'Dad, great, hold it for another 5 seconds, relax.' Her father's forehead broke out in a fine sweat, but he was very cooperative. During a break, Xiaowen walked to the end of the corridor to drink some water and did two shoulder and neck circles to relieve her tense muscles. At 11:15, the training ended. She helped her father lie down to rest and agreed to visit him again in the afternoon.
location: Neurology Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Walk home
description: After leaving the hospital, her brother suggested eating the egg noodles with sauce that their mother made. Xiaowen smiled and said Mom must have already prepared it. Passing a newsstand at the hospital gate, Xiaowen bought a copy of Chinese National Geography magazine as a light read during afternoon study breaks.
location: On the walk from Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University to her parents' home at 42 Kaixuan Road.

name: Family lunch and midday rest.
description: Back home, Mother had indeed prepared egg and tomato noodles, served with minced garlic and shredded cucumber. The family sat around the table, and Xiaowen and her brother vividly described Father's rehabilitation progress that day, making Mother beam with joy. After the meal, she took the initiative to clear the dishes, and at 13:00 she and her brother each found a comfortable position on the living room sofa, ready for an afternoon nap.
location: Dining room and living room at parents’ home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Short midday rest
description: Set a 25-minute alarm on my phone, covered myself with a small blanket on the sofa, and rested with eyes closed. The brief rest restored a lot of energy.
location: Sofa in the living room of parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Studying for the attending physician exam.
description: After waking up, she made a cup of hot tea and went to the quiet study. She took out the attending physician exam textbook and iPad, and began to focus on the respiratory diseases chapter—the differential diagnosis of bronchial asthma and COPD and the management principles for acute exacerbations. She spent 40 minutes studying the textbook and highlighting key points, then did 40 practice questions on a question-bank app, with an accuracy rate of about 72%. She screenshotted the wrong questions and organized them into a Notion mistake notebook, and wrote detailed annotations next to several wrong questions about changes in blood gas analysis during acute asthma attacks.
location: Parents' home study, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Rest and stretching between study sessions
description: After two hours of continuous study, she felt eye strain and lower back fatigue. She stood up, walked to the floor-to-ceiling window, and looked out at the street view. She did a few standing forward bends and chest-opening exercises to mobilize her lumbar spine and shoulder blades. She took out her father's compartmentalized pillbox, double-checked the medication list she was about to organize, and got herself back into a good state.
location: Parents' home study, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Organize father's medications and memos
description: Back at her desk, she officially began organizing her father's pillbox. She took out the discharge medication list and checked it item by item: aspirin enteric-coated tablets, atorvastatin calcium tablets, nifedipine controlled-release tablets, and ambroxol hydrochloride tablets. Using a moisture-proof compartmentalized pillbox, she sorted the medications into morning, midday, evening, and bedtime, and used a small label printer to put clear labels on each compartment, such as Morning: Aspirin 1 tablet + Atorvastatin 1 tablet; Evening: Nifedipine 1 tablet. She also wrote a precautions card and clipped it to the case, reminding her mother to be sure to double-check. When done, she stood up and stretched her lower back.
location: Parents' home study, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Helping my mother prepare dinner
description: Walking into the kitchen, she saw her mother preparing to make tomato egg noodles. Xiaowen tied on an apron and helped beat the eggs, cut the tomatoes, and wash the greens. Her mother began kneading the dough and rolling out the noodles. She chatted with her mother as she worked, mentioning that her father's statin medication required regular liver function checks, and her mother took careful note.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Ward meal delivery and family dinner
description: Her mother carefully packed the freshly cooked tomato-egg noodles into an insulated jar. Her brother carried the jar, and the family of four walked to the hospital again. In her father's ward, her mother set up the tray table and served the noodles. Seeing the steaming noodles, her father was in a good mood and insisted on trying to eat with a spoon in his left hand. His movements were clumsy, but he ate with great relish. Xiaowen and her brother also sat around with their own bowls, and the ward was filled with the warm aroma of food and cheerful conversation.
location: Ward of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Family heart-to-heart talk and warm moments after dinner
description: After dinner, Xiaowen and her older brother cleared the table. Her brother took out his phone and began showing his parents photos from his company's annual party in Shenzhen, the green plants at his desk, and scenery from hiking Fenghuang Mountain over the weekend. He vividly talked about his hard work in Shenzhen, and once again said solemnly to his parents, Dad, Mom, don't worry. I'm doing very well in Shenzhen. Every month I will regularly send 5,000 yuan home as Dad's rehabilitation expenses, and the money I keep is more than enough. Hearing this, Xiaowen nodded quietly, filled with emotion and admiration. Their father's eyes glistened with tears, and their mother held her son's hand and kept saying how good that was.
location: Ward of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Gather belongings and walk home
description: The after-dinner heart-to-heart talk lasted until 19:30. Xiaowen and her brother helped pack up the insulated food containers and other items, said goodbye to their father, and walked out of the hospital together. On the night of the fifth day of the Lunar New Year, the streets felt a little cold and quiet under the streetlights. Her brother walked ahead, turned back, and told Xiaowen that she had been working too hard preparing for the exam and should not push herself too hard; health mattered most. Xiaowen felt warm inside and acknowledged him.
location: On the walk from Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University to her parents' home at 42 Kaixuan Road.

name: Evening relaxation and lower back care.
description: After arriving home, she changed into loose pajamas, took out the foam roller she had brought, and did a 5-minute rolling massage on the living room carpet to relax her lower back, mainly rolling the muscles on both sides of her waist and her buttocks, which eased the soreness somewhat. Then she went into the bathroom, washed her face with hot water, and did basic moisturizing skincare.
location: Parents' home living room and bathroom, No. 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Mood journaling and casual chat with family
description: After washing up, she sat on the bed in her bedroom, took out her phone, and wrote a short note in the memo app: "Fifth day of the first lunar month, I did rehab with Dad and it seems like there's a little progress. My brother's promise makes me feel extremely at ease. The noodles in the ward tonight were the most delicious." After writing, she walked out of the bedroom and saw Mother and her brother still in the living room drinking tea and chatting, so she sat down and listened to her brother talk about interesting things from his business trip to Hainan. The whole family was happy and at ease.
location: Parents' home bedroom and living room, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and browsing pottery videos
description: Back in the room, she did a 10-minute pre-sleep stretch on the yoga mat by the bed, focusing on relaxing her legs and back. Then she lay down on the bed, put on her earphones, opened Bilibili, and browsed pottery teaching videos. She saw a tutorial on making a "one-sip cup" and found it interesting, thinking she would go to the studio to try it after returning to Zhengzhou.
location: Parents' home bedroom, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Organizing items for the next day and relaxing to music.
description: Using the screen so late at night is bad for the eyes, so I turned off the video. I opened the white noise app and played the light music "Forest Night" to relax my nerves. At the same time, I tidied up what I needed to bring tomorrow: review materials, a power bank, and a water bottle. I did not set an alarm and decided to let my body wake up naturally and get plenty of rest.
location: Parents' home bedroom, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: She turned off the bedside lamp and lay quietly in the dark. Images of the family being together today flashed through her mind, and she felt extremely at ease and content. She took a deep breath, closed her eyes, and her breathing gradually steadied as she prepared to fall asleep peacefully.
location: Parents' home bedroom, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and shopping plan
description: Woke up naturally at 7:20, stretched in bed, and smelled the aroma of millet porridge. After washing up, I went to the living room and saw my father reading the newspaper with his reading glasses while my mother was busy in the kitchen. I said good morning to my father softly, then went into the kitchen to watch my mother ladle out the steaming porridge. Decided to have millet porridge with home-pickled dried radish for breakfast. While drinking the porridge, I took the initiative to suggest accompanying my mother to buy groceries and learn to cook her specialty dishes. Mother took out the shopping list: beef bones, cooked beef shank, wood ear mushrooms, dried daylily flowers, fried tofu puffs, vermicelli, cilantro, and scallions (for hulatang); high-gluten flour, leafy greens, garlic, and chili oil (for braised noodles). We discussed the quantities, and Mother said Father and Brother have big appetites, so we'd need to prepare more. I kept that in mind.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Street Market Shopping and Meal Prep
description: At 9:00, I put on a thick coat and walked to the Kaixuan Road community vegetable market near home. The winter morning was cold, but the market was bustling. My mother skillfully selected ingredients and bargained with the stall owners. I noted the key points for choosing beef bones (choose marrow bones; the more marrow, the more flavor) and the trick for rehydrating dried wood ear mushrooms. After shopping, I took the initiative to carry the heaviest bag and walked home with my mother, arriving home at 10:00. I put on an apron and helped my mother in the kitchen: soaking wood ear mushrooms and day lilies, chopping ginger, and washing greens. My mother blanched the beef bones, put them in a large pot, and boiled them over high heat to make a white soup base.
location: Kaixuan Road Community Vegetable Market near the intersection of Kaixuan West Road and Jiefang Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, and the route home.

name: Organize medical records and prepare for exams
description: My mother took over and simmered the soup base over low heat. I went to the study, turned on the computer, and organized the filing of my father's medical records and all examination reports after discharge. I sorted the CT films and lab test sheets by date and labeled them for easy access and for tomorrow's follow-up. Then I took out my attending physician exam review notes and went over the frequently confused points in the respiratory system chapter, feeling that I could focus better than when I was at the hospital.
location: Study room at parents’ home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Afternoon City Walk and Riverside Stroll
description: Since lunch was late and high in calories, she decided to go out for some fresh air. She changed into her running shoes, put on earphones to play relaxing piano music, walked west along Kaixuan Road to the intersection of Kaixuan East Road and Luopu West Road, then turned south into Luopu Park (about 15 minutes). The winter Luo River shimmered in the sunlight, and the air was fresh. She walked briskly along the riverbank for 20 minutes, which relieved the back soreness from standing for a long time.
location: Walking path on the south bank of Luopu Park, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province (via the intersection of Kaixuan East Road and Luopu West Road)

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: Walked home; my mother had prepared a simple lunch: leftover millet porridge from the morning, freshly stir-fried garlic greens, and some braised beef. After eating, I took the initiative to help clear the dishes and wiped down the kitchen counter. After the meal, I leaned back on the living room sofa with my eyes closed for 20 minutes to regain my energy.
location: Parents' Home Restaurant, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Solitude and personal interests.
description: Back in the bedroom, picked up the phone to watch pottery teaching videos, learning the techniques of using "engobe." Planned to go practice at the Shenghuali Studio after returning to Zhengzhou. Then sent photos capturing the lively atmosphere of the morning market to her close friend Wang Lina in Shenzhen, and chatted about everyday things.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Mother lovingly cooks hometown flavors
description: At two in the afternoon, my mother was showing off her cooking skills in the kitchen, and I occasionally went in to hand her seasonings. She made Hulatang: into the simmered beef bone broth, she added in turn shredded cooked beef shank, sliced wood ear mushrooms, fried tofu puffs, and daylily flowers, seasoned with ground pepper and a special spice powder, colored with dark soy sauce, and finally thickened with sweet potato starch. Before taking it off the heat, she sprinkled in a handful of crushed peanuts and drizzled in mature vinegar and sesame oil. A pot of thick, spicy, fragrant Hulatang was complete. Then she made Huimian: she cut the rested dough into wide strips, pulled them into wide, evenly thick pieces, boiled them in boiling water and scooped them out, then dressed them with garlic juice and chili oil, making two large portions. Mother put the Hulatang into a large thermos, packed the Huimian into two glass food containers, and wrapped them in thick cotton cloth to keep warm.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Departure and meal delivery preparation.
description: Just after four o'clock, Father and older brother were ready to leave. I checked the schedule and arrival times of Bus No. 23 on my phone. Father insisted on carrying the heavy thermos himself, and older brother held the lunch box. The two left early and walked ten minutes to the bus stop near the intersection of Kaixuan West Road and Jiefang Road to wait for the bus.
location: From No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province to the bus stop near the intersection of Kaixuan West Road and Jiefang Road

name: Hospital Companionship and Waiting
description: My mother rode her e-bike to the hospital ahead of time, and I walked over a little later (about 33 minutes). When I arrived at the ward, my mother was already accompanying my father. I chatted with my father and told him that my mother had made his favorite hulatang soup. Father smiled expectantly. I checked the warm water and medicine on the table and reminded him to take them on time.
location: Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Father and son delivering meals and reuniting in the ward
description: At 17:10, my father and elder brother arrived at the ward on time. They brought over the hospital's small tray table, poured the spicy soup into a large bowl, and dished out the braised noodles onto plates. The four of us sat around it. My father, trembling slightly, picked up the spoon with his left hand and took the first sip of the spicy soup. His eyes grew slightly moist as he said, "Still your mother's cooking—really hits the spot!" My mother kept telling me not to order so much takeout after returning to Zhengzhou and to take care of myself. My brother shared funny stories from his office in Shenzhen, and the family kept laughing. Because I had missed the taste of home for so long, I couldn't help eating an extra bowl of braised noodles. I felt a long-missed feeling of fullness, but I was also a bit stuffed.
location: Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Warm follow-up and farewell
description: After dinner, the whole family worked together: Mother took the thermos to the utility room to wash it, I helped wipe the table and sweep the floor, and my brother went downstairs to take out the trash. After tidying up, Father and my brother put on their jackets and said goodbye to Mother and me. Before walking out of the ward, Father turned and gave me a deep look, instructing me to “Take good care of your mother, and also take care of yourself.” After the ward quieted down, I tucked in the corner of Father's blanket.
location: Wards, corridors, and inpatient lobby, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Night caregiving and reading and stretching
description: My mother spread a thin quilt on the companion bed and quietly watched the night outside the window. I sat down by my father's bedside, took out The Doctor's Progress, and read aloud softly for over half an hour. When I got tired from reading, I felt bloated from eating too much at dinner. At 8:30 I went to the ward corridor and walked slowly for 10 minutes, and did several sets of waist stretches and chest-opening movements to relieve the bloating while also taking care of my lumbar spine.
location: Wards and corridors of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Washing up and making tomorrow's plan
description: After returning to the ward, she went to the public washroom to wash up. Using her phone's memo app, she noted that after returning to Zhengzhou tomorrow, she needed to contact Wang Fang about the bridesmaid dress and also organize ideas for a case report.
location: Ward and public washroom, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Pre-bed preparation and quiet conversation
description: Around 22:30, the ward lights were dimmed. I lay on the accompanying chair, and my mother lay down too. We talked softly in the moonlight. I said it felt so good to come home today, and that Mom's cooking was always the best. Though I was a bit tired, my heart felt especially at ease because of the warmth of today. Then I turned my head to look at my mother and father's sleeping faces, and turned off the bedside lamp.
location: Ward, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: She fell into a deep sleep with a full stomach and a contented heart, recalling the warm scenes of today's family reunion.
location: Ward companion chair, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Morning home activities
description: Woke up in the second-floor bedroom at her parents' home in the morning; it was cloudy and slightly bright outside the window. Measured her temperature at 36.5°C and did side-lying lower back stretches to relieve stiffness. Checked her phone to confirm today's agenda of contacting Wang Fang about the bridesmaid dress. The weather showed Luoyang: cloudy turning clear, 1 to 7°C. Put on thick loungewear and washed up. Went downstairs and had breakfast with her parents. Her mother had made millet porridge, pan-fried scallion pancakes, and homemade pickled vegetables. Her father slowly drank porridge with his left hand while her mother helped him with dishes. She had two bowls of porridge and a scallion pancake, feeling warm and comfortable. Chatted about returning to work the next day and her father's blood pressure control. After breakfast, helped her father with morning rehabilitation exercises: supported him as he walked slowly around the living room twice, and completed left-hand spoon holding and passive shoulder joint exercises. Her father had made obvious progress, steadily holding the spoon and picking it up himself when it dropped. She noted down the key movement points and encouraged him, while her mother watched from the kitchen.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Pack luggage and check the vehicle.
description: She returned to the second-floor bedroom to pack the suitcase, folding in two knit sweaters and a scarf, and putting dirty clothes in a separate cloth bag. She placed the USB drive with medical records in the inner layer of her shoulder bag, picked up the handmade steamed dumplings and chili sauce prepared by her mother, checked the seals, and put them in the side pocket of the suitcase. She confirmed that the phone charger, constant-temperature water bottle, and spare masks were all present. Then she put on her down jacket and went downstairs to the ground-level parking space in the residential complex, checking the condition of the white Corolla: measured the tire pressure of all four tires (front 2.4 bar, rear 2.5 bar), found the oil level on the dipstick normal, discovered the windshield washer fluid was low, took out -25 windshield washer fluid from the trunk, and topped it up.
location: Parents' home and the community's surface parking space at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Say goodbye to family and pick up my older brother
description: Back home, her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng had already packed his luggage and was waiting in the living room. Their mother's eyes were slightly red; she tucked a small bag of dried red dates into the side pocket of the backpack and told them to eat them on the way to replenish qi and blood. Yu Xiaowen hugged her mother, then crouched by the sofa and told her father to walk more during the day but not to tire himself, to take his medicine on time, and to keep practicing with his left hand. Her father nodded, and her brother patted him on the shoulder and said, "Let's go, we'll talk on the way." Then they drove off from Kaixuan Road, turned onto Kaixuan West Road, then Jiefang Road and Zhongzhou Middle Road, arriving at Jinguyuan Road on the southwest side of Luoyang Station at about 10:40. They stopped temporarily with hazard lights on, rolled down the window, and picked up her brother.
location: From the parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province to near Luoyang Station on Jinguyuan Road

name: Have lunch with my brother and get on the highway
description: Brother Yu Xiaofeng took the wheel and drove south on Jinguyuan Road, turned onto Tanggong Middle Road, and headed for the “Small Street Beef Soup Old Shop.” They arrived at 11:10, went in, and ordered two bowls of beef soup, oil-spiral buns, and a side-dish platter; Yu Xiaowen's bowl had extra chili. As they ate and chatted, they mentioned a detail: their father's eyes had welled up when he drank soup early in the morning. The brother was silent for a moment, then said, “He will get better gradually.” The meal cost 58 yuan in total. After the meal, the brother continued driving, made a U-turn from Tanggong Middle Road, went via Dingding Road and Wangcheng Avenue, and arrived at the Luoyang entrance to the Lianhuo Expressway at about 11:55. After swiping the ETC card, he sped up and merged into the main lane.
location: "Xiaojie Beef Soup Old Shop" on Tanggong Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, and surrounding roads, heading to the Luoyang station entrance of the Lianhuo Expressway.

name: Drive on the expressway to Zhengzhou Service Area.
description: After entering the Lianhuo Expressway, her brother kept cruise control at 105 km/h, connected his iPad to the classical music channel on Apple Music, and played the "Commuter De-Stress" playlist. The first piece was Debussy's "Clair de Lune," and the second was Bach's "Air on the G String." Outside the window, winter sunlight over the fields occasionally broke through the clouds. Yu Xiaowen helped check the real-time traffic, and traffic on the Luoyang-to-Zhengzhou section of the Lianhuo Expressway was moderate. At around 12:45, Yu Xiaowen leaned back in her seat and rested with her eyes closed for about 20 minutes. There were no stops along the way, and they arrived at the Zhengzhou service area at 14:00.
location: Lianhuo Expressway (section from Luoyang station to Zhengzhou service area)

name: Rest stop at the Zhengzhou service area
description: The car pulled into a parking space at the Zhengzhou service area and was turned off. Yu Xiaowen got out and walked laps around the plaza, doing bent-over toe touches to relieve the stiffness in her lower back from sitting for a long time. She filled her thermos with hot water and washed her face, feeling much more refreshed. Her brother checked the app and saw that the fuel level was 47%, so they decided to refuel in the city. After resting, they got ready to continue the trip.
location: Lianhuo Expressway Zhengzhou Service Area, Huiji District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove on the expressway into Zhengzhou city
description: Got back on the expressway. My brother changed the playlist to the classical music list Yu Xiaowen had saved. At the beginning of Rachmaninoff's Piano Concerto No. 2, the bass was slightly heavier. At 15:20 we passed the Zhengzhou North service area; a road sign showed about 12 km to the city center. At 15:50 we exited the Lianhuo Expressway at Wenhua Road and entered Huiji District.
location: Lianhuo Expressway (section from Zhengzhou Service Area to the Wenhua Road exit on Lianhuo Expressway)

name: Arrive at the apartment and store the luggage
description: Her brother followed the navigation along Jingsan Road into the apartment underground garage and arrived at 16:20. The two took out the suitcase and bags from the trunk. Her brother helped press the elevator to the 13th floor and carried them to the doorway, then without entering he said he would take a taxi back to his own place, and they agreed to video call in the evening. Yu Xiaowen swiped her card to open the door and moved the luggage into the entryway. She then put her mother's homemade steamed dumplings and chili sauce into the freezer and refrigerator compartments, hung the winter clothes from the suitcase back in the closet, threw the dirty clothes into the washing machine to be washed, and put the medical-record USB drive, chargers, and other items back in place.
location: Apartment underground garage and room at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Remote contact after returning home
description: First, she watered the pothos and snake plant on the balcony moderately, checked the express locker in the foyer, took out the spicy soup seasoning packet ordered the day before, opened it, and put it in the cabinet for now. Then, sitting on the sofa, she contacted Wang Fang via WeChat. Based on the measurements taken before the New Year, she selected a size M bridesmaid dress and confirmed it with a screenshot. She also chose the nude chunky-heel style from three pairs of shoes, and they agreed to have the heels adjusted together next Saturday. The call lasted 23 minutes. Next, she listened to the WeChat voice messages from Dr. Wang Zihong of the Rehabilitation Department at Luoyang Central Hospital, reported her father's left-hand stability in holding a spoon and the improvement in shoulder abduction, and asked whether the frequency of standing training could be increased. Dr. Wang suggested a follow-up at the outpatient clinic next Tuesday to adjust the plan, saying that seated training should remain the main focus in the near term. Yu Xiaowen noted down the reminders.
location: Apartment at 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Then I switched to the second movement of Dvořák’s Symphony No. 9, “From the New World.” After about seven minutes, I felt drowsy and turned off the music. Went to the bathroom to brush my teeth, wash my face, and apply night cream. Since the skin around my eyes was a bit dry, I applied a thick layer of moisturizer, then set my alarm for 6:30 the next morning.

The room was pitch dark, with faint sounds of cars outside the window. Took a few deep breaths and fell asleep in about 3-5 minutes. Drove about 130 kilometers in total today.

description: After finishing stretching, she went to the bathroom to wash up. When she got back to the bedroom, she sent her brother Yu Xiaofeng a WeChat voice message to say she had arrived home, that their parents were fine, and to thank him for handling the reimbursement. Her brother replied 'OK' and 'Good night.' Xiaowen organized all of today's screenshots and records related to reimbursement into the 'Father's Medical Insurance Reimbursement' folder.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Visiting her father before bed and going to sleep.
description: Before turning off the light, she heard some noise from her father's room. Worried that her father had woken up, she gently knocked on the door and went in. Seeing Xiaowen back, her father gave a weak smile. Xiaowen sat on the edge of the bed, helped her father adjust his pillow, gave him water, and softly reassured him, telling him she would take him for a follow-up visit the next day. Her father nodded and fell into a deep sleep. Back in her own room, she recorded her feelings in her phone memo: 'Home safe, reimbursement submitted successfully, Dad stable, Mom worked hard, at ease.' Then she turned off the light and, in the faint glow of the streetlamp, felt both at ease and exhausted, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Morning family time and a surprise.
description: Woken up by my mother's WeChat message and the faint light outside the window, I got up and made the bed. After washing up, I changed into comfortable loungewear and went to the living room, saying good morning to my mother, who was preparing breakfast. Mother had cooked millet porridge and made scallion pancakes. While eating breakfast, I kept an eye on the SF Express tracking information on my phone. The temperature was -1 to 4°C, cloudy, and someone in the community outside was walking a dog.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Signed for the iPad mini and was moved while unboxing it.
description: Hearing the doorbell, she immediately went to open the door. She signed for an SF Express delivery from Shenzhen and brought it to the living room to open—it was a brand-new iPad mini (WiFi model, 64GB). Inside was a pink sticky note in her best friend Wang Lina's handwriting: "Don't push yourself too hard, but don't give up either. — Nana." Xiaowen felt a warmth in her heart and immediately took a photo and sent it to their three-person best friend group chat with the caption: "Wuwuwu, what an amazing best friend!"
location: Living room of parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Activated new iPad and synced data
description: Back at the desk in her room, she opened the iPad packaging, turned it on and activated it. She connected to the home WiFi and logged in with her Apple ID. She deftly downloaded 'Medical Statistics,' 'EndNote,' 'GoodReader,' and 'Tencent Video' from the App Store. Then she used iCloud to sync two research papers she had organized before the New Year and some records from the last follow-up visit. To test the sound quality, she also downloaded several high-resolution classical piano pieces to her music library.
location: Study room at parents’ home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Pre-departure preparations
description: She packed the new iPad and charger into her canvas tote bag. She said to her mother, Mom, I'm all set, let's go. Her mother had also prepared the thermos, towel, and other items her father needed. Xiaowen helped her father put on his thick coat, and the family of three got ready to leave.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Drive to Luoyang Central Hospital
description: Xiaowen drove along Kaixuan Road for about 5 minutes, turned right onto Zhongzhou Middle Road, and after another 5 minutes arrived at Luoyang Central Hospital. Today was a compensatory workday, so traffic was not too heavy. She parked in the hospital's surface parking lot.
location: In the car, from Kaixuan Road to Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Ward accompaniment and rehabilitation data collection (morning)
description: The family of three walked into the hospital room of about 10 square meters, where the temperature was comfortable. Her mother wiped down and changed her father, while Xiaowen skillfully opened 'Notes' on her new iPad, created a new 'Father's Rehabilitation Log,' and recorded the morning blood pressure: 132/85 mmHg. Around 10 o'clock, the rehabilitation therapist arrived on time to guide the session. She immediately used the iPad's camera to record the core process of her father's passive lower-limb range-of-motion training from an angle that would not disturb the treatment. The therapist encouraged her father, "Lift your leg actively, good, do it again." While recording, Xiaowen noted in her Notes, "Right leg active knee flexion angle improved by about 5 degrees compared with yesterday." During breaks between caregiving tasks, she used the iPad stand to follow a few standing stretches on the screen, relieving the lower back pressure caused by her caregiving posture.
location: Rehabilitation Department ward (3rd floor), Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Midday break and rehabilitation journal entry.
description: She helped tidy her father's bed, then walked with her parents to the second-floor cafeteria for lunch. Xiaowen ordered the soft noodles and light steamed egg that her father liked, and had a plate of rice with stir-fried tomatoes and eggs for herself. While her father napped, she sat on the chair beside the bed, opened 'GoodReader' on her new iPad, and carefully read two WeChat official account articles about early stroke rehabilitation nursing. Then she returned to 'Father's Rehabilitation Log' and carefully filled in this morning's blood pressure, the subjective feelings she had just recorded, and the objectively observed changes in his gait.
location: Second-floor cafeteria and third-floor wards, Luoyang Central Hospital, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Ward companionship and walking training (afternoon)
description: After father woke up, Xiaowen helped him out of bed. In the spacious and bright corridor, she supported his arm with one hand and used the pedometer function on her iPad with the other to record the steps and time of father walking slowly while holding the handrail alone (15 minutes in total, about 200 steps). During the walk, she kept encouraging him: "Dad, you're walking much more steadily than yesterday. Let's take ten more steps, okay?" During the rest, Xiaowen showed father the training video clips she had just recorded on her phone; father showed a pleased smile after watching.
location: Rehabilitation department corridor and 3rd-floor wards at Luoyang Central Hospital, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Complete discharge procedures and drive home.
description: Considering that her father was in good spirits in the afternoon and his condition was stable, Xiaowen discussed it with her mother and decided to complete a temporary discharge registration to make it convenient to go home for recuperation and dumpling-making. She went to the first floor to handle the relevant procedures and then drove her parents back home. On the way, her father looked at the long-missed street scenes outside the window, and there was more light in his eyes.
location: From the first floor of the inpatient building, Luoyang Central Hospital, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, to the car at No. 42 Kaixuan Road.

name: After returning home, made dumplings with her mother
description: After arriving home, her mother had already mixed the chive and egg filling. Xiaowen changed clothes, washed her hands, put on an apron, and joined in making dumplings. The mother and daughter chatted while wrapping crescent-shaped and ingot-shaped dumplings. Her father sat on the living room sofa watching TV, occasionally turning his head to look at the busy mother and daughter in the kitchen, with a smile on his lips.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Dinner and video call with older brother
description: The dumplings came out of the pot, and the room filled with aroma. At the dining table, Xiaowen used her new iPad to start a video call with her brother Yu Xiaofeng, who was working overtime in Shenzhen. She propped the iPad on the table, “showed off” the gift Nana had given to her brother, and turned the camera to her father: “Brother, look, Dad has a good appetite today—he ate eight dumplings!” Her brother carefully looked at their father's complexion and eating movements, then reminded Xiaowen to take care of herself too.
location: Parents' Home Restaurant, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Accompanying my father watching the news in the evening
description: After dinner, mother cleared the dishes, and Xiaowen helped her father walk slowly around the living room to aid digestion. Then she turned on the TV and switched to CCTV-1. She sat beside her father, occasionally pointing at the news on the screen and making brief comments. Although her father's speech was not very articulate, he would nod or shake his head in response.
location: Living room of parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Rest and pre-class preparation.
description: After watching Xinwen Lianbo for a while, she helped her father prepare his medicine and warm water, and made sure he took the medicine. Then she returned to her room, opened her iPad, placed her notebook and pen on the desk, and prepared for the upcoming "Medical Statistics" live-streamed class.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Attended an online medical statistics course.
description: At 7 pm, Xiaowen opened the "Medical Statistics" app on her iPad on time and entered the first live class. The course topic was "Types of Research Data and Descriptive Statistics." While listening, she noted key points and formulas the teacher emphasized. During the break, she quickly answered a question the teacher asked in the live room about data classification. Throughout the class, she was fully focused and felt the long-missed sense of fulfillment from systematic learning.
location: Own room at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Personal care and relaxing to music
description: After the class ended, Xiaowen stretched. She went to the bathroom and carefully washed up with warm water. Returning to the room, she changed into comfortable cotton pajamas. She lay on the bed, put on earphones, closed her eyes, and played the soothing piano piece 'River Flows in You' on her new iPad. The gentle music flowed out, washing away the fatigue of the day.
location: Bathroom and her own room at her parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Organized the rehabilitation journal and interacted with close friends.
description: After listening to the music, she felt much more relaxed. She opened Notes on her iPad, organized and polished the draft of today's 'Father's Rehabilitation Log,' and highlighted the training items that would need special attention tomorrow. Then she opened WeChat and, in the group chat with her close girlfriends, @mentioned Wang Lina, once again expressing how moved she was, and attached a photo of tonight's dumplings. She also exchanged a few casual words with Jingjing, sharing the joy of receiving gifts and successfully watching the course.
location: Own room at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Bedtime wrap-up and falling asleep
description: She checked tomorrow's weather again (forecast: cloudy, 2-8°C) and confirmed everything was fine. She turned off the room light, leaving only the soft bedside lamp. She gently closed her eyes, briefly reviewing in her mind the good news received today and her father's progress, and slowly drifted off to sleep accompanied by the quiet city lights of Luoyang outside the window.
location: Own room at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Waking up and breakfast
description: At her parents' home, she was awakened by the aroma of spicy soup stewed by her mother, Li Xiuying. After washing up, Yu Xiaowen went to the kitchen, drank two bowls of spicy soup, and ate half a fried flatbread. During this time, she listened to her mother talk about her father Yu Jianguo's health condition and the items that needed to be taken to the hospital that day. She also took out her iPad mini and quickly browsed the rehabilitation log she had organized the night before to confirm the focus of her father's rehabilitation training for that day.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Walked to the hospital to take over from her mother
description: She put on a thick coat, took the insulated thermos, a few wet wipes, and the iPad with rehabilitation data recorded for her father, then set off from her parents' home on foot to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University. The morning air was cold and crisp, and she could see her breath. After walking about 15 minutes, she arrived at the outpatient building, then spent about 3 minutes crossing the connecting corridor to reach the neurology ward in the inpatient department.
location: From No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China

name: Morning companionship and rehabilitation training
description: After completing the handover with her mother Li Xiuying, her mother went home to rest. Yu Xiaowen began the morning caregiving. She first helped her father Yu Jianguo wipe his face with a warm towel and rinse his mouth, and then carried out the morning rehabilitation training: following the rehabilitation therapist's guidance, she helped her father perform passive joint exercises on his left upper limb from the shoulder to the fingers for 15 minutes; she then guided her father through speech practice, having him follow her lip movements to produce vowels and simple phrases. During the session, she recorded rehabilitation data such as her father's blood oxygen and active elbow flexion range on the iPad.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Old friend's visit and memories of youth.
description: High school classmate Chen Siyu came to the ward to visit, carrying a fruit basket and a handwritten card album. The two excitedly flipped through the yellowed cards and photos taken at the school gate, recalling the fun of passing notes in high school. Chen Siyu pointed at one photo and teased Yu Xiaowen about how shy she used to be, and their laughter echoed gently in the ward. Yu Xiaowen's father, Yu Jianguo, watched them and smiled. Before leaving, Chen Siyu pressed a bag of Luoyang old town peanut crisps into Yu Xiaowen's hand, telling her to eat one when she felt stressed. Yu Xiaowen opened the bag right away and ate one; the sweetness eased the exhaustion of accompanying care.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: See off an old friend and have lunch with her father.
description: Accompanied Chen Siyu to the elevator and watched her leave. After returning to the ward, the hospital nursing assistant brought her father Yu Jianguo's nutritious lunch, including pumpkin millet porridge, steamed fish, and chopped broccoli. Yu Xiaowen sat by the bed, fed her father spoonful by spoonful, chatted with him about family matters, and felt reassured to see that he had a good appetite.
location: Neurology ward and elevator entrance, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Subscribed to a classical music channel and took an afternoon nap with Father.
description: After her father, Yu Jianguo, fell asleep, Yu Xiaowen took out her iPad mini and connected to the ward Wi-Fi. In the Apple Music recommendations, she found the channel 'High-Resolution Classical: Timeless Masterpieces' with an annual fee of 198 yuan. While previewing Beethoven's 'Moonlight Sonata', she was drawn to the distinct layered piano sound and subscribed via Alipay. She then selected 12 pieces, including Mozart's Requiem and Dvořák's 'From the New World', created a playlist named 'Commute/De-stress', and downloaded all of them for offline listening.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Coffee time and remote greetings
description: Father was still sleeping soundly. Yu Xiaowen made a cup of drip coffee she had brought with her, put on earphones, and softly played the newly downloaded "Moonlight Sonata." While resting, she replied to messages from her friends Wang Fang and Sun Yue on WeChat, telling them that everything was fine with her, that her father's recovery was progressing steadily, and asking how they were doing.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Ward yoga and shoulder and back stretching
description: Her father continued to sleep peacefully. Yu Xiaowen stood by the ward window, gently doing a few yoga side bends and shoulder and neck circles to relieve the shoulder and back soreness from long hours of caregiving. The room was very quiet, with only her father's steady breathing accompanying her. She then softly played Dvořák's New World Symphony, stretching and relaxing to the melodious music.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Listen to classical music while walking home.
description: After greeting the nurses' station, I walked home from the hospital, listening to the newly downloaded Dvořák's "From the New World" on my headphones, walking at a leisurely pace. I arrived home in about 18 minutes. My parents' home was empty; my mother, Li Xiuying, was probably still at the market.
location: From Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province to No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Simmering nourishing soup at home
description: After returning to her parents' home, she opened the fridge and found frozen chicken carcass, red dates, and goji berries, and also took out angelica root. Following her mother's method, she blanched the chicken carcass and skimmed off the foam, added red dates, goji berries, and angelica root, put everything in a clay pot with enough water, and simmered over low heat. While the soup was simmering, she used her iPad to look up several articles on nutritional support for stroke patients.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Replenishing energy and cleaning up the soup
description: While the soup was simmering on the stove, she cooked herself a bowl of frozen shrimp wontons and ate them quickly to regain energy. Around 5 p.m., she turned off the heat, strained out the herbal residues and bones with a fine mesh strainer, poured the rich golden broth into a thermos, and screwed the lid tight, ready to take it to her father.
location: Kitchen at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Walked back to the hospital to deliver the soup.
description: Carrying a canvas bag with a thermos, she walked back to Luoyang Central Hospital affiliated with Zhengzhou University on foot. In the cold wind, the warmth of the thermos passed through the bag, making her feel warm inside.
location: From No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China

name: Feeding father soup and handing over care to Mom
description: When she returned to the ward, her father had just woken up. She poured a bowl of soup, blew on it to cool it, and fed it to her father spoonful by spoonful. He drank two bowls, his forehead slightly sweating, and kept saying “warm”. Then her mother Li Xiuying hurried over from home. Yu Xiaowen gave her a detailed handover of her father's condition that afternoon and the evening medication, and handed the thermos to her mother for safekeeping.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Evening Music Organizing and Relaxation
description: While her mother chatted with her father, Yu Xiaowen sat in the caregiver chair, opened her iPad, sorted the tracks in the Commute/De-stress playlist she had created by the composers' chronological order, and connected the small Bluetooth speaker she had brought. She turned the volume down and played Bach's Air on the G String as background music, feeling an unprecedented sense of relaxation in both mind and body.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Reminisce with father over old photos
description: Father was leaning against the headboard. Yu Xiaowen opened her phone and shared the old photos Chen Siyu had brought today. Looking at the photos, Father identified the names of a few old classmates and asked in a somewhat unclear voice, 'Where does she work now?' Yu Xiaowen answered patiently, enjoying the rare quiet time alone with her father.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Record mood and evening yoga.
description: After her father fell asleep, Yu Xiaowen wrote a mood entry in her notebook: 'Today's two beams of light—old friends and new joy—made the night of accompanying care less hard to bear.' Then she stood by the window, completed a 15-minute set of yoga movements focusing on spinal twists and neck-shoulder relaxation, and felt her body stretch out.
location: Neurology Ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Video call with a distant friend
description: Went to the public area at the end of the ward corridor and made a video call to friends Zhang Jing and Sun Yue. The three chatted for over ten minutes. She showed them the card album Chen Siyu had brought today, shared the sweet fragrance of peanut crisps, and briefly talked about her father's current condition. Her friends urged her to rest more and take good care of herself.
location: Public corridor outside the Neurology ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Video-called her mother to report on her father's condition
description: At the end of the corridor, she had a video call with her mother, Li Xiuying, for a few minutes, telling her in detail how much soup her father had drunk tonight, what medication he had taken, and what his mental state was like, so that her mother could rest at home with peace of mind. Her mother also reminded her to cover herself with a blanket at night and not catch cold.
location: Public corridor outside the Neurology ward, Inpatient Department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and tomorrow's plan
description: She spread her own blanket on the accompanying chair, washed up briefly, and lay down. She turned on the iPad, put on earphones, and softly played Bach's Cello Suites while silently planning tomorrow's schedule in her mind: hand over to her mother in the morning, then drive back to Zhengzhou, and report to the hospital in the afternoon.
location: Caregiver chair in the neurology ward, inpatient department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Fell asleep to classical music.
description: After jotting down tomorrow's to-do items for returning to Zhengzhou in her phone's Notes, she listened to Dvořák's 'From the New World.' The warm memories of the day and the melodious music soothed her fatigue. Around 10 PM, she fell into a deep sleep with the music.
location: Caregiver chair in the neurology ward, inpatient department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Friend and vegetable stall owner.
description: Got up at 5:50 in the early morning, laid out a yoga mat on the guest room floor, and followed an iPad video of Baduanjin for ten minutes to stretch the body and relieve stiffness in the shoulders and neck.
location: Guest room at the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Breakfast and farewell to mother.
description: Mother had already prepared breakfast: spicy soup, fried dough, and tea eggs. She ate some quickly, made sure her father had taken his blood pressure medicine, hugged her mother goodbye, and got ready to drive back to Zhengzhou.
location: Parents' Home Restaurant, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Driving back to Zhengzhou
description: Drove from Luoyang, took the Lianhuo Expressway toward Zhengzhou, and bought hot soy milk at the Gongyi Service Area along the way. Arrived at the parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital at about 8:10, changed into a white coat, and went to the doctors' office.
location: Gongyi Service Area, Lianhuo Expressway (Luoyang-Zhengzhou direction); underground parking garage of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Cardiology department morning meeting
description: Attended the department morning meeting, where we discussed diuretic resistance in heart failure patients. Based on the literature, I proposed a sodium supplementation maintenance-dose plan, which was recognized by supervising teacher Li Wei, who suggested using it as a supplementary case for the afternoon mini-lecture.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Cardiology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Morning clinical work and teaching
description: Followed Dr. Li Wei on the grand ward round, listened to patients' chief complaints, performed physical examinations, and answered family members' questions. Then handled medical records, updated medical orders, wrote progress notes, and organized discharge summaries. Guided two interns in interpreting ECGs.
location: Cardiology Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dressing changes and teaching practice
description: I changed the wound dressing for a postoperative patient, strictly followed aseptic technique, comforted the patient, and explained to the intern the clinical significance of the exudate's color and disinfection techniques.
location: Dressing Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Supplementing progress notes and literature search.
description: Focus on supplementing the progress notes from the past few days, and use the hospital's research system to search for guidelines and literature on diuretic resistance to prepare for the afternoon mini-lecture.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Cardiology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Lunch shopping
description: During the lunch break, walked to the Dennis supermarket near the hospital, picked healthy foods such as dragon fruit, sugar-free yogurt, whole wheat bread, and ready-to-eat chicken breast salad, and stocked up on nuts and instant multigrain powder.
location: Dennis Supermarket near Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Garden lunch and walk.
description: Enjoyed lunch on a bench in a quiet small garden at the hospital, then took a slow ten-minute walk along the path, soaking up the afternoon sun.
location: Small garden on the campus of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Organizing and learning
description: Back in the office, she put the snacks she had bought into a drawer as reserves, made a cup of multigrain powder, and, while drinking it, flipped through the literature she had downloaded in the morning to deepen her understanding of the clinical use of maintenance sodium supplementation.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Cardiology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon clinical work and department mini-lecture
description: Continued refining the unfinished progress notes. At 15:00 attended the department's routine mini-lecture, and based on the morning ward-round cases, offered insights and questions on new approaches to diuretic resistance, receiving affirmation from the attending physician and the department director.
location: Cardiology Department teaching room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handover and Preparation for Leaving Work
description: She carefully handed over to her night-shift colleague Wang Fang, focusing on the latest condition of a patient whose condition was unstable. Then she packed up her personal belongings and got ready to leave work.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Cardiology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Upgrade the vehicle music system
description: In the basement parking garage, she imported the high-resolution classical music playlist from her iPad to the SD card of the car's multimedia system, replacing the low-bitrate MP3s. When played, the soundstage was noticeably wider. She took a photo and posted it on Moments with the caption “Mobile concert hall.” Her friend Lin Wei commented right away.
location: Underground parking garage, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Drove back to the apartment
description: Driving along Zhongyuan Road and Jinshui Road, with Bach's "Air on the G String" playing in the car, the soothing melody dispelled the day's fatigue, and I returned home to Qunying Community in Jinshui District.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province  Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Housework and a healthy dinner
description: Back home, she put the accumulated clothes into the washing machine. She made a healthy dinner with yogurt mixed with dragon fruit and nuts, served with whole wheat bread and boiled chicken breast. While eating, she browsed simple recipes from food bloggers.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Video call with family
description: Had a video call with her mother. Her father came over and spoke; though his speech was intermittent, it was clearer than before. Her mother said her father had walked for ten minutes with his walker today. She praised her father and reminded her mother to take her blood pressure medicine. She felt very gratified.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Study the medical statistics course.
description: To prepare for the live online medical statistics class, I replayed the recorded video of the previous lesson on the independent samples t-test, wrote down the key formulas and SPSS operation steps, and marked the knowledge points I had not fully digested.
