location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Pre-bed preparation and foot soaking
description: Her temperature measured 37.5°C, slightly elevated. She sucked on a throat lozenge and soaked her feet in hot water for ten minutes to relieve nasal congestion and promote sleep.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Going to bed
description: Turned off the light and lay down to rest. Although the nasal congestion still made her toss and turn, and the side effects of the cold medicine made her drowsy, her physical exhaustion eventually brought on sleep. Outside the window, the occasional sound of vehicles passing on the wet road could be heard.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Getting up and light stretching
description: The alarm went off, and Yu Xiaowen felt that her stuffy nose and sore, dry throat had worsened. She leaned against the headboard for a while. Slowly getting out of bed, she did simple shoulder, neck, and arm stretches in the living room, then went to the kitchen to boil a kettle of hot water. She made a cup of warm honey lemon water and drank it slowly to relieve her throat pain. The sky outside was gloomy; the weather forecast said it would be cloudy today. She secretly hoped her cold would not get worse.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prepare breakfast and pack luggage.
description: Yu Xiaowen took out the sliced marinated beef Zhang Jing had sent last night from the refrigerator and heated a bowl of millet porridge cooked in advance. While eating a light breakfast, she packed the change of clothes, iPad, power bank and other items she would need for her return to Luoyang tonight into a dark blue duffel bag. She also grabbed several sticky notes with medical English roots, ready to clip them onto the car's sun visor for review on the road.
location: Kitchen at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Commute by car.
description: Yu Xiaowen put on a mask and drove out from Qunying Community. She played Dvořák's Humoresque via the car's Bluetooth. While waiting at red lights, she quickly glanced at the sticky notes clipped to the passenger-side sun visor and memorized a few words, such as 'Cardiology'. Because she had a cold, she deliberately turned on the car's warm air and lowered the music volume.
location: On the way from Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital at No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Change clothes, drink water, and check on key patients.
description: After arriving at the hospital, Yu Xiaowen changed into her white coat in the changing room and poured a full cup of warm water, placing it on her desk. She turned on the computer and quickly browsed the latest test reports of the current inpatients, focusing on the condition changes of Grandpa Wang (post-myocardial infarction) and Aunt Liu (heart failure), to prepare for the morning meeting. She noticed that her voice was a little hoarse and cleared her throat.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning handover and ward rounds
description: Yu Xiaowen attended the department morning meeting and reported on the nighttime conditions of key patients. She then followed Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds. At the bedside, she performed physical examinations one by one and carefully asked patients how they felt. When she reached Aunt Liu's bed, Aunt Liu took her hand and said she felt much better. Yu Xiaowen gently reminded her about medication precautions after discharge. Because she had a cold, her voice was softer than usual, but still clear and patient.
location: Cardiovascular Medicine Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handle medical orders and write progress notes.
description: After the ward rounds, Yu Xiaowen returned to the office and sat down, began processing medical orders, and wrote the day's progress notes on the computer. She felt a bit tired because of a cold, but still carefully checked each medication and test result. During this time, she repeatedly picked up the water cup on her desk and drank warm water to ease the discomfort in her throat.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Received the reimbursement payment and notified family members.
description: Her phone vibrated. Yu Xiaowen picked it up and saw a deposit alert from China Merchants Bank: “Card ending in 3582 received 8,078 yuan (Luoyang medical insurance fund reimbursement).” She felt a weight lift, immediately took a screenshot and typed: “Dad's hospitalization reimbursement has arrived, 8,078 yuan in total!” and sent it to the family group chat. Her brother instantly replied “Efficient,” and then her mother sent a voice message saying, “I just received the text message too. I feel so much more relieved now.” Yu Xiaowen quietly let out a sigh in a corner of the office, but then she had a coughing fit and quickly put on her mask.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Continue with medical records and family communication.
description: Yu Xiaowen continued to polish the discharge summaries and medication instructions for the patients being discharged today. She received a call from a family member of a heart failure patient, patiently answered the question about taking diuretics with food, and told them they could come to the hospital in the afternoon to handle the related procedures. Her throat felt dry and sore, and she was drinking water more and more often.
location: Doctor's office and wards, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Lunch and taking medication
description: Yu Xiaowen went to the cafeteria alone and ordered a light tomato and egg noodle soup. She ate slowly, then took out cold medicine from her bag and took it, and then got a large cup of warm water. The cafeteria lady noticed she did not look well and kindly urged her to get some rest.
location: Employee cafeteria at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break: studying medical English
description: During the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen did not rest. Instead, she put on earphones, opened the "Medical Classics English" course on her iPad, and entered Unit 4, "Departments and Common Diagnoses." While listening to the explanation audio, she made a mind map in Notability, systematically organizing vocabulary such as Internal Medicine and Pediatrics. Because of nasal congestion, she could only read along in a low voice and frequently drank water to moisten her throat.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon work and preparation for next week's plan.
description: Yu Xiaowen continued to work on the progress notes left unfinished in the morning and checked the afternoon's medical orders. She opened a blank document, began drafting the outline for next Monday's medication review report, jotted down a few key data points, and added a reminder on her to-do list: 'Contact the rehabilitation department on Tuesday.' She felt chills coming in waves, took her temperature, and it was 37.5 — a low-grade fever.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bedside handover with the night shift doctor.
description: Yu Xiaowen and Dr. Liu Qiang conducted a bedside handover together. She introduced in detail the day's condition and precautions for each key patient (including Uncle Wang and Aunt Liu, who were about to be discharged). Because she had a cold, she wore double masks throughout and reminded Dr. Liu Qiang to keep a close eye on a newly admitted patient. After the handover, she felt a sudden dizziness, steadied herself against the wall, and rested for a moment.
location: Cardiovascular Medicine Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tidying up workstation and shopping after work
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the office, tidied her desk, poured out the tea that had long gone cold, and packed up her charger and iPad. She put on her bag and, on the way, stopped at the Xinyuan Convenience Store next to the parking lot to buy two cups of hot milk tea (one for herself and one for her mother) and a bottle of warm ginger tea, planning to drink them on the road. She felt a little unsteady on her feet.
location: Doctor's office and Xinyuan Convenience Store beside the parking lot at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Pre-departure preparations
description: Yu Xiaowen got into the car, put the ginger tea and milk tea in place, fastened her seatbelt, set the navigation, and switched the car music to a classical playlist. She took out her phone and sent a WeChat message to her mother: "Mom, I'm about to leave. I'll be home a little after seven."
location: Inside the car in the parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Driving back to Luoyang.
description: Yu Xiaowen set off from Zhengzhou and drove along the Lianhuo Expressway toward Luoyang. She opened the car window to let in some air and played Dvořák's Humoresque. On the way, she stopped at the Gongyi Service Area to refuel, got out to stretch her limbs, and drank a few sips of the ginger tea she had brought in the car, trying to break a sweat. After resting for twelve minutes, she continued on her way home.
location: Gongyi Service Area, Lianhuo Expressway, Zhengzhou-Luoyang direction.

name: Arrived home in Luoyang.
description: Yu Xiaowen parked the car downstairs at her parents' home, then went upstairs carrying milk tea and luggage. As soon as she entered, her mother took the milk tea and said with affectionate reproach, “Hey, why did you buy this?” Hearing the voice, her father, sitting on the living room sofa, tried to raise his hand and waved at her. Yu Xiaowen put down her things, walked over, and sat down beside her father.
location: Living room at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Discussed reimbursement status and the rehabilitation plan.
description: Yu Xiaowen took out her phone and showed her father the screenshot of the reimbursement arriving in her account. Her father slowly nodded and said, in a somewhat slurred but firm voice, "We have money… no more worries." Yu Xiaowen squatted down to carefully check her father's ankle and found there was still slight swelling. She discussed the weekend rehabilitation plan with her parents and decided to help her father with passive joint exercises at home the next morning, and encourage him to try walking a few steps with a walker.
location: Living room and bedroom of the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Talking with Mother and writing in the diary
description: Yu Xiaowen helped her mother clear the dishes, and the two chatted about family news and follow-up matters regarding the reimbursement. Afterwards, she returned to her room and used her phone's memo app to write down today's grateful feelings: "The reimbursement arrived, and Dad is relieved; although the cold is uncomfortable, my family's support and care make me feel very warm."
location: Parents' home living room and bedroom, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Soaking feet to relax
description: Yu Xiaowen boiled a pot of hot water, poured it into a foot-soaking bucket, added a vitamin C effervescent tablet, and soaked her feet while closing her eyes to rest. She felt the day's fatigue gradually dissolve in the hot water, and her heavy forehead also felt somewhat relieved.
location: Bathroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: After washing up, Yu Xiaowen changed into comfortable pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and read for a while from Still Walking on her Kindle as a way to relax. Although her nose was still a bit stuffy, she felt calm. Then she set the alarm for the next morning, turned off the light, and lay down. Although she felt some discomfort from the cold, the thought that the reimbursement had solved the family's urgent problem and that she could spend the weekend with her father put her at ease, and she soon fell into a deep sleep. Occasionally the sound of a passing car came from outside the window, but none of it disturbed her.
location: Bedroom in parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Morning home life and planning the rehabilitation corner
description: At 6:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen woke up naturally, completely free of cold symptoms. She did abdominal breathing in bed, drank warm honey water, and opened the curtains to let in the sunlight. At 6:55, she did a 15-minute Baduanjin session on the yoga mat in the living room, with gentle and focused movements. Her mother, Li Xiuying, reminded her with concern not to tire herself out, and Xiaowen replied that it was traditional Chinese medicine wellness exercise. At 7:10, the family of three sat around the dining table for breakfast: millet and pumpkin porridge, boiled eggs, and sweet garlic. While eating, Xiaowen confirmed with her mother the process and tool checklist for setting up the rehabilitation corner. She showed her father a reference picture of a home rehabilitation environment for stroke patients and pointed to the east corner of the living room to explain where the handrails would be installed. Her father nodded with effort, showing anticipation and approval.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Set up the rehabilitation corner and guide father through his first training session
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowen and her mother began setting up a home rehabilitation corner. They moved the old cardboard boxes and clutter from the eastern corner of the living room to the balcony storage room. Xiaowen carried the heavy items, while her mother swept, vacuumed, and mopped the floor repeatedly. After the floor was completely dry, Xiaowen laid down dark blue thickened non-slip floor mats and cut them precisely. She arranged the resistance bands, grip balls, fascia balls, and dumbbell plates borrowed from the rehabilitation department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, storing them neatly. She brought over a sturdy chair with a backrest and used no-trace adhesive strips to stick the calligraphy banner "Heaven rewards the diligent" that her father loved onto the wall directly in front, and her mother put a rattan cushion on the chair. Her father, Yu Jianguo, watched quietly from the sofa. At 10 a.m., they began the rehabilitation experience. Xiaowen helped her father walk two round trips in the rehabilitation corner with a walker. Then she had him sit on the chair and performed passive joint mobilization on his shoulders, elbows, wrists, knees, and ankles using hospital techniques, explaining the key points. She then demonstrated seated rows and shoulder external rotation with the resistance band and guided her father to try. Her mother watched attentively and made mental notes, recording the explanation on her phone and marking keywords for future assistance.
location: Family rehabilitation corner, east corner of the living room, at the parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Prepare lunch and contact a friend.
description: Her father was a little tired, so Xiaowen helped him back to the bedroom to rest. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother prepare lunch. While trimming celery, she sent her parents' location to her best friend Sun Yue via WeChat and confirmed they would meet at 2 p.m. at the parking lot of Luoyang Central Hospital. She sent a voice message: 'Navigate to the Luoyang Central Hospital on Zhongzhou Middle Road. See you at the ground parking lot! My dad is in your hands tonight!' Sun Yue quickly replied 'OK.' Lunch was celery stir-fried with shredded pork, chives scrambled with eggs, and rice. The family of three ate quickly. Xiaowen told her parents the afternoon arrangements and reminded her mother to call if anything came up. Before leaving, she separated the antihypertensive medicine and Xueshuantong that her father needed to take in the afternoon into the pillbox on the bedside table and wrote a note indicating the administration times.
location: Kitchen and dining room, parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Afternoon English study and driving to the hospital to meet Sun Yue
description: With 45 minutes left before departure, Xiaowen went back to her room, opened the Medical Canon English app on her iPad, and reviewed the 'Departments and Common Diagnoses' unit she had studied yesterday. Wearing earphones, she repeated the vocabulary after the audio and quickly wrote the words from memory. During this time, she also made a cup of warm water for her father and placed it at his bedside. At 13:15, she drove from her parents' home, turned from Kaixuan Road onto Zhongzhou Middle Road, and arrived at the ground parking lot of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University about 25 minutes later. Just as she parked, Sun Yue's car pulled in too. The two got out and hugged happily. Xiaowen thanked Sun Yue for coming on the weekend, and Sun Yue said it was the least she could do.
location: From the bedroom of my parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, to the ground parking lot of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University at No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Ward handover and a short walk
description: Xiaowen brought Sun Yue to the neurology ward. First, at the nurse station, she introduced Sun Yue to Nurse Lin, who was responsible for her father. Sun Yue greeted her politely. After returning to the ward, Xiaowen stuck a note she had written in advance on the bedside table. It included the medication list, turning schedule, and Nurse Lin's emergency contact number. She explained each item to Sun Yue and personally demonstrated how to turn her father over, pat his back, and record nighttime urine. Seeing Sun Yue, her father's spirits also improved, and he chatted with a smile. After the handover, the two walked out of the inpatient building and to the south entrance of Luopu Park beside the hospital. In the early spring sunshine, they leaned on a bench and chatted for about 15 minutes. Xiaowen shared the joy of setting up a rehabilitation corner. Sun Yue teased her about becoming a future home rehabilitation instructor. Xiaowen told Sun Yue to call anytime if anything came up.
location: Neurology ward of the inpatient department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province; and the south entrance of Luopu Park

name: Returning home to rest, buying groceries, making soup, and studying in intervals
description: After saying goodbye to Sun Yue, Xiaowen drove home. Once home, she took a hot shower, changed into comfortable home clothes, and rested for a while. Remembering that the soup needed beef brisket and radish, she went downstairs and walked five minutes to the Zhengda Laijia Fresh Supermarket at the entrance of the neighborhood. She picked out a piece of fresh beef brisket, one white radish, two corn cobs, and a box of tofu. Back home, she cut the brisket into chunks and blanched them, cut the radish and corn into sections, added a few slices of astragalus root to the soup to boost qi and replenish deficiency, then put all the ingredients into a pressure cooker and set the timer. While the soup was simmering, she sat on the living room sofa, opened the Medical Classics English app on her iPad, and studied Unit 4, Musculoskeletal System. She focused on reading along with words such as skeleton and femur, drew a simple human skeleton diagram in her notebook, labeled the English words and roots in different colors, and also read abstracts of English papers on post-stroke rehabilitation to deepen her understanding of professional vocabulary.
location: Parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, and Zhengda Laijia Fresh Supermarket

name: Deliver soup and feed father, then complete the night care handover.
description: The pressure cooker signaled that the soup was done. Xiaowen put on heat-proof gloves, ladled the beef brisket and corn soup into an insulated container, and screwed the lid tight. She left a message for her mother saying she was going to deliver the soup and would be back for dinner, then picked up the insulated container and her information bag and drove off again. At 6:10 p.m. she returned to the ward. Her father was awake, and Sun Yue was massaging his hands. Xiaowen opened the container, and the rich aroma of meat filled the air. She scooped out half a bowl of soup, blew on it to cool it, and carefully fed it to her father through a straw. He drank it smoothly and contentedly. After her father rested, Xiaowen and Sun Yue did the last detailed night-shift handover on the caregiver chairs. She took out a sticky note from her bag and again emphasized matters such as turning him over, recording nighttime urine, and giving medication the next morning. Sun Yue nodded seriously and assured her she could go home with peace of mind.
location: From the kitchen and garage of parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, to the Neurology Ward of the Inpatient Department of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Having dinner with mother and discussing follow-up care
description: Back at her parents' home, her mother had prepared chive and egg dumplings for dinner. The mother and daughter chatted while eating. Xiaowen told her mother in detail about what was happening at the hospital, said that Sun Yue was very reliable and she could feel reassured, then brought up something she had been mulling over for a long time. She suggested that after her father was discharged, they could check whether the community had home rehabilitation guidance services, so that her mother wouldn't have to work so hard. Her mother was silent for a while, then nodded in agreement and said it was time to plan things properly.
location: Parents' Home Restaurant, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Evening in-depth English learning and body stretching
description: After dinner, Xiaowen helped her mother clear the dishes, then returned to her room for focused study time. She opened the Yidian English app and played the core vocabulary audio for Unit 4, adding labels to the anatomical diagram she had drawn earlier. She also used blank cards to write down 5 core roots (such as crani-, spondyl-, etc.) with corresponding example words, and attached simple joint movement diagrams for later review. Around 9 p.m., after finishing her study, she did 5 minutes of gentle pre-bedtime stretching, focusing on relaxing her shoulders and lower back to ease the fatigue of the day.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Contact family and friends before bed and record mood
description: After stretching, Xiaowen leaned against the headboard. She first sent a WeChat message to Sun Yue to ask whether her father had gone to sleep. Sun Yue instantly replied that he had just fallen asleep and everything was normal, and Xiaowen replied with a bear-hug emoji. Then she messaged her best friend Zhang Jing to ask about the reimbursement payment status and thank her for the peony cakes she had sent, which her mother enjoyed very much. Zhang Jing immediately replied with a celebration sticker pack. Finally, Xiaowen opened the memo on her phone and recorded today's mood: 'Saturday, sunny. Recovered from a cold, finished setting up the rehabilitation corner, and Father had good results trying it. Sun Yue's support let me catch my breath. I feel calm and more confident about the future.'
location: Bedroom at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Xiaowen got up and went to the bathroom to wash up and do a simple skincare routine. Back in bed, she picked up Still Walking from the bedside and flipped through a few pages. Drowsiness soon set in. Thinking that she could spend the next day with her parents, she closed the book, turned off the lamp, and fell asleep peacefully, ending the day's activities.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Preparing at home for family interaction in the morning.
description: The phone alarm rang; outside the window the sky was overcast. Yu Xiaowen got up, washed up, changed into loungewear, and went to the kitchen to cook millet porridge, heat up steamed buns, and fry eggs. She had breakfast with her parents. After the meal, she did Baduanjin in the rehabilitation corner of the living room, took a photo, and sent it to her older brother Yu Xiaofeng, who was far away in Shenzhen, with the message: "Dad's exclusive gym is ready, waiting for you to come back and inspect it." Then she discussed with her mother about contacting the community for home rehabilitation services, and organized medical records, notebooks, and other caregiving items, preparing to go to the hospital.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Courtyard, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Accompanying her father at the hospital.
description: Yu Xiaowen and her mother walked to the hospital and performed morning care for her father in the neurology ward, gently wiping his body, turning him over, and assisting him with in-bed rehabilitation exercises. During the exercise breaks, she fed her father fruit puree with a small spoon, taking careful care of him. Her mother also assisted by the side.
location: Neurology ward, inpatient department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Discussed the rehabilitation plan with the attending physician.
description: While her father was taking a nap, Yu Xiaowen went to the doctor's office and had an in-depth discussion with Dr. Zhang, the attending physician. She carefully listened to suggestions such as increasing the frequency of sitting balance training and trying sitting up at the bedside, and reported her father's mental state at home. Together they adjusted the rehabilitation plan for the next week.
location: Doctors' office, Neurology Department, Inpatient Building, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Lunch and buying bandages
description: Yu Xiaowen went alone to the Old Chengdu Noodle Shop near the hospital and ate a bowl of tomato and egg noodles, and noted down the key points emphasized by Dr. Zhang in her phone memo. After the meal, she stopped by the Baoshenlu Pharmacy across the street to buy a box of multi-functional elastic bandages, planning to use them to secure her father's joints during subsequent training.
location: Old Chengdu Noodle House (near the intersection of Zhongzhou Middle Road and Jiefang Road, Xigong District, Luoyang) and Baoshenlu Pharmacy (Xingshu Road Branch) (Xingshu Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province)

name: Noon break in the ward and music relaxation
description: After returning to the ward, Yu Xiaowen put the bandage into the bedside cabinet, connected the Bluetooth speaker, and played Bach's "Air on the G String." In the melodious cello music, she sat by the bed with her eyes closed, enjoying a moment of peaceful music time with her father.
location: Neurology ward, inpatient department, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Nursing handover and farewell to her mother
description: Yu Xiaowen gently woke her mother and carefully explained the location of the items her father would need in the afternoon, the medication times, and the key points for communicating with the doctor. After hugging her mother goodbye, she put on her backpack and walked alone to the parking lot, preparing to return to Zhengzhou.
location: From the neurology ward of the inpatient department of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, to the parking lot.

name: Return home, pack belongings, and relax briefly
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to her parents' home, took a quick shower, changed into dry clothes, and tidied the books she had brought back from Luoyang. She used her phone to check Zhengzhou's weather forecast and traffic conditions, preparing for the drive back.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Courtyard, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Drove back to Zhengzhou
description: Light snow began to fall. Yu Xiaowen drove from Luoyang onto the expressway, returning to Zhengzhou via the Lianhuo Expressway and the Zhengzhou Ring Expressway. She drove cautiously, turned on the fog lights, and played Bach's Cello Suites in the car. She also used in-car CarPlay to play medical English course audio and review musculoskeletal system roots.
location: Lianhuo Expressway, Zhengzhou Ring Expressway (within Henan Province)

name: Arrived at residence to pick up package
description: Yu Xiaowen drove to her Zhengzhou residence, Qunying Community, parked the car, and went upstairs. At her door she found a delivery box, a package sent by her best friend Zhang Jing. She carried it inside and prepared to open it.
location: No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, Qunying Residential Complex

name: Opening packages, tidying the room, and socializing
description: After entering the room, Yu Xiaowen opened the parcel and found peony cakes, Luoyang meat swallow, silver strip vegetables, and a card that read "Take care of yourself, keep going!" She felt warm inside. She took a photo, sent it to her close friends' group chat to thank Zhang Jing, then put away her luggage and made herself a cup of honey water.
location: At the residence in Qunying Community, Courtyard 14, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and fragmented learning
description: Yu Xiaowen took frozen pork and cabbage dumplings out of the fridge and cooked 15 for dinner. While boiling, she propped her phone against the kitchen spice rack, opened the digital sticky notes on medical English roots and affixes, and quickly reviewed them.
location: Dining room at the residence, Qunying Residential Community, Courtyard No. 14, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening exam preparation for the cardiovascular system
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen opened the Internal Medicine textbook in her study and organized the core knowledge of the cardiovascular system chapter into a mind map, using a three-color pen to mark easily confused points. Then she opened the medical question bank app, completed a mock test of 50 questions, scored 72%, and focused on analyzing 5 wrong questions about antiarrhythmic drugs, writing down her reflections in a notebook.
location: Study room of the Qunying Community residence, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Writing the first draft of the paper.
description: After a short rest, Yu Xiaowen opened her laptop, pulled up the archived patient medical records, and focused on writing the case description section of her paper. She described in detail the clinical manifestations, key imaging features, and initial treatment response of the complex case. After carefully weighing her wording, she completed a first draft of about 800 words at 9:10 p.m.
location: Study room of the Qunying Community residence, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Online work communication and exchanges with friends
description: After completing the first draft of the paper, Yu Xiaowen sent a WeChat message to her supervising teacher Li Wei to ask about the review of tomorrow's medication audit report. At the same time, she replied to her best friend Zhang Jing, thanked her for the local specialties she had sent, and asked whether there was a reliable herbal medicine shop near her home, because she wanted to buy astragalus and angelica root to make soup for her father.

location: Inside the car, along the route from Fengle Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Qunying Road, Jinshui District

name: Returning home, tidying up, and preparing dinner
description: After returning home, she washed her hands and put the walnut cookies away properly. Then she watered the potted plants in the living room and had a video call with her mother, Li Xiuying, to confirm the plan to return to Luoyang on the weekend. She told her that she had bought the walnut cookies she loved, and after the call she started preparing a simple dinner.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and brief rest
description: Quickly cooked a steaming bowl of vegetable egg noodles, with some greens bought a couple of days ago. She sat at the dining table, eating while playing soothing classical music on her phone, enjoying the peace and relaxation after work.
location: Dining room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Online communication with a financial advisor about the investment plan
description: After clearing the dishes, she had a scheduled WeChat video call with financial advisor Wang Mingyuan on the sofa. Wang Mingyuan analyzed recent market fluctuations and, taking into account Yu Xiaowen's risk preference and the possibility that her father's rehabilitation might require funds, recommended increasing the monthly automatic investment from 2,000 yuan to 2,500 yuan and adding a bond-biased fund to balance risk. Yu Xiaowen found the advice pertinent and feasible, and agreed.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Immediately adjust the fund's automatic investment plan.
description: After hanging up the video call, she logged into the China Merchants Bank App and, according to the discussed plan, increased the monthly automatic investment amount for the two existing mixed funds by 250 yuan each, and set up a new monthly automatic investment plan of 500 yuan for a bond-biased fund. After the operation succeeded, the system prompted that the deduction date had been confirmed.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bookkeeping and budget review
description: Open the bookkeeping app Suishouji, carefully calculate the total expenses so far this month, confirm that all expenses are within budget, enter today's pastry purchases and supermarket grocery shopping into the system, and set a calendar reminder for next month's investment deduction date to ensure sufficient account funds.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Online socializing and relaxation
description: After handling the financial matters, she relaxed. She opened WeChat and saw her close friend Zhang Jing asking in the group chat about the next weekend's dinner gathering. Yu Xiaowen replied that they would arrange dinner for next Sunday evening. Then she browsed the family group, saw the video of her father exercising posted by her mother, liked it, and replied with a '666' sticker.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening washing up and skincare
description: Went into the bathroom to wash up and do basic skincare. While the face mask was on, she stood by the living room window and did a few minutes of gentle shoulder and neck stretches following a video on her phone, to relieve the fatigue of a day's work.
location: Bathroom and living room of the home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading before bed and preparing for sleep
description: After washing up, she leaned against the headboard and read the 'Medical Quality Improvement' chapter in Better, thinking about ways to avoid medical errors and optimize diagnosis and treatment procedures based on the details of that day's preoperative discussion with the patient's family. She underlined key points in the margins and wrote down her reflections. Then she closed the book, confirmed that the alarm for the next morning was set, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: The phone alarm went off, and Yu Xiaowen woke from a somewhat tired sleep; the sky outside the window was gray. After getting up, she did a 10-minute full-body stretch on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on relaxing her shoulders, neck, and lower back. After stretching, she leaned by the window and took five deep breaths, silently repeating, "Today will be steady and fulfilling," setting a calm tone for the long trip and weekend caregiving ahead.
location: Living room, Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Wash up, prepare breakfast and pack belongings
description: After quickly washing up, Yu Xiaowen prepared a simple breakfast for herself: two slices of whole-wheat bread, a cup of hot milk, and a boiled egg. While using the microwave to heat the milk, she checked the backpack at the entrance, confirming that the car keys, thermos, power bank, change of clothes, and the rehabilitation aids bought the day before (such as grip balls) were inside. She also placed the walnut cookies and an unopened bottle of coffee she had bought last night at the entrance, ready to take when leaving.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuted by car and reviewed medical English.
description: Yu Xiaowen drove off, connected the car stereo via Bluetooth, opened the medical English app on her phone, and set all the words and example sentences learned this week to 'random review' mode. While waiting patiently in the morning rush-hour traffic, she used the intervals at red lights to softly read along, focusing on reinforcing several technical terms related to the cardiovascular system and drug compatibility that had felt difficult during Tuesday night's review.
location: On the drive from Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Clinical work and weekend handover preparation
description: Arrived at the department on time, changed into a white coat, and attended the morning shift handover. During ward rounds, followed Dr. Li Wei and focused on patients who might need special handover over the weekend: the fluid balance of a heart failure patient and the medication adjustment plan for a coronary heart disease patient. During work breaks, used spare moments at the doctor station computer to organize the weekend handover checklist, and verbally confirmed overnight nursing matters for several key patients with head nurse Wu Min, ensuring everything was foolproof.
location: Department of Cardiology, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 North Tongbai Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Hospital cafeteria lunch and communication with family
description: At the cafeteria counter, she ordered a bowl of tomato and egg noodles and a plate of stir-fried seasonal vegetables, then found a seat by the window. While eating, she sent her mother a voice message on WeChat, saying that she planned to leave around five or six in the evening and arrive in Luoyang at about 7:30. She also thoughtfully asked her mother to prepare some soft, easy-to-digest food that her father liked, and asked about his rehabilitation training and mood that day.
location: Employee cafeteria at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Organize handover notes at noon
description: After lunch, she returned to the office and did not rest. Instead, she took out the duty log and handwrote a detailed weekend handover memo. After finishing, she took a photo and sent it to Dr. Liu Qiang, the colleague on night duty tonight, and left him two long voice messages on WeChat, briefly explaining the conditions of several patients requiring close observation and their possible changes in condition.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon consultation and bedside handover
description: After finishing the remaining medical orders and progress notes in the afternoon, it was just past four o'clock. She took the initiative to carry the handover checklist and, together with Dr. Liu Qiang, who was about to start the weekend shift, made a complete ward round, conducting a seamless, detailed handover at the bedside of each key patient to ensure that the oncoming doctor had a thorough understanding of all situations.
location: Cardiology Ward, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After work, tidy up and prepare to leave
description: Back in the office, she took off her white coat, hung it up, and changed into comfortable casual clothes. She put her work badge and office keys into her bag, then checked her phone, wallet, and car keys one last time. From the desk drawer she took out the walnut cookies and coffee prepared that morning, and hurried to the underground parking lot, placing the provisions securely on the passenger seat.
location: From the doctors' office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to the underground parking lot.

name: Drive back to Luoyang and listen to classical music
description: The sky gradually darkened and fine snow began to fall. Yu Xiaowen started the car, checked the fuel tank and condition of the car, and drove onto the Lianhuo Expressway. Traffic was not heavy. She turned on the seat heating and warm air conditioning, selected Mahler's Fifth Symphony from the playlist, and let the powerful music dispel her fatigue. When she reached the Gongyi Service Area, she pulled over, got out to stretch her stiff neck and shoulders for five minutes, and took a few sips of hot water from her thermos to make sure she stayed alert while driving.
location: On the Lianhuo Expressway (passing Gongyi Service Area), en route from Zhengzhou to Luoyang.

name: Arrived in Luoyang and exchanged greetings with family
description: The car slowly stopped downstairs at her parents' home. As soon as she entered, her mother Li Xiuying came up to take her backpack and coat. Yu Xiaowen gave her mother a warm hug, then asked about her father's rehabilitation training and emotional state that day. Hearing her mother say that her father had walked a few steps in the living room with a walker that afternoon, slow but steady, she felt very relieved and walked quickly into the bedroom to see her father.
location: Living room of parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Preparing dinner together and having family conversations
description: After changing into loungewear, she went into the kitchen, helping her mother prepare a simple home-cooked dinner (heating up the hulatang her mother had made earlier and cooking some hui mian pieces), while asking in detail about her father's medication this week and his daily rehabilitation progress. She carefully noted the details her mother dictated in the memo on her phone, and planned to communicate again with her doctor friend in Zhengzhou's rehabilitation department to confirm. Her father sat at the dining table, and the family enjoyed a warm dinner together.
location: Kitchen and dining room at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Organize caregiving supplies and record expenses
description: After dinner, she returned to her room and packed into her backpack the change of clothes she had brought back, her iPad, and a few books on rehabilitation nursing. Then she opened the expense-tracking app and roughly calculated today's spending on gas and tolls. She also wrote a preliminary framework for Saturday's caregiving schedule in her phone's memo app: take her father to the hospital for routine checkups in the morning; the afternoon is still to be decided (she could sort through old things at home or meet a friend).
location: Bedroom at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Washing up, soaking feet, and warm family time
description: After washing up, she poured herself a basin of hot water at a comfortable temperature and sat in the living room soaking her feet with her mother, listening to her mother chat about neighborhood small talk and funny things her father did on the weekend. The tension of the day's work and the fatigue of the long drive slowly melted away in the warm water. Afterward, she said good night to her mother, told her to sleep in a little longer tomorrow, and said she would take care of her father's morning activities.
location: Bathroom and living room at the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Before bed, read "Better".
description: Back in her own bed, she didn't fall asleep immediately. Leaning against the headboard, she opened the copy of Better she carried with her and carefully read the chapters on inpatient rehabilitation for cardiovascular and cerebrovascular patients and family communication skills. In light of her father's situation, she quickly jotted down a few rehabilitation care ideas and key points suitable for application in the blank margins and in her notebook.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Going to bed
description: She closed the book and turned off the desk lamp. After a day of rushing around, the familiar warmth of home and her father's recovery progress put her at ease. The snow outside seemed to have stopped, and the room was perfectly quiet. She soon fell into a peaceful sleep, ending this full and busy day.
location: Bed in parents' home bedroom, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China

name: Get up, wash up, and do morning Baduanjin.
description: Light snow was falling outside the window and the sky was faintly bright. After getting up, she felt her energy had recovered, but her lower back still felt a bit sore. She put on loose loungewear, and on the warm living room floor began a 10-minute Baduanjin session, paying special attention to movements such as 'Two Hands Held Up to Regulate the Triple Burner' and 'Seven Bounces at the Back to Dispel All Illnesses,' feeling her body stretch and her qi and blood flow.
location: Bedroom and living room of parents' home, No. 7, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Had breakfast with parents, chatting about family matters.
description: Mother had already prepared steaming millet porridge, boiled eggs, and homemade pickled radish. As you ate, you listened to Father talk about how he slept last night, while Mother kept urging you to drink more porridge and dress warmly. You shared interesting things you encountered while accompanying someone at the hospital and mentioned that you had arranged to meet an old classmate in the afternoon. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. After the meal, you took the initiative to clear the dishes.
location: Dining room at parents' home, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Walk to the hospital
description: Put on a down jacket, wrapped a scarf and gloves, and walked along Kaixuan West Road toward the hospital. The air was fresh on the snow-covered street. You carefully avoided puddles and thin ice on the ground, breathing the crisp air, and felt calm. It took about 15 minutes to reach the hospital.
location: On foot from No. 7 Courtyard, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Accompanying father and assisting with rehabilitation training
description: When you arrived at the ward, your mother had already helped your father get ready. Under the guidance of rehabilitation therapist Dr. Wang, you assisted your father with basic bedside exercises such as leg flexion and extension and arm raises, and encouraged him to walk slowly about 15 meters while holding a walker. You kept encouraging him with phrases like “Dad, great, keep breathing.” During breaks, you took out the Luoyang Evening News and read him the local news he cared about, and the two of you occasionally discussed a few things. You also recorded the details of your father's training in your phone notes (training items, duration, completion, and reactions), and discussed next week's plan adjustments with Dr. Wang.
location: No. 288, Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University, Rehabilitation Medicine Department Training Room and Ward

name: Studied treatment-related medical English during caregiving breaks.
description: After finishing training, Father felt tired and lay down for a nap with Mother's help. You sat on a chair by the hospital bed, took out your iPad, and opened the pre-downloaded medical English course, focusing on terms related to 'rehabilitation therapy' studied this week, such as therapy, rehabilitation, prescription, surgery, etc. You repeated after the audio while spelling in your notebook, and completed the accompanying fill-in-the-blank exercises.
location: No. 288, Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, at Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, beside the ward companion chair.

name: Left the hospital and walked back to her parents' home.
description: Father rested peacefully after lunch. After a few words with Mother, you left the hospital and walked home. On the way, you noticed icicles hanging from the branches in the community garden and took a photo with your phone to record the winter scene.
location: Walk from Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, to No. 7 Courtyard, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Tidying up old belongings, found my middle school diary, and went to the vegetable market with my mother.
description: After returning home, you go to the study to sort through the old box in the corner. Opening the box, inside are childhood toys, faded certificates of merit, and yellowed textbooks. At the bottom of a cardboard box, you are pleasantly surprised to find a locked middle school diary. You sit down on the chair nearby, carefully open it, and see the crooked handwriting from those years, recording nicknames shared with good friends, funny classroom anecdotes, and your dream of becoming a doctor. You cannot help but smile, and a warm, sentimental feeling rises in your heart. You then carefully close the diary. Afterward, you and your mother go to the nearby Kailu Road Farmers' Market to buy ingredients: fresh pork belly, chives, and ready-made dumpling wrappers.
location: The study at the parents' home, 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, and the farmers' market on Kaixuan Road

name: Organizing purchased items and calling old classmate Chen Siyu on the phone.
description: After returning home, you put away the groceries, washed your face briefly, and then called Chen Siyu, agreeing to meet at Lijing Gate in the Old City half an hour later. On the phone you joked about whether walking in the snow was romantic, and confirmed that she had already set out from Xigong District; the estimated times matched.
location: Living room at parents' home, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Take the bus to Lijing Gate in the old city
description: You sling a small shoulder bag over your back and take a bus to the old town. The bus runs along Zhongzhou Road, and the familiar street scenes pass by outside the window. About 25 minutes later, you get off at Lijingmen Station.
location: From Kaixuan West Road Bus Stop, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province to Lijing Gate Scenic Area, Laocheng District, Luoyang, Henan Province, by bus

name: A City Walk with Chen Siyu at Lijing Gate in the Old Town.
description: At the entrance of Lijing Gate, you met Chen Siyu and hugged playfully. You walked side by side along the bluestone-paved Cross Street, admiring the red lanterns and snow scenery on the ancient buildings while complaining about your work pressure and hospital trivialities. When you came to a time-honored Liu's Hulatang shop, you each ordered a bowl of steaming hot hulatang with freshly fried oil cakes, and felt warm all over. Passing a pastry shop, you bought a box of peony cakes and ate them while strolling. Then you stopped at an old bookstore called Dream-Seeking Bookstore at the street corner. You found a copy of Stories of Old Luoyang with a slightly yellowed cover and bought it immediately. Chen Siyu bought a literary magazine. You talked about the old days in high school when you went to the study room together and snacked secretly, and reluctantly said goodbye at the intersection as it grew dark.
location: Lijing Gate and Cross Street, Laocheng District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Took the bus back to her parents' home in Xigong District.
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Siyu, you took the bus home alone. Watching Luoyang light up in the twilight, you felt relaxed and savored the leisurely afternoon.
location: Take the bus from Lijingmen Bus Stop, Laocheng District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, to Kaixuan West Road Bus Stop, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Make dumplings with my mother and prepare dinner
description: After getting home and putting down your bag, you sat around the dining table with your mother. She minced the meat and prepared the filling, while you washed and chopped the vegetables. Once everything was ready, you started making dumplings together. Your mother taught you hand-over-hand how to pinch the pleated edges. Your first few dumplings were crooked, but after patient practice, they gradually began to look quite presentable. You found the process of making dumplings very therapeutic, and your mood settled down after the whole day.
location: Kitchen and dining room of parents’ home, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: The whole family enjoys dinner (handmade dumplings)
description: Father was helped by mother to the dining table. Seeing the steaming dumplings and vinegar dishes on the table, he showed a rare smile. Mother placed a dumpling on each of your and father's plates and said, "Xiaowen made them, have a taste." You took a bite of the dumpling you had made yourself; the pork and chive filling was delicious and juicy, and you felt satisfied and warm inside. At the table, you mentioned the amusing things you saw in your middle school diary that afternoon, drawing laughter from your parents.
location: Dining room at parents' home, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Writing the introduction section of the paper
description: After dinner and cleaning up, you went to the study and opened your laptop. You reorganized your thoughts on the cardiorenal syndrome case report, combined with the medical English knowledge you learned in the morning and the literature you had previously reviewed, and began to focus on writing the "Introduction" section. You described in detail the clinical challenges of the disease and the shortcomings of existing research, and naturally led into the research value of this case. During the writing process, you opened PubMed on your phone twice to check references, carefully weighing your wording. By 9:30 p.m., you finally finished the first draft of the introduction and merged it with the previously completed case description, saving it as one document.
location: Study at parents' home, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and a call with best friend Sun Yue
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, you lay in bed and called Sun Yue on WeChat video. You told her about the day's experiences, including your father's rehabilitation progress, the fun you had with Siyu in the old town, and the new progress on your thesis. Sun Yue said she had already bought a high-speed rail ticket for the next morning to come to Luoyang. You excitedly confirmed the specific time and place to meet at Luoyang Longmen Station and then go to visit your father together. You felt deeply grateful for your best friend's timely help. After chatting for 20 minutes, you said goodnight to each other. After hanging up, you felt grounded and warm inside.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, Courtyard 7, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Read before bed to relax
description: From the bedside table, you picked up Stories of Luoyang's Old Town, which you had found in the second-hand bookstore that afternoon. You turned on the bedside lamp, leaned against the headboard, and flipped through a few pages. The book described Luoyang's old alleys and street life from decades ago, with plain and warm writing. From outside the window came the occasional sound of melted snow dripping. You felt that although your body was tired, your mind was greatly relaxed and comforted.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, Courtyard 7, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Turn off the lights and rest.
description: You closed the book, turned off the bedside lamp, and listened to the faint sounds outside the window. Carrying the anticipation of meeting your close friend tomorrow and the satisfaction of a day filled with family affection, friendship, and nostalgia, you gently closed your eyes and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at parents' home, Courtyard 7, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Morning exercise and washing up
description: Yu Xiaowen practiced Baduanjin and neck stretches in the small courtyard at her parents' home. Afterwards, she went inside, washed up briefly, changed into home clothes, and prepared for the day.
location: The courtyard and interior of parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Had breakfast with parents and organized discharge paperwork.
description: Yu Xiaowen had breakfast with her mother Li Xiuying and father Yu Jianguo, eating millet and sweet potato porridge, pickled cucumbers, and steamed buns. After breakfast, she returned to her study and carefully sorted out her father's ID card, medical insurance card, hospitalization deposit receipt, examination report sheets, and other documents required for discharge, placing them in a document folder for the procedures.
location: Parents' home dining room and study, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Walk to the hospital and handle discharge billing.
description: Yu Xiaowen put on her down jacket, slung on her canvas bag, and walked about 22 minutes from No. 42 Kaixuan West Road to Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated with Zhengzhou University. After arriving, she queued at the settlement window on the first floor of the inpatient building, handed in all the documents, and after the fees were calculated, paid the out-of-pocket portion via mobile payment, smoothly obtaining the discharge summary and itemized cost statement.
location: From No. 42, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, to the inpatient settlement window of Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288, Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Assisted father with rehabilitation exercises and completed the final discharge procedures.
description: After returning to the ward, Yu Xiaowen helped her father pack his personal belongings and borrowed a wheelchair. Then, together with the rehabilitation therapist, she helped her father to the rehabilitation therapy room, where he performed balance standing and short-distance walking training under guidance. After 10 o'clock, her mother Li Xiuying arrived. Yu Xiaowen went to the nurse station to complete the final confirmation, picked up discharge medications (aspirin, statins, etc.), and listened to the nurse's detailed instructions on home care precautions.
location: Orthopedic ward, rehabilitation treatment room, and nurses' station, 6th floor of the inpatient building, Luoyang Central Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Take a taxi home and settle father down to rest
description: When everything was ready, Yu Xiaowen and her mother called a ride-hailing car, carefully helped her father into the car, and asked the driver to drive slowly on the way. After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen helped her father into the bedroom, took off his coat, helped him recline half-sitting on the bed with soft pillows, and her father sighed that it was more comfortable at home. Then she poured warm water and placed it by the bedside, then left the room to let him rest.
location: From No. 288 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province to the master bedroom of the parents' home at No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Simple lunch
description: While her father was resting, Yu Xiaowen and her mother had a quick lunch. Her mother cooked plain noodles in clear soup with poached eggs and braised beef, and they chatted about the afternoon visit from Sun Yue, her mother's close friend.
location: Dining area of parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Midday nap
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to her bedroom, set an alarm for 13:00, lay on the bed, and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes. Although she did not fall fully asleep, her energy was somewhat restored.
location: Bedroom in parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Jogging along the riverbank, then showering and changing clothes
description: After her lunch break, Yu Xiaowen changed into running shoes and sweatpants and jogged slowly south for 2 kilometers along the riverside path on Kaixuan Road at a comfortable pace, keeping her heart rate between 140 and 155. After the run, she stretched carefully. Back home, she quickly rinsed off with warm water, changed into a clean hoodie, and prepared fruit and tea to welcome her best friend.
location: The riverside walkway on Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province (from Luoyang Bridge to Qiyi Road) and the home at No. 42 Kaixuan West Road

name: Best friend Sun Yue comes to visit
description: In the afternoon, her close friend Sun Yue arrived by taxi, bringing a fruit basket and nutritional supplements. Yu Xiaowen warmly welcomed her at the entrance of the residential community. Sun Yue first visited Yu Jianguo, then helped place the thermos, blood glucose meter, and pill box by the bedside, and put non-slip mats in the hallway. Afterwards, the two of them sat in the living room with her mother Li Xiuying, drinking tea and chatting. Together they sorted out her father's medication, rehabilitation training schedule, and follow-up appointments for the next two weeks, and Sun Yue shared some home rehabilitation tips. In the evening, Yu Xiaowen walked Sun Yue to the community gate, hugged her goodbye, and they agreed to meet again in Zhengzhou.
location: Parents' home and the community entrance at No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Short rest and adjustment
description: After seeing Sun Yue off, Yu Xiaowen returned to the living room, poured herself a glass of warm water, and sat on the sofa to rest. She opened her phone and saw Sun Yue's message reporting her safe arrival, and felt warmth in her heart.
location: Living room at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Hand-shaping pottery at home
description: Yu Xiaowen found the remaining clay and tools from her pottery class, spread newspapers on the dining table, and patiently shaped a small teacup using the coil-building method. Although the cup walls were slightly uneven, she was fully focused. Finally, she carved the character "Yu" on the bottom, wrapped the semi-finished piece in a damp cloth and stored it, enjoying the tranquility and joy of creation.
location: Dining table at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Family dinner and evening leisure time
description: Yu Xiaowen helped her mother prepare dinner, picking vegetables and slicing beef. Her father was helped to the dining table, and the family enjoyed a reunion dinner including braised pork, green vegetables, and other dishes. Her father praised her mother's cooking. After the meal, the family watched the news in the living room, discussed Father's rehabilitation plan for the next week, and talked about whether to hire a caregiver. In the end, they decided that the mother and daughter would take turns caring for him first.
location: Kitchen, dining room, and living room at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China

name: Video call with my cousin Li Yaqin.
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the bedroom, organized the key points from the family discussion, and charged her phone to get ready. At 8 pm she made a video call on time to her cousin Li Yaqin, asking in detail about practical experience caring for an elderly patient with hemiplegia, including safe bathing, dietary nutrition, preventing foot drop, and using an anti-bedsore air mattress. After the call, she wrote down more than a dozen suggestions one by one.
location: Bedroom in parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Write a rehabilitation diary.
description: After ending the call, Yu Xiaowen recorded in her notebook her father's rehabilitation training performance today, his adaptation at home, the help from Sun Yue and her cousin, and her plans and confidence for future caregiving life.
location: Desk in the bedroom at parents' home, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Helped her mother put her father to bed
description: Yu Xiaowen and her mother helped her father to the bed, propped up his pillow, wiped his face and back with warm water, set up the next day's pillbox, and only after confirming that the night light and bedside call button were ready did they leave the room at ease.
location: Father's bedroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Yu Xiaowen finished her evening skincare routine, changed into pajamas, and leaned against the headboard reading The Doctor's Advancement for more than ten minutes. At 22:30 she turned off the main light, left the night light on, and closed her eyes peacefully in the faint light from outside the window, expecting to fall asleep before 23:00.
location: Bedroom in parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Morning stretching and preparations to leave Luoyang.
description: At 5:30 in the morning, I naturally woke up in the living room of my parents' home. Then I did about 10 minutes of full-body stretching on the yoga mat, focusing on relaxing my neck and shoulders, which were sore from yesterday's caregiving and lifting. I also took a few brisk walks around the living room to fully wake up my body. Afterwards, I quickly checked the luggage I had packed last night to make sure the car keys, phone charger, the rehabilitation handbook I bought for my father, and other items were all in my backpack.
location: Living room of parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Wrote reminders for her father and said goodbye to her mother
description: At 6:20, at the desk in her father's bedroom, she carefully wrote detailed medication and rehabilitation reminders on A4 paper with a pen: take metformin and aspirin after breakfast, and amlodipine after lunch; rehabilitation exercises included standing practice in the morning and cycling in the afternoon. At the end, she drew a smiley face and wrote “Come on, Dad!” and placed the note under her father's water cup. Then she went to the kitchen and repeated the contents of the note to her mother, who was cooking porridge, reminding her to take her blood pressure medicine on time and not to overwork herself. Before leaving, she gave her mother a firm hug and turned to walk out the door briskly.
location: Study and kitchen at the parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

Along the way, I connected my phone via the car's Bluetooth. On the Fan Deng Reading App home page, I found a group reading plan for the "2025 Women's Power Booklist," which included The Second Sex and Lean In. I signed up right away, planning to join the online discussion every Tuesday evening starting March 4. The app then automatically played an audio summary of The Second Sex, and I listened for about 40 minutes while driving, absorbed in thoughts about women's self-growth. After about 80 minutes, I arrived at Zhengzhou Central Hospital at 8:10.
location: Lianhuo Expressway (Luoyang to Zhengzhou section), passing through Huiji District, Zhengzhou.

After the meeting, took over the 7 inpatients under my charge, and followed the supervising teacher Li Wei on key ward rounds, asking in detail about the recovery of the sequelae of cerebral infarction for bed 27, and checking the drainage tube of the postoperative fracture patient in bed 18. After the ward rounds, returned to the office, adjusted the medical orders for 3 patients according to Teacher Li's suggestions, and had a 15-minute condition communication with one patient's family member, patiently explaining the next rehabilitation plan.
location: Doctor's office and ward, 2nd floor, Building 7, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

While eating, Wang Fang asked with concern about your father’s recovery. You shared some warm details and thanked her for her concern. After the meal, the two of you sat on chairs in the cafeteria hall with your eyes closed for about 10 minutes to recharge for the afternoon’s work.
location: Staff cafeteria, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (Floor B1, Building 1).

After finding a high-quality paper published in 2024, she used her phone to photograph the title, authors, and DOI information. These materials are valuable for optimizing her father's rehabilitation plan and for seeing similar patients.
location: Hospital Library, Floor B1, Building 3, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: Doctor's office and ward, 2nd floor, Building 7, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: Route: drive from the hospital to Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, then walk to 1st Floor, Unit 2, Building 5, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

You reminded her to help your father apply a warm compress to his legs once more before bed and to contact you at any time if anything came up. After the call, you went into the kitchen, washed the vegetables, cut the tomato, and cooked a bowl of noodles with greens, tomato, and tofu. Then, carrying the bowl, you sat on the living room sofa, blowing on the steam as you ate, enjoying the peace and satisfaction of a moment alone.
location: Kitchen and living room, 1st floor, Unit 2, Building 5, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

location: Living room, 1st floor, Unit 2, Building 5, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

After the practice, her whole body was slightly warm and she felt full of energy.
location: Living room, (Zhengzhou Dingdong Apartment), 8th Floor, Unit 2, Building 1, Compound 85, North Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning clinical work and documentation
description: From 9:30, followed Dr. Li on ward rounds. First checked on the seven patients taken over yesterday, asking about their conditions overnight, examining vital signs, and adjusting medication orders. Around 10:00, a patient with acute pancreatitis newly admitted through the emergency department was brought to the ward. Under Dr. Li's guidance, I took a detailed history (gallstones, hyperlipidemia, alcohol use, etc.), performed a physical exam (abdominal tenderness, rebound tenderness), presented my initial assessment, helped write orders (fasting, gastrointestinal decompression, fluid replacement, somatostatin, etc.), and communicated the condition and treatment plan with the family. While recording the key case points, I asked Dr. Li about the differential diagnosis (gastric perforation, intestinal obstruction). At 11:30, after rounds ended, I returned to the office to complete the first progress note for the newly admitted patient and updated the other patients' daily orders and the senior physician's ward-round notes.

participant.name: Acute pancreatitis patients and their families.

They chatted about everyday matters for over ten minutes, and her mother reminded her to eat on time, not to overexert herself, and to rest early.
location: Living room, (Zhengzhou Dingdong Apartment), 8th Floor, Unit 2, Building 1, Compound 85, North Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Paper revision work
description: At 19:20 I went into the study, opened the laptop, found the previous paper draft, and created a new folder Paper Revision_20250225. I made a cup of hot tea, adjusted the desk lamp, and officially started revising at 19:30. I began by reading the introduction, rearranged the order of several paragraphs to make the logic flow better, and polished the language in the case description section. During the process, to verify a statistical statement about drug usage rate, I spent nearly half an hour searching relevant Chinese literature on PubMed and added citations. At 21:00 I felt stiffness in my neck and shoulders, so I went to the living room and did 5 minutes of mi-character neck exercises, shoulder circles, 8 neck rotations, and 10 shoulder shrugs to relax. After the break, I returned to the study at 21:30 and continued revising. I turned on Word's Track Changes feature, checked the paragraph transitions in the case discussion section, and revised awkward sentences one by one. At 22:30 I completed the first round of integrated revisions, saved the file as Paper_IntroductionCaseDescription_Revision1_20250225.docx, and planned to finish the final revision and polishing by the 27th.
location: Study and living room, 8th floor, Unit 2, Building 1, No. 85 North Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (Zhengzhou Dingdong Apartment)

After finishing, my body was slightly warm and my mind felt refreshed.
location: Living room of Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Washing up, breakfast, and light housework

name: Adjusting study mindset.
description: After tidying up, she went into the study and sat down at the desk. She first made herself a cup of hot tea and placed it on her right. Then she opened her laptop, connected the Bluetooth keyboard, and neatly arranged a thick medical English notebook and several pens of different colors. She opened the medical English course app on her phone and glanced at the syllabus for Week 3, 'Reading Medical Literature Abstracts,' which was the part to study today. After getting a rough idea of the content, she was ready for the immersive study ahead.
location: Study at Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Immersive medical English learning
description: At 8:50 a.m., she officially began studying. She put on headphones and opened the English literature excerpts and lecture slides provided by the course. When she encountered complex terms such as randomized controlled trial, cohort study, and hazard ratio, she habitually paused the video, used a medical dictionary app on her phone to look up their exact explanations and example sentences, and carefully recorded them in her notebook. She adopted a paragraph-by-paragraph close-reading method: first, she read through the English paragraph and tried to guess the meaning from context; then she compared it with the video explanation to understand the author's argumentation logic; finally, she turned off the explanation and tried to orally retell the core content of the paragraph. This immersive study lasted about 2.5 hours, ending around 11:20. Her notebook had five full pages of notes, and she felt that her understanding of academic English had improved significantly.
location: Study at Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.
