location: Kitchen, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and interaction with family
description: She skillfully boiled a pot of water. While the noodles were cooking, she cut the tomatoes into pieces and washed the spinach. After the water boiled, she put in the noodles, and when they were about 70% cooked, she added the tomatoes and beaten egg. Finally, she added the spinach and blanched it, sprinkled in a little salt and sesame oil, and a steaming bowl of tomato egg noodles was ready. She also quickly tossed a small bowl of spinach salad with vinaigrette. At 12:15, she sat at the table with her lunch, eating while scrolling on her phone. She saw her second brother Yu Xiaofeng send a message in the “Happy Family” group saying he had confirmed going back to Luoyang for the weekend, and @-ed her to ask if she was going too. She replied that she had no shift this weekend and should be able to go back to Luoyang with everyone to see how their dad was doing. Her mother then sent a happy emoji, and her father also sent a voice message saying okay, looking forward to her return. After eating the noodles, she felt satisfied and content, as if the warmth of home was right there with her.
location: Qunying Community Restaurant, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and relaxation
description: After finishing lunch, she did not immediately dive into studying. After cleaning up the dishes, she went into the bedroom, drew the sheer curtains, dimmed the light, put on a steam eye mask, and took a 40-minute nap on the bed. After the nap, feeling quite refreshed, with 20 minutes left, she leaned against the headboard, opened the music app on her phone, played a soothing piano piece, and enjoyed a moment of peace and relaxation.
location: Bedroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tackling the thesis methodology.
description: At 1:50 PM, she sat down at her desk on time and began thinking about the long-troubling methodological issues of her paper. She opened the outline she had written earlier, focusing on the data statistics section. She realized that her research involved survival analysis, especially the application of Cox regression and Kaplan-Meier curves, and that her undergraduate statistics foundation was weak. She dug out her undergraduate statistics textbooks and also searched for relevant examples on Zhihu and PubMed. Instead of writing immediately, she took out a new grid notebook and listed her confusions one by one: How to handle missing data? How to assess the Cox proportional hazards assumption? How to mark censored data in Kaplan-Meier curves, and how to interpret them? She planned to ask Li Wei, the department's statistics expert, or colleagues in the statistics office the next day, using this list as the core outline for communication.
location: Study at Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Rest and going out for fresh air
description: After an hour and a half of brainstorming, she felt a little tired and stuck. To change her mood, she decided to go out for a walk. She put on lightweight sneakers, grabbed her keys and phone, and walked to Zhuchunyuan Park, not far from the residential complex. It took about 10 minutes on foot. In the park, she walked slowly along the lakeside path for two laps. Seeing the white magnolias in full bloom immediately lifted her spirits. She took out her phone, snapped a few photos, and sent them to the WeChat group 'Childhood Friends Trio' to share the beauty of spring.
location: Zhuchun Garden Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Review and final test for the online course
description: She got home at 4 o'clock and quickly got herself into the right state. Following the plan, she systematically went through the medical English notes from the previous three weeks, quickly reviewing everything from basic vocabulary and doctor-patient conversations to literature reading, and confirmed there were no major gaps. Then she logged into the course platform, took a deep breath, and clicked the button for the 'Final Quiz.' The quiz included 15 listening multiple-choice questions, 10 situational matching questions, and one short essay. She answered with full concentration and in an orderly manner. About 60 minutes later, she clicked submit, and the score immediately appeared on the screen: 88. She was fairly satisfied with this score, feeling that she had achieved the goal she set for herself. She immediately took a screenshot of the wrong questions and saved it to the 'Medical English Wrong-Question Analysis' folder for later review.
location: Study at Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Decided to renew the course and register.
description: Seeing the quiz results, she gained more confidence in continuing to study. She logged in to the course website and carefully reviewed the course schedule of 'Advanced Systematic Medicine English Course', and found that it covered case discussions, academic presentations, and other content—exactly what she needed. Without hesitation, she completed the payment on her phone and successfully registered. Looking at the successful registration page, she felt that her career development had taken another step forward.
location: Study at Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Dinner and video chat with family
description: After the study session came to an end, she felt hungry. She did not want dinner to be too complicated, so she used the leftover spinach and tomatoes from lunch, added two eggs and a few shrimp, and made a simple tomato spinach shrimp soup, served with a slice of whole wheat bread. It was light and nutritious. After dinner, she made a video call to her parents. After a few rings, her mother's face appeared on the screen, and her father was also sitting beside her. She asked with concern how her father's rehabilitation training had gone today. He smiled and told her that this morning, with her mother's support, he had walked back and forth across the room twice. Although it was slow, his legs felt stronger than before. Yu Xiaowen was very happy to hear this and gave her father a thumbs-up, telling him not to be impatient and to take it step by step. The video call lasted 20 minutes. She felt both comforted and still a little concerned.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Short rest and preparation
description: After hanging up the video call, she cleared the dining table and washed the dishes and chopsticks. Then she prepared for the evening's paper revision work: she opened the draft saved on her computer and confirmed the structure adjusted based on the 25th. She also made a fresh cup of hot tea, set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, and got ready to enter a state of focused work.
location: Living room/study, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Final revision and finalization of the paper.
description: At exactly 7 PM, formally started the paper revision work. Put on glasses, and faced the computer screen, reading through the introduction and case description sections word by word. Today's main tasks were language polishing, terminology consistency, and data verification. Every time a faulty sentence or inappropriate wording was found, it was marked in track changes. For terminology consistency, she made sure 'acute coronary syndrome' was used throughout the full text instead of an abbreviation, and that the singular and plural forms of all medical terms were correct. For the time points in the case description (such as 'day 3 after admission'), she carefully checked the original medical records to ensure the data were accurate. After two hours of hard work, the final revision of this part was completed. At 9 o'clock, after checking everything, she renamed the file to Paper_Introduction_Case_Description_Final_20250227.docx and saved it both locally on the computer and to a cloud drive, and only then felt relieved.
location: Study at Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Evening core training and spinal relaxation
description: After finalizing the paper, she stood up and moved her stiff neck and shoulders. To relieve the discomfort of prolonged sitting, she started today’s exercise plan on the yoga mat in the living room. First, she did 15 minutes of core training: 3 sets of planks, each held for 45 seconds; 3 sets of glute bridges, 15 reps each; and 3 sets of bird-dog exercises, 10 reps per side. After training, she felt her core activated and a pleasant soreness in her waist and abdomen from being worked out. Then she did a 5-minute spinal relaxation routine, using poses like cat-cow stretch and child’s pose to thoroughly relax her tense back muscles.
location: Living room of Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Desk tidying and evening reading
description: After exercising, her body felt relaxed and comfortable. She spent 15 minutes tidying the desk, putting the reference books and notebooks scattered on it back in place, and wiping the desk surface with a tissue. Then she opened the Todoist app on her phone and listed tomorrow's to-do items: 1. Ask Teacher Li about statistics questions; 2. Go to Bank Street Painting and Calligraphy Society to buy a new book; 3. Contact the paper's co-author to confirm authorship. After doing all this, she returned to the bedroom, leaned against the headboard, turned on the bedside lamp, picked up "Records of Integrating Chinese and Western Medicine" that she had been reading recently, turned to where she had left off, and read quietly for 20 minutes, immersed in the wisdom of traditional medicine.
location: Study/Bedroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: At 22:15, she put down her book and went to the bathroom to wash her face, brush her teeth, and do her pre-bed skincare routine. Then she went back to the bedroom, set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, turned off the main light, and left only a dim night light. Lying in bed, she reflected on the fulfilling day and felt confident about the next steps for her paper. Soon after, she fell asleep.
location: Bathroom/bedroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning Baduanjin and micro-habit review
description: At 7 a.m., the alarm went off right on time. I spread out the yoga mat in the living room and smoothly completed a 12-minute Baduanjin routine following the guided music on a mobile app. After the closing posture, I sat on the mat and felt my shoulders and neck relax. Feeling accomplished for having kept it up for 21 consecutive days, I decided to make this habit a long-term lifestyle.
location: Living room, Room 602, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Washing up, breakfast, and pre-departure preparation
description: After washing up, I changed into comfortable casual pants and a sweater, with a thick trench coat on top. For breakfast I had a simple meal of millet porridge and a boiled egg, while checking the packing list on my phone to make sure the trunk contained the new grip balls, resistance bands, and a few seasonal clothes I had bought for my father. I put the backpack full of thesis materials and The Second Sex by the door, grabbed the car keys.
location: Room 602, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Complex, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Drove to the hospital.
description: Starting from Qunying Road, drove about 18 minutes to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. On the way, listened to traffic radio for road conditions and weather, and switched the station to a classic oldies channel to relax. Arrived at the hospital parking lot around 8:10.
location: From Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Morning clinical work and asking questions.
description: At 8:10 I went to the department and changed into a white coat. At 8:30 I attended the department morning meeting, focusing on handover of newly admitted patients. After the meeting, I followed Dr. Li Wei on rounds, asked in detail about the overnight conditions and rehabilitation progress of key patients, and carefully recorded treatment adjustment opinions. After rounds, I asked Dr. Li about how to perform data stratification in SPSS for Cox regression analysis. Dr. Li patiently answered and recommended a statistics textbook, suggesting starting with the software menu Analyze - Survival Analysis. I took careful notes.
location: Rehabilitation Medicine Department office and ward, 6th floor, inpatient building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and casual chat with colleagues
description: I had lunch with my colleague Wang Fang on the second floor of the hospital cafeteria. I ordered rice topped with fish-flavored shredded pork, and Wang Fang ordered small dishes. We chatted about our weekend plans. I mentioned that I was going back to Luoyang in the evening. Wang Fang asked about my father's recovery and shared her relative's experience with rehabilitation after a cerebral infarction. Learning that my father could stand while holding onto a cabinet made us both happy.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: During the lunch break, she reviewed rehabilitation literature
description: After lunch, I went to the hospital library on the second floor of the administration building. In the periodicals area, I browsed the latest issue of the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine and used my phone to capture two articles on mirror therapy and motor imagery in upper-limb functional rehabilitation after stroke. Then, in the electronic reading area, I opened reference management software, created a folder named 'Rehabilitation Medicine Transition,' and entered the reference information.
location: Library, 2nd Floor, Administration Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work and shift handover preparation
description: As soon as I got to work in the afternoon, I continued handling my tasks: I received a newly transferred stroke patient and completed the assessment, and communicated with the family of a patient about to be discharged about home rehabilitation precautions. In my spare time, I mentally reviewed the SPSS operation points that Teacher Li taught in the morning. At 4:00 PM, I attended and completed the department's daily shift handover on time.
location: Office, Rehabilitation Medicine Department, 6th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Organizing and wrapping up before leaving work
description: After the handover ended, I returned to my workstation and packed up my belongings, then shut down the computer. I used a mobile map app to confirm the best route from the hospital to my parents' home in Luoyang, checked the traffic on the Lianhuo Expressway, and sent my mother a WeChat message to let her know I was leaving. Then I went to the parking lot to get the car.
location: Office of the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, 6th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province; parking lot

name: Drove back to Luoyang
description: Starting from the hospital parking lot, she took the Lianhuo Expressway back to Luoyang. Traffic on the expressway was steady; she turned on the radio to a music channel. On the way, she stopped at the Gongyi Service Area for 5 minutes to stretch, and exited the Luoyang toll station at about 18:55.
location: Lianhuo Expressway (Zhengzhou section to Luoyang section)

name: Arrived in Luoyang to reunite with parents.
description: I parked the car downstairs at my parents' building, took my backpack and rehabilitation supplies, and went upstairs. When the door opened, I was greeted by my mother's smiling face and the aroma of food. My father was sitting on the sofa and smiled when he saw me. My mother told me to wash my hands and eat quickly. On the table were my favorite braised spare ribs and Luoyang swallow dish.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Building 2, Courtyard 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Assist father with rehabilitation training and family dinner.
description: After dinner, I took out my newly bought grip ball and resistance band, demonstrated how to use them, and encouraged my father to try. My father gripped and squeezed with his affected hand while I counted and cheered him on, 3 sets of 15 reps each. Next, I helped him do several arm abduction exercises with the resistance band. After exercising, I helped my mother clear the table and washed the dishes while chatting; my father listened in the living room and occasionally chimed in.
location: Living room and dining room, Room 501, Unit 3, Building 2, Courtyard 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Accompanied mother for a walk in the neighborhood
description: I walked arm in arm with my mother in the neighborhood. The neighborhood was quiet at night, and under the streetlights our mother-daughter shadows stretched long. We strolled and chatted along the path around the central garden. Mother talked about everyday things, such as the new vegetable shop downstairs and the neighbors' new grandson. I also carefully observed the neighborhood roads for obstacles, considering my father's future outings.
location: Internal road in the residential compound at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Evening family communication
description: After the walk, the family of three sat in the living room. I peeled an apple for my father and handed it to him. We watched TV news for a while, talked about my father's rehabilitation plan for the next week, and my brother Yu Xiaofeng's recent situation in Shenzhen. I shared what I gained from consulting Dr. Li today and said I would learn SPSS on the weekend. My father encouraged me to study hard.
location: Living room of Room 501, Unit 3, Building 2, Courtyard No. 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Washing up and tidying
description: I first took a shower and changed into comfortable pajamas, then in the bedroom I took out my laptop and work notebook, organized the key points of the statistics questions I asked Teacher Li today into electronic notes, bookmarked the SPSS software download link, and wrote my weekend plan in my phone memo: take a walk in the park with my father, learn basic SPSS operations, and catch up on medical statistics video courses.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Unit 3, Building 2, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Setting March daily routine alarms and plan records
description: Before going to bed, I picked up my phone to check and fine-tune the March alarm schedule, and set the 6:30 weekday wake-up alarm. I opened my notebook and wrote down a simple plan for tomorrow: take my father for a walk in the morning, and install and learn the basics of SPSS in the afternoon. I looked through the calendar and marked the arrangement for the Women's Power Reading List online discussion on March 4.
location: In front of the desk in the bedroom at Room 501, Unit 3, Building 2, Courtyard 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Reading and bedtime reflections.
description: I leaned against the headboard, took out The Second Sex from my backpack, and continued reading, reflecting on the ideas in the book. After finishing a chapter, I closed the book and wrote today's reflections in my phone memo: 'Sticking to a habit for 21 days has made me believe in the power of long-termism; the warmth of going home is the support that drives me forward; tomorrow I will keep learning and keep accompanying my family.'
location: On the bed in the bedroom of Room 501, Unit 3, Building 2, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Bed rest
description: I turned off the main light, leaving only a small bedside nightlight, and savored the warm moments with my family during the day. With a sense of contentment, I turned off the light and fell asleep around 22:30.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of Room 501, Unit 3, Building 2, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Restorative morning jog along the riverside
description: I left home at 6 a.m. and went for a recovery jog along the riverbank path of the Luo River, from Kaixuan Bridge to Qiyi Road. The 2 km took about 13 minutes 30 seconds, and my heart rate stayed at around 145 bpm. After the run, I did static stretching carefully by the riverbank, enjoying the fresh morning air and the changing sky.
location: Kaixuan Road riverside trail, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China (Kaixuan Bridge to Qiyi Road section).

name: Return home for stretching and Baduanjin exercise
description: After jogging back to her parents' home, she laid out a yoga mat in the living room and first did a 5-minute full-body stretch, focusing on relaxing her leg muscles. Then she perked herself up and practiced two complete Baduanjin movements: "Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner" and "Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Eagle." The movements were slow and steady, and the 15-minute practice left her body fully stretched and relaxed.
location: Living room of parents' home, No. 42 Courtyard, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Helped mother care for father and had breakfast with parents
description: After a quick wipe of sweat, she immediately joined her mother and helped her father, Yu Jianguo, wash up. She prepared warm water, a towel, and a toothbrush, and assisted her mother in measuring her father's morning blood pressure (138/85 mmHg). She supervised her father taking his pre-meal medication, chatting softly with him to ease his somewhat restless mood caused by slow recovery. Then the family of three sat around the dining table, enjoying the spicy soup (hulatang) made by her mother, Li Xiuying, and the freshly fried oil cakes. Xiaowen praised her mother's cooking while drinking the soup, and also peeled a boiled egg and put it into her father's bowl. A smile appeared on her father's face.
location: Parents' home, No. 42 Courtyard, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan, China (father's bedroom and dining room)

name: Assisted mother in caring for father, performing rehabilitation massage and mental imagery training
description: After breakfast and a short rest, Xiaowen and her mother did lower-limb rehabilitation massage for her father. Drawing on the literature she had looked up the night before about mirror therapy and motor imagery, she tried to guide her father through a mental exercise of "imagining himself walking" during the passive massage, while adjusting the strength and rhythm of the massage techniques to better stimulate the nerves and muscles. Her mother watched and learned seriously, asking questions from time to time.
location: Living room of the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Accompany mother to buy groceries at Kaixuan Road Farmers' Market
description: She accompanied her mother on foot to the Kaixuan Road farmers' market. Passing Kaixuan Road Primary School, her mother talked about her grandchildren's schooling. The weekend market was bustling. They first bought sugar tangerines and sugar-roasted chestnuts that her father loved, then picked out some fresh spinach and mushrooms at a vegetable stall to prepare lunch. Her mother chatted with a familiar vendor while Xiaowen waited quietly beside her, enjoying the everyday liveliness.
location: Kaixuan Road Farmers' Market, intersection of Kaixuan West Road and Jiefang Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Returned home to pack up belongings and help mom prepare lunch
description: Carrying the purchased items home, Xiaowen helped her mother sort and put away the vegetables and fruits. She then went to her room, drank some water, and relaxed for a moment. Then she put on an apron and went into the kitchen to help her mother, peeling garlic, trimming vegetables, and washing mushrooms while her mother stir-fried at the stove, the kitchen filling with the aroma of cooking. At noon, she took a cup of water to the living room and chatted with her father, talking about the TV drama he was watching or about her older brother Xiaofeng's recent situation in Shenzhen, keeping her father in good spirits.
location: Parents' home (kitchen, living room, and bedroom) at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Lunch and fruit distribution
description: Lunch was garlic spinach, stir-fried sliced pork with mushrooms, and tomato and egg soup made by her mother. Xiaowen served rice for her father, and the family of three chatted while eating. After the meal, she washed sugar tangerines and strawberries, and peeled a few for each person as after-meal fruit.
location: Dining room at parents' home, Compound 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Lunch break and rehabilitation literature review.
description: After the meal, drowsiness set in, and Xiaowen returned to her room for a nap. Before sleeping, she browsed the notes from the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine brought back from the hospital the day before, focusing on application cases of mirror therapy, and marked them for the afternoon practice. About 30 minutes later, she put down the notes and fell asleep peacefully.
location: My own room at my parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Accompany her father for outdoor rehabilitation training
description: In the warm afternoon sun, Xiaowen and her mother supported her father on both sides as they went downstairs to the open area in the central garden of the community. She patiently encouraged her father to walk slowly along the flat path, and when he got tired, they rested on a bench. During the rest, she supervised her father through several sets of balance exercises involving chair-supported standing and leg lifts. She recorded the entire training process on her phone and noted in the rehabilitation log: 'Today's walking distance is about 150 meters, balance score 3, high spirits.'
location: Central Garden, No. 42 Courtyard, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Studied SPSS statistical software independently at home.
description: After her father went upstairs to rest, Xiaowen opened SPSS on her laptop. Following the guidance of the textbook recommended by Teacher Fang, she started with menu operations, tried importing a simple data set, and used functions such as "Descriptive Statistics" and "Independent Samples T-Test." She jotted down every small problem she encountered, planning to ask the teacher for advice later.
location: At the desk in her room at her parents' home, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Helped mother sort seasonal clothes and tidy up the kitchen
description: After the study session came to an end, Xiaowen took the initiative to have her mother help sort through her father's seasonal clothes. She folded the thick winter coats and placed them in storage boxes, then took out the light spring jackets and hung them in a convenient spot. She then wiped down and reorganized the kitchen condiment bottles and the dish and utensil cabinet. Her mother watched from the side, her eyes full of pride.
location: Bedroom and kitchen at parents' home, Courtyard 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Preparing dinner and caring for father.
description: Xiaowen let her mother rest and tied on an apron to prepare dinner. She planned to make a clear stewed crucian carp soup to nourish her father and stir-fry two light vegetable dishes. While busy in the kitchen, she occasionally went to the living room to check on her father, who was watching TV, to make sure he was all right.
location: Kitchen and living room of parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Dinner was served, including the clear-simmered crucian carp soup and oyster sauce lettuce made by Xiaowen, and the cucumber salad made by her mother. The atmosphere at the table was peaceful; the family of three chatted about everyday family matters while eating.
location: Dining room at parents' home, Compound 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Discuss moving to Zhengzhou with parents
description: After clearing the dishes, Xiaowen gathered her courage and formally proposed the idea of moving to Zhengzhou to her parents. She explained in detail that Zhengzhou had more abundant rehabilitation resources and a higher medical insurance reimbursement rate, that she would no longer need to travel back and forth between the two cities, and that she could better take care of the family. She even suggested renting a three-bedroom apartment near the hospital. Her mother, Li Xiuying, listened carefully and her expression softened; her father, Yu Jianguo, remained silent the whole time and finally only said, 'Let me think it over.' Xiaowen said she understood and would organize more detailed materials for them to review.
location: Living room of the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Watch TV with my mother to keep the atmosphere stable
description: To avoid an awkward standoff, Xiaowen proactively turned on the TV, tuned to the opera channel her mother loved, and watched it with her. The mother and daughter chatted about the plot now and then, and her mother's mood gradually calmed. Xiaowen knew this matter would take time; at least today's conversation was a good start.
location: Living room of the parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: WeChat communication with my brother and video call with my best friend.
description: Back in her room, Xiaowen first sent a long WeChat message to her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng, updating him on their father's condition today and the discussion with their parents about relocating. Then she video-called her close friend Zhang Jing and talked about recent confusion and stress. Zhang Jing encouraged her to take things slow and not rush. Her friend's comfort made her feel much lighter.
location: My own room at my parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Wash up and relax
description: After hanging up, Xiaowen went to the bathroom and thoroughly enjoyed a hot shower. After changing into comfortable pajamas, she sat against the headboard and read a few pages of The Second Sex. The book's discussion of women's self-worth made her think of her multiple identities as a doctor, a daughter, and a woman.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Organized rehabilitation logs and drafted next week's rehabilitation plan.
description: After reading, she opened the memo app on her phone and carefully entered today's rehabilitation data (walking distance, balance scores, emotional state, etc.). Based on her father's recent progress, she drafted an outline of next week's rehabilitation training plan, including daily massage time, training items, and goals.
location: My own room at my parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Bedtime reading, listening to music, and going to bed
description: After setting the alarm for tomorrow morning and charging her phone, she picked up 'The Second Sex' to read again. Thinking about today's communication with her parents, although there was no breakthrough progress, she had at least taken the first step, and her mood was calmer than expected. She read until 22:30, then played soothing classical piano music on her phone and closed her eyes, immersing herself in the melody. As the music faded, she turned off her phone, reviewed the day's arrangements in her mind, and felt satisfied with a sense of fullness and calm. At 23:00 she turned off the light on time and fell into a deep sleep accompanied by the faint city lights outside the window.
location: My own room at my parents' home, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China

name: Morning stretching and Baduanjin exercise
description: After the 6:25 alarm went off, Yu Xiaowen felt a bit heavy. She first sat on the edge of the bed and did 5 minutes of lower back stretches and shoulder-neck circles to relieve the soreness from caregiving. Then she practiced Baduanjin on the living room floor, focusing on the two movements “Looking Back to Treat Five Strains and Seven Injuries” and “Swaying the Head and Swinging the Tail to Dispel Heart Fire,” coordinating the movements with breathing. After ten minutes, her body felt slightly warm and her spirits were lifted. She recorded completing Baduanjin for the 21st consecutive day on the health app on her phone. Outside the window, the weather was cloudy and it felt a bit cool.
location: Living room of the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Assisted my father with morning care
description: After finishing her morning exercise, Yu Xiaowen went to her father's bedroom. Her mother, Li Xiuying, had prepared warm water, a towel, and a pillbox. Yu Xiaowen first helped her father wash up with an electric toothbrush, then helped him sit steadily, measured his blood pressure (136/84 mmHg), and supervised him taking aspirin, atorvastatin, and other medications. Throughout the process, she moved gently and kept encouraging her father. Afterwards, together with her mother, she carefully pulled her father's left leg out of the trouser leg in preparation for the subsequent rehabilitation massage.
location: Father's bedroom and bathroom, Yu Residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Her mother made the millet and pumpkin porridge her father loved, along with boiled eggs and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Yu Xiaowen blew on the porridge to cool it slightly before handing it to her father. He had a good appetite and ate most of the bowl. During the meal, her mother mentioned that the son of their neighbor Uncle Zhang had settled in Shanghai. Yu Xiaowen took the opportunity to gently bring up the topic of how convenient life and good medical resources in Zhengzhou were. Her father drank the porridge in silence; he didn't respond but didn't frown either. The atmosphere was more relaxed than yesterday.
location: Yu's Restaurant, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Submit an extension request for the medical statistics assignment.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowen returned to her room, opened her laptop, logged into the school course platform, found the medical statistics assignment submission page, and clicked “Request Extension.” In the reason field, she wrote in detail that because her father had hemiplegia after a stroke and was in the critical period of home rehabilitation, she needed to stay with him in Luoyang and could not complete the assignment, so she asked for a one-week extension. She also uploaded the relevant medical records. The system quickly showed that the request was approved, and she received a confirmation email, which temporarily reduced her academic pressure.
location: At the desk in her room at the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigu District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Perform rehabilitation training with mother for father
description: Yu Xiaowen took out the rehabilitation record book and, together with her mother, carried out the rehabilitation training for her father according to the plan. She first demonstrated lower-limb massage techniques, with her mother assisting, while she focused on kneading and pressing the muscles of her father's left leg from thigh to calf using her fingertips and palm heels to promote blood circulation and prevent muscle atrophy. Then they moved on to balance training, encouraging her father to hold on to the back of a chair and try to lift his right foot for 10 seconds. After three attempts, he managed to hold it for 8 seconds. Yu Xiaowen immediately clapped and praised him, and her father smiled.
location: Father's bedroom, Yu residence, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Cooking lunch personally and having lunch together
description: After the rehabilitation training, Yu Xiaowen let her mother rest and took over the kitchen herself. She took fresh bass, tomatoes, and eggs from the refrigerator, carefully cleaned the scales and innards, made diagonal cuts on the fish, stuffed ginger and scallions into the cuts, drizzled with steamed fish soy sauce, and made a steamed fish; the scrambled eggs with tomatoes also looked golden and appetizing. At lunch, she put the tenderest belly meat of the fish into her father's bowl. Her father nodded and praised that her cooking had improved, and her mother also smiled in praise. The family was filled with joy, and her father ate most of a bowl of rice and quite a lot of dishes. After lunch, Yu Xiaowen helped her mother clear the dishes and wipe the dining table. While washing the dishes, she chatted with her mother about the professional rehabilitation equipment in Zhengzhou. Her mother seemed to think and asked about the cost, and Yu Xiaowen was secretly delighted.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Noon break
description: Yu Xiaowen lay in bed, set a one-hour alarm, closed her eyes, and reviewed her afternoon plan: playing chess with her father, persuading her mother, organizing rehabilitation records... Amid the occasional birdsong from the community outside the window, she gradually drifted into a light sleep.
location: My room at the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Played Chinese chess with Father.
description: After the afternoon nap, Yu Xiaowen got up and washed her face. Her father had already set up the chessboard in the living room. She played chess with him, deliberately slowing down her moves and pretending to think for a long time before each move, using words to guide his thinking: "Can't this rook be moved here to check?" Her father frowned in deep concentration and gestured with his fingers on the board. Although he did not win, his thinking was clear throughout the game, and the cognitive stimulation effect was good. The game lasted nearly an hour.
location: Beside the living room coffee table at the Yu residence, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Helped my mother with household chores and urged her to move.
description: After finishing the chess game, Yu Xiaowen went to the balcony and folded dried clothes with her mother. While folding her father's shirts, she casually told her mother that Zhengzhou's medical insurance reimbursement rate is high and the rehabilitation hospital is professional, and that she could take care of him directly after work. She also mentioned that she had already looked online at several elevator communities near the hospital. Her mother's movements slowed down, and after a moment of silence she sighed and said she would discuss it further with her father. Yu Xiaowen felt the heavy weight in her heart finally lift.
location: Balcony, living room, and own room at the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Organizing father's rehabilitation records and checking work messages
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to her room, opened her laptop, created a new Excel document, and recorded in detail her father's rehabilitation training content, subjective feelings, blood pressure data, and walking duration over the past two days. At the same time, she logged into the hospital internal system to check work groups and emails; there were no urgent notices, and she took a screenshot of the day shift schedule for returning to Zhengzhou next week and saved it.
location: My room at the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Walk with mother around the neighborhood.
description: Mother suggested going downstairs for some air, and Yu Xiaowen accompanied her for a walk in the community garden. Mother pointed at the small slope ahead and mentioned that Father used to walk to that small square every morning. Yu Xiaowen took her mother's arm and, taking the opportunity, mentioned that the parks in Zhengzhou are bigger and that she could also accompany them for walks after work in the future. The mother and daughter enjoyed this rare time alone together.
location: Garden and walking path of the housing compound at No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Prepare dinner and have dinner together
description: After the walk, Yu Xiaowen helped her mother prepare dinner. Her mother chopped vegetables while Yu Xiaowen cooked porridge, and they made garlic broccoli and winter melon pork rib soup, paired with the leftover fish from lunch. The dinner atmosphere was relaxed. Her mother proactively mentioned to her father the benefits of Zhengzhou rehabilitation equipment for his leg recovery. Her father glanced at Yu Xiaowen, did not directly refute, just said “hmm” and lowered his head to drink soup. Yu Xiaowen knew her father was beginning to soften inside.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: WeChat communication with her older brother Yu Xiaofeng
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen returned to her room and made a WeChat video call to her brother Yu Xiaofeng. She briefly reported on their father's rehabilitation progress and mental state over the past two days, and excitedly told him that their mother had basically agreed to the move. Her brother, smiling in his office, expressed support, saying not to worry about their father's rehabilitation expenses, and that once they moved, they would reunite in Zhengzhou for the Spring Festival. The call lasted nearly half an hour, and Yu Xiaowen's confidence grew greatly.
location: My room at the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Reading The Second Sex
description: After talking with her brother, Yu Xiaowen leaned against the headboard, opened the WeChat Reading app, and continued reading the remaining chapters of The Second Sex. When she read the line 'One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman,' she felt deeply touched and copied the thought into her phone memo, noting the date.
location: My room at the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Watching TV with Mom
description: Mother called Yu Xiaowen to the living room to watch a popular-science variety show with her. While watching TV, Yu Xiaowen massaged her mother's sore neck and shoulders. Her mother quietly told her that her father was in a much better mood today and had even praised her at lunch. The mother and daughter sat closely together for a while, and the living room felt warm and cozy.
location: Living room of the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Evening washing up and skincare
description: Yu Xiaowen went back to her room and began to wash up. She first carefully removed her light makeup with makeup remover, then washed her face with facial cleanser, followed a skincare routine of toner, essence, lotion, and cream, and carefully applied eye cream in front of the mirror. Thinking that she would return to Zhengzhou the next day, she felt somewhat reluctant to leave.
location: Bathroom, Yu Residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Evening core workout
description: After washing up and skincare, Yu Xiaowen took out her yoga mat, laid it on the living room floor, played Bach's cello music as background music, and started a 15-minute core workout: 3 sets of standard planks, each held for about 40-50 seconds; 20 glute bridges focusing on glute engagement; 20 bird-dog exercises for balance, with 30 seconds of rest between sets. After her core was activated and she was slightly sweating, the fatigue vanished.
location: On the yoga mat in the living room of the Yu residence, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Evening relaxation and continued reading
description: After the training session ended, Yu Xiaowen returned to bed, dimmed the desk lamp, and picked up the paper version of The Second Sex to continue reading. After finishing a chapter, she closed her eyes and took deep breaths for 5 minutes, letting her mood completely settle, quietly savoring the fullness and gains of the day.
location: On the bed in her own room at the Yu residence, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Yu Xiaowen set an alarm at 5:50 the next morning to return to Zhengzhou. Considering the Monday morning rush hour, she decided to leave a bit earlier and put her charger, earphones, water bottle, and other items into her commuter bag. After turning off the desk lamp, she recalled her mother's words in the dark, "Talk it over with your dad again," and felt full of hope, planning to fall asleep before 23:00.
location: My room at the Yu residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Drove back from Luoyang to Zhengzhou in the early morning and prepared for work.
description: The alarm rang at 5:50 in the morning. Yu Xiaowen quietly got up in her parents' home in Luoyang to wash up. Before leaving, she left a note on the dining table, took the leftover fried dough cakes from last night, and at 6:00 drove her white Fit from No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, back to Zhengzhou via the Lianhuo Expressway. On the way, she played Mozart piano sonatas to stay focused, and arrived at the parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital at 7:35. After changing into her white coat, she quickly glanced over the duty schedule and patient list, and did a 5-minute stretching routine in the corner of the office, moving her neck and shoulders to help her body wake up.
location: Drive from 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang (family compound next to Kaixuan Road Primary School) to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and prepare in the doctor's office.

name: Attend the department's morning shift handover meeting
description: Attended the department morning meeting at 8 o'clock sharp. Dr. Chen from the night shift reported on last night's situation in the ward. Yu Xiaowen listened carefully and noted changes in the nighttime condition of key patients, preparing for the upcoming ward rounds.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Accompanied Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds
description: After the morning meeting, she made ward rounds with her supervising teacher Li Wei, checking patients one by one and focusing on the patient with post-cerebral-infarction sequelae. Drawing on the rehabilitation insights from the weekend in Luoyang, she suggested adjusting the patient's rehabilitation orders, such as adding ankle pumps and sitting balance training. Teacher Li Wei approved and guided her to modify the orders on the spot. During rounds, she carefully asked about the patient's feelings and comforted an anxious family member.
location: Wards, inpatient department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Saw follow-up patients in the outpatient clinic.
description: After ward rounds, she returned to the outpatient clinic and saw five follow-up patients who had made appointments in advance. She reviewed each patient's medical records and examination reports, patiently asked about their recent conditions, adjusted the antihypertensive dosage for a patient with hypertension, ordered HbA1c and blood lipid rechecks for a diabetic patient, and advised a stroke patient in rehabilitation to persist with home training. Her professional and meticulous manner was well received by the patients.
location: Outpatient consultation room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch with colleagues and a midday rest
description: After the clinic ended, Yu Xiaowen had lunch with her colleague Wang Fang in the hospital cafeteria. Yu Xiaowen ordered stir-fried seasonal vegetables and rice, while Wang Fang ordered hot and sour noodles. They chatted while eating, and Yu Xiaowen shared her feelings about returning to Luoyang over the weekend, her father's rehabilitation progress, and her mother's changed attitude. Wang Fang encouraged her and offered suggestions, starting with rehabilitation institutions and accessible facilities in Zhengzhou. After the meal, she rested with her eyes closed for more than ten minutes in the doctors' lounge. Then she browsed rental housing apps on her phone, focusing on communities with elevators in Jinshui District and Zhongyuan District that were close to rehabilitation hospitals. She put the saved links to rehabilitation center official websites and medical insurance policy articles into a memo folder, preparing material for the persuasion work in the evening.
location: Staff cafeteria and doctors' rest room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon clinical work: medical record writing and patient communication.
description: In the afternoon, she continued with clinical work. Sitting at the computer, she carefully checked and improved the medical records from the morning ward rounds and outpatient clinic, supplementing the attending physician's ward round comments. During this time, a family member of a discharged patient was unclear about follow-up rehabilitation care, so Yu Xiaowen patiently went to the ward and explained in detail the home care precautions and follow-up appointment schedule. She also found time to send a WeChat message to her mother asking about her father's recovery.
location: Doctor's office and wards, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Handed over work to the night-shift doctor.
description: At 16:30 in the afternoon, I finished organizing all patient work records and gave a detailed handover to the night-shift Dr. Chen who came to take over, focusing on the cerebral infarction patient whose rehabilitation orders had been adjusted and the hypertension patient who developed new symptoms in the afternoon.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After work, went home to cook and continued rental housing research
description: After handing over the shift, I changed into casual clothes and drove away from the hospital, along Tongbai North Road and over the Nongye Road elevated road, arriving at my residence in Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, in about 20 minutes. Back home, I changed into loungewear and made myself a steaming bowl of tomato egg noodles. While eating, I opened the rental platform on my phone again, focusing on checking the details of several alternative elevator-equipped communities, such as Jinheyuan in Zhongyuan District and the Water Resources Department Family Compound in Jinshui District, marking them as pending and saving screenshots of the listings.
location: Drove from No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City; at the residence.

name: Video chatting with parents to discuss relocating and communicating with her older brother
description: At 18:25, she started the video call with her parents as scheduled. She used her tablet to show the prepared comparison table, introduced the rankings, programs, estimated costs, and medical insurance reimbursement advantages of rehabilitation centers in Zhengzhou, and emphasized the convenience of living together and taking care of each other. For the first time, her father proactively asked, "When will you come back to look at the house?" Her mother's attitude clearly softened. After the call ended about an hour later, she immediately sent a WeChat message to her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng to report the breakthrough progress, asking him to make more calls over the weekend to help persuade them from the perspective of city life. Her brother replied with a thumbs-up emoji and agreed.
location: Residence at Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Evening washing up and stretching to relax
description: After finishing the conversation, I went to the bathroom to wash up and do my skincare routine, changed into pajamas, and did a few minutes of lower back stretches on the living room carpet to relax my body, which was a bit stiff from driving and standing for a long time.
location: Residence at Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Reading and writing notes before bed.
description: Propped up in bed, I read a few pages of The Second Sex and felt inwardly fulfilled. After finishing a chapter, I took out my diary and briefly recorded the day’s return trip to Zhengzhou, the change in my parents’ attitude, and encouraged myself by writing, “Everything is getting better. Be patient, and persevere.”
location: Bedroom at the residence in Qunying Residential Complex, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Review tomorrow's schedule and relax into sleep.
description: Checked the phone for tomorrow's schedule, confirmed the day shift, set the alarm for 6:20, placed the morning running clothes and shoes by the bed, and cast the Baduanjin follow-along video from the phone. Afterwards, she turned off the bedroom main light, turned on the bedside night light, played Chopin's Nocturne, and lay in bed recalling the day's experiences, feeling tired but hopeful. At 22:00, she turned off her phone and fell asleep in peace.
location: Bedroom at the residence in Qunying Residential Complex, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning exercise, breakfast, and getting ready to go out.
description: After the alarm went off, she did shoulder and neck stretches and two Baduanjin movements on the yoga mat in the living room—"Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner" and "Single Hand Raising to Regulate the Spleen and Stomach"—to relieve the fatigue from yesterday's long drive. Then she washed up with warm water, toasted two slices of whole-wheat bread, drank hot milk, and ate boiled eggs as a nutritious breakfast. Finally, she checked the stethoscope, flashlight, pen, and duty phone in the pockets of her white coat, put the folder with the central venous catheterization materials for the heart failure patient into her commuter bag, confirmed her work badge, drank the last mouthful of milk, and left with her car keys.
location: Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting to work by car
description: Drove the white Fit, setting off from Qunying Road, along the Nongye Road elevated road for about 16 minutes to arrive at the underground parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, listening to Mozart piano pieces on the way to stay calm.
location: Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Pre-duty preparation.
description: After putting on my white coat, I had a brief handover with Dr. Chen, who had just finished the night shift, and learned about the special changes in ward conditions overnight. Then I opened the computer to review today’s on-duty to-dos and newly reported critical lab values.
location: Doctor's office, 8th floor, Inpatient Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Department morning handover and ward rounds
description: Attended the department morning meeting on time and listened to the night-shift doctors and nurses report on last night's conditions; then joined Teacher Li Wei and the full team of doctors on ward rounds, focusing on newly admitted and unstable patients. Drawing on her father's rehabilitation experience after his cerebral infarction, she suggested to a patient with post-cerebral-infarction sequelae that the frequency of passive range-of-motion training be changed from once a day to twice a day. Teacher Li approved and changed the medical order on the spot.
location: Doctor's office and wards, 8th floor, Inpatient Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Handling ward orders and documents
description: After ward rounds, she returned to the office and carefully handled the changes to ward round medical orders, checking each one and issuing them in the system. At the same time, she started processing the admission records for newly admitted patients, including medical history collection, physical examination records, preliminary diagnosis, and treatment plan. During this period, she received an emergency call and briefly discussed the condition of a heart failure patient.
location: Doctor's office, 8th floor, Inpatient Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handling emergencies while on duty
description: A hospitalized COPD patient suddenly developed dyspnea and decreased blood oxygen saturation. I immediately rushed to the bedside with the nurse on duty, adjusted the oxygen flow, used a non-invasive ventilator as ordered, reassured the patient, and contacted the respiratory department doctor on duty for consultation. After the patient stabilized, I recorded the disease course in detail and communicated the condition changes with the family.
location: Ward and doctor's office, 8th floor, Inpatient Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and pre-procedure preparation for central venous catheter placement
description: She had lunch with her good friend Wang Fang in the staff cafeteria, eating tomato and egg noodles and green vegetables. She shared the progress of accompanying her father over the weekend and the news that her parents were softening their attitude toward moving. Wang Fang reminded her to pay attention to natural light and elevators when looking for an apartment. After lunch, she returned to the office rest area and quickly reviewed Dr. Li's procedure for central venous catheterization in heart failure patients, including the operational steps, anatomical key points, and complication management plan, while replying to Wang Lina's greeting on WeChat.
location: Staff cafeteria and doctor's office rest area, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and organizing discharge medical records
description: She first rested with her eyes closed on the cot in the on-call room for 15 minutes to recover energy, then used the quiet period after the lunch break to organize two discharge medical records, checked whether the progress notes, medical order sheets and examination report sheets were complete, and completed writing and reviewing the discharge summaries.
location: Doctor's duty room and doctor's office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Online preview and reading reflections
description: Opened the memo app on her phone and organized the reflections from last night's reading of the first chapter of Becoming into keywords, such as "From medical student to doctor, learning to accept imperfection" and "Every diagnosis is an act of self-understanding," preparing material for the evening book-sharing session.
location: Doctor's office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Assisted in completing central venous catheterization
description: Assisted Teacher Li Wei in central venous catheterization for a heart failure patient, responsible for draping, disinfection, checking medications, and other preoperative preparations. During the procedure, she served as an assistant and focused on observing the puncture technique, and under the teacher's guidance completed the local anesthesia and the first trial puncture. After the procedure, she assisted with pressure hemostasis, wound dressing, and wrote the operation record.
location: Interventional/Critical Care Operating Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Then she returned to the office to complete the remaining paperwork, printed the shift handover report, and clearly handed over the newly admitted patients, critical patients' conditions, management processes, and precautions to the oncoming Dr. Feng.
location: Nurses' station and doctor's office, 8th Floor, Inpatient Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District

name: Simple dinner and sorting out remarks

location: Kitchen and living room, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Online book club preparation and warm-up
description: Expand the keywords into a 3-5 minute sharing outline: from choosing to become a doctor, experiencing her father's illness, to accepting the imperfect process of practicing medicine. Combined with the core ideas of the first chapter of Becoming, come up with inspiring sentences and write them on small pieces of paper. Enter the Tencent Meeting 5 minutes early to adjust the earphones and microphone, and greet and chat with book club friends who are already online.
location: Study or living room, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Participated in the online group reading “Women’s Power”.
description: In the group reading discussion of Chapter 1, “Self-Awareness,” of Becoming, Yu Xiaowen opened with “We are always expected to be perfect, but growth begins with accepting imperfection,” and shared her transformation from the anxiety of pursuing quick, accurate diagnoses when she first started working to understanding medical uncertainty. She also incorporated her reflections on her father's rehabilitation, and received positive responses and likes from her fellow readers.

name: Video-called parents to finalize the move.

She presented the 'Zhengzhou Relocation Plan': targeting communities near Qunying Community with elevators and community hospitals (monthly rent 3,000-3,500 yuan), calculated that Zhengzhou's outpatient medical insurance reimbursement rate is 15% higher than Luoyang's, and promised to regularly take her father to the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University for rehabilitation assessments. Xiaowen was moved and thanked them.
location: Living room, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Discussing the family relocation with my older brother
description: Excitedly, she sent a WeChat message to her brother Yu Xiaofeng: "Bro! Mom and Dad agreed!" Then she immediately called him and recounted how their parents' attitude had changed. The two discussed financial support, and her brother readily agreed to cover half of the rent difference for the first year, saying with emotion, "Now our family is finally reunited in Zhengzhou, and I feel more confident about Dad's rehabilitation."
location: Living room, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening relaxation and preparation for tomorrow
description: After tidying the living room, she washed her face carefully in the bathroom and applied a hydrating face mask while listening to Chopin's "Nocturne" on her phone to soothe her mood. After removing the mask, she did basic skincare, opened the wardrobe to confirm tomorrow's outfit, put "The Second Sex" back on the bookshelf, and wrote in her diary: "Dad agreed. 2025, the prelude to our family's new life."
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: After flipping through a few pages of The Second Sex, I put the book down because my mind was unsettled. I briefly jotted down keywords such as 'move settled,' 'parents understand,' and 'brother supports.' Then I turned off the light, set the alarm for 6:20 the next day, thought about the fullness of the day's work and the joy of the family decision, and fell asleep with a smile.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

After getting up, she drank a glass of warm water to wake up her stomach, then did gentle stretching and Baduanjin exercises in the living room, practicing the moves 'Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Eagle' and 'Looking Back to Treat Five Strains and Seven Injuries.' The movements were slow and soothing, lasting about 15 minutes, until she was lightly sweaty.

description: She made herself a bowl of instant oatmeal and a boiled egg—simple and nutritious. While eating breakfast, she quickly scrolled through the departmental group messages on her phone, confirmed that the handover last night was fine, and also sent a greeting message to her mother, asking about the morning condition of her father and of Li Xiuying.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (residence dining room/kitchen)

name: Focused study of the “Medical Statistics” SPSS course.
description: Entering the study, she turned on the iPad and connected a Bluetooth keyboard, then started watching the SPSS hands-on video on 'descriptive statistics and t-test operations' in the course 'Medical Statistics Software Application'. It was a learning task that had been put off for two days. She focused on recording the key steps, data import format, and result interpretation, and drew an analysis flowchart in her notebook.

name: Called the rehabilitation center for consultation and organized the materials
description: After waking up and regaining her energy, she began one of the day's core tasks. She called four medical institutions in turn, including the Rehabilitation Medicine Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital and Henan Provincial Rehabilitation Center Hospital, and made detailed inquiries about post-stroke rehabilitation programs (PT, OT, and speech therapy), outpatient and inpatient fee standards, medical insurance reimbursement rates (ranging from about 70% to 85%), and appointment procedures, paying special attention to whether home assessment services were available. She then carefully entered the information into an Excel spreadsheet on her laptop, with categories such as ‘Hospital Name,’ ‘Special Programs,’ ‘Fee Standards,’ ‘Medical Insurance Reimbursement,’ ‘Appointment Method,’ and ‘Home Assessment,’ for a clear side-by-side comparison. She marked two institutions that could be scheduled for home assessments and noted key contacts, thus preparing the information for her father's subsequent rehabilitation treatment plan.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (home study)

name: Preparing and enjoying lunch

While eating lunch, she used her phone to watch a short documentary about the Mediterranean diet, both to build up knowledge for her father's later rehabilitation diet and to create a relaxed eating atmosphere for herself.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (residence kitchen/dining room)

Then I returned to the sofa in the living room and opened the few pages of core arguments in Chapter 1 of "The Second Sex," titled "Why Woman Is Defined as the Second Sex," which I had read last night, and wrote a few scattered thoughts in the blank space as a warm-up for the evening online discussion.

location: Living room at home, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (home study/kitchen)

She cooked wontons with tomato and egg, adding washed lettuce to the soup—nutritionally balanced and refreshing. She ate dinner quietly alone, then cleaned and washed the dishes.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (residence kitchen/dining room)

description: She completed her personal care before the group reading began. First she took a hot shower to wash away the day's fatigue, changed into comfortable loungewear, and applied basic moisturizing skincare products in front of the bathroom mirror to let her skin relax.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (bathroom/bedroom at residence)
