At the same time, test the computer microphone and camera to make sure the audio and video equipment works. There is then some free time: I open my phone to play European classical piano music and lazily lean back on the living room sofa to relax. As the shared reading session is about to start, I get up from the sofa, do a few simple shoulder, neck, and wrist exercises in the study, reconfirm how to enter the shared reading group, and wait for the discussion to begin.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (home study/living room)

name: Participated in the online group reading discussion of The Second Sex
description: At exactly 8 p.m., logged into the group reading club's voice/video conference on time. During the discussion on Chapter 1 of The Second Sex, 'Why Women Are Defined as the Other,' she shared her understanding and reflections on the concept of the 'Other' in light of the stereotypes she occasionally encounters as a female doctor in the workplace (such as patients or family members doubting professional competence), which resonated with several members and sparked extended discussion. The exchange of ideas was enjoyable.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (home study)

name: Video call with brother, finalize rental support.
description: Just after the shared reading ended, she received a video call request from her brother Yu Xiaofeng. After answering, she showed her brother the compiled photos of several rental listings and the rehabilitation information comparison table she had made that afternoon on the camera. Her brother was very satisfied, reiterated his promise to subsidize the 1,000 yuan monthly rent difference, and suggested that the two of them do a 'cloud house viewing' together next week, with him helping to vet the properties via video. Her brother also said he had already sent samples of the elderly-friendly grab bars from Shenzhen via SF Express.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (home study)

name: Wrote in my diary and prepared for bed.
description: After the video call ended, I felt more grounded inside. I briefly recorded today's three core progress items in my paper diary: rehabilitation materials organized, brother's support confirmed, and the rental plan made substantial progress. Then I set tomorrow's (Thursday) day shift 6:20 alarm clock, and picked out tomorrow's clothes and commuter bag to ensure a calm morning. After that, I turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp on. Leaning against the headboard, I listened to some soothing instrumental music on my phone and took a few deep breaths to calm my mind. At 23:15, after a brief look at my phone, I turned it off, switched off the light, and fell asleep peacefully. The whole day ended, fulfilling and efficient, bringing a perfect close to the compensatory rest day after the night shift.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (home study/bedroom)

name: Morning exercise and breakfast
description: The alarm went off at 6:20. After getting up, Yu Xiaowen did some deep breathing and neck stretches beside the bed. After a slight click in her lower back, she began doing Baduanjin on the mat in the living room, focusing today on “Shake the Head and Sway the Tail to Expel Heart Fire” and “Two Hands Hold the Feet to Strengthen the Kidneys and Waist” to relieve the back and waist soreness from prolonged sitting and night shifts. After 10 minutes, her body felt slightly warm and her spirits lifted. She then changed into athletic clothes and went downstairs to jog in the residential complex, circling the garden and the walkways between buildings, about 2 kilometers, with an average heart rate of 148 beats per minute, which was easier than the previous few times. After the run, she stretched downstairs. Back home, she took a shower. Breakfast was warm milk and whole-wheat bread with a fried egg, and she browsed the discussion messages in the “Medical Statistics” study group while eating. After breakfast, she checked her backpack, bringing a tape measure, notebook, power bank, and water bottle. She deliberately wore flat shoes and commuting clothes, and at 7:30 she locked the door and went downstairs.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Visited the property in person and confirmed the intention
description: Yu Xiaowen drove along Qunying Road, Jinshui Road, and Jingsan Road, with Chopin's nocturnes playing in the car, and arrived at the Jingsan Road parking spot in about 20 minutes. At 8:00 she met the agent Liu Ming at the entrance to No. 3 Courtyard, North Jingsan Road. She first viewed an 80-square-meter three-bedroom apartment on the 5th floor. It had a north-south layout, but climbing the stairs was tiring. Considering her father's postoperative recovery, she immediately ruled it out in her mind; still, she checked the kitchen and bathroom layouts and found that the bathroom door was about 65 cm wide, making wheelchair access difficult. She took a photo of the floor plan. Then she walked 1.5 kilometers to the Huayuan Road community and arrived at the west unit of XX Building after about 23 minutes. Taking the elevator to the 12th floor, she instantly felt relaxed. The 95-square-meter three-bedroom apartment had a living room facing south with good light, spacious master and second bedrooms, and a bathroom doorway about 80 cm wide. Yu Xiaowen took out a tape measure, measured it, and thought that with folding grab bars installed in the future, a wheelchair would be able to enter and exit easily. She also checked the kitchen workflow and water pressure, and asked about property management fees, parking spaces, and the distance to the community clinic. After the viewing, she had an in-depth discussion with Liu Ming outside the agency office, expressed strong interest, and asked about the contract signing process, deposit payment, and whether her parents could be arranged for another viewing. Liu Ming promised to relay this to the landlord and try to schedule a second viewing next week. The two said goodbye.
location: 12th floor of a new residential community near Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Seasonal vehicle maintenance and return to the hospital.
description: After walking from the real estate agency store back to Jingsan Road to pick up her car, Yu Xiaowen drove to the GAC Honda 4S store on Jianshe West Road, arriving in about 21 minutes. The service advisor received her, and the car was taken into the workshop for seasonal maintenance: oil and filter change, plus checks on tires, brake pads, and the cabin air filter. She read rehabilitation medicine papers on her phone in the waiting area. About 40 minutes later, the service advisor told her the battery was aging and recommended replacement. Recalling how hard the car was to start before winter, she agreed. Maintenance plus battery replacement cost about 1,200 yuan in total, and the car also got a free wash. Afterward, Yu Xiaowen drove the refreshed car east along Jianshe Road back to the hospital, arriving in about 12 minutes, and parked in the staff parking lot.
location: GAC Honda (Zhengzhou Jiutong West Third Ring Branch), Zhongyuan West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch at the hospital cafeteria.
description: After parking, Yu Xiaowen went straight to the staff cafeteria, got stir-fried pork with green peppers, tomatoes and eggs, and rice. Just as she sat down, her colleague Wang Fang came over with a tray, and the two ate and chatted. Yu Xiaowen shared her morning experience of viewing an apartment and getting her car serviced. Wang Fang approved of the apartment on Huayuan Road, and they also talked about the afternoon outpatient schedule. She finished eating at 13:10 and went back to the duty room to rest.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday nap
description: Back in the office, she lay down on the on-duty bed, set a 20-minute alarm, and closed her eyes to rest. After the alarm rang, she woke up, went to the bathroom to wash her face, drank half a glass of water, and felt refreshed. Then she put on her white coat, checked her phone and stethoscope, and prepared to start the afternoon's work.
location: Doctor's duty room, Internal Medicine Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: In her study, Yu Xiaowen opened the reference management software and the submission guidelines for Henan Medical Research, checked more than 70 citations in the paper one by one, added 3 latest related studies from 2024, corrected 6 errors in author name spellings, journal abbreviations, and volume/issue/page numbers, and finally regenerated the reference list to ensure full compliance with the guidelines.

She asked about their recent conditions in detail and adjusted medication regimens. During this time, she also assisted Li Wei, her supervising doctor, with adjusting the insulin regimen for a diabetic patient. Around 17:00, a patient with an acute exacerbation of COPD was helped in by family members. Yu Xiaowen immediately arranged oxygen and nebulization therapy with the nurse and asked Dr. Li Wei for a consultation. After handling all patients, she used a lull in the outpatient schedule to finish organizing the day's consultation records and medical notes.
location: Consulting Room 5, Outpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

She arrived at 17:55, bought tomatoes, greens, eggs, and half a jin of noodles, exchanged a few words with the shop owner, paid, and then walked home.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Cooking and dinner

Fifteen minutes later, a steaming bowl of tomato-and-egg noodles was ready. While eating, she scrolled through the photos of houses she had taken that day on her phone, considering how to report to her parents and older brother.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

Her mother was very satisfied, and her father also said, "An elevator is good." She promised to take a more detailed video over the weekend. Then she had a video call with her brother Yu Xiaofeng, sent him screenshots of the apartment photos and the bathroom dimensions, and shared the vehicle maintenance status. Her brother was very satisfied with the apartment and said he would transfer the first month's rent difference next week, telling her to negotiate with confidence. The two chatted for more than twenty minutes and agreed to do a "cloud re-inspection" together next weekend.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She opened the previously compiled Zhengzhou Stroke Rehabilitation Institution Comparison Table, updated the field-visit conclusions such as transportation convenience and medical insurance reimbursement ratios, and calculated the monthly expense pressure if she rented the Huayuan Road house with her brother's support.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Evening reading and relaxation

She circled the passages that moved her and planned to share her impressions in the book club group the next day. She also listened to several piano pieces by Debussy, letting her tense nerves completely relax.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She wrote: “Running around for my father is tiring, but I feel at ease inside.”
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

At 22:40, she turned off the bedside lamp, closed her eyes, and fell asleep quickly. The day had been fulfilling and satisfying.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Morning exercise, washing up, and breakfast
description: At 6:20 in the morning, the phone alarm rang. She completed a 5-minute full-body stretch on the living room mat to wake up her body. Then she did her unshakable Baduanjin practice, focusing on the stretching feeling of "Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner" and the slight vibration of "Seven Heel Jolts at the Back to Eliminate All Diseases," feeling her spine relax segment by segment. The 10-minute practice left her full of energy. At 7:00, she took a quick shower and put on a neatly ironed white coat. In the kitchen, she heated a glass of milk, ate two slices of whole wheat toast and a boiled egg, while quickly browsing department group messages on her phone to confirm there were no new key points for the day's morning meeting. After checking her commuting bag and confirming that her work badge, stethoscope, and notebook were all there, she got ready to leave.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 66 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting to work by car
description: She drove from home along Tongbai North Road toward Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The morning rush-hour traffic was heavy but still manageable; the whole trip took about 16 minutes. Along the way, she turned on the radio and listened to the local morning news, easing herself into the day's work.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (commuting destination)

name: Morning meeting, ward rounds, and managing inpatients
description: Arrived at the hospital at 7:36, parked in the staff parking space, reached the department changing room at 7:45, and changed into work clothes. Attended the morning handover meeting at 8:00 sharp, listening carefully to the night-shift colleague's report on newly admitted patients. At 8:20, began ward rounds with Teacher Li Wei, responsible for reporting on the condition of the 3 patients under my charge, with emphasis on a patient with low mood after cerebral infarction. I again proposed a psychology department consultation, and after Teacher Li Wei agreed, I issued the consultation order as soon as possible. After the ward rounds, I changed dressings for two post-operative patients with intern Xiao Zhang and guided him in standardizing the writing of progress notes. At 10:30, returned to the office, processed the medical records of newly admitted patients, checked medical orders one by one, and called the imaging department to book an afternoon CT scan for a patient. At 11:00, during a work break, searched and saved several latest articles on 'dual antiplatelet therapy' in the department's medical journal database to prepare for the afternoon mini-lecture.
location: Department of Neurology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and midday break
description: At 12:00, colleague Wang Fang was waiting at the office door, and they went together to the hospital staff cafeteria. The cafeteria served sweet and sour pork tenderloin and other dishes. The two got their food and chatted while eating. Wang Fang shared the preliminary wedding banquet plan, and Yu Xiaowen complained about the strange real estate agent she had encountered when viewing an apartment the day before. At 12:40, after lunch, they walked to the Painting and Calligraphy Club on Bank Street, where they browsed the newly arrived Chinese Journal of Neurology. Wang Fang bought a watercolor painting album. At 13:00, they strolled back to the office, and she rested on the desk for 20 minutes to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Staff canteen at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province; and Bank Street Painting and Calligraphy Society, Zhongyuan District

name: Organizing and archiving medical records and outpatient notes.
description: After the lunch break, her energy recovered. In the office, she turned on the computer and organized the electronic medical records of the last few outpatients from the previous day, carefully checking the chief complaints, present illness, and preliminary diagnoses, and archived them one by one after confirming accuracy. During this time, she received a call from the psychology department confirming that the consultation request for the cerebral infarction patient had been approved and scheduled for next Monday morning, so she recorded this good news in the patient's progress notes.
location: Office of the Neurology Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Departmental mini-lecture study
description: Arrived at the meeting room 10 minutes early with a notebook and a phone with downloaded papers. At 15:00, Director Zhang Lei began the lecture "Interpretation of the Latest Guidelines for Secondary Prevention of Cerebrovascular Disease," explaining key points such as antiplatelet therapy, statin selection, and the timing of rehabilitation intervention in a simple and clear way. I listened attentively, photographed and recorded key data and tables, and marked the points related to my father's medication plan. After the lecture, I took the initiative to approach the director and asked about the "duration of dual antiplatelet therapy in patients with asymptomatic carotid stenosis." The director's answer was enlightening.
location: Neurology Department Conference Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handle the day's wrap-up work.
description: Returning to her desk, she organized the mini-lecture notes into an electronic document. Then she checked the afternoon test reports for several stable patients and, after confirming no abnormalities, made brief notes in the ward round records. She reviewed the discharge summaries for the two patients scheduled for discharge tomorrow and reminded the intern Xiao Zhang to double-check the discharge medications.
location: Office of the Neurology Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting home from work and buying groceries on the way

She deliberately detoured to the Rixian Fruit and Vegetable Supermarket at the intersection of Qunying Road and Fengqing Road. Inside the supermarket, she picked fresh tomatoes, broccoli, Gannan navel oranges, and tender greens, planning to make scrambled eggs with tomatoes and garlic broccoli for dinner. At the checkout, she noticed the strawberries by the entrance were fresh, so she also grabbed a box.
location: Rixian Fruit and Vegetable Supermarket, at the intersection of Qunying Road and Fengqing Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Preparing and eating dinner
description: Back home, she changed into loungewear. First, she washed the oranges and strawberries and placed them on a plate. Then she quickly washed and cut vegetables, heated oil in a wok, and made a steaming pot of tomato and egg soup noodles, served with stir-fried broccoli. While eating the simple and healthy dinner, she used her iPad mini to play an episode of a podcast about Women and Stress Management, letting her mind relax as well.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 66 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Organize house viewing materials and family communication.
description: After putting away the dishes and chopsticks, she sat down at the desk, opened the photos and memos stored on the tablet, and systematically organized the information on the two apartments she had seen the day before. She used a mind map to list a detailed comparison: Huayuan Road, 12th floor (3,200 yuan/month) — has an elevator, north-south ventilation, good lighting, close to the planned rehabilitation hospital, but more expensive and the master bedroom faces west; Jingsan Road, 5th floor (2,800 yuan/month) — cheaper and slightly larger, but no elevator (inconvenient for her father's legs), poorer lighting, and a smaller living room. She sent the comparison chart and analysis of pros and cons to the family group chat, along with a voice message: Mom, Dad, Brother, take a look. Give priority to the one on Huayuan Road with the elevator; daily life is much more convenient. Mother quickly replied, With an elevator, your dad won't have trouble going up and down the stairs. Let's settle on this one. Her brother also chimed in, Don't worry about the money. I'll transfer the rent to you every month on time. You can start planning the move. Seeing the replies, the heavy weight in her heart finally lifted, and she felt full of hope for the future.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 66 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Personal study and leisure reading
description: Feeling cheerful, I made use of this whole free evening to improve myself. I opened NetEase Cloud Classroom on my iPad mini and continued the medical statistics course I had purchased earlier, completing the video lessons and supporting exercises for the 'Independent Samples t-Test' chapter. Then I picked up my Kindle and continued reading Chapter 3 of The Second Sex. I checked in on the online co-reading community and shared a thought about the invisible bias that female doctors face in the workplace.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 66 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: Went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, letting the warm water wash away the day's fatigue. After washing up, did 5 minutes of bedtime shoulder, neck and spine stretches in front of the mirror, feeling the muscle tension ease significantly.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 66 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bedtime family communication and falling asleep
description: Lying in bed, she first sent a WeChat message to her father: “Dad, did you take your meds on time? How do you feel today?” Her father quickly replied: “All taken. I'm much better today, don't worry. Your mother told me about the house decision—you did well.” After a few more casual exchanges, they hung up. She set the alarm for 6:20 tomorrow and put the phone on the nightstand. As she reflected on this fulfilling day—work went smoothly and the home was basically settled—she felt warm anticipation and genuine happiness about the upcoming new life with her parents. She turned off the light at 23:10 and drifted off to sleep feeling content and at peace.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 66 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning stretching and Baduanjin exercise
description: The 7:00 alarm went off, and Yu Xiaowen woke up naturally. She changed into workout clothes, spread out a yoga mat on the living room balcony, and started with basic stretches to wake up her body, then began Baduanjin practice. She deliberately extended the hold time for the two movements 'Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Eagle' and 'Regulating the Spleen and Stomach by Lifting the Arm' to 6 seconds, feeling the stretch in her shoulders, back, waist, and abdomen. Outside the window the sunlight was just right, and a gentle breeze brought the comfort of spring.

Yu Xiaowen first tried internal jugular vein puncture. On the first attempt, there was slight resistance when inserting the guidewire; after adjusting the angle, she completed it successfully on the second attempt. Then she practiced subclavian vein puncture in cooperation with Wang Fang. After the training ended at 16:30, she discussed and reviewed with Wang Fang in the rest area, exchanging tips on localization and needle entry angles.

She called her father to confirm that they had already set out from home at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, with an estimated 2.5-hour drive, arriving in Zhengzhou around 9:30 to 10:00.

At the halal beef and mutton stall, bought 2 jin of lamb leg meat and 1 jin of lamb bones for making soup; at the dried goods and seasonings shop, bought bread flour, cilantro, scallions, tomato sauce, and fragrant vinegar; at the fruit stall, selected dragon fruit, mangoes, and strawberries. After shopping, ran into the landlady, Aunt Song Yumei, who was approaching. Took the initiative to greet her and told her that her parents were coming to live with her today. Aunt Song warmly gave her 4 freshly steamed pork-and-scallion buns. After thanking her, they said goodbye.
location: Jingsan Road Vegetable Market, near the intersection of Jingsan Road and Hongzhuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China

Checking the WeChat groups on her phone, she saw that the department had released the Notice on Holding the 2025 First Aid Skills Competition. Wang Fang sent a message inviting her to form a team. After hesitating for a few seconds, she thought of how sincerely Wang Fang had given her the bridesmaid invitation last week, and finally agreed to team up. They agreed to go to the hospital at 2 PM to register and practice basic operations.
location: Former residence, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Installing rehabilitation equipment in the new home and moving the last of the luggage
description: Carrying some ingredients and shopping bags, she walked about 15 minutes to the new residence in Shengzhi Garden Community. At the community entrance, she signed for a package; the box contained a bathroom anti-slip mat and safety grab bars. After entering the new home, she used a toolbox to install grab bars on the wall beside the toilet and in the shower area, laid the anti-slip mat, tugged hard to confirm they were secure, then filmed a video and sent it to her father. Afterward, she quickly returned to the old residence and moved all the packed 3 medium suitcases and 2 storage bags to the new home in two trips using a handcart.
location: Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Garden Residential Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China.

description: Just after 11 o'clock, a taxi with a Yu C license plate stopped at the entrance of the residential community. She ran downstairs to welcome them. Her father Yu Jianguo slowly got out while holding the car door, and her mother Li Xiuying followed carrying large and small bags. She hurried over to support her father, and the whole family worked together to carry several large suitcases up to the third floor. After entering the new home, her mother praised the new place for being bright and spacious, and her father, supporting himself against the wall, slowly walked around before sitting down in a chair on the balcony. Looking out at the green belt, he showed a long-lost smile.
location: Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Garden Residential Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China.

name: Simple lunch and preliminary communication
description: Suggested that the family get familiar with the area around the new home and have lunch downstairs. At the Old Zhengzhou braised noodle restaurant downstairs, they ordered three bowls of mutton braised noodles, a portion of cold beef with sauce, and two small side dishes. During the meal, she proactively talked with her parents about her morning exercise habits. Her father smiled and agreed to get up early and learn together in the future, while her mother asked with concern whether her work was tiring.
location: Old Zhengzhou Huimian Noodle Restaurant, downstairs of Shengzhi Garden Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China.

name: Midday break and preparation for departure
description: After the meal, helped her parents tidy up the kitchen supplies, and sorted the cured meat, dried goods, etc. they had brought into the refrigerator. Checked the time and confirmed with Wang Fang to meet at the hospital at 2 p.m. Changed into a clean denim jacket, put on a crossbody bag, grabbed her phone and keys, and prepared to head to the hospital.
location: Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Garden Residential Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China.

description: Walked 10 minutes from the new home to Huayuan Road Metro Station, took Line 3 for three stops to Wuyi Park Station, then walked 8 minutes to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Met Wang Fang at the internal medicine doctors' office on the 7th floor of the inpatient department, and together they filled out the printed registration form, naming their team "First Aid Skills Competition — Zheng Yi Vanguard Team". After successfully submitting the form via the intranet system, Wang Fang suggested starting afternoon practice next week for CPR and defibrillator operation.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Internal Medicine, 7th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China

description: After leaving the hospital, she walked 10 minutes to the Moxiangge Calligraphy and Painting Society on Bank Street, where she browsed and bought Haruki Murakami's new book The City and Its Uncertain Walls. Then she walked 5 minutes to the coffee shop at Xiyuan Plaza, ordered a medium latte, sat by the window reading the new book, and sent a message to her older brother Yu Xiaofeng, who was far away in Shenzhen, telling him that their parents had arrived in Zhengzhou and the new home was tidied up. Her brother replied and urged her to spend more time with their parents.
location: Cafe on the 2nd floor of Xiyuan Plaza, at the northwest corner of the intersection of Jianshe Road and Qinling Road, near the Bank Street Calligraphy and Painting Society, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Return to the new home.

location: Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Garden Residential Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China.

name: Cook and prepare the preliminary work for the reunion dinner
description: I put on an apron and entered the kitchen to prepare dinner. I blanched the lamb and lamb bones from the refrigerator in cold water, skimmed off the foam, then put them in a clay pot with ginger slices, scallion sections, star anise, and Sichuan peppercorns. After bringing to a boil over high heat, I turned the heat to low and slowly simmered the lamb soup. I mixed high-gluten flour with salt and water into a smooth dough, covered it with a damp cloth, and let it rest. Meanwhile, I cut the tenderloin into strips, marinated them with salt, cooking wine, egg, and starch, and prepared the sweet-and-sour sauce. When Mother tried to come into the kitchen to help, she was smilingly persuaded to leave.
location: Kitchen, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Garden Residential Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China.

name: Accompanied father to get familiar with the community.
description: While the lamb soup was simmering over low heat, I washed my hands and suggested taking my father downstairs for a walk to get familiar with the surroundings. The father and son went downstairs, and I slowed down to match my father's pace, showing him the community convenience store, parcel lockers, waste sorting station, and community activity center. When we passed several cherry trees in full bloom, my father stopped and looked up to admire them, remarking that spring in Zhengzhou was beautiful too. I took a photo of him from behind.
location: Inside Shengzhi Garden Residential Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China.

description: Back in the kitchen, the mutton soup had become milky white and savory. She stretched the rested dough into wide noodles, cooked them in boiling water, and scooped them into a large bowl. In another pan, she heated oil and fried the marinated tenderloin until golden and crispy, then poured in the prepared sweet-and-sour sauce, quickly stir-fried to coat the meat, and plated it. She cut dragon fruit and mango into pieces, halved the strawberries, mixed them with yogurt, and arranged them in a newly bought glass bowl. She set the three bowls of stewed noodles, sweet-and-sour tenderloin, and fruit salad on the table and took a photo as a memento.
location: Kitchen, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Garden Residential Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China.

name: Family reunion dinner
description: At 6 p.m., the family of three sat together under the warm yellow light of their new home. She first served Father a steaming bowl of huimian noodles, then picked up a piece of sweet and sour pork for Mother. After tasting it, Mother praised that it tasted exactly like what she had taught Grandma to cook, and Father also repeatedly praised the noodles for being chewy and the soup for being fresh. During the meal, they chatted about old neighbors in Luoyang, funny work stories, and Father's rehabilitation progress. When Mother mentioned older brother Yu Xiaofeng, they immediately made a video call, and the family chatted for more than ten minutes across the screen. Seeing Father in good spirits also made Brother very happy.
location: Dining room, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Garden Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Post-meal cleanup.
description: After dinner, she insisted on cleaning up the dishes herself, gently holding back her mother who wanted to help and urging her to rest. She carried the empty plates to the kitchen, carefully washed every bowl and dish with dish soap, wiped the stove and countertops, and polished the dining table with a cloth until it shone. Noticing the kitchen trash bin was nearly full, she replaced it with a new trash bag on the spot.
location: Dining Room and Kitchen, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Garden Residential Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Family leisure time
description: After tidying up, the family of three sat on the living room sofa while the TV played CCTV Music Channel. She brewed a pot of jasmine tea, opened the peony cakes bought this morning, and chatted with her parents while drinking tea. She shared the plot of the newly bought book; her mother talked about amusing incidents while packing luggage in her hometown Luoyang, and her father occasionally chimed in. Snuggling up to her mother, she felt this night was especially peaceful and warm.
location: China, Henan Province, Zhengzhou City, Jinshui District, Beilin Road Subdistrict, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Shengzhi Garden Community, Building 2, Unit 3, Room 302, living room.

name: Pre-sleep preparation and body stretching
description: She stood up, stretched, and told her parents she would go wash up and get ready for bed. Back in her room, she closed the door, changed into her pajamas, spread a yoga mat on the floor, and did 10 minutes of stretching for her back and legs to relieve the fatigue of a whole day of rushing around and standing.
location: Master bedroom, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Huayuan Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Reading, thesis preparation, and pre-bed washing routine
description: She sat down at the desk, turned on the desk lamp, and first read the first chapter of the newly purchased The City and Its Uncertain Walls for about 15 minutes. Then she opened her laptop, reviewed the case report section of the paper draft she had written earlier, marked key points at the newly added literature citations, and wrote in her memo: 'Next week I need to summarize the bivariate analysis in statistics.' After that, she shut down the computer and, using her phone, set 'Practice first-aid procedures with Wang Fang every day from 19:00 to 19:30' as a repeating reminder for next week in the TickTick app. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up, washed her face with facial cleanser, brushed her teeth, and applied basic moisturizing lotion. Back in bed, she used her little notebook to record her feelings of the day: 'March 22, 2025, sunny. My parents arrived safely in Zhengzhou, and the new home is beginning to take shape. Teaming up with Wang Fang went smoothly, and the dinner was well received. Tired, but happy. Good night.'
location: In front of the desk in the master bedroom and in the bathroom, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Garden Residential Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China

name: Sleep
description: Set the alarm for 7:00 a.m. tomorrow, turned off the desk lamp, and in the darkness savored the little moments of the day before quickly falling into deep sleep. Though her body was tired, her heart was full; the new life officially began today.
location: Master bedroom, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 2, Shengzhi Huayuan Community, northeast corner of the intersection of Huayuan North Road and Guotai Road, Beilin Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Morning stretching and guided family Baduanjin
description: After getting up, Yu Xiaowen changed into workout clothes and laid out a yoga mat in the living room. She first guided her father, Yu Jianguo, through a few simple upper-limb and shoulder-neck stretches on a chair, while her mother, Li Xiuying, followed along. Then Yu Xiaowen performed a complete set of Baduanjin with smooth movements. As she practiced, she explained the key points of each movement, such as how "Two Hands Hold Up the Sky to Regulate the Triple Burner" stretches the spine, and encouraged her father to try the gentler movements while sitting in the future. Outside, the sunlight was just right, shining on the brand-new floor.
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Mother and daughter work together to prepare breakfast

Yu Xiaowen skillfully lit the gas stove in the new home, cooked millet porridge, warmed the 'silver strip' pickled vegetables her mother had brought from Luoyang, and fried three eggs. The two chatted while working. Yu Xiaowen introduced in detail how to use the various kitchen appliances in the new home, such as the wave-sensing switch on the range hood and the location of the cabinet pull-out baskets. Li Xiuying nodded from time to time and said, 'These new things are really easy to use.'
location: Kitchen, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Yu Xiaowen explained the day's plan to her parents in detail: in the morning, wait for the delivery and set up the rehabilitation corner in the living room; in the afternoon, take them out to get familiar with the neighborhood and the nearby supermarket and pharmacy. Her father, Yu Jianguo, was very interested in the rehabilitation corner and asked if it was the kind of “handrails used in hospitals,” saying that he would definitely practice hard. Her mother smiled and reminded Yu Xiaowen not to forget to sort through the pile of old belongings she had brought from Luoyang.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

description: Yu Xiaowen let her parents rest in the living room and watch TV, while she began to clean an empty area of about 2 square meters by the window in the living room. She first mopped the floor twice with a wet mop, then wiped it dry with a dry cloth to ensure the floor was dry and slip-proof. At the same time, she temporarily moved aside the nearby small tea table and the floor mat that was hard to walk on, leaving space for the non-slip mats and handrails to be installed. During this time, she checked the logistics information on her phone, which showed that the package was out for delivery and expected to arrive within an hour.
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Sign for the delivery of rehabilitation equipment.

She confirmed that the items were a 'medical anti-slip pad' and an 'L-shaped handrail', and after checking that the outer packaging was intact, she signed for the packages. The deliveryman teased, 'Miss, this big box is pretty heavy!' After thanking him, she carried the packages back home.
location: Downstairs, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Setting up a home rehabilitation corner and trying it out
description: Yu Xiaowen opened the packaging. The non-slip mat was dark gray with an anti-slip texture, and the grab bar was made of stainless steel. Following the instructions, she spread the non-slip mat on the cleaned floor, then drilled holes at the appropriate height on the wall with an electric drill and installed the L-shaped grab bar. After installation, she shook it repeatedly to confirm it was very sturdy. She then helped her father, Yu Jianguo, come over, let him hold the bar to try standing up and sitting down, and explained the function of the rehabilitation corner in detail. Her father walked slowly to the bar with his walker, stood holding it for a while, and then tried sitting down. A satisfied smile appeared on his face, and he said, 'Okay, this place is good, directly facing the window and bright.'
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Walk with parents around the neighborhood and get familiar with the environment

Her father, Yu Jianguo, held a walker, with Yu Xiaowen and her mother Li Xiuying accompanying him on both sides. Along the way, she pointed out to her parents which building was the property management office, which was the parcel locker, where the back gate was, and where the garbage disposal point was. At the small central plaza, the family sat on a bench and rested for 15 minutes, enjoying the quiet Sunday community time. Her father also greeted a neighbor who was with a child.
location: Inside Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Family lunch time
description: After walking around the community, Yu Xiaowen went home and prepared lunch with her mother, Li Xiuying. The lunch was simple and home-style: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and leftover lamb soup from yesterday reheated with some noodles added. The family of three chatted while eating. Yu Xiaowen said the pavilion beside the community park was very suitable for cooling off in summer, and her father took note of it.
location: Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and replying to messages on phone.
description: During the post-meal break, Yu Xiaowen returned to her bedroom and lay in bed looking at her phone for a while, replying to a few WeChat messages from colleagues. Her parents Yu Jianguo and Li Xiuying were also resting in the master bedroom.
location: Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Took her parents to familiarize themselves with the surrounding living facilities.

Then they walked a few more minutes and found Zhang Zhongjing Pharmacy (Qunying Road store). Yu Xiaowen went in to ask about the price of a home oxygen bag for her father and had her mother note the location. Passing a fruit store, she bought bananas to supplement her father's potassium. On the way back, she deliberately took a detour to the community pavilion and sat for a while; her father said the environment was nice.
location: Dennis All-Day Fresh (Qunban Road Store), Qunban Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She placed books on the shelves by category and neatly arranged her pottery tools (clay sculpting knives, turning wheels, etc.) on the desk in the corner. In an old storage box, she found several zodiac commemorative coins and held them in her hands to examine. She conceived an idea: perhaps she could embed one Year of the Monkey commemorative coin into the bottom of a ceramic tea cup she was planning to make, as her zodiac-themed piece. Excited by this inspiration, she took out her phone and snapped a few photos.
location: Secondary bedroom (study), Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Shared pottery ideas with parents
description: After tidying up, Yu Xiaowen came to the living room and showed the commemorative coins to her parents. Sitting next to her father, she shared her idea of incorporating the coins into her pottery creations, such as making them into bookends or coasters. Her father praised her creativity, while her mother smiled and said she had loved tinkering with such things since childhood, and reminded her not to lose them.
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Her mother planned to make dumplings filled with shepherd's purse (the shepherd's purse had been brought from Luoyang yesterday). Yu Xiaowen was in charge of rolling out the wrappers, and her mother was in charge of wrapping. The mother and daughter chatted about family matters while making dumplings. Yu Xiaowen also suggested that once her father recovered a bit more, they could invite his chess friend Old Zhao from Luoyang to come to Zhengzhou for a visit.
location: Kitchen, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Warm dinner and family conversation.
description: Steaming hot dumplings were served, accompanied by a plate of cold cucumber salad. The dinner atmosphere was warm. Yu Xiaowen again brought up the suggestion of inviting her father's old friends to Zhengzhou. Her father smiled and said, "You kid, you've already arranged everything," but his tone showed happiness. Her mother talked about her feelings about the new home during today's walk, saying that the supermarket downstairs was convenient and the fruit was fresh.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Holding two remote controls, she taught her mother step by step how to use the smart TV in the new home, how to turn it on, switch the input source, find CCTV, and how to use the washing machine's "Quick Wash" and "Down Jacket" modes. Her mother learned very attentively and even jotted down a few notes in a small notebook, saying, "My memory is not good now, and I'm afraid I'll forget."
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

She first opened the Word document of her paper, read through the previously written case report section, and revised a few phrases. Then she started processing the follow-up data of discharged patients, filled in the “Results” section with data, and worked out ideas for the “Discussion” section. It was not until her phone alarm went off, reminding her to rest, that she saved the document and turned off the computer.

For next Monday’s first aid skills competition practice, we’re meeting tomorrow evening (Monday) at 19:00 in the demonstration room, right? Please reply when you get this~” Shortly after sending, she received Wang Fang’s reply: “Yes! I’ll wait for you tomorrow!”

Everything is getting better, and I feel very grounded.' location: 8th Floor Ward and Doctors' Office, Internal Medicine Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Director Zhang listened attentively and did not reject the idea outright. He promised to contact rehabilitation medicine experts to provide guidance. The conversation lasted about 20 minutes. Afterwards, Yu Xiaowen returned to her workstation and, while her memory was fresh, used her brown leather-bound work notebook to record the key points of the conversation and Director Zhang's two suggestions, and listed an action plan: during tonight's night shift breaks, search CNKI and Wanfang for core journal literature on "rehabilitation medicine"; tomorrow, make an appointment to shadow Director Li of the rehabilitation department in his outpatient clinic; within this week, based on typical cases she had encountered, brainstorm an initial direction for a case report or review paper.

She quickly noted the key points in her notebook.

When Dr. Li asked for my views on early intervention in neurological rehabilitation, I answered briefly based on the literature I had reviewed and received an approving look. During a break in the rounds, I quietly discussed the details of the midday rehearsal with Wang Fang.

location: Neurology Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

They began rehearsing the preset full emergency resuscitation process: you were responsible for CPR, and Wang Fang was responsible for airway management and endotracheal intubation. They practiced three times, focusing on optimizing equipment preparation before intubation and the timing of switching between chest compressions and intubation. After finishing, they sat on the floor and reviewed the timer data—the transition time had been cut from 7 seconds last time to under 5 seconds. They decided to consolidate this process again on Saturday.
location: Teaching room at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (3rd floor, inpatient building).

name: Afternoon outpatient clinic and work tasks.

In the afternoon, I saw more than ten patients, most of whom were follow-up visits or picking up medications, and skillfully assisted Liu Qiang with physical examinations, recording medical records, and writing examination orders. After finishing the last group of patients at 17:00, I returned to the office to organize outpatient records and handover matters.
location: Neurology outpatient clinic/office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

She immediately replied with admiration and made plans to go to the studio together sometime next week.

Sitting on the sofa, I remembered that after my father moved, monthly expenses had increased, so I opened WeChat and sent a message to financial advisor Wang Mingyuan, asking him to reduce the monthly fund investment from 3,000 yuan to 2,000 yuan. After sending the message, I drank some water and rested for a few minutes.

description: She changed into loungewear and began preparing for tomorrow's gathering. Passing the balcony, she noticed that the anti-slip mat on the handrail of her father's rehabilitation corner was starting to curl at the edge, so she reached out and smoothed it.

location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

At about 22:20, she turned off the main light, kept the night light on, set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, and lay flat on her back, recalling the day with a sense of fulfillment and satisfaction, gradually drifting off to sleep.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning preparation and making a small ceramic lamp
description: The 7:00 alarm went off right on time. Yu Xiaowen did a 10-minute body-wakening stretch in bed, focusing on loosening her shoulders, neck, and lower back. Then she washed up and changed into comfortable loungewear. She went to her study and began making the most important small clay lamp of the day. She took out the red clay prepared in advance, kneaded it repeatedly to expel air, and patiently used pushing, pinching, and rolling techniques to shape a thick, rounded lamp base. Then she rolled out the lamp bowl wall, carefully attached it to the base, and smoothed the seams with a scraper. Using a small blade, she carefully carved the abbreviated names of her grandfather "Yu Shoucheng" and grandmother "Zhao Xiulan" on the belly of the lamp bowl, and finally poked out the wick hole with a wooden stick. Her father, Yu Jianguo, stood quietly nearby holding a teacup. When he saw the carved names, he was silent for a moment, his eyes showing deep longing and emotion.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Yu Xiaowen helped cut a plate of fruit and fried two sunny-side-up eggs. The family of three sat around the table. Yu Xiaowen mentioned she was going to Wang Fang's place to practice that afternoon, and her mother told her not to get too tired and to come back home for lunch. After that, Yu Xiaowen actively cleared the dishes and wiped the table clean. Then she returned to the study, checked how the small clay lamp was drying, and placed it in a ventilated spot. She also checked the canvas bag and confirmed she had brought the zodiac commemorative coin.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She discussed with her mother, "Mom, the weather is nice today. Let's go for a walk in Dongfeng Canal Park in the morning. It's bigger than the street park and has exercise equipment. I'll show you the way." Her mother readily agreed. Afterwards, Yu Xiaowen and her mother put on comfortable shoes, brought water bottles, and walked out. They went east along Qunying Road, crossed Fengqing Road, and after about 13 minutes of walking, arrived at the pleasant Dongfeng Canal Riverside Park.

name: Accompany mother to the park and the market, then go home
description: The park had fresh air and quite a few people exercising in the morning. Yu Xiaowen walked slowly along the riverside trail with her arm around her mother's arm. They stopped to watch the elderly practicing tai chi, and Yu Xiaowen patiently taught her mother how to use the smart space walker and back-and-lumbar massager. When they crossed a small stone bridge, Yu Xiaowen took out her phone and took a few photos of her mother, and taught her how to use the pedometer function. Her mother learned seriously and said the environment here was much better than in the residential complex. On the way home from the park, they passed by Qunying Road food market. Yu Xiaowen took her mother inside, pointed to the grain and oil shop and familiar vegetable stalls she used to visit, and taught her how to tell whether vegetables were fresh.
