After arriving, she changed into quick-dry sportswear and shorts, packed her badminton racket, water bottle, and towel into her sports bag, then lay on the sofa with her eyes closed for 10 minutes to save energy for the evening workout.
location: Room 302, Unit 5, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Replenish energy.
description: In the living room, Yu Xiaowen took a fruit container from the refrigerator, ate half a container of dragon fruit and kiwifruit to replenish sugar and vitamins, and drank a glass of water to stay hydrated.
location: Living room, Room 302, Unit 5, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Played badminton with friends.
description: Yu Xiaowen cycled to Court 3 at Maiya Badminton Hall to meet her friend Lin Wei. The two started with warm-ups, rallied clears for 20 minutes, and then played doubles matches. Yu Xiaowen felt more agile in movement and more powerful in smashes. While playing, they chatted. Lin Wei shared the experience of having her design proposal rejected, and Yu Xiaowen talked about the sense of achievement from helping her parents activate medical insurance. The satisfying workout took away the fatigue of work.
location: Court 3, Maiya Badminton Hall, 130 meters southwest of the South Gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan, Tongbai Road Subdistrict, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return trip and buying fruit.
description: After saying goodbye to Lin Wei, Yu Xiaowen rode her bike home. Passing by the Qunying Road grain and oil shop, she remembered that the apples were finished, so she stopped and bought 3 Red Fuji apples, and also grabbed a box of fresh small Taiwan mangoes.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Going home to bathe and relax.
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen took a hot shower and changed into loungewear. She washed and sliced the apples she had just bought, sat on the sofa, and played Bach's unaccompanied cello suites. While eating fruit, she replied to WeChat messages, and the fatigue from exercise gradually faded.
location: Living room and bathroom, Room 302, Unit 5, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Studying an online statistics course
description: Yu Xiaowen sat down at the desk, opened her laptop, logged into the learning platform, and studied the "Data Description" module. She carefully watched the instructional videos, used colored highlighters to mark the differences between the mean, median, and standard deviation, and drew box plots based on the board notes. After finishing, she completed 5 multiple-choice questions and made detailed annotations on the item about the median being better than the mean in skewed distributions.
location: At the desk in Room 302, Unit 5, Building 1, Qunying Residential Quarter, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: After studying, Yu Xiaowen went out to the living room balcony and had a video call with her mother, Li Xiuying. Her mother was in a good mood because she had successfully activated her medical insurance credential during the day, and she recounted an amusing story about showing off the new feature to her neighbors. Yu Xiaowen also asked for the recipe for hot and sour shredded potatoes. Her mother guided her step by step, and she said she would show off her cooking skills next time she went home.
location: Living room balcony, Room 302, Unit 5, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Bedtime reading and today's summary
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the bedroom and leaned against the headboard, flipping through the newly purchased Chinese Medical Humanities. She read an essay on narrative medicine about doctor-patient communication and was deeply struck by the line, "Patient listening itself is therapy." After closing the book, she wrote a daily summary in her phone's memo, affirming her work-life balance and encouraging herself to take every small thing seriously.
location: Bedside, bedroom, Room 302, Unit 5, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Preparing for sleep
description: After setting the alarm for 6:45 the next day and turning off the bedside lamp, Yu Xiaowen, content and at peace, listened to the wind outside the window, thought about her father's upcoming rehabilitation training, and gradually drifted off to sleep with anticipation.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Unit 5, Building 1, Qunying Residential Complex, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning preparation and commute
description: The alarm went off, and it was overcast outside the window. After getting up, Yu Xiaowen did 10 minutes of simple stretching on the mat next to the bed to loosen her shoulders, neck, and waist that had become stiff from long periods of sitting at work, then drank a glass of warm water. Because she planned to switch entirely to buying meals from the cafeteria, breakfast was extremely simple: she quickly ate two slices of whole wheat bread and a hard-boiled egg prepared ahead of time. She put the written application for night shift adjustment that needed to be submitted, her phone, a power bank, and a booklet titled How Doctors Observe into her commuter bag, put on her white coat, and grabbed her electric bike key. Then she rode the electric bike out of Qunying Community and headed straight to Zhengzhou Central Hospital along the familiar route. There were not many vehicles on the road, and after about 10 minutes she arrived at No. 16 Tongbai North Road, where the hospital is located.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Changing clothes and attending the department morning meeting
description: After parking her electric bike in the hospital's designated area, Yu Xiaowen quickly walked into the changing room in the inpatient building and put on her white coat. At 7:40 she attended the neurology department's morning shift handover on time, listened to the night-shift colleagues report on the overnight conditions of newly admitted and key patients, and noted down today's matters requiring attention.
location: Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Follow Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds.
description: After the morning meeting, Yu Xiaowen started ward rounds with her supervising doctor, Dr. Li Wei. She was responsible for reporting the latest condition of the patients under her care, including yesterday's test results, changes in condition, and patient complaints. Dr. Li Wei gave adjustment suggestions for the rehabilitation plan of a patient in the recovery phase after a cerebral infarction, and Yu Xiaowen carefully wrote them down in her portable memo pad.
location: Wards, inpatient department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Apply for night shift adjustment
description: After the ward rounds ended, Yu Xiaowen seized the moment when Director Zhang Lei was temporarily free, knocked on the door and entered the director's office. She respectfully handed over a pre-printed written application and briefly explained to the director that her father needed her nighttime care during his postoperative recovery, requesting that her night shifts be reduced from twice a week to once, and that day shifts be prioritized. After learning the situation, Director Zhang expressed understanding and agreed to the adjustment, telling her to just inform the colleague in charge of scheduling.
location: Office of the Director of Neurology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning paperwork
description: Back in the doctor's office, Yu Xiaowen opened the computer system and started dealing with the backlog of work. Based on Dr. Li Wei's instructions from the ward round, she adjusted medication plans one by one in the system and wrote the complete medical records for two newly admitted patients today. During this, she received a call from a patient's family member and patiently answered questions about post-discharge care and follow-up.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Hospital lunch and book club sign-up.
description: To practice her new eating habits, Yu Xiaowen didn't go to Old Zhengzhou Huimian Restaurant today but went straight to the hospital cafeteria. She picked a set meal with two vegetable dishes and one meat dish (stir-fried broccoli, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, braised chicken chunks, and rice), which cost less than 15 yuan. After lunch, she took out her phone in a corner of the cafeteria, opened the Douban Events app, found the discussion event about 'Being Mortal' hosted by the Under the Parasol Tree Book Club, confirmed the time was 2 p.m. on April 13, clicked the sign-up button, and successfully submitted. Afterward, she ran into her colleague Wang Fang at the door of the duty room. They chatted for a while about the shift schedule during the Qingming Festival holiday. Wang Fang said she had to work two days during Qingming, which was a bit frustrating.
location: Canteen and on-call room area at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday nap
description: Back in the duty room, Yu Xiaowen leaned on the folding bed and rested with her eyes closed for about 20 minutes, seizing the time to recover her strength so she could stay energetic in the evening to complete the remote memorial ceremony and study plan.
location: Duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon clinical work
description: The pace of work in the afternoon remained tight. A newly admitted elderly patient with dizziness needed her to take a history and perform a physical examination, and she patiently asked about the medical history and daily medications. Afterwards, she needed to communicate with the family of a critically ill patient under her care. In a gentle but clear tone, she explained the current treatment plan and prognosis, and comforted the family's emotions.
location: Wards and doctor's office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: End-of-shift cleanup and handover
description: After handling the last medical orders at hand, Yu Xiaowen checked the medical records under her responsibility and confirmed there were no missing items. She tidied her workstation, briefly handed over the afternoon's new patient conditions to the doctor on duty, and then got off work.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-work commute and shopping on the way
description: Yu Xiaowen rode her electric bike away from the hospital. She didn't go straight home, but rode to the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road and stopped at the entrance. She went in and bought a small bottle of vegetable oil and a disposable lighter for the evening's remote memorial ceremony. After paying, she continued riding back to Qunying Community.
location: From Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Remote memorial ceremony.
description: After getting home, Yu Xiaowen changed into loungewear, carefully took out the plain small ceramic lamp she had made at the pottery studio, poured the vegetable oil she had bought into the lamp bowl, and put in a new wick. She found a piece of white paper from the drawer and wrote the wish: “May my father Yu Jianguo recover soon, and may my grandparents rest in peace.” Then she carried the ceramic lamp, lighter, note, and tray to the railing of the south balcony. As dusk fell, she lit the wick of the small ceramic lamp on the balcony, placed the wish note beside the tray, faced the direction of Luoyang, closed her eyes, and quietly remembered her grandparents, recalling fragments of her childhood while whispering a prayer for her father’s speedy recovery. After the ritual, once the ceramic lamp had completely cooled, she carefully gathered the tray and lamp, wrapped the lamp in a cloth, put it back on top of the cabinet, and cleaned the balcony.
location: South balcony and living room at home, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Dinner at the community canteen
description: After the remote memorial ceremony ended, Yu Xiaowen walked to the Nanyang Xincun Community Canteen near the residential area. The food was good and cheap, and the environment was clean. She ordered a bowl of millet porridge, a corn bun, and a small dish of pickled vegetables. She ate dinner slowly in the canteen, feeling the lively atmosphere of the neighborhood around her. Her mood was much calmer than in previous days.
location: Nanyang New Village Community Canteen, No. 68 Courtyard, Nanyang Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen made a WeChat video call to her mother Li Xiuying in the living room. On the other end, her mother was watching TV in the living room. She told her mother that she had successfully applied to reduce night shifts today, and briefly described the evening remote memorial ceremony. Her mother was somewhat emotional after hearing this, and urged her to take good care of herself even when alone and not to overwork. They also talked about the rehabilitation training arrangements her father was about to start after the Qingming holiday.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening study and reading
description: After the video ended, Yu Xiaowen sat down at her desk, took out her statistics notebook, and spent about 15 minutes quickly reviewing core formulas and concepts in the descriptive statistics section, such as mean, median, and standard deviation. She reminded herself that in the next stage she needed to start practicing basic operations with SPSS. Then, she took the "Chinese Medical Humanities" magazine out of her bag, which she had bought at the Bank Street Painting and Calligraphy Society on April 2, curled up on the living room sofa and flipped through it, paying special attention to a feature article on hospice care and doctor-patient communication that happened to coincide with the theme of the book club she had signed up for.
location: Study and living room at home in Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Nighttime accounting and relaxation
description: She opened the expense-tracking app on her phone and recorded today's spending on shopping and the cafeteria. Then she stood up and did a few more minutes of simple shoulder, neck, and leg stretches to relieve the fatigue of a day's work.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Yu Xiaowen took a hot shower, changed into comfortable pajamas, and prepared the clothes she would wear to work the next day in advance.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep journaling and reading
description: She leaned against the headboard, opened her phone's memo app, and recorded the day's reflections: successfully applying for the night shift, completing the remote memorial ritual before Qingming, and beginning to get used to cafeteria life. She wrote: "Although I'm a bit tired, I feel more at ease. I hope my father can feel my sincerity and get better soon." Then she put down her phone, picked up another essay collection from the bedside, casually flipped through about twenty pages to fully calm down, and finally turned off the lights at 22:30 sharp and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning activities and breakfast
description: Woke up to the sound of light Qingming rain. After washing up briefly, drank some water and opened the window for fresh air. Then did morning stretching, measured my father's blood pressure and asked about his sleep, and chatted with him about Qingming customs in Luoyang. After that, quickly prepared breakfast in the kitchen: oatmeal with milk, eggs, and my mother's red date millet porridge. The family of three ate together.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Making Qingming jujube cake with mother
description: Mother and daughter busied themselves in the kitchen. Mother mixed the dough, Yu Xiaowen kneaded it, pitted and chopped the soaked red dates, mixed them with brown sugar, and steamed the jujube cake. Meanwhile, they chatted about Luoyang Qingming delicacies such as mugwort green rice balls and elm seed buns, and her father also joined in the memories. The sweet fragrance of the jujube cake filled the air - the traditional flavor of a family Qingming.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Tidying up the house and preparing items for the night shift.
description: While the date cake was steaming, Yu Xiaowen sorted and washed clothes by category, tidied the living room, then returned to the bedroom to pack her commuter bag: she put in a power bank, a water bottle, the Medical Statistics textbook, and a notebook, and also brought along apples and a few pieces of date cake as a late-night snack for the hospital.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch and family reunion
description: For lunch, freshly baked date cake was the staple, served with tomato scrambled eggs, stir-fried spinach, and millet porridge. Her father proactively mentioned that he could go to the rehabilitation center by himself the next day. Yu Xiaowen encouraged him and double-checked the next day's schedule.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Noon bookkeeping and inventory of on-duty supplies
description: After lunch, I helped my mother clear the table, then went back to the bedroom and used a bookkeeping app to record the cost of the cooking oil bought yesterday. I checked the duty bag again, confirmed everything was complete, set the 14:00 alarm, and prepared for a nap.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Took an afternoon nap to recharge for the night shift.
description: Pulled the curtains, put on sleep earplugs, and took a nap of about an hour and a half to the sound of Qingming rain, recharging for the upcoming night shift.
location: Bedroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-departure preparations and supervising Father's rehabilitation training
description: After napping, she woke herself up with a cold-water face wash, changed into casual clothes and non-slip sneakers, and carried a folding umbrella. Her mother packed the prepared date cake and cherry tomatoes into an insulated container. Yu Xiaowen helped her father complete arm raises and ankle pump exercises, recorded his progress, and discussed the next day's rehabilitation center visit details. Finally, she said goodbye to her parents.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Go to the community canteen to pack dinner and make final preparations
description: Walked in the rain to the Qunying Road community canteen and packed up millet porridge, chive and egg vegetarian buns, and pickled vegetables as dinner for the night shift. After returning home, put the dinner in her commuter bag, checked the e-bike keys and raincoat again. Her mother helped her fasten the raincoat buttons, her father told her to be careful on the road, and then she set off on the e-bike.
location: The community canteen on Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, and home

name: Commute to the hospital by e-bike.
description: Wearing a raincoat, I rode an electric bike for about 15 minutes through the light Qingming rain, from Qunying Community to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, paying attention to safety along the way.
location: From Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Night shift handover, dinner, and statistics study
description: Arrived at the duty room in the hospital's internal medicine building, changed into the white coat, and handed over the shift with a colleague. Then ate the packed dinner while reading medical records. After dinner, opened the iPad, put on headphones, studied the probability distribution module in medical statistics, watched instructional videos, and recorded key formulas such as the normal distribution.
location: Duty room, Internal Medicine Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: On-duty work: handled patients, talked with Wang Fang, and prepared for practice.
description: During this time, the on-duty nurse called. I went to the ward to manage a patient with mild abdominal pain and wrote medical orders. After returning to the on-call room, I organized medical records. At about 21:30, I discussed statistics study progress with my colleague Wang Fang. After a short rest, we agreed to go to the demonstration room to practice CPR.
location: On-call room and ward, Internal Medicine Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Night shift duty and medical record organization
description: To avoid the night-shift rush, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang decided to practice after midnight. She returned to her workstation, quickly reviewed the statistics content she had just learned, marked the common mistakes with a red pen, and organized some medical records.
location: Duty room, Internal Medicine Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Practiced two-person CPR with Wang Fang in the demonstration room
description: In the demonstration room, the two practiced two-person cardiopulmonary resuscitation on a manikin according to first-aid competition standards. Yu Xiaowen performed chest compressions, Wang Fang performed rescue breathing and AED operation, and they timed each other and corrected movement details. They practiced three sets in total until the procedure was basically smooth.
location: Demonstration Room, Internal Medicine Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Night shift duty and ward rounds.
description: After the practice, the two put the models back in place and returned to the duty room. Yu Xiaowen made another round of the key wards and confirmed that everything was normal. Around 1 a.m., she ate some jujube cake her mother had brought to regain her energy.
location: On-call room and ward, Internal Medicine Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Brief rest during duty and recording of reflections
description: Drowsiness hit, so she took a nap in her clothes on the camp bed in the duty room and set an alarm for 1 hour. Before sleeping, she wrote in her phone memo: "On a rainy Qingming night, family is by my side, and my hands still carry a lingering fragrance. Learning skills while on duty and preparing for tomorrow leaves me calm and fulfilled."
location: Duty room, Internal Medicine Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Early-morning duty and shift handover preparation.
description: Woken by the alarm at 3 a.m., she felt a little tired but fulfilled inside. After a simple wash-up, she began organizing the shift handover records and checking all patients' conditions during the night shift, preparing for the formal handover at 8 a.m.
location: Duty room, Internal Medicine Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning activities
description: Yu Xiaowen woke up in the bedroom at her parents' home at 7 a.m. After washing up briefly, she did 10 minutes of morning stretching to relieve the fatigue after the night shift. Then she went to the living room to have breakfast with her parents. Her mother had prepared millet porridge, eggs, and cucumber salad, as well as the date cake made yesterday for Qingming Festival. During the meal, she chatted with her parents, asked her mother about her sleep, and again explained the afternoon rehabilitation treatment process to her father in detail to ease his anxiety. After breakfast, remembering her scheduled badminton appointment with her friend Lin Wei, she took out her phone and sent Lin Wei a WeChat message explaining that her father needed rehabilitation accompaniment, that this week's badminton date was cancelled, and that they would resume later.
location: Room 302, Unit 5, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Organize the study and buy a Kindle.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowen went into her study to organize several boxes of books that had accumulated. She put on a mask and found the books were mostly covered in dust. Thinking that she would need to use fragmented time to read while accompanying her father during his rehabilitation, and that paper books were inconvenient to carry, she remembered that her best friend had recommended the Kindle, so she decided to buy an e-reader. She walked to the living room sofa, used the JD.com app on her phone to compare the basic Kindle and the Kindle Youth Edition, and ordered the white basic model, which offered better value for money, for 658 yuan. She chose JD Express same-day delivery and paid with her China Merchants Bank debit card. Then she went back to the study and continued organizing, dividing the books into four categories: medical professional, literature and fiction, life encyclopedia, and old textbooks and magazines. She packed the old textbooks and magazines she no longer needed into a cardboard box to donate to the community book corner, and set aside books she wanted to read, such as Better. Along the way, she came across Stories of Luoyang's Old City, took a photo of it and sent it to her mother, and chatted about the time they went to bookstores during the Spring Festival.
location: Room 302, Unit 5, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Activities before and after lunch.
description: After tidying up the study, Yu Xiaowen went to the kitchen to help her mother prepare lunch, washing tomatoes and mincing garlic. During the noon break, she sat on the rattan chair in the living room and used her phone to review the normal distribution module she had learned during the night shift on the statistics course app, then took a 20-minute nap. As lunchtime approached, her mother prepared tomato and egg noodles, and the whole family had lunch together. After the meal, Yu Xiaowen supervised her father taking his blood pressure medication, packed a water cup, towel, and medical record booklet into a canvas bag, double-checked the appointment information and navigation route on her phone, and prepared for the afternoon rehabilitation treatment.
location: Room 302, Unit 5, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Accompany father to rehabilitation therapy
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowen helped her father walk to the Jian'an Community Rehabilitation Center about 800 meters away, heading east along Qunying Road and turning onto Zijingshan Road, encouraging him to keep moving as they walked. Upon arrival, Dr. Li received them. He first assessed her father's muscle strength, balance, and joint range of motion, then gave about an hour of personalized treatment, including ankle pump exercises, seated leg raises, and resistance band training. Yu Xiaowen observed throughout and wrote down every key movement point in her phone's memo. After the treatment, her father said his body felt loosened up and comfortable. The two walked back the same way, and on the way Yu Xiaowen took a photo of the crabapple blossoms in full bloom on Zijingshan Road and sent it to the family group chat.
location: Jian'an Community Rehabilitation Center, 1st Floor, Building 3, Ziguangyuan Community, Zijingshan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After going home, unbox the Kindle, set it up, and download content
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowen settled her father down for his afternoon nap and placed warm water by the bedside. She checked her phone and saw that the Kindle delivery was out for delivery. Then she received a call from the courier and went to the parcel pickup station at the community entrance to collect the white packaging box. She opened it on the bench downstairs and was very satisfied with the compact device. Back in the living room, she connected to Wi-Fi, logged into her Amazon account, browsed the user guide, and downloaded 'The Doctor's Progress'. She also searched for and downloaded the free 'Introduction to Rehabilitation Medicine' and 'Concise Medical Statistics', and was pleased with the clear display of the e-ink screen.
location: Room 302, Unit 5, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Family leisure time and home rehabilitation guidance
description: After her father woke up from his afternoon nap, Yu Xiaowen showed him the new Kindle, demonstrating the font size and backlight adjustment. He found it novel and convenient. Then, following the notes she had taken at the rehabilitation center, she guided her father through ankle pump and seated flexion/extension exercises on the sofa to consolidate the treatment effect. Her mother also joined in with questions, and the atmosphere was harmonious. Yu Xiaowen patiently guided the movements and once again emphasized the importance of daily practice.
location: Room 302, Unit 5, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Went out shopping with her mother.
description: Before dinner, she found there wasn't enough vinegar, so Yu Xiaowen voluntarily went downstairs with her mother, walked about 3 minutes to the usual grain and oil shop on Qunying Road, bought aged vinegar, and also grabbed her mother's favorite hawthorn slices and a small bag of five-spice peanuts. On the way back, listening to her mother chat about neighborhood news, the mother and daughter strolled home slowly in a relaxed mood.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Dinner and rest after the meal
description: Dinner was mapo tofu, tofu with scallions, garlic greens, and the leftover noodles from lunch, all made by her mother. The family ate and talked about father's rehabilitation experience. Father felt his left leg had more strength, mother urged him to keep going, and Yu Xiaowen shared the convenience of reading on a Kindle. After dinner, she helped clear the table, returned to her room, played soothing piano music, washed up, changed into comfortable pajamas, and checked her phone memo to confirm the next day's rehabilitation appointment time.
location: Room 302, Unit 5, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening companionship and bedtime activities.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen took her Kindle to her father's bedroom and sat on the edge of the bed reading Better with her father. Her father was very interested in the new device, so she patiently explained its functions. The room then fell quiet, and she became immersed in the book's stories about the medical system. After the care session, they said goodnight to each other. She returned to her room and did 5 minutes of stretching to relax her back, then recorded the day's expenses in her phone's ledger (the Kindle was listed under study/entertainment). Afterwards, she lay in bed browsing medical public accounts on WeChat and sent a message to her best friend Wang Lina sharing the news of getting a Kindle. She turned off the light and went to sleep at 10 p.m., looking back on a fulfilling day and feeling hopeful about the future.
location: Room 302, Unit 5, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up and preparation.
description: The sunlight was just right. After sleeping enough, Yu Xiaowen got up, drank a glass of warm water, and did 10 minutes of stretching in front of the window, loosening her shoulders, neck, and lower back. name: Outpatient assistance work
description: After the emergency training ended, Yu Xiaowen changed into her work uniform and went to the outpatient department to assist an attending physician. Her tasks were to measure patients' blood pressure in both arms and their body temperature, and to enter their chief complaints and medical history into the computer system. During this time, she encountered an anxious family member. She patiently reassured them and briefly explained the doctor's diagnosis and treatment process. The pace was intense until close to the lunch break.
location: Outpatient Clinic of General Internal Medicine, 2nd Floor, Outpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch and midday tasks
description: Returned to the department to organize the medical records from the morning outpatient clinic. After handling some routine matters, Yu Xiaowen went alone to the hospital staff cafeteria. Today's offerings were Lanzhou pulled noodles and a braised lion's head meatball set meal. She chose the noodles, added a poached egg, and thought about the afternoon's work schedule while eating.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Studying statistics during the lunch break.
description: After eating, she returned to the duty room. Yu Xiaowen took out her statistics notebook and textbook. She first quickly reviewed the complete steps of hypothesis testing: establishing hypotheses, determining the significance level, calculating the test statistic, determining the P value, and making inferences. Then she focused on reviewing the applicable conditions and common mistakes of the t-test. Finally, she opened the learning app on her phone, completed a comprehensive exercise on paired t-tests, checked the answers, and confirmed that she understood correctly.
location: Duty room of the inpatient department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work and case discussion.
description: After the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen returned to the office and began organizing the medical records of several patients under her care, especially the rehabilitation records of a patient with cerebral infarction. At 14:00, she attended an internal department case discussion about a patient admitted due to drug-induced liver injury. She carefully listened to the analytical approaches of Dr. Li Wei and other senior doctors, and noted down key diagnostic points and treatment principles in her notebook. After the case discussion, she did her ward rounds, visiting her assigned patients in turn, asking about discomfort, checking vital signs, and recording changes in their conditions. During the rounds, the emergency department called about a new patient with suspected pneumonia. She immediately went to the emergency department to receive the patient, completed the history taking, physical examination, ordered tests, and coordinated bed arrangements.
location: General Internal Medicine ward and doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: End-of-shift handover
description: Near the end of her shift, Yu Xiaowen did a detailed handover with the doctor on duty tonight, passing on changes in the condition of high-attention patients, the test results of new patients, and their medication regimens. She then organized and filed all of the day's medical records, turned off the computer, and packed up her personal belongings.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-work commute and grocery shopping
description: Yu Xiaowen changed into casual clothes, walked to the nearest subway entrance, and rode a shared bike home. After riding about 1.5 kilometers, she arrived at the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road, where she picked out a box of free-range eggs, two bunches of small greens, a bag of small Tainan mangoes, and two tomatoes, spending 47.6 yuan in total. Then she walked slowly back home carrying the groceries.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Preparing and enjoying dinner
description: Back home, Yu Xiaowen put down her things, changed into loungewear, took out tomatoes and greens and washed them. She skillfully chopped the tomatoes, whisked the eggs, boiled water and cooked dried noodles, making a steaming hot bowl of tomato and egg noodles. She enjoyed the simple dinner while scrolling through her phone for a while and replying to a few messages from friends.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Preparation for the reading club event
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen sat at her desk, opened WeChat, and followed the official account of "Paper Room Bookstore" to check the latest posts. She confirmed the activity flow and schedule for the weekend reading club and wrote it down in her notes. Then she opened her notebook and organized her observations from several end-of-life patients she had encountered in clinical work, especially cases involving difficult communication with family members and patients' expression of their own wishes. She outlined key points and stories for sharing and wrote a speech outline of about 200 characters.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening reading of "Being Mortal."
description: After making a cup of hot lemon water, Yu Xiaowen picked up Being Mortal, which she had already started reading, and turned to Chapter 2. She marked with a highlighter the passage about balancing honesty and hope in doctor-patient communication, and wrote a reflection in the margin: “A doctor not only treats disease, but also accompanies patients as they face the journey of life.” Moved by the passage, she thought of her father's recovery after his cerebral infarction, and her eyes grew a little moist.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with family
description: Yu Xiaowen started a video call with her mother. On the other end, her mother happily told her that her father had done very well at the community rehabilitation center that afternoon and could independently walk for 15 minutes with a walker. Her father took the phone, sounded in good spirits, and told Yu Xiaowen to eat meals on time no matter how busy work was. Yu Xiaowen then asked about his rehabilitation training plan for tomorrow and shared how she felt about practicing first aid skills today. By the end of the call, she saw the gratified smile on her father's face, and her worries eased considerably.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening washing, stretching, and keeping accounts.
description: After hanging up the phone, Yu Xiaowen went to the bathroom to wash up. Then she did a simple set of Downward-Facing Dog and Cat-Cow stretches on the yoga mat to relieve the fatigue of a day’s work. Sitting on the edge of the bed, she took out her account book, recorded today’s grocery and transportation expenses, and opened the mobile banking app to check the day’s gains and losses on her funds, updating the income and expense balance sheet.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Wind-down relaxation and planning for tomorrow
description: Yu Xiaowen lay down on the bed. She first opened a music app and played the first movement of Mozart's Symphony No. 40 in G minor, listening with her eyes closed for 10 minutes. Then she read a few pages of the later chapters of Being Mortal on her e-reader. At 22:10, she turned off the music and listed tomorrow's to-dos on her phone memo: follow up on the new patient's test results, organize speaking materials for the book club, and confirm next week's training schedule with Wang Fang. Then she set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Turning off the bedside lamp, Yu Xiaowen silently recited tomorrow's key points in the dark, took a few deep breaths, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: The alarm went off right on time. A light rain was falling outside the window, and the air carried the damp smell of soil. Yu Xiaowen did not stay in bed. She sat on the edge of the bed and did an 8-minute morning stretch, focusing on her shoulders, neck, and lower back, to prepare for taking care of her father today.
location: Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 88 Qunying Road, Zijingshan Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Cycling to parents' home
description: She changed into a light jacket, put her phone, power bank, medical insurance card and house keys into her commuter bag, put on a rain poncho, got on her electric bike, and set off against the cool morning breeze. A light rain pattered on her face, and her mood was fairly calm. Passing familiar streets along the way, she arrived at her parents' home about 20 minutes later.
location: Cycling route from Qunying Residential Community, No. 88 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Guangdian Residential Community, No. 36 Huayuan Road

name: Assisted with preparations for picking up medication at my parents' home
description: When she arrived, her mother had already cooked millet porridge, and her father was sitting on the sofa. Yu Xiaowen put down her bag, exchanged brief greetings, and sat down at the dining table with her mother. She took out her father's medical insurance card and medication list, and through the WeChat family group confirmed again with the pharmacy staff that the required blood pressure medication and the traditional Chinese patent medicine for promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis were both in stock. She opened the 'National Healthcare Security Platform' app and checked the status of the bound family account, which showed normal. During that time, she eased her mother's anxiety about the slow progress of her father's recovery.
location: Living room, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Community, No. 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch
description: Her mother made a home-style meal: scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and steamed sea bass, all light flavors her father liked. At the dinner table, Yu Xiaowen brought up some amusing incidents at the hospital to lighten the mood. Her father didn't eat much, while her mother kept talking about picking up the medicine in the afternoon. The atmosphere was fairly calm.
location: Dining room, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Community, No. 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Accompanied her mother to the pharmacy to pick up medicine and taught her how to use mobile payment.
description: After lunch, the rain stopped, and Yu Xiaowen walked with her mother to Kangjian Pharmacy, about 800 meters away. On the way, she took out her phone and patiently taught her mother how to use Alipay's "Scan" feature to pay by QR code. Wearing her reading glasses, her mother operated carefully and was delighted when she successfully opened the scanning interface. When they arrived at the pharmacy, Yu Xiaowen first opened the National Healthcare Security Platform app and showed her father's family account QR code. After the pharmacy scanned it, the medical insurance was settled in real time. She then encouraged her mother to pay the remaining amount with Alipay. Her mother smiled like a child after the successful payment. Xiaowen helped her mother verify the drug names, quantities, and invoice.
location: Kangjian Pharmacy, 100 meters south of the intersection of Huayuan Road and Hongqi Road, on the east side of the road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Returning home to organize medications and explain
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowen laid out the medicines in a row on the coffee table. She first used label paper to mark 'after breakfast' and 'after lunch/dinner,' then sorted the blood pressure medication and blood circulation medication. She invited her father over and patiently explained the usage, dosage, and precautions for each medicine, pointing to the instructions on the medicine boxes, but her father seemed distracted. After explaining, she neatly placed the medicines into the family medicine cabinet and confirmed the labels were intact. Her mother, meanwhile, excitedly showed her father the mobile payment skill she had just learned.
location: Living room and bedroom, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Residential Area, No. 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Short break.
description: After putting the medicine box back, Yu Xiaowen sat down on the sofa, drank a glass of warm water, watched the sky outside gradually clearing, and savored a moment of tranquility, storing up energy for the family frictions that might come next.
location: Sofa in the living room, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Community, 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Assisting Father with Rehabilitation Training and the Outbreak of Family Conflict.
description: Her father began his afternoon rehabilitation training. Yu Xiaowen brought a chair, helped him sit down in the living room, and helped him complete the doctor-prescribed movements such as leg lifts, shoulder rotations, and knee bends, but his movements were weak and he was very passive. Just as she was encouraging her father to do the movements properly, her mother came out of the kitchen, saw this scene, became angry, and loudly accused her father of going through the motions. The two began to argue. Yu Xiaowen tried to mediate but failed. Her father sulkily stood up, walked back to the bedroom, and closed the door. She stood in place, feeling a deep sense of helplessness.
location: Living room and hallway, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Residential Community, 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tidied up the mess and prepared dinner
description: Her mother sat in the living room for a while. Once her emotions had calmed a bit, she went into the kitchen in a huff. Yu Xiaowen sighed, went to the kitchen to help wash and cut vegetables, and prepare a simple dinner. As her mother chopped vegetables, she kept quietly complaining about her father's lack of cooperation. Yu Xiaowen did not interrupt, just listened quietly, with mixed feelings.
location: Living room and kitchen, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Community, No. 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner
description: Dinner was a light noodle soup with vegetables and shredded pork. The atmosphere at the table was unusually heavy; the three of them sat in silence, with only the clink of chopsticks and bowls. Yu Xiaowen tried several times to say something to lighten the mood, but the words stopped at her lips and she swallowed them back. The meal felt impossibly long.
location: Dining room, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Community, No. 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After sitting with him in the living room, returned to the bedroom.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen sat in the living room with her mother for a while. Her mother looked at the TV but was clearly not paying attention, letting out an occasional sigh. Her father stayed in the bedroom the whole time and did not come out. Yu Xiaowen felt a tightness in her chest, as if a stone were pressing on it. Feeling powerless to change things, she stood up and said to her mother, 'I'm a bit tired, I'm going back to my room,' then returned to her own bedroom and closed the door.
location: Living room and bedroom, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Residential Area, No. 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Confiding in her best friend Zhang Jing
description: Back in the bedroom, Yu Xiaowen's shoulders slumped. She picked up her phone and sent a voice message to her best friend Zhang Jing, recounting how her father's rehabilitation training and her mother's quarrel had gone that afternoon, and lamenting that she felt like a sandwich cookie squeezed in the middle. Zhang Jing quickly replied with a hugging emoji and a long message, comforting her that she had already done enough and shouldn't be too hard on herself. Looking at the screen, Yu Xiaowen felt a lump in her throat, and the tight stone in her heart finally loosened a little.
location: Bedroom, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Community, 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Brief meditation to relax
description: Sitting cross-legged on the bed, Yu Xiaowen opened the Tide meditation app on her phone and chose a 5-minute breathing relaxation exercise. She followed the guidance to inhale and exhale slowly, trying to release the restless feelings in her mind. Although her thoughts occasionally drifted away, she felt her heartbeat was much steadier after the exercise ended.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Residential Community, 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Keeping accounts and reading.
description: After calming down, Yu Xiaowen opened the expense-tracking app on her phone and recorded today's spending on groceries and her father's medicine. Then she took out her Kindle, leaned against the headboard, and continued reading the final part of Chapter 2 of Being Mortal, about how to communicate with patients on the topic of end of life. When she read the doctor-patient communication skills in the case studies, she thought of today's ineffective communication with her parents and gained new insight.
location: At the desk in the bedroom, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Residential Community, No. 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Bedtime preparation: washing up and changing clothes.
description: Closing her Kindle, Yu Xiaowen went to the bathroom to wash up. She carefully washed her face with warm water, squeezed toothpaste onto her toothbrush and brushed her teeth, then changed into the cartoon pajamas she had brought. The cold running water and the clean feeling made her feel a bit more awake.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Community, No. 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and planning tomorrow's tasks
description: Standing by the bed, I did 5 minutes of pre-sleep stretching to relieve the fatigue of the day. Then I sat down at the desk, took out a sticky note, and wrote down tomorrow's to-do list: 1. Go to the hospital in the afternoon for extra physical training; 2. Organize the speaking outline for the book club; 3. Water the pothos at home.
location: At the bedside and in front of the desk in the bedroom, Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Residential Community, No. 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Listening to music to relax and getting ready to sleep
description: She turned off the main light, leaving only a small bedside lamp on, and put in earphones to play the first movement of Mozart's Symphony No. 40 in G Minor. As the melodious tune flowed in her ears, Yu Xiaowen closed her eyes and let her mind go blank. When the music ended, she set the alarm for the next morning, switched her phone to silent, took a deep breath, turned off the light, lay down, and prepared to fall asleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of Room 601, Unit 1, Building 1, Guangdian Residential Community, 36 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning routine and breakfast
description: At 6:50 in the morning, the alarm went off. I woke up in the bedroom at my parents' home and first weighed myself: 49.2 kg, feeling pretty good. Then I did ten minutes of full-body stretching and five minutes of mindfulness meditation to adjust my mindset, reminding myself to be gentler and more patient with my father today. After washing up, I went to the dining room, where my mother, Li Xiuying, had already prepared millet porridge, boiled eggs, and steamed buns. We chatted about the weather as we ate, and by unspoken agreement did not bring up the rehabilitation training, only casually saying that we were in a good mood today. After the meal, I checked my phone, power bank, and earphones to prepare to go out.
location: Xinyuan Shijia, 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commute and department morning meeting.
description: She rode her electric bike from Xinyuan Shijia to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. On the way, she put on earphones and listened to Mozart's "Serenade", letting the soothing music help her detach from family emotions. Fifteen minutes later, she arrived at the hospital, changed into her white coat, and attended the morning meeting in the doctor's office on the fifth floor of the inpatient internal medicine building on time. The night-shift doctor reported on the ward situation overnight, mentioning that a patient with heart failure was in stable condition, which relieved her a lot. Director Zhang Lei of the department emphasized the standards for medical record writing and reminded everyone that flu was prevalent recently and precautions were needed.
location: Doctors' Office, 5th Floor, Internal Medicine Building, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning clinical work and departmental affairs
description: After the morning meeting, I followed the supervising teacher Li Wei on ward rounds. I reported the test results of the patients under my care. When we encountered a patient anxious about blood pressure fluctuations, I imitated Teacher Li's manner and patiently explained the medication adjustment plan in plain language, and the patient's mood visibly calmed. After rounds, I processed five new test orders, wrote medical orders, and completed three progress notes. Near noon, after organizing the documents, I went to the nurse station and checked next week's schedule with head nurse Wu Min. She told me that next Wednesday's night shift had already been adjusted, and I expressed my gratitude, so I can arrange my book club and study plan with peace of mind.
location: Wards on the 5th floor of the Internal Medicine Building, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and the doctors' office and nurses' station

name: Lunch, study, and midday walk.
description: At noon, she had lunch with her colleague Wang Fang in the hospital staff canteen, ordering braised pork ribs, green vegetables, and rice. While eating, she confirmed the details of the afternoon emergency practice session: at 4:30 in the demonstration room, focus on physical fitness and chest compressions. After lunch, she returned to the on-duty room and used the statistics course app on her phone to quickly review the characteristics of the normal distribution, then completed the accompanying ten online quiz questions. Because she had reviewed the material last night, she got a perfect score. After the quiz, she went to the back garden of the inpatient department for a relaxing walk. The spring sunshine was warm. She walked two slow laps along the path and did neck and shoulder relaxation exercises to stretch her body after sitting for a long time.
location: Staff canteen, duty room, and rear garden of the inpatient department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work
description: The afternoon's work began. I first handled a discharged patient who came for a follow-up visit, then saw a newly admitted pneumonia patient and carefully completed the history taking, physical examination, and test orders. Meanwhile, a diabetic patient admitted yesterday developed a hypoglycemic reaction. I immediately went to the bedside, guided the nurse in emergency management, and adjusted the medication plan. The patient's condition subsequently stabilized. Amid the busy work, I juggled the ward and the office, continuously following up on the various examinations and treatments.
location: Wards and doctors’ office, 5th Floor, Internal Medicine Building, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Extra first-aid skills practice and work handover
description: Leaving the office early, she met with her colleague Wang Fang in the demonstration room. According to the first aid competition rules, they focused on practicing CPR—each performed five consecutive minutes of chest compressions, timing and recording the number and depth. The technique felt good, and Wang Fang's compression depth was also more stable. After that, they practiced a set of endotracheal intubation procedures. After the extra practice, she returned to the office, gave a detailed handover to the night-shift doctor about today's newly admitted patients and the key test results requiring attention, and wrote down the items to track tomorrow in her notebook.
location: Demonstration Room and Doctor's Office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return home, accompany father in rehabilitation exercises, and prepare dinner.
description: After work, she took off her white coat and rode her electric bike back to her parents' home. On the way, she passed a bakery and bought sugar-free whole wheat bread, planning to give it to her father as a late-night snack. When she arrived, she saw her father, Yu Jianguo, sitting on the sofa watching TV. She gently handed him some warm water, asked softly how he was feeling today, and invited him to do rehabilitation exercises together. After hesitating, her father slowly stood up. She patiently guided him through arm raises and ankle pump exercises, offering timely encouragement after each completed movement. Then she went into the kitchen to help her mother, Li Xiuying, prepare dinner. While trimming vegetables, she told amusing stories from the hospital, mentioning that Wang Fang's hands were shaking during emergency practice. Her mother laughed, and the atmosphere became much lighter. She suggested making steamed sea bass, her father's favorite, and her mother readily agreed. The three of them had dinner together.
location: Xinyuan Shijia, 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After dinner, take a walk and have a heart-to-heart talk with father and family communication
description: After dinner, I took the initiative to invite my father downstairs for a walk on the garden tree-lined path in the neighborhood. The moonlight was clear and bright. After a period of silence, my father finally asked whether he was a burden to the family. I immediately held his hand and firmly told him he was not a burden, and that we as a family would work hard together, just as he had taken care of me when I was little. My father's eyes became moist, and he tightly squeezed my hand in return. The hearts of father and daughter grew even closer. When we got home, I saw that my mother's expression had softened. I quietly signaled that everything was fine, and whispered to her that father just needed time to accept it, and that she should encourage him more and not be anxious.
location: Garden walking paths in Xinyuan Shijia Residential Community, No. 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and at home

name: Evening personal study and relaxation
description: Returning to her own room, she opened her laptop and logged into the online statistics course. Wearing earphones, she carefully watched the lecture video on the one-sample t-test. After understanding the applicable conditions, she imported the case data of "the effect of a certain antihypertensive drug on systolic blood pressure" into SPSS, completed the analysis independently, and recorded the t-value, p-value, confidence interval, and other results. After studying, she went to the bathroom to wash up and apply a hydrating mask. While the mask was on, she did a ten-minute evening relaxation stretch on the yoga mat to relax her whole body. Then she sat at her desk, used an expense tracking app to record the day's expenses, wrote in detail in her rehabilitation diary about her father's completion of the rehabilitation exercises and the positive emotions after the walk and heart-to-heart talk, and organized the key SPSS operation points into her electronic notes. Afterwards, she lay in bed and read Chapter 3 of "Being Mortal" on her Kindle. The discussion in the book about giving meaning to the end of life reminded her of her conversation with her father, and she immersed herself in reading with Debussy's "Clair de Lune" playing in the background. Finally, she opened the memo on her phone and wrote down tomorrow's to-dos: check the test results of new patients, confirm details of Sunday's reading club, and plan weekend family activities. Reviewing the full and warm day, she set the alarm, put down the book, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Xinyuan Shijia, 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning meditation, stretching, and breakfast
description: Early Saturday morning, Yu Xiaowen meditated in bed, focusing on her breath and letting her thoughts settle. Then she stretched by the window to relieve neck stiffness. Afterward, she went to the dining room to have breakfast with her father Yu Jianguo, eating millet porridge, boiled eggs, and baozi, and they talked about sleep and rehabilitation progress.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, Xinyuan Shijia, No. 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Supervising and assisting father's rehabilitation training
description: Yu Xiaowen helped her father massage his legs, supported him as he practiced standing against the wall, and walked with him in the living room using a walker. Her father was in good condition and completed the training seriously. Yu Xiaowen recorded the training duration on the rehabilitation record form.
location: Home living room, Xinyuan Shijia, No. 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tidy up the room to welcome mother
description: To make it easier to organize the wardrobe with her mother in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen tidied the books on the living room sofa, cleared the clutter from the coffee table, mopped the bedroom floor, and opened windows for ventilation, leaving the home fresh and tidy.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Xinyuan Shijia, No. 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Leisure time: checking the recycling process and reading
description: Yu Xiaowen checked the White Whale Fish old-clothes recycling mini program on her phone from the sofa to learn about the booking process. Then she moved to a lounge chair on the balcony, drinking tea and reading Being Mortal on her Kindle, occasionally looking up at the street view outside the window. Her father was watching a Chinese opera channel in the living room.
location: Xinyuan Shijia, No. 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, living room sofa and balcony at home

name: Welcome mother's arrival
description: Her mother, Li Xiuying, arrived on an electric bike from near Yuantian Road in Jinshui District, carrying vegetables and pork ribs. Yu Xiaowen opened the door to greet her, took the bags from her mother's hands, and smilingly welcomed her into the home.
location: Front of home, Xinyuan Shijia, No. 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Prepared lunch with her mother and had lunch together
description: Mother put on an apron and prepared lunch with Yu Xiaowen in the kitchen. Yu Xiaowen picked and washed the vegetables and sliced tomatoes, while Mother simmered pork rib soup. The kitchen was filled with aroma as the two chatted about family matters. Lunch was clear pork rib soup, garlic lettuce, and scrambled eggs with tomatoes. The family of three sat around the dining table. Father had two bowls of soup with a good appetite, and Mother shared her experience of buying groceries on her phone. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Xinyuan Shijia, No. 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Midday rest
description: Yu Xiaowen asked her parents to take a nap, and sat on the living room sofa herself, scrolling through her phone, reading WeChat official account articles, letting the food digest, and relaxing briefly.
location: No. 9 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, Xinyuan Shijia, living room sofa at home

name: Organize the wardrobe and select unused clothes.
description: Yu Xiaowen and her mother sorted out the wardrobe in the bedroom together. They folded winter down jackets and thick sweaters into storage boxes and hung up spring light jackets and dresses. Then they selected unused clothes. Her mother was reluctant at first, but Yu Xiaowen patiently explained the environmental significance of recycling old clothes. In the end, they picked out 13 items and packed them by category on the living room floor.
location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City, Jinshui District, No. 9 Nongke Road, Xinyuan Shijia, the floor in Yu Xiaowen's bedroom and living room

name: Scheduled old-clothes recycling and neck-shoulder heat compress rest
description: Yu Xiaowen used her phone to schedule a doorstep recycling pickup in the Baijingyu mini program, choosing the 17:00-18:00 time slot. She adjusted her sleeping position and gradually fell asleep before 23:00.

Through the living room window, she saw that the roses in the community garden downstairs were already in full bloom and colorful. She then walked to the kitchen, where her mother was already simmering millet porridge over low heat. The aroma of pancakes filled the air, and she felt a sense of peace.

Her mother, Li Xiuying, brought out her specialty millet porridge and pancakes; there was also a plate of soy-sauce cucumbers on the table. While ladling porridge for Xiaowen, her mother said, 'The weather is nice today. After lunch, I'll take your dad downstairs for a walk.' Xiaowen took a bite of the pancake and replied, 'Sure, but let him do his rehab exercises first, step by step.' Her father, Yu Jianguo, nodded with a smile, picked up a slice of cucumber with his chopsticks, and chewed slowly.

As they hung the clothes, mother and daughter chatted about what they had seen in the neighborhood and the new dog that the neighbors had got. After hanging the clothes, she helped her father walk a couple of laps in the living room to warm up for the rehabilitation exercises.
location: Balcony and living room of Room 201, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Yu Xiaowen opened the rehabilitation exercise video on her phone and guided her father through gentle movements such as raising his arms and legs. After a short rest, she helped her father walk in the hallway using a walker. She encouraged him: Dad, yesterday you walked 15 steps, today let's try 18 steps. Take it slow, no rush. She watched his steps closely, noticed that he lifted his right leg higher than yesterday, and immediately praised him. After he finished 18 steps, his forehead was slightly sweaty, but his eyes shone with joy, and Xiaowen handed him warm water in time.
location: Living room and hallway, Room 201, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China

I've put it in the community Hive Box locker." She immediately thought it was the walker accessories sent by her brother and replied, "Okay, thank you. I'll go pick it up in a bit."
location: Living room, Room 201, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

The market was bustling with noise and full of the flavor of daily life. Her mother carefully selected vegetables at the stall, bargained with the vendor, and bought fresh tomatoes, a bunch of baby bok choy, and a few cucumbers. Xiaowen took the initiative to buy pork ribs that her father liked, planning to make soup at noon. Passing by a fruit stall, she picked a box of blueberries, thinking to supplement her father's nutrition.

She blanched the pork ribs, added ginger slices and cooking wine to remove the gamey smell, and then put them into a pressure cooker with corn to make soup. Her mother, meanwhile, was cutting tomatoes and beating eggs to prepare stir-fried dishes. The two worked in perfect harmony in the kitchen, occasionally exchanging cooking tips. Her father watched a traditional opera program on TV in the living room, humming a few lines from time to time. The sounds of pots and pans and the soft laughter of mother and daughter from the kitchen wove together into the warmest background sound of a Sunday noon.
location: Kitchen, Room 201, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Yu Xiaowen served the rice and put food on her parents' plates. Her father took a sip of the soup and was full of praise, and her mother responded with a smile. Xiaowen felt warm inside and thought that such ordinary days were happiness.
location: Restaurant, Room 201, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Based on the SPSS data analysis results prepared earlier, she began writing the methodology section. She clearly described the sample selection criteria, the data inclusion and exclusion process, and the principles and applications of the independent sample t-test and chi-square test used in the statistical analysis. Her thoughts flowed smoothly, and she wrote about 800 words in almost one go, going more smoothly than expected.

She opened her phone and watched a pottery-throwing teaching video shared by Teacher Zheng Guodong in the pottery exchange group, carefully observing every turn of the hand movements. After watching, she took out a sketchbook and pencil and began to quickly sketch the outline of a clay pot on the paper, adding zodiac animals in various postures to the pot's body, emphasizing a "relief feel" with lines, accumulating inspiration for her next studio creation.
location: Bay window of the study, Room 201, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She sat on the living room floor, carefully replaced the old parts according to the instructions, and adjusted the height. Then she helped her father out of the bedroom and let him try it. Dad held the newly fitted walker and took a few steps, and feeling that it was more stable and non-slip, said with a smile, "This thing is great; your brother is thoughtful." Xiaowen photographed her father trying it out and sent it to the family group chat, tagging her brother: "Dad says 'steady!' Thanks to the sponsor."

Xiaowen replied that she was free next Monday to Friday, mainly in the evenings, and they agreed to go for a fitting after work next Wednesday. She also confirmed the makeup trial next Saturday and the wedding on Sunday.

She picked up The Night Submarine from the bedside and continued reading, immersed in its richly imaginative prose. After half an hour, she switched to the Attending Physician Exam Sprint Question Bank, turned to the cardiology section, and did 10 multiple-choice questions on antiarrhythmic drugs to reinforce her knowledge.

Yu Xiaowen supported her father along the circular path in the community garden. The roses were in full bloom—red, pink, and yellow—a splendid sight. Her father took the initiative to point at several blooming red roses and said, 'Look, how vigorously these flowers are blooming.' Her mother agreed, in high spirits. Xiaowen supported her father for nearly 80 meters and felt he was in very good condition today, his steps steadier than yesterday. She walked in the middle, feeling the gentle warmth of her parents' company.

Her father had a good appetite, drinking a bowl of porridge and eating some pickles. The family chatted while eating. Her mother said the roses in the community garden were blooming beautifully and suggested going to see them again tomorrow, and Xiaowen agreed.

Yu Xiaowen leaned on her mother's shoulder, and while watching the show, shared the progress of her thesis writing with her parents. She mentioned that the methodology section was going smoothly, and her parents were happy for her. She took a photo with her phone of the three of them watching the show from behind, sent it to the family group chat, and captioned it: 'Tonight's family theater.'

Back in bed, she picked up 'The Night Submarine' and continued reading for 30 minutes. At 22:00 she turned off the lamp, thinking that tomorrow is a new week, and fell asleep with satisfaction and anticipation.
