name: Join an online discussion of the women’s empowerment book list
description: The discussion started on time, with the theme being 'How Women Can Build Support Systems.' Xiaowen listened carefully to the other mothers' sharing. When it was her turn, she shared the story of her ten-year friendship with Zhang Jing and Wang Lina since high school, and how, when her father was ill last year, the two friends independently helped her contact rehabilitation specialists, purchased rehabilitation equipment remotely, and even stayed on late-night video calls with her until dawn when she was feeling down. Her sharing was sincere and warm, attracting likes and questions from group members, and she patiently responded to each one. After the session, she proactively sent a private message to her new friend Zhao Min, chatting for half an hour about how to balance the roles of working professional and new mother, and they agreed to go deeper at the next offline book club meeting.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (Tencent Meeting)

name: Contacted mother by phone
description: After finishing the online activity, she called her mother. Her mother was watching TV and enthusiastically talked about her trip to the morning market on Kaixuan Road today, where she bought fresh Chinese toon shoots and free-range eggs, and said she would make flatbread rolls with vegetables for the family on May Day. Xiaowen told her mother that she had understood the instructions for her brother's walker accessories and would study them together with him when he came back. Her mother smiled with relief. They hung up after chatting for nearly half an hour.
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up and bedtime meditation
description: Went to the bathroom to wash up and apply skincare. After changing into pajamas, sat cross-legged on the bed, opened the Tide app, selected the “Breathing Meditation” mode, and practiced mindfulness meditation for 10 minutes. Guided by the instructions, she focused on each breath, clearing away the day’s fatigue and the excitement after socializing, and her mind became calm.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Planning tomorrow and reading
description: After meditation, she felt inner peace. She picked up the notebook by her bedside and briefly planned the work priorities for the next day (the last day before the May Day holiday adjustment): during ward rounds, she should pay special attention to the newly admitted patient with atrial fibrillation; she also roughly thought through preliminary ideas for the May Day holiday, such as picking someone up at the station and family activities. After writing the plan, she opened a few essay collections on the desk and read two essays, then felt drowsy.
location: At the head of the bed in the bedroom, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Going to bed
description: Turning off the light and pulling up the quilt, she fell asleep peacefully in the faint sweet aftertaste of Jin Junmei and the calm after meditation.
location: Bed in the bedroom, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Morning routine: Baduanjin, washing up, and breakfast
description: After getting up at 6:30, she spread out a yoga mat on the living room floor and practiced Baduanjin, stretching her shoulders and neck, feeling refreshed. Then she washed up, and while washing, browsed an article from DXY about post-stroke dysphagia assessment on her phone with the speaker on, noting down key terms. Afterward, in the kitchen, she heated milk, toasted two slices of whole wheat bread, and boiled an egg. This simple yet nutritious breakfast started the last day of April.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commute and preparation for arrival at work
description: After changing into my white coat and flat shoes, I checked the contents of my commuter bag: medical record notebook, pens, power bank, water bottle, Kindle, and the badminton clothes and shoes prepared for after work. After confirming everything, I drove to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, arriving in about 16.8 minutes. At 7:20 I entered the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine office on the 6th floor of Building 5, opened the computer to review the latest lab reports and vital sign records of the 7 patients under my care, and specifically noted the blood sugar fluctuations of Grandpa Li in Bed 2 and Aunt Wang’s reaction to nighttime sedatives in Bed 4. I flagged to-dos in the medical record system and organized the content for the morning meeting report.
location: Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, 6th Floor, Building 5, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning shift handover
description: The morning meeting started on time in the doctors' office. Dr. Zhao, the night-shift resident, gave a detailed report on the overnight situation. Yu Xiaowen briefly reported the dynamic changes of key patients, especially the blood sugar control suggestions for Uncle Li in Bed 2. Afterwards, Director Zhang Lei emphasized the precautions for ward safety management during the May Day holiday and required the department to strictly implement the 24-hour duty system.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, 6th Floor, Building 5, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Ward rounds and medical documentation
description: Followed Teacher Li Wei on ward rounds. Teacher Li checked the right upper limb muscle tone of the patient in Bed 2 and adjusted the rehabilitation plan. Yu Xiaowen listened carefully and recorded the diagnosis and treatment opinions. After the rounds, she returned to the office to write progress notes, checked the discharge orders for Aunt Wang in Bed 4 (who was to be discharged the next day), and organized consultation request forms. During this time, head nurse Wu Min came to check the cost list for the Bed 4 discharge patient. Yu Xiaowen assisted in checking the charges for medications and rehabilitation items and then signed.
location: Ward and doctors' office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, 6th Floor, Building 5, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and casual chat
description: Had lunch with colleague Wang Fang in the staff cafeteria, ordering tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. While eating, Wang Fang excitedly shared her May Day travel plan to Laojun Mountain in Luanchuan, Luoyang. Yu Xiaowen smiled and replied, "Tomorrow my older brother is also coming to Zhengzhou. I plan to pick him up, and then we'll return to Luoyang together for a few days."
location: Staff Canteen, Basement Level 1, Building 2, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday financial review and literature search
description: After lunch, in the lounge, she opened the bookkeeping app on her phone and carefully reviewed April income and expenses: about 1,460 yuan for household public expenses, about 2,800 yuan for daily expenses, 2,000 yuan already deducted for the systematic fund investment, another 1,000 yuan saved into the emergency reserve fund, and about 800 yuan for buying medicine and checkups for her father. Total spending was kept within budget. Then she took out her Kindle and read the literature on post-stroke dysphagia assessment she had noted in the morning, jotted down a new assessment scale, then put on an eye mask and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes.
location: Rehabilitation Medicine Department Lounge, 6th Floor, Building 5, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reported study progress to Li Wei
description: Carrying her literature notes on “Application of Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation in Neurorehabilitation,” she knocked on Dr. Li Wei’s door and reported her study insights and the conceptual framework for her paper. Dr. Li affirmed her efforts and suggested writing a review first, sorting out the efficacy comparisons of different stimulation parameter methods, and then discussing future research directions.
location: Dr. Li Wei's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, 6th Floor, Building 5, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Midday nap
description: Back in the on-call room, she leaned on the folding bed, put on an eye mask, and took a 15-minute nap to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Duty room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, 6th Floor, Building 5, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon work: wrapping up and contacting patients
description: Completed the remaining medical record entry and discharge paperwork. According to the checklist provided by the nurses' station, she called several patients scheduled for post-holiday follow-up visits, reminded them that outpatient appointments might be tight in the first week after the holiday, advised them to book in advance, and patiently answered questions about medication and rehabilitation exercises.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, 6th Floor, Building 5, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Changing clothes and getting ready to leave work
description: After finishing the work at hand, she returned to the changing room, changed into the sports bra, short-sleeved T-shirt, and shorts she had prepared, put on a thin trench coat, tied a neat ponytail in front of the mirror, and shouldered her sports bag to set off.
location: Changing room, Rehabilitation Medicine Department, 6th Floor, Building 5, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuted to the badminton hall.
description: She drove away from the hospital, took the Nongye Road elevated road east, then turned onto Dongfeng Road. The evening rush hour was beginning to show, and traffic was heavier than expected, but the navigation showed the trip was about 22 minutes. Driving steadily, she arrived at the Maiya Badminton Hall parking lot at 16:52, parked the car, and entered the hall before 17:00.
location: Malt Badminton Hall, 130 meters southwest of the south gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan, Huiji District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Play badminton with Lin Wei.
description: Lin Wei was already warming up by the court. After stretching together for 10 minutes, they started rallying. The weather was hot and the gym was a bit stuffy, but they played heartily. After several rounds of high-quality multi-shot rallies, they were drenched in sweat and exclaimed how satisfying it was. An hour flew by, and they agreed to meet again after the May Day holiday.
location: Court 3, Maiya Badminton Hall, 130 meters southwest of the South Gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan, Huiji District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drive home, purchasing supplies on the way
description: After playing ball, I was parched and thirsty. On the drive home, I stopped at the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road, bought a bottle of iced Mizone, and drank half in one go to quench my thirst. Then I picked up two tomatoes and a pack of salt for dinner. Afterward I drove straight back to Qunying Residential Community and arrived home at 18:30.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Supervising her father's rehabilitation training
description: Pushing open the door, she saw her father Yu Jianguo sitting on the sofa watching the news. Yu Xiaowen wiped off her sweat and sat down, urging her father to finish today's rehabilitation exercises. Her father smiled and said he had already gone downstairs for two laps in the afternoon and felt his leg was much better, but she still accompanied him through each movement step by step. When they finished, she knelt on the floor and carefully massaged the stiff muscles in his right leg until they were noticeably relaxed.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: On March 19, after her parents were basically settled in, Yu Xiaowen contacted her badminton partner Lin Wei via WeChat at noon and confirmed that they would play badminton at the usual hall that evening. After work, she went to the hall in Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, to meet Lin Wei, and the two played doubles practice for about one hour. Yu Xiaowen's stamina had declined because of the two-month break, but she felt relaxed after sweating, and they caught up during breaks.
description: After exercising, I had a good appetite. I took the leftover tomato meat sauce and pasta from last night out of the fridge, quickly heated and mixed them, and also washed two tomatoes and cut an orange for vitamins. After eating, I quickly washed the dishes, wiped down the countertop, and the kitchen was tidy again.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading literature and preparing for exams
description: After dinner, she opened her Kindle at her desk and read the latest review on the treatment of post-stroke spasticity in the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine, highlighting key data and conclusions. Then she opened her attending physician exam prep notes, quickly reviewed the key and difficult points in the neurology section, and worked on several related case analysis questions.
location: In front of the desk, Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Meditation
description: After closing the Kindle, her brain felt a little tired. She dimmed the bedroom lights, sat cross-legged on the bed, opened the Tide app, and followed a 15-minute guided breathing meditation, focusing on each inhale and exhale, letting tense thoughts slowly settle and her mind gradually become peaceful.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: WeChat confirmation and arrangement
description: After meditation, I picked up my phone and sent Su Ya a WeChat message: 'Yaya, is the time to visit your studio on the afternoon of May 6 still three o'clock? No problem for me, see you then!' Su Ya quickly replied with an 'OK' emoji. Then I checked the family group and saw that my mother was asking about the pickup time, so I replied to my brother that the train arriving around 2:40 p.m. would be at Zhengzhou East Station, and she would go to pick him up.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Wash up and get ready for bed
date: Check morning exercise data and log the completed Baduanjin session
description: She went into the bathroom and enjoyed a comfortable hot bath, washing away the day's fatigue and sweat. After the bath, she carefully completed her evening skincare routine, patted on toner, and applied lotion.
location: Bathroom, Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Bedtime reading, review, and sleep
description: Changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, picked up the essay collection Steps Never Stop and flipped through a few pages, feeling the delicacy and gentleness in the words. Briefly reviewed today's work and life: wrapped things up smoothly, played a satisfying game, accompanied my father through rehabilitation, and completed the reading task. I felt very fulfilled, a perfect end to the last day of April. Then I turned off the desk lamp and fell asleep peacefully with satisfaction.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning activities and home preparations.
description: On the first day of the Labor Day holiday, the alarm went off at 8:00. Considering her exhaustion from several days of duty, she did not rush to get up. After waking, she stretched in bed, picked up her phone, and saw the photo of sweet and sour pork that her mother had sent in the family group, feeling warm inside. Then she got up, went to the living room, and did a simple 10-minute full-body stretch to wake up her body. After quickly washing up, she made herself a cup of milk oatmeal with whole wheat bread and had a simple breakfast.
location: Qunying Community, 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Selecting gifts and preparing to depart
description: She changed into a light blue floral long dress and a white thin jacket, and carried her shoulder bag. She walked five minutes to the Qunying Road grain and oil shop downstairs and selected a basket of fresh fruit, including strawberries, mangoes, and cantaloupe. She asked the shop owner to arrange it into a fruit basket as a holiday gift for her parents. Then she walked home, packed her things, and took her car keys.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Drove to the rehabilitation hospital.
description: Starting from home by car, go south along Qunying Road, turn onto the Nongye Road elevated road, head west to Tongbai Road, then turn south, and finally arrive at Funiu Road. Navigation shows about 12 km in total. During the May Day holiday, city traffic was heavier than usual, so it actually took about 35 minutes. On the way, feeling expectant, sunlight streamed through the car window. She turned on the car music and listened to cheerful piano music.
location: No. 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Rehabilitation Hospital, No. 61 Funiu Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Ward reunion and warm moments in the garden
description: Arrived at Zhengzhou Rehabilitation Hospital, parked in the parking lot, and walked toward the inpatient building carrying a fruit basket. Entering the ward, I saw Dad Yu Jianguo sitting in a wheelchair and Mother Li Xiuying making the bed. I handed the fruit basket to Mom. She smiled and said, “Why did you buy so much, child?” Dad looked in good spirits. I chatted with my parents for a while and asked about Dad's sleep last night and today's rehabilitation arrangements. The weather was excellent, so I suggested pushing Dad to the garden downstairs for a walk. The three of us walked with the wheelchair to the hospital garden, where roses and rambler roses were in full bloom, and stopped beside a bench. Mom opened the insulated lunchbox she had brought, and the aroma of sweet and sour pork, cucumber salad, fruit salad, and stewed noodles drifted into the air. We sat around the bench, eating and chatting. I shared funny stories from work with my parents, and Dad also reminded me not to overwork myself.
location: Inpatient Department and Garden, Zhengzhou Rehabilitation Hospital, 61 Funiu Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bid farewell to parents and head back.
description: After clearing away the tableware, she urged her mother to rest well and agreed with her father to come see him again tomorrow. After sending them back to the ward, she drove home alone. Traffic had eased on the way back, and it took about 25 minutes. Her mood was relaxed, and she was thinking about the plan to pick up her brother in the afternoon.
location: 61 Funiu Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Resting and recuperating at home.
description: After arriving home, hung up the coat, rested on the sofa for 15 minutes, drank a glass of warm water, and had a light snack to replenish energy. Checked the phone and confirmed again that the G96 train taken by elder brother Yu Xiaofeng would arrive at Zhengzhou East Station at 14:45, stopping at Platform 13. Considering the large crowds during the May Day holiday, decided to leave early.
location: Qunying Community, 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Go to Zhengzhou East Station to pick up my brother.
description: At 13:30, I set off by car on time. The navigation showed about 25 minutes to Zhengzhou East Station, but considering holiday traffic, it actually took 35 minutes. I parked in Zone C of the underground parking lot at the East Square, quickly crossed through the crowd, and reached the exit. Standing at the exit, I opened my phone to check the time — it was exactly 14:45. After waiting a few minutes, I spotted my older brother Yu Xiaofeng at a glance, wearing a bright orange hoodie and dragging his suitcase out of the ticket gate. I waved at him. He smiled and walked over quickly, and we gave each other a big hug. Long time no see.
location: East Square Exit, Zhengzhou East Railway Station, 199 Xinyi Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pick up and return to the residence to settle luggage
description: I walked back to the parking lot with my brother, then drove home. On the way, we talked about what he had seen and heard along the way, and I told him about Dad's condition today. After getting home, I helped my brother put his suitcase in the spare bedroom. He took a quick look around my little place and said it was much tidier than he had imagined.
location: From 199 Xinyi Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Settled on holiday plans and leisure time.
description: The two of us sat down on the sofa in the living room. My brother took out a box of trendy egg yolk pastries he brought me as a specialty from Shenzhen from his suitcase, and I made him a cup of Xinyang Maojian tea. We started chatting casually and planned the itinerary for the next two days. My brother suggested going to the Yellow River Scenic Area tomorrow morning, saying the weather was perfect for a short trip. I agreed, checked the scenic area's opening hours and ticket information on my phone, and made a preliminary plan for the self-driving route and return time. After finishing the serious talk, we ate egg yolk pastries, drank tea, scrolled through our phones, and chatted, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: Living room, Qunying Community, No. 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Preparation before going out
description: My brother and I each went back to our rooms to change. I put on a T-shirt and jeans that were easier to move in, and my brother also changed into a casual outfit. I checked my backpack and brought my phone, power bank, and keys.
location: Qunying Community, 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Went out for dinner and a city walk.
description: I suggested taking my brother to Dehua Pedestrian Street near Erqi Square to experience Zhengzhou's night scene and food. It took about 20 minutes by car, and we parked in the underground garage of the shopping district. For dinner, we chose the renowned Heji Huimian on the pedestrian street. We each ordered a bowl of their signature mutton huimian, plus a large mixed salad and barbecue skewers, eating to our hearts' content. After dinner, we strolled casually along the lively Dehua Pedestrian Street, soaking in the festive atmosphere, and I also bought my brother a cup of Kaifeng-style almond tea.
location: Heji Huimian Restaurant and Dehua Pedestrian Street, No. 200 Erqi Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Drove home
description: She drove about 20 minutes back to Qunying Community. After parking, the two walked and chatted; the night breeze was slightly cool, and it was very pleasant.
location: From Dehua Pedestrian Street, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to No. 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening relaxation and personal time
description: After returning home, my brother was in the living room working on his computer, and I went to my room and changed into loungewear. I did 15 minutes of mindful meditation and stretching on the bedroom carpet to relieve the day's emotional swings and physical fatigue. After meditation, I opened my Kindle and continued reading the final part of Still Walking. At about 22:00, I said goodnight to my brother, then opened the Suishouji app on my phone and quickly listed tomorrow's to-do list and items to bring.
location: Bedroom and living room, Qunying Community, No. 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and peaceful sleep
description: Washed up and did her skincare routine. Lying in bed, she used her phone to record today's mood: “Labor Day, being with Dad, Mom, and my brother is the best gift. I saw Dad’s smile and brought back my brother whom I hadn’t seen for a long time. My heart is full of a sense of security. Good night, tomorrow is a new day.” She set the alarm for 8:00 tomorrow morning, turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom, Qunying Community, 89 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: After waking up naturally in the morning, she washed up and changed into a comfortable cotton shirt and jeans, preparing for outdoor activities with her family. Then she made a simple fruit salad with yogurt, oats, and kiwi for breakfast, chatted with her older brother, who had just gotten up, in the kitchen about the taste of last night's stewed noodles, and after the meal quickly tidied up the messy blanket on the sofa and put the clothes from last night into the washing machine.
location: Room 402, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Buy fruit and pick up father.
description: Walked to the Qunying Road grocery store downstairs, quickly picked out bananas and blueberries, thinking it would be convenient for father to eat. Afterward, my brother had already driven the car to the entrance of the residential community. After getting in, we drove together to Zhengzhou Rehabilitation Hospital. On the way, we discussed when mother would arrive in Zhengzhou. When we reached the ward, father had just finished physical therapy and was in good spirits. After helping father change into his jacket and confirming his condition, the family left the hospital happily, ready to head to the Yellow River Scenic Area.
location: Zhengzhou Rehabilitation Hospital, 71 Nongye Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove to the Yellow River Scenic Area.
description: She drove the car herself, setting off from the rehabilitation hospital and setting the navigation to the Zhengzhou Yellow River Culture Park. Along the way, she opened the window, played a selection from 'Chaoyanggou', a Henan opera favorite of her father, chatted with her brother about interesting work stories from Shenzhen, and her father occasionally chimed in. The family enjoyed a rare time driving together.
location: Zhengzhou Yellow River Culture Park, Jiangshan Road, Huiji District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Visited the Yellow River Scenic Area
description: After arriving at the scenic area, she bought electric shuttle tickets to save her father's energy. Taking the shuttle to Yanhuang Square, they took photos in front of the statues of Emperors Yan and Huang. Then she pushed the wheelchair provided by the scenic area and walked with her father along the Yellow River bank trail, enjoying the river flowing eastward and listening to her father tell stories from when he was young and on duty at the Yellow River Bridge in Luoyang.
location: Zhengzhou Yellow River Culture Park, Jiangshan Road, Huiji District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Enjoying a lunch of Yellow River carp
description: Near the scenic area, they found the highly rated Dahe Renjia farmhouse restaurant and ordered the signature Yellow River carp, farmhouse free-range chicken, and iron-pot stew. During the meal, she video-called her mother, letting her see her father's condition and the dishes on the table. Her mother said she was almost there too and told everyone to take their time eating.
location: Dahe Renjia farmhouse restaurant, near the intersection of Jiangshan Road and the Yellow River Levee, Huiji District, Zhengzhou City

name: Returning home
description: Drove back to the city. Overwhelmed by drowsiness in the car, her father closed his eyes to rest. She and her brother talked in low voices about when their mother would arrive in Zhengzhou and what to have for dinner at home.
location: Room 402, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Settle father down to rest
description: After arriving home, together with my older brother, I helped my father lie down on the sofa, covered him with a thin blanket, poured a glass of warm water and placed it within reach, and told him to rest for a while.
location: Room 402, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Home study: literature review
description: Taking advantage of the time when family members were resting, she opened her laptop, logged into the hospital library's remote access system, entered keywords such as "post-cerebral-infarction sequelae stage," "depressive state," "exercise therapy," and "psychological intervention," and quickly screened out 3 articles with high levels of evidence. At the same time, she opened OneNote and, while reading, excerpted key conclusions, recommended intervention methods, and assessment scales to reserve material for the department's case discussion.
location: Room 402, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Household chores and welcoming mother back
description: She came out of the study, went to the balcony, took down the dried clothes, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe. Soon the doorbell rang, and her mother arrived with homemade fried crispy pork and Yintiao vegetables, a specialty of Luoyang. Her brother stepped forward to take the things, and she gave her mother a big hug.
location: Room 402, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Family gathering time and video call with best friend
description: Her parents were chatting in the living room, and she and her brother were keeping them company. Around 17:00, she received a video call from her best friend Zhang Jing. While talking, she walked to the balcony, shared photos of taking her father out today, complained about the exhaustion of being on duty, and listened to amusing stories about Zhang Jing's students practicing for a public lesson, laughing heartily.
location: Room 402, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prepare and enjoy dinner
description: After hanging up the phone, she returned to the kitchen to help her mother prepare food, peeling garlic and trimming vegetables. Her mother took charge of the cooking and made her specialty tomato beef brisket soup and stir-fried vegetables. Her father also got up to help set out the bowls and chopsticks. The family sat together to enjoy dinner, and her mother gave each person a slice of cut watermelon.
location: Room 402, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Family walk and evening conversation.
description: After dinner, I suggested the whole family go out for a walk to help Dad digest. We strolled slowly to the nearby Zhuchun Park. The park was lively, with many people walking and doing square dancing. My mother and I walked arm in arm at the front, while my father and older brother followed behind, talking about Dad's recent blood pressure control.
location: Zhuchun Garden Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening reading and quiet time alone
description: After returning home, my parents and older brother were watching TV and chatting in the living room. I made myself a cup of light tea, went back to the bedroom, turned on the desk lamp, opened 'Better', and played Dvořák's 'From the New World' through the Bluetooth speaker. I read quietly in the soothing music and underlined the passage about 'how to maintain humanistic care within the system' with a pencil, feeling peaceful and fulfilled.
location: Room 402, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bedtime family care
description: I closed the book and walked out of the bedroom. I saw my brother helping my father adjust the newly bought walker, so I went over and massaged my father's calves after his day of walking. Mother urged everyone to wash up and rest early. After chatting with Mother for a while, I went to the bathroom to wash up and do my skincare routine.
location: Room 402, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: After changing into pajamas, she lay on her side in bed, set the alarm, and reviewed the pleasant and fulfilling day. Then she opened the meditation app and followed the guided instructions for a 10-minute deep breathing and body scan practice. Afterward, she picked up her phone and browsed the latest articles from several medical WeChat official accounts. Feeling sleepy, she turned off the desk lamp and soon fell asleep to the faint snoring of her family.
location: Room 402, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Waking up in the morning and getting ready to head out
description: At 7:10 in the morning, the alarm went off. Seeing the bright sunshine outside the window put me in a good mood. Remembering that today I would take my parents to the Yellow River with my brother, I got up quickly. I spread a yoga mat in the living room and did 10 minutes of morning stretching to wake up my body, feeling both eager for my father to try walking and a little nervous. Then I brushed my teeth and washed my face, and changed into a casual T-shirt and sports pants. Next, I took out my backpack and carefully checked the outing supplies: my father's thermos, blood pressure medicine, and thin jacket; my mother's sun hat and water cup; and my own power bank, phone, and so on. I also stuffed in a few packs of soda crackers and two apples. Finally, I made a glass of milk and quickly finished breakfast with whole wheat bread and a banana.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Community, No. 16 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Met up with her brother and went to the rehabilitation hospital
description: At 8:10, she put on her backpack and went downstairs. Her older brother Yu Xiaofeng was already waiting at the gate of the community in his white Volkswagen Tiguan. After folding the wheelchair and putting it in the trunk, she got into the passenger seat. Her brother handed over the hot soy milk that their mother had specially asked him to bring, and she felt warmth in her heart. The two decided to pick up their parents at the hospital first. Her brother drove west along Qunying Road, turned onto Nanyang Road, and then onto the Agricultural Road elevated road. There was not much traffic on the way. They chatted about their father's recovery and the plan for the day. Her brother mentioned an example of a colleague in Shenzhen whose father recovered well after a stroke, which was very encouraging. They arrived at the Rehabilitation Branch of the Fifth Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University around 8:35.
location: From the entrance of Qunying Residential Community, No. 16 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to the Rehabilitation Branch of the Fifth Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, No. 69 Nongye Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pick up parents and set off for the Yellow River Scenic Area
description: After parking the car, she went straight to the ward. Her mother, Li Xiuying, had already changed her father, Yu Jianguo, into his going-out clothes, and he was in high spirits. Li Xiuying carefully packed his blood pressure medication into separate doses and put it in the bag. Her brother chatted briefly with their father to check on his condition. Once everything was ready, they helped their father into the wheelchair, and the family walked to the parking lot chatting and laughing, ready to start the trip to the Yellow River scenic area.
location: Rehabilitation Branch of the Fifth Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, No. 69 Nongye Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Drove to the Yellow River Scenic Area.
description: To avoid downtown congestion, her brother chose to take the Jingsha Expressway, then onto the North Fourth Ring Road, and then into Jiangshan Road. He opened the car window a crack, and the spring breeze carrying the scent of grass and soil brushed their faces. He chatted about everyday things with his mother, while his father quietly watched the scenery outside the window and occasionally chimed in. The car was filled with singing and laughter. The navigation showed the whole trip was about 40 minutes, and the family drove easily and happily toward Zhengzhou Yellow River Culture Park.
location: Jingsha Expressway, North Fourth Ring Road, and Jiangshan Road, from Jinshui District to Huiji District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Visit to the Yellow River Scenic Area and a precious moment of my father walking independently.
description: After arriving at Zhengzhou Yellow River Cultural Park, we found a parking spot close to the riverbank. My brother pushed the wheelchair, I held Mother's arm, and the family walked slowly along the flat path. The sunlight was just right and the Yellow River was vast and mighty. On a wooden boardwalk about a hundred meters long, Father asked to walk on his own. My brother and I were overjoyed inside but stayed calm, guarding him on the left and right as he held the railing and walked steadily step by step for nearly a hundred meters. Mother was so moved that her eyes reddened, and she kept praising him. I quickly recorded the whole process on my phone to capture this precious moment. After he finished, Father had a light sweat on his forehead but wore a relaxed smile. We helped him sit back into the wheelchair to rest, and this experience greatly uplifted the whole family.
location: Zhengzhou Yellow River Culture Park, at the intersection of Jiangshan Road and the Yellow River embankment, Huiji District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Farmhouse lunch and family chat
description: Around noon, I drove to Dahe Renjia, a well-regarded farmhouse restaurant near the scenic area. We ordered the signature braised Yellow River carp, mutton stewed noodles, scrambled eggs with magnolia buds, and cold dressed nepeta. My father had a good appetite, ate most of a bowl of stewed noodles, and praised the fish for being fresh and tender. My brother told funny stories about a seaside camping team-building trip in Shenzhen, making my mother laugh heartily. My mother kept saying that once my father got better, the whole family would go to Luoyang to see the peony festival. The table was filled with laughter and a warm, relaxed atmosphere.
location: Dahe Renjia Farm Stay, 300 meters east of the intersection of Jiangshan Road and the Yellow River Levee, Huiji District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Returned and got my parents settled back at the hospital
description: Considering that Father needed his midday rest, they set off back around two o'clock along the same route. On the way, Father rested with his eyes closed, while Mother chatted with me and my brother about family matters, saying it was the happiest day of her life. The car was filled with contentment and peace. At 2:15 p.m., they returned to the hospital. After parking, they took Father back to the ward together, helped him take off his coat, supported him into bed, tucked in the blanket, and told him to rest well. Mother also began packing up the things she had brought, still wearing a smile.
location: Return trip from Huiji District to Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province; ward of the Rehabilitation Branch, Fifth Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, No. 69 Nongye Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Worked with her older brother to make a short video of her father walking.
description: While my father was resting and my mother was tidying things up, I sat with my brother on the caregiver's chairs in the ward and opened a video editing app on my phone. I selected the footage of my father walking independently that I had filmed in the morning, added a warm piano piece saved on my phone, simply trimmed it, and added the words 'Comrade Lao Yu, keep going!' to make a heartwarming one-and-a-half-minute short video. When it was finished, my brother posted it to the family group 'Happy Family,' and relatives gave likes and words of encouragement one after another. I also saved a copy of the video.
location: Ward, Rehabilitation Branch, Fifth Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, No. 69 Nongye Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Said goodbye to parents, shopped on the way, and returned to the apartment
description: After saying goodbye to our parents, my brother drove me back to Qunying Community and stopped by the Qunying Road grain and oil shop on the way. I bought a bag of whole wheat bread, a carton of fresh milk, some kiwis, a bunch of green vegetables, and two boxes of eggs as groceries for the next two days. After shopping, I carried the bags and walked a few minutes back to my home in Qunying Community.
location: From the Rehabilitation Branch of the Fifth Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, No. 69 Nongye Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to the Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and then to Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Community, No. 16 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Resting at home and talking with mother on the phone
description: After returning to the apartment, she put the food in the fridge and poured herself a glass of warm water. When she opened her phone, she saw that the family group chat was still enthusiastically discussing her father's walking, and she happily replied to several messages. Then she sat on the sofa and called her mother to confirm that her father had woken up and was in good spirits. On the phone, her mother proudly recounted the scene of her father walking again. After hanging up, she felt much more at ease and made a simple plan for the evening.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Community, No. 16 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Attending physician exam preparation plan and review start.
description: She sat down at her desk and took out the 2025 attending physician exam syllabus and core textbooks. Checking the calendar, she used a highlighter to mark the review chapters to complete on the dates in May and June, and put sticky tabs on the weak areas, “Neurological Rehabilitation” and “Cardiovascular System.” She wrote out a plan to review 1.5 hours every evening starting next Monday. After planning for half an hour, she opened the first chapter of “Neurological Rehabilitation” and read it carefully to warm up for formal exam preparation.
location: Desk, Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Area, 16 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Simple dinner
description: Not wanting to make too much trouble while home alone, she cooked a steaming bowl of vegetable and egg noodles with the freshly bought baby bok choy and eggs, and cut a kiwi to supplement vitamins. She turned on her tablet and watched the food documentary Once Upon a Bite while eating, enjoying her time alone.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 16 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening reading, music, and personal care
description: After eating and cleaning up, she leaned on the sofa and continued reading several chapters of Still Walking, feeling touched by the passages about family and regret. Then she put on earphones and played Debussy's 'Clair de Lune,' closing her eyes and letting the soothing music calm her mind. Next she went to the bathroom and carefully completed her cleansing and skincare routine: applying a hydrating mask, patting on toner, and applying serum and lotion. Seeing her content smile in the mirror, she felt that everything today was wonderful.
location: Living room and bathroom, Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, 16 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Changed into pajamas and lay in bed. Finished the last few pages of Better on Kindle. After turning off the light, she did a 10-minute meditation, focusing on her breathing and letting today's emotions, excitement, and satisfaction settle, emptying her mind. Recalling that every step of her father's progress touched her heart and gave her great confidence and motivation. With relief and gratitude, she set the alarm for 7:10 a.m. the next workday and peacefully turned off the light to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Community, No. 16 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

description: After waking naturally at nine, I leaned against the headboard, picked up my Kindle, and read The Second Sex. I was fascinated by the book's discussion of women realizing their self-worth in social roles. At one brilliant passage, I drew a wavy line on the edge of the screen with my finger. This sense of detachment relaxed me physically and mentally.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: After closing the Kindle, I stood on the yoga mat by the bed and did morning stretches, including neck stretches, Cat-Cow, and Downward-Facing Dog, feeling my spine stretch out. Listening to the birdsong, I was fully awake.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

After vacuuming out the air, she took the summer quilt and light dresses from the top cabinet, steamed them with a garment steamer, and hung them in the wardrobe. location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She bought kiwifruit, bok choy, and apples, and chatted with the shop owner, Old Chen. On the way, she took the cardboard boxes from express deliveries and old magazines to the community waste sorting and recycling station.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

description: After getting home, she put on an apron to make tomato egg noodles. She chopped tomatoes, beat eggs, and heated oil in the wok, while connecting her phone to a Bluetooth speaker to play a podcast about work-life balance. She listened while cooking the noodles, enjoying the time in the kitchen.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Short nap during lunch break
description: After lunch, cleared the dishes, drew the curtains, set a 30-minute alarm, and lay on the bed for a light sleep.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tidying balcony laundry and transcribing work notes
description: After waking from an afternoon nap, she went to the balcony to take in the drying sheets, folded them, and put them in the wardrobe. Then she sat down at the desk and transcribed the key points of medical orders and medication contraindications encountered during the rehabilitation rotation into a notebook for easy reference.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Took out the textbook Neurorehabilitation, previewed Chapter 2, drew a mind-map framework while reading, marked a question mark next to the difficult point “Rehabilitation Therapy for Balance Dysfunction,” and planned to ask Teacher Li Wei for advice at work.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Brewing tea before the rain and taking a moment to relax
description: The sky was gradually clouding over, and the air was muggy. She went to the kitchen and brewed jasmine tea with boiling water, then carried the glass cup to the balcony window. Opening the window a crack, she smelled the damp earthy scent, watched pedestrians downstairs quicken their pace, and felt at ease.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading Still Walking
description: After tea, I curled up on the living room sofa to read Still Walking. Drawn in by Hirokazu Kore-eda's portrayal of family relationships, when I read about the death anniversary of the eldest brother, Junpei, I remembered that the Dragon Boat Festival was approaching and wondered whether to go home to visit my parents.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prepare ingredients in advance to cope with the rain shower.
description: Seeing that the sky was dark and raindrops were falling sporadically, she went into the kitchen early to prepare ingredients: she trimmed and washed the green vegetables, cut tomatoes into chunks, and set out the dried noodles and beaten eggs, so that she could cook the noodles quickly later.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Cook hot noodle soup and watch Once Upon a Bite.
description: A downpour started at five o'clock. She lit the stove, boiled water, and cooked hot tomato-and-egg noodle soup. She brought it to the coffee table, turned on the TV to watch Season 4 of "Once Upon a Bite", and ate while watching. The sound of rain mixed with the program, and she felt comfortable.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: Mother Li Xiuying called via video, told me to bring an umbrella tomorrow, and said my brother had changed his ticket to the 7 p.m. high-speed train back to Shenzhen, with reluctance in her voice. We talked for nearly fifty minutes, from my brother to Father's rehabilitation training and then to work. Finally, Mother told me to take good care of myself. After hanging up, I set the alarm for 6:50 tomorrow morning.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Indoor stretching after dinner and chatting with her best friend
description: After finishing the noodles and cleaning up, my best friend Zhang Jing sent me a WeChat message to chat about her thoughts on watching the movie "Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri". I shared my feelings about the seasonal change and organizing my notes today. We chatted casually about the mood of wrapping up the holiday, and I didn't mention my brother's ticket rescheduling.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Helped her mother enable care mode on her phone.
description: She remembered that her mother wanted to use WeChat's care mode. Through the Family Guard app, she remotely taught her how to use it, sending screenshots step by step. Her mother quickly learned and shared balcony photos in the family group.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up, skincare, and bedtime preparation.
description: Go into the bathroom for the evening skincare routine: wash your face with cleanser, apply toner and lotion, massage the eye area, and brush your teeth for two minutes with an electric toothbrush. Then check the keys, work badge, and power bank needed for work tomorrow, and set the alarm for 6:50.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bedtime meditation
description: Turned off the main light, left the night light on, sat cross-legged on the bed, and did a 15-minute breathing meditation with a meditation app. She followed the guidance and let distracting thoughts drift away, feeling calm inside.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bedtime reading and self-motivation
description: Picked up the Kindle and continued reading Chapter 11 of The Second Sex. Moved by the line ‘One is not born, but rather becomes, a woman,’ I underlined it and plan to write it on a sticky note tomorrow to stick on the office partition. At ten, I finished the chapter, felt sleepy, closed the Kindle, left a gap in the window, turned off the light, and fell asleep to the sound of rain.
location: Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up, stretching, and breakfast
description: After the alarm went off, she did a simple stretch in bed to wake up her body. After getting out of bed, she did 10 minutes of shoulder, neck, and waist stretches in the living room to relieve the fatigue from last night's reading. Then she washed up and changed into comfortable loungewear. She prepared breakfast for herself: heated a glass of milk, toasted two slices of whole-wheat bread, and cut up a kiwi. While eating, she played a news podcast on her phone to learn about the day's weather and hot topics.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Finishing household chores and waiting for mother
description: After breakfast, she cleared the dishes and chopsticks into the kitchen. While her mother had not yet arrived, she took out the winter clothes that had been preliminarily sorted the day before from the bedroom wardrobe, spread them on the living room floor, and divided them into piles again according to "needs vacuum sealing" and "can be stored directly." At the same time, she opened the windows for ventilation to prepare for today's thorough cleaning.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Start of Summer seasonal storage (done with mother)
description: At exactly nine o'clock, her mother, Li Xiuying, arrived on time from Luoyang, bringing a bag of homemade pastries and some vegetables. The mother and daughter quickly divided the work: Yu Xiaowen took the technical tasks, taking down the curtains in the bedroom and living room and loading them into the washing machine in batches; she used a screwdriver to remove the air conditioner filters, then took them to the bathroom and scrubbed them carefully with a brush and cleaner, and hung them on the balcony to drain. Her mother, Li Xiuying, took the physical tasks, folding the down quilt and thick mattress pad and stuffing them into vacuum compression bags, sucking them flat with a vacuum cleaner, and then tucking them into the storage box under the bed; she took out the summer blanket and rattan mat and spread them on the bed; she wiped the fan blades in the living room and bedroom with a wet rag. As they worked, they chatted. Her mother talked about the courtyard of the old house in Luoyang and said, 'It's time to plant loofah seedlings at the start of summer.' Yu Xiaowen smiled and agreed, telling her to go back and arrange it after her father was discharged. The washing machine rumbled on the balcony, and the house was filled with the fresh scent of laundry detergent and the warmth of hard work.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Finish up washing and hanging clothes to dry
description: After her mother helped finish most of the tidying, Yu Xiaowen took the washed curtains and bedspreads out of the washing machine and hung them to dry on the balcony. Taking advantage of the good sunshine, she also hand-washed a few wool sweaters and hung them in a ventilated spot. The air was filled with the fresh scent of laundry detergent, which lifted her spirits.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and saying goodbye to mother
description: They were busy until nearly midnight, and both were a little hungry. Yu Xiaowen went to the kitchen and cooked two bowls of tomato and egg noodles, while her mother heated the snacks she had brought in the microwave. The mother and daughter sat at the dining table, eating and chatting about the father's recent condition. Her mother looked tired but was in good spirits. After the meal, her mother said she had to rush back to Luoyang by 2 p.m. to accompany her father, told Xiaowen to drive safely in the afternoon, and left first.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday rest and changing clothes
description: After her mother left, Yu Xiaowen rested for twenty minutes and drank a glass of water. She turned over the curtains and bed sheets drying on the balcony to ensure they would dry thoroughly. Then she changed out of her loungewear, put on dark blue jeans and a white cotton T-shirt, changed into a pair of comfortable canvas shoes, picked up her shoulder bag, car keys, and an old notebook, and was ready to go out.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove to the bookstore
description: She went downstairs, started the car, and set the navigation. The destination was Zhengzhou Book Center on Xitaikang Road, Erqi District. The trip was about 9 kilometers, and because it was a workday and she avoided rush hour, the roads were clear and the drive took about 20 minutes.
location: Along the route from Qunying Road, Jinshui District to West Taikang Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (in a car)

name: Afternoon book shopping
description: After arriving at Zhengzhou Book Center, she went straight to the medical science and technology section on the third floor. In front of the bookshelves, she carefully compared several editions of Medical Statistics and finally chose Medical Statistics and SPSS Practical Tutorial. She asked the counter staff whether there was a companion case CD-ROM, and the staff brought one out from the storeroom for her. After paying, she saw that it was still early, so she stopped in the social sciences and humanities section on the first floor. She picked up a collection of essays about Henan's local scenery and customs, flipped through a few pages, found it quite interesting, and bought it as bedtime reading.
location: Zhengzhou Book Center, No. 19-1 Xitaikang Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Having coffee and briefly browsing the new book.
description: After buying the book, she followed the navigation and drove for about 8 minutes to nature cafe in Zhongyuan District. After ordering a medium iced latte, she found a seat by the window, tore off the plastic wrap of the new book, opened the table of contents and the first chapter, and skimmed through the basic SPSS interface and data types. She took photos of the key pages with her phone, forming a preliminary plan for tomorrow's review. Halfway through her coffee, she noticed light rain starting outside the window. She sat for a while longer, and when the rain eased, she got up.
location: Nature Cafe near the intersection of Daxue Road and Zhongyuan Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove back home
description: She drove home and parked in the residential complex. On the way, she stopped at the "Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop" at the Qunying Road intersection and bought some fresh vegetables and eggs to prepare dinner.
location: On the way (in the car) from Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District

Next, she took down the curtains and bedspreads that had been aired in the morning and were completely dry, folded them neatly, and put them back in the wardrobe. Then she neatly arranged the vacuum-packed winter bedding in the storage bins. After a day of ventilation, the air in the home was fresh, and seeing the tidy bedroom made her feel very comfortable.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Rest and light tidying up
description: After tidying up, she made a cup of jasmine tea, collapsed onto the sofa, scrolled through her phone for a while, replied to messages in several WeChat groups, and checked tomorrow's weather forecast while she was at it.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Fund transaction confirmation
description: She had dinner alone and didn't want to make too much trouble. She cooked a light bowl of green vegetable and egg noodles with the fresh vegetables and eggs she had just bought. She opened her tablet and watched the latest episode of Once Upon a Bite while eating. It happened to feature the seasonal Jiangnan dishes of fava beans and spring bamboo shoots, which made her appetite grow. After eating, she simply tidied up the kitchen and washed the dishes.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening walk and reading
description: After dinner the sky gradually cleared, and she decided to go out for a walk. She walked about 8 minutes to the nearby Zhuchunyuan Park and strolled two laps in the moist air after the rain. Then she sat on a bench, took out the prose collection of Henan scenery she had bought at the bookstore, and read two chapters about her hometown Luoyang, feeling deeply nostalgic.
location: Zhuchun Garden Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with Wang Lina
description: When she got back from her walk, her phone rang right on time—it was a WeChat video call from Wang Lina, who was far away in Shenzhen. Yu Xiaowen leaned back on the sofa and answered. They chatted for an hour. Lina excitedly shared her embarrassing moments learning to swim, such as choking on water because she didn't dare put her face in the water, and also showed off her newly learned ability to float, making Xiaowen laugh so hard on the sofa that she doubled over. Lina also perceptively asked, 'Haven't you been tensing up too much again lately?' Yu Xiaowen thought for a moment and admitted that she had indeed been a bit anxious before the holiday, but after doing housework and buying new books today, she felt much better. Finally, Lina suggested she stop staying cooped up at home. Yu Xiaowen smiled and said okay, deciding to invite her sports buddy Lin Wei to play a game after work tomorrow evening.
location: Living room sofa, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Study preparation and note organization
description: After hanging up the video call, she sat back at her desk feeling relaxed. She opened her newly bought Medical Statistics and SPSS: A Practical Tutorial, took out a highlighter and a notebook, and, referring to the chapters she had photographed at the café, began drawing her first mind map on 'data entry and variable definition'. She planned to spend a week working through the introductory part of the book.
location: Study room, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening stretching, washing up, and preparing for the next day's work
description: After studying, she did 20 minutes of full-body stretching and neck-shoulder relaxation in the living room to relieve the day's strain. Then she went to the bathroom to wash up and do her skincare routine. She took out a clean white coat for tomorrow from the wardrobe, checked her work badge and stethoscope, and hung them on the coat rack. She also checked her phone alarm to confirm it was set for 6:50 tomorrow morning, without any mistake.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Write and practice a speaking outline for the case discussion.
description: After making a cup of instant coffee, I opened the laptop, pulled up my literature notes, clinical observation records, and clips of my father's rehabilitation videos, and began writing a speech outline for a one-week case discussion based on the framework I had conceived last night. The outline was divided into four parts: disease background and current status; evidence-based psychological intervention, reviewing literature on methods such as CBT and mindfulness; exercise therapy mechanisms integrated with neuroplasticity theory; and case integration with recommendations, in which the real process of my father's emotional improvement during rehabilitation was incorporated anonymously as support. The first draft was about 1,200 words. Afterward, I read the whole text aloud in a low voice, polishing the transitions to ensure the oral presentation was smooth and confident.
