location: Room 303, Building 8, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Attended Medical English Lesson 3 (diabetes terminology)
description: In her study, Xiaowen attended a medical English course via Zoom. The topic was diabetes-related terminology. At first she was somewhat distracted because she was worried about her mother, but she quickly adjusted and repeated words such as 'glycosuria' and 'ketoacidosis,' taking screenshots to save key points. During the break, she saw Zhang Jing's reply to Sunday's invitation and felt warm.
location: Study, Room 303, Building 8, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-class diary entries and detailed planning for Sunday
description: After the class ended, Xiaowen wrote today's diary in her notebook, recording how moved she was by her mother's tears, and resolved to definitely accompany her on Sunday. Then she opened the memo app on her phone and made a list of items for the park trip on Sunday (picnic mat, water bottle, fruit, camera), and then went to wash up.
location: Study, Room 303, Building 8, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Socializing and family contact before bedtime
description: After washing up and doing her skincare routine, Xiaowen sent a voice message to her friend Sun Yue explaining that the dinner gathering had been rescheduled, and sent her father a message with a photo of the pothos plant to express how much she missed her parents. Then she did 10 minutes of bedtime yoga (Child's Pose and Legs-Up-the-Wall Pose) to ease fatigue.
location: Bedroom, Room 303, Building 8, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Read Still Walking and prepare for bed.
description: After getting into bed, I read two chapters of Hirokazu Kore-eda's 'Still Walking' and felt the delicate details of family daily life. At 22:45 I felt sleepy, turned off the light, thought back on the satisfying feeling of helping others and comforting my mother during the day, and fell asleep peacefully before 23:00.
location: Bedroom, Room 303, Building 8, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning preparations after getting up
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the phone alarm rang softly. Yu Xiao woke up and slowly drank half a glass of warm water, feeling her parched throat and stomach soothed and refreshed. The mood from last night's phone call with her mother had turned into motivation for the day. Then she walked to the balcony, opened the Baduanjin instructional video on her phone, and practiced along with the soothing music, paying special attention to the Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner stretch and the Look Back to Dispel the Five Strains and Seven Injuries neck turn. The tightness in her shoulders and neck gradually eased during the stretching; her body warmed up slightly, and she felt invigorated. After practicing, she took a warm shower, changed into clean casual clothes, and quickly prepared breakfast in the kitchen: she heated whole wheat toast, made a cup of hot milk, and while tying back her slightly damp long hair with a hair tie, she reviewed the day's to-do list.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Commuted to work by electric bike.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiao checked her backpack, made sure her phone, power bank, notebook, and review cards were all there, then got on the small electric bike downstairs and set off. The weather was clear and the temperature pleasant. She rode south on Qunying Road to Nongye Road, then turned west onto Tongbai North Road. The ride was smooth, and she arrived at Zhengzhou Central Hospital about 20 minutes later.
location: From Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Hospital preparation and department morning meeting.
description: After arriving at the hospital, Yu Xiaowen parked the car, swiped a card to enter the inpatient department, changed into a white coat in the changing room, and pinned on her name badge. After starting the computer at her workstation, she quickly organized yesterday's unarchived files, then opened the ward management system and used the time before the morning meeting to review the conditions of patients in her ward, focusing on the early-morning blood pressure record of the 67-year-old patient whose antihypertensive medication had just been adjusted yesterday. Seeing that the data was stable, she felt somewhat reassured. The morning meeting started on time, chaired by Head Nurse Wu. The night-shift doctor briefly reported on the ward situation overnight, confirming that the key elderly patient had been stable during the night. Head Nurse Wu emphasized the recent requirements for standardizing medical documentation and improving the quality of medical records. The meeting was short and efficient.
location: Doctor's Office and Meeting Room, Inpatient Department of Internal Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Accompanied Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds
description: After the morning meeting, Yu Xiao closely followed Teacher Li Wei to begin routine ward rounds. They first came to the bedside of the 67-year-old patient with hypertension. Teacher Li asked in detail whether the patient had dizziness or fatigue, and personally measured the patient's supine and standing blood pressure. Yu Xiao reported the early-morning monitoring data she had recorded to Teacher Li, who nodded in approval of her careful observation, made a slight adjustment to the day's medication plan, and instructed that blood pressure should be measured again in the afternoon. The entire ward round was rigorous and efficient.
location: Internal medicine ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Discuss the manuscript revision plan with Teacher Li.
description: After checking on the key patients, Yu Xiaowen followed Dr. Li Wei to the office and took out the printed revision comments from Henan Medical Research. Dr. Li put on his reading glasses, reviewed them item by item with her, approved the idea of adding follow-up data from the past two years, and gave key advice on the statistical methods: "The chi-square test is more appropriate than your original t-test. Go back and set up the data extraction framework, and we'll touch base on the weekend." This pointed the way for the upcoming revision.
location: Dr. Li Wei's office, Internal Medicine Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning office work: handling medical orders and new medical records
description: Back at her workstation, Yu Xiaowen first entered the post-rounds medication order adjustments, then received the admission documents for a patient admitted late last night. She carefully read the CT report and present illness history, and began writing the comprehensive medical record and the first progress note. During a break, her phone rang with a message from her close friend Zhang Jing. She took a moment to reply, 'Sunday park plan is still on,' keeping up her social rhythm for the day.
location: Internal Medicine Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Planning the route for a Sunday outing with mother
description: After the morning routine work came to an end, Yu Xiao used bits of spare time to fulfill her promise to her mother. She opened the map app on her phone, searched for 'People's Park', carefully checked the locations of several entrances and the scenic paths inside the park, and specifically marked the gently sloping tree-lined avenue near the East Gate and the public restrooms along the road. She saved screenshots of the routes, suggested entrances, and rest points in her memo for easy navigation on Sunday. This meticulous planning made her look forward to the weekend family day.
location: Internal Medicine Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Cafeteria lunch and chatting with colleagues
description: At noon, Yu Xiao got a plate of scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and rice in the staff cafeteria and sat down by a window. Her colleague Wang Fang came over with a tray and joined her, and the two chatted about everyday life. Yu Xiao asked with a smile, "Have you ever taken your elderly parents to People's Park? Where's a good place for a walk?" Wang Fang recommended the greenhouse flower house on the west side of the park, saying the paths there were flat and there were plenty of flowers. The relaxing lunch break eased the fatigue of the morning's work.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday neck and shoulder relaxation and Anki review
description: After lunch, Yu Xiao walked alone to the quiet demonstration room. She turned on the phone timer and did 5 minutes of neck stretches and shoulder circles against the wall; the original sore spot in her left shoulder almost disappeared. Then she took out her phone, opened the Anki app, and quickly memorized 5 attending physician exam prep cards, focusing on the high-frequency test point "Differential Diagnosis of Cerebral Hemorrhage and Cerebral Infarction," using fragmented time to consolidate professional knowledge.
location: Teaching Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Short afternoon nap.
description: After reviewing, Yu Xiao felt a little tired. She returned to the duty room, leaned back on the rest chair, set a 15-minute alarm, and closed her eyes to rest. The brief lunch break quickly restored her energy and recharged her for the afternoon's work.
location: Duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon ward work
description: The alarm rang, and the afternoon work began. Yu Xiao first went to the ward and re-measured the supine and standing blood pressure for the elderly patient whose antihypertensive medication had been adjusted in the morning. The values were all within the ideal range, and the patient also felt fine. Back in the office, she helped a colleague put together an EEG report for a newly admitted patient, then handled the routine medical orders for her shift, ensuring all treatments were properly implemented.
location: Internal Medicine Ward and Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon self-study for exam preparation.
description: After finishing routine work, the afternoon was relatively quiet. Yu Xiao took advantage of the free time to open the Anki app again and quietly memorized several flashcards for the attending physician exam preparation, repeatedly reinforcing key exam points to make solid preparations for the upcoming assessment.
location: Internal Medicine Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Organizing and handover before leaving work.
description: As the end of the shift approached, Yu Xiao began organizing the day's work log and checking for any missed medical orders. She verbally relayed the key follow-up points for the elderly hypertensive patient to the colleague taking over the night shift, making sure nothing was missed. Then she tidied her desk, said hello to Wang Fang, took off her white coat, and got ready to go home.
location: Internal Medicine Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting from work and buying groceries on the way
description: Yu Xiao rode her e-bike east along Tongbai North Road, turned onto Nongye Road, and then into Qunying Road. Passing the Qunying Road grain and oil shop near her home, she stopped and went in to buy fresh sweet corn, blueberries, and a bunch of seasonal greens. The warmhearted boss also gave her a few extra scallions. A few minutes later, she arrived at the foot of a building in Qunying Community.
location: From Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, via Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video called with mother after taking a shower at home
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiao first put the fruits and vegetables in the fridge, then relaxed completely. She went into the bathroom to take a hot shower, washing away the day's fatigue and the risk of germs, and changed into clean cotton loungewear. She nestled comfortably on the sofa and video-called her mother Li Xiuying on WeChat, telling her excitedly, 'Mom, I've planned the route for our Sunday park walk! We'll enter from the east gate; the paths are flat, there are lots of flowers, and there are benches too. I'm sure you won't get tired walking!' Hearing her daughter's voice and thoughtful plan, the smile at the corners of her mother's eyes could not be hidden. The mother and daughter also chatted about the hand-rolled braised noodles in the fridge and the pothos on the desk. The warm conversation made the atmosphere at home especially cozy.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Simple dinner and professional reading
description: After hanging up, Yu Xiao took out the pork-and-cabbage dumplings her mother had wrapped the day before from the refrigerator. She put a pot of water on the stove, boiled 15 dumplings, and quickly smashed two cucumbers, mixing them with minced garlic, vinegar, and sesame oil. She set the dumplings and cold dish on the table—simple, but satisfying. After clearing the table, she sat at her desk and opened Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance to read Chapter 3 for the online book club at the end of the month. She read for over 20 minutes. The chapter about how doctors face medical uncertainty touched her deeply. She used a highlighter to underline several sentences she resonated with and wrote brief annotations.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Organize the first draft of responses to the paper revision comments.
description: After reading, Yu Xiao switched gears, opened the laptop, and began organizing the revised manuscript based on the morning discussion with Teacher Li. She created a new Word document, listed the follow-up data from the past two years that needed to be supplemented one by one by patient ID, and annotated the specific fields to be extracted. For the statistical methods that needed adjustment, she marked the revision ideas and formula basis in red next to them, laying the foundation for subsequent revisions.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Reviewed neurology and coordinated Sunday arrangements
description: Closing the thesis document, Yu Xiao took out her thick neurology review notes and focused on tackling the chapter “Treatment Principles for Cerebrovascular Diseases.” She spent 40 minutes silently reading while sorting out the differences in treatment pathways for ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke on scratch paper, focusing on memorizing the rationale for selecting different treatment options and the medication time window. After the review, she sent the illustrated guide to People's Park she had made in the afternoon to the family group chat and @-mentioned her parents. Her brother quickly replied with a thumbs-up sticker. Then she sent a voice message to her best friend Zhang Jing: “Sunday's park plan is unchanged—see you at 10 a.m. at the east gate of People's Park!” Zhang Jing quickly replied “OK,” and everything was set.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Evening hygiene and bedtime routine
description: After finishing the online communication, Yu Xiao went to the bathroom to wash up. She cleansed her face carefully with facial cleanser, then applied toner and moisturizing lotion. Because the heated room in the hospital had made her skin a bit dry, she applied an extra layer of moisturizing cream tonight. After washing up, she sat cross-legged on the bed, closed her eyes, and did 10 minutes of mindful breathing, focusing on the breath at her nostrils and the rise and fall of her abdomen with each inhale and exhale, letting stray thoughts drift past, and finally felt very calm and relaxed. Then she opened the grid-pattern journal by her bedside and briefly wrote down today’s thoughts and feelings: “Mom’s dumplings are a healing remedy. Today I prepared for Sunday’s park trip. Looking forward to it.” Then she turned to the Sunday page and made a checklist of items to bring for the outing with her mother: a thermos cup, a sun hat, a portable folding stool, blood pressure medication, small snacks, and wet wipes. Closing the journal, she went to the living room, lightly organized the backpack she would use tomorrow, plugged in her phone, draped tomorrow’s clothes over a chair, turned off the main light, and left only a warm yellow bedside lamp on. Once everything was ready, she turned off the bedside lamp and lay down. Sleepiness came almost as soon as her head touched the pillow, and she quickly fell into a deep sleep, storing up energy for tomorrow’s studies and Sunday’s family day.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Morning jog along the Dongfeng Canal
description: I woke up naturally in the early morning and first did 10 minutes of morning stretching on the balcony. The weather was cloudy and cool. After changing into sportswear, I walked to the Dongfeng Canal Greenway near my home and jogged about 3 kilometers along the river. The canal water sparkled in the morning light, and the air on the tree-lined path was fresh. After running, I felt relaxed in both body and mind, injecting vitality into the day.
location: Dongfeng Canal Greenway, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (Huayuan Road to Jingsan Road section) and the balcony of the home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road

name: Take a shower, prepare and enjoy a healthy breakfast.
description: After returning from running, she took a shower to relax. To fulfill her promise to her mother, she took pre-cooked sweet corn, whole wheat bread, and eggs out of the refrigerator, quickly made a vegetable salad sandwich with a dressing of yogurt and lemon juice, and heated up milk. Her mother, Li Xiuying, walked over from the neighboring community at 8:10. The two ate and chatted at the dining table. Her mother was full of praise for the homemade healthy breakfast, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Accompanied mother to visit Zijingshan Park and taught her to use mobile payments.
description: After breakfast, she took a taxi with her mother to the south gate of Zijingshan Park, about a 15-minute ride. Once inside, she walked arm in arm with her mother along the lakeside path, pointing out the octagonal pavilion in the center of the lake. Her mother showed interest in the women dancing folk dances in the square, and Yu Xiaowen encouraged her to try. When they stopped at the park kiosk to buy water, she patiently taught her mother to use WeChat's QR code payment. Her mother was very happy after successfully paying. The whole morning was filled with family happiness.
location: Inside Zijingshan Park, at the intersection of Jinshui Road and Zijingshan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Go home to prepare a light lunch and take a nap.
description: Took a taxi from the south gate of the park back to Qunying Community. Considering that her mother needed to control blood sugar, the two prepared a low-fat lunch together: Yu Xiaowen cut fruits and vegetables and made vinaigrette, while her mother helped wash strawberries and lettuce. After lunch, she settled her mother for a nap on the sofa and returned to her bedroom to rest for half an hour to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Had a video call with a childhood friend.
description: At 1 p.m., childhood friend Wang Lina started a video call. From far away in Shenzhen, she asked about Yu Xiaowen's recent situation, and Zhang Jing also shared interesting things from class. Yu Xiaowen told them about her plan to hike Mount Song tomorrow, and Wang Lina mentioned that she was going to Tanglang Mountain on the weekend. The three agreed to share their outdoor experiences again next week. The call was relaxed and pleasant, relieving the usual stress.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tidying up the house and taking mother home
description: After the video call ended, her mother, having woken from her nap, wanted to go home to call her father. Yu Xiaowen walked her mother downstairs and watched her head to the neighboring residential complex. Then she returned home alone, washed the dishes, and tidied up the living room to keep the home neat.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and mother's residence (neighboring community).

name: Prepare supplies for the next day's hike to Mount Song and confirm the plan
description: Take out hiking shoes and quick-dry clothes, check the Band-Aids and iodine cotton swabs in the first-aid kit in the backpack; go to the Qunying Road grain and oil shop at the entrance of the community to buy energy bars and sports drinks; after returning home, pack everything neatly. Then send a WeChat message to Sun Yue to confirm meeting at the gate of Zijingshan Park at 7 a.m. tomorrow, share the Shaoshi Mountain hiking route map, and find the old knee pads for backup according to the reminder. Finally, soak lemon water to relax, browse photos of Songshan Mountain scenery, and feel full of expectation for the next day's trip.
location: Home in Qunying Xiaoqu, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road

name: Bathing and changing clothes to prepare for the evening concert
description: To make the evening even more perfect, take a hot bath in advance. Change into a pre-ironed French floral dress, pair it with nude flats, apply sunscreen, and brush the hair smooth, completing the transformation from casual to elegant.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Took a taxi to Henan Art Center to meet a friend
description: Before 6 p.m., she took a taxi from the entrance of Qunying Community to Zhengdong New District, chatting with Zhang Jing on the phone along the way. About 20 minutes later, she arrived at the entrance of the concert hall at Henan Art Center. She and Zhang Jing, who was equally elegantly dressed, complimented each other's outfits and entered together.
location: Concert Hall Entrance, Henan Art Center, West 6th Street, Inner Ring Business Road, Zhengdong New District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Enjoy a Tchaikovsky symphony concert together.
description: Shortly after taking their seats, the conductor came on stage, and the Swan Lake suite began. Yu Xiaowen closed her eyes and immersed herself in the power of the live performance. During intermission, she shared her feelings with Zhang Jing, marveling at how different live music was from headphones, and they agreed to pay more attention to performances at the art center in the future. After the show, they took a group photo under the glass curtain wall as a memento.
location: Concert Hall of Henan Art Center, West 6th Street, Inner Business Ring Road, Zhengdong New District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Take a taxi back home
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Jing at the entrance of the art center, they each took a taxi. The night breeze was cool; sitting in the car, Yu Xiaowen savored the beautiful melodies of the concert and felt peaceful.
location: From the entrance of Henan Art Center, West 6th Street, Inner Business Ring Road, Zhengdong New District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District

name: Evening stretching, hiking backpack check, and bedtime preparation
description: After getting home, first did 10 minutes of stretching to relax the muscles from the whole day. Then opened the backpack again and checked the next day's hiking supplies: hiking shoes, quick-dry clothes, water bottle, energy bars, sun hat, sunscreen, first-aid kit, and knee pads, confirming everything was ready. Then completed the evening skincare routine, set the alarm for 6:00, and charged the phone. Before bed, flipped through a few pages of "Still Walking," feeling the calmness in the book, and turned off the light at 22:30, falling asleep with fulfillment and anticipation.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Getting up in the early morning and heading to the meeting point.
description: At 6 AM, sunlight spilled into the room through the curtains. You quickly got up, washed your face with cold water to wake up, put on a quick-dry T-shirt, a hardshell jacket, hiking pants, and high-top hiking boots, and checked your backpack once more: sports drink, mineral water, energy bars, beef jerky, first-aid kit, power bank, sunscreen, sun hat, and knee pads. After drinking some warm water, at 6:30 you locked the door with your backpack on, ordered a ride-hailing car on your phone, and arrived at the East Gate of Zijingshan Park at 6:42, about 12 minutes later. After paying the fare, you walked quickly toward the assembly point under the “Walker Outdoor” flag.
location: From Room 202, Unit 3, Building 6, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to the East Gate Square of Zijingshan Park, Guancheng Hui District.

name: Gather and take a coach to Mount Song.
description: At the east gate plaza of Zijingshan Park, you saw your friend Sun Yue, wearing a bright orange soft-shell jacket, waving at you. She handed you a sports drink and confirmed that she had brought her knee pads, and you took a happy selfie. At exactly 7 o'clock, after the team leader counted the people, the group of 30 boarded the bus bound for Dengfeng. The bus drove onto the Zheng-Shao Expressway, and the team leader explained today's route over the microphone: starting from Songyang Academy, passing through Laojun Cave and Zhongyue Xinggong, then summiting Junji Peak, with an elevation gain of about 800 meters and an estimated time of 6-7 hours. You listened carefully, exchanged a few words with Sun Yue, and felt both nervous and expectant about the 'Sky Ladder' section, listening to music and enjoying the scenery outside the window.
location: East Gate Square of Zijingshan Park, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and the bus to Dengfeng City

name: Initial section of the Mount Song hiking challenge
description: At 9 a.m., the bus arrived at the Songyang Academy parking lot. After a group photo, they started hiking. At first it was gentle stone steps with ancient trees towering on both sides; you and Sun Yue chatted and laughed. After entering Zhongyue Palace, the stone steps became steep, and the continuous climb left you short of breath and with sore calves, so you leaned on the railing to catch your breath. Sun Yue handed you a trekking pole and encouraged you to go at your own pace. You took the pole, adjusted your breathing, and continued with its support.
location: Songshan Scenic Area, Dengfeng, Henan Province (trail from Songyang Academy parking lot to Zhongyue Palace)

name: Lunch break and rest on the platform
description: At 11:40 a.m., the group stopped to rest on a flat viewing platform with a wide view. You found a flat rock to sit on and took out a sandwich, an apple, and beef jerky. Sun Yue also took out a lunchbox, and the two of you shared the food. The mountain breeze carried the fresh scent of grass and trees, and in the distance the outline of Dengfeng's urban area was visible. You rubbed your aching calves, enjoyed the soothing mountain breeze, and thought you had to reach the summit.
location: Observation deck along the trail of the Mount Song Scenic Area, Dengfeng, Henan Province (about 1.5 km from Junji Peak)

name: Sprint to the summit of Junji Peak.
description: At 12:30 you set off again. The last section was the ultimate test of physical strength and willpower. Clutching the iron chains with both hands, you gritted your teeth and climbed the nearly vertical 'Heavenly Ladder' stone steps. Each step was accompanied by heavy breathing, and sweat soaked your T-shirt. Sun Yue kept encouraging you from behind: 'Almost there!' 'Can you see the light at the top of the mountain?' At 13:10, you crossed the last step, and a stone tablet inscribed with 'Junji Peak, Elevation 1492.0m' proclaimed a successful summit.
location: Mount Song Scenic Area, Dengfeng City, Henan Province (section from Zhongyue Palace to Junji Peak Sky Ladder)

name: Summit photos and reflections.
description: At the summit, the sea of clouds churned and the Yellow River looked like a golden ribbon. You asked Sun Yue to take a back-view photo of you spreading your arms to embrace the mountain wind, then walked to the cliff edge and shouted into the valley to release months of stress. You took out your notebook, wrote down "expand boundaries," and resolved to take on more life peaks in the future.
location: Summit of Junji Peak, Songshan Scenic Area, Dengfeng City, Henan Province

name: Descend the mountain and return to the parking lot
description: At 2 p.m., you started down the mountain. The pressure on your knees was obvious, but thanks to the knee pads and trekking poles, it was not a problem. You chatted with Sun Yue as you walked, and you agreed to go hiking once a month from now on. At 15:45, the whole team returned safely to the Songyang Academy parking lot, and you fell asleep as soon as you got on the bus.
location: Mount Song Scenic Area, Dengfeng City, Henan Province (Junji Peak to Songyang Academy parking lot)

name: Returning to Zhengzhou by coach.
description: The coach smoothly got onto the return expressway, and you slept deeply. At exactly 18:00, the coach arrived on time at the east gate of Zijingshan Park. Sun Yue gently woke you, and in your daze you felt sore all over.
location: From the parking lot of Songshan Scenic Area, Dengfeng City, Henan Province to the East Gate of Zijingshan Park, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City

name: Shared dinner after returning from hiking
description: After getting off, you and Sun Yue were starving, so you walked into the busy "Gansu Lanzhou Lamian Noodle Restaurant (Zijingshan Branch)" opposite the north gate of the park and each ordered a large bowl of beef lamian with extra beef and an egg. The two of you slurped the noodles and talked cheerfully about hiking anecdotes, feeling enormously satisfied. When you finished, you asked enthusiastically, "Which mountain should we climb next?" Sun Yue readily agreed to go back and do some research.
location: Gansu Lanzhou Lamian Noodle Restaurant (Zijingshan Branch), No. 97-4 Jinshui Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return home for evening relaxation and rest
description: At 18:50, she said goodbye to Sun Yue, took a taxi, and returned home to Qunying Residential Complex in about 15 minutes. She boiled water to soak her feet, and the soreness eased. Around 20:00, she sat at her desk and sent the summit photos Sun Yue had taken to her parents in Luoyang and her older brother in Shenzhen. The family chat group blew up; her parents told her to rest, and her brother sent a big thumbs-up. She also sent the photos to her close friends' group chat and received envious replies. Then she wrote a hiking reflection in her phone's memo: "Climbing a mountain is like life — only by persevering can you see the most beautiful scenery. From now on, hike outdoors at least once a month." At 20:15, she got up, took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and stretched her front thighs and back calves on the yoga mat. Though it was sore, she knew it was beneficial. After drinking warm water, she lay in bed at 21:10. She read a few pages of Still Walking, felt sleepy, closed the book, turned off the light, and recalling the fullness of the day, fell asleep with a smile.
location: Room 202, Unit 3, Building 6, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning Recovery and Stretching
description: At 06:30 the alarm went off. Yu Xiaowen felt her calves were even sorer than yesterday and, remembering yesterday's summit of Mount Song and her mother's advice, she stayed in bed a little longer to feel her body. Then she got up despite the soreness and started targeted recovery stretching on the yoga mat in the living room. Holding a chair, she did lunge stretches, feeling the stretch in the back of her calves, then used a towel hooked around her toes to statically stretch the back of her thighs. After 20 minutes, the muscle tightness eased, laying a good foundation for a day of standing work.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Quick nutritious breakfast
description: Yu Xiaowen opened the refrigerator and took out the eggs and soy milk she had prepared the night before. She fried a sunny-side-up egg with whole-wheat bread and warmed the soy milk. While eating, she browsed the department group messages and confirmed there were no urgent notices. A simple and efficient way to refuel.
location: Kitchen at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Getting ready and commuting
description: She took a warm shower and changed into a breathable T-shirt and athletic pants to relieve pressure on her legs. She checked the stethoscope, pen, and notebook in the pockets of her white coat. She wheeled out her electric bike and set off. The morning sunlight broke through the clouds, and the roses in the community were in full bloom. She deliberately slowed down to feel the city waking up. When she passed the Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop at No. 14-10 Qunying Road, she went in and bought a bowl of freshly cooked millet porridge to bring to her colleague Wang Fang, who was on the night shift. Then she continued riding to Zhengzhou Central Hospital.
location: Start from Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province; pass by Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop at 14-10 Qunying Road; and finally arrive at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Arrive at the hospital and prepare
description: After arriving at the hospital, she swiped her card to enter the inpatient building. She first went to the duty room and quietly placed the millet porridge on Wang Fang's desk while Wang Fang was sorting medical records, noticing that Wang Fang had dark circles under her eyes. Then she changed into her white coat, turned on the computer, and quickly skimmed the medical records she was responsible for that day, focusing on the previous day's nursing records and temperature changes of a patient in the recovery period of cerebral infarction, in preparation for ward rounds.
location: Doctors' Office and Duty Room, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Monday morning meeting shift handover
description: All medical staff in the department attended the morning meeting. The on-duty doctor, Wang Fang, reported on the overnight ward situation, focusing on a patient with a hypertensive crisis she had admitted through the emergency department. Yu Xiaowen listened and noted handover items related to the patients she was responsible for, while mentally sorting out the key points for ward rounds. The teaching supervisor Li Wei was also present.
location: Doctors' office/conference room, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Attending physician rounds and medical record handling
description: Followed Teacher Li Wei on the daily ward round. In the cardiovascular and cerebrovascular ward, focused on a patient recovering from cerebral infarction. The teacher asked about the patient's standing training from yesterday, and Yu Xiaowen observed and recorded changes in muscle strength. Li Wei noticed that she walked with a slight limp and joked asking whether she had gone mountain climbing again. She nodded sheepishly, and the teacher encouraged her to observe this patient's rehabilitation progress more. After the ward round, returned to the office, adjusted medical orders based on the results, handled new examination forms, organized medical records for newly admitted patients, and checked diagnosis and treatment records and lab test sheets.
location: Inpatient wards and doctors' offices, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Cafeteria lunch and an unexpected encounter
description: During the lunch break she went to the cafeteria. While queuing, she ran into Dr. Chen Mingyuan from the Department of Stomatology. Yu Xiaowen greeted him first, and the two sat down together with their trays. Dr. Chen talked about cases linking periodontal disease and diabetes. She thought of her father's rehabilitation needing comprehensive health management, so she asked a few more questions about the effects of inflammation on the cardiovascular system. They hit it off, exchanged WeChat contacts, and agreed to share cutting-edge literature with each other in the future.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital cafeteria, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and career exploration
description: After returning to the doctors' office, Yu Xiaowen turned on her computer and searched the database for "rehabilitation medicine". She browsed review articles on "rehabilitation engineering" and "neurorehabilitation", especially the application of brain-computer interfaces in rehabilitation. She wrote down three keywords in her notebook: "rehabilitation, technology, humanities". Then she set a 25-minute alarm and took a nap on her desk. Although she did not sleep deeply, she felt better after resting with her eyes closed.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon paperwork and mentoring
description: In the afternoon, she continued writing the discharge summary. Teacher Li Wei passed by and casually asked about the optimal timing for rehabilitation intervention for Xiao Qiu's infarct size. Yu Xiaowen pulled up the imaging and, combining it with her morning observations, answered fluently about the importance of early rehabilitation and the precautions. The teacher nodded with satisfaction and reminded her to pay attention to the newly introduced isokinetic muscle strength testing equipment in the rehabilitation department, saying she might have a chance to rotate and learn there in the future.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Preparation and confirmation before leaving work
description: After handling the last doctor's order, her phone vibrated. Zhao Ming, her college roommate, sent a WeChat message saying he had arrived in Zhengzhou and wanted to have dinner the next day. Yu Xiaowen happily replied and agreed to meet at a Hunan restaurant next to the hospital at 7, craving their chopped pepper fish head. She then tidied her desk and organized the materials she would need the next day.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-work commute and shopping
description: Rode the e-bike home, stopped on the way at the Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop at 14-10 Qunying Road, bought two fresh tomatoes and a bunch of scallions. The auntie recommended local muskmelons, and she picked one. Then continued riding back to her home in Qunying Community.
location: From Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, via Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, to Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Simple dinner
description: After getting home, she washed her hands, boiled water, and cooked noodles. She used tomatoes and eggs to make a soup base, added half a jin of dried noodles, and sprinkled scallions on top. After eating a steaming bowl of noodles, her body warmed up, and much of the soreness in her legs seemed to disappear.
location: Kitchen at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Evening rest and replies.
description: While eating muskmelon, she scrolled through her phone. She received a WeChat message from her friend Sun Yue asking if her leg was feeling better and sending photos of Mount Song. Yu Xiaowen replied, "Lying flat at home to recover," and selected a few of the hiking photos she had organized to show her, agreeing to go together next time.
location: Sofa in the living room at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Organizing climbing records
description: Sitting in front of the computer in the study, she opened the photo album on her phone to organize yesterday's photos of Mount Song, from the departure group photo to the rest photo at Zhongyue Palace and the panoramic sea of clouds at the summit. After carefully selecting 9 photos and adjusting the color temperature, she posted on WeChat Moments: 'The body is in hell, the eyes are in heaven. #OneMountainAWeek# #BackFromMountSong#' She soon received likes and comments from colleagues and friends.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Preparing for the attending physician exam
description: Switch to test mode, take out the Anki cards, and review the arrhythmia section of the cardiovascular system. My state was good; I went through 30 cards in 45 minutes and gave extra review to several easily confused distinguishing points.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Washing up and skincare.
description: Enjoying a relaxing time, soaking feet in hot water to promote blood circulation and relieve sore legs, then doing the evening skincare routine: removing makeup, cleansing, applying a hydrating mask, listening to soothing classical music, and feeling the skin being nourished.
location: Home bathroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Record in journal
description: After finishing the face mask, she took out her notebook and wrote down the date and weather with a fountain pen. She recorded the inspiration from encountering Dr. Chen today, Teacher Li's encouragement, and the career reflections brought by 'rehabilitation medicine.' She listed tomorrow's to-dos: 1. Leave time for dinner with Zhao Ming; 2. Continue reviewing the digestive system flashcards; 3. Call Mom.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and bedtime
description: She changed into pajamas and did a 10-minute yoga relaxation routine in the living room, stretching her legs and back. She turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp on, and read two chapters of Junichi Watanabe's Still Walking, absorbing the father-son relationship and life insights in the text. After lying down, she closed her eyes and reflected on the oral health issues Dr. Chen had mentioned, her father's rehabilitation, and the future of rehabilitation medicine, feeling fulfilled. Then she got up, hung out the clothes she would wear the next day, placed her commute bag on the shoe cabinet by the door, and checked the electric bike key. When everything was in order, she turned off the light, listened to the insects chirping outside the window, adjusted her sleeping position, and fell asleep.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Late-night bedtime and early-morning awakening
description: She did not fall asleep until shortly after midnight. At 6:40 a.m., the alarm went off right on time, and sunlight from outside was already streaming through the gap in the curtains, announcing another sunny, hot day. When she woke up, she felt lingering soreness in her calves and shoulders from yesterday's hike on Mount Song. She did a few simple stretches in bed to loosen up, in preparation for her morning exercise later.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Gentle morning exercise at Zhuchunyuan Park.
description: Given the fatigue from yesterday's mountain hike, she did not do high-intensity running. Instead, she chose to jog a few laps in Zhuchunyuan Park, enjoying the cool morning air, and focused on a 15-minute stretch of her calves and hips to help relieve muscle soreness. Then she sat on a park bench, checked last night's sleep data and today's weather on her phone, confirmed the high was 31, and planned to drink more water today.
location: Zhuchun Garden Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Went home, took a shower, and had a simple breakfast
description: After walking home from the park, I took a quick shower to wash off the light sweat from my morning exercise. Breakfast was simple: two slices of whole-wheat toast, toasted and spread with peanut butter, along with a cup of warm soy milk. While eating, I sent a greeting sticker in the family WeChat group and replied to the good-morning voice message from my best friend Zhang Jing.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Took the metro to work.
description: She checked her commuter bag again to make sure she had brought her water bottle and a light sun-protection jacket. After locking the door, she walked 10 minutes to Jingsan Road Station on Metro Line 5, took the metro for 15 minutes (4 stops) to Central Hospital Station, and then walked another 5 minutes after exiting, arriving at the hospital at 08:10. The sun was not scorching but already a bit dazzling; she planned the day's priorities as she walked.
location: Zhengzhou Metro Line 5, Henan Province (Jingsan Road Station to Central Hospital Station)

name: Attend the department's morning shift handover meeting
description: Arrived at the department at 8:10 and changed into a white coat. The morning meeting was led by Head Nurse Wu Min. The night-shift colleague reported the overnight conditions of newly admitted patients and critically ill patients. Yu Xiaowen took careful notes, focusing on a newly admitted cerebral infarction patient.
location: Rehabilitation Department Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (2nd Floor, Building 3)

name: Morning ward rounds and medical record work
description: After the morning meeting, she followed Dr. Li Wei on regular ward rounds, focusing on the muscle strength assessment and rehabilitation plan for the stroke patient in Bed 15. After rounds, she returned to the office and began independently handling medical records for several regular patients, including writing a physical therapy prescription for a patient with chronic low back pain and recording in detail the changes in his condition. During a break, she remembered yesterday's conversation with Dr. Chen Mingyuan and noted the potential link between oral health and rehabilitation in her phone's memo.
location: Rehabilitation Department ward (Building 3, Floors 3-5) and office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Cafeteria lunch and chatting with colleagues
description: At lunchtime, she met Wang Fang and Wu Min in the cafeteria and ordered tomato and egg noodles and a cold dish. Wang Fang enthusiastically shared her plans for next week's baking class. Although Yu Xiaowen was not very interested in making cakes, she listened patiently and occasionally responded. Wu Min talked about the training of the new nurses in the department, and the atmosphere was relaxed. Meanwhile, Yu Xiaowen had the evening's class reunion on her mind, thinking she should be more efficient in the afternoon.
location: Staff Canteen of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (1st Floor, Building 2)

name: Efficient work in the afternoon
description: After lunch, she did not take a nap and went straight back to the office to start on the afternoon's work. She focused on organizing the morning ward-round records, revising medical orders, and began completing some pending tasks ahead of time to leave enough time for the evening dinner appointment. During work, she received a WeChat message from Zhao Ming: 'I've arrived in Zhengzhou. See you at 7 p.m.?' She quickly replied, 'It's a date!' A smile unconsciously crept across her lips, and then she continued working.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (Building 3, Floor 2)

name: Wrap up work and prepare to change clothes.
description: She efficiently completed the remaining medical records writing and patient communication, and sent a checklist of tomorrow's to-dos to Teacher Li Wei. Around 16:45, she finished in advance all the work that could be done ahead of time, then went to the duty room, took out the clean shirt she had prepared, changed into it, and tidied up in front of the mirror to make herself look refreshed.
location: Office (Building 3, 2nd Floor) and duty room of the Rehabilitation Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: After-work decompression and a relaxing walk.
description: After changing out of her work uniform, she didn't go straight to the appointment, but took a leisurely walk on Tongbai Road near the hospital. She put on her earphones, played her favorite light music, and enjoyed the rare relaxed time after work, adjusting her state of mind. She also bought a bottle of water at a convenience store on the way.
location: Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (streets around the hospital)

name: Taking the subway to the Hunan restaurant.
description: After half an hour of walking, she checked her phone and saw that it was about time, so she walked to Central Hospital Station on Metro Line 5, took the metro four stops (about 12 minutes) to the Second Municipal People's Hospital Station, walked 8 minutes after exiting the station, and arrived at Xiangtuqing Restaurant at 18:35.
location: Zhengzhou Metro Line 5, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (from Central Hospital Station to Second People's Hospital Station)

name: Have a dinner gathering and a good chat with old classmate Zhao Ming
description: The two sat down in a Hunan restaurant. Zhao Ming ordered his favorite chopped chili fish head, and Yu Xiaowen ordered stir-fried yellow beef. During the meal, Zhao Ming excitedly shared what he had seen and heard in the rehabilitation department in Shenzhen, especially the newly introduced lower-limb rehabilitation robot and AI gait analysis system. Yu Xiaowen listened intently. Thinking of her father's monotonous rehabilitation training and her own tactile experience in pottery, she blurted out: “Rehabilitation shouldn't be cold and impersonal. If we combine the idea of art therapy and add a sense of design, would patients be more motivated?” Zhao Ming was stunned, then slapped the table in admiration. The more they talked, the more they clicked, discussing everything from technology to the “humanistic warmth” of rehabilitation medicine. They only left reluctantly after the restaurant staff reminded them that it was closing time.
location: Xiangtuqing Restaurant, 2nd Floor, Jintaicheng Plaza, Intersection of Huaihe Road and Jingguang Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Take the subway, walk home, and share her mood
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Ming, she walked to the subway station, took Metro Line 5, got off at Jingsan Road Station, and walked 10 minutes home. The night breeze was cool, dispelling the heat of the day. She took out her phone and took a night photo of the street under the streetlight, adding the caption “Tonight’s conversation felt like opening a window to a new world,” and posted it as a WeChat Moments entry visible only to herself, as a memento of the evening.
location: Metro Line 5 in Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (from the Second People's Hospital Station to Jingsan Road Station) and the surrounding streets

name: After returning home, I took a shower to relax
description: After getting home, she first drank a large glass of water, then took a comfortable hot shower to wash away the day's fatigue. She changed into comfortable loungewear and prepared to enter tonight's "recharging" mode.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Late-night diary and literature exploration
description: She sat down at her desk, opened her diary, and solemnly wrote down three keywords: “rehabilitation + technology + humanities,” and drew connecting lines around them. She opened her laptop and began searching for literature on “art therapy rehabilitation.” To her surprise and delight, she found successful cases abroad of using pottery in hand-function rehabilitation. Excitedly, she saved the relevant papers and webpage screenshots and decided to discuss this new idea with Teacher Li Wei at work the next day.
location: Study, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep review and exam preparation notes
description: Lying in bed, she couldn't settle down for a long time, with Zhao Ming's words and her own inspiration replaying in her mind. She sat up, opened the Anki cards she was using to prepare for the attending physician exam, and wrote firmly on the blank back: 'rehabilitation robots, art intervention, Dad's recovery,' followed by a question mark: 'My next step?' After organizing her thoughts, she gradually drifted off to sleep before midnight, excited and looking forward to the new direction.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning stretching and light breakfast.
description: The morning alarm went off. Yu Xiaowen canceled her planned morning run and chose to start the day gently. She laid out a yoga mat on the balcony and focused on completing a 15-minute Baduanjin stretching routine. Then, in the kitchen, she toasted whole-wheat bread, fried a soft-yolk egg, and paired them with homemade soy milk, playing Mozart's string quartet as music accompanied breakfast. After the meal, she carefully checked her backpack, making sure she had her notebook, red and black pens, power bank, and other work items, and looked forward to the robot demonstration she was about to observe.
location: Room 503, Unit 3, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting and buying fruit on the way.
description: Yu Xiaowen pushed her electric bike downstairs. At the Qunying Road grain and oil store by the community entrance, she picked a bunch of bananas and four Red Fuji apples to bring to her parents. Then she turned from Qunying Road onto Tongbai North Road, wore her helmet, rode for about 15 minutes to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, and parked the electric bike in the staff bike shed.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop (14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province) to Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Arrive at work early and confirm with the department
description: After changing into her white coat, Yu Xiaowen first went to the department bulletin board to confirm the time and place of the "Lower Limb Rehabilitation Robot Demonstration" notice, then returned to the office, opened the computer, and reviewed the shift handover patient list, marking the bed numbers of patients in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction to make preliminary preparations for the morning's work.
location: Neurology Department office and hallway bulletin board, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Department morning meeting and shift handover.
description: The morning meeting started on time, and the night shift doctor reported on newly admitted and key patients. Yu Xiaowen focused on recording the muscle strength plateau information of a 73-year-old patient in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction. Dr. Li Wei suggested that the patient's lower limb proprioception needed to be assessed. Director Zhang Lei commented on the standardization of medical record writing, and Head Nurse Wu Min reminded that the rehabilitation treatment room might have its passageway occupied by equipment demonstrations. All on-duty medical staff attended the handover.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Neurology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Accompany the preceptor on ward rounds
description: After the morning meeting, Yu Xiaowen immediately followed Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds, focusing on a 73-year-old patient with cerebral infarction surnamed Wang. Under the teacher's guidance, she assessed muscle strength, muscle tone, and balance function, and noted that the patient could sit alone but needed assistance to stand. She thought of the afternoon robot demonstration and wrote in the medical record that the possibility of lower-limb exoskeleton-assisted standing training could be evaluated, and efficiently handled 5 inpatient orders and 2 progress notes.
location: Neurology Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Observe the lower-limb rehabilitation robot demonstration.
description: After rounds, Yu Xiaowen grabbed her notebook and arrived at the rehabilitation treatment room 10 minutes early to watch the manufacturer's engineer do final debugging. When the demonstration began, the engineer explained in detail how to put on the lower-limb exoskeleton robot, the operation interface, and the safety strap fixation (three-point locking at the hip, knee, and ankle), and demonstrated how to set gait parameters (stride length 35 cm, cadence 80 steps/min, adaptive assist mode) and switch among the three training modes: passive, active, and resistance. Yu Xiaowen squeezed into the front row and recorded key parameters in red pen (real-time gait adaptive algorithm, automatic emergency stop when joint angle exceeds limit by 15 degrees, indications for Brunnstrom stage III and above), and also used her phone to shoot short videos of the gait trajectory and the emergency stop test.
location: Rehabilitation Treatment Room, 3rd Floor, Outpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Discussed clinical applications with the preceptor.
description: After the demonstration, Yu Xiaowen found Teacher Li Wei in the rest area and excitedly shared her observations, proposing that the adaptive assist mode was valuable for early neural remodeling in stroke patients, and envisioning adding different tactile textures to the foot pedals to speed up the recovery of gait symmetry. Teacher Li Wei affirmed her thinking, pointed out that the robot is more suitable for patients with muscle strength above grade 3, and suggested that Yu Xiaowen consider the rotation opportunity in the hospital's rehabilitation department. She solemnly said she would give it serious consideration.
location: Rest area of the Neurology Department doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Cafeteria lunch and online sharing
description: After the discussion ended, Yu Xiaowen went alone to the staff cafeteria and ordered a bowl of braised beef noodles and a soft-yolk fried egg. While eating, she sent the robot demo photos and videos she had taken that morning to her friend Wang Fang, who was on leave, via WeChat, along with a voice message sharing her excitement, and received an encouraging reply from Wang Fang. After the meal, she rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Organize morning notes and electronic documents
description: After the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen returned to the office, created a new Word document titled "2025_05_21 Lower-Limb Rehabilitation Robot Demonstration Notes," and systematically entered the key parameters, technical points, discussion insights with Teacher Li Wei, and her own thoughts on combining art therapy and tactile feedback from her paper notes, then sent it to her personal email for backup.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Neurology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon ward work and clinical preceptorship
description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen continued to follow Li Wei, her teacher, to check the remaining wards, handled two newly admitted patients' medical records and admission notes, and took the initiative to write a discharge summary, carefully checking lab reports and medical orders. Around 16:00, after finishing her current work, she went to the nurse station.
location: Neurology ward and doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Ask the head nurse for advice on communication skills
description: Taking advantage of a brief lull at the nurse station, Yu Xiaowen asked Head Nurse Wu Min for advice on how to communicate with patients and promote rehabilitation robots when introducing them into clinical practice. Wu Min shared her experience: first let patients' families understand the principles and benefits, use videos to show the results, and find patients who have used it with good results to share their own experiences, turning the cold machine into a helper of hope. Yu Xiaowen listened carefully and said she had learned important soft skills.
location: Nursing Station, Department of Neurology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Organizing shared documents and preparing for shift handover
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowen sent the electronic presentation notes to her mentor Li Wei via the hospital intranet email, briefly reporting the afternoon's work and what she had gained from consulting the head nurse. She then checked the shift handover records and confirmed that the day's work had been completed smoothly with no omissions.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Neurology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting home from work and buying dried radish along the way
description: Yu Xiaowen left work on time, got her electric bike from the bicycle shed, rode to the grain and oil store on Qunying Road, and exchanged the fruit she had bought that morning for a bag of the owner's homemade pickled dried radish, intending to bring it to her mother.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store (No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province)

name: Visiting her parents and sharing rehabilitation experiences
description: Yu Xiaowen rode about 12 minutes from the grain and oil shop to Compound A6, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, where her parents were renting. After entering, she excitedly played a robot demonstration video. Her father, Yu Jianguo, put on reading glasses and watched carefully, then marveled at the high technology but worried about the cost. Yu Xiaowen helped her father do standing exercises in the living room and massaged the quadriceps and triceps surae muscles of both his legs as taught by Teacher Li Wei. Her mother brought out freshly steamed fennel and pork buns, and the family of three ate and chatted about what they had seen at the rehabilitation center and daily trivia, in a warm atmosphere.
location: Room 206, Building 3, Courtyard No. 6A, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Return to the accommodation and rest for a while
description: After saying goodbye to her parents, Yu Xiaowen rode her electric bike south along Huayuan Road and turned onto Qunying Road, arriving home in Qunying Community around 20:00. She changed into comfortable home clothes, plugged her phone in to charge, drank a large glass of warm water, and rested on the sofa for about 15 minutes, reflecting on the conversation with her father and Teacher Li's advice.
location: Room 503, Unit 3, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

My first independent data analysis was completed successfully and was recognized by Teacher Li, which greatly boosted my career confidence! In the evening I glazed the little horse and little rabbit, looking forward to them coming out of the kiln. Review for the attending physician exam is going well. Good night."

location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She stretched her slightly sore and stiff shoulders, changed into exercise clothes, and went to the balcony. Outside the window, the sky was faintly lit, and the air held the freshness after a passing rain shower. She focused on completing a full set of Baduanjin, and between deep breaths felt her body's vitality gradually awaken, injecting energy into the new day.

location: Bathroom and kitchen at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

After the coordination succeeded, she immediately sent a voice message in the family group: “Done! I’ll be with you all day tomorrow to make zongzi!” Her mother quickly replied with a happy smiley face. Afterward, she attended the morning meeting and listened carefully to the reports on the newly admitted patients from the previous day.

I'll try to finish this afternoon's work in the morning as much as possible.' Dr. Li Wei flipped through the medical records in his hand and nodded in agreement: 'OK, go ahead. Don't neglect your current work. By the way, I read your data analysis from yesterday. It was well done. The hospital's youth forum deadline is next month. You can start thinking about an abstract; don't waste this good material.' Yu Xiaowen nodded seriously and agreed.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Then she began ward rounds. She patiently checked the rehabilitation progress of a patient who had suffered a stroke and guided him through seated balance training. After the ward rounds, she returned to her office and focused on processing medical orders and writing the initial admission records and daily progress notes for newly admitted patients, ensuring she could finish the main work by noon and leave time for the afternoon intensive class.
location: Rehabilitation Medicine Department, Inpatient Division, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Wang Fang said: "I know Director Zhao is giving the main lecture this afternoon. He's especially experienced in the part on craniocerebral injury, so I'll definitely have to borrow your notes." Yu Xiaowen smiled and replied: "Let's complement each other and get all the key points."
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital staff cafeteria, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

After waking up, she took out her notebook, highlighters, and lecture handouts, briefly reviewed the outline of the afternoon course, and marked several chapters in which she was relatively weak, fully preparing for the lecture.

Dr. Zhao, a senior chief physician in neurology, began the lecture on time. The course was compact and covered core test points such as "Rehabilitation Assessment of Traumatic Brain Injury" and "Management of Spinal Cord Injury Complications." Dr. Zhao lectured with clear logic and interspersed clinical cases. Yu Xiaowen was fully focused and kept writing, marking key points in red and adding her own understanding in blue, filling five pages of notes. There was a break midway, but she hardly left her seat.

description: After the course, Yu Xiaowen immediately got together with Wang Fang to exchange notes. Yu Xiaowen found that she had missed a detail about “indications for intermittent catheterization in neurogenic bladder,” while Wang Fang filled in one of her vague records. Huang Ya, a colleague from the adjacent department, also joined in. The three had a brief but lively discussion about the rehabilitation plan for a difficult case mentioned by Teacher Zhao, until they each had to return to their posts.
location: Corridor of the training classroom, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She quickly checked the computer system, confirmed that there were no urgent new medical orders in the afternoon, and verbally handed over the precautions for several of her patients to the duty nurse, ensuring a smooth transition of work.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

On the way, she called her mother: 'Mom, I'm off work now. I'm coming to pick you up, I'll be there in about twenty minutes.' Her mother's cheerful voice came through the phone: 'No rush, no rush. I just changed my shoes and I'll wait for you downstairs!'
location: Zhengzhou, Henan Province: drove from Zhengzhou Central Hospital to Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District

The market was fresh and had a wide variety of goods. Her mother skillfully moved between the stalls, selecting large, tough fresh reed leaves for zongzi, smelling the fragrance of round glutinous rice, and also buying bright red candied dates, plump red beans, and a bundle of white cotton thread. Yu Xiaowen followed behind her mother, learning to pick mugwort by imitating her. Her mother taught her: “Pick leaves that are thick and have a fresh, grassy smell.” She also bought a few kinds of seasonal vegetables and fruits. The whole shopping trip was filled with the warm, lively atmosphere of an approaching festival.
location: Jingba Road Seafood and Farmers' Market, No. 11-1 Jingba Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Her mother began rinsing the glutinous rice, while Yu Xiaowen was responsible for soaking the bamboo leaves in clean water. Her mother suggested, "We've had a tiring day too, so let's keep it simple tonight and just cook some noodles." Yu Xiaowen readily agreed. She quickly cooked two steaming bowls of tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried some greens. Mother and daughter sat facing each other at the small dining table, eating noodles while talking about the specific plan for wrapping zongzi the next day. Her mother couldn't stop smiling.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She answered and set the phone on the tea table, and her mother came over to join. On the screen, Yu Xiaofeng asked about their father's rehabilitation and his sister's exam preparation progress. Yu Xiaowen said that their father was walking much better in his hometown and that this afternoon's attending physician shift had been quite rewarding. Her mother cheerfully turned the camera toward the soaked glutinous rice and reed leaves in the kitchen, showing off the day's spoils. Yu Xiaofeng said enviously, "Remember to send more photos and videos to the group tomorrow, so I can celebrate the festival virtually!" The three chatted for nearly an hour, with peals of laughter.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: After hanging up the video call, Yu Xiaowen composed herself and sat down at her desk. She took out the notes from the afternoon intensive class and the book Better. She didn't start right away, but first flipped through the book for over ten minutes to calm herself down from the excitement of the conversation. Then she opened her laptop and used mind-mapping software to organize the core knowledge points Teacher Zhao had taught that day—such as "assessment methods for consciousness disorders after traumatic brain injury"—by levels and key points, and highlighted the points she often confused.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

Back in the bedroom, she took out a massage ball, lay down on the bed, and slowly rolled the ball around her shoulder blades and along both sides of her spine to ease the muscle fatigue from long periods of listening to lectures and working at a desk.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

She closed her eyes, letting the gentle melody fill the room as her thoughts gradually drifted away. In the music, she happily went over tomorrow's plan in her mind: going to the market with her parents to buy fresh meat, red dates... and then making rice dumplings together... As she thought about this, the corners of her mouth curled up unconsciously.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

She did a simple pre-sleep stretch, then turned off the light and adjusted her sleeping position. Carrying the fulfillment of today's enriching on-the-job learning and the warm anticipation of tomorrow's family reunion, she soon fell into a peaceful sleep.

Afterward, she wiped off her sweat with a towel and, refreshed and clear-headed, prepared to welcome the Dragon Boat Festival.
location: Balcony, Room 503, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

The fragrant scent of mugwort filled the hallway. She then warmed the soy milk she had scheduled the night before, toasted two slices of multigrain bread, and enjoyed a simple, nutritious breakfast with her mother's oil-preserved cherry tomatoes.

She marked key data with a highlighter and wrote quick memory mnemonics in the margins.
location: Study, Room 503, Building 3, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Next she helped wash the zongzi leaves, rinse the glutinous rice, and chop the candied dates and red dates, while her father watched and smilingly instructed that the leaves should be broad and the rice should be drained thoroughly.

Her father wheeled over in his wheelchair and taught her hand by hand, emphasizing the key points of folding the corner, pressing the rice, and tying a slipknot. With her father's patient guidance and her mother's help, she gradually got the hang of it. The three chatted and laughed, recalling fun Dragon Boat Festival stories from her father's youth in his hometown in Luoyang, and in the end they made more than 30 plump zongzi filled with honey dates, red beans, and peanuts.

After the meal, Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to clear the dishes, let her mother take a nap, refilled hot water for her father, and chatted with him about interesting things at the hospital.
location: Dining room at parents' home, Room 201, Building 1, No. 151 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan
