description: After ward rounds, Yu Xiaowen returned to the doctor workstation and quickly entered the medical orders that needed adjustment, including adjusting insulin dosage for a patient with high blood sugar and issuing examination orders. She set her phone to vibrate and waited for her mother's message. Soon the phone vibrated. She opened the video her mother had sent: her father, holding a four-legged walker in the rehabilitation department corridor, took more than ten trembling steps with the encouragement of the therapist and her mother, his eyes full of hope. Yu Xiaowen's eyes welled up, her heart pounded, and she immediately forwarded it to her older brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen, with the message: “Dad is amazing!!”.
location: Doctor Workstation, Inpatient Department of Internal Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning clinical work and paper progress
description: Her excitement quickly turned into work motivation. Yu Xiaowen admitted a newly hospitalized patient with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, took a detailed history, performed a physical examination, and wrote initial medical orders. Then, using spare moments, she opened the medical literature folder on her laptop, continued refining the methods section of her paper, adjusted the statistical method description based on Teacher Li Wei's suggestions, and added details about patient informed consent, making her thinking clearer.
location: Inpatient Department of Internal Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Had a video call with family during the lunch break.
description: During the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen heated up her packed lunch (sliced pork stir-fried with green peppers and multigrain rice) in the microwave in the doctors' lounge, and while eating, she called her mother on video. Her father and mother appeared on the screen. Beaming, she praised her father for today's progress. Her father said sheepishly, 'It's still very slow, but it counts as a good start.' Her mother agreed, and the family shared a warm moment. After hanging up, she played soft music on the sofa in the lounge and did a five-minute neck-and-shoulder relaxation routine to relieve the soreness in her neck and shoulders.
location: Doctor's lounge, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work and paper writing
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to her workstation early, organized the afternoon work list, and noted that she needed to contact Dr. Li of the Rehabilitation Department to confirm a visit time on Wednesday. In the afternoon, she handled more than a dozen medical records awaiting signature, explained in detail the post-discharge medication and rehabilitation plan to the patients being discharged the next day and their families, and communicated with head nurse Wu Min about the nursing priorities for newly admitted patients. At 4 p.m., she set aside half an hour to polish the literature review in the introduction of her paper and added two latest citations.
location: Inpatient Department of Internal Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Shift handover and next-day arrangements
description: Near the end of her shift, Yu Xiaowen organized all the medical records and orders, and gave a detailed verbal handover to the night-shift doctor Wang Fang, focusing on the condition of Uncle Zhang in Bed 25 and the newly admitted COPD patient. After confirming everything was correct, she signed off and told Wang Fang that at noon tomorrow she would visit Dr. Li in the rehabilitation department with her colleague Sun Yue.
location: Doctor's office, Internal Medicine Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Drove to buy groceries and returned home
description: Yu Xiaowen took off her white coat and changed back into casual clothes, drove away from the hospital, and stopped by Lao Zhou’s grain and oil shop on Qunying Road on the way. She greeted the owner, Lao Zhou, warmly, bought tomatoes, baby bok choy, soft tofu, and whole wheat flour, planning to make dinner. After shopping, she walked about 4 minutes along the familiar sidewalk back to her home in Qunying Community.

name: Dinner at home and relaxation
description: When she got home, Yu Xiaowen changed into comfortable loungewear, drank some water, and sat on the sofa. She repeatedly watched her father's rehabilitation videos and listened carefully to her mother's words of encouragement. Deeply moved, she replied to her brother in the family group chat. Then she cheerfully prepared dinner: using chicken broth as the base, she added crescent-shaped tomato chunks and soft tofu cubes to make tomato tofu soup, and stir-fried baby bok choy with garlic. The dinner was simple and healthy. While eating, she played 'My Own Swordsman' on her tablet and enjoyed a relaxing moment.
location: At home, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Video-called parents to encourage them
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen called her parents again via video, making a point of asking her father to sit in front of the phone. She sincerely encouraged him: today was only the first step; he should make a little progress every day, like a child just learning to walk, and the whole family would always support him. She also said she would consult Dr. Li from the rehabilitation department the next day to find a more suitable approach. Her father's eyes glistened with tears and his smile grew brighter, while her mother nodded repeatedly. The family talked for half an hour, feeling the warmth of home.
location: Living room at home, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Evening financial management and expense records
description: After the video call ended, Yu Xiaowen went into the study, opened her laptop, and logged into online banking. Following the advice of financial advisor Wang Mingyuan, she set up automatic investment of 1,000 yuan each into two hybrid funds and transferred the remaining 5,000 yuan into a 30-day short-term wealth management product; the system prompted that interest would accrue starting tomorrow. After completing the operations, she took out her financial planning notebook, wrote down today's date with a pen, recalculated her demand deposit, short-term wealth management balance, the market value of the two funds, and the total automatic investment, and added a note: “June allocation completed; because of my father's recovery, I need to keep an eye on next month's medical reserve fund.” The whole process strengthened her sense of financial control.
location: Home study, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening leisure time
description: After finishing her financial matters, Yu Xiaowen finally had time entirely to herself. She lay on the bean bag chair in the living room and played classical music. During that time, her best friend Zhang Jing called, and the two discussed preparations for the weekend birthday party. They joked with each other and agreed to confirm the details at noon the next day. After hanging up, she picked up "The Art of Ceramic Making" and flipped through it for inspiration for her next visit to the pottery studio.
location: At home, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Washing up and nighttime care
description: Feeling tired, Yu Xiaowen got up to do her nighttime skincare routine. In the bathroom, she carefully washed her face, applied a face mask, and put on serum, completing her skincare regimen. Then she used a fascia ball to roll over her shoulders, neck, and calf muscles to relieve the muscle tightness from sitting at work all day.
location: Home bathroom, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: After changing into her pajamas, Yu Xiaowen leaned against the headboard, turned on the bedside lamp, read the chapter on doctor-patient communication in Better, and took brief notes. Then she turned off the ceiling light, left only the aromatherapy lamp on, sat cross-legged on the bed, and did a fifteen-minute mindful breathing practice, focusing on the flow of breath and letting the day's emotions drift by like clouds, her mind gradually calming.
location: Home bedroom, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Preparing for sleep and falling asleep
description: After finishing meditation, Yu Xiaowen set her phone to airplane mode and placed it on the nightstand. Thinking back on today's fulfilling and meaningful day, she smiled, turned off the light, and quickly fell into a deep sleep in the dark and quiet.
location: Home bedroom, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

description: The alarm went off. Yu Xiaowen felt heavy and, still tired from last night's insomnia, opened the curtains to find a cloudy, humid day outside. She drank warm water to try to wake up, then persisted in following a 7-minute Baduanjin video on her phone in the living room, moving her shoulders and neck until her body warmed up slightly. Afterward, she quickly washed up and did her skincare routine, heated milk, and toasted whole wheat bread with peanut butter for breakfast. While eating, she opened the DXY app to browse the latest medication guidelines for cardiology, focusing on dosage standards for antihypertensive drugs.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Walk to work
description: Yu Xiaowen put on lightweight canvas shoes and walked from Qunying Community to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. She chose a path through Zhuchunyuan Park, breathing in the fresh air of the park to relax her tense nerves.

For elderly patients with unstable blood pressure, she repeatedly confirmed the antihypertensive dosage, determined to be extra focused.
location: Doctor's Office, Inpatient Department of Internal Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

location: Internal Medicine Teaching Room, 3rd Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Li Wei, who was beside her, reminded her in time; she immediately corrected it and apologized. Dr. Li said earnestly, "You must concentrate fully when writing orders—a tiny mistake can have serious consequences. Haven't you been sleeping well lately?" Yu Xiaowen nodded with mixed feelings and resolved to improve her sleep.

In between, she found time to send a WeChat message to her colleague Sun Yue to arrange to meet at noon.
location: Doctor's Office and Wards, Internal Medicine Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Yu Xiaowen and Sun Yue found Dr. Li in the rehabilitation department on time for a detailed consultation on the follow-up rehabilitation plan for her father Yu Jianguo. Dr. Li analyzed the video of her father walking, suggested increasing lower-limb weight-bearing and balance training, and recommended a simple walker suitable for home use. Yu Xiaowen took careful notes and recorded the key suggestions.

She then leaned back on the sofa and rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes, followed by 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching exercises to loosen up her cervical spine and shoulders.
location: Internal Medicine rest area, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She patiently took the patient's medical history, ordered tests, and soothed her anxiety. During this time, she also discussed the puzzling symptoms of their respective patients with Wang Fang.
location: Doctor's Office and Wards, Internal Medicine Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Just before getting off work, Yu Xiaowen went to the nurse station to pick up medical records and met Head Nurse Wu Min. She gathered her courage to ask about sleep problems. Wu Min gently shared the “4-7-8 breathing technique” she often used (inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 7 seconds, exhale for 8 seconds), and led her through it on the spot. She patted her on the shoulder and encouraged her not to keep the bowstring too tight—only with a healthy body and mind can she work better.

name: Work wrap-up and shift handover before leaving.

location: Doctor's Office, Inpatient Department of Internal Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

It was an overcast day, and the park was sparsely populated, with the fresh scent of soil in the air. She walked along the lakeside path, took photos, and sent them to the family group chat with the message, "It's going to rain, everyone, please add some clothes." She then sat on a bench and cleared her mind for a few minutes. name: Prepared and enjoyed a healthy dinner
description: After returning home, she changed into loungewear, made vegetable tomato soup with tomatoes, enoki mushrooms, and spinach, pan-fried low-fat chicken breast, and enjoyed a healthy, light dinner while listening to Bandari piano music playing on her phone.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with parents to share rehabilitation consultation
description: After dinner, she started a WeChat video call with her parents, sharing what she had learned from the rehabilitation department consultation and playing Dr. Li's voice suggestions. Her father, Yu Jianguo, was glad that he could walk more steadily, and her mother, Li Xiuying, noticed that she looked tired and told her not to overdo it. Yu Xiaowen felt warm inside and reassured her mother that she would go to bed early.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Seeing a WeChat message from her best friend Zhang Jing, she called her back. The two finalized the venue, menu, cake style, and number of guests for next weekend's birthday party. Yu Xiaowen also confided in her about the mistakes she had made at work during the day, and Zhang Jing comforted her and told her to relax.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Took a hot shower, blow-dried her hair, and finished her skincare routine. She drew the bedroom curtains, turned off the main light and left only the warm yellow bedside lamp on to create a sleep-inducing atmosphere, set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, and set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Practice mindful breathing meditation
description: Sitting cross-legged on the bed, she opened the “Tide” app and selected a 10-minute basic meditation. Putting on her earphones, she followed the guided instructions and focused her attention on her breath. Although her thoughts occasionally drifted away, she gently brought her attention back to each inhale and exhale. After 10 minutes, she felt the tension in her chest had eased considerably.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Fall asleep and rest
description: After meditating, she took a few deep, long breaths and slowly lay flat. Her mind was no longer as anxious as the previous night; she felt that she had taken the first step toward change today, and finally fell into a peaceful sleep before 23:40.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: In the early morning, I again made a written error in a medical order and was caught by the head nurse.
description: At 3 a.m., a patient's temperature rose. When Yu Xiaowen was writing a temporary medical order, due to several days of sleep deprivation and late-night fatigue, she again made a clerical error, mistakenly writing the commonly used antibiotic as twice the adult dose. Wu Min, the nurse manager on duty, noticed it immediately while checking and gently reminded her: 'Xiaowen, take another look at the dose?' Yu Xiaowen woke up instantly, cold sweat on her back. With Wu Min's help, she corrected the order, avoiding a potential medical risk.
location: Nurse Station, 6th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Reflected alone in the duty room
description: After the slip-of-the-pen incident, Yu Xiaowen returned to the duty room, filled with self-blame and lingering fear. She opened the notes app on her phone and typed, “I almost made a huge mistake. I can't let this go on.” Then she did another round of 4-7-8 breathing to calm herself, admonishing herself to stay absolutely focused for the remaining time.
location: On-duty Room, 6th Floor, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Continued the night shift and organized the handover records.
description: After a rough late night, Yu Xiaowen did not dare let her guard down in the slightest. She stayed highly alert, checking the ward every half hour and closely monitoring the condition of the key patients. At 6 a.m., she went through all medical orders one by one and began organizing the shift handover records, ensuring a clear and complete briefing for the next shift.
location: 6th Floor, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning handover and end of shift.
description: At 8 a.m., the day shift colleague arrived on time. Yu Xiaowen gave a detailed report on the night shift, focusing on how the patient with a fever in the early morning was treated and the adjusted medication plan. After the handover, she said goodbye to her night shift colleague and headed home exhausted to catch up on sleep.
location: Doctors' office, 6th floor, inpatient building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Wake up, wash up, and cook noodles to recharge
description: The alarm rang, and Yu Xiaowen struggled to sit up in bed, still feeling heavy. She first went to the kitchen and drank a glass of warm water, then washed up briefly. While boiling water, she took out eggs and a bundle of dried noodles from the refrigerator, cooked herself a bowl of plain noodle soup, and added a little sesame oil and chopped scallions. While eating, she checked the weather forecast on her phone: thundershowers, with lightning at night. She silently planned her afternoon schedule in her mind.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Check parking fee and get ready to go out.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowen opened the "Zhengzhou Parking" app on her phone to check the overtime parking fee incurred in the underground parking lot of the Central Hospital yesterday, confirmed that the order status was "Paid", and felt relieved. Then she changed into a clean dark blue T-shirt and light gray casual pants, and slung on a canvas bag containing an umbrella, a journal, and a power bank.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Rode a shared bike to the hospital.
description: Yu Xiaowen walked out of the residential compound carrying a black long-handled umbrella. Considering there would be scattered showers in the afternoon and she needed to work the night shift, she decided not to drive, scanned and rented a shared bike, and rode about 10 minutes to the hospital. On the way, raindrops began to fall sporadically, and she was glad she had brought her umbrella.
location: Along the route from Qunying Road, Jinshui District to Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Preoperative preparation and initial paperwork.
description: After arriving at the department, Yu Xiaowen first changed into her white coat, opened the computer system, and, before the afternoon work began, quickly handled some routine paperwork: she completed the initial progress note for a pneumonia patient admitted that morning and reviewed the final medical orders for two patients to be discharged later that day.
location: Doctors' office, 6th floor, inpatient building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Had an open and honest conversation with supervising teacher Li Wei
description: Yu Xiaowen took a deep breath and knocked on the door of her mentor Li Wei's office. She honestly recounted the clerical error caused by exhaustion in the early morning and how head nurse Wu Min had reminded her in time, admitting that it stemmed from the psychological stress of her father's recovery and the lack of sleep due to consecutive night shifts. Instead of making excuses, she sincerely asked for advice on how to adjust. After a moment of silence, Li Wei affirmed her proactive attitude in communicating, shared tips he had used during night shifts in his younger days, and reminded her that there was zero tolerance for errors in the job, and that she could raise it if she couldn't handle it. This conversation made Yu Xiaowen feel cared for and supported, and the pressure inside her was somewhat relieved.
location: Office of Teacher Li Wei, 6th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Adjust mindset and practice the 4-7-8 breathing method
description: After the conversation with Teacher Li, Yu Xiaowen returned to her workstation, but her heart was still not completely calm. She walked to the empty window at the end of the corridor and began practicing the 4-7-8 breathing technique: inhale through the nose for 4 seconds, hold the breath for 7 seconds, then exhale slowly through the mouth for 8 seconds. After repeating it four or five times, her heartbeat gradually calmed down and most of her anxiety faded away. Then she returned to the office and neatly wrote in her journal, “I almost made a big mistake. I can't go on like this.” and drew an exclamation mark beside it as a self-warning.
location: By the window at the end of the corridor on the 6th floor of the inpatient department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

She ordered a medium iced Americano at the Starbucks on the first floor of the plaza, sat down by the window, and enjoyed buffer time that belonged entirely to herself.
location: Starbucks Coffee, 1st Floor, Xiyuan Plaza, intersection of Tongbai Road and Zhongyuan Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Since walking would be too far, she went back to the hospital parking lot to get her car and drove about 20 minutes to Zhuchunyuan Park. The greenery in the park looked especially vibrant after being washed by the rain. She walked two laps along the circular trail, enjoying the tranquility after the rain. When she saw a stray cat licking water droplets off a lotus leaf, she took a photo and sent it to the family group chat. Her mother quickly replied with praise, which made her feel even happier.
location: Zhuchun Garden Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store at 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community

name: Prepared a light dinner and relaxed.

She connected her phone to a Bluetooth speaker, played Schubert's Trout Quintet, and focused on preparing the ingredients amid the classical music, enjoying the tranquility of cooking. The dinner was simple and healthy.
location: Kitchen, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

In her mind, she silently reviewed her afternoon conversation with Teacher Li and her feelings about the breathing exercises, and encouraged herself: 'Tonight, I am a blank slate. Focus on every medical order, every patient, and perform double checks. You can do this.'
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

When she arrived at the hospital gate, seeing the emergency building brightly lit, she was ready to face the challenge.
location: Along the route from Qunying Road, Jinshui District to Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

After taking over the shift, she reviewed the nursing records and latest vital signs of each patient under her care, confirmed that all patients were stable, and prepared for the night's work.
location: 6th Floor, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Around 1 AM, feeling drowsy, she got up and walked around the duty room, washed her face, and did a round of 4-7-8 breathing. At the same time, she opened the Tide app on her phone and completed a 10-minute mindful breathing exercise, letting her thoughts completely settle down to stay alert.
location: Doctor's office and on-call room, 6th floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove home after the night shift handover
description: At the neurology department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen completed the morning handover after the night shift. Meanwhile, she played Debussy's piano pieces through her phone's Bluetooth speaker as background music, immersed in the quiet atmosphere.

Next to "Reflection on Typos" I added a note: "Besides fatigue, is there an attention allocation problem? I could try the Pomodoro Technique." Then I confirmed in my calendar the appointment with Teacher Li Wei at 4 p.m. tomorrow (June 20), feeling fulfilled and looking forward to it.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

description: Set the alarm for 6:30 the next day. Remembering the introduction to a new clay body she had seen on a pottery WeChat official account, she decided to invite her friend Su Ya to go look at it together next time. She turned off the bedside lamp and went to bed an hour earlier than usual to make up for the sleep she had been missing recently, saving energy for the meeting with her advisor and the busy day ahead.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning activities: Baduanjin, breakfast, and a call with my mother.
description: In the early morning it was cloudy with a gentle breeze. Yu Xiaowen got up after the alarm rang, put on loose cotton loungewear, and walked to the balcony. She opened the Tide app and followed the guide to complete a 7-minute Baduanjin session. During the last two movements, "Two Hands Hold the Feet to Strengthen the Kidneys and Waist" and "Seven Shakes Behind the Back to Cure All Illnesses," she felt her neck and shoulders loosen and her breathing deepen. After finishing, she took a deep breath by the window for a minute, and the tightness caused by her canker sore eased somewhat. Then she went to the dining room and made a simple breakfast with milk, instant oatmeal, and red-fleshed dragon fruit. While eating, she left a voice message on WeChat to her mother to let her know she was safe. Her mother quickly replied, reminding her to eat more vegetables and avoid getting overheated, and mentioned that her father was doing well in rehabilitation training, in a relaxed tone. After the chat, her mood became calmer.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 9, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She rode along Tongbai North Road, turned onto Jianshe West Road, passing a lush green street park with a gentle breeze on her face, and arrived at her destination in about 8 minutes.

name: Salon perm consultation and shopping, then home
description: After arriving at the Suxin Styling chain hair salon, Yu Xiaowen first had her hair washed, then had a detailed discussion with Sister Chen, a female hairstylist in her early thirties with a neat and capable look. Xiaowen explained that her hair was fine and soft, that she needed a style that was easy to manage while wearing a white coat, and that her face was relatively round. Sister Chen suggested a collarbone-length short haircut with naturally slightly curled ends and showed her photos of the finished style. Xiaowen was very satisfied and booked an appointment on the spot for a perm at 10 a.m. Saturday. Sister Chen reminded her to wash her hair the night before the perm and not to use conditioner. During the conversation, they also discussed daily hair care and quick blow-drying tips suitable for the medical profession. After leaving the salon, Xiaowen stopped at a fruit shop at the intersection of Jianshe West Road and Tongbai North Road, bought 4 fresh peaches, then rode her electric scooter home and put the fruit in the refrigerator.
location: Suxin Styling Hair Salon, 1st Floor, No. 128 Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and the fruit shop at the intersection of Jianshe West Road and Tongbai North Road

name: Tidying up the house and changing the bedding
description: At home, Yu Xiaowen used a vacuum cleaner to clean the dust from the living room floor, then removed the duvet cover and pillowcases from the bedroom and replaced them with a clean sky-blue cotton four-piece bedding set. She folded and sorted the old sheets she had taken off, ready to wash them later. Then she watered the pothos on the windowsill. Looking at the refreshed bedroom, she felt brighter.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 9, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch of homemade tomato and egg dragon-beard noodles
description: Yu Xiaowen took out dragon whisker noodles, tomatoes, eggs, and lettuce from the fridge. She cut the tomatoes into chunks and stir-fried them in oil until they broke down into a sauce, added water and seasonings, and brought it to a boil. Then she put in the noodles, poured in beaten egg, and finally added the lettuce leaves, cooking it into a bowl of tomato-egg dragon whisker noodle soup. Before eating, she took a photo and sent it to the family group chat; her mother liked it and commented, 'Well-balanced nutrition.' After the meal, she washed the dishes and chopsticks and put them away to dry.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 9, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and professional reading
description: Yu Xiaowen leaned on the living room sofa, opened the surgery section of Better, and read carefully for about 30 minutes. She highlighted the passage 'When doctors face burnout, how to rebuild connection with patients through concrete actions' and wrote in pencil beside it: 'I can use this perspective when talking to her.' After reading, she set an alarm for 13:00, closed her eyes, and took a 20-minute nap.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 9, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Preparing before the interview and free relaxation.
description: Yu Xiaowen took a black-covered notebook out of the drawer, flipped to the concern list she had written in Luoyang last night, and reorganized and prioritized it by importance: how to balance her own emotions and work stress during her father's recovery; how to adjust the self-blame after the night-shift clerical error; and her entanglement between her interest in rehabilitation medicine and her current department. She wrote her thoughts and questions after each item. Then she washed her face and confirmed that her phone and bus card were with her. In the following time, she rested freely, leaned on the sofa and browsed the hospital's internal system on her phone to confirm there were no urgent notifications, and also watched a few videos on wheel-throwing techniques pushed by a pottery WeChat official account to relax.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 9, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Going to the hospital for a career discussion with Teacher Li Wei
description: Yu Xiaowen put on a clean light blue shirt and a thin knit cardigan, checked the notes saved on her phone, then rode her electric scooter south along Tongbai North Road to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. She swiped her employee card to enter the hospital campus, parked her scooter in the employee bicycle shed, and at the elevator entrance on the first floor of the outpatient building ran into Head Nurse Wu Min and exchanged a brief greeting. She arrived at the corridor outside the fourth-floor demonstration room 15 minutes early and sat on the bench outside to review the key points in her notebook again, when Ward Nurse Xiao Zhao passed by and greeted her. Teacher Li Wei opened the door, let her into the demonstration room, and poured her a glass of water. Yu Xiaowen candidly described her recent situation: after her father's cerebral infarction, the family had moved from Luoyang to Zhengzhou, and she was commuting between the two cities every week; last month, she made a clerical error while writing records during her night shift, which made her blame herself; she also mentioned her interest in rehabilitation medicine and her wavering about transferring departments. Teacher Li did not evaluate her directly but used sticky notes to break it down for her: the attending physician exam is in the second half of the year, so putting it aside now would mean giving up the accumulation; her father's rehabilitation should be stable for at least another two months before further discussion; and the transfer procedure could be calmly advanced after the exam. Finally, he said: "You have always been very capable. Hold your ground first." Yu Xiaowen accepted the suggestion and wrote in her notebook: "Postpone the decision to transfer departments, and prioritize exam preparation and family care." After the talk, she stood for half a minute at the window at the end of the corridor, watching patients' family members in the garden downstairs push wheelchairs as they walked.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Returning home after the interview and contacting friends
description: Yu Xiaowen rode her electric scooter from the hospital back home, passing the familiar Jingxiang Huimian Restaurant on the way but not going in. After arriving home, she changed out of her shirt into a comfortable off-white home outfit, drank a glass of warm water, then opened WeChat, found her friend Zhang Jing, and asked whether she was free that evening, saying that she really wanted to see that Japanese movie and suggesting they meet at 7 p.m. at the CGV cinema on Jingsan Road. Zhang Jing quickly replied that she had been just about to ask her, that great minds think alike, and that she would see her at seven, and sent a hugging emoji.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 9, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and movie ticket confirmation.
description: Yu Xiaowen used the leftover tomato and egg soup from lunch to cook half a bowl of white rice as a simple dinner. While eating, she opened the ticketing app and confirmed that the 7:00 showing at CGV Cinema in Zhenghong City still had tickets available, but she did not buy in advance. After the meal, she took the washed sheets out of the washing machine and hung them on the balcony drying rack, and washed some grapes to eat while watching the movie in the evening.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 9, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Rest and simple makeup before the movie screening
description: The afternoon sunlight slanted into the living room, no longer so hot. Yu Xiaowen lay on the sofa for a while, then opened her phone to watch a video on wheel-throwing techniques pushed by a pottery WeChat official account. Then she went to the bathroom, washed her face, and applied makeup primer and a light dusty rose lip gloss to look more radiant. She put the washed grapes into a fresh-keeping bag and got ready to go out.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 9, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Cycled to Zhenghong City to meet Zhang Jing and buy snacks.
description: Yu Xiaowen changed into white canvas shoes, put on earphones, and rode her electric scooter north along Jingsan Road before turning onto Huayuan Road. The evening breeze was pleasantly cool. After riding for about 10 minutes, she saw the big sign for Zhenghong City and parked at the entrance. She sent a message to Zhang Jing saying she had arrived at the entrance. Zhang Jing jogged over from the subway exit, and the two high-fived when they met. Zhang Jing said that seeing the trailer on the crowded subway made her look forward to it even more. Xiaowen suggested buying popcorn and milk tea; Zhang Jing offered to pay, and Xiaowen promised to treat her to late-night snacks after the movie ended. In the end, they bought a large bucket of caramel popcorn and two cups of cheese-capped jasmine tea.
location: Lobby of CGV Cinema, Zhenghong City, No. 126 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Watched a Japanese healing movie.
description: Yu Xiaowen and Zhang Jing watched a Japanese healing film in Hall 5 of CGV Cinema at Zhenghong City. The film told the story of an elderly man living alone and a stray dog relying on each other in the countryside. The images were clean and delicate, with both laughter and tears. When the old man applied medicine to the dog and the dog waited for its owner in the snow, Yu Xiaowen quietly wiped away tears twice. Zhang Jing noticed, gently held her hand, and said nothing, but that moment felt reassuring. After the film ended, they waited until the end-credits song finished and the lights came on before standing up.
location: Hall 5, CGV Cinemas, Zhenghong City, No. 126 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening walk and late-night chat with Zhang Jing
description: Walking out of the cinema, the shops on both sides of Huayuan Road were brightly lit, and Yu Xiaowen and Zhang Jing strolled slowly along the street. Zhang Jing took the initiative to ask about recent events. Xiaowen told her about the outcome of the afternoon meeting with Professor Li Wei and her decision to postpone the department transfer, and also mentioned that her mouth ulcer was still painful that day. Zhang Jing did not give a lengthy analysis but simply said, "Xiaowen, I'll take you out for a walk this weekend. Don't keep yourself so tense. How about going to the science museum or having a picnic in a park?" That remark struck a chord with Xiaowen, and she nodded in agreement. The two said goodbye at the entrance of Qunying Community, and Zhang Jing said she would see her next week.
location: Along the route from Huayuan Road to Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 9, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

After changing into pajamas, she did a simple 5-minute stretch on the yoga mat, focusing on relaxing her lower back, which was sore from sitting for a long time. Then she turned off the main light, lit a lavender aromatherapy candle, lay down in bed, opened the Tide app, and chose "Breath Anchor" for a 10-minute meditation. Following the guided voice, breathing in and out, the distracting thoughts from the day's interview and the evening's movie slowly quieted down. She changed her Saturday morning alarm from 7:30 to 8:00 and reviewed the rhythm of the day in her mind: haircut, interview, movie, late-night chat—every moment felt like a steady step. Thinking that her father was recovering steadily and that she had a new hairstyle, the tension that had been tight all month finally loosened, and she closed her eyes peacefully.
location: Room 402, Unit 3, Building 9, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: At 6 a.m., she was woken by the crisp sound of birdsong outside the window, feeling that the mouth ulcer had completely healed and she was full of energy. After a quick wash, she put the sheets changed last night into the washing machine, set the quick wash and delay functions, so that they could be hung out to dry when she got home in the afternoon. location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province
