description: After going downstairs, she got into her car. Driving north along Jingsan Road, she turned onto Huayuan Road, with smooth traffic all the way. When she passed the newly opened flagship store of “Fang Zhongshan Spicy Soup,” she stopped on purpose to pack two beef spicy soups and a serving of fried dough cake, wanting to surprise her parents. The whole trip took about 20 minutes, and she arrived at the “Haixing Garden” community near the intersection of Huayuan Road and Nongye Road at 7:00.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province; Haixing Garden Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Early-morning rehabilitation walk and family companionship
description: After parking the car, she carried the piping-hot spicy soup upstairs. Her mother opened the door and said with a smile, "I knew you'd be thinking of your dad's favorite taste." Her father was already in the living room, moving his arms and legs while holding on to a walker. Xiaowen put down the soup, briskly brought out the wheelchair from the storage room, prepared warm water, and hung her father's water cup on the armrest of the wheelchair. At 7:20, the three of them went to the central garden in the residential complex. Her father walked slowly with the walker, while Xiaowen gently called out the rhythm "left, right" and protected his elbows with her hands, helping him adjust his center of gravity. Her mother followed a little behind, ready to hand over a towel or steady the wheelchair. After walking for about 30 minutes, her father sat down on a bench to rest. Xiaowen massaged his leg muscles and moved his ankles. Then she helped her father back home.
location: Central Garden, Haixing Garden Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning Baduanjin
description: After helping her father back home, Xiaowen walked alone to the balcony, where the view was open and she could see the green trees in the garden downstairs. After drinking a glass of warm water on an empty stomach, she opened the Tide app and followed the guide to complete seven minutes of Baduanjin. "Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner," "Drawing the Bow Left and Right Like Shooting an Eagle"... She stretched as fully as possible in every movement, feeling her whole body's muscles and bones awaken.
location: Balcony, Haixing Garden Residential Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Breakfast was the spicy soup and fried dough cakes Xiaowen brought, plus the millet porridge and boiled eggs her mother had made early. A steaming breakfast filled the table. Her father tasted the spicy soup and said with a smile that it tasted authentic, and Xiaowen felt very satisfied. As she ate, she listened to her parents talking about the new community supermarket in the neighborhood and the square-dancing team downstairs.
location: Restaurant in Haixing Garden Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Accompany Mother to the Vegetable Market
description: After breakfast, her mother suggested visiting the Fengle Road Farmers Market outside the south gate of the residential complex to get familiar with the surrounding area. Xiaowen readily agreed and walked out arm in arm with her mother. The market was bustling; her mother skillfully bargained with the vegetable vendors and bought pork ribs, lotus root, greens, and a few lemons. Xiaowen bought two dragon fruits and kiwis, planning to make juice in the afternoon.
location: Fengle Road Farmers' Market, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prepared ingredients and made lunch with her mother.
description: When they returned home, her father was watching the news on the sofa, and Xiaowen and her mother got busy in the kitchen. Her mother handled the pork ribs and lotus root, planning to make lotus root and rib soup. Xiaowen was responsible for washing and cutting vegetables. She cut the green peppers into roll-cut chunks and planned to make a dish of shredded pork with green peppers. The kitchen was filled with clattering sounds and the mixed aroma of food, full of a warm, homely atmosphere.
location: Kitchen, Haixing Garden Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Family lunch and casual chat
description: The family sat around the table enjoying a hearty lunch: lotus root and pork rib soup, shredded pork with green peppers, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and cucumber salad. Mother filled a large bowl of soup for Father and told him to drink more. Xiaowen talked about next week's department duty roster and mentioned that Dr. Li Wei suggested she focus on preparing for the exam first. Father expressed his support: 'Dr. Li is right — take it one step at a time.'
location: Restaurant in Haixing Garden Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Midday nap
description: After dinner, Xiaowen helped clear the dishes, then comfortably leaned back on the living room sofa to rest. Outside the window was the warm afternoon sunshine, and the air conditioning kept the room cool. She picked up her phone to reply to a message from her colleague Wang Fang, then closed her eyes and took a short nap of about 40 minutes.
location: Living room, Haixing Garden Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Received the gift from Liu Yang and expressed gratitude
description: The unit entrance intercom rang; it was the courier. Xiaowen went downstairs to sign for a medium-sized cardboard box. The sender information read "Liu Yang, Nanshan District, Shenzhen." She carried it home, and her parents curiously gathered around. Xiaowen gently cut the tape with scissors, and inside the box was a beautiful kraft paper box. She carefully opened the kraft paper box; inside were neatly arranged two vacuum-packed packages of Cantonese cured sausages and a well-sealed box of the Macau specialty "Koi Kei" golden sand biscuits. Tucked in the gap between the sausages was a folded note. The note said: "Xiaowen, I heard your dad is recovering, so I'm sending some Guangdong specialties for you to try. Don't work too hard; take care of your health. I'm doing well in Shenzhen, don't worry. — Liu Yang." After reading it, Xiaowen felt a warm current in her heart and couldn't help smiling. Then she used her phone to take a photo of her father smiling while holding the sausage box, and also took a group photo of the gifts. She posted it on WeChat Moments: "Concern from afar, thank you, old classmate!" She also sent the photos to the "Yu Family Happiness" family group, and her brother immediately replied with three thumbs-up emojis. She then sent Liu Yang a WeChat message: "I received the gift, what a pleasant surprise! The sausages and biscuits are so tempting, and my dad is especially happy. Thank you! How are you doing in Shenzhen? Busy with work lately?" Liu Yang quickly replied, saying that a project had just been launched, and also asked about her father's recovery. The two chatted for about ten minutes and agreed to meet up next time in Luoyang.
location: Living room, Haixing Garden Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading and enjoying tea with Father on the balcony
description: The sunlight grew softer. Xiaowen and her father sat down in the rattan chairs on the balcony, while her mother went to the bedroom to rest. Xiaowen took out the copy of The Doctor's Progress she had brought, turned to a marked chapter, and began reading. Her father brewed a pot of newly purchased Xinyang Maojian tea. The two sat quietly, and occasionally her father pointed to the pigeons kept by a neighbor in the garden downstairs and said a few words. As she read, Xiaowen silently connected Dr. Li Wei's advice from the interview with the doctor-patient communication cases mentioned in the book.
location: Balcony, Haixing Garden Residential Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Having fruit with her mother and helping in the kitchen
description: Returning from the balcony to the living room, Xiaowen felt a little thirsty, so she washed the red-fleshed dragon fruit and kiwis she had just bought, cut them into pieces in the kitchen, and added some yogurt to make a simple fruit salad. She shared it with her mother, who had woken up. Afterwards, Xiaowen helped her mother pick the spinach they would use for dinner, listening as her mother grumbled about her brother being too busy with work and wondering when he would find a girlfriend.
location: Kitchen, Haixing Garden Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drive back home, shop on the way, and hang bed sheets
description: At 5:30 p.m., Xiaowen said goodbye to her parents, told them to take care of their health, and said she would come to see them again in a couple of days. She went downstairs and drove back. She deliberately took a detour to the familiar “Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store”, used her membership card to buy a box of discounted fresh milk, a tray of eggs, and two bags of whole wheat toast. After arriving home, she immediately took the sheets and duvet covers she had washed in the morning out of the washing machine, shook them flat, and hung them on the balcony clothes rack.
location: Haixing Garden Residential Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province; Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province; Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Dinner and a simple meal
description: After returning home, she felt a little tired and decided to keep dinner simple. She heated up the lotus root and pork rib soup she had brought back from her parents' house at noon, added a handful of dragon beard noodles, and blanched a few baby bok choy leaves. A steaming bowl of pork rib soup noodles warmed her stomach. After the meal, she used the juicer to make a cup of fruit and vegetable juice from the apples and celery in the fridge.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Tidy up the room and personal care
description: After dinner she rested briefly, then began tidying the room. She put away the eggs and milk she had bought and cleared away the sticky notes and receipts that had accumulated on the desk over the week. Then she went into the bathroom, thoroughly washed her hair with the conditioner recommended by the hairdresser when she got her perm last weekend, and applied a hydrating sheet mask. During the 15 minutes while the mask absorbed, she leaned against the headboard and played Debussy's 'Clair de Lune' on her phone in a loop.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Bedtime meditation and journaling.
description: After finishing her sheet mask and basic skincare routine, she turned off the main light, leaving only a bedside lamp on, and sat cross-legged on the yoga mat. She opened the Tide app, selected "10-Minute Breathing Meditation," closed her eyes, and slowly inhaled and exhaled, letting the day's warmth and comfort settle in her heart. After the meditation, she opened her diary and wrote down today's feelings: "I walked with Dad today, and he walked very steadily. I was really happy. Liu Yang's gift was like a warm breeze that blew away the recent fatigue. Spending the weekend together is the best recharging for life. Good night, world."
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Evening relaxation reading and bedtime
description: After finishing her diary, Xiaowen felt a little sleepy. She changed into pajamas, drank a few sips of warm water, set her phone alarm for 7:00 tomorrow morning, then turned off the light and lay down. Although it was not yet 11 o'clock, the fulfilling day left her physically and mentally satisfied, and she soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up, morning exercise, and breakfast
description: The phone alarm rang at 6:15 on the dot. Yu Xiaowen opened her eyes and saw the overcast sky outside the window. She pressed her fingertips against her temples to shake off the fatigue, felt at ease remembering that her father was recovering well, took a deep breath, and got up. Then, wearing her loungewear, she walked to the balcony. Because the day was cloudy and the roads were slippery, she didn't go out for a run. Instead, she did a seven-minute Baduanjin routine, beginning with 'Holding Both Hands Up to Regulate the Triple Burner,' hitting every movement. After the closing posture, she stared blankly at the plane trees downstairs to wake up her body. Then she went back to the living room, took fresh milk and whole-wheat toast out of the refrigerator, toasted the bread, cut up kiwi and strawberries into a fruit salad, and ate breakfast with the milk, taking her iron supplement on time.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Wash up, change clothes, and commute.
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowen quickly washed up, put on the neatly ironed white coat and trousers, and looked in the mirror at the collarbone-length hair she had curled last Saturday. Then she organized her commuter backpack, putting in her medical records notebook, water bottle, pen, and Better. She put on her helmet and mask, rode her electric scooter along Jingsan Road and turned onto Tongbai North Road, arriving at Zhengzhou Central Hospital 10 minutes later.
location: From Qunying Residential Area, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou.

name: Department morning meeting and full-department ward rounds
description: After arriving at the hospital, Yu Xiaowen changed into her white coat in the department changing room, went to the office, exchanged a smile with Wang Fang, quickly skimmed the shift handover records, and prepared for the morning meeting. The departmental morning meeting started promptly at 7:30, and the doctor on duty reported on newly admitted patients and those with changed conditions. After the meeting, Director Zhang Lei led the Monday full-department ward rounds. Xiaowen stayed close to the bedsides of the patients she was responsible for, listening carefully to the director's analysis and instructions, noting key points, and asking questions of Teacher Li Wei.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning ward work.
description: After ward rounds, Yu Xiaowen returned to the doctors' office, first processed the updated medical orders, then sat at the computer to write progress notes, check laboratory reports, and record changes in patients' conditions. During this time, she received a phone call from a patient's family member and patiently explained the adjustments to the rehabilitation plan. Around 10 o'clock, she went to the ward to do admission assessments and health education for a newly admitted patient with cerebral infarction.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Hospital cafeteria lunch and lunch break
description: After the morning work ended, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang went to the staff cafeteria together. They ordered green pepper stir-fried pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and huajuan (steamed twisted rolls), sat by the window and chatted while eating. Wang Fang complained about being tired from overtime, and Xiaowen shared amusing stories about accompanying her father on walks. After the meal, they returned to the teaching classroom. Standing by the window, she did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder exercises to relax. Then she sat down and read "Better" for about 25 minutes, writing annotations about clinical decision-making in the margins. When the 13:00 alarm went off, she closed her eyes and rested for 5 minutes.
location: Staff cafeteria and teaching room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon ward work
description: In the afternoon, I continued filling in the medical progress notes, received the transfer documents for the new patient, carefully studied the condition summary and examination reports, and wrote the handover notes for the next doctor on duty. Around 16:30, I checked the day's medical orders with Wang Fang to make sure they were correct. Before 17:00, I completed the day's handover and confirmed nothing was missed.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: After-work commute, shopping, and resting at home.
description: After finishing the handover, Yu Xiaowen changed out of her white coat, got on her e-bike, and went home. Passing the fruit and vegetable shop on Qunying Road, she stopped and bought lemons and scallions. Back at the apartment, she first took in the sheets and pillowcases drying on the balcony, folded them, and put them back in the wardrobe. Then she used a lemon to make a warm cup of honey lemon water, sat on the sofa, and drank it to relax.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Realized the cards had been reorganized and adjusted her emotions.
description: After drinking water, Yu Xiaowen wanted to glance at the exam prep cards on the refrigerator, but found them gone. She quickly went to the bedroom, but the cards on the bedside table were also missing. She searched the living room and bedroom tabletops without success. Finally she saw the green iron box on the tea table, opened it, and found the prep cards neatly arranged by her mother according to systems: 'cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, nervous'. She realized the review order had been disrupted, and frantically searched for the 'nervous system' section without success. Irritation surged, and she almost complained to her mother. Then she touched a folded note at the bottom of the box, unfolded it and saw what her mother had written: 'Keep going, Mom doesn't know medicine, but she believes in you.' She was stunned, read it over and over, and her irritation turned to gratitude. Then she took a deep breath, re-examined the cards, tried to understand her mother's classification logic, and decided to accept the new order first, using the systematic classification to review the respiratory system that evening.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Confided in her best friend Zhang Jing via WeChat.
description: After calming down, Yu Xiaowen sent a long voice message to her best friend Zhang Jing, telling her about her mother sorting through the cards and seeing the sticky note. Zhang Jing instantly replied with a string of "hahaha," then sent a voice message praising her for not blowing up and for being understanding—a big improvement. The two chatted for a few more minutes, and Xiaowen's mood completely improved.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Preparing and enjoying dinner
description: After talking with Zhang Jing, Yu Xiaowen went into the kitchen, took the leftover pork rib soup she had simmered earlier from the fridge, boiled it, then added noodles, a poached egg, and some greens. Once the noodles were done, she sprinkled chopped scallions on top and sat at the table to savor them slowly. The hot soup noodles made her feel content.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening study and work tidying.
description: After eating, Yu Xiaowen sat down at her desk, took out her laptop and the cards her mother had organized. She sorted out review notes and common error-prone points for the respiratory system content. Then she opened her diary and wrote down the process of discovering the cards and adjusting her mindset today, recording her insights to remind herself to stay disciplined.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with family
description: After organizing her notes, Yu Xiaowen made a WeChat video call to her mother. Her mother was tidying up in the kitchen and smiled when she saw her daughter. Xiaowen thanked her mother for organizing the cards and sticky notes, and said playfully that she couldn't find them at first. Her mother laughed proudly. Her father came over to ask about the rehabilitation progress. Mother and daughter chatted about everyday things, and the call ended warmly.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Leisure, relaxation, and listening to music
description: After hanging up, Yu Xiaowen turned on the Bluetooth speaker and played the Prelude to Bach's First Cello Suite. Listening to the soothing cello music, she casually flipped through a pottery magazine, enjoying a rare moment of leisure.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bathing and hair care.
description: At 20:15, she turned off the music. Yu Xiaowen went to take a shower, washing her body with warm water, applying hair oil to her curly hair and massaging her scalp. After the shower, she applied a hydrating mask, patted it in, and put the clothes she had changed out of into the washing machine.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After drying her hair, Yu Xiaowen decided to give her mother a small surprise. She took the miniature clay bowl she had made from the pottery display shelf, pulled out a sticky note, wrote "Mom, this bowl was made by me. Use it to hold your cards, my 'system administrator.'" and put it into the bowl. Then she turned off the living room light, went back to the bedroom, left only the warm yellow bedside lamp on, and lit lavender essential oil for aromatherapy. Lying in bed, she opened the Tide app for a 10-minute breathing meditation to let her thoughts settle. After meditating, she wrote in her diary, 'Monday passed smoothly. Mom's love is "overbearing," but it is warm. I need to be more disciplined.' She set the alarm for 6:30 the next day, switched to sleep mode, turned off the light, and quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning routine
description: At 6 a.m., the alarm on her phone went off. Yu Xiaowen quickly washed up, changed into her workout clothes, and went to the balcony. Facing the morning light, she opened the window and began a 7-minute Baduanjin practice, moving smoothly and feeling her body wake up. When it was done, she took a deep breath. Then she prepared breakfast in the kitchen, taking out the homemade whole-wheat toast her mother had made from the refrigerator, along with a boiled egg and hot milk, for a simple meal. At the same time, she checked her phone, browsed the department WeChat group to confirm today's duty schedule, and replied to her colleague Wang Fang's question about assessing a patient's muscle tone.
location: Balcony, kitchen, and living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning commute and shopping
description: Yu Xiaowen packed her commuter bag (containing study cards, a water bottle, and a power bank), checked that her e-bike was fully charged, and set out. The morning breeze brushed her face as she rode her electric bike through familiar streets. At the Fresh Fruit convenience store opposite the hospital, she stopped and bought 2 lemons and 1 bunch of spring onions. She then arrived at the hospital, swiped her card to enter the rehabilitation medicine department, changed into her white coat in the changing room, put her things away, and got a cup of warm water.
location: Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and the convenience store across from it

name: Morning ward work and rounds in the department
description: Yu Xiaowen turned on her computer, logged into the hospital system, and reviewed the overnight records and test results of the patients under her charge. She ran into her colleague Wang Fang and chatted briefly about the funny incident of her putting too much salt in last night's stew. She then attended the department morning meeting, listened to the on-duty doctor's report, and began the department-wide ward round. During the round, she reported to Director Zhang Lei and Dr. Li Wei on the conditions of the three patients she was managing, specifically mentioning that an elderly patient with hemiplegia after a cerebral infarction had shown obvious improvement in walking function. Dr. Li Wei affirmed this and added suggestions for balance training.
location: Conference room and wards of the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning ward work and communication
description: After ward rounds, Yu Xiaowen began processing medical orders, prescribing a rehabilitation physiotherapy plan for a newly admitted patient who had undergone disc surgery, and writing the admission record. She then spent about 20 minutes communicating with the family member of a patient about to be discharged, explaining key points of home rehabilitation in plain language, and personally demonstrating several joint mobilization exercises. During this time, she also answered a call from another patient's family member and patiently reassured their anxiety about the rehabilitation outcome.
location: Rehabilitation Medicine Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday rest and study
description: At noon, Yu Xiaowen asked her colleague Wang Fang to bring back stir-fried pork with green peppers and rice from the cafeteria, and ate in the break room. While eating, she took out the categorized flashcards her mother had organized and reviewed them, focusing on memorizing the indications and contraindications of respiratory antibiotics. After the meal, she did 5 minutes of neck stretching exercises. Feeling sleepy, she put on an eye mask and earphones, listened to Debussy's "Clair de Lune", and took a nap for about 40 minutes, feeling refreshed.
location: Rehabilitation Medicine Department lounge, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon ward work and data collection
description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen continued writing the unfinished medical records from the morning, and then performed medium-frequency electrotherapy and joint mobilization for two patients separately. Afterward, she returned to the office and used the department’s internal system to retrieve the post-discharge follow-up data of patients needed for the mid-term report of the preliminary research, and carried out preliminary organization and labeling.
location: Wards and offices of the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Wrap up work before leaving.
description: As the end of her shift approached, Yu Xiaowen finished the last progress note and completed the handover with the evening-shift doctor. She then opened the hospital's electronic library database, searched for and downloaded 5 latest core journal articles on the topic of "Elderly Rehabilitation Exercise," and saved them to a USB drive to read carefully at home.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commute home from work, grocery shopping, and dinner
description: After work, Yu Xiaowen changed into casual clothes and rode her electric bike home. On the way, she stopped at the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road, paid for the lemon she had bought that morning together with the honey she had just selected, and exchanged a few pleasantries with the shopkeeper. After arriving home, she boiled water, sliced the lemon, and made a cup of warm honey lemon water. Then she quickly prepared dinner, using the eggs and tomatoes from the fridge to make a bowl of tomato and egg noodles. While eating, she scrolled through WeChat Moments, saw the update Lin Wei posted about the student sports meet, liked it, and commented, “The kids are so full of energy! Thank you for your hard work, Teacher Lin!”
location: Home, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pre-exam preparation
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen tidied the desk in her study and neatly arranged her exam supplies, including the laptop, notebooks, highlighters, and water cup. She logged into the online mock exam system in advance, tested that the network and headset were working properly, and set her phone to silent to ensure she would not be disturbed for the next two hours. Once everything was ready, she took a deep breath to calm down and reviewed the cardiovascular drug mnemonics for her weak chapters.
location: Study, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Online mock exam.
description: At 19:00 sharp, Yu Xiaowen began answering questions online with full concentration. She carefully read each question and analyzed the options. For cardiovascular and neuropathology questions she was unsure about, she marked them and skipped them first, then came back to think them through later. After about two hours of focused answering, the system automatically submitted the test, showing an accuracy rate of 68%.
location: Study, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Rest and online book list discussion
description: Feeling tired after the exam, Yu Xiaowen stood up to stretch and drink some water. Then she opened the community app on her phone and found that the online discussion of the "Women's Power Book List" was in progress, with over a hundred messages. After quickly browsing, she typed a farewell message and sent it, and received enthusiastic responses from the group members, which warmed her heart.
location: Study, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Post-exam study and research work
description: After finishing the honey lemon water, Yu Xiaowen refocused, opened the mock exam score report, and used a highlighter to mark the wrong questions in cardiovascular system and neuropathology, analyzed her weak areas, and planned a new sprint plan in her notebook. Then she opened the literature and interim report data for univariate analysis downloaded in the afternoon from a USB drive, used a spreadsheet to generate a visual bar chart, and quickly read a paper on the effects of rehabilitation exercise on gait analysis in elderly patients, excerpting key conclusions as material for the paper introduction.
location: Study, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Body Scan Meditation
description: Yu Xiaowen left the study and walked into the bedroom, changed into loose pajamas, turned off the main light and left a desk lamp on. She lay in bed, opened the Tide app, and chose the 25-minute body scan meditation audio. Following the guidance, she began perceiving her body from her toes upward, especially slowing her breathing to relax the sore, stiff areas in her neck, shoulders, and lower back. After it ended, the stiffness in her neck and shoulders was noticeably relieved, and she felt calm.
location: Bedroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Pre-sleep routine and falling asleep.
description: After meditating, Yu Xiaowen wrote down today's feelings in her diary: I got 68% on the mock exam, but it exposed problems, which is a good thing. The first meditation felt great, and my shoulders and neck are much more relaxed. I hope the sisters in the reading-list community all have a bright future. Then she went to the bathroom to brush her teeth, wash her face, and apply moisturizer. She set the alarm for 6 a.m. the next morning and took out tomorrow's clothes and workout clothes from the wardrobe. She turned off the light, lay down, reviewed tomorrow's goals, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Coming home after the night shift and catching up on sleep
description: Opening the door, she placed her hospital work bag and thermos on the shoe cabinet in the entryway, took off her white coat, and hung it up. She changed into loose cotton loungewear and drew the blackout curtains in the bedroom. Picking up her phone from the bedside table, she quickly replied to Lin Wei's message from half an hour ago, “Don't forget to play ball tonight,” saying, “Just got off the night shift, exhausted. Can't make it tonight—let's set it up tomorrow.” Then she set the alarm for 11:20, lay down, and closed her eyes. Outside, the sky was gloomy; inside, the room was dim, and the air felt damp before the rain. Her body soon sank into deep sleep. The fatigue of the night shift was repaired by several hours of sleep. When the alarm went off, her shoulders and neck were still sore, but her mind was much clearer.
location: Entryway and bedroom, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Get up, wash up, and stretch.
description: After turning off the alarm, she took a few deep breaths in bed, then sat up and stretched her back. Getting out of bed, she went to the bathroom to wash up, splashed her face with warm water, and simply tied her hair up. Passing by the bay window, she saw the message sent by Master Zheng on her phone shortly after six in the morning: "Do you want to share a kiln firing for the bisque pieces?"
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Quarter, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Made a simple lunch by herself.
description: She opened the refrigerator and took out eggs, vegetables, a little dried shrimp, and dried noodles. She boiled water in a small pot, added the noodles after the water came to a boil, and blanched the washed baby bok choy in the same pot. She fried an egg, then scooped all the ingredients into a bowl and drizzled with a little light soy sauce and sesame oil; the soup was clear and bright. She carried the steaming noodles to the small tea table in the living room and sat down.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and post-meal activities.
description: While eating noodles, she opened WeChat. First she opened Lin Wei's chat and saw that the other person had replied with an animated sticker saying: 'Okay, see you tomorrow. Rest well.' Then she opened the chat with Master Zheng, thought for a moment, and replied: 'Master Zheng, I found the kaolin clay Su Ya sent over before. I want to try making a small teacup. In a couple of days, I'll go to the studio and use your kiln.' After sending the message, she finished the remaining noodles and took the bowl and chopsticks to the kitchen sink and rinsed them clean. Then she walked to the balcony window, stretched a few times, and looked down at the sparse pedestrians on Qunying Road and the overcast sky. She casually touched the leaves of the pothos in the flowerpot and sprayed a little water on another spider plant. Then she brought the laptop and charger from the study and placed them on the desk, ready for the afternoon's work.
location: Living room and balcony, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Write the first draft of the paper's introduction
description: Open the computer, find the reference folder organized the day before yesterday and the charts drawn earlier. Create a new Word document and start writing the introduction of the paper. She proceeded in three steps according to plan: first, sorted out the research background of current rehabilitation interventions for elderly stroke patients, citing key literature; then pointed out the controversies in the academic community, such as the choice of rehabilitation timing and the bottleneck in intensity setting; finally, presented the innovative purpose of this study. Several times in the middle she stopped to check the charts and revise her wording. After three rounds of polishing, she completed a draft of about 800 words and saved the file as 'Paper Draft_v1' on the local desktop.
location: Study at Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Brief rest and hydration
description: After saving the document, she got up and went to the kitchen to make a glass of warm honey lemon water. She leaned against the refrigerator and drank it slowly, glanced at the Tide app on her phone a few times, then casually opened a Rehabilitation Medicine notebook on her desk and flipped through two pages. She pressed her fingertips into the tense back of her neck and felt that her cervical spine was still somewhat stiff.
location: Study and kitchen, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Formulate an intensive review plan for cardiovascular medications
description: Returning to the desk, I opened my notebook and the analysis records from yesterday's mock exam. Based on the weak areas, I systematically planned a 6-day review schedule: the first day focused on the mechanisms and classification of antiarrhythmic drugs (Class -); the second day tackled digoxin toxicity management and electrolyte effects; the following days were arranged for systematic memorization of representative drugs and side effects. In the margin, I noted a tip: 'Squeeze in study during gaps on tomorrow's night shift,' and planned to underline and check off items on the review cards every night before bed. Finally, I tucked the list into the first page of the exam-prep folder.
location: Study at Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Organizing pottery materials and Baduanjin exercises
description: She put down her pen, walked to the corner of the study, and found the express cardboard box Su Ya had sent from among the stacked clutter. She carried it to the living room coffee table and used a utility knife to cut open the sealing tape. Inside was a sealed clear plastic bag holding a few jin of fine, dry kaolin clay. She untied the bag, reached in, and grabbed a handful. The cool, smooth, slippery touch of the clay made her heart skip a beat, and she instantly missed the rhythm of the pottery wheel. She took a photo and sent it to Su Ya: 'I've opened the package. It feels amazing! I'll get started right away!' Then she smelled the clay at the bag opening. After that, she changed into a pair of thin-soled sneakers, walked to the balcony, and opened the window; the slightly damp air after the rain blew in with a chill. She opened the Baduanjin instructional video saved in her phone, and followed the music and cues to do a complete session, about seven and a half minutes. She focused on relaxing her neck, shoulders, and waist in the movements 'Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner' and 'Sway the Head and Shake the Tail to Dispel Heart Fire.' After the closing posture, she was slightly breathless but felt her body much lighter. She wiped the sweat from her hands, returned to the living room, poured part of the kaolin into a clean glass basin, sprayed a little water, and squeezed it with her hand to feel the moisture of the clay. Then she sat on the sofa and sent a fairly long voice message to Master Zheng: 'The kaolin feels really good. I plan to make a small bisque teacup to practice. When is the studio available recently?' After sending it, she used a scraper to put the clay back into the sealed bag and stored it in a cool place, already envisioning the shape of the cup in her mind.
location: Living room and balcony, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Free relaxation and phone browsing
description: Curled up on the sofa, she scrolled on her phone for a while, browsing pottery and craft videos on Xiaohongshu and liking several tutorials on throwing teacups. She also cut up some fruit to eat and replied to a couple of greeting messages in the high school classmates group. The sky gradually cleared outside, and the cool evening air seeped through the screen window, so she decided to prepare dinner while the weather was good.
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Cooking a simple dinner
description: She opened the refrigerator and took out a handful of garlic sprouts, two tomatoes, a piece of soft tofu, and eggs. She decided to make tomato tofu soup with garlic sprout scrambled eggs. She washed and chopped the ingredients with practiced ease. The wok soon gave off a fragrant sizzle. After about ten minutes, a soup and a vegetable dish were served on the table, and the corn rice in the rice cooker had switched to keep-warm mode.
location: Kitchen, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and after-meal cleanup
description: Sitting at the small dining table, she ate slowly while playing a Chopin nocturne on her phone. The rice was warm, the soup was sweet and sour and appetizing, and the garlic scapes were crisp and tender. She savored the rhythm of finally being completely relaxed, no longer thinking about review or the thesis, and focused on chewing. After the meal, she cleared the dishes and chopsticks, washed the pots, and wiped the stove clean with a cloth. She also sorted the kitchen waste, tied the bag tightly, and put it by the door to take downstairs the next morning.
location: Henan Province, Zhengzhou City, Jinshui District, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Qunying Community, Building 3, Unit 1, Room 502, dining room and kitchen

name: Essential oil bath and shower
description: She turned on the bathroom faucet, adjusted the water temperature, filled the tub with hot water, and added a few drops of lavender essential oil. Taking off her loungewear, she immersed herself in the hot water, closed her eyes, and lay there for a while, letting the water flow over her shoulders, neck, and back. After soaking long enough, she rinsed off in the shower, wrapped her hair in a dry towel cap, applied body lotion, and changed into a set of light-colored cotton pajamas.
location: Bathroom, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Read 'Better'.
description: Leaning against the headboard, she took off her hair-drying cap with her hair ends still half-dry, picked up 'Better' from the nightstand, turned to the page with the bookmark, and quietly read more than 20 pages. When she reached the chapter on end-of-life care, she felt a pang, closed the book, and reflected for a moment.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Body Scan Meditation
description: Adjusted the pillow, lay flat, and opened the Tide app to choose a 30-minute body scan meditation. Following the voice guidance, she gradually moved her attention from her toes up to her head. While breathing, she deliberately extended her attention to her shoulders, neck, and lower back, imagining warm currents circulating through these areas and continuously releasing the tension accumulated during the day. When the meditation ended, her body sank softly into the mattress, and she felt great.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Write a gratitude journal.
description: She took a diary and a pen from the desk drawer, sat under the desk lamp, and began to write: "June 25, Wednesday. Today was a very comfortable rest day — I caught up on sleep, finalized the first draft of my paper, and mapped out my review plan. The moment I touched kaolin again, I felt truly happy. Baduanjin loosened up my shoulder blades. During the body scan, I noticed there is still a pressure point in my right shoulder blade; tomorrow after my morning run I'll do some extra stretching." After writing, she signed off with the date.
location: Bedroom desk, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Evening relaxation and preparation for bed
description: I put down the diary, turned off the desk lamp, and left only a warm yellow night light on. I put in earphones and listened to an unaccompanied cello suite. As I listened, I jotted down in my phone’s memo what to bring back to the hospital tomorrow and a list of clay tools I planned to buy. Then I went to the living room to bring the dried face cream and hand cream back to the bedroom, and casually replied to the dinner photo my mother sent in the family group chat with a thumbs-up emoji. I checked the next day’s alarm setting (7:00) to make sure I would not be late for work. I plugged my phone into the charger and tidied up the odds and ends on the small bedside table.
location: Bedroom and living room, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Leaning against the backrest made of stacked pillows, she reopened 'Better' and read for half an hour. Halfway through, her eyelids grew heavy, so she closed the book, pulled the quilt up to her chest, and fell asleep lying on her side with eyes closed. She reached out and turned off the bedside lamp, and the room became completely quiet. Her body sank comfortably into the blanket; thinking of the day's accomplishments, she felt grounded and content, and soon fell into deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 1, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning activities and study preparation
description: Woke up naturally at 6:20 in the morning, feeling refreshed. Pulling open the curtains, she saw the sky was dark and a fine rain was falling. After confirming the weather information, she changed into loose sportswear and prepared for morning exercise. At 6:30, she did a complete 10-minute Baduanjin routine on the balcony, with smooth movements and deep breathing. After finishing, she wiped the light sweat from her forehead and stood quietly at the window, taking in the greenery of the community and her inner calm. Then she went to the kitchen to prepare a simple breakfast: oatmeal mixed with hot milk, topped with blueberries and sliced banana. While eating, she checked “Paper Draft_v1” on her phone to confirm the logic was smooth; she also flipped through the “Classification of Antiarrhythmic Drugs” section in her review plan notebook and marked key study points such as lidocaine and propranolol. Finally, she checked her commuter bag—water bottle, notebook, textbooks, pens, and power bank—and put the umbrella in the side pocket of the bag to ensure everything was complete.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commute to the hospital
description: At 7:15, wearing her white coat and carrying her commuter bag, she put on her helmet, took an umbrella, and went downstairs. She started her e-scooter and rode north on Jingsan Road, turned onto Nongye Road, then left onto Tongbai North Road. The road was wet and slippery from the rain, so she slowed down and arrived at the west gate of Zhengzhou Central Hospital at 7:25, about 10 minutes later.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning meeting and department-wide grand rounds.
description: After arriving at the hospital at 7:25, she parked the e-scooter in the staff parking shed, took the elevator to the 6th floor changing room, put on her white coat, and adjusted her name badge. At 7:40 she entered the demonstration room for the department morning meeting. The department director Zhang Lei presided, and the night-shift doctor reported on the new patients admitted the previous day and the nighttime blood pressure fluctuations of an existing patient. Yu Xiaowen took careful notes and, mentally linking it to her review plan, silently recited the warning signs of complications in elderly heart-failure patients using diuretics. After the morning meeting, she followed her supervising doctor Li Wei on the department-wide grand rounds, focusing on a patient with sequelae of cerebral infarction and the patient with blood pressure fluctuations. Dr. Li took a detailed history and performed a physical exam, and in the corridor quietly discussed medication adjustments with the team, mentioning the differences in indications between propranolol and metoprolol. Yu Xiaowen jotted down key points in her rounds notebook, deepening her understanding by connecting them to last night's review content.
location: Rehabilitation Department Demonstration Room and Ward, 6th Floor, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning ward work and fragmented learning
description: After ward rounds, handled paperwork in the doctor's office: checked the test reports of newly admitted patients from the previous day, and wrote rehabilitation physiotherapy and medication orders for the third day. At 9:45, answered a call from a family member of a discharged patient, explained in detail the anticoagulant medication precautions for home recovery (including the use of warfarin), and the call lasted about 5 minutes. From 10:30 to 11:00, during gaps between reviewing medical records, took out the essential edition of Pharmacology, cross-referenced it with the hand-drawn cardiovascular drug tree diagram, focused on memorizing the key points of class I antiarrhythmic drugs (lidocaine, propafenone), and added the sodium channel blocking strength classification in red pen. At 11:00, after finishing the last progress note, briefly discussed the next day's work arrangements with Wang Fang.
location: Doctor's Office and Wards, 6th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Lunch and study during the midday break
description: At 11:30, she went with her colleague Wang Fang to the staff cafeteria on the first floor of the inpatient building for lunch, choosing a light meal: stir-fried lettuce, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, and a bowl of millet porridge. The two chatted while eating; Wang Fang complained about the family members' repeated questions during ward rounds, while Yu Xiaowen shared her initial joy of successfully throwing a clay piece the night before. The meal took about 20 minutes. At 12:00 she returned to the doctors' rest room on the 6th floor, sat on the sofa by the window, opened the PDF "Classification of Antiarrhythmic Drugs" on her tablet, quickly scanned the key points, and completed the day's fragmented learning loop. At 12:25 she turned off the screen, rested her head on a neck pillow, set an alarm for 12:55, and closed her eyes for a 20-minute nap to restore energy.
location: Staff cafeteria and doctors' rest room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon rehabilitation therapy and communication
description: After the alarm rang, she washed her face and returned to work full of energy. In the afternoon, she independently performed medium-frequency electrotherapy and joint range-of-motion training for two patients. During that time, she communicated with a family member about the patient's recent improvement in muscle tone and encouraged the family to participate more in bedside sitting balance training. She briefly recorded the afternoon treatment in the medical records before 14:00.
location: Rehabilitation treatment room and wards, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon: medical documentation, research, and shift handover
description: At 14:00, she began focusing on medical documentation: she completed progress notes for three inpatients and updated the discharge summaries for two patients scheduled to be discharged the next day. At 15:00, she spent half an hour opening the research follow-up data folder on her computer, performed a simple summary of the "blood pressure control rate" she had marked the day before, and organized the data tables in preparation for later analysis. At 16:30, she started preparing the shift handover records and gave the on-duty doctor Liu Qiang a handover focusing on the day's situation. At 17:00, she took off her white coat, packed her commute bag, and left.
location: Doctors' office, 6th floor, inpatient building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Returning home after work and a simple dinner
description: At 17:00 after work, she cycled back along the same route. The rain had stopped and the air was fresh, arriving at Qunying Residential Community at 17:10. She quickly went upstairs, changed out of her work clothes, and put on a loose shirt and casual pants. She took washed lettuce and leftover chicken soup from the fridge, boiled water in the kitchen to cook noodles, while reheating the chicken soup and shredding the boiled chicken breast. After the noodles were done, she drained them and added lettuce and the chicken soup as toppings, making a steaming bowl of chicken soup noodles with shredded chicken and vegetables. She sat at the dining table eating alone, browsing the latest works on the "Between the Earth" studio's official account on her phone, feeling full of anticipation for the evening pottery activity.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prepared and went to the pottery studio.
description: At 17:50, after finishing dinner, she quickly rinsed the bowls and chopsticks. In the bedroom, she checked what she was carrying: car keys, phone, power bank, and a coin purse. She specially brought a canvas tote bag with the kaolin clay sample sent by her best friend Su Ya, intending to show Master Zheng the texture. At 18:15, she put on a light jacket and went downstairs, then started the white car parked at the entrance of the residential complex. She set the navigation to the Artists' Park on Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District. She took Jingsan Road south, turned onto Jinshui Road, and headed east; after getting off the bridge at Dongming Road, she went straight to Shangcheng Road and turned right. Traffic was acceptable during rush hour, and the trip took about 25 minutes. She arrived at the park around 18:40 and parked in a temporary spot. She walked across the quiet flagstone paths of the park, following the warm yellow lights straight to the “Between the Earth” studio in the corner.
location: Artists' Park, Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pottery throwing and glazing discussion
description: At 18:55 she pushed open the door to Between the Clay. Master Zheng was sitting in the corner trimming a piece; when he saw Xiaowen, he smiled and nodded. Xiaowen put on a work apron, took a piece of about 300 grams of white clay, sat down in front of the pottery wheel, took a deep breath, and firmly threw the clay onto the center of the wheel head. She dipped her hands in water and gently guided the clay ball, feeling its center and the rhythm of the rotation. After the familiar collapses and restarts, she stayed calm, repeatedly adjusting the angle of her fingers and the focus of her force. Finally she opened the form and slowly pushed the walls up with her thumb. After nearly 3 hours of immersive attempts (19:10-22:00), a small tea cup blank with a mouth about 8 cm in diameter, slightly clumsy in line but clear in outline, stood on the wheel. Master Zheng came over, gently pinched the bottom, and nodded, saying, "The bottom is thick enough; if you trim it thinner, it will be beautiful." Xiaowen carefully moved the blank together with the plaster board to the drying rack, covered it with plastic wrap, and stuck on a sticky note reading "2025.06.26 initial blank - Xiaowen." She took photos from multiple angles with her phone to remember the moment. At 22:00, after cleaning the workbench, she discussed the glazing plan with Master Zheng. He suggested naturally drying it for 3 days, and on Sunday evening (June 29) to replenish water, polish, and apply the base glaze. Xiaowen noted this in her phone's memo. Then she took off the apron and thanked Master Zheng for his guidance.
location: 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio, Artist Park, Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Returning home
description: At 22:15, she walked out of the studio, and the park was already quiet. She started the car and drove back the same way, connecting her phone via Bluetooth to play Debussy's Clair de Lune to soothe her mood. Traffic was smooth all the way. At 22:35, she returned to Qunying Community and parked. Her hands still smelled of moist clay, and her heart was filled with the joy of creation and a sense of fulfillment after completing the work.
location: Along the route from the Artist Community on Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Qunying Residential Area, Jinshui District

name: Writing a gratitude journal and sharing
description: After getting home, she changed out of her outer clothes, sat at the desk, opened a new notebook, and wrote in her gratitude journal: "1. Although I failed a few times at wheel-throwing, I finally succeeded; the feeling of focus was wonderful. 2. Master Zheng still patiently guided me on the thickness of the base. 3. I received an encouraging message from my best friend Su Ya. Thank you for today." After finishing, she took a photo and sent it to Su Ya with the caption "The first step from kaolin to a tea bowl." Su Ya quickly replied, "!! Awesome, can't wait to see the finished piece!"
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and going to bed.
description: At 22:50, she turned off the overhead light, switched on the bedside night light, put on her earphones, and selected the 15-minute Body Scan Meditation mode in the Tide app. Lying flat, she followed the guidance and moved from her toes upward to her head, focusing on her neck and shoulders—after the morning workout and heavy physical exertion from pottery, the muscles there were slightly sore, and she gradually relaxed through exhalation. The meditation ended at 23:05, and she felt soft, relaxed, and at peace. Then she got up and went to the bathroom for her evening routine: removing sunscreen, washing her face, and applying moisturizing toner and lotion and eye cream. At 23:20 she returned to bed, set the alarm for 6:20 the next morning, and picked up the book Better from beside her pillow to continue reading five pages until her eyelids grew heavy. At 23:35 she put down the book and turned off the reading lamp, adjusted her sleeping position, and soon fell into a deep, quiet sleep amidst the damp night outside the window.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Area, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up and Baduanjin.
description: Woke up naturally to the faint morning light through the curtains. Changed into sportswear, opened the balcony door, and took a deep breath. Standing on the balcony with soothing Baduanjin music playing on her phone, she stretched her body from holding up the sky with both hands to seven heel drops behind the back, feeling the power of morning focus.
location: Balcony, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Efficient breakfast and fragmented review
description: Quickly prepared breakfast: oatmeal milk, boiled eggs, and soda crackers. While eating, reviewed the 'Digitalis Toxicity Management' mnemonic card, softly reciting: 'Causes: hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, renal function; manifestations: nausea, vomiting, arrhythmia; treatment: stop the drug, supplement potassium, phenytoin sodium.' After several repetitions, it was deeply memorable.
location: Dining room, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commute: ride an e-bike to the hospital
description: Putting on her helmet and getting on her e-bike. A gentle breeze brushed her face as she rode through the morning streets. About 15 minutes later, she arrived at the bicycle shed at Zhengzhou Central Hospital and locked the bike.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Changing clothes and preparing for the morning meeting
description: Changed into the white coat and rubbed hands with hand sanitizer. Wang Fang handed over a mint candy to refresh herself; she smiled and took it. She quickly scanned the handover notes left by the colleague on night duty and marked the names of patients needing attention.
location: Cardiology Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning shift handover
description: The morning meeting was chaired by the doctor on duty. The night-shift nurse reported that an elderly patient had been admitted in the early morning with nausea and vomiting after taking an overdose of digoxin, and initial treatment had been provided. Director Zhang Lei emphasized the patient's electrolyte monitoring and follow-up treatment plan, and Yu Xiaowen quickly wrote down his approach in her notebook.
location: Cardiology meeting room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning ward work: ward rounds, medical orders, communication.
description: After the morning meeting, I made rounds with Dr. Li Wei. At the bedside of a patient with digitalis toxicity, Dr. Li asked about the management principles. Referring to the morning meeting notes, I answered fluently, 'Discontinue the drug, supplement potassium, monitor the ECG, and use phenytoin sodium.' Dr. Li nodded. After rounds, I returned to the office area to handle medical orders and write progress notes, and explained in detail the home care points and follow-up schedule to the family of a heart failure patient who was about to be discharged.
location: Cardiology ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday relaxation and neck and shoulder exercises.
description: Went to the cafeteria with Wang Fang. She ordered stir-fried broccoli and scrambled eggs with tomatoes, while Wang Fang ordered braised fish chunks. They sat by the window in the corner of the cafeteria, chatting about weekend plans while eating. After the meal, she stood up and did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretching exercises to relieve the fatigue from writing medical records in the morning.
location: Window seat in the cafeteria of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break recharge and in-depth study
description: Back in the lounge, she put on headphones and listened to Bach's Unaccompanied Cello Suites. She took out Internal Medicine, turned to the chapter on digitalis poisoning, and, based on the morning case, focused on studying the differentiation and management of premature ventricular contractions caused by digitalis poisoning, drawing a simple management flowchart in her notebook.
location: On-call rest room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday nap
description: Set the alarm for 13:20, lay on the recliner, and rested with eyes closed. I didn't fall fully asleep, but the half-hour of quiet lying restored much of my afternoon energy.
location: On-call rest room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon ward work: documentation and collaboration
description: Returned to the office area full of energy. Handled admission records for newly admitted patients, then checked with Sister Wu Min from the nursing department about the examination items and medication adjustments for several patients for the next day. Brother Liu Qiang came over and shared a case about 'digoxin drug interactions'; as we discussed it, I gained a more concrete understanding of drug combinations.
location: Cardiology Department Office Area, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Summary and handover before leaving work
description: Before the shift handover, she finished organizing the daily progress notes and key matters for the patients under her care, especially the potassium level and next-step plan for the patient with digoxin poisoning, and made a clear, detailed handover to the oncoming doctor.
location: Cardiology Department Office Area, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-work commute and neighborhood shopping
description: Left work on time, rode my little e-bike home. Stopped at the familiar "Lao Zhou Grain and Oil Store", picked tomatoes, cucumbers and spinach, and saw the newly arrived peaches looked good, so bought two more. The owner greeted me with a smile: "Xiaowen, you're off work early today!" I smiled back: "Yeah, it's Friday today!"
location: Old Zhou's Grain and Oil Shop, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Preparing and enjoying a simple dinner
description: After arriving home, she changed into loungewear, tied on an apron, and cooked a refreshing bowl of tomato, egg, and spinach noodles. She fried a runny-yolk egg and served it with cucumber salad. While eating, she used her phone to reply to the messages her mother shared in the family group.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Short rest and household chores.
description: After putting away the dishes and chopsticks, she made a cup of lemon water. She went to the balcony to water the succulents and pothos she had planted a couple of days ago. Watching the little succulents stretch their leaves, she felt relaxed. She sat back on the sofa and zoned out for a while, easing the fatigue of the day.
location: Living room, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Core exam preparation: digitalis toxicity topic.
description: Set the phone to Do Not Disturb mode, spread out the textbook and notebook. First used a mind map to sort out the logical chain of digitalis poisoning from triggers and clinical manifestations to the management process, then used a question-and-answer approach to write the key points in the notebook, and recited them aloud. Finally, opened the phone question bank, found 5 case analysis questions, completed them independently with an 80% accuracy rate, and felt the study was solid and effective.
location: At the desk in Room 501, Unit 2, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Getting ready before the appointment and heading out.
description: I checked the time; there was still half an hour before the time I had agreed on with Zhang Jing. I stood up and moved around a bit, put on some lip balm, changed into a cotton-linen dress and canvas shoes, and picked up my small shoulder bag. Before going out, I tidied my hair in the mirror, feeling relaxed.
location: Room 501, Unit 2, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Evening walk and heart-to-heart talk with her best friend
description: Rode the electric scooter for a few minutes to Zhenghong City, and met Zhang Jing at the square beside the subway entrance. We walked and chatted along the square and the tree-lined path, with a pleasant evening breeze. Zhang Jing shared a handmade craft made by a child in her class and was deeply moved.
