Afterwards, I went to the balcony, spread out the yoga mat, and followed an audio recording of Baduanjin for a 10-minute morning exercise, then spent 5 minutes focusing on stretching my calves and the back of my thighs. After exercising, I took milk and instant oatmeal from the fridge, and made a quick salad with mango and blueberries. While eating breakfast, I checked the transit card, keys, phone, the small notebook in the white coat pocket, and the excerpt notebook for Medical Statistics in my canvas bag; everything was neatly in place.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Listening to medical podcasts while commuting by car
description: Went downstairs to get the car, drove from Qunying Road to Tianming Road, then turned under the Nongye Road elevated highway, listening all the way to a podcast about new advances in rehabilitation for post-stroke swallowing disorders. Sixteen minutes later, the car pulled steadily into the hospital parking lot.
location: From Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Arrived at the hospital for preparation and attended the department morning meeting.
description: Swiped her card to enter the inpatient department, changed into a white coat, and put on her work badge. She turned on the computer, pulled up the medical records of two discharged patients, reviewed recent lab reports and nursing records, confirmed there were no pending items, and listed questions she wanted to ask Dr. Li Wei during outpatient clinic shadowing. Then she attended the department morning meeting, where the night-shift doctor gave a detailed report on the emergency dizziness patient and the stroke recovery patient; she took careful notes. After the meeting, she briefly confirmed with Dr. Li Wei the cerebrovascular disease patient for the afternoon follow-up visit.
location: Doctor's offices, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning outpatient clinic shadowing and record-keeping
description: The 8 o'clock clinic started on time. She assisted Dr. Li Wei with calling patients and entering chief complaints and vital signs. While treating a patient with lacunar cerebral infarction, Dr. Li pointed at the imaging film and emphasized the typical imaging findings of a lacunar infarct in the basal ganglia region. She quickly wrote it down in her notebook. Throughout the busy morning, she earnestly studied Dr. Li's approach to history-taking and diagnostic skills.
location: Neurology clinic, outpatient building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Lunch, sign up for volunteering at the nursing home, and afternoon rest
description: During lunchtime, in the staff cafeteria with colleague Wang Fang, I chatted about weekend plans while eating tomato and egg noodles. Wang Fang wanted to see a newly released movie, while I said I would drive back to Luoyang tomorrow. After the meal, I walked to the Social Work Department in the administrative building and saw the Warm Sunset volunteer recruitment poster. Remembering how volunteers had helped us when my father was hospitalized, I filled out the application form, scanned the QR code to join the volunteer group, and learned that pre-service training would be held on July 20. I felt full of anticipation. Afterward, I returned to the duty room, lay back on the bed to rest with my eyes closed, and stretched my stiff neck. Then I recorded in my phone memo the medication approach and rehabilitation suggestions for the morning outpatient stroke cases, planning to add them to the draft paper on the weekend.
location: Staff canteen, Social Work Department office and duty room, Administration Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon outpatient clinic shadowing and patient gratitude
description: The pace of the afternoon outpatient clinic was a bit slower. Around 15:00, a family member of a patient returning for a follow-up on cerebral infarction came to thank her specially, saying, "Dr. Yu, last time you explained everything so clearly that I even remembered the bed number. Thank you!" A warm feeling rose in her heart, and she became even more determined to do this job well. She continued to assist Teacher Li Wei with outpatient clinic matters until the end of the shift.
location: Neurology clinic, outpatient building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: After work, walked to the supermarket to go shopping.
description: Left work at 17:30 sharp, took off her white coat, and walked to the Dennis All-Day Fresh Supermarket near the hospital. On the way, she used her phone memo to list the shopping items: cooking vinegar, hydrating face masks, water and apples for the road tomorrow, and low-fat milk for her father. After arriving at the supermarket, she quickly found what she needed and also grabbed an extra pack of her mother's favorite black sesame paste. When checking out, the shopping bag was stuffed full, and she felt reassured.
location: Dennis Fresh Mart (Hanting Hotel Branch), No. 66 Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Driving home
description: Carried the shopping bags and put them in the trunk, then started the car and drove back along Tongbai Road to Qunying Road. The radio was playing a light folk song, and she hummed along; the busy feeling of the day gradually faded. Arrived home after a 16-minute drive.
location: From No. 66 Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District

name: Dinner, sharing her volunteer decision with her best friend, and packing for the trip home.
description: After getting home, I made a bowl of hot noodle soup with the tomatoes and eggs I had just bought. While eating, I sent voice messages to my best friend Zhang Jing, excitedly sharing my decision and original intention to sign up as a volunteer today. After eating, I took out my black backpack, put in the protein powder I had bought for my father and the new knee pads I had prepared for my mother, and also stuffed in two changes of clothes and the excerpt notebook for Medical Statistics. I opened the location of the old house in Luoyang and planned the route on the navigation app, departing at 8 a.m. tomorrow, about 2 hours in total, and felt mentally prepared.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Evening reading, music, planning, and medical exam practice
description: Curled up on the living room sofa, I opened the essay collection Keep Walking, and the Bluetooth speaker played Debussy's Clair de Lune. Halfway through, I remembered the Zhengzhou old-town City Walk guide I had saved last weekend, so I noted down the No. 3 State Cotton Mill historic buildings and the time-honored snack shops on Shuncheng Street in my phone memo, planning to explore them on the way back. Then I went to the study, opened the medical exam practice app, and completed 5 Type A2 questions on cerebrovascular disease as required. After checking the answers, I found two were wrong. I copied key points such as the thrombolytic therapy time window and contraindications into my mistake notebook, marking the reasons for the errors in red pen to deepen my memory.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Evening washing up and skincare
description: Wash face thoroughly with facial cleanser, then apply a newly purchased hydrating mask, lean back in a chair, play soft music on the phone, close eyes and enjoy 15 minutes of tranquility. After removing the mask, gently massage until absorbed; skin becomes moist and hydrated.
location: Home bathroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Confirmed shift arrangements with colleagues and video-called with mother.
description: After washing up, she sent a WeChat message to her colleague Wang Fang asking whether the Sunday duty schedule had changed. Wang Fang quickly replied that it hadn't, so she sent back an "OK" emoji with relief. Then her mother Li Xiuying called via video, smiling and asking what she wanted to eat. She excitedly shouted, "Sweet and sour pork! And hulatang!" Her mother reminded her to drive slowly on the road tomorrow and not to be impatient. They chatted about the pomegranate tree in front of the old house blooming, and her mother said she had visited the morning market today, leaving her heart feeling warm.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Pre-sleep check, journal writing, and mindfulness meditation.
description: After hanging up the video call, she checked her backpack one last time to make sure everything was packed, then went down to the garage and walked around the car to check that the fuel level was sufficient. Back in the room, she set an alarm for 8 a.m. tomorrow on her phone and changed into her pajamas. She opened her diary and used a fountain pen to write down the three things that moved her most today: the patient's family's sincere thanks, the excitement of successfully registering as a volunteer, and her mother's gentle words. Her heart was full of warmth. Then she dimmed the lights, lay flat on the bed, put on her earphones, and followed the guided audio for a 10-minute mindful breathing meditation, focusing on her breath as her body gradually relaxed. After the meditation, she turned off the night light and pulled up the quilt.
location: At home and in the underground garage, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Falling asleep
description: Although it was a little later than usual, my heart was full of anticipation for tomorrow's trip to Luoyang. I imagined my parents waiting at the alley entrance and my mother's sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin. With this sweet expectation and the satisfaction of a fulfilling day, I gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning Baduanjin
description: Woke up on time at 6:30. The sky outside the window was somewhat overcast, but the forecast said it would clear up in the afternoon. On the balcony, she laid out a yoga mat and, to gentle music, slowly stretched her body, completing a set of Baduanjin. She felt completely relaxed and ready for the day's drive back to Luoyang.
location: Home balcony, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Breakfast and preparations before leaving
description: Heated last night's milk in the microwave and had a simple breakfast with whole wheat toast. Checked the backpack again: protein powder for father, knee pads for mother, a change of T-shirt and shorts. Before going downstairs, deliberately walked around to the car, checked the tire pressure and fuel level, and confirmed everything was fine.
location: At home, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Drove to hometown in Luoyang
description: Departed on time at 7:30 and got on the Lianhuo Expressway. There weren't many vehicles on the road. I turned on the car music and played Jay Chou's "Sunny Day," feeling delighted. Driving smoothly all the way, I arrived at the family compound on Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang at 9:07. I saw my mother waving by the window from afar, and my heart felt warm.
location: Lianhuo Expressway (Zhengzhou to Luoyang section)

name: Warm gathering and recording rehabilitation data
description: Upon entering, I gave my father a hug; he looked much better than last month. After a brief greeting, I took out the rehabilitation record book from the bedside table, carefully copied down this month's training data, and entered it into the comparison table on the tablet. After analysis, I found that my father's lower limb muscle strength had improved significantly, but his cardiorespiratory endurance indicators had not improved much. In red pen, I marked in the notebook: "Next week, it is recommended to add 15 minutes of daily in-place stepping aerobic training."
location: Living room of the family home in the staff quarters of Kaixuan Road Primary School, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Kept mother company while sorting through old belongings.
description: Mother said the main purpose of returning to the old house this time was to sort through old belongings. She pulled out a yellowed photo album with photos of Xiaowen as a child. While helping her sort things, I listened to her tell the stories behind each photo. Mother also mentioned wanting to learn traditional Chinese painting after retirement, so I immediately encouraged her to sign up for a senior citizens' college. The atmosphere was warm and relaxing.
location: Living room of the family home in the staff quarters of Kaixuan Road Primary School, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Lunch and rest
description: Her mother made sweet and sour pork, hulatang, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables — her favorite dishes since childhood. The family chatted while eating, and the familiar flavors made her feel especially content. After the meal she cleared the table and washed the dishes, then watched CCTV's Open the Door with her parents in the living room for a while, and finally went back to her room for a nap.
location: Dining room of the home in the family compound of Kaixuan Road Primary School, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Noon break
description: A drizzling shower started outside the window, and the air became cool. Lying on the single bed she had slept in since childhood, listening to the pitter-patter of rain and the occasional bird calls, she soon fell into a light sleep, saving energy for the afternoon's activities.
location: Bedroom at home, Kaixuan Road Primary School Family Compound, No. 7, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Accompanied her mother to buy ingredients for dinner.
description: The rain had stopped and the air was especially fresh. Arm in arm with her mother, she walked 15 minutes to the Tanggong Road farmers' market. Her mother skillfully selected fresh sea bass, tender tofu, tomatoes, greens, and more. She took the initiative to suggest that she would cook steamed sea bass herself today to let her mother take a rest.
location: Tanggong Road Farmers' Market, No. 7 Jiankang East Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Hand-cooking and preparing dinner
description: Back home, she put on an apron and skillfully prepared the sea bass, slicing scallion and ginger into shreds and mixing the steamed-fish soy sauce. Her mother smiled and helped out on the side, occasionally offering little tips. While the fish was steaming and the kitchen filled with a savory aroma, her mother said with feeling, 'My daughter has really grown up.'
location: In the home kitchen at the Kaixuan Road Primary School Family Compound, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Family rehabilitation walk
description: She helped her father downstairs and walked slowly along the circular path in the community garden. Her father was in good spirits today; they walked two laps, about 100 meters, and his steps were much steadier than last time. She recorded a short video on her phone and sent it to the “Happy Family” WeChat group. Her brother liked it right away and commented, “Go, Dad!”
location: Garden of Kaixuan Road Primary School Family Compound, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Cozy dinner
description: On the dinner table were steamed sea bass, sweet and sour pork, tomato egg drop soup, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Her father picked up a piece of fish and said over and over, 'Fresh and tender!' Her mother also was full of praise for her cooking. The family chatted while eating, warm and harmonious.
location: Dining room of the home in the family compound of Kaixuan Road Primary School, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Post-meal rest and household chores
description: After the meal, she insisted on clearing and washing the dishes herself. Then she accompanied her parents in the living room to watch the evening news for a while. Her father leaned back on the sofa and rested with his eyes half closed, her mother knitted, and she used her phone to look up the latest literature on rehabilitation training on PubMed.
location: Living room and kitchen, family compound of Kaixuan Road Primary School, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Free time and preparation for making contact
description: After watching TV for too long, I felt a bit bored, so I went back to the quiet study and made myself a cup of jasmine tea. I opened my laptop, entered the rehabilitation data I had organized in the afternoon into the paper draft, and listed the key points for the evening video discussion with Zhou Haoran, especially the issue of sorting out the logic of the "Discussion" section.
location: Study at home, Family Compound of Kaixuan Road Primary School, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Have a video call with Zhou Haoran to discuss the paper
description: At 8 p.m., I started a video call with Zhou Haoran on time. He remotely guided me on how to use PubMed's advanced search techniques to precisely find literature, and helped me sort out the logical structure of the “Discussion” section of my paper. I took careful notes and resolved the questions that had been puzzling me for days. After discussing until 10 o'clock, the direction of the paper became clearer, and the weight in my heart was lifted.
location: Study at home, Kaixuan Road Primary School Family Compound, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province (video call)

name: Washed up and said goodnight.
description: After the discussion ended, she finished washing up and changed into pajamas. She walked to her parents' room and gently said goodnight. Her father was already drowsy and told her not to stay up too late. She acknowledged, softly closed the door, and returned to her own little space.
location: Home at Kaixuan Road Primary School Family Compound, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Writing diary and preparing for sleep.
description: Lying in bed, I took out my diary and wrote down the three things that moved me today: my father's progress in walking gave me hope for his recovery; my mother's anticipation of Chinese painting showed her love for life; the breakthrough in my thesis ideas filled me with confidence for the upcoming midterm report. After finishing the diary, I turned off the light and slowly fell asleep, feeling at ease and grounded.
location: Bedroom at home, Kaixuan Road Primary School Family Compound, No. 7, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Waking up naturally in the early morning amid the chirping of cicadas, I felt full of energy. After a quick wash, I changed into sportswear and running shoes and drank a glass of warm water. Hearing my mother bustling in the kitchen and smelling the aroma of spicy soup, I felt at ease.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Morning run along the Luo River
description: Walked to the starting point of the Luohe Greenway, completed a 2.5-kilometer morning jog at a pace of about 7 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. The morning breeze was gentle, the river sparkled, and the air was fresh. After the run, stretched thoroughly and asked an auntie who was doing morning exercise to take stretching photos for me, planning to share them with my best friend Zhang Jing.
location: Luopu Park, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province (greenway along the Luo River, Kaixuan West Road entrance)

name: Walking Home and Family Breakfast
description: After finishing the jog, she strolled leisurely home along the greenway. Passing the breakfast stall at the entrance of the community, she caught the aroma of fried dough sticks and quickened her pace. When she got home, her mother had already made hulatang soup, fried vegetable dumplings, and boiled eggs. The family sat around the table eating. Her mother mentioned wanting to learn traditional Chinese painting after retirement. Yu Xiaowen took note seriously and said she would look up enrollment information for the senior citizens' college when she returned to Zhengzhou. Her father shared the morning news while drinking his soup.
location: No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: After-Meal Cleanup and Relaxation
description: Helped clear the dishes, washed the dishes and wiped the table. Then I watched the morning news with my father in the living room, and sent the morning run photos to the family group with a caption about the pleasant morning in Luoyang. My brother Yu Xiaofeng liked them right away.
location: No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Accompany father on a rehabilitation walk
description: As planned, she helped her father walk slowly two laps around the loop path in the community garden, about 100 meters. Her father tried to stand alone without using the walker. Yu Xiaowen gently stopped him and reminded him that rehabilitation must proceed step by step. She recorded video and took photos throughout, and sent the video showing his good walking state to the family group. Her brother Yu Xiaofeng instantly liked it and replied with encouragement.
location: Garden trail, Residential Community No. 7, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Sorting through mother's old belongings.
description: After Father returned to his room to rest, she organized the old photo albums and calligraphy and painting materials her mother had collected in her youth together with her mother. She helped take out and smooth the yellowed drafts, and photographed them with her phone for digital archiving. While looking through old photos, her mother told funny stories about the siblings' childhood, and the living room was filled with laughter. She sorted the drafts by era for her mother's later reference.
location: Study and living room, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Family lunch.
description: Lunch was rich, with her mother's signature braised noodles and light home-style dishes. At the table, Yu Xiaowen briefly reported her work plan for the coming week and the departmental changes. Her father reminded her not to work too hard, and her mother kept telling her to take good care of herself in Zhengzhou.
location: A restaurant at No. 7, Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Noon break
description: Feeling drowsy after lunch, she returned to her own room for a half-hour nap to conserve energy for the long drive in the afternoon.
location: Bedroom, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Say goodbye to my parents and prepare for the return trip.
description: Packed the luggage and checked the car. At the door, said a reluctant goodbye to my parents. Mother stuffed a bag of tomatoes and cucumbers grown in the old house's yard into my hands, repeatedly telling me to be safe on the road. Father stood at the door, his eyes full of concern. Slowly drove away toward the Luoyang entrance of the Lianhuo Expressway.
location: No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province to the Luoyang station entrance of the Lianhuo Expressway.

name: Driving back to Zhengzhou and studying medical English
description: Merged onto the Lianhuo Expressway, connected the phone to the car stereo via Bluetooth, and played the Medical English 600 Words podcast. The drive encountered mild congestion, so she used the time in traffic to silently memorize 10 newly learned words in the phone's memo and tried to make sentences to consolidate her memory.
location: G30 Lianhuo Expressway (Luoyang Toll Station to Zhengzhou Gouzhao Toll Station section)

name: Arrived home and organized belongings
description: Drove back smoothly to the home on Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. Put the tomatoes and cucumbers into the fridge, and tossed the laundry into the washing machine. Changed into loungewear; the fatigue of the trip dissipated and my mind returned to calm.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon tea and message replies
description: Made a cup of jasmine tea, ate a few snacks brought from Luoyang, sat on the sofa scrolling through her phone, replied to messages from her best friend Zhang Jing, and chatted about today's activities and Luoyang experiences.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Baduanjin practice on the balcony
description: She rolled out her yoga mat on the balcony and practiced Baduanjin for 15 minutes. The movements were smooth and stretching, effectively relieving shoulder and neck fatigue, and she felt the tranquility she had brought back from Luoyang. After finishing, she stood on the balcony, looked into the distance, and rested for a while.
location: balcony at home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Trimming the pottery tea cup
description: I changed into an old T-shirt and an apron, and laid out the semi-finished tea bowl with the line draft painted last time at Shenghuali Pottery Studio, along with the trimming tools. I carefully studied the moisture level of the clay body, picked up the trimming knife, and concentrated fully on thinning the cup wall, adjusting the curve, and shaping a slightly flared rim. I was completely immersed in the tranquility of creation and did not stop until I felt hungry.
location: Home study / temporary work desk, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Simple evening meal and video call with family
description: She made a simple bowl of egg noodles with tomatoes from the old house, added some green vegetables; it was light and satisfying. While eating, she video-called her family, reported that she had arrived home safely and had dinner, mentioned again that her mother wanted to learn traditional Chinese painting, and said she would help look up materials next week.
location: Kitchen/dining room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Washing up and relaxing, journaling and meditating, and going to bed
description: After thoroughly washing up, I applied a hydrating mask to soothe my skin. I read a passage from Liang Shiqiu's essay collection Leisure Is Where Life Is. Then I noted down three touching things from today in my diary: my father's progress in walking, the old drawings my mother had kept, and the focused contentment of trimming pottery. I did five minutes of mindful breathing to clear my mind of stray thoughts, turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: In the early morning, Yu Xiaowen practiced Baduanjin on the balcony, focusing on the movement 'Look Back to Relieve the Five Strains and Seven Injuries' to ease shoulder and neck soreness, then did leg stretches. Afterward, she went to the bathroom to wash up, applied sunscreen, and changed into a light blue striped shirt and dark gray wide-leg pants. In the kitchen, she made oatmeal with milk, added washed and chopped Luoyang flat peach as breakfast, and checked the weather (high of 36°C), deciding to park the car in a spot with a sunshade at the hospital. Then she packed another flat peach in a fresh-keeping bag to bring to Wang Fang.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (Building 14, Qunying Road)

name: Commute to the hospital
description: Yu Xiaowen drove from home to Zhengzhou Central Hospital along Jingsan Road and Zhongyuan Road, taking about 15 minutes.
location: From Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province
