description: After clocking in, Yu Xiaowen arrived at the department, reviewed the admissions, and organized the shift handover records. In the break room, she communicated with Teacher Li Wei about the basic conditions of today's critically ill patients and confirmed the focus of the ward round.
location: Doctor's office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (Inpatient Building 1, 6th Floor)

name: Morning handover and ward rounds
description: Attended the department morning meeting and listened to the on-duty doctor's report. Then followed Teacher Li Wei on the major ward rounds. Yu Xiaowen reported the condition changes and examination results of the patients under her charge, recorded the director's treatment adjustment opinions, and communicated with the patients and their families.
location: Doctor's offices and wards, inpatient department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Revise and submit the first draft of the paper
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to her workstation, opened her laptop, and integrated the literature viewpoints sent by Zhou Haoran and the statistical suggestions from senior fellow student Liu Qiang into the 'Discussion' section of the paper. After carefully weighing every word, at 11:15 she sent the revised draft to Director Zhang Lei through the hospital OA system, with an attached message asking for his guidance.
location: Workstation in the inpatient department office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handling medical orders and medical records
description: Yu Xiaowen opened the HIS system, processed the updated medical orders after ward rounds, and wrote discharge summaries for patients about to be discharged. During this period, she browsed WeChat messages from her mother, learned that her mother was very happy sorting through photo albums, and replied that work had gone smoothly today.
location: Workstation in the inpatient department office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: Yu Xiaowen waited for Wang Fang at the entrance of the cafeteria, and the two ordered set meals. She handed the flat peach to Wang Fang, who was pleasantly surprised. They chatted while eating, and Wang Fang showed the wedding company's decoration plan. Yu Xiaowen suggested using vintage kraft paper for the wedding invitations. After the meal, Yu Xiaowen went to the teaching room to do the neck and shoulder relaxation exercises, then rested with her eyes closed on the sofa in the duty room for half an hour.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital staff cafeteria (B1 floor, Inpatient Department), demonstration room, and duty room (6th floor, Inpatient Building No. 1), No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work
description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen was busy processing admission records for new patients and had a twenty-minute conversation with the family of a patient whose condition had worsened, explaining the treatment plan and prognosis. During this time, she answered an impromptu emergency consultation call and adjusted medication orders for two patients.
location: Doctor's offices and wards, inpatient department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handover and tidy-up before leaving work
description: Yu Xiaowen finished writing and signing all medical records, opened her planner to confirm that the handover for tomorrow's return to Luoyang for a follow-up was properly arranged, communicated with the on-duty colleague about patients needing attention, and tidied her desk.
location: Office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Commute home
description: Yu Xiaowen drove from the hospital back home, avoiding rush-hour traffic congestion, and planned the key review points for arrhythmia on the way.
location: From Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Qunying Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner preparation and dining.
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowen took off her white coat and washed her hands. She cooked a light bowl of tomato egg noodles with eggs, tomatoes, and green vegetables, stir-fried a seasonal vegetable, and had a simple meal.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-dinner relaxation and family contact.
description: After washing the dishes, Yu Xiaowen sat by the bay window in the living room, played classical piano music, video-called her mother, and shared the news of her paper being accepted and amusing stories from Wang Fang's wedding. Her mother listened happily, and they chatted for more than twenty minutes.
location: Bay window in the living room at home, Qunying Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening exam preparation.
description: Yu Xiaowen sat at her desk, took out the arrhythmia chapter of Internal Medicine and a practice problem set, systematically reviewed the mechanisms and drug treatments for common arrhythmias such as atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia, and finished 15 practice questions. After checking the answers, she copied the 3 wrong questions into her error notebook and filled in the gaps.
location: At the desk at home in Qunying Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Mindful breathing meditation
description: Yu Xiaowen leaned back in her chair, put on her earphones, opened the meditation app, and followed the guide for ten minutes of mindful breathing. After finishing, she felt clear-headed and her fatigue dissipated.
location: At the desk at home in Qunying Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Packing for tomorrow
description: Yu Xiaowen took out a travel bag from the wardrobe, put in a change of T-shirts, pajamas, and a charger, then took Rehabilitation Medicine from the bookshelf, and put a box of sugar-free biscuits purchased at the Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop (for her father) into the bag.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Check Zhou Haoran's literature
description: Yu Xiaowen checked her phone and saw the latest cardiac rehabilitation review PDF link sent by Zhou Haoran. She quickly skimmed the abstract and figures, found that the exercise prescription design matched the direction of her paper, and excitedly replied, 'So timely! I'll study it tonight!'
location: At the desk at home in Qunying Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening washing up, planning, and reading before bed.
description: Yu Xiaowen took a hot shower, applied toner and moisturizer, and put on a hydrating face mask. She sat on the edge of the bed and wrote in her diary the three small things from that day: the paper was submitted smoothly, Wang Fang's expression at the idea of the invitation, and the peace of meditation. Then she set an alarm for 6:10 the next morning, checked navigation to confirm the road conditions back to Luoyang, and prepared her clothes for the next day. After lying down, she read Liang Shiqiu's essay collection "Yashe Essays" until around 23:00, then turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom in the home, Qunying Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning preparation and departure
description: Woke up at 7 a.m., laid out a yoga mat on the balcony at home in Qunying Residential Community, and did a 10-minute gentle stretch, focusing on relieving shoulder and neck soreness, while going over the plan for returning to Luoyang today in my mind. Then I quickly made milk cereal and ate whole wheat bread as a simple breakfast. While eating, I checked my carry-on backpack to confirm items like my wallet, phone charger, sugar-free biscuits, and notebook. After that, I sent a WeChat message to my mother Li Xiuying telling her I was about to leave, finally checked the house key, and went downstairs to the garage.
location: Balcony, kitchen, and garage at home, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 23 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Drive to Luoyang
description: Set out from home in Zhengzhou and drove via the Lianhuo Expressway to her hometown in Luoyang. On the way, she played a cardiac rehabilitation review recommended by Zhou Haoran through the car's Bluetooth, focusing on key information and planning to use it when talking with her father in the afternoon. Traffic was normal, and she arrived in Luoyang around 9 o'clock. After getting off the expressway, she headed to the old house on Kaixuan Road at 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang.
location: Departed from Qunying Community, No. 23 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, drove along the Lianhuo Expressway, and arrived at the old Kaixuan Road residence at No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Arrival, observation, and counseling preparation
description: She arrived at the home in Luoyang. Her mother opened the door, and she saw her father sitting on the living room sofa looking glum. Yu Xiaowen went over and softly asked how her father was feeling today, keenly sensing his low mood. She then went into the study, took out a notebook, and, based on the rehabilitation review and motivational interviewing techniques she had listened to on the way, quickly outlined a conversation framework: first empathize and acknowledge how hard rehabilitation is, then use open-ended questions to guide him in recalling experiences of overcoming difficulties, and organize the short videos of his rehabilitation training from the past three weeks on her phone to prepare for the upcoming conversation.
location: Living room and study of the old house at No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Having a heart-to-heart talk with her father and demonstrating rehabilitation progress.
description: After brewing his favorite jasmine tea, she sat down beside her father and opened with the old photo frames newly placed in the living room, guiding him to recall his experience teaching a senior high school graduating class when he was young, talking about how he had heart-to-heart talks with students and how he created and predicted exam questions. Gradually, his tone became full of pride. Seeing his mood improve, she took out her phone and played the comparison videos of his rehabilitation training from the past three weeks, analyzing frame by frame the progress in gait and support time. After watching carefully, her father smiled, reached out and patted her head in praise, saying that he really had improved a lot.
location: Living room of the old house on Kaixuan Road, 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Help mother prepare lunch.
description: She went to the kitchen to help her mother, Li Xiuying, with the cooking, washing vegetables and peeling garlic, and quietly shared the good progress she had just made in talking with her father. Her mother smiled with relief. Her mother told her she had bought pork ribs today and planned to make braised pork ribs and stir-fried tomatoes with scrambled eggs, both dishes her father loved.
location: Kitchen of the old Kaixuan Road house, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Family lunch and midday rest
description: The family of three sat around the dining table. Her father had a better appetite than in the previous few days and actively picked up several pieces of spare ribs. During the meal, Yu Xiaowen shared interesting stories from the department and the news that her submitted paper had been praised by the department director. Her parents listened with great interest, and the atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious. After dinner, she helped clear the tableware, then returned to her childhood room and lay on the bed for a short rest of about 40 minutes, relieving the fatigue from the morning drive and the effortful communication.
location: Kaixuan Road Old House dining room and bedroom, No. 7 West Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Afternoon stroll in the old town.
description: After waking from her nap, she went downstairs alone. First she took a walk in the community garden to breathe fresh air and reflect on the morning conversation, feeling more confident about the afternoon plan. Then she walked to the old town, visited the area near Jianhuayuan Community at No. 2 Chundu Road, looked at the old buildings, and felt the changes in Luoyang. On the way back, she bought two pomegranates at a fruit stall at the north gate of the community, planning to bring them to her mother, who loves pomegranates.
location: Starting from the old Kaixuan Road residence at 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, walk to the vicinity of Jianhua Garden Residential Community at 2 Chundu Road, Laocheng District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, and then return.

name: Deep heart-to-heart talk and rehabilitation walking
description: She made tea again and sat down face to face with her father, opening with “constant dripping wears through stone.” She listened patiently to her father's anxiety about the long rehabilitation period and his fear that he would not recover to how he was before. Using medical knowledge, she explained the staged nature of rehabilitation and guided him to treat it as a new “problem” to solve, just as he had once tackled difficult math problems. Her father listened attentively and nodded from time to time. The talk was effective, so, striking while the iron was hot, she helped her father downstairs and, on the walking path of the community fitness area adjacent to Kaixuan Road Primary School, encouraged him to take a few more steps with the aid of a walker while she recorded his walking on her phone. After he finished, his eyes brightened, and he said voluntarily, “I can walk another circle tomorrow.”
location: Living room of the old residence at No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, and the community fitness area beside the playground of Kaixuan Road Primary School

name: Prepare mutton stewed noodles and the family dinner with mother
description: She entered the kitchen with her mother and took out lamb, flour, shredded kelp, cilantro, and other ingredients to make the family's favorite lamb stewed noodles. Yu Xiaowen was in charge of kneading the dough, washing the vegetables, and cutting the kelp, while her mother deftly simmered the lamb soup. Father, as expected, moved to the kitchen doorway on his crutch, sat on a small stool and "directed," commenting on the thickness of the noodle pieces and the timing for adding the lamb to the pot. This sense of participation made him spirited. With the joint efforts of her parents, a pot of fragrant lamb stewed noodles was ready, and the whole family sat around to enjoy it. Father slurped a big mouthful of noodles and praised repeatedly that this was exactly the flavor, better than restaurants outside. Seeing her parents so happy, Yu Xiaowen felt that all the rushing and worrying was worth it.
location: Kitchen and dining room of the old house on Kaixuan Road, No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Watching the news and chatting with parents
description: After dinner, she cleared the dishes and chopsticks, sat between her parents, and watched CCTV News together. When the news about the renovation of old residential communities came on, her father mentioned the newly installed charging piles downstairs. Yu Xiaowen rested her head on her mother's shoulder, quietly enjoying this rare moment of family warmth.
location: Living room of the old house on Kaixuan Road, 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Organize the counseling notes in the study and share them.
description: Back in the study, I opened my laptop and carefully recorded the psychological counseling process of the day in English, writing down in detail my father's depressed appearance, his underlying anxiety, the motivational interviewing techniques used, and the psychological changes he went through from resistance to rebuilding confidence, as a deep professional reflection. When I finished, I took a screenshot of the notes and sent it to the family WeChat group with a message asking my brother to review. My brother Yu Xiaofeng, far away in Shenzhen, quickly replied with a thumbs-up emoji and praised, "Awesome, Xiaowen." The three of us chatted happily online for more than ten minutes.
location: Study room at the old house on Kaixuan Road, 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Washing up and pre-bed record
description: After saying goodnight to my parents, I went back to my room to wash up and put on a face mask. Lying in bed, scenes from the day kept replaying: the moment my father patted his head, the warm hustle of the whole family making hui noodles, and my brother's like in the group chat. I was too excited to fall asleep, so I opened the memo app on my phone and wrote down the three things that moved me most today: the look in my father's eyes as his confidence was rekindled, the scene of the whole family making hui noodles, and the self-affirmation of successfully using professional knowledge to help my family. After writing, I gradually calmed down and fell into a deep sleep with satisfaction and emotion just before midnight.
location: Bathroom and bedroom of the old Kaixuan residence at No. 7 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Drove back from Luoyang to Zhengzhou in the early morning
description: At 5:30 in the morning the alarm rang on time. After quickly washing up, she took her backpack and Luoyang specialty products, set out from the old house on Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, and drove onto the Lianhuo Expressway. The road was excellent in the early morning, so she drove at a steady speed the whole way, using the car's Bluetooth to play medical English listening materials to stay focused. About 1 hour and 35 minutes later, at 7:05, she smoothly entered Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, and parked the car under the Qunying Community building.
location: Lianhuo Expressway, Henan Province, China (section from Xigong District, Luoyang to Jinshui District, Zhengzhou)

name: Morning tidying and Baduanjin practice
description: Back at her home in Qunying Community, she first put away the clothes and local specialties she had brought back from Luoyang, then changed into sportswear and practiced her daily Baduanjin on the yoga mat on the living room balcony, with soft music and smooth, flowing movements. Afterward, she confirmed via WeChat with her father Yu Jianguo that the 5,000 yuan rehabilitation training fee for July had been deposited into the designated account on time, and set up a scheduled transfer reminder for July 15.
location: Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Prepare and enjoy a simple breakfast.
description: After taking a quick warm shower, I made oatmeal with milk in the kitchen, paired it with a banana and a boiled egg, and finished breakfast quickly while standing by the window. At the same time, I packed my work badge, notebook, thermos cup, and sun-protection jacket for the day into my commuter backpack.
location: Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Commute to the hospital by car.
description: I took my commuter bag, went downstairs, started the car, turned on the air conditioning, and set off from Qunying Community to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Ten minutes later, I drove into the hospital parking lot right at 8:00.
location: No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Tidy up workstation and prepare for the morning meeting.
description: Arriving at the respiratory medicine office, she quickly put on her white coat, returned to her workstation, turned on the computer, quickly skimmed the list of patients for handover today, and jotted down key questions for ward rounds in her notebook to prepare for the morning meeting.
location: Respiratory Medicine Department office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Department morning meeting and full ward rounds
description: Attended the department morning handover meeting promptly and listened carefully to the night-shift nurse's report on patients' overnight conditions. Then followed Dr. Li Wei and the medical team on routine grand rounds, focusing on reporting the changes in condition and treatment responses of the patients under my care, and carefully recorded Dr. Li Wei's key diagnosis and treatment points for each patient, especially the newly admitted pneumonia patient.
location: Doctor's office and ward of the Department of Respiratory Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China

name: Receive and review paper feedback
description: After ward rounds, she returned to her workstation, logged into the hospital OA system, and saw the review email from Director Zhang Lei about the paper draft. After affirming the topic selection, the director annotated the "Multivariate Analysis of Rehabilitation Prognosis" section with comments, suggesting that the argumentation be strengthened and that the latest literature be cited. Lin Xiao read the comments one by one and took photos with her phone to archive them, so she could think about them after work.
location: Respiratory Medicine Department office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Clinical work and patient communication
description: After dealing with emails, I started routine clinical work: adjusting some patients' medication orders according to ward-round instructions, writing progress notes, and communicating with family members of patients whose conditions had changed—for example, explaining the treatment plan in detail to the son of Uncle Li in Bed 35.
location: Respiratory Medicine office and ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Had lunch with colleague Wang Fang
description: At noon, she had lunch with Wang Fang, a doctor on the same team, at the hospital staff cafeteria. While eating, Lin Xiao shared the story of accompanying her father back in Luoyang yesterday and the experience of using the metaphor of dripping water wearing through stone to help her father regain confidence in his recovery. Wang Fang was moved and praised Lin Xiao's communication skills.
location: Staff Canteen of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Contacted a financial advisor during the lunch break.
description: After lunch, returned to the doctors' rest room and called financial advisor Wang Mingyuan, briefly explaining that due to the recent increase in expenses for her father's rehabilitation, she wanted to adjust the risk preference of the fund allocation. He suggested meeting at 3 p.m. at the cafe downstairs from China Merchants Bank near the hospital. After the call, she did five minutes of neck and shoulder stretches, then took a 20-minute nap.
location: Doctors' Rest Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China

name: Afternoon clinical work and medical record handling.
description: In the afternoon, I continued processing the medical records of the two patients admitted yesterday, completing the admission records and treatment plans. Meanwhile, I asked Dr. Li Wei for details about the treatment plan for a patient with pleural effusion and received clear guidance.
location: Respiratory Medicine office and ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Assisted with thoracentesis.
description: Assisted Teacher Li Wei on time in performing a thoracentesis on a patient, prepared the ultrasound-guided equipment and sterile puncture kit in advance, smoothly passed instruments during the procedure, and carefully observed the teacher's technique. After the procedure, Teacher Li Wei praised Lin Xiao for her aseptic awareness and teamwork.
location: Treatment room, Department of Respiratory Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Work arrangements before leaving the office
description: After the operation, she returned to the office, organized the discharge summaries that needed to be completed that day, and compiled the shift handover records. She quickly reviewed Director Zhang Lei's comments on the paper and sketched a rough framework for the evening revisions.
location: Respiratory Medicine Department office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Aerobic exercise in the staff gym
description: She changed into her workout clothes and went to the gym in the staff activity center, Building B, of the hospital. She did 30 minutes of aerobic training on the elliptical machine, keeping her heart rate around 140 beats per minute, and listened to light music while exercising. After finishing, she did 5 minutes of stretching to relieve shoulder and neck fatigue.
location: Gym, Staff Activity Center, Building B, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Going home for dinner and rest
description: Drove back to the house in Qunying Community, took a quick shower, then made a fruit and oat salad with yogurt for dinner, and ate it standing at the kitchen island. After that, she sat on the sofa for a short rest and replied to the WeChat message from her close friend Zhang Jing.
location: Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Return to the hospital office to revise the paper
description: Since the hospital literature database could not be accessed from home, she drove back to the hospital office. She brewed a cup of tea, turned on the computer, and devoted herself entirely to revising the paper. She created a new section specifically to expand the "multivariate analysis of rehabilitation prognosis," accessed the hospital literature database, and reviewed the three latest cardiac rehabilitation review articles recommended by her colleague Zhou Haoran and the statistical methods notes shared by senior Liu Qiang, ensuring rigorous data analysis.
location: Respiratory Medicine Department office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Drive home and talk with family
description: She saved and backed up the revised paper, packed her things, and drove home. On the way, she called her mother Li Xiuying via Bluetooth earphones for a video call, letting her know she was safe and telling her that work was going well and the paper had a clear direction, so that her parents would feel reassured. The call lasted about 10 minutes.
location: Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China (on the way driving from No. 16 Tongbai North Road back to No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District)

name: Evening washing and self-care
description: Returned home to do evening washing up; after removing makeup and cleansing the face, applied a hydrating mask. Lying in bed, opened the diary to record three touching things today: the reassurance that Father confirmed receipt of the rehabilitation expenses, Dr. Li Wei's praise for the puncture procedure, and the immersion of focusing on paper revisions in the evening.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Reading before bed and preparing for sleep.
description: Turned off the main light, turned on the bedside lamp, and read a few essays from Liang Shiqiu's The Elegant House on Eating, enjoying quiet personal time. At 23:30, put down the book, set the alarm for 6:20 tomorrow morning, and turned off the light to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China

name: Morning jog and journaling
description: At 6 a.m., Yu Xiaowen got up quickly after the alarm went off, changed into workout gear, washed up briefly, drank a glass of warm water, and then walked from her home on Qunying Road, Jinshui District, to Jinshui River Riverside Park. She jogged 3 kilometers on the tree-lined path from Dongfeng Road to Nongye Road at a pace of about 7 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer. The morning breeze carried the coolness of the river, and she felt very refreshed. After the run, she did a full set of stretches on a bench, then took river view photos with her phone under the Nongye Road bridge, paired them with a screenshot of her sports watch data, and wrote "Week 3, 3 kilometers achieved. A change of mood—running along the river is great too" to post on Moments. Finally, she walked home along Qunying Road.
location: Jinshui River Riverside Park, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (Dongfeng Road to Nongye Road section), starting and ending at Qunying Community

name: Shower, breakfast, and chores.
description: After returning home from the morning run, Yu Xiaowen first took a few minutes of deep breathing to settle down, then quickly showered to wash off the sweat. In front of the mirror, she blow-dried her hair and applied sunscreen and primer. She put last night's clothes into the washing machine for a pre-wash and prepared for her night shift. Then in the kitchen she made a bowl of cereal with milk, paired with half a dragon fruit and blueberries as breakfast. While eating, she browsed medical news and department group messages on her phone. After finishing, she quickly washed the dishes, put the dried cups back in place, and kept the home tidy.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Commute to the hospital by car.
description: Yu Xiaowen carried her commuter bag and water bottle downstairs, then drove from Qunying Residential Area to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The traffic was smooth along the way; she turned on the radio to listen to the morning traffic report and arrived at the hospital parking lot in less than fifteen minutes.
location: From Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou

name: Morning meeting and departmental grand rounds.
description: After parking her car, Yu Xiaowen walked to the doctors' office in the inpatient department, put down her personal items, and opened mobile banking to check her account balance and transfer limit. At 8:00 sharp, she attended the department morning meeting and listened to the night-shift colleagues' handover reports. Then she followed Dr. Li Wei, her supervising physician, on the major ward round, accompanied by colleagues including Wang Fang and head nurse Wu Min, focusing on several patients with sequelae of cerebral infarction and carefully noting Dr. Li's adjusted rehabilitation orders and medication plans.
location: Doctor's offices and wards, inpatient department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Transfer the rehabilitation fee and receive a voice recording about Dad's progress
description: After the ward round, Yu Xiaowen returned to the office, logged into the bank app, transferred 5000 yuan in rehabilitation fees to the corporate account of Luoyang Rehabilitation Hospital, and took out a paper ledger from the drawer, carefully recording it under the 'medical expenses' column. Looking at the current balance of 23,000 yuan, she felt a little tense. Then she opened WeChat and left a message for her father to inform him that the transfer was completed. In less than a minute, her father instantly replied with a voice message, saying in a slightly excited voice that today he had stood steady against the wall for 10 seconds. Yu Xiaowen listened to it twice, the corners of her mouth unconsciously lifting, and saved the voice message.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Routine clinical work in the morning.
description: Her father's progress put Yu Xiaowen in a good mood, and she threw herself into the morning clinical work: sorting out medical records for newly admitted patients, verifying laboratory test results, preparing a discharge summary and take-home medication prescription for a patient about to be discharged, and patiently answering questions from two family members about the patient's condition. During this time, her colleague Wang Fang passed by, and the two briefly talked about the online cardiac rehabilitation lecture they had watched last night. Wang Fang promised to send her the link.
location: Inpatient wards and doctors' offices, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Looked up rehabilitation medicine materials.
description: To build up a theoretical basis for the evening department transfer conversation, Yu Xiaowen used a break at work to go to the Rehabilitation Medicine Department in the same building, borrowed a copy of the latest "Rehabilitation Therapy for Neurological Diseases" from the doctor on duty, quickly skimmed the cutting-edge chapters on post-stroke rehabilitation strategies combined with clinical practice, and photographed several key passages with her phone.
location: Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Making tea in the office and taking a short break
description: Back in the office, Yu Xiaowen brewed a cup of the peppermint tea she had brought, sat down in her seat for a brief rest, and while sipping the fragrant tea, quickly flipped through the book contents she had just photographed, jotting down keywords such as "early rehabilitation intervention" and "multidisciplinary collaboration" in her phone memo.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At 11:30, Yu Xiaowen arrived at the staff canteen on time, ordered a newly launched dish of cold buckwheat noodles with shredded chicken and a serving of greens, and ate lunch quietly by herself by the window. After the meal, she returned to the duty room, drew the curtains, dimmed the lights, put on an eye mask, and listened to soft instrumental music, forcing herself to relax. She slept for about 40 minutes to conserve energy for the work ahead.
location: Staff cafeteria and duty room of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work and midday break
description: After the lunch break, her energy recovered considerably. Yu Xiaowen devoted herself to the afternoon's work: handling the medical records of a newly admitted patient with vertigo, ordering examination forms, and explaining the condition and initial diagnosis and treatment plan to the patient's family in detail; also having a brief communication about the condition with a patient about to be transferred to another department, and comforting the patient. In between, she returned to the duty room to drink water and rest, opened her phone and listened to about a quarter of an hour of Debussy's 'Clair de Lune', which soothed her tense nerves.
location: Inpatient ward and duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Paperwork and afternoon shift handover
description: Yu Xiaowen began preparing the afternoon shift handover records, checking all inpatients' orders and test results for the day, and organizing unfinished discharge records to ensure the night shift handover was clear and complete. At 5 p.m. she had a detailed handover with the incoming night-shift doctor, focusing on the precautions and emergency response plans for several unstable patients, and signed the handover records.
location: Doctor's Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and shopping
description: After the shift handover, Yu Xiaowen walked about 10 minutes to Zheng Xiaojia Dacheng Xiaojia community restaurant near the hospital and had a steaming bowl of tomato and egg noodles. Then she walked along the way to Dennis Fresh Mart, where she bought a bag of mint tea, a jar of goji berries, a box of blueberries, and a few cucumbers to restock the refrigerator. She then walked back to the hospital.
location: Zheng Xiaojia Big City Small Home Community Restaurant, No. 8 Compound, Rantun East Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, and Dennis All-Day Fresh (Hanting Hotel Branch), No. 66 Jianshe West Road, then returned to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road.

name: Plan the department rotation conversation
description: After returning to the duty room and putting things away, Yu Xiaowen opened her phone and looked through the photos and videos comparing her father's rehabilitation progress, and listened once more to the morning voice memo about "holding the wall for 10 seconds." She took a deep breath, took out a blank page of the duty log, and wrote down the core points of the department transfer conversation: the deep insight and motivation gained from family care, strong research interest in neurological rehabilitation and cardiopulmonary rehabilitation, and the clinical value and prospects of rehabilitation medicine.
location: Duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Night shift early-stage work and rounds
description: The ward was relatively quiet in the evening, and Yu Xiaowen began her night shift. Around 8 o'clock, the emergency department admitted a patient with chest pain. She quickly attended to the patient, took a medical history, ordered tests, and contacted the on-duty cardiologist for consultation. Before 9 o'clock, she made rounds on time, checked the vital signs of several key patients, and comforted an elderly person who was anxious because of insomnia.
location: Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Refine the department rotation plan and take a short break
description: After finishing ward rounds and handling emergency patients, Yu Xiaowen felt her thinking was clearer. Returning to the duty room, she refined the key points of the earlier conversation into three logically clear sections and added specific cases and thoughts. Around 22:00, she heated a glass of milk on the small electric stove in the duty room and drank it slowly, while replying to her mother's message of reminders, saying that everything was going well.
location: Duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Late-night in-depth talk with the supervising physician about transferring departments.
description: After the ward fell completely quiet, Yu Xiaowen knocked on the door of Teacher Li Wei's rest room and honestly explained her wish to transfer to the rehabilitation department. She began with her father's rehabilitation journey after two strokes, spoke about how deeply she had been moved and her growing research interest in rehabilitation medicine, and finally expressed her hope to combine clinical practice with rehabilitation research. Teacher Li listened, expressed understanding and support, promised to privately convey her wish to Director Zhang, and encouraged her to prepare well. Yu Xiaowen felt relieved, with an unprecedented sense of lightness and determination.
location: Doctor Li Wei's lounge, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Late-night rounds and patient condition management
description: Feeling pleased after talking with Dr. Li, Yu Xiaowen did her routine night-shift rounds. The test results for the chest pain patient admitted earlier ruled out myocardial infarction, so she could feel at ease. She checked again on the elderly patient with insomnia and found the old man sound asleep. The entire ward was quiet.
location: Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Late-night reading and rest
description: In the early morning, the ward was quiet. Yu Xiaowen returned to the on-duty room, brewed a cup of mint tea she had bought in the morning, opened the book 'Rehabilitation Therapy for Neurological Diseases' borrowed from the rehabilitation department, and focused on reading and taking notes about stroke prognosis assessment and multidisciplinary rehabilitation models. Soft classical piano music played on a loop on her phone.
location: Duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Night shift nap
description: At around 1:30 a.m., feeling sleepy, Yu Xiaowen set her alarm and lay down fully clothed on the bed in the duty rest room, ready to respond to emergencies at any time. With expectations for the future, she soon fell into a light sleep.
location: On-call rest room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Returning home after the night shift and relaxing in the morning
description: After finishing the 24-hour hospital shift and handing over duties, I drove home. Although somewhat tired, I felt relaxed. Once home, I took off my white coat and changed into comfortable loungewear. I sat quietly on the sofa for a few minutes, feeling my body release from tension. I took out my phone and played the voice message of my father saying he had 'stood against the wall for 10 seconds' again, and a relieved smile appeared on my face.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Simple breakfast and today's plan
description: In the kitchen, she heated a glass of milk, ate two slices of whole wheat bread and an apple. While eating, she quickly sorted out today's to-do list in her phone memo: catch up on sleep, contact the financial advisor to confirm tomorrow's meeting details, pick up the physical examination report, go shopping to relax, write the application, and call Mom. Thinking of Teacher Li Wei's promise last night, she felt full of motivation.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Catching up on sleep to restore energy
description: I drew the bedroom curtains to create a completely dark and quiet environment. Although my body was exhausted, my mind was a bit restless. Lying in bed, I took a few deep breaths with my eyes closed before slowly drifting off to sleep. I slept for a full two hours and felt much more refreshed when I woke up.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Got up, washed up, and contacted the financial advisor.
description: After getting up, she washed her face with cold water and quickly freshened up. Sitting on the sofa, she opened WeChat and sent a message to her financial advisor, Wang Mingyuan, to confirm the details of tomorrow's meeting, along with the prepared Excel file of household income and expenses. Wang Mingyuan quickly replied to confirm, and Yu Xiaowen agreed to meet him tomorrow at 3 p.m. at the café downstairs of China Merchants Bank.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Brunch and light housework
description: Made a simple tomato and egg noodle dish as brunch. After eating, I washed the dishes and put yesterday's white coat into the washing machine. While the machine was running, I tidied up the house a bit and opened the windows for ventilation.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and outlining thoughts on the department transfer application
description: The morning catch-up sleep only relieved fatigue; this nap was the real afternoon rest. She lay in bed for half an hour, half awake and half asleep. After waking up, she did not get up immediately but leaned against the headboard and began outlining the department transfer application she planned to draft that evening in her phone's memo app. She listed the core points: “father's rehabilitation experience,” “change in understanding of rehabilitation medicine,” and “personal career planning.”
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove to the hospital
description: She walked from home to the entrance of the residential complex, got into the car, and drove to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. There was not much traffic, and she arrived at the hospital in about ten minutes.
location: On the way from Qunying Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to No. 16, Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou

name: Picked up the health check report and learned the good news about the department transfer
description: After parking the car, she went directly to the physical examination center in the administration building. At the front desk, she gave her name and employee ID, and the nurse quickly found her physical examination report. Flipping through it on the spot, she saw that most indicators were within the normal range, but in the bone density column it was marked "Osteopenia (T-score -1.2)", with a suggestion to pay attention to calcium and vitamin D intake; she kept this in mind. After getting the report, she found a bench in the small garden downstairs of the inpatient building and sat down, preparing to send a WeChat message to Teacher Li Wei. At that moment, her phone vibrated first, and she received a message from Teacher Li Wei: "Xiaowen, regarding the idea you talked to me about last night, after my outpatient clinic this morning, while Director Zhang was in the office, I mentioned it to him. He was surprised by your initiative to change departments, but expressed support and asked you to submit a formal written application. Prepare well, this is a key step." Seeing this message, her heart jumped, and she was so excited that she almost stood up from the bench. She immediately replied with gratitude and resolved to prepare seriously.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Relaxing by shopping and strolling
description: Left the hospital with excitement and drove to Zijingshan Department Store. First went to a pharmacy and bought a bottle of Caltrate D tablets. Then strolled leisurely to the women's fashion section on the second floor, and in a brand store she had liked before, carefully picked out a light blue linen shirt. She tried on two and finally chose one with a flattering fit and skin-friendly fabric. At checkout she felt especially happy, as if the shirt also symbolized a new beginning.
location: New World Department Store (Zhengzhou Store), Zijingshan Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Resting at a café and letting her thoughts settle
description: After leaving Zijingshan Department Store, I drove about 15 minutes to Xiyuan Plaza. I chose a quiet Gloria Jean's Coffees, ordered a hot latte, and sat in a corner by the window. I read Teacher Li Wei's message over and over, and my excitement had not yet calmed down. I took out the notebook I carried with me and began writing a draft outline of the department transfer application, making the points I had sorted out during the lunch break more specific and better organized.
location: Gloria Jean's Coffees, Xiyuan Plaza, Qinling Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Returned, doing shopping along the way
description: After drinking coffee, I drove home. Passing the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road, I got out and bought half a jin of millet and a few fresh tomatoes to prepare for tomorrow's breakfast. Then I returned to the residential compound.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Dinner preparation and Baduanjin practice
description: After returning home, she first put away the calcium tablets and shirt she had just bought. Then she changed into workout clothes and followed an app on the balcony to practice Baduanjin for 15 minutes, stretching her muscles and joints that had become stiff from night shifts and prolonged sitting. After the exercise, she began preparing dinner, deciding to make a light winter melon meatball soup and a stir-fried seasonal vegetable dish—nutritious and healthy.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Enjoying dinner
description: While eating a hot dinner, she opened her phone and scrolled through social media. She saw that her badminton partner Lin Wei had posted in the group that all badminton courts on Saturday afternoon had been booked up, and felt glad she had already reserved a Saturday evening court earlier in the week. Her mood during dinner was very relaxed and happy.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-dinner walk and evening preparations
description: After dinner, she changed into flat shoes, went downstairs, and took a 20-minute slow walk in the community garden to aid digestion and completely clear her mind. After returning home, she first took a comfortable hot shower, changed into loose loungewear, then made herself a cup of rose tea and got ready to start the most important task of the evening.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Draft the department transfer application and review the detailed rules
description: She sat down at the desk, opened her laptop, and created a new Word document. After thinking for a moment, she began typing the title: 'Application for Transfer from Cardiology to Rehabilitation Medicine.' She explained in detail her observations and reflections as a family member accompanying her father after his two strokes, and the mental journey this triggered in her toward rehabilitation medicine, from 'vague awareness' to 'firm pursuit.' Then, based on her professional background, she explained her understanding of rehabilitation medicine, her future study plan, and career planning. After finishing, she spent another half hour carefully reviewing the latest details and further training requirements for standardized residency training in rehabilitation medicine on the hospital's official website, and made notes at the end of the document.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: After the video call connected, mother Li Xiuying appeared on the screen, beaming with joy. Yu Xiaowen could not wait to tell her the good news she had received today: "Teacher Li Wei helped communicate about switching departments, and Director Zhang agreed to write the application." Her mother was very happy to hear this, urged her to write it carefully and not be careless, and also told her to take care of herself and not get too tired. Yu Xiaowen also shared again the news that her father had stood against the wall for 10 seconds, and both of them were glad. The mother and daughter exchanged many intimate words, and the video call lasted more than 40 minutes.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening relaxation and journaling
description: After finishing the phone call with my mother, I felt very relieved. I opened my diary and recorded the most important moments of today: receiving a message from Teacher Li Wei, writing the first draft of the department transfer application, and my mother's smile. After writing the diary, I opened the Tide app and followed the guidance for a 10-minute mindful breathing exercise, focusing on my breath and letting my mind become completely calm.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Skincare before bed and preparation for tomorrow.
description: After applying a hydrating face mask, she lay in bed and let her mind go blank. She did a final check of the materials for tomorrow's meeting with the financial advisor (income and expense statement, etc.), confirmed everything was ready, set the alarm for 8:30 tomorrow morning, and prepared to sleep.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Going to bed
description: With anticipation for tomorrow and confidence in the future, she closed her eyes and soon fell into a peaceful sleep. Weight: 48.4 kg.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning preparation and walking to the sports hall.
description: Woke up naturally at 7 a.m., practiced Baduanjin for 15 minutes on the yoga mat in the living room to stretch her shoulders, neck, and joints, then washed up and tied her hair into a high ponytail. For breakfast, she heated milk oatmeal in the microwave, paired it with fresh blueberries and a boiled egg, and browsed the badminton group chat on her phone while eating, confirming that Lin Wei had left and noting that the day's high was 37°C. After the meal, she tidied the quilt in the bedroom, hand-washed and hung out the T-shirt she had changed out of, and checked her sports bag to make sure she had brought a spare T-shirt, towel, electrolyte water, and keys. Wearing a sun hat and sports sunglasses, she set out from the east gate of Qunying Residential Complex, turned east along Qunying Road onto Zhengqi Street, and walked about 12 minutes to reach the Maiya Badminton Hall.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Badminton doubles and socializing.
description: After arriving at the badminton hall, I checked in and swiped my membership card to open the court. I saw Lin Wei already stretching. We warmed up together with high knees, wrist and ankle circles, and other exercises. At 9 o'clock, I partnered with Lin Wei in a doubles match against two other players. I was in good form, with quick net smashes and good teamwork, and we won two consecutive games, sweating it out. After the match, we took a quick shower in the locker room, changed into dry T-shirts, and drank electrolyte drinks in the rest area. Lin Wei shared her enjoyable trip to Luoyang last week to see peonies, and we agreed to travel together next time.
location: Maiya Badminton Hall, 130 meters southwest of the south gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan, at the intersection of Fengchan Road and Zhengqi Street, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Buying vegetables and eggs on the way home
description: On the way home from the gym, she made a detour to the grocery store on Qunying Road and bought eggs, tomatoes, and scallions, spending 15 yuan. Then she walked back to Qunying Community carrying the vegetables and eggs. Upon arriving home, she immediately turned on the air conditioner and enjoyed the coolness indoors.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: Using an iPad stand, she started a video call with her mother Li Xiuying in Luoyang. Her mother was trimming green beans. Xiaowen shared the morning's badminton match, and her mother laughed, saying, "It's good to sweat." She then asked about her mother's back pain, and her mother said it had improved with the medicated patch. Xiaowen took the opportunity to bring up her plan to have her parents come stay with her in Zhengzhou during the summer vacation. Her mother's attitude softened slightly and said she would discuss it with her father when the weather cooled down.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Make and enjoy tomato and egg noodles.
description: After hanging up the video call, go to the kitchen and make tomato and egg noodles as planned. First stir-fry the tomatoes and eggs, add boiling water and noodles, and finally sprinkle with chopped scallions. A bowl of hot noodles replenishes the energy spent on exercise and feels very grounding.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Short nap during lunch break
description: Set an alarm for 2 p.m., drew the bedroom curtains, and set the air conditioner to 26 degrees. Reviewing the morning's arrangements for exercise, housework, and family time, she soon fell into a light sleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon preparation and trip to Starbucks.
description: After the alarm went off, she got up and washed her face, changed into a white polo shirt and dark blue casual pants, put the income and expense details and a calculator into her canvas bag, and brought a bottle of water. Then she drove her white Volkswagen Polo east along Dongfeng Road and turned onto Zhongyi Road, reaching the CBD of Zhengdong New Area after about 20 minutes. She parked in the underground garage of the China Merchants Bank Tower, took the elevator to the first floor, walked into the Starbucks at Qianxi Plaza, sat down by a window, ordered an iced Americano, and took out her notebook and the income and expense statement to wait for her financial advisor Wang Mingyuan.
location: Starbucks (Qianxi Plaza), 1F, Qianxi Plaza, B1, Business Inner Ring Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Meeting with financial advisor
description: Wang Mingyuan arrived on time and brought three financial plans. The two discussed in detail for an hour. Xiaowen used a calculator to work out the remaining balance after redeeming 10,000 yuan and pausing the monthly 2,000-yuan automatic investment, and she explicitly rejected the consumer loan product he recommended. In the end, they settled on the plan to “redeem 10,000 yuan of the fund and pause the monthly 2,000-yuan automatic investment plan.” Wang Mingyuan demonstrated the steps on the spot using mobile banking.
location: Starbucks (Qianxi Plaza), 1F, Qianxi Plaza, B1, Business Inner Ring Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove home and completed the fund redemption.
description: After leaving Starbucks, she drove to a safe roadside spot near Business Inner Ring Road and stopped. Following Wang Mingyuan's guidance, she successfully submitted a redemption request for 10,000 yuan of funds on the mobile banking app (confirmed T+2 arrival), suspended the 2,000 yuan auto-investment agreement, and manually transferred 2,000 yuan from the redemption proceeds into the money market fund account. After completing the operations, she restarted the car, drove home, and arrived at Qunying Community around 16:25.
location: Roads around Qianxi Square, Business Inner Ring Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Revised and submitted the department transfer application.
description: After returning home and changing into loungewear, she opened her laptop in the study. Based on Teacher Li Wei's advice, she added content to the "personal career plan" section of the department transfer application regarding her parents settling in Zhengzhou and family responsibilities, and emphasized her determination to choose rehabilitation medicine in light of her father's rehabilitation experience. After reviewing it repeatedly, she sent it to Teacher Li Wei via WeChat at 17:15, with a message asking him to review it.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening stroll in Zhuchunyuan Park
description: After sitting at the computer for a long time, my eyes felt sore and dry, so I went outside for a 10-minute walk to Zhuchunyuan Park. I put on my headphones, played soothing piano music, strolled at a leisurely pace along the park path, watched residents taking walks and children playing, and enjoyed a relaxing time in the sunset.
location: Zhuchun Garden Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner preparation and evening relaxation at home
description: After the walk, she began preparing dinner. She took out a fresh sea bass, cleaned it and scored the skin, laid ginger slices and scallion sections on top, and steamed it in the pot, while mixing the soy sauce for the steamed fish. Dinner was at 18:30, including steamed sea bass, mixed-grain rice, and cucumber salad. While eating, she browsed her phone, liked the photos from the competition Lin Wei had posted, and replied to Su Ya's casual WeChat message from last night. After the meal, she washed the dishes, wiped the kitchen counter, and boiled water to brew mint tea. At 19:30, she curled up on the sofa with tea, watched news and pottery-making videos on her tablet, and brainstormed ideas in case Su Ya invited her to do pottery.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening social interaction with friends
description: At exactly 8 p.m., she received a link from Su Ya to a weekend handmade pottery market. Su Ya excitedly invited her to set up a stall together in September. Xiaowen immediately replied excitedly in agreement, and the two began chatting animatedly on WeChat, starting to brainstorm pottery designs. At 8:30 p.m., she switched to a voice call with her best friend Zhang Jing, sharing the fulfilling experiences of the day: winning consecutive badminton matches, finalizing the financial plan, and submitting the department transfer application. Zhang Jing joked that it felt like several days had passed, and the two then joked about her upcoming blind date the next week.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening care, journal, and bedtime.
description: At 9 p.m., she washed up, took a hot shower, and applied a hydrating mask to repair her skin. At 21:30, she did her regular evening skincare routine, then opened her notebook and wrote in her diary, recording three things that touched her that day: the joy of the badminton doubles match, the reassurance of having set aside the financial reserve, and the anticipation of Su Ya's pottery invitation. At 10 p.m., she set her phone to sleep mode, sat cross-legged on the bed, and practiced mindful breathing for about ten minutes. She then turned off the light, lay down, and fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up naturally at 6:15, feeling full of energy. After getting up, she drank a glass of warm water, then changed into sports clothes and running shoes. She did simple stretches of her shoulders, neck, and legs on the balcony to prepare for the morning run. Seeing the bright sunshine outside the window, she felt relaxed.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, Building 1, Courtyard 2, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning run along the Jinshui River
description: Walked downstairs to the bank of the Jinshui River, started from Jingsan Road Bridge and jogged south along the river for 3 kilometers at a pace of about 7 minutes 30 seconds, enjoying the cool morning breeze and birdsong. After finishing the run, stretched on a bench by the river, sat for a while looking at the river view, and took photos with her phone. After stretching, walked home.
location: Jinshui River bank, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (Jingsan Road to Huayuan Road section)

name: Morning tidying and breakfast
description: After returning home, I took a shower to wash off the sweat and changed into linen loungewear. I prepared a simple breakfast: whole wheat toast, fried egg, warm milk, and cherry tomatoes. While eating, I browsed the weather and news on my phone and replied to morning greetings in the friends' group chat.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, Building 1, Courtyard 2, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Getting ready to leave, commuting, and meeting at the museum
description: Packed her crossbody bag for going out, putting in a power bank, a water bottle, a sun umbrella, a small notebook, and a pen. She sent a WeChat message to her friend Zhang Jing to confirm meeting at 9:30 at the museum entrance. Then she took a taxi to the Henan Museum and listened to Bach's Unaccompanied Cello Suites in the car. She arrived at the square outside the main gate of the museum at 8:50 and waited for Zhang Jing in the shade. At 9:20, Zhang Jing arrived on her electric scooter. The two hugged happily and entered after ticket checking while chatting.
location: Henan Museum, No. 8 Nongye Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Visited the special exhibition on ancient traditional Chinese medicine.
description: She entered the special exhibition hall on the second floor of the Henan Museum to visit the special exhibition on ancient traditional Chinese medicine and was drawn to the medical artifacts. She focused on the Tang Dynasty sancai medicine grinder and the Song Dynasty black-glazed medicine bottle, carefully recording the texture and structure of the grinder, and taking photos from multiple angles to consult her pottery teacher later. In front of the bronze acupuncture figure exhibit, she vividly explained the pathways of the meridians to Zhang Jing using her anatomical knowledge. Zhang Jing was interested in a hand-copied Ming Dynasty medical book, and the two discussed the holistic rehabilitation concepts of ancient Chinese medicine.
location: Special Exhibition Hall, Second Floor, Henan Museum, No. 8 Nongye Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Lunch near the museum
description: After coming out of the museum, she discussed with Zhang Jing going to a nearby well-regarded noodle restaurant called "A Bowl of Zhengzhou" for lunch. Xiaowen ordered the signature beef noodles, and Zhang Jing ordered liangpi and roujiamo. While eating, they continued talking about what they had seen at the museum. Xiaowen said she wanted to incorporate her insights on holistic rehabilitation into her paper, and Zhang Jing encouraged her to keep it up.
location: "A Bowl of Zhengzhou" noodle shop, southeast corner of the intersection of Nongye Road and Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Taking the bus home
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Jing at the subway entrance, she took Bus B18 at Huayuan Road-Nongye Road Station to go home. There were not many people on the bus, so she leaned against the window and rested with her eyes closed. Twenty minutes later, she got off at Jingsan Road Station and walked home.
location: Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (on the way home from Jingsan Road stop on Bus B18)

name: Lunch break and relaxation
description: After returning home, she changed into pajamas, drew the curtains, and turned on the air conditioner. Lying in bed, she savored the morning's museum trip, especially the shape of the Tang Dynasty medicine roller. With joy and inspiration, she soon fell asleep and napped for about an hour.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, Building 1, Courtyard 2, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prepare and begin paper revision.
description: After the 2 p.m. alarm went off, she got up and washed her face to refresh herself. She made a cup of mint tea, ate a few blueberries, and opened her laptop and the first draft of her paper at the desk in the study. In the discussion section of the paper, she created a new subsection titled "Exploration of a Holistic Rehabilitation Concept Based on Ancient Chinese Medicine Thinking," and wrote the discussion by combining the design of Tang Dynasty ceramic medicine grinders with modern rehabilitation humanistic care, emphasizing that rehabilitation should pay attention to patients' psychology and living environment. She cited the idea of correspondence between heaven and humanity from the Huangdi Neijing, adding humanistic depth to the article, and remembered Zhou Haoran's earlier suggestion. After reading it through, she felt the logic was smooth.
location: Study, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 1, No. 2 Courtyard, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Practice Baduanjin.
description: After two consecutive hours at the desk, her shoulders and neck became stiff. She got up, went to the living room, and followed a teaching video on her phone to do a complete round of Baduanjin. The stretching movements relieved her physical fatigue, and her mood calmed down. Then she did another simple set of neck stretches.
location: Living room, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 1, Courtyard No. 2, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Going out to buy daily necessities.
description: After checking the refrigerator, she found that eggs and yogurt were almost gone, so she walked to the Qunying Road grain and oil shop near the community to buy fresh eggs, plain yogurt, blueberries, and white vinegar. After paying, she slowly carried the shopping bags home.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Dinner preparation and evening leisure housework
description: Using the newly bought ingredients, she made a light dinner: cucumber and wood ear mushrooms dressed with white vinegar and sesame paste, and two small yellow croakers pan-fried. The staple was leftover rice from lunch. She set out her bowls and chopsticks, and slowly enjoyed the meal while listening to a podcast. After eating, she tidied up, washed the dishes, and wiped down the kitchen counter. Then she curled up on the sofa, poured herself a glass of warm water, and flipped through a leisure book on traditional Chinese medicine culture, still looking for inspiration for her paper.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, Building 1, Courtyard 2, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: At exactly 7:30 p.m., she made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying. Her mother was watching TV in the living room. Xiaowen excitedly shared her experiences at the museum and the new angle for her paper, and her mother praised her. Then her mother happily told her that her father had proactively practiced on the exercise bike for an extra 5 minutes today and played a recorded video. After watching it, Xiaowen gave a thumbs-up to her father on the screen, and the three of them laughed across the screen.

She personally accompanied the patient for a head CT to rule out hemorrhage, and briefly explained the condition and the necessity and risks of thrombolysis to the family. After obtaining informed consent, she calculated the alteplase dose, wrote the orders, and supervised the nurse in administration. During thrombolysis, vital signs were continuously monitored. After about 45 minutes, the patient's right limb muscle strength recovered from grade 1 to grade 3, speech became clearer, and repeated NIHSS dropped to 5. The patient was transferred to the intensive care ward for continued observation.

She worked up a light sweat and found it more refreshing than running. While washing up, she reminded herself in the mirror to stay energetic. After parking the bike in the hospital parking area, she swiped her card to enter the inpatient building, changed into her white coat in the changing room, and took out her notebook to quickly review the key patients' conditions. Then she returned to the office and continued completing the admission records and daily progress notes for all newly admitted patients today.

Her father, holding his walker, was standing in the middle of the living room slowly but firmly. He took a deep breath and, relying on the strength of his waist, abdomen, and arms, completed a steady 90-degree turn. She was so excited that she almost cried out. She quickly stepped forward to support her father and praised him again and again, while tears welled up in her mother's eyes. She recorded this precious moment completely with her phone. To celebrate, her mother specially made several dishes from the Luoyang water banquet and a newly learned steamed sea bass. At the table, her father had a hearty appetite and talked about his rehabilitation training experience with great enthusiasm. In plain language and drawing on medical knowledge, she explained what the movements meant for core muscle control and neurological recovery, and encouraged him to keep training. After the meal, she proactively cleared the table. Then she sat with her parents on the living room sofa, eating watermelon and chatting, sharing her recent progress at the hospital and in exam preparation, and hearing about her brother's current situation in Shenzhen. She helped her father walk back and forth in the living room several times, adjusted his posture when using the walker, and taught him a few safer little rehabilitation exercises to do at home.

On the way back, it was already dark, so I drove with more focus to ensure safety. There was little traffic on the expressway at night. Just after 22:30, I smoothly entered Zhengzhou's urban area and returned to Qunying Residential Complex.

Seeing the gold lettering and the wedding photo, she felt genuinely happy for her. She took a photo, sent it to her, and added the blessing: “Received! So beautiful! Wishing my dear friend a long and happy marriage!” After washing up, she sat back at the desk, opened the attending physician exam past questions app, called up a timed mock exam, and answered it carefully. When she finished, she stood up and did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder relaxation exercises. Then she changed into pajamas, turned on the bedside night light, and did 5 minutes of breathing meditation, replaying in her mind her father's smile as he turned around that day, the teacher's praise, and the warm time with her family, feeling grateful and confident. After the meditation, she went to bed at 23:45, set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, and quickly fell asleep.
location: 5th floor, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Along the park's inner trail, she jogged 3 kilometers at a pace of 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer, making it the perfect finish to 31 consecutive days of morning running this month. There were few people exercising in the park, the air was fresh, and she ran with unusual ease. After finishing, she stretched and relaxed on a park bench, bringing this habit to a perfect close.

name: Afternoon work and wrap-up
description: In the afternoon, she continued handling medical records and communicated with several patients and their families about the next day's surgical schedule and precautions, and checked the preoperative test results. location: Doctor's office, Department of General Surgery, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16, Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

description: Carrying the fruit, she walked about 3 minutes back home. She placed the document bag on the shoe cabinet at the entrance, then checked her phone alarm to confirm it was set for 5:45 the next morning.

Then her mother turned the camera to her father Yu Jianguo, who was sitting on the sofa in good spirits. He waved at the camera and said, 'Go for it, sweetie! Your dad can already walk a few steps with support!' Yu Xiaowen felt a warmth in her heart and said with a smile, 'Dad, after I finish the exam, I'll come back and practice with you more.' Her heart was filled with a sense of groundedness and strength.

location: Bedroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Then she closed her eyes and took a 20-minute nap to regain her energy.
location: Balcony of Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

location: Bathroom, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

location: Bedroom, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province
