Following the guidance, I slowly adjusted my breathing, focused on the rise and fall of each breath, and let my nerves, tense all day, completely relax. After the practice, I felt calm in both body and mind, and turned off the lights to sleep peacefully at 23:20.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning routine, breakfast, and plan confirmation
description: Woken by the muffled thunder outside the window in the early morning, Yu Xiaowen got up on time at 7:45. She weighed herself in the bedroom: 48.1 kg, stable. Because of the weather and having completed her morning run plan yesterday, she chose to do a 15-minute gentle stretching session on the yoga mat beside the bed to relax her neck, shoulders, and lower back. At the same time, she sent a WeChat message to her mother Li Xiuying to confirm the time she would come at noon to make braised noodle soup; her mother replied that she would arrive around 10:30. After washing up, she had oatmeal with milk and whole wheat toast for breakfast. While eating, she checked the weather forecast on her phone, confirmed there would be thundershowers in the morning, and sent a message to her friend Zhang Jing suggesting rescheduling the city walk plan and proposing alternatives such as going to the Bank Street Calligraphy and Painting Society or a café next week. Afterward, she replied to messages in a few work groups and prepared for a full day of work.
location: Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reference checking and format correction work
description: Yu Xiaowen opened the study window a crack to let the humid air circulate. She turned on the computer and created a new folder on the desktop named 20250802_Submission_Check to start the reference verification before paper submission. While checking the official submission guidelines page of Henan Medical Research, she switched between EndNote and Word to verify more than 70 citations one by one. She found and corrected six errors, including author name misspellings, nonstandard journal abbreviations, and misplaced decimal points in volume, issue, and page numbers. She also looked up three recent papers published in 2024 in the same field and saved them on the desktop for possible use in the main text. Around 10:00 during work, she took a short break. She picked up her phone and saw Zhang Jing's reply. The two chatted for a while and finally confirmed postponing the stroll plan to next week, which relaxed her mood. Then she continued to focus on completing the verification and saved the document.
location: Study room, Room 501, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Greeted mother and enjoyed lunch
description: When the doorbell rang, Yu Xiaowen knew her mother, Li Xiuying, had arrived. She quickly saved her document and went to open the door. Seeing her mother carrying a bag of vegetables and a thermal bag containing lamb bone soup and prepared braised-noodle dough, she felt a surge of warmth inside. Her mother deftly cooked the noodles and heated the soup in the kitchen; the soup had been simmered with lamb bones in advance and was milky white and rich. Yu Xiaowen helped by washing cilantro and peeling garlic. The mother and daughter chatted while cooking. Yu Xiaowen complained about the tediousness of fixing the references, and her mother said that her father, Yu Jianguo, had been very obedient recently and insisted on doing rehabilitation training every day. Soon, two large steaming bowls of braised noodles were served, with sweet garlic and chili oil on the side. Yu Xiaowen ate all the soup and noodles and praised her mother's cooking. After the meal, they put the dishes and chopsticks into the dishwasher together. Her mother told Yu Xiaowen that her father had been talking about her last night and, when he heard she was coming back, he voluntarily ate an extra bowl of rice at lunch. Hearing this, Yu Xiaowen felt reassured and decided to leave early in the afternoon to return to Luoyang.

name: Driving to my parents' home in Luoyang.
description: The thundershower stopped after lunch, and the sky began to clear. Yu Xiaowen took her backpack containing the iPad with the thesis files and went downstairs with her mother. She first drove her mother back to her residence in Jinshui District, then drove alone onto the Lianhuo Expressway toward Luoyang. In the car, she played Dvořák's Ninth Symphony from her phone via Bluetooth, relaxing in the music. The one-and-a-half-hour drive became a rare moment for her to clear her mind.
location: Lianhuo Expressway (Zhengzhou to Luoyang section)

name: Visited parents, assisted father's rehabilitation, and organized records.
description: Arriving at her parents’ home in Luoyang, she found her father Yu Jianguo watching TV in the living room. Yu Xiaowen first chatted with her father about everyday things, then took out the timer on her phone and started helping her father with rehabilitation exercises. She first massaged his leg muscles for 10 minutes to improve blood circulation. Then, with her mother’s support, her father slowly stood up holding the walker and managed to stay standing for nearly two minutes. Though he was somewhat out of breath, he had a proud smile on his face. She recorded the standing time, took a photo, and sent it to the family group chat, praising her father’s performance. After the training, her father rested, and Yu Xiaowen accompanied her mother in the living room for tea and conversation. name: Morning wake-up, exercise, and breakfast
description: The alarm went off right on time. Yu Xiaowen turned over and turned it off, taking stock of how she felt. She had slept restlessly the night before because she had submitted her department transfer application, but upon waking she felt even more determined. She checked the weather on her phone: 27–33 degrees, high humidity, so she decided to do Baduanjin. She removed the cervical heat patch she had applied before bed and felt that her shoulders and neck were much more relaxed. She spread a yoga mat on the balcony and followed a Baduanjin instructional video on her phone, starting with 'Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner,' feeling her spine stretch and the tension melt away with each breath. She deliberately slowed down during 'Sway the Head and Shake the Tail to Remove Heart Fire.' When she finished, there was a slight sweat on her forehead and her heart rate was steady. She put away the yoga mat, washed up, fixed her hair, and put on a white shirt with dark trousers. She took eggs and whole wheat bread out of the fridge, made a fried egg sandwich, and had it with warm milk for breakfast. While eating, she saw the caring message her mother had sent in the family group chat last night. She replied, 'Mom, I'll come home after work today and video call you. I have good news.' After breakfast she washed the dishes.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Commute and pre-shift preparation
description: Before going out, she checked her backpack to make sure she had the application letter, notebook, water bottle, spare mask, and pen, and also put in a manila envelope. She left at 7:20, locked the unit door, and walked to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The weather was hot and muggy, but the distance was not far; she arrived in about 10 minutes. She entered through the back door of the hospital, and colleagues who had arrived early were already busy in the corridor. After changing into her white coat and straightening her name badge, she glanced at herself in the mirror and thought that today was indeed a different beginning. She then went to the doctors' office, checked the shift handover log and the test results of her current patients, and prepared for the upcoming handover meeting.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Department morning meeting.
description: Attended the department handover meeting on time. The night-shift doctor reported on newly admitted patients and changes in patients' conditions during the night. Director Zhang Lei emphasized the key tasks and precautions for the day. Yu Xiaowen listened while taking notes in her notebook; for a moment her mind drifted to the application she was about to submit, but she quickly pulled herself back to reality and focused on the details of the work at hand.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Neurology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Submit the department transfer application and inform colleagues.
description: After the shift handover meeting, Yu Xiaowen waited outside Director Zhang Lei's office with a handwritten application letter. After he finished his current matters, she knocked and entered. She handed over the three-page application letter with both hands. The director read it carefully, then looked up and affirmed her motivation and career choice, suggested that after transferring to the rehabilitation department she could try the clinical-research interdisciplinary direction, and asked about her father's recent condition. After talking for about 20 minutes, the director accepted the application letter and said he would inform the human resources office. After leaving the office, Yu Xiaowen found Teacher Li Wei, who was writing medical records in the doctors' work area, and quietly told him that she had submitted the transfer application. Though surprised, Li Wei expressed understanding and support, reminded her to stand her ground well in the final stage in neurology and ensure proper patient handover, and said he would help with communication.
location: Director Zhang Lei's Office and Doctors' Work Area, Department of Neurology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning clinical work
description: Returning to work, she began the morning ward round. Yu Xiaowen rounded on the patients she was responsible for together with Teacher Li Wei, focusing on the recovery of the patient operated on yesterday and the condition of a newly admitted patient. A family member of a patient with sequelae of cerebral infarction asked about rehabilitation; she patiently explained in plain language and helped the patient move the limbs on the hemiplegic side. After the ward round, she returned to the doctors' station, adjusted medications according to the orders, issued test requests, and wrote medical records and progress notes, remaining focused and undisturbed by department transfer matters.
location: Neurology ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, she went to the staff cafeteria with Wang Fang for lunch. The cafeteria served braised small yellow croaker and garlic stir-fried water spinach, both of which Yu Xiaowen liked. They chatted briefly while eating. Wang Fang curiously asked about the conversation with Director Zhang today, and Yu Xiaowen smiled and said she would go into detail in the afternoon. After lunch, she took a relaxing walk in the hospital garden, then returned to the doctors' duty room, pulled the curtain closed, lay down, and browsed a rehabilitation medicine forum on her phone. Reading sharing from rehabilitation physicians gave her a more concrete idea of daily work. She set a 30-minute alarm and closed her eyes for a nap, recharging for the afternoon's work.
location: Staff cafeteria and doctors' on-duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work
description: In the afternoon, she continued her clinical work. She handled a patient with sudden dizziness and arranged an emergency CT scan; performed detailed physical examinations and history taking for two newly admitted patients and completed their admission records; and communicated with the family of a patient about to be discharged about post-discharge precautions and rehabilitation advice. During a break, Yu Xiaowen organized the key points from her conversations with Director Zhang Lei and Dr. Li Wei in her notebook, clarified the handover tasks that needed to be prioritized next week, and ensured the department's operations would not be affected.
location: Neurology ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Organizing and recording before leaving work, and the commute home
description: As quitting time approached, Yu Xiaowen took out a document envelope in the rest area. She neatly arranged the copy of the application letter, the talking-points notes, and the photocopies of her ID card and medical practitioner qualification certificate, wrote 'Yu Xiaowen's department transfer materials' on the front, and asked a colleague heading to the HR department to pass it along. The colleague joked, 'The department is losing a key member,' and she smiled in response. Just after sending off the materials, Wang Fang passed by and, upon learning the application had been submitted, smiled and lightly punched her shoulder in support. The two agreed to have another meal together before the transfer. Afterwards, Yu Xiaowen returned to the office, opened her personal work log, and carefully recorded the day's key milestones and follow-up plan. After tidying her desk and changing out of her white coat, she walked home from work. On the way, she stopped by the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road and bought some fresh peaches and two cartons of milk to take home.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province; and on the walk home

name: Video call with parents to share the decision
description: After getting home, she washed her hands, sat on the living room sofa, steadied her emotions, and made a WeChat video call to her mother. When her mother answered and saw her at home, she smiled. Yu Xiaowen directly told her that she had submitted an application today to transfer departments, planning to move to the rehabilitation department. On the screen, her mother was stunned for a moment, her eyes reddened, and her voice choked up. Her father took the phone, was silent for a moment, then firmly said he supported her, believing that the rehabilitation department could better use her abilities, and added that he might need her advice for his own recovery in the future. The family chatted for nearly half an hour, and her mother reminded her to eat on time. After hanging up, Yu Xiaowen sat on the sofa for a while, letting all of today's conversations and emotions settle, feeling extremely grounded at heart.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and evening relaxation
description: After unwinding, I cooked a bowl of noodles with the cherry tomatoes and eggs from the fridge, and had it with the peaches I had just bought as dinner—simple and refreshing. After eating, I cleaned up the kitchen, curled up on the sofa, turned on the TV and listened to a music channel for a while, and replied to a few friends' messages on my phone, enjoying a brief moment of ease.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Evening personal time
description: I took a quick shower, changed into comfortable pajamas, and felt some fatigue in my shoulders and neck. Sitting on the sofa, I took out my notebook and wrote a short diary entry, recording this important moment of submitting the application and my feelings. Then I picked up the bedside book Still Walking and flipped through a few pages, immersed in the peacefulness of reading.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Bedtime preparation, free relaxation, and falling asleep
description: After rinsing with fluoride mouthwash, she applied a new cervical heat patch. Lying in bed, she opened the Tide app and listened to a 10-minute body-scan meditation, letting her thoughts gradually detach from the day's intense conversations and focusing on physical relaxation. After the meditation, she picked up her phone and shared the important decision she had made that day in the 'childhood friends trio' group chat. Zhang Jing and Nana immediately showed concern; Yu Xiaowen briefly told them about changing departments, and they both expressed support. She then replied to her mother's goodnight message in the family group. She double-checked tomorrow's alarm on her phone and placed it by the bedside. Listening to the insects chirping in the summer night outside the window and recalling the firm expression on her father's face when he said, 'Dad supports you,' she unconsciously smiled. With fulfillment and anticipation, she turned off the light, adjusted her posture, and slowly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Getting up, morning jog, and breakfast
description: The alarm went off on time. She got up quickly, washed up briefly, changed into running clothes and shoes, and tied her hair into a ponytail. She jogged about 5 minutes from home to Zhuchunyuan Park, completed a 2.5 km jog along the trail at a pace of about 7 min/km, and did leg stretches in the fitness area. After the run, she went home, took a shower, changed into her white coat, and had milk, whole wheat bread, and a boiled egg for breakfast.
location: Home at Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and Zhuchunyuan Park (40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road)

name: Commute to the hospital by car.
description: Picked up her commuter bag and drove to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. On the way, she listened to soft classical music. Traffic was normal, and she arrived at the hospital parking lot about 10 minutes later.
location: Along the way from Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Department morning meeting handover.
description: She swiped her card to enter the department and changed into her work uniform. She attended the morning meeting, where the night-shift nurse gave the handover and reported on the ward situation the previous night, including a newly admitted patient with dizziness under investigation. Director Zhang Lei assigned the key ward-round tasks, and Yu Xiaowen took careful notes.
location: Neurology doctors' office, 6th Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Routine ward rounds
description: Followed Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds. Beside the beds of the newly admitted patients in Bed 3 and Bed 7, I assisted Dr. Li with neurological examinations, including muscle strength, sensation, and coordination, and recorded them accurately. During the rounds, I patiently explained the follow-up rehabilitation plan to the family members of the stroke patient.
location: Neurology Ward, 6th Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning medical records organization and doctor's order processing
description: After rounds ended, she opened the HIS system, pulled up the 28 inpatient records she was managing, put on anti-blue-light glasses, and began sorting. She marked stable cases green, cases needing close attention red, and wrote follow-up diagnosis and treatment suggestions in the remarks section of each record. Then she entered the temporary medical orders from the morning rounds. During this, a family member came over anxiously because he was worried about his father's condition fluctuating. She calmed the family member down and explained the drug onset cycle and recovery process.
location: Doctors' Duty Room, Department of Neurology, 6th Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Hospital cafeteria lunch and casual chat
description: She went to the staff cafeteria with Wang Fang. Yu Xiaowen ordered a braised pork ribs set meal, and Wang Fang chose fish-flavored shredded pork rice. They sat by the window. Wang Fang asked about the follow-up on the department transfer application. Yu Xiaowen briefly updated her, and they talked about future work and chances to meet.
location: Employee Canteen, 1st Floor, Building 5, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday neck exercises and nap.
description: After the meal, she went to the demonstration room, took out a heat patch, applied it to her sore neck, and followed the guided audio on her phone to do 5 minutes of cervical spine exercises. Then she returned to the on-call room, reclined in a chair, put on an eye mask and earplugs, closed her eyes, and rested for half an hour, feeling much more refreshed.
location: Doctors' Duty Room, Department of Neurology, 6th Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Discussing difficult cases with Dr. Liu Qiang
description: Dr. Liu Qiang brought the materials to jointly study a complex headache case of unknown cause. Facing the patient's cranial MRI, MRA, and blood biochemical results, Yu Xiaowen carefully compared them and proposed a differential diagnosis of 'low intracranial pressure headache' or 'cerebral venous sinus thrombosis.' Liu Qiang praised her observation of imaging details, and the two discussed and decided to schedule a joint consultation with the ENT department next week.
location: Reading area, Neurology Department doctor's office, 6th Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: In the afternoon, handled routine paperwork and newly admitted patients
description: Returned to the computer to handle afternoon work, including writing admission records and initial progress notes for newly admitted patients, reviewing and signing a discharge summary, and replying to several critical value reports from the lab. In between, she answered a consultation call from the emergency department and gave medication recommendations after a quick assessment.
location: Doctors' Duty Room, Department of Neurology, 6th Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Department handover and confirmation of tomorrow's schedule
description: Had a detailed handover with tonight's on-duty colleague, focusing on the status of 28 medical records and the upcoming consultation arrangement with Liu Qiang to ensure complete information. Printed out tomorrow's personal work plan and packed up personal belongings, ready to leave work.
location: Doctors' Duty Room, Department of Neurology, 6th Floor, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: After-work commute and shopping preparations
description: She drove away from the hospital. A light drizzle began to fall, and she turned on the windshield wipers. On the way, she used her phone's memo app to make a shopping list: pork front leg meat, Chinese cabbage, scallions, and dumpling wrappers.
location: En route from the Zhengzhou Central Hospital parking lot to Vanguard Supermarket.

name: Grocery shopping at the supermarket and organizing ingredients at home
description: At the Vanguard supermarket, I pushed a shopping cart and picked out a piece of pork front leg, a head of Chinese cabbage, a bunch of scallions, and dumpling wrappers. Passing the dairy section, I grabbed two boxes of probiotic yogurt. Considering my father's low-salt diet, I swapped the light soy sauce for low-sodium soy sauce. After checkout, I carried two large bags back home, changed out of my rain-soaked jacket, put away the low-sodium soy sauce and groceries, and placed the pork, cabbage, and scallions in the sink for washing.
location: China Resources Vanguard Jingsan Road Store, 40 m north of the intersection of Jingsan Road and Nongye Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, and the kitchen at home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District

name: Prepare dumpling filling and video call with family.
description: In the kitchen, while washing vegetables and chopping scallions, she made a video call on her iPad to her parents in Luoyang. Her father, sitting in his wheelchair, beamed when he learned they were having dumplings. Her mother gave remote instructions: 'After chopping the cabbage, remember to sprinkle some salt to draw out the water; squeeze it dry before mixing the filling.' She did exactly as told and soon mixed the minced meat with the cabbage and chopped scallions, with the aroma wafting out.
location: Kitchen at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Making dumplings together as a family and teaching how to roll out wrappers.
description: The prepared filling and dumpling wrappers were brought to the table. Her mother demonstrated how to roll out the wrappers. Yu Xiaowen tried and initially produced misshapen ones, but under her mother's guidance she gradually improved. Her father sat in his wheelchair and also took a wrapper and filled it; although his fingers were not nimble, he wrapped it carefully. The three sat around the table, chatting about family matters, with continuous laughter.
location: Dining room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Boiling dumplings and enjoying dinner
description: After the dumplings were wrapped, her mother went to the kitchen to boil them, and Yu Xiaowen made a dipping sauce of vinegar and sesame oil. Plates of steaming hot dumplings were brought to the table, and her father praised the filling after his first bite. She picked up dumplings for her parents with chopsticks, and seeing their satisfied expressions, her heart felt warm, and the slight unease about her career change gradually dissolved.
location: Dining room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tidying up around the house and chatting with family.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen hurried to clear the dishes. While drying the plates with kitchen paper towels, she listened to her mother talk about interesting stories about old neighbors. After cleaning up, she accompanied her parents on the living room sofa to watch the news and shared the sense of achievement from discussing a case with Liu Qiang at the hospital that day.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, Qunying Residential Complex, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Wash up and change into loungewear
description: Back in her own room, she went to the bathroom and washed up carefully, using the newly purchased fluoride mouthwash. She changed into soft, comfortable loungewear and completely relaxed.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Reading Fundamentals of Rehabilitation Medicine before sleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, she opened her Kindle, opened Fundamentals of Rehabilitation Medicine, turned to the "Muscle Strength Assessment" chapter, carefully highlighted the 6-level grading criteria and key operation points of MMT with a highlighter, building her knowledge base for the transfer to the rehabilitation department. She read with great concentration.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Writing a diary and practicing mindful meditation.
description: Close the Kindle, take out the diary to record today's mood: 'The second day after the department transfer, work is orderly, family is warm. Making dumplings with Mom and Dad is really the best way to relieve stress. I have both expectations and a little confusion about the future, but I feel grounded.' After writing the diary, sit cross-legged on the bed, open the meditation app, and follow the guided instructions for a 5-minute mindful breathing exercise.
location: At home, bedroom desk and bed, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and going to bed.
description: After finishing meditation, I did a few simple leg stretches at the bedside, then took a fresh heat pack from the drawer and applied it to my neck and shoulders. I set an alarm for 5:45 tomorrow morning, dimmed the lights, listened to the sound of rain outside the window, got into bed, and soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Early-morning wake-up, park stroll, and breakfast
description: The alarm rang at 6:15 in the morning. Yu Xiaowen got out of bed, lingered for a moment, then mustered her energy. She changed into workout clothes, walked about 30 minutes to Zhuchunyuan Park, and strolled two slow laps along the circular trail, breathing fresh air and taking in the lively atmosphere of elderly people doing morning exercises. She returned home at 7:10, took a quick shower, changed into loungewear, pan-fried the leftover dumplings from the previous night until golden brown, and ate a simple, satisfying breakfast with a glass of hot milk.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Residential Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province; and Zhuchunyuan Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City

name: Tidy the desk and systematically review neurology.
description: She walked into the study, reorganized the neurology and rehabilitation medicine materials and mistake cards she had reviewed yesterday, and took out her notes on common mistakes and framework diagrams to create a focused atmosphere. At 8 a.m., she formally began systematically reviewing key points in neurology, using mistake cards to tackle the localization diagnosis of cerebrovascular diseases, the Hoehn-Yahr staging of Parkinson's disease, and the differential diagnosis of various types of headache, while silently drawing neural conduction pathway diagrams as she reviewed. During the break at 9:45, she stood up and looked into the distance to relieve eye strain, then sent a WeChat message to her badminton partner Lin Wei to arrange a game at 9 a.m. on Saturday. After receiving a positive reply, she continued reviewing.
location: Study, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Rehabilitation Medicine Review and Simulated Self-Test
description: After a short rest, she began reviewing the rehabilitation medicine section, focusing on post-hip-replacement rehabilitation assessment and treatment, memorizing the processes from the acute phase to the recovery phase, including transfer techniques, muscle strength training, and gait training, while mentally simulating guiding patients through rehabilitation. At 11:30, she opened the mobile question bank app and did a mock test of 30 multiple-choice questions on the module just reviewed. After checking the answers, she circled the knowledge points related to the wrong questions with a highlighter, ready to review them next time.
location: Study, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch
description: In the kitchen, she made a bowl of tomato and egg drop soup with dough pieces using ingredients from the fridge, and a cucumber salad. While eating lunch, she listened to a classical music podcast to relax her nerves.
location: Kitchen, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Noon break and pre-exam item preparation.
description: Feeling sleepy after the meal, I set a 30-minute alarm, put on a steam eye mask, and had a high-quality nap. After waking up, I made a checklist of exam items and tomorrow's schedule in my phone memo. At 1:50, I got up, took out a transparent document bag, and put in the admission ticket, ID card, black gel pen, 2B pencil, eraser, and unmarked water bottle one by one, zipped it up, and placed it on the shelf at the entryway to make sure nothing was left behind.
location: Bedroom and study, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Afternoon: fill in the gaps through review and take a short break
description: Afternoon review focused on memory and output. She spread out A4 blank paper and wrote out knowledge framework diagrams from memory, covering basic anatomy, drug mechanisms, and clinical diagnosis and treatment principles. When stuck, she consulted books and used homophonic memory mnemonics to reinforce impressions. At 3:20 she felt neck stiffness, went to the living room, and followed a phone video to do five minutes of cervical spine relaxation exercises. Then she saw Lin Wei's reply and smilingly responded with an OK gesture.
location: Study and living room, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: She initiated a WeChat video call to her mother Li Xiuying. Her mother enthusiastically talked about the fun she had at the community senior activity center that morning, where she joined the singing group and practiced My Motherland and Jasmine Flower, and also met a warm retired Aunt Wang from the cotton mill. Yu Xiaowen listened with a smile, happy that her mother was fitting into a new circle.
location: Study, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Review and revisit error-prone points
description: Took out the mistake-prone points notebook and reviewed the knowledge points that repeatedly caused errors, including contraindications and interactions of specific antibiotics, medication choices for arrhythmias, and others, reading them aloud softly to deepen memory.
location: Study, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner, walk, shopping, and returning home to tidy up
description: To save time and ensure nutrition, she made a bowl of tomato and egg noodles with Shanghai greens. After the meal, she changed into light cloth shoes, went downstairs and took a ten-minute walk in the community park, then stopped by the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road on the way to buy apples and yogurt as tomorrow's breakfast and an exam-interval snack. After returning home, she washed the apples and put them in her backpack, tidied the materials on the desk, and browsed old photos on her phone to prepare topics for the evening video call with her parents.
location: Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Residential Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, and Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop, No. 14-10 Qunying Road.

name: Final review and mental rehearsal.
description: Sitting back at the desk, I quickly scanned the exam key-point framework outline to identify and fill gaps. Then I closed the book and, with my eyes shut, imagined the whole process of walking into the exam room tomorrow, finding my seat, receiving the test paper, calmly reading the questions, and answering them at ease — completing a full mental rehearsal.
location: Study, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Family video call
description: She again dialed the family group video call; her father Yu Jianguo answered. They talked about amusing stories from her mother's choir and tomorrow's exam. Before hanging up, her father walked in front of the camera leaning on his cane and encouraged her in a serious but warm voice not to be nervous, saying he would make her favorite mutton stewed noodles after the exam. Yu Xiaowen's eyes grew slightly moist, and she agreed in a choked voice.
location: Study, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After hanging up, set aside the books completely, brushed teeth and washed face carefully, applied a soothing face mask. Changed into soft pajamas, dimmed the bedroom lights, and sprayed lavender sleep mist on the pillow.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Residential Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and diary
description: Leaning against the headboard, opened the paper journal and recorded heartwarming little things: today's solid review, making a ball date with Weiwei, mother happily singing, father's promise of braised noodles. After writing, put on earphones and did 5 minutes of mindful breathing to try to calm excited thoughts.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Residential Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Nervous insomnia and eventually falling asleep
description: After turning off the light, despite being physically exhausted, my mind kept replaying the exam points, and my heart raced because I had not memorized a certain key point. I turned on my phone and confirmed that the exam venue was Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, which put me somewhat at ease. I tried two rounds of mindful breathing, silently reciting words of self-encouragement, and only fell into a dazed sleep after midnight.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at Room 503, Unit 2, Building 4, Qunying Residential Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Getting up, preparing for the exam, and breakfast
description: You were woken by the alarm. Although you went to bed late last night due to nervousness, you felt fairly energetic. You got up and checked the exam file bag, confirming once more your admission ticket, ID card, and stationery. Then you quickly flipped through the neurology cranial nerve examination mnemonics and core rehabilitation assessment scales for a final review. Your mother, Li Xiuying, had prepared millet porridge and egg pancakes for breakfast. You only ate half a bowl of porridge and half a pancake, but still praised your mother's cooking.
location: Home in Building 2, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Drive to the exam center
description: You changed into a comfortable cotton T-shirt and sports trousers, took a backpack containing mineral water, chocolate, and review materials, drove alone south along Tongbai Road and turned onto Jianshe West Road. With smooth traffic, you arrived at the parking lot near the exam center and confirmed the exam room and seat number again.
location: Parking lot on Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (near Zhengzhou No. 1 Junior High School)

name: Enter the examination room early and wait for the exam
description: You entered Room 305 of Teaching Building No. 2 20 minutes early, settled into your seat, and took a few sips of water. Instead of looking at review materials again, you looked around, closed your eyes, and took deep breaths, waiting for the exam bell.
location: Classroom 305, Teaching Building 2, Zhengzhou No. 1 Junior High School, No. 8 Xigang Village, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning exam (basic knowledge and relevant professional knowledge)
description: Once the exam begins, as planned, first do the rehabilitation medicine questions you are best at, then tackle the difficult neurology points, allocate your time wisely, finish filling in the answer sheet on time, and use the remaining time to repeatedly check your candidate number and answer markings to ensure nothing goes wrong.
location: Classroom 305, Teaching Building 2, Zhengzhou No. 1 Junior High School, No. 8 Xigang Village, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch and short break.
description: After the exam ended, you ordered a beef and potato stew set meal at Li Ji Fast Food near the test center. While eating quickly, you couldn't help glancing at exam answer discussion posts on your phone, but soon realized it would disturb your mindset, so you decisively closed the browser, got up, paid, and prepared to rest in the car.
location: Li Ji Fast Food Restaurant, near Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday rest in the car and physical-mental relaxation.
description: You returned to the car parked on the roadside, reclined the driver's seat, played Bach's Cello Suite in G major on your phone, closed your eyes and adjusted your breathing, left a crack in the car window, and took a 30-minute nap. After waking up, you gave an encouraging smile to the rearview mirror, did some simple chest expansion exercises, locked the car, and walked toward the examination room.
location: Parking lot on Jianshe West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (inside the car)

name: Pre-exam preparation, entering the afternoon examination room
description: You arrived early outside the examination room, checked the time again, drank a few sips of water, exchanged a smile with a nearby candidate who was also waiting, and felt the tense yet hopeful atmosphere. At 13:50 you walked calmly into the examination room and sat in your seat waiting for the test papers to be handed out.
location: Classroom 305, Teaching Building 2, Zhengzhou No. 1 Junior High School, No. 8 Xigang Village, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Afternoon exam (professional knowledge and professional practice ability).
description: The case analysis questions in the afternoon were more challenging. You read each question word by word, listed key points and possible differential diagnoses on scratch paper, and answered cautiously. The final question on the three-tier rehabilitation program for stroke went smoothly. At 17:15 you completed all the questions and checked again. At 17:30 the hand-in bell rang, and you let out a long sigh of relief.
location: Classroom 305, Teaching Building 2, Zhengzhou No. 1 Junior High School, No. 8 Xigang Village, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Drove home after the exam
description: You walked out of the exam room, feeling completely at ease. On the drive home, you opened the sunroof to feel the breeze, texted your mother on WeChat to let her know you were done and heading home, and felt a deep sense of relief.
location: Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (returning by car)

name: Share exam experience and dinner with parents.
description: When you got home, your mother had already prepared cold noodles and refreshing cucumber. While eating, you gave your parents a detailed account of the exam process, the exam questions that left a deep impression, and your mindset changes. Your father, Yu Jianguo, listened quietly, occasionally nodding and smiling, while your mother kept adding food to your bowl. When you said you had tried your best, your father patted you on the shoulder to encourage you.
location: Home dining room, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Family chat and relaxation
description: After dinner, the family sat on the living room sofa watching TV. You switched to CCTV Documentary Channel to watch a nature documentary, leaning on your mother's shoulder, while your father browsed the news on his phone beside you, occasionally looking up at the TV, sharing a family time without the pressure of exams.
location: Living room at home, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Relaxation after the exam: binge-watching shows and socializing
description: You curled up on the sofa and watched an episode of Hospital Playlist; the plot made you smile knowingly. Later, you sent a WeChat message to your badminton buddy Lin Wei to arrange to meet at Maiya Badminton Hall at 9 a.m. tomorrow. She readily agreed, and you felt that tomorrow would be full of energy again.
location: Living room at home, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: You opened the curtains and looked at the night view, took a warm shower to wash away the fatigue, changed into pajamas, read a few pages of “Still Walking,” which you hadn't opened in a long time, then turned off the light, put on a steam eye mask, and did a body scan from head to toe, letting yourself fall into a completely peaceful sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Woke up at exactly 6 a.m. feeling full of energy. After getting up, she opened the curtains and saw cloudy weather with a gentle breeze, which felt pleasant. After washing up, she changed into a quick-dry workout suit, drank a glass of warm water, checked her fitness band, and got ready for a morning run.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning jog at Bishagang Park and buying breakfast
description: Departed from home at 6:30, drove along Qunying Road and Nanyang Road, then turned onto Jinshui Road, arriving at the south gate of Bishagang Park in about 18 minutes. Jogged 2.5 kilometers along the small loop inside the park at a pace of 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, with a heart rate around 135, running for about 30 minutes in total. After the run, stretched in the fitness area on the east side of the park. Running ended at 7:10. Drove via the intersection of Jianshe East Road and Zhongyuan Road, and at Zihao Breakfast Shop next to Minsheng Pharmacy bought tea eggs, steamed dumplings, and hot soy milk, and bought an extra serving of millet porridge as a backup.
location: Bishagang Park, No. 31 Jianshe East Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Go home, take a shower, have breakfast, and review department transfer materials
description: At 7:30, returned home, put breakfast on the dining table, showered off the sweat, and changed into a white T-shirt and sports shorts. Sat in the living room eating breakfast while watching the morning news: tea eggs, steamed dumplings, and soy milk. After breakfast, went to the study to check the department transfer application and attached materials, going through page by page to ensure they were complete and accurate. Then put the materials back into the document folder and got ready to go out.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Went to the East District for a light recovery badminton session with Lin Wei.
description: Set off by car at 7:55, taking the North Third Ring elevated road then turning onto the East Third Ring, arriving at the underground parking lot of Zhengdong New District Civic Sports Park in about 35 minutes, then walked to the badminton hall. Arrived at 8:32 and warmed up wrists, ankles, and shoulder joints. At 9:00 Lin Wei showed up on time. The two first hit clears for 15 minutes, then practiced net shots and smashes/drops for about 80 minutes, and finally played two unscored mixed doubles games at moderate intensity with a heart rate around 145. After training, they drank water in the rest area and agreed on weekend playing times, locking in the mornings of August 24 and September 7.
location: Badminton hall, Zhengdong New District Citizens' Sports Park, Yulin North Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Had lunch with Lin Wei and caught up.
description: After packing up their sports bags, the two went to the Yuexiang Light Food restaurant on the first floor of the Sports Park and chose a window seat. Yu Ming ordered avocado chicken salad and watermelon juice, while Lin Wei ordered teriyaki chicken leg rice and lemonade. During the meal, they shared updates about their lives. Lin Wei talked about interesting stories from the new energy vehicle project, and Yu Ming explained in detail his idea and progress on transferring departments. Lin Wei expressed support and jokingly said she would come to him for family rehabilitation in the future.
location: Yuexiang Light Food Restaurant, 1st Floor, Zhengdong New District Civic Sports Park, Yulin North Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Said goodbye to Lin Wei, shared photos, then drove home
description: At 12:10, she said goodbye to Lin Wei and walked alone to the parking lot. In the car, she took a selfie with her phone and posted it to the "Childhood Friends Trio" WeChat group, sharing her mood after exercising, with the caption: "First recovery training since the exam, so happy playing ball with my besties, I'm in great shape today!" Jingjing replied, "Freedom really makes a difference!", and Nana sent an envious emoji. At 12:25, she departed from the Sports Park parking lot, drove back along Jinshui Road with smooth traffic, and returned to the Qunying Community underground garage at 12:50.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday nap
description: After arriving home, I changed into loungewear, drew the curtains, and took a 1-hour nap in the bedroom. At 14:30, the alarm rang, and I woke up refreshed.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tidying up and preparing, then going out to buy groceries
description: After getting up, she washed her face and drank water, and prepared her father's small folding stool, water bottle, and sun hat in advance by the entrance. At 15:00, she drove to the Jingba Road Seafood and Farmers Market, where she picked out pork ribs, leafy greens, Chinese yam, tomatoes, and ginger, spending 65 yuan. At 15:25, she returned home, put the groceries in the kitchen, then called her father and mother, helped her father carry the stool, and the family got ready to go to the park.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Accompanied parents on a rehabilitation walk at Bishagang Park.
description: At 15:40, she drove from Qunying Residential Community, took the Nongye Road elevated road and Jianshe East Road, and arrived at the east gate of Bishagang Park in about 20 minutes. Her parents and Yu Ming walked slowly along the gently sloping lakeside path. Her father walked independently with a cane for about 30 minutes, rested twice on benches along the way, and fed koi and pigeons, looking delighted. Her mother recorded a video and sent it to the family WeChat group with the caption: "Look, your dad is in high spirits today." At 17:10, they ended the walk and drove back, arriving home at 17:30.
location: Bishagang Park, No. 31 Jianshe East Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Prepare family dinner.
description: After returning home, the mother did the main cooking and Yu Ming helped. They first blanched the pork ribs, then put them in a clay pot with Chinese yam, scallions, and ginger to simmer slowly. The mother stir-fried tomatoes and eggs and a simple vegetable dish. The kitchen was filled with the warm scent of home.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: Dinner included rice, yam and pork rib soup, tomato and scrambled eggs, and stir-fried baby bok choy. Father drank a full bowl of soup and had a good appetite. Mother talked about wanting to go to the community senior activity center to watch the choir. The family laughed and chatted warmly and harmoniously.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-dinner cleanup and casual family chat.
description: After dinner, Yu Ming took the initiative to clear and wash the dishes, cut some watermelon, and carried it to the living room. His parents sat on the sofa watching CCTV News. Yu Ming sat down and chatted about funny moments from playing ball and his plan to switch departments. His father encouraged him, 'Since you've made up your mind, just prepare steadily.'
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Watched pottery teaching videos and formed a creative plan.
description: In the study, she used her tablet to watch the pottery throwing teaching video 'Centering and Clay Lifting Techniques' released by Teacher Zheng Guodong, carefully recording the key steps and wrist force angles, with special notes on the rhythm of recentering the clay. After watching, she planned her next visit to the pottery studio, intending to first try making a commemorative cup in the shape of the zodiac dog.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and daily care
description: She put down her phone, went to the bathroom to wash up, applied a hydrating mask, and used the phone memo to record her mood. Then she brushed her teeth, washed her face, changed into pajamas, and did a 5-minute neck relaxation exercise.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Organizing work items and communicating the handover with colleagues
description: In the bedroom, she hung up her white coat and work badge and confirmed that the charger and car keys were in her bag. At 21:50, she called her colleague Wang Fang to discuss changes in the condition of several key patients and treatment plans, including the patient in Bed 25 with a cerebral infarction and the patient in Bed 31 with hemiplegia. The call lasted about 15 minutes.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading before bed and preparing for sleep
description: She leaned against the headboard and flipped through Standards for Diagnosis and Treatment of Rehabilitation Medicine for a few minutes. When drowsiness came, she turned off the light, recalled the fulfilling day, and soon fell asleep.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning exercise and breakfast
description: At 6:15 in the morning, the alarm went off. Xiaowen changed into her sportswear and went to Zhuchunyuan Park for a 3-kilometer jog, going over the important matters of the day while running. After exercising, she returned home to take a shower and had breakfast with her parents. Her mother had prepared millet porridge, fried eggs, and whole-wheat bread. Xiaowen chatted with her father, mentioning that she would go shopping after work for elderly-friendly renovation items, planning to install grab bars and non-slip mats in the bathroom. Her father was pleased.
location: Zhuchun Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and home at Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District

name: Driving to work and preparing for the morning meeting
description: Xiaowen drove from Qunying Road to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, listening to classical music on the way. After arriving at the hospital, she changed into her white coat, quickly reviewed yesterday's handover records in the doctors' office, familiarized herself with key patients' conditions, and prepared for the department morning meeting.
location: Doctor's Office, Neurology Department, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16, Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Department morning meeting handover.
description: All the medical staff of the department attended the morning meeting. The on-duty doctors and nurses reported weekend and nighttime ward updates, including newly admitted patients and records of how condition changes were handled. Xiaowen listened carefully to important information related to the beds under her responsibility and took notes.
location: Conference Room, Department of Neurology, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning clinical work
description: After the morning meeting, supervising teacher Li Wei led the group on the major ward round. Xiaowen reported the test results and treatment responses of the patients she was in charge of. Teacher Li proposed adjustments to the anticoagulation regimen for one patient and gave guidance on rehabilitation treatment for another. After the ward round, Xiaowen returned to the office to modify and enter medical orders and handle discharge summaries. Then she focused on writing progress notes and medical records. In between, she assisted Dr. Liu Qiang in looking up test results and completed the morning's paperwork.
location: Neurology ward and doctors' office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch and midday study
description: At noon, Xiaowen had lunch with her colleague Wang Fang in the hospital staff cafeteria, chatting about weekend life and the progress of her transfer application. After the meal, she went to the rest room on the fourth floor, registered for the 'Fundamentals of Rehabilitation Medicine' course on Chinese University MOOC on her phone, paid a 198 yuan registration fee, browsed the first week's preview content, and set reminders for every Wednesday and Friday evening at 7 pm. Then she returned to the duty room and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes to regain energy for the afternoon work.
location: Staff Cafeteria and Fourth-Floor Lounge, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Age-friendly renovation consultation for the rehabilitation department.
description: Xiaowen took advantage of a break at work to go to the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine and consulted Dr. Wang about the elderly-friendly renovation plan for the home bathroom. She explained that her father had hemiplegia after a cerebral infarction. Dr. Wang suggested installing an L-shaped grab bar 75 cm above the floor, buying non-slip mats with an anti-slip rating of R10 or higher, and recommended a rehabilitation nursing bed with three adjustable sections. Xiaowen carefully recorded the suggestions and clarified her purchase goals.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work
description: In the afternoon, Xiaowen admitted a suspected cerebral infarction patient transferred from the emergency department. She completed the history taking, physical examination, and preliminary examination orders, and explained the condition to the family. She then wrote the day's progress notes to ensure accurate documentation. Her supervising teacher Li Wei reviewed them and gave his approval. Near the end of her shift, she handed over to the on-duty doctor, confirmed the patient had no urgent conditions, took off her white coat, and prepared to leave.
location: Doctor's office and wards, Department of Neurology, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Purchasing safety grab bars and non-slip floor mats
description: After getting off work, Xiaowen drove to the Zheng-Bian Building Materials Market in Jinshui District and went straight to the accessible facilities specialty store in Zone B. Following Dr. Wang's recommendation, she selected a set of 304 stainless steel L-shaped grab bars, costing 160 yuan. At the mat store next door, she chose a 2 m by 1 m PVC anti-slip mat with an R10 slip resistance rating, costing 120 yuan, and asked the shop to cut it to size. The purchase went smoothly.
location: Accessibility equipment specialty store and floor mat store, Zone B, Zhengbian Building Materials Market, Zhengbian Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Selecting a rehabilitation nursing bed and returning home
description: Xiaowen drove from the building materials market to the 'Rehabilitation Home' medical equipment store at the intersection of Jingsan Road and Hongzhuan Road. With the salesperson's recommendation, she compared three nursing beds and finally chose a model with adjustable height, side rails on both sides, and a movable bed table. She paid 3,700 yuan and arranged same-day delivery to her home. Afterward, she drove back to her home in Qunying Community, as the sky turned cloudy and it began to rain.
location: 'Rehabilitation Home' medical device store at the intersection of Jingsan Road and Hongzhuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province; return to Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road

name: Age-friendly home renovation.
description: When Xiaowen returned home, the delivery worker had just arrived. She and her father carried the nursing bed into the living room and assembled it. Then Xiaowen used an electric drill to make holes in the wall next to the toilet and in the shower area, and installed stainless steel grab bars, while her father helped level them. Next they laid down anti-slip floor mats. After finishing, Xiaowen had her father try them out. He pulled on the grab bar and stood up steadily, looking relieved. Her mother brought over mung bean soup, and the family inspected the results with satisfaction.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Evening leisure and socializing.
description: After the renovation was completed, Xiaowen took a shower and did 8 minutes of relaxing meditation. Then she lay in bed and used WeChat to share her joy over the finished renovation with her best friend Lin Wei via voice messages, and also sent photos to Zhang Jing, earning praise. Before sleep, she leaned against the headboard and read an article about hospice care in the magazine "Chinese Medical Humanities" until she felt sleepy.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Bedtime preparations
description: Xiaowen put down the magazine, went to the living room to check whether her father was comfortable on the new nursing bed, said goodnight, then returned to her room for a nighttime skincare routine, set the alarm for 6:15 the next day, recorded her weight as 47.9 kg in her memo, then turned off the light and fell asleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Get up, wash up, and prepare assembly tools.
description: The alarm went off right on time at 6:30. Outside, the sky was somewhat overcast and it felt cool. Yu Xiaowen lingered in bed for a moment to collect herself, then got up. She first went to the bathroom to wash up and splashed cold water on her face to wake up quickly. Next, she changed into an old T-shirt and athletic pants that allowed easy movement, opened the box of care-bed accessories delivered yesterday, and laid out screwdrivers, wrenches, and other tools in the living room, waiting for her father to get up.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Room 602, Building 3, Qunying Community, 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Assembling the rehabilitation nursing bed with father
description: Her father, Yu Jianguo, got up, and the two of them assembled the nursing bed in the living room according to the manual. One held the bed frame while the other tightened screws and installed the lifting motor. The process was orderly. After about 40 minutes, they successfully installed the side rails and the movable tabletop. Her father lay down on it to test the lifting and backrest adjustment, beamed with joy, and remarked, "Getting up is much easier now, and I can lie half-reclined and watch TV during the day." Yu Xiaowen felt much more at ease.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province - Living Room

name: Preparation and a simple meal before going out
description: Seeing her father satisfied, Yu Xiaowen, relieved, went back to her room and changed into clean work clothes. She gently urged her father to finish breakfast, packed her work bag and folding umbrella, glanced at the weather on her phone (today: overcast turning to moderate rain), said goodbye to her father at the door, and told him to rest at home today.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Qunying Community, 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province - living room and doorway.

name: Commute to the hospital by car.
description: Yu Xiaowen went downstairs and started the car, listening to Chopin's nocturnes playing on the car stereo. She felt calm. It had not yet started to rain on the drive, so the trip was smooth. About 15 minutes later, she arrived at the underground garage of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, completing her commute.
location: Qunying Residential Community, No. 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Attended the department morning meeting and did ward rounds with Teacher Li Wei.
description: After arriving at the department, she quickly changed into her white coat, attended the morning handover meeting at 8:00 sharp, and listened to the night-shift colleagues report on newly admitted and critically ill patients. She then followed Dr. Li Wei on the major ward round, recording along the way patients' changes in condition from the previous day and the medical orders that needed adjustment today, with special attention to the recovery progress of the patient suspected of cerebral infarction who had been admitted last week.
location: Doctor’s office and ward, Department of Neurology, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handled medical orders and medical records documentation.
description: After ward rounds, Yu Xiaowen went back to her desk, turned on the computer, and began handling medical orders: placing a lab test order for the newly admitted patient in Bed 3 and adjusting the antihypertensive medication dosage for Bed 26. In the midst of her busy work, she used office software to organize 2 discharge medical records that needed to be archived today and double-checked the medical orders issued that morning to ensure they were correct.
location: Neurology doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch with Wang Fang at the cafeteria and visiting a bookstore
description: At 12:00, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang went to the hospital cafeteria together. Carrying trays, they ate and chatted about the department transfer application. After the meal, Yu Xiaowen suggested going to the nearby Bank Street Calligraphy and Painting Society to walk off the meal, and Wang Fang readily agreed. The two walked about 9 minutes to the society. Yu Xiaowen picked a book titled Clinical Practice of Stroke Rehabilitation in the medical book section, paid, and planned to take it home to study.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital cafeteria, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province; and the Calligraphy and Painting Society, Bank Street, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work
description: Back in the department in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen continued working at her desk. She handled the medical records left over from the morning and saw a discharged patient who came for a follow-up, patiently asking about his medication adherence and current symptoms. At 14:30, the department delivered several leaflets for new medications; she carefully read them and noted the information in her handbook.
location: Neurology doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Received a call from the HR department approving the department transfer
description: Around 15:00, the phone rang; it was a call from a clerk in the human resources department. The clerk formally notified Yu Xiaowen that her application for department transfer had been approved by the vice president in charge, and that she should report to the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine at 8:30 AM on September 1. Yu Xiaowen thanked them on the spot. After hanging up, her heartbeat instinctively quickened, with both the excitement of finally being confirmed and reluctance to leave the neurology department and her teachers.
location: Neurology doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Replied to her cousin on WeChat and reported the good news to Director Zhang Lei
description: After hanging up, Yu Xiaowen saw a congratulatory WeChat message from her cousin Li Yaqin on the phone screen, along with a question about exercises for her husband's lumbar muscle strain. During a break, she went to the rest room and opened WeChat. She first sent a detailed voice reply covering the key points and precautions for movements such as supine hip raises and the superman exercise, and promised to send an illustrated version later. Then she sent a brief WeChat message to Director Zhang Lei to report the matter. The director quickly replied, "Good thing. Prepare well. Rehabilitation medicine has great potential." She felt a warmth in her heart.
location: Neurology Department Lounge and Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commute home from work
description: Around 16:50, a light drizzle began to fall outside the window. Yu Xiaowen tidied her desk, stood up, and left. As the rain outside grew heavier, she opened her umbrella and walked quickly to the parking lot. She drove home with extra care; the windshield wipers swung back and forth and the road was slightly slippery. She arrived home safely after about 25 minutes.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Qunying Community, No. 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Had dinner with her father and exchanged thoughts on using the nursing bed.
description: When she got home, her father, Yu Jianguo, was resting on the sofa. After washing her hands, Yu Xiaowen quickly made two bowls of tomato and egg noodles and brought them to the table. While eating, she asked her father about his experience trying the nursing bed today. Her father said, "I took a nap in the recliner at noon. The backrest can be adjusted, my waist feels much better, and turning over takes less effort." Yu Xiaowen felt gratified when she heard this.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 602, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: In the evening, studied the MOOC neurorehabilitation course and organized the knowledge.
description: After the meal and cleanup, Yu Xiaowen went to the study and logged into the MOOC platform. Although it was Tuesday, she decided to start the Neural Rehabilitation module of 'Fundamentals of Rehabilitation Medicine' early. She watched a 40-minute teaching video titled 'Overview of Post-Stroke Rehabilitation', drawing the pathophysiological mechanism diagram of stroke in her notebook while watching, and writing down key points. She then completed 5 in-class quiz questions with an accuracy rate of 80%, and took screenshots of the wrong answers for review. Around 20:00, after finishing the quiz, she stood up, moved her cervical spine and shoulders, and did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder stretches to relax. Then she sat back at the desk, organized the key knowledge points from the session, recopied the important concepts and explanations of the wrong questions into her notes, and marked the key points for the next review.
location: Study, Room 602, Building 3, Qunying Community, 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video called her parents to share the good news about the department change.
description: At 20:30, Yu Xiaowen picked up her phone and opened the family group chat, where she saw a voice message from her mother. She then made a video call and shared the good news with her parents that she had received the approval notice for her department transfer that afternoon. On the other end, her mother happily said 'good' over and over. Her father, Yu Jianguo, also walked over from the living room and said to his wife on the video with a smile, 'Xiaowen even set up my bed for me today—it's great.' The family of three chatted for about 20 minutes.
location: Study, Room 602, Building 3, Qunying Community, 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Read the magazine Chinese Medical Humanities.
description: After the video ended, Yu Xiaowen poured herself a glass of warm water, picked up the magazine Chinese Medical Humanities from the bedside, and read an article about narrative medicine. She underlined several sentences that touched her, wrote her thoughts in the margins, and felt her spirit had been nourished.
location: Study, Room 602, Building 3, Qunying Community, 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Take a shower, do skincare, and prepare items for the next day
description: Closing the magazine, Yu Xiaowen went to the bathroom to take a shower, washing away the fatigue of the day. Afterward, she dried off and did basic skincare. Returning to the bedroom, she hung tomorrow's work clothes and white coat on the clothing rack, checked the items in her commuter bag, and set the 6:20 alarm clock.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 602, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: At 22:00, she turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. Yu Xiaowen lay in bed, did a few minutes of deep breathing to relax, and mentally ran through her upcoming plans: she needed to report to the rehabilitation department on September 1, and next week she should start preparing some materials. She picked up her phone and opened the health app to record today's weight: 48.0 kg. At 22:35, she said goodnight to her father, checked the door lock, then turned off the light and closed her eyes. The rain pattered outside the window; she felt a sense of steadiness and the joy of being recognized, and gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 602, Building 3, Qunying Community, 12 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Early-morning wake-up and morning run
description: At 5:40 a.m. the alarm went off. After getting up, Yu Xiaowen sent a WeChat message to her parents asking how her father was getting along with his new nursing bed. Relieved to learn he was very satisfied, she changed into workout clothes and walked to Zhuchunyuan Park for a morning run. She opened Keep and completed a 2.5 km jog and three sets of acceleration runs, with a steady heart rate and feeling refreshed.
location: Home in Qunying Residential Complex, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and Zhuchunyuan Park

name: Breakfast and getting ready for work
description: After her morning run, on the way home Yu Xiaowen bought jianbing guozi and unsweetened soy milk at Lao Zhao's breakfast stall at the intersection of Qunying Road and Tianming Road. After returning home, she took a shower and changed into a light blue shirt and white casual pants. While eating breakfast, she checked the department shift handover records and confirmed the patients requiring special attention. After the meal, she checked her commuter bag, put in her work badge, stethoscope, notebook, and a copy of the department transfer approval document, and prepared to drive to work.
location: Home and nearby, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting to work
description: Yu Xiaowen drove from Qunying Community to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Traffic was smooth, and she arrived at the hospital staff parking lot about 12 minutes later.
location: On the way from Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Morning meeting and ward rounds
description: Yu Xiaowen attended the morning meeting of Ward 2 of the Cardiovascular Medicine Department on time. She listened to the night shift report and the work arrangements of attending physician Li Wei, and exchanged views with her colleague Wang Fang. She then followed attending physician Li Wei on ward rounds. At the bedside of Grandpa Zhang in Bed 35, she reported his blood pressure readings and assisted with auscultation; at the bedside of newly admitted Aunt Li in Bed 37, she comforted her and explained the next day's coronary angiography.
location: Cardiology Ward 2, 14th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Consulted reference materials and processed medical orders.
description: After the ward round, Yu Xiaowen returned to the office and, during a break, logged into the hospital intranet to download and browse the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine introduction, the annual report of the community stroke rehabilitation program, and a PDF on common rehabilitation assessment procedures, marking key points. Then she handled routine medical orders, double-checked medication adjustments, updated electronic medical records, and chatted with Wang Fang about how it felt to have her department transfer approved, agreeing to visit each other often.
location: Resident Physician Office, 14th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Visit Director Wang of the Rehabilitation Department
