description: Yu Xiaowen walked to the office of the director of the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine to visit Director Wang Zhenhua. She introduced herself and explained that she was reporting for duty on September 1 and wanted to learn about the department in advance. Director Wang warmly introduced the community stroke rehabilitation program and gave her the Rehabilitation Assessment Manual and the project plan booklet. Yu Xiaowen offered to sit in on the weekly Wednesday professional study session and agreed with the director to attend on Wednesday, September 2. Director Wang readily agreed and encouraged her. Finally, she received a materials folder containing the Rehabilitation Assessment Manual, the project plan booklet, and the Compilation of Commonly Used Stroke Rehabilitation Scales, and thanked the director.

participant.name: Wang Zhenhua
participant.relation: Director of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department

location: Office of the Director, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, 4th Floor, Building 2, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return to the office for handover and wrap-up
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the cardiology office feeling pleased. She seized the time to deal with the unfinished medical record work from the morning, and handed over the ward round arrangements for tomorrow afternoon to Wang Fang, wrapping up her work before leaving the department.
location: Resident Physician Office, 14th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and visiting the calligraphy and painting club
description: At lunchtime, Yu Xiaowen went to the staff cafeteria with Wang Fang. She ordered steamed sea bass and stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and excitedly shared the details of her morning visit to the director with Wang Fang. After lunch, she took a walk alone to Bank Street in Zhongyuan District, browsed the "Moxiangxuan" calligraphy and painting shop. Although she didn't find the book she originally wanted, she found a copy of Rehabilitation Guide for Spinal Cord Injury and bought it, and had a brief chat with the shopkeeper.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province; and Moxiangxuan Calligraphy and Painting Society, Bank Street, Zhongyuan District

name: Noon break
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the resident physicians' lounge, rested her head on the desk for half an hour, and recharged for the afternoon's work.
location: Resident physician lounge, 14th floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Afternoon clinical work
description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen continued working in the Second Ward of Cardiovascular Medicine. She assisted attending physician Li Wei in organizing the medical records and discharge summaries of two discharged patients, and had a preoperative conversation with the patient in Bed 45, who was to undergo coronary angiography the next day, patiently explaining the surgical procedure and risks and guiding the signing of the informed consent form. During a break, she browsed the Rehabilitation Assessment Manual she had received in the morning.
location: Cardiology Ward 2, 14th Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Commute home from work and call with mother
description: After work, Yu Xiaowen packed up her things and drove home. On the way, she called her mother and shared how smoothly the visit to Director Wang had gone. Her mother was happy for her and reminded her to take care of herself.
location: On the way from Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Preparing dinner, dinner, and family time
description: After getting home, Yu Xiaowen changed into loungewear and made a tomato and egg rotini with tomatoes, eggs, and diced carrots. She put her work clothes into the washing machine, then brought her homemade dinner to the living room and ate while listening to a rehabilitation medicine podcast. After the meal, she cleared the dishes and chatted with her father, who was watching TV. She asked again about the nursing bed and learned that her father was very comfortable. Then she brewed a cup of green tea and went into the study to prepare for the evening study session.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Evening study and practice
description: In the evening, Yu Xiaowen opened her laptop in the study, logged into the MOOC course, and studied "Rehabilitation Treatment of Motor Dysfunction After Stroke". She watched the video carefully for 50 minutes, used a mind map to record the key points of Bobath technique and the training essentials of Brunnstrom staging, and took photos of key diagrams. Then she completed the after-class exercises. For a wrong question about PNF technique, she replayed the video clip, gained a deeper understanding, and drew simple diagrams in her notebook to reinforce her memory.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Organize notes and take care of washing and grooming
description: After completing the learning tasks, Yu Xiaowen spent 15 minutes organizing the evening's study notes and the key points from her daytime visit to the department director into the 'Rehabilitation Prep' folder in her electronic notebook. Then she went to the bathroom for a hot shower and performed a full evening skincare routine to relax her body and mind.
location: The study and bathroom at home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading
description: Yu Xiaowen took the newly purchased 'Spinal Cord Injury Rehabilitation Guide' out of her bag and placed it on the bedside. She checked the items needed for tomorrow: white coat, notebook, water bottle, car keys, and the 'Rehabilitation Assessment Manual.' She stepped on the scale and recorded her weight as 48.1kg. Then she leaned against the headboard and read two sections about respiratory function rehabilitation after spinal cord injury in the 'Spinal Cord Injury Rehabilitation Guide.' At 23:15 she closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep with her longing for rehabilitation medicine and a steady heart.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning Baduanjin exercise
description: In the early morning, Yu Xiaowen was awakened by the alarm clock in bed. To cope with the daytime heat and her evening plans, she skipped her morning run, laid out her yoga mat on the balcony, and, facing the morning light, focused on completing a full set of Baduanjin and 10 minutes of stretching exercises. The movements were gentle and fluid; she felt her body gradually wake up and her mind become calm and peaceful. After finishing, she drank a glass of warm water.
location: balcony at home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Breakfast and commute preparation
description: Yu Xiaowen prepared breakfast at home: toasted two slices of whole wheat bread, fried a soft-boiled egg, and paired them with a glass of warm milk. While eating, she checked the hospital schedule and to-do list on her phone. After the meal, she washed the dishes, changed into a light blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, and carefully checked her backpack to make sure she had brought the Rehabilitation Assessment Manual, Spinal Cord Injury Rehabilitation Guide, and notebook.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Commute to the hospital by car.
description: Yu Xiaowen drove from home to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Traffic was smooth on the way, so she played an episode of a podcast about speech rehabilitation after stroke to warm up for the afternoon study. She arrived at the hospital about 23 minutes later and parked in the staff parking lot.
location: Staff parking lot, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Morning meetings, ward rounds, and other clinical work
description: After arriving at the department, Yu Xiaowen changed into her white coat, attended the morning handover meeting on time, and carefully recorded the conditions of newly admitted patients and critical patients during the night. She then followed Li Wei on ward rounds and reported in detail on the rehabilitation progress of the patients under her care. Li Wei suggested adjustments to the limb rehabilitation plan for a patient with sequelae of cerebral hemorrhage, and she immediately wrote them down. After rounds, she returned to the office to process medical orders, write progress notes, and prepare home rehabilitation instruction sheets for patients being discharged the next day.
location: Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Taking a work break and booking a health checkup online
description: During a break at work, Yu Xiaowen went to the water dispenser in the hallway to get water and stood by the window to rest her eyes. She took out her phone, made a health check-up appointment through the hospital's WeChat official account, chose the basic package and added cervical spine anteroposterior and lateral DR X-rays, booked a Saturday morning slot on August 16, confirmed the fasting and no-water requirement, completed the payment, and received a confirmation text message.
location: Office and corridor, inpatient department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Continue the morning's clinical work
description: Yu Xiaowen continued working, assisting Teacher Li Wei in formulating an initial rehabilitation assessment plan for a newly admitted patient with spinal cord injury. Afterwards, she patiently answered a family member's inquiries about the condition, explaining the patient's rehabilitation stages and priorities in plain language to ease the family's anxiety.
location: Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch at the cafeteria and midday rest.
description: During the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang went to the staff canteen and ordered braised pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. While eating, they chatted about department anecdotes and Wang Fang's plan to go to the library on the weekend. After the meal, Yu Xiaowen took a 30-minute nap on the folding bed in the office to regain energy.
location: Staff cafeteria and office of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Financial review and monthly budget planning notes
description: After her lunch break, Yu Xiaowen walked to the Moxiangxuan Painting and Calligraphy Society on Bank Street. She browsed the medical book section and found no new books she liked. Then she was attracted by a beautifully bound copy of 'Selected Modern Chinese Essays'. After flipping through it, she bought it and planned to read it in her spare time.
location: Moxiangxuan Calligraphy and Painting Studio, Bank Street, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon work and online learning for the speech rehabilitation course.
description: After finishing routine paperwork, Yu Xiaowen took her equipment to the department teaching room and continued watching the Speech and Swallowing Disorder Rehabilitation course on the MOOC platform, learning about post-stroke aphasia rehabilitation assessment and treatment, as well as compensatory strategies for dysphagia. As she watched, she drew a Wada water drinking test flowchart, recorded key rehabilitation techniques, and simulated swallowing and oral muscle training in front of a mirror.
location: Teaching Room, Rehabilitation Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Had a phone call with my mother and agreed to a blind date.
description: During a break in studying, her mother Li Xiuying called via video. After asking about Yu Xiaowen's work and health, she mentioned that her father was under a lot of mental stress and again urged her to meet a promising state-owned enterprise engineer for a blind date. Yu Xiaowen felt helpless, but gently reassured her mother, agreed to go that evening, and arranged to meet at the Dennis Lakeview Restaurant in Zhengdong New District at 19:00.
location: Corridor of the Rehabilitation Department teaching room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Work wrap-up and getting ready to leave the office.
description: After finishing her study session, Yu Xiaowen returned to the office, organized her work notes and medical records, wrote tomorrow's reminders on a sticky note, and attached it to the edge of her computer. Then she changed out of her white coat, packed up her personal belongings, and prepared to leave work.
location: Office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Returned home to get dressed up and prepare for the blind date.
description: Yu Xiaowen drove home, and the traffic was a bit congested. After arriving home, she quickly showered, changed into a misty-blue floral dress, put on light makeup, and wore the pearl earrings her mother had given her. Her father, Yu Jianguo, praised her when he saw her, but she didn't explain much.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Driving to the blind date restaurant
description: Yu Xiaowen didn't want to be late, so she drove off early to Dennis Lakeview Restaurant and sent a WeChat message to her mother to say she was on the way. On the road, she mentally prepared herself to end the blind date politely if it became awkward.
location: Dennis Lakeview Restaurant, 11 Shangwu Inner Ring Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan (on the way)

name: Blind date dinner with engineer Zhang Jianguo
description: Yu Xiaowen met her blind date Zhang Jianguo at the restaurant. He wore silver-rimmed glasses and a plaid shirt, and was reserved in speech and manner. The two ordered steak sets, and the conversation stayed on superficial topics such as company organizational structure and commuting. Yu Xiaowen tried to find common topics, but the other party had no interest in literature or art, which made her feel bored. She maintained a polite smile. After the meal, he proposed going Dutch, and they took a polite leave of each other.
location: Dennis Lakeside Restaurant, No. 11 Business Inner Ring Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lakeside walk at Ruyi Lake and self-reflection.
description: After the blind date ended, Yu Xiaowen walked alone to the boardwalk by Ruyi Lake and strolled around the lake twice. The lake reflected the building lights, and a gentle breeze brushed her face. The emptiness inside her was gradually replaced by a clear realization: she needed a partner who was spiritually compatible and could grow together with her, not a 'suitable match' based on conditions. She decided that in the future she should communicate her inner thoughts more honestly with her mother.
location: Ruyi Lake lakeside boardwalk, Business Inner Ring Road service road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Vented about the blind date experience in the besties' group chat.
description: Yu Xiaowen sat down on a bench by the lake and sent a message in the WeChat group Childhood Friends Trio describing the blind date process, jokingly saying she had completed the KPI task. Wang Lina immediately comforted her and suggested she not force herself to settle in the future; Zhang Jing sent a hugging emoji and said she would help screen the next one. The replies from her close friends warmed her heart and made her feel much better.
location: Bench on the lakeside boardwalk of Ruyi Lake, auxiliary road of Business Inner Ring Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Wrote in diary after returning home
description: Yu Xiaowen drove home, greeted her father, and went into her room. She used a locked diary to record the day's experiences and reflections, writing: 'I don't want to settle. Companionship cannot be just a pile of conditions; it needs soul connection. In the future, I must be braver in expressing myself.' After writing, she felt her thoughts were clear.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening washing up and skincare
description: After removing her makeup, Yu Xiaowen carefully cleansed her face and applied a sleeping mask. She changed into comfortable pajamas, laid out tomorrow's clothes and belongings, turned off the main light, and kept only the bedside lamp on before getting ready for bed.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Read essays before bed and fall asleep
description: Yu Xiaowen lay in bed, picked up the "Selected Modern Chinese Essays" she had bought during the day, and began to read. Under the soft lamplight, an essay about "loneliness" struck a chord with her. Around 11:30 p.m., drowsiness set in; she closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up, morning stretching, and breakfast preparation
description: Woken by the alarm, it was raining outside the window. A pang of heaviness passed through her heart as she remembered that her father's insurance application had been rejected, but she decided to focus on the present. She laid out a yoga mat on the balcony and followed a phone app to do 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches. Then she washed up, heated milk in the microwave, and hastily ate breakfast with whole wheat bread and a banana. She sent a WeChat message to her parents in Luoyang reminding them to put on more clothes. She changed into her white coat, checked her stethoscope, notebook, and pen, and because the rainy roads were slippery, decided to commute by subway. She took her umbrella and bag and left home.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Courtyard 12, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (bedroom, balcony, kitchen, entryway)

name: Commuting and learning from a rehabilitation medicine podcast.
description: She walked about 8 minutes with an umbrella to Jingsan Road Station on Metro Line 5. The platform was a bit crowded. After boarding, she put on Bluetooth earphones and played the cached rehabilitation medicine podcast, titled “Stepped Treatment for Neuropathic Pain after Spinal Cord Injury.” She listened attentively the whole way, occasionally looking up at the station display, and after transferring at a Metro Line 1 station, she arrived at the station near the hospital.
location: Starting from No. 12 Yard, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, walk to Jingsan Road Station on Metro Line 5, take the subway to a Line 1 station, and after exiting, walk to Zhengzhou Central Hospital at 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou.

name: Morning clinical work (including arrival and changing clothes)
description: After arriving at the hospital, she entered through the side door of the outpatient building, changed into her white coat in the neurology locker room, and tidied her appearance. At 08:30 she attended the department morning meeting. Under the direction of Director Zhang Lei, she reported the conditions and treatment plans of two newly admitted patients with cerebral infarction, and her clinical instructor Li Wei added key points. Starting at 09:00, she joined Instructor Li Wei on the grand ward round, focusing on a Parkinson's disease patient's drug response, recording UPDRS scale scores, and noting that the patient's festinating gait had improved. After 10:30, she accompanied Instructor Li Wei throughout the specialist outpatient clinic. During this time, she independently attended to an elderly woman whose chief complaint was "recurrent dizziness for 1 week," completed history taking and a neurological examination, considered benign paroxysmal positional vertigo, and after reporting to her instructor, arranged a vestibular function test for the patient.
location: Doctor's office, ward, and outpatient clinic of Neurology Ward 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break, insurance consultation, and emotional adjustment
description: After entering the rest room alone and locking the door, she called her insurance advisor Wang Jie and explained in detail her father Yu Jianguo's age, history of cerebral infarction, and current rehabilitation status of walking slowly indoors with a walker, expressing her intention to apply for hospitalization medical insurance. Wang Jie frankly told her that the cerebral infarction history was a major pre-existing condition and that it was highly likely she would not pass health disclosure; he advised against applying and briefly explained alternatives such as Huimin Insurance. Although she had anticipated it, she still felt her throat tighten. She calmly thanked him and hung up. She closed her eyes and remained silent for a few minutes, then decided to focus on increasing savings and professional competence. She sent Wang Jie a WeChat message thanking him for his honest advice, and sent Wang Fang a message explaining why she had not gone to the canteen. She leaned back in her chair and rested for about 20 minutes.
location: Neurology department doctors' lounge, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon clinical work
description: I processed the discharge procedures for a patient with sequelae of cerebral infarction and explained home rehabilitation precautions in detail to the family. Then I wrote the outpatient medical record and the initial progress note for the morning patient with dizziness. From 15:00 to 16:00, I used my spare time to organize notes on the Parkinson's medication adjustment plan from clinical shadowing. At 16:00, the emergency department called to say a patient with a suspected transient ischemic attack was being admitted. I quickly went to the emergency department and completed the history-taking and initial neurological examination.
location: No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province; Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Department of Neurology, Ward 1, doctor's office, ward, and emergency department.

name: After-work commute and relaxation
description: After finishing work, I changed back into casual clothes in the changing room. The rain had stopped and the air was fresh. I walked to the subway station, took Line 1 and transferred to Line 5 to return. The carriage was crowded, but I did not listen to any audio programs. I only played a soothing piano piece to let my nerves relax.
location: Starting from the changing room at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, walk to the subway station, take Line 5 to Jingsan Road Station, then walk back to Courtyard No. 12, Qunying Road, Jinshui District after exiting the station.

name: Dinner at home, relaxing on the balcony, and video call with parents
description: After changing into loungewear, she had a video call with her parents in Luoyang. Her father said in a vigorous voice that he had walked two laps around the living room with a walker, which made her feel a little relieved. Not feeling very hungry, she simply cooked a bowl of tomato and egg noodles, adding a poached egg and a few greens. After the meal, she stood on the balcony with a cup of water, looking at the clean community roads after the rain. She zoned out for a moment, and most of her fatigue faded away.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, No. 12 Courtyard, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (living room, kitchen, balcony)

name: Adjusting the family financial plan
description: She sat at the desk and took out her ledger and mobile banking app. Because the insurance was rejected, she decisively raised the monthly medical reserve for her parents from 2,000 yuan to 2,500 yuan, circled it in red and marked it "first priority." She recalculated this month's budget: rent 5,000 yuan, parents' medical reserve 2,500 yuan, living expenses 1,800 yuan, transportation and communication 300 yuan, emergency expenses 400 yuan. Below the date she wrote a note: "Increasing primary income and obtaining the attending physician qualification is the fundamental way to resist risks."
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Courtyard No. 12, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (in front of the desk)

name: Study the spinal cord injury rehabilitation course and take a short break
description: She opened her laptop, logged into the MOOC platform to continue the spinal cord injury rehabilitation course, and studied the "ASIA classification and neurological localization of sensory and motor levels." While watching the video, she drew diagrams of spinal cord segments in her notebook. Then she did 10 supporting practice questions. She got stuck on question 8 about determining the sensory level, and finally scored 70 points. Frustrated, she spent 20 minutes re-studying the definitions of "sacral sparing" and "neurological level," marked the parts she didn't understand with a red pen, and planned to ask the rehabilitation physician the next day. Feeling tired from studying, she got up and went to the kitchen to brew rose tea, and paced slowly around the living room to exercise her neck and shoulders.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Courtyard 12, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (in front of the desk, living room, kitchen)

name: Video call with her older brother Yu Xiaofeng.
description: She took the initiative to start a video call with her brother in Shenzhen and told him in detail about the rejection of the insurance application for their father and her decision to raise her reserve fund to 2,500 yuan. Her brother comforted her, saying that if commercial insurance could not be bought, using their own savings would be more flexible, and the 5,000 yuan monthly rehabilitation money he transferred would not be reduced. He told Yu Xiaowen to focus on her work with peace of mind, and that the siblings would carry the family matters together. She suddenly felt warm inside, and her stress was greatly reduced.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Courtyard 12, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (living room sofa)

name: Washing up and neck care routine before bed.
description: In a relaxed mood, she washed up and did her skincare routine. After cleansing with a gentle facial cleanser, she took the cervical topical ointment and gently massaged it on the back of her neck to relieve the day's fatigue, then changed into pajamas.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, No. 12 Courtyard, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (bathroom, bedroom)

name: Bedtime neck exercises and mindfulness meditation
description: She laid out the yoga mat in the bedroom, opened Keep, and did a 15-minute "Shoulder and Neck Relief" workout with gentle, stretching movements. After finishing, she turned off the main light, leaving only the night light, sat cross-legged for 10 minutes of mindfulness meditation, focusing on her breath and letting her mind withdraw from trivial matters. A thought flashed through her mind: for tomorrow's physical exam, she had to fast and avoid water after 10 p.m.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, No. 12 Courtyard, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (on the yoga mat in the bedroom).

name: Recorded today's summary and went to bed
description: After meditation, I felt calm in body and mind. I picked up my phone and wrote a summary in the memo: "The insurance was rejected, but the financial plan has been decisively adjusted upward. Study hit a snag; I need to ask the rehabilitation department for help. My brother's support is a shot in the arm. Tomorrow is Saturday and I have the physical exam; I'll try to get a good report." I turned off my phone, placed loose clothes and the physical exam form on the bedside table, and after turning off the light, fell asleep peacefully listening to the faint sound of rain in the distance.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, No. 12 Courtyard, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (on the bed in the bedroom)

name: Morning exercise and remote companionship with father.
description: The morning sunlight gently streamed onto the balcony. At 6:30, the alarm went off right on time. Wearing a loose sports tank top and shorts, I walked onto the balcony and felt the summer morning breeze. I first did a 10-minute full-body stretch to loosen up my shoulders, neck, and lower back, then followed the Baduanjin teaching video saved on my phone, slowly and attentively completing the whole routine. Every movement was coordinated with deep breathing, and I felt my sleeping body gradually awaken. After finishing Baduanjin, I wiped the light sweat from my forehead and, instead of going inside immediately, called my father on video. On the screen, he was walking slowly with a walker in a small park near his home in Luoyang. While moving my wrists and ankles on the balcony, I chatted with him: "Dad, take steadier steps; if you're tired, sit down on the side and rest a while." He smiled and nodded, telling me the weather was nice today and that he had walked for over ten minutes without feeling dizzy. I reminded him to drink plenty of water to prevent heatstroke and cool down. The call lasted 15 minutes. Seeing him in good spirits, I felt reassured.
location: Balcony and living room, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, 25 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Breakfast and preparation to go out
description: After hanging up, I went back inside and washed up. I took out the whole-wheat bread, a boiled egg, and a carton of plain milk I had bought last night. As I ate the simple breakfast, I glanced at today's weather and a few medical news briefs on my phone, and confirmed the physical examination requirements (the fasting items had been done; a cervical spine X-ray was needed). After eating, I changed into an easy-to-put-on T-shirt and sweatpants, grabbed my patient card, ID card, and portable charger, checked my backpack, and got ready to go out.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, 25 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove to the hospital.
description: At 7:45, I went downstairs on time and started the car. It was the tail end of morning rush hour, and there weren't many cars on the road. I listened to traffic radio along the way and arrived at the hospital smoothly after about 12 minutes. After parking in the underground garage, I took the elevator directly to the health examination center on the fourth floor of the outpatient building.
location: From Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, ending at the Zhengzhou Central Hospital parking lot

name: Annual comprehensive physical examination.
description: I scanned the QR code to sign in at the self-service machine at the front desk with my ID card, and soon received a check-up guide sheet and a confirmation form that included an additional item (cervical spine X-ray). At exactly 8 o'clock, the physical examination officially began. I proceeded in order: at the blood draw window, I watched the nurse deftly draw 3 tubes of blood (complete blood count, biochemistry, tumor markers); then I left a urine specimen. Next, I had an electrocardiogram and abdominal ultrasound, both of which went smoothly, and the doctors were gentle. Around 9 o'clock, I arrived at the radiology department and had anteroposterior and lateral cervical spine X-rays taken. While lying on the X-ray table, I deliberately moved my neck a bit and felt that my shoulders and neck were indeed somewhat tense. After all the items were done, I received a nutritious breakfast at the front desk—a vegetable bun, a cup of soy milk, and an egg.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Physical Examination Center, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After the physical exam, have breakfast and go to the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine.
description: I didn't eat breakfast right away. Instead, carrying the breakfast bag, I went directly to the Rehabilitation Medicine Department in the same building. On August 13, I had made an appointment with Director Wang to ask him questions this morning, so I went to see if he was free now. When I reached the doctor's office door, I saw Director Wang Zhenhua sitting at his computer reading literature. I gently knocked on the door. He looked up, saw me, and said with a smile, "Xiaowen, you're here. Perfect, I still have a bit of time."
location: Outside the office of the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Seeking advice on difficult points in the rehabilitation course
description: I took out my phone and showed him several difficult points I had marked while studying the MOOC 'Rehabilitation Treatment Techniques for Spinal Cord Injury' last night, especially the design of a specific rehabilitation plan for a patient with a T10 complete injury on the ASIA scale, including wheelchair selection, transfer training, and respiratory training. Director Wang was very patient. He picked up the spinal model and diagrams from the desk and spent 20 minutes explaining it to me in detail. He particularly emphasized that for such patients, early bladder management and respiratory function training are even more important than muscle strength training, and he recommended that I also read the relevant chapters in 'Neurorehabilitation'. As I listened, I quickly jotted down the key points in my phone memo.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return home.
description: After thanking Director Wang, I went downstairs to the parking lot and got in the car. On the way home, I replayed Director Wang's explanation in my head. Once home, I washed my hands, poured a glass of water, and sat down at my desk.
location: From Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Qunying Road, Jinshui District, ending at Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community.

name: In-depth study of rehabilitation treatment techniques for spinal cord injury
description: First, I spent 15 minutes organizing the notes from my consultation with Director Wang onto the courseware I printed yesterday, and marked the key points with a red pen. Then, I opened the "Chinese University MOOC" app on my tablet and listened carefully again to the course on T10 complete injury in "Rehabilitation Therapy Techniques for Spinal Cord Injury." This time, I paid special attention to the rehabilitation plan design Director Wang mentioned. On a piece of scratch paper, I drew a flow chart of the rehabilitation plan: I listed short-term goals (preventing complications, sitting balance) and long-term goals (independently propelling a wheelchair, partial self-care), and then filled in all the details from three dimensions: physical therapy (muscle strength, breathing, bladder), occupational therapy (ADL, assistive device selection), and psychosocial rehabilitation. I even simulated the scenario of a 45-year-old male patient and formulated a detailed weekly plan for him. It was 12:00 when I finished studying, and I felt my thinking was clearer than ever before.
location: Study room, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, No. 25 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch and rest
description: After studying, I went to the kitchen. There were still the greens and eggs I bought yesterday, so I made myself a simple bowl of green vegetable and egg noodles. After eating, I leaned on the sofa in the living room, opened the 'Tide' app, and played a 15-minute 'Afternoon Nap' white noise, closing my eyes to rest and let my brain fully relax.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, 25 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drive to the pottery studio
description: At 13:15, I changed into an old stain-resistant T-shirt and casual pants, took a canvas tote bag, and went out to drive. I set the navigation to 'Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio'. The roads were clear, so I drove for about 25 minutes and listened to an episode of a podcast about music therapy on the way.
location: On the way from home to the pottery studio, the destination is the Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio at the northeast corner of the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Jingkai 8th Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Pottery wheel-throwing breakthrough and creation
description: After arriving at the studio, I put on an apron and found my workbench. I first pinched a piece of clay to feel its moisture, then started throwing on the wheel. The first two attempts failed because I was a little impatient. Not discouraged, I took a deep breath, put on earphones, and played Bach's Cello Suites. In the low and peaceful melody, my mind became calm. On the third try, I held my breath and concentrated, gently but firmly holding the clay in both hands, feeling it spin, rise, open, and take shape in my palms. This time, I succeeded! In an hour and a half, I threw a well-proportioned greenware bowl, a small teacup with an everted rim, and a small saucer with smooth edges. Excitedly, I called Master Zheng to come and look. He praised, 'Music and clay have merged in your hands; your technique is steady. This is your real breakthrough!' I smiled happily.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, northeast corner of the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Jingkai 8th Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Making engraved ceramic plaque gifts and clearing the venue
description: The excitement of creating reminded me of the gift for my best friend Chen Siyu. Using the leftover clay, I carefully shaped a small ceramic plaque about 8 cm long and 3 cm wide. With a carving knife, I carved the two characters 'Siyu' on the back of the plaque, crookedly but very earnestly, and drew a small heart. Then I dipped a small brush in water and smoothed the surface of the plaque. Around 17:00, I placed all the pieces, including that plaque, into the electric kiln in the studio, set the temperature and time for bisque firing (the first firing). At the worktable, I filled out the piece labels and firing form.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, northeast corner of the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Jingkai 8th Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return trip and grocery shopping.
description: After saying goodbye to Master Zheng and friends at the studio, I drove home. On the way, I made a point to stop at the Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop on Qunying Road. It was the weekend, so the shop was quite busy. I bought 2 tomatoes, a bunch of scallions, a piece of silken tofu, and a bag of dried noodles, planning to make a light tomato tofu soup noodle dish for dinner. I also picked up a carton of milk, spending 17.5 yuan in total.
location: The Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop at 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and on the way home.

name: Dinner and tidying up
description: When I got home, I washed and chopped the vegetables, boiled water, and cooked noodles. I cut the tomatoes into pieces and the tofu into cubes. After the water boiled, I first stir-fried the tomatoes to make a red soup, added water and brought it to a boil, then put in the tofu, and finally added the noodles. Five minutes later, a steaming hot and light noodle soup was ready. Carrying the bowl, I sat at the dining table and watched an episode of the documentary 'Herbal China' while eating. After eating, I washed the dishes and cleaned up the kitchen.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 25 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China

name: Organizing physical exam and study notes
description: I opened my laptop and created a Word document called 2025.08.16 Review. I wrote down today's impressions of all the physical examination items and the doctor's reminders, and added a note that the cervical spine X-ray result needs attention. Then I organized the key points of the T10 complete injury rehabilitation program I studied in the afternoon into a mind map of about 600 words, and also entered Director Wang's guidance points, then saved and archived it.
location: Study room, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, No. 25 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: WeChat socializing and making plans to watch a movie
description: After finishing, I leaned back on the sofa and opened WeChat. I saw my best friend Zhang Jing asking in the group, "Anyone up for a movie this weekend?" I replied by voice message: "Today I got my checkup and studies done, and I even made a breakthrough in pottery this afternoon! How about tomorrow, Sunday, we go to CGV to see the newly released The Secret Life of Walter Mitty? I'll treat you!" She instantly replied, "Great! Deal! You buy the movie tickets, I'll buy the popcorn." We chatted by voice for another 10 minutes. She talked about the pressure of preparing her open class, and I comforted her, telling her, "Your spontaneous performance is always the best."
location: Sofa in the living room, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, 25 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening washing up, meditation, reading, and going to bed
description: After hanging up the phone, I got up to wash up. I carefully washed my face, brushed my teeth, and applied a hydrating mask. At the same time, I took out the casual dress and canvas shoes I planned to wear tomorrow from the wardrobe, and placed the backpack I would use for the movies tomorrow by the door, with keys, tissues, and wet wipes already inside. After washing up, I turned off the main light and left only the small bedside nightlight on. I lay down, opened the Tide app, chose the Day 5 session of "7-Day Mindfulness Meditation," and followed the voice guidance for a 15-minute breathing meditation. I focused on each breath in and out, letting all of today's thoughts and joy slowly settle, feeling the day's fatigue dissolve with every breath. After the meditation, I picked up the book Selected Modern Chinese Prose from the bedside table and flipped to Zhu Ziqing's "The Back." Although I had read it many times, reading it today, recalling the details of my phone call with my father this morning, I felt even more moved. After reading quietly for 40 minutes, I picked up the newly borrowed Neurological Rehabilitation and browsed the chapter on cervical spine rehabilitation as a preview for tomorrow. I put down the book, checked my phone alarm (already set for 8:30 tomorrow), and placed it on the nightstand. I stretched, adjusted my pillow, and turned off the desk lamp. In the darkness, I reflected on today's smooth health checkup, the gains from the rehabilitation course, the breakthrough in pottery, and the interactions with family and friends, feeling full and at peace. Soon, I fell into a deep, contented sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 25 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning run and return home
description: Woke up at 6:00 a.m., washed up, changed into workout clothes, and drove to Bishagang Park. Arrived at 6:15, did dynamic stretching first, then jogged 2.5 km along the greenway at a pace of 7 min/km, completed squats and lunges in the fitness area and recorded them with Keep, and finally did static stretching. On the way back, I bought mineral water and milk at the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road, and returned home to Qunying Community, Jinshui District, around 6:50.
location: Bishagang Park (at the intersection of Jianshe Road and Songshan Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou)

name: Accompany father on rehabilitation walk remotely
description: After returning home, she had a video call with her father Yu Jianguo. Accompanied by her mother, her father walked slowly with a cane on the gentle slope in front of the house. Xiaowen, while stretching in the living room, encouraged her father and asked about his sleep and appetite. After accompanying him for about 25 minutes, her father rested, and after a brief chat, they hung up.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Breakfast, rest, and preparations before departure.
description: After showering, she changed into loungewear and prepared whole wheat toast, a fried egg, and hot milk for breakfast. While eating, she checked the hospital's official WeChat account and confirmed that her biochemistry and blood routine indicators from the physical exam were normal, and that the cervical spine X-ray indicated a slightly straightened physiological curvature. After breakfast, she tidied the living room, then changed into a shirt and jeans. She wrapped the ceramic plaque engraved with ‘Siyu’ in bubble wrap and put in a blessing card, checked the other ceramic works, and took her keys, phone, and power bank before getting ready to go out.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drive to the pottery studio
description: Drove from Qunying Residential Complex to the Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio. Traffic was smooth, and the drive took about 25 minutes. Along the way, Debussy's Clair de Lune played, and I reached the studio at the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Jingkai Eighth Street in Guancheng Hui District.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, 200 meters south of the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Jingkai Eighth Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City

name: Attended a pottery demonstration and sent a gift.
description: After arriving at the studio, Su Ya and Zhang Jing were already waiting, and the three brewed jasmine tea; Sun Yue arrived a little later because of her emergency shift. Xiaowen showed the thrown cups, small bowls, and the carefully crafted Siyu ceramic plaque, demonstrated the throwing technique on the spot, exchanged insights with Su Ya, and promised to make small bowls for Zhang Jing as well. At the end of the viewing session, she sent the ceramic plaque and card via SF Express to Chen Siyu at Luoyang Experimental High School, and took a photo of the waybill to send to her. The friends teased and praised her, and the atmosphere was pleasant.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, 200 meters south of the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Jingkai Eighth Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City

name: Had a simple lunch with a friend.
description: After the observation session, the four of them walked to the nearby 'Ni Hao Shi Guang' fusion restaurant. Xiaowen ordered a avocado chicken salad and lemonade. As they ate and chatted, Sun Yue shared interesting stories from pediatrics, Zhang Jing complained about mischievous students, and Xiaowen revealed that she would soon be transferred to the rehabilitation department, which everyone approved of. They took a group photo after the meal.
location: The 'Nihao Shiguang' fusion restaurant at the southwest corner of the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Jingkai Eighth Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou

name: Returning home and a brief midday rest
description: After saying goodbye to her friends, she drove back home in Jinshui District. Feeling a little drowsy on the way, she opened the window for ventilation to refresh herself. After getting home, she changed into pajamas, set the alarm, and lay down on the bed for a nap of about 20 minutes to regain energy for the afternoon activities.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Meeting Zhang Jing at the movie theater
description: After her lunch break, she changed into a dress and cycled to the CGV Cinemas in Zhenghong City, picked up the tickets for The Secret Life of Walter Mitty, and waited for Zhang Jing to arrive. The two bought popcorn and Coke and entered the theater. They were deeply moved by the scenes of Walter Mitty's adventurous journey, and especially remembered the line 'I just want to live in it.' After the movie, they strolled around the mall, bought milk tea at Yidiandian, and discussed the film while drinking, enjoying a pleasant afternoon.
location: Zhenghong City CGV Cinema and the shopping mall, No. 126 Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Went to the calligraphy and painting club to buy books, then returned home for dinner and relaxation.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Jing, she cycled to the Moxiangxuan Calligraphy and Painting Society near the intersection of Huayuan Road and Nongye Road, browsed novels and medical humanities magazines, and bought “Case Analysis in Neurological Rehabilitation” (Third Edition) and the essay collection “The Grass and Trees of the Human World”. After paying, she returned home, made a simple tomato egg noodle dish, and enjoyed a relaxing dinner alone while eating and watching “A Bite of China” on her iPad.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Conducted neurological rehabilitation case studies.
description: In the study, she opened her laptop and studied three comprehensive cases in depth: stroke hemiplegia with speech impairment, spinal cord injury with paraplegia, and sequelae of traumatic brain injury. She analyzed them according to the steps of rehabilitation assessment and goal setting, took notes while watching Director Wang's instructional video, focused on analyzing the T10 complete injury case, and underlined key points in the book Neurorehabilitation Case Analysis. She continued studying for 1.5 hours.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Evening Wash-Up and Skincare
description: After studying, she got up to stretch her shoulders and neck, then went through her evening cleansing routine in the bathroom: removing makeup, washing her face, applying toner and moisturizer for basic skincare, and finally putting on lip balm to get ready for sleep.
location: Home bathroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening meditation, reading, and going to bed
description: After turning off the lights, she lay flat and used the Tide app for a 10-minute mindful breathing meditation, reviewing her fulfilling and happy day. Then she turned on the bedside lamp, leaned against the headboard and browsed Plants and Trees in the Human World, enjoying its plain, warm style. She then spent half an hour carefully reading the alternative treatment plan for traumatic brain injury in Neurorehabilitation Case Analysis and underlined key points. At around 21:50 she put down the book, set the alarm for 6:30 the next day, switched her phone to silent, turned off the lights and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up and Baduanjin exercise
description: Office of Dr. Li Wei, Rehabilitation Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province
location: Balcony, Room 301, Unit 5, Building 12, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Check the health check-up report and have breakfast
description: After completing Baduanjin, Yu Ming used their phone to log in to the Zhengzhou Central Hospital WeChat official account to check the electronic physical examination report. After seeing the conclusion "cervical physiological curvature straightened", they carefully read the health suggestions. Then they heated milk, fried eggs, and prepared whole-wheat bread as breakfast in the kitchen. While eating, they checked the weather, confirmed that the day would be sunny turning to thundershowers, and added cervical spine exercises to the evening plan.
location: Kitchen and living room, Room 301, Unit 5, No. 12, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Commuting to the hospital by car
description: Yu Ming checked that the sunlight outside the window was still fine, but he put a folding umbrella into his commuter bag in case of the forecast thunderstorm. He changed into casual clothes, took his car keys, and went downstairs. Driving the family car along Qunying Road onto Tongbai Road, listening to classical music, he arrived at the parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital about 16 minutes later.
location: From Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (while driving)

name: Monday morning meeting and grand rounds preparation
description: At 7:50, I went to the office, put on my white coat, organized the medical records, and attended the department morning meeting. The department director, Zhang Lei, introduced this week's work priorities and reminded everyone that there would be a small surprise for Doctors' Day tomorrow. After the meeting, the teaching attending, Li Wei, led the grand ward rounds. Yu Ming reported on the conditions of the patients in Bed 5, Bed 12, and Bed 25. Li Wei asked a question about the principles of diuretic use in heart failure patients, and Yu Ming's fluent answer won praise. After the rounds, he returned to the office and adjusted the medical orders.
location: Doctor's Office/Conference Room, Department of Cardiology, 3rd Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Handle clinical work in the morning.
description: After the ward rounds, Yu Ming plunged into the morning work: writing discharge summaries and medication orders for two discharged patients and completing the initial progress note for a newly admitted patient's medical record. Around 10:30, a family member of the patient in Bed 25 anxiously asked about the condition. Yu Ming patiently explained the treatment plan and prognosis to calm their worries. He also assisted the nurse with a bedside electrocardiogram for a patient with limited mobility, handling everything in an orderly manner.
location: Cardiovascular Medicine, 3rd Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Lunch and cervical spine exercise practice
description: At 11:30, she had lunch with her colleague Wang Fang in the hospital cafeteria, chatting about funny stories from the weekend mountain hike and the pottery observation session. After lunch, she returned to the department lounge, where Yu Ming performed the cervical spine health exercises for the first time, slowly completing neck flexion, extension, and shoulder shrugs, feeling comfortable in the neck.
location: Staff cafeteria and doctors' rest room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon clinical work and Doctors' Day preparation.
description: In the afternoon I continued with work: organizing the morning ward round records and completing a consultation request form. Around 15:30, I saw Head Nurse Wu Min walk into the nurses' station carrying an exquisitely designed cake box. I learned it was a surprise cake that the director had prepared for tomorrow's Doctors' Day. At 16:00, I finished the last medical record on hand, tidied my desk, and wrapped up work.
location: Cardiovascular Medicine, 3rd Floor, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Going home after work and changing clothes to prepare
description: At 16:30, I left work, changed into casual clothes, and drove home. On the way, I thought about the Toastmasters event; although it brought some social pressure, I decided to take it seriously. I got home around 17:00, quickly changed into a neat knit top and trousers, took a sandwich and yogurt from the fridge for a quick snack, and reconfirmed the event address.
location: Room 301, Unit 5, No. 12, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Drive to the Toastmasters club
description: At 17:00, she took an umbrella and a notebook, drove to the Jianshe West Road Community Activity Center, chose a route with less traffic, arrived about 15 minutes later, and saw the Toastmasters speech club sign.
location: From Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Jianshe West Road Community Activity Center at the northeast corner of the intersection of Jianshe West Road and Wenhua Palace Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (while driving)

name: Attend the Toastmasters Speech Club regular meeting
description: Arrived at the venue early, and his colleague Liu Qiang warmly invited him to sit down. The regular meeting started at 17:30. Yu Ming was called on to participate in the one-minute impromptu speech segment, with the topic "One thing that made you re-understand yourself." He spontaneously shared the moment during a hospital rescue when a patient's family member's grateful look made him realize the significance of being a doctor. The speech was nervous but sincere and moving, and won warm applause. After the meeting, Liu Qiang affirmed him. Yu Ming candidly said that although he had completed the challenge, he might not be suited for public occasions and might prefer to focus on his specialty in the future. After briefly chatting with Liu Qiang and other members, he left at 19:30 and drove back.
location: Meeting room, 2nd floor, Jianshe West Road Community Activity Center, northeast corner of the intersection of Jianshe West Road and Wenhua Gong Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and brief rest
description: She got home at 19:45. On the way, she bought a multigrain pancake and soy milk for dinner, ate quickly, then rested briefly to recharge before her study tasks.
location: Room 301, Unit 5, No. 12, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Neurological rehabilitation module summary and online test
description: At 20:10 entered the study, opened the laptop and tablet, reviewed relevant chapters of "Case Analysis in Neurological Rehabilitation" and her notes from last week, focusing on spinal cord injury rehabilitation assessment and treatment principles. At 20:30 logged into the online learning platform to take the unit test, completed 30 multiple-choice questions and 2 short-answer questions, answered with full concentration, and finally scored 86 points. Marked the mistakes related to bowel management for review tomorrow.
location: Study room, Room 301, Unit 5, Building 12, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening cervical spine exercises
description: After finishing the test, she returned to the living room and stood in front of the TV. Based on her lunch break practice and online recommendations, she again performed the full set of neck exercises, focusing on slow head-and-neck extension and left-right lateral flexion, combined with shoulder shrugs for relaxation. Her neck muscles were well stretched, and she resolved to make this a fixed nightly habit.
location: Living room, Room 301, Unit 5, No. 12, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up and relaxation record.
description: At 21:30, she went into the bathroom to wash up and do her skincare routine, then used her phone to record today's new Toastmasters experience and the relaxed feeling after finishing the test.
location: Restroom, Room 301, Unit 5, No. 12, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading and meditation before bed
description: Changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard. She opened Wang Zengqi's Plants and Trees in the Human World and read one or two essays about plants, insects, and fish, feeling the plain, warm quality of the writing. At 22:15, she turned off the light and did a 10-minute bedtime meditation to clear her mind. At 22:30, she fell into a deep sleep with the satisfaction of taking on new challenges and continuing to learn.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Unit 5, No. 12, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning exercise and washing/getting ready
description: In the early morning, at her home in Qunying Residential Community, Yu Xiaowen started the new day on the balcony under the faint light of the rainy day outside. She first did head, shoulder, and neck stretches, then opened a mobile app and followed 'Green Pine Melody' to practice the complete Baduanjin routine, paying special attention to the cervical-spine-friendly movements 'Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner' and 'Look Back to Prevent Five Strains and Seven Injuries'. She felt her shoulders and neck loosen up. After exercising, she went to the bathroom to wash up. While combing her hair, she quietly said to herself in the mirror, 'Happy Doctor's Day, Dr. Yu!' Then she changed into a neatly ironed white doctor's coat and dark gray trousers, and pinned a ginkgo leaf brooch to her chest pocket. The brooch was a birthday gift from her older female cousin last year, symbolizing resilience and composure.
location: Balcony, bathroom, and bedroom at home in Qunying Residential Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Buy breakfast and commute by car
description: Yu Xiaowen took her folding umbrella and commuter bag and left. A fine drizzle was falling, so she opened her umbrella and walked to Old Zhao's Caring Breakfast Shop on the corner near the community entrance. She said to the owner familiarly, "Uncle Zhao, one jianbing guozi with an extra egg and a cup of hot soy milk!" Old Zhao, busy with his hands, replied with a smile, "Coming right up! Dr. Yu, today is Doctors' Day, so I'll add extra crispy cracker for you. Happy Doctors' Day!" Yu Xiaowen felt a warmth in her heart, thanked him repeatedly, and took the steaming breakfast. She then carried it to the car, started the engine, and drove a little slower than usual because the rainy roads were slippery. While waiting at a red light, she took a couple of bites of the jianbing. The car stereo played Debussy's "Moonlight," and the serene piano piece made her feel relaxed and focused on the way to the hospital.
location: Old Zhao's Caring Breakfast Shop, No. 13-7 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and the drive via Qunying Road to Tongbai North Road in Zhongyuan District

name: Department morning meeting and celebration for Doctors' Day.
description: At 07:50, Yu Xiaowen stepped into the doctor's office of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department at Zhengzhou Central Hospital on time. The morning meeting proceeded as usual. Director Zhang Lei first summarized the previous day's critical patient situations and pointed out the focus of ward rounds. Then, in a gentle voice, he said, "Today is August 19, 2025, the seventh Chinese Doctors' Day. On behalf of the department, I want to say thank you to every doctor who has stayed at their post!" As soon as he finished, Head Nurse Wu Min pushed in a cart with a cake box tied with a pink ribbon. Director Zhang opened the box himself, revealing an exquisite cream cake with the word "Guardian" written on it in chocolate. Applause and cheers broke out. After the morning meeting, everyone gathered to share the cake. Yu Xiaowen, along with her friends Wang Fang and Liu Qiang, stood by the window and shared a piece of cake with the "Guardian" lettering using small forks. Wang Fang said excitedly, "These chocolate letters are so full of ceremony!" Yu Xiaowen smiled, took out her phone, took a close-up of the cake, and said to Wang Fang, "I want to send this to my parents to see." She then sent the photo to the family WeChat group. Her father, Yu Jianguo, replied, "Received, Xiaowen. The title of 'Guardian' is both an honor and a responsibility. You are truly worthy of being the daughter of the Yu family." Her mother, Li Xiuying, sent a long voice message with relief: "My girl, I saw it! It's so beautiful! The director and head nurse went to a lot of trouble. It's a special day today, so be sure to eat something nice at lunch. The weather is bad, so be careful on your way home from work." A warm feeling surged in Yu Xiaowen's heart, and she replied, "Received, Mom and Dad. I'll work hard!"
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning ward rounds and handling medical orders
description: Yu Xiaowen began her ward rounds with a warm heart. Today she was especially patient. She walked to the bedside of Grandpa Zhang in Bed 15, half crouched down, and asked gently, 'Good morning, Grandpa Zhang. Did you sleep well last night? Is the swelling in your legs a little better than yesterday? Let me see your ankle range of motion.' She carefully recorded each patient's feedback, followed her supervising teacher Li Wei while discussing cases, and after returning to the office, she carefully checked the new medical orders and wrote discharge summaries for the patients about to be discharged. Everything proceeded in an orderly manner.
location: Rehabilitation Medicine Department ward and doctor's office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Lunch and lunch break
description: At noon, Yu Xiaowen, Wang Fang, and Liu Qiang went to the staff cafeteria of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. They each got their meals and sat down by the window. Wang Fang said excitedly that she had heard the cafeteria was giving each doctor an extra mousse cake as a benefit today. Liu Qiang raised his orange juice and said, "Xiaowen, although I don't celebrate the holiday, I wish you a happy holiday! I hope our rehabilitation department gets better and better!" Yu Xiaowen smiled and clinked glasses with them, feeling that the simple lunch was especially delicious. After the meal, she did get a matcha mousse cake. Then Yu Xiaowen returned to the doctors' rest room, leaned back against the soft chair, put on a steam eye mask, and rested with her eyes closed for 20 minutes, getting a short but high-quality rest amid the rain tapping the window and the faint hum of the air conditioner.
location: Staff cafeteria and doctors' rest room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon organizing medical records and newly admitted patients
description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen finished organizing the medical records of two patients who were about to be transferred to other departments in the doctor's office. She then received a newly admitted Ms. Wang, who needed rehabilitation treatment for the sequelae of a cerebral hemorrhage. She conducted a detailed admission assessment and patiently explained to her husband the three-stage goals of rehabilitation and the key points of home care. The family's gratitude made her feel that all her efforts were worthwhile.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Book gift for Doctors' Day
description: The afternoon's work came to a pause. Yu Xiaowen wanted to give herself a gift for Doctors' Day. She greeted Teacher Li Wei, then walked across the street with her umbrella to Moxiangxuan Bookstore near the hospital. As a rehabilitation physician, she stopped in the medical section and found the latest edition of the Practical Manual of Rehabilitation Medicine Assessment. Since it was thorough and detailed, she bought it immediately. She then went to the literature section and picked up a selection of Wang Zengqi's essays, Plants and Trees in the Human World, as a reward for herself.
location: Moxiangxuan Bookstore, 7-2 Bank Street, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Continue afternoon work
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the office with the new book in a pleasant mood. After putting it in the drawer, she quickly got down to work. She completed the afternoon ward round records, handled several ad hoc medical orders, and had a detailed handover with the duty doctor. Before leaving, she carefully cleaned the desk and hung up her white coat.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove home after work.
description: Yu Xiaowen changed into casual clothes and drove into the evening rush-hour traffic. The air was especially fresh after the rain. She turned on the car radio to listen to the program "Medicine and Humanities." The discussion of "What defines a good doctor?" on the program made her reflect and once again confirmed her conviction.
location: While driving from Tongbai North Road in Zhongyuan District to Qunying Road in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Buying groceries on the way
description: Yu Xiaowen wanted to go home and make a bowl of hot noodle soup. She parked at the entrance of the familiar grain and oil shop on Qunying Road, went inside, and picked out a bunch of tender green Shanghai bok choy with water droplets, two bright red tomatoes, and a piece of firm tofu. When she checked out, Boss Li greeted her, "Dr. Yu, off work? It's a holiday today, buy something nice!" She smiled and replied, "Thanks, Uncle Li, I'll make myself a good meal tonight."
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Arrive home and prepare dinner
description: Back at home in Qunying Residential Community, Yu Xiaowen changed into comfortable pure cotton loungewear, washed her face, and walked into the kitchen listening to a Mozart piano sonata. She boiled water, cut tomatoes, beat eggs, and chopped scallions—all in one smooth flow. She wanted to make a simple yet heartwarming tomato tofu egg noodle soup and fill the whole room with the aroma of food.
location: Home kitchen, Qunying Community, No. 14 Courtyard, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Dinner and video call with mother
description: A bowl of noodles with red, yellow, and green ingredients was served. Yu Xiaowen sat down and made a video call to her mother Li Xiuying on her phone. Her mother was watching TV in the living room and, seeing the noodles in the bowl, said with a smile, "Oh my, my daughter's cooking is really good—it looks even tastier than Mom's!" Yu Xiaowen smiled and showed off her work, talked about today's cake in the department and the gratitude received from patients. Her mother reminded her that work is important but she must take care of her health. The short call was full of the warmth of home.
location: Dining room at home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 14 Compound, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: In-depth study of the exercise therapy module
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen cleared away the dishes and went into the study. She opened her laptop, logged into the online medical education platform, and prepared her notebook and red and blue pens. She spent the first 40 minutes reviewing and consolidating the difficult part of joint range-of-motion assessment—how to distinguish tension between the joint capsule and the muscles—using the new book she had bought that afternoon. Then she formally started studying the new module 'Muscle Strength Training,' carefully watching the teaching videos and drawing the MMT manual muscle testing grading scale in her notebook, with the difference between grade 3 (against gravity) and grade 4 (against resistance) marked in red. After an hour, she felt a bit tired, got up to drink some water, and stretched in the living room. She then continued studying for another 30 minutes and did several quiz questions. The high accuracy rate gave her a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Study at home, Qunying Community, Courtyard 14, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening cervical spine exercises
description: After the study session, Yu Xiaowen came to the yoga mat in the living room and began the second cervical spine exercise of the day, strictly following the steps: slowly flexing and extending her neck forward and backward, holding each position for 15 seconds to feel the stretch in the back of her neck; slowly turning her head left and right to fully stretch the sternocleidomastoid muscles; and finally completing the classic 'mi' character exercise, with each movement slow and precise. After finishing, she moved her shoulders and felt her neck muscles relax like never before.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bedtime washing and skincare routine
description: Yu Xiaowen went into the bathroom and enjoyed a hot bath to wash away the day's fatigue. Then, standing in front of the mirror, she applied toner, eye cream, whitening essence, and moisturizing lotion in order, carefully completing her bedtime skincare routine. Seeing herself looking good in the mirror, she felt satisfied.
location: Home bathroom, Qunying Residential Quarter, No. 14, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and reading
description: After changing into a silk nightgown and sitting back against the headboard, Yu Xiaowen dimmed the lights, closed her eyes, and did a 10-minute mindful breathing meditation. She imagined all of today's kindness and warmth - the director's 'Guardian' cake, her colleagues' wishes, her family's care, and her patients' trust - turning into a warm golden light that spilled down from above her head and melted into her heart. After the meditation, she felt calm inside. Then she picked up Wang Zengqi's 'The Plants and Trees of the Human World' from the bedside, turned to a piece called 'The Grape Calendar', and savored the plain, serene writing.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Record mood and bedtime
description: After reading an essay, Yu Xiaowen gently closed the book and recorded her feelings in her phone memo: “The seventh Doctors’ Day. I was struck by the word ‘guardian’ — my heart was moved and filled with strength. I have received support from my family, trust from patients, and friendship from colleagues. Wang Zengqi said, ‘Life is great fun.’ I think being a good doctor, healing and saving people, is also great fun and truly worthwhile. Good night.” She set her alarm for 6:40 tomorrow, checked the door lock and windows, and then fell asleep peacefully in calmness and gratitude.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up and exercise
description: Woken by the alarm at 6:50, she saw the gloomy sky outside; the weather forecast predicted light rain. She reminded herself that her mood might fluctuate today, but she had to remain professional. After changing into sportswear, she completed a set of Baduanjin on the south balcony, and her movements were smoother than yesterday. Then she focused on a 10-minute neck exercise routine, because the soreness from yesterday was still there and she had to keep at it. After finishing, she drank a glass of warm water and washed her face, instantly feeling much more alert.
location: South balcony of her home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Commute preparation and breakfast
description: Washed up briefly, put on a clean white coat. Found an umbrella and put it in her bag. Took a carton of milk and a slice of whole wheat bread from the fridge, eating while checking her phone. Seeing the good-morning picture her mother sent in the family group chat and the thumbs-up her father replied, she felt somewhat relieved. Bought a tea egg at the entrance to the residential community, packed it in a plastic bag, and took it away.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Commute by car
description: Drove to the hospital, with soft piano music playing in the car. The cloudy morning traffic was not heavy, and after about 17 minutes, arrived smoothly at the hospital parking lot at 08:12. Before getting out of the car, checked the phone again; there were no unread messages from Zhang Jing, and felt a little relieved. Locked the car and walked into the outpatient building.
location: Drive from Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Morning departmental work (morning meeting and ward rounds)
description: At 08:20 attended the department morning meeting; the handover was routine. After the meeting, followed Teacher Li Wei on grand rounds. While working on the rehabilitation plan for a patient with sequelae of cerebral infarction, Teacher Li asked a few questions about exercise therapy insights. Drawing on the MMT grading knowledge learned yesterday, she answered methodically, and the teacher nodded in approval.
