After rounds, she returned to the office to process medical orders and review imaging data for new patients, trying to immerse herself in professional work.
location: Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning departmental work (documentation and communication)
description: Continue writing the progress notes and discharge summary. Halfway through, Wang Fang came over to share a pack of daily nuts. We chatted a bit about the Doctors' Day cake, but I didn't dare mention the wedding, afraid that I would slip up. I asked her for a detail about the medical insurance reimbursement policy to change the subject. In between, I handled a consultation call from a patient's family member and patiently explained the rehabilitation course arrangement.
location: Doctor's office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday rest and emotional recharge
description: At the cafeteria, she ordered a simple takeout of tomato-and-egg noodles and cucumber salad. To give herself some space to be alone, she decided to go to a café in Xiyuan Plaza. She found a corner in the café, and while eating the noodles, she opened the music app on her phone and played Bach's cello piece. She closed her eyes and listened for a few minutes, trying to calm her mind and store up emotional energy for the storm that might come in the afternoon.
location: A café on B1 of Xiyuan International Plaza, at the intersection of Jianshe Road and Tongbai Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Return to the department
description: After finishing coffee and composing myself, I walked back to the hospital. On the way, I saw plane tree leaves blown to the ground by the wind, and autumn seemed not far away. Back in the office, I saw a new consultation request form on the desk waiting to be processed.
location: Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon work and emotional storm
description: In the afternoon, she continued handling paperwork. Around 14:20, her phone vibrated—it was a WeChat message from Zhang Jing. She excitedly sent over a wedding invitation mini-program. When I opened it, the date clearly read October 2, 2025. My mind went blank and my heart sank—sure enough, it conflicted with Wang Fang's wedding. Staring at the screen with sweaty palms, anxiety instantly drowned me. After catching my breath, I first replied with forced ease: "Got it! Congratulations! Let me check my schedule first~" Then I immediately sent Wang Fang a WeChat message, simply asking: "Fangfang, what time exactly does your wedding start on October 2?" Wang Fang replied: "The ceremony is at 5 p.m., what's up?" Confirming the worst outcome, I found myself in a dilemma.
location: Doctor's office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Emotion management and decision-making
description: She could no longer focus on work. Her mind raced through calculations: the two weddings were in Zhengzhou and Luoyang, and neither time nor money allowed her to attend both. She had promised Wang Fang to be her bridesmaid, yet she could not refuse her childhood friend Zhang Jing, and she was tormented inside. As a resident physician, her savings were indeed tight. After taking a deep breath, she decided to stop overextending herself and asked her mentor Li Wei to leave at 16:00 instead of the usual time. Seeing that she looked unwell, the mentor asked if she was sick. She vaguely said there was something at home, and he readily approved, telling her to rest and get back on track.
location: Doctor's office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Leaving work early and driving to parents' home
description: Packed up, changed into casual clothes, and drove out of the hospital. A light drizzle began to fall, matching my mood. I didn't play music on the way; the car was silent except for the rhythmic sound of the windshield wipers. I called my mother, saying that I got off work early and wanted to come home for dinner. She happily said yes, she had just been thinking of simmering some pork rib soup for my dad. Hearing her voice made me feel a bit more settled. The drive took about 20 minutes, and I went straight into the residential community of my parents' home.
location: Drive from Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Guomao Xinlingdi, No. 39 Wenhua Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Purchase ingredients
description: I parked the car, took an umbrella, and walked to the vegetable market near my parents' home. As planned, I bought live sea bass that my father likes, and picked a few vegetables my mother prefers (broccoli, leaf lettuce) along with scallions, ginger, and garlic. I also bought a portion of the cold beef salad my father often eats from the cooked food stall. At the checkout, I saw a small wonton stall nearby and remembered that my mother used to wrap wontons for me when I was little, so I bought 500 grams of wrappers and meat filling to keep on hand.
location: Fenghe Fresh Food, 26 Nongke Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Comforting dinner: preparing and cooking
description: When she got home, her mother was already busy in the kitchen, and her father was sitting on the living room sofa watching the news. She greeted her father, changed into home clothes, and went to the kitchen to help her mother. She insisted on cooking herself, with her mother guiding from the side. She skillfully scraped the scales, gutted the fish, marinated the sea bass, and steamed it. She also stir-fried two light seasonal vegetables. The kitchen was steaming hot, filled with the aroma of scallions and ginger. Her mother chattered about neighborhood anecdotes, and her father occasionally interjected comments on current events. This long-missed atmosphere of everyday life gradually relaxed her tense nerves.
location: Kitchen at the parents' home, Guomao Xinlingdi, No. 39 Wenhua Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Family dinner and warm time
description: The dishes were served: steamed sea bass, cold beef with sauce, stir-fried lettuce, and tomato egg drop soup—all looking and smelling delicious. The family of three sat around the table. Father had a good appetite and kept praising the fish for being well steamed. He talked about amusing stories from his days as a teacher, making me and my mother laugh. Mother shared funny stories from community choir rehearsals, saying they were practicing a new song. The table was filled with warm conversation, and I felt recharged. After the meal, I took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes, letting my parents rest in the living room.
location: Dining room at parents' home, Guomao Xinlingdi, 39 Wenhua Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Family time and walk.
description: After washing the dishes, the rain stopped. I suggested taking my father for a walk around the neighborhood to aid digestion. He put on his jacket, and we strolled slowly along the flower beds in the community. I had originally wanted to talk to my father about my worries, but seeing his side profile as he gradually recovered from illness and enjoyed the peace, I swallowed my words. We only chatted about work, and I reminded him to take his medicine on time and attend regular check-ups. My father patted my hand and said, "Daughter, you’ve worked hard. Don’t push yourself too hard at work." I nodded firmly and held back the tears welling up in my eyes.
location: Inside Guomao Xinlingdi Community, No. 39 Wenhua Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Facing reality and planning
description: Returning to the room, she closed the door. She needed to deal with this matter. She opened the calculator on her phone and carefully calculated the cash gift for Wang Fang's wedding (based on the closeness of the relationship, she, Sun Yue, and Zhang Jing had agreed on 2,000 yuan in total, but as a bridesmaid she had to give separately) as well as the costs of the bridesmaid dress and makeup, initially estimating she would have to spend at least 1,500 yuan. Then she looked at her bank savings balance and suddenly felt a sense of helplessness. In her phone memo, she listed several alternative options and drafted the wording to confess to Wang Fang about her financial situation and the conflict between the two weddings. She decided to find a suitable time at work tomorrow to talk to Wang Fang alone, sincerely explain the situation and apologize, and try to gain her understanding.
location: My room at my parents' home, Guomao Xinlingdi, No. 39 Wenhua Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Saying goodbye to parents and returning to the apartment
description: Said goodbye to my parents and told them to rest early. My parents walked me to the door, and my mother reminded me to drive carefully. I drove back to my apartment. The light rain on the road had stopped, and the air was fresh. The drive took about 20 minutes, and I arrived at the apartment building at 22:50. When I parked, I saw that most of the lights in the upstairs windows were already off. I got home at 23:00, washed up briefly, and changed into pajamas.
location: Drive from Guomao Xinlingdi, No. 39 Wenhua Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Dingdong Apartment, 8th Floor, Unit 2, Building 1, No. 85 North Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.
description: She stood by the window for a while looking at the scattered lights outside, then laid out a yoga mat and completed the evening neck exercises for the day. Finally, she turned off the light, sat cross-legged on the bed, opened the meditation app, and followed the guided music for a 10-minute mindfulness meditation on the theme of rainy-night relaxation. She tried to put aside the day's anxiety and tomorrow's plans, focusing only on breathing. After meditation, she felt much lighter in body and mind. At 23:30, accompanied by the faint sound of rain outside, she turned off the bedside lamp and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, 8th Floor, Unit 2, Building 1, No. 85 North Jingsan Road, Zhengzhou Dingdong Apartment, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up and driving to Bishagang Park.
description: After the alarm rang, Yu Xiaowen did not get up right away. She stretched in bed and enjoyed the moist morning air after the rain. She walked onto the balcony, stood still, closed her eyes, and did a 5-minute mindful breathing exercise to clear her thoughts. Then she changed into her sports clothes, grabbed her car keys, went downstairs, and drove along Qunying Road-Songshan Road to Bishagang Park.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning run at Bishagang Park and drove back home.
description: In Bishagang Park, she first did 5 minutes of dynamic stretching by the lake to loosen her joints, then jogged 2.5 kilometers on the greenway at a pace of about 7 minutes per kilometer. The air was especially fresh after the rain. After the run, she did 10 minutes of static stretching in the fitness area to cool down. After a short rest, she drove back home along the same route.
location: Bishagang Park, No. 31 Jianshe East Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: After getting home: washing up, breakfast, and cervical spine exercises
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowen took a quick shower to wash off the sweat from the morning workout. For breakfast, she heated up the Poria eight-treasure congee she had brought back from her parents' home last night, and ate it with a boiled egg. After the meal, she did 10 minutes of cervical spine exercises on the living room floor mat, slowly and thoroughly moving her shoulders and neck to relieve the stiffness caused by long periods of desk work.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Driving to work and attending the department morning meeting
description: She changed into her white coat, picked up her handbag and car keys, went downstairs, drove south along Tongbai Road to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, and parked in the staff parking lot. She attended the department's 8 am morning handover meeting on time and listened to the night shift medical staff's report. After the meeting, she quickly reviewed the latest lab results and imaging reports for patients in beds 3, 5, and 9 under her care, preparing for the upcoming ward round.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Accompanied Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds
description: I followed Teacher Li Wei on the daily grand ward rounds. When reaching the newly admitted patient with sequelae of cerebral infarction in Bed 5, Teacher Li asked, "What is the patient's current muscle strength grading and the key points of rehabilitation assessment?" Yu Xiaowen answered fluently and earned the teacher's approval. She carefully recorded the teacher's adjusted rehabilitation treatment plan at each patient's bedside, and exchanged information with Wang Fang about the changes in the conditions of the patients they were responsible for.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Handling medical orders and medical records
description: After the ward round, she returned to her office, opened her computer, and began handling and adjusting follow-up appointment matters, completing today's progress notes and discharge summary. She noticed Wang Fang kept looking down at her phone and seemed a bit down, and she silently planned how to ask her out for a talk.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Communicated candidly with Wang Fang
description: Before the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen plucked up her courage and tugged at Wang Fang's sleeve: 'Fangfang, can we talk in the break room for a bit?' In the break room, she candidly told her everything: she had received Zhang Jing's wedding invitation with a clashing date, and she was worried that bridesmaid expenses would make her, already on a tight budget lately, even more strapped. Wang Fang was stunned, then said with relief, 'I was just worrying about how to tell you I have something to schedule too! Xiaowen, honestly, there's nothing to be embarrassed about. I understand your financial pressure. It's fine—I'll be happy just to come and have a drink at the wedding banquet!' After their frank talk, the weight on Xiaowen's heart finally lifted.
location: Rehabilitation Medicine Department lounge, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Having lunch with colleagues and calculating expenses
description: After opening up, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang went to the hospital staff cafeteria in a relaxed mood, and Liu Qiang joined them too. While waiting in line, Xiaowen opened her mobile expense-tracking app and carefully calculated her expenses from August to now. Gift expenses, nutritional supplements for her parents, and the expected cash gifts for two weddings added up, making her cash flow a bit tight before the end of the month. She silently calculated what adjustments she needed to make.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and study preparation

We used to be happy whether we won or lost, but now I feel like you're just focused on beating me." Xiaowen was taken aback. The sentence from the book suddenly echoed in her mind: "The hardest thing for a doctor is learning to take care of oneself." Watching other people in the gym play happy casual badminton, she suddenly realized that she had projected her need to vent stress and her obsession with perfection onto the sport she loved.

Xiaowen smiled and nodded, but she seriously took those words to heart. On the drive home, the evening breeze was cool, and the pleasant feeling in her body was interwoven with inner reflection. After arriving home, she first took a comfortable hot shower to wash away the fatigue, then used ingredients from the fridge to cook herself a bowl of clear soup buckwheat noodles, adding a poached egg and a few slices of lettuce.

After the meditation, she opened the notes app on her phone and recorded tonight's reflections: "Today's conversation with Wang Fang made me feel much lighter, and also made me realize that bravely and sincerely expressing my difficulties makes friendship stronger. As for exercise and rehabilitation, the real focus is actually yourself—learn to enjoy the process instead of just completing tasks. Good night."

You observed him using neuromuscular facilitation techniques to conduct functional training with the patients and gained a lot. During a break in the rounds, you remembered paying the rent, and subconsciously opened your mobile banking app, only to find your current account balance was low, with just over 8,000 yuan left. You frowned, realizing that last month you had overspent due to purchasing rehabilitation supplies for your father and a home exercise bike. You decided to strictly control discretionary spending starting this month and planned to discuss sharing the cost with your brother on the weekend.

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: On Saturday morning, Yu Xiaowen woke from sleep, turned off her phone alarm, and remembered that today she was going to attend an underglaze painting masterclass. A wave of anticipation welled up in her heart. She sat up and skillfully began her morning neck exercises, pressing and rubbing the Fengchi acupoints and slowly rotating her neck to relax the muscles made stiff by long hours at a desk. After the exercises, she went into the bathroom and, after thoroughly waking up her skin with warm water, completed her basic skincare routine: toner, serum, lotion, and sunscreen. Then she prepared a simple breakfast: a glass of warm milk, two slices of whole-wheat bread, and a boiled egg. Standing in the kitchen, she ate while quickly scrolling through the notes on her phone to confirm today's gear: a bisque vase, a liner brush, a pencil, a sketchbook, a power bank, and the gift for Wang Fang — a cup engraved with 'WF'. Next, she contacted Lin Wei, with whom she often played sports. She first sent a WeChat message apologizing that she could not make it back in the evening to play badminton, then called to explain. Lin Wei teased her for 'ditching her friends for something more appealing' and said she would only forgive her if she treated her to milk tea next time. Yu Xiaowen agreed readily.
location: Room 402, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Nanyang Xincun Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commute and arrival before class

The soothing piano piece tempered her excitement about studying. She drove south along Zhongzhou Avenue, then turned onto Hanghai East Road, arriving at the parking lot near the studio about 45 minutes later. After parking, she walked into the Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, which was filled with the smell of clay and glaze. Teacher Zheng Guodong was adjusting the lights with a student who had arrived early. Seeing her come in, he nodded and smiled: "Xiaowen is here! You look great!" She saw Su Ya already fiddling with tools at her workstation, so she went over to say hello, set down her bag, and looked forward to the class beginning.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, Building 2, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Theoretical course on underglaze painting.
description: At 9:05 a.m., Teacher Chen Zhiming from Jingdezhen started the lecture on time. He explained the historical development of underglaze painting in an accessible way, using projections to show the "five shades" of blue-and-white wash technique and the stroke control in multicolored outlining. Yu Xiaowen listened with full attention, her pen never stopping as she noted key points: "The cobalt material should be ground as fine as flour; mixing it with tea broth can enhance fluidity," and "When applying the wash, hold seven-tenths water in the belly of the brush, touch the tip to the blank, and guide the water to flow." During the Q&A session, she asked the question she had prepared: "Teacher Chen, when painting on a blank, how can we effectively prevent brushstrokes from appearing dry and stiff because the body absorbs water too quickly?" Teacher Chen looked at her approvingly and answered, "That's a very professional question. Before outlining, you can brush a thin layer of diluted alum-gelatin water over the body, which will slow down water absorption and make your brush movement smoother. Alternatively, maintaining humidity in your working environment is also key." She suddenly felt enlightened and quickly wrote it down.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, Building 2, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and socializing
description: After the class, Yu Xiaowen, Zheng Guodong, Su Ya, and two students went to a Sichuan restaurant called “Kuanzhai Alley” near the studio for lunch. She ordered a fish-flavored shredded pork rice bowl and chatted with everyone while eating. During the meal, she took out the ceramic cup engraved with “WF” from her bag and quietly asked Zheng Guodong, “Teacher Zheng, this is a gift I want to give a friend. I always feel the ‘double happiness’ pattern on the bottom is a bit shallow. Is there any way to fix it or deepen it?” Master Zheng took it, looked at it carefully against the light, and said after a moment, “The glaze is already applied, so it’s not suitable to carve again. However, you can dip a fine brush in a little high-concentration glaze of the same color and carefully trace along the existing pattern. It will emphasize the pattern, but your hand must be very steady. I suggest you practice on a waste clay blank first.” She nodded seriously and planned to practice in the afternoon. After the meal, while everyone was chatting, she video-called her mother. The screen immediately showed the roses blooming in the courtyard at home. Her mother excitedly showed her each flower. She smiled and said she could see them, reminded her mother to put on more clothes as the weather turned cold, and chatted for seven or eight minutes before hanging up. Afterwards, she also logged into the submission system of Henan Medical Research during a spare moment, and only felt relieved after seeing that the paper was still “under external review.”
location: Kuanzhai Alley Sichuan Restaurant, Zichen Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Underglaze painting practice and finishing.
description: In the afternoon class, Yu Xiaowen received the long-awaited plain vase blank. She did not rush to paint but first practiced lines on a scrap blank for half an hour to get a feel for the brush. Then she sketched with a pencil and began drawing the draft of the zodiac Rooster on the vase body—a rooster standing tall with its head held high and tail feathers raised, symbolizing enterprise and good fortune. After finalizing the design, she held her breath, dipped a chicken-head brush into the prepared blue-and-white pigment, and carefully drew the outlines. As the rooster's silhouette gradually became clear, she lightly added underglaze red accents to the comb, striving to make it vivid and lifelike. She asked Teacher Chen Zhiming for techniques to render the feather layers. Teacher Chen immediately demonstrated on the scrap blank she had brought, explaining the difference between the "water-division method" and the "feather-tearing method," and encouraged her to try boldly. She practiced attentively and used her phone to photograph the teacher's demonstration and her own initial draft. As the practical session drew to a close, she also asked Teacher Zheng Guodong to look at the results of outlining the edge of the gift. Teacher Zheng praised her steady hand and said the effect was good. She thanked the teachers and Su Ya for their help that day, tidied up her tools and belongings, said goodbye to her friends at the studio, and left.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, Building 2, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

After paying, she walked home carrying the groceries and returned to Qunying Community in less than 5 minutes.

She remembered the rough shape of the rooster with its head held high from today, imagined how it would look after being fired, and also planned tomorrow's carving session for the second day of the masterclass. Near 10:30, she set the alarm for the next day, switched her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, and placed it on the nightstand. In peace and contentment, she fell into a deep sleep.

After adjusting, my technique became steadily more stable, and recording the data went smoothly.

Then, using the Barthel Index, I patiently asked about daily activities such as dressing, eating, and using the toilet, and compiled preliminary scores.

name: Had lunch and a midday break with Wang Fang
description: At 12:00, went to the staff cafeteria with Wang Fang, and each ordered a small-bowl dish and rice. I took the initiative to share my mental journey from nervousness to confidence when independently completing yesterday's assessment, as well as Teacher Li's affirmation. Wang Fang offered sincere congratulations. To make up for last week's oversight, while Wang Fang was getting soup, I ordered two cups of taro boba milk tea in advance at the cafeteria's milk tea window, and they were ready just as she returned. Wang Fang took them with delighted surprise, and our relationship returned to how it was before. After lunch, we walked along the garden path behind the inpatient building. The air held the fresh scent of soil after rain, and a few raindrops felt cool on my face. I recorded the feeling with my phone. Back in the department's break room, I stood by the window and did a serious 5-minute neck and shoulder relaxation exercise to store up energy for the afternoon study.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province: staff canteen (B1 floor), walking path in the back garden of the inpatient building, and department rest room.

name: Afternoon professional study and preparation
description: She arrived at the meeting room early at 13:10, opened her computer, quickly browsed the department-shared courseware on 'Mirror Therapy,' marked the unfamiliar theoretical concepts, and wrote down two questions she planned to ask. One was about her father's hand function training: 'For chronic-stage patients with fine motor disorders of the hand, how should the timing and frequency of mirror therapy intervention be selected?' At 14:00, the professional study session started on time. The senior chief rehabilitation therapist vividly explained the principles of mirror therapy, operating standards, and its application in post-stroke upper limb functional recovery using clinical cases. She listened very attentively, recorded key parameters and contraindications, and compared them with her father's condition. After the class, she raised her hand to ask a question. The instructor praised her and gave a detailed answer, resolving much of her confusion about her father's home rehabilitation.

participant.name: All the medical staff of the Rehabilitation Department

location: Rehabilitation Department Conference Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Study summary and document processing.
description: After the professional study session, she returned to her desk, reorganized her notes, circled with a red pen the points applicable to recent similar cases, and added new training ideas to the special note page for her father. Then she handled the remaining medical record archiving and routine paperwork. At 17:00, she completed the handover on time, packed her personal belongings, and prepared to leave work.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-work drive and errands along the way
description: At 17:00, after getting off work, she drove out of the hospital. Because of rain, the road was slippery, so she drove slowly and followed the navigation to avoid congestion, arriving at the Qunying Road grain and oil shop about 24 minutes later. She picked two jin of fresh free-range eggs, a bunch of Shanghai greens, three tomatoes, a small bunch of cilantro, and a pack of dried noodles. After paying, she walked about 4 minutes back home.
location: From the parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, then walk to Room 501, Unit 4, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 88 Qunying Road, Jinshui District.

name: Cook dinner.
description: After putting the ingredients away, changing out of her coat, and washing her hands, she began bustling in the kitchen and decided to make a bowl of tomato and egg noodles. She boiled water, chopped tomatoes, and beat eggs with practiced skill. While the noodles cooked, she connected her phone to a Bluetooth speaker and played Chopin's nocturnes. Listening to the music and watching the billowing steam from the pot, in less than half an hour the fragrant tomato and egg noodles were on the table, and she enjoyed a warm dinner alone.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 501, Unit 4, Building 3, Qunying Community, 88 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Organized mistake cards for exam preparation.
description: After dinner and a short rest, she took out the mistake cards her mother had rearranged and the handwritten notes. She first took a deep breath to calm down, then re-sorted all the cards one by one according to her familiar system: by body system, by question type, and by error difficulty. For cards with key points handwritten on sticky notes by her mother, she carefully attached the notes to the back of the corresponding cards and added new index labels. After organizing, she looked at the neatly arranged card box and felt a sense of control and accomplishment.
location: At the desk in the study, Room 501, Unit 4, Building 3, Qunying Community, 88 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Brisk walk in the rain and a shower
description: After organizing the mistake cards, she changed into sports shoes, picked up her long-handled umbrella, and went out. Holding the umbrella, she walked quickly along the main road of the residential area for 20 minutes. The sound of raindrops hitting the umbrella and her footsteps splashing through puddles created a strange tranquility. She adjusted her breathing, felt the slight panting and body heat, and stretched her muscles and bones. After exercising, she was slightly sweaty. Back home, she went into the bathroom, adjusted the water temperature, and took a comfortable hot shower, washing away fatigue and stickiness. She changed into comfortable loungewear and felt refreshed.
location: Internal roads of Qunying Community at 88 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and the bathroom of Room 501, Unit 4, Building 3.

name: Evening reading and catching up with family and friends
description: She brewed a pot of rose tea, curled up on the living room sofa, picked up Still Walking, and continued reading from where she had left off last time. The author's portrayal of family daily life and delicate emotions was immersive, and she unconsciously thought of her parents far away in Luoyang, warmth rising in her heart. At 20:45, she sent a WeChat message to her best friend Zhang Jing, sharing two pieces of good news: yesterday's independent assessment and the patient progress she saw during today's ward rounds. Zhang Jing immediately called back, excitedly praised her, and they chatted for over ten minutes. After hanging up, she video-called her parents. On the screen, her father looked well, and her mother asked what she had eaten. She enthusiastically talked about what she had gained from that day's professional learning, especially how mirror therapy might help with her father's hand function. Her father listened very attentively and asked several specific questions.
location: Living room, Room 501, Unit 4, Building 3, Qunying Community, 88 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening washing up and preparations for the next day.
description: After saying goodbye to her parents, she went to the bathroom to wash up and carefully applied a hydrating mask. While the mask was on, she stood in front of the mirror and did a few minutes of evening relaxation exercises, loosening her shoulders, neck, and lower back from sitting for a long time. Then she checked the next day's schedule, put her commuter bag by the door, and hung up the coat she would wear to work in advance.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 501, Unit 4, Building 3, Qunying Community, 88 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bedtime journaling, reading, and falling asleep.
description: After applying the sheet mask, I leaned against the headboard and took out my diary to write down every moment of the day worth recording: Zhao Zhiqiang's arm progress, Wang Fang's smile, inspiration from professional study, the satisfaction after sorting out mistake cards, and the peace of walking fast in the rain. I felt fulfilled and calm. Then I picked up Still Walking, which had only a few dozen pages left, and finished it. At 22:20 I closed the book, turned off the main light, and left only a dim bedside lamp on. I pulled up the quilt, set my phone to silent, and placed it on the nightstand. Closing my eyes, I reviewed the day, feeling expectant about tomorrow but calm, and fell asleep peacefully before the 23:00 alarm went off.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Room 501, Unit 4, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 88 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning activities and breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., the phone alarm rang. It was drizzling outside, so Xiaowen gave up the morning run, spread a yoga mat in the living room, and completed a 15-minute set of Baduanjin and cervical spine exercises. After washing up, she heated a glass of milk in the microwave, paired it with two slices of whole-wheat bread and a boiled egg, and made a small cup of black coffee to stay alert, getting ready for a busy day.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting to work
description: After changing into a neatly ironed white coat and taking an umbrella and commuter bag, she drove to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The roads were slightly congested in the rain, and Debussy's 'Clair de Lune' played in the car, smoothly shifting her into work mode.
location: Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (while driving)

name: Morning check-in and preparation.
description: Arriving at the parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, she swiped her card to enter the inpatient building, changed into her work clothes in the locker room, and straightened her white coat and ID badge. She went to the Rehabilitation Department doctors' office, turned on the computer, quickly skimmed the night shift handover records, and sorted out the day's work priorities.
location: Doctor's Office, Rehabilitation Department, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning meeting and teaching ward rounds
description: She attended the department morning meeting on time and recorded the key points from the night shift handover. Then she followed Dr. Li Zhigang on the Friday routine teaching rounds, focusing on three patients who were about to be discharged. Under Dr. Li's guidance, Xiaowen was responsible for reporting the rehabilitation progress, muscle strength recovery data, and Barthel Index score of one patient in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction. Dr. Li praised her, saying 'You prepared very thoroughly and the data are solid,' which greatly encouraged her.
location: Rehabilitation Department ward and doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handling paperwork and organizing medical records
description: After ward rounds, I returned to the office and finalized the rehabilitation summaries for three patients about to be discharged. I carefully checked the data to ensure that the rehabilitation goals, treatment outcomes, and discharge recommendations were logically rigorous and professionally described. After finishing, I opened an Excel spreadsheet to organize the complete case data of the patients whose beds I managed this week, including age, diagnosis, admission Barthel index, main rehabilitation interventions, and this week's assessment data, to accumulate material for future research papers.
location: Doctor's Office, Rehabilitation Department, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Cafeteria lunch and chatting with colleagues
description: Xiaowen went to the cafeteria for lunch. While in line, she ran into her colleague Wang Fang, and the two sat down to eat together. Xiaowen ordered kung pao chicken rice, Wang Fang had beef noodles. They chatted about the morning's work while eating, in a relaxed and natural atmosphere.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital cafeteria, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday rest and relaxation exercises.
description: After the meal, Xiaowen took an umbrella and walked under the eaves of the back garden of the inpatient department, breathing the fresh air after the rain. Back in the office, she used her break time to do a set of neck and shoulder relaxation exercises by the window to relieve the fatigue of desk work.
location: Back garden of the inpatient department and doctors' office at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Afternoon work, review, and social appointments
description: In the afternoon, she continued organizing the data left unfinished in the morning, and read through the attending physician exam chapters of Rehabilitation Medicine, marking high-frequency test points with a fluorescent highlighter. During this, she received a WeChat message from Wang Fang, who invited her to the newly opened cat café at Xiyuan Plaza over the weekend. Xiaowen replied that she was free on Saturday afternoon, and they agreed to meet at 1:30. The weekend appointment was finally confirmed.
location: Doctor's Office, Rehabilitation Department, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening shift handover
description: Near the end of the shift, I conducted a detailed handover with the incoming duty doctor, especially verbally briefing the situation of an elderly patient with unstable blood pressure and nighttime precautions. After the handover, I shut down the computer and packed up my personal belongings.
location: Doctor's Office, Rehabilitation Department, Inpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Buying groceries after work and going home to rest
description: The rain had stopped. Xiaowen drove away from the hospital and stopped by the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road near the neighborhood on the way. The shopkeeper, an older woman, greeted her warmly. She picked three tomatoes, a bunch of greens, one catty of free-range eggs, and a pack of dried noodles. Then she drove home, parked, went upstairs, put the groceries in the fridge, changed into comfortable loungewear, set an alarm for 23:30 for a nap, lay in bed, and scrolled through the chat history of the doctor exam prep group on her phone.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and evening reading
description: Mother called, reminding her to keep warm and drink more water on the night shift. After a brief chat, Xiaowen cooked a bowl of light noodles with greens and egg using ingredients from the fridge. After eating, she leaned back on the sofa and read two chapters of the essay collection Still Walking, letting the day's busyness settle.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Packing for the night shift
description: She put the Attending Physician Exam Wrong-Question Collection, a thermos, a charger, a few packs of soda crackers, and a light jacket into her commuter bag to prepare for the night shift.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return to the hospital.
description: As night fell, the city lights came on. Xiaowen drove toward Zhengzhou Central Hospital. Traffic on the road was sparse, and soothing piano music played in the car as she mentally prepared for the upcoming night shift.
location: Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (while driving)

name: Night shift start and review attempt
description: Returned to the hospital at 19:50, greeted the colleagues on duty, then went to the wards to check on the key handover patients. At 20:15 returned to the duty room, organized belongings, and familiarized herself with the night shift nursing handover book. Before 22:00, she sat quietly at the duty desk, opened the mistake notebook intending to review in spare moments, but her phone kept receiving patient status inquiries from the wards, so she only managed to read two pages intermittently.
location: Doctor's duty room, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Night rounds and on-call duty
description: At 22:30, conducted the first full-ward night round, checked all patients' conditions, and returned to the on-duty room after confirming everything was normal. After rounds at around 00:30, lay on the duty bed with eyes closed to rest, but kept ears on alert, saving energy for possible emergencies in the latter half of the night.
location: Inpatient ward and duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Late-night review (first interruption)
description: At 1 a.m., she forced herself to sit up in bed, turned on the desk lamp, and opened her collection of mistakes to review the differential diagnosis in the shock chapter. She had just gotten into focus and done five questions when the ward call bell rang—the elderly patient from the night handover had a blood pressure rise to 180/100 mmHg. Xiaowen immediately put down her book and hurried to the ward.

participant.name: An elderly patient with unstable blood pressure.

location: Doctor's duty room and patient wards, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Late-night work and intermittent review
description: After dealing with the hypertension patient and giving orders for the nurse to monitor the blood pressure every hour, she returned to the duty room at 01:50. Just as she reopened her notebook of missed questions, another ward called again; the patient's family reported that the patient was dizzy. She rushed over to handle it, reassured the family, and found after examination that it was caused by improper sleeping posture compressing a blood vessel. This went on until nearly 03:00. Then at 04:00 and 05:30 in the early morning, she was called again to handle routine issues. In the intermittent gaps, she managed to piece together less than twenty minutes of reading, and before 06:00, taking advantage of a quiet moment when the patients were calm, she did ten single-choice questions from the attending physician question bank on her phone.
location: Inpatient wards and doctors' duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning shift handover and wrap-up
description: Completed the morning handover with the day-shift colleagues, explaining in detail the treatment process and vital sign changes of the patient who developed hypertension during the night. Dragging her tired body, she signed the handover log to confirm. The long and challenging night shift was finally over.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Left work and went home.
description: She changed out of her white coat, packed her personal belongings, and washed her face with cold water to refresh herself. She drove away from the hospital and headed home. There was little traffic on the road, and the city was waking up. Xiaowen knew that what awaited her was a day of catching up on sleep, but she felt steady and content. The dual-track train of work and exam preparation had, once again, made a determined run forward.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (driving back home)

name: Slow morning start and household chores
description: After waking naturally, she felt soreness in her right shoulder blade from yesterday's overexertion at work. After a quick wash-up, she weighed herself in loungewear at 47.2 kg, then made instant coffee and, while drinking it, opened the balcony window for ventilation. She decided to sort out seasonal clothes: stored summer T-shirts and thin skirts in suitcases under the bed, then took out autumn lightweight jackets and trousers from the back of the wardrobe and hung them up.
location: Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Reading and studying 'Chinese Rehabilitation Medicine'
description: Taking a break from housework, I curled up on the living room sofa, holding a cup of coffee and opening the latest issue of Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine. I focused on reading an article about rehabilitation models for community stroke patients, and marked the sections on 'home environment modification' and 'remote rehabilitation guidance' with a highlighter. When I read the shoulder joint protection content, I thought it might be useful for my father, so I took a photo of that page with my phone and planned to share it in the evening.
location: Living room sofa, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning exercise and preparing to go out
description: After sitting for a long time, her shoulders and neck were stiff. She did 10 minutes of Baduanjin and cervical spine exercises in the open area of the living room, focusing on stretching the right scapular area. Then she went into the bedroom to gather items for going out in the afternoon: badminton racket, heart-rate wristband, sports water bottle, tissues, a clean towel, and medicated oil, neatly placed on the shoe cabinet by the door.
location: Living room and bedroom, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch and rest
description: Took the millet porridge and side dishes cooked last night from the fridge, heated them up, and enjoyed lunch with a light music playlist. While eating, sent a WeChat message to best friend Zhang Jing: "Finally resting today. This afternoon I'm going to pet cats and play ball, and I'll call you tonight." Received an envious reply from Zhang Jing.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pre-departure preparation and driving to the cat café
description: Checked the phone battery and car keys, applied a hot towel to the right shoulder and gently kneaded it, feeling the muscles relax considerably. At 12:45, she drove out to the cat café in Erqi District. Traffic was smooth on Saturday afternoon, and she arrived at the "Meow Time" themed café and parked after about 25 minutes.
location: "Meow Time" themed coffee shop, southeast corner of the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Biyun Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Time at the cat café with Wang Fang
description: Entering the cat cafe, Wang Fang was already waiting by the window holding an orange tabby cat. You ordered caramel lattes, and the two of you chatted while petting the cats. Wang Fang shared the emotional journey of a recent quarrel and reconciliation with her boyfriend. You also described in detail your reflections after a week in the rehabilitation department, especially the detail that Teacher Li praised your solid data yesterday. Wang Fang encouraged you: "You've always been dependable, so you're sure to do very well in the rehabilitation department." It wasn't until Wang Fang reminded you of the time that you realized it was almost 2:30.
location: "Meow Time" themed coffee shop, southeast corner of the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Biyun Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Move on to the badminton court
description: After saying goodbye to Wang Fang, she drove to the badminton hall of Zhengzhou Central Hospital in Zhongyuan District. On the way, she used her phone's navigation to confirm the venue's location. While waiting at a red light, she sent Lin Wei a voice message: "I just left the cat café. I should arrive at the court around 3. Let's play some casual badminton today!" She also applied a portable hot towel to her right shoulder again.
location: Badminton Hall, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Play badminton with Lin Wei.
description: Arrived at the gym on time; Lin Wei had already changed into sportswear and was warming up. I wore a heart rate bracelet and kept the exercise intensity between 130 and 150 beats per minute. I adopted a strategy of fewer backhand smashes, focusing mainly on steady rallies and multi-shot exchanges, which both achieved the workout effect and protected my right shoulder. During the break, Lin Wei shared stories of taking students to the district sports meet, and you also talked about the challenges after switching departments. At 16:20, we finished the game feeling great and agreed to play again next Wednesday.
location: Badminton Hall, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Return trip and dinner preparation.
description: After wiping off sweat, she drove home and put away the gym bag and jacket. She took a small piece of pumpkin and a handful of millet from the fridge, put them into a thermal cooking jar, added boiling water, sealed it tightly, and left it on the kitchen counter to simmer slowly.
location: Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Shower and shoulder relaxation
description: Took a hot shower in the bathroom, using the steam to rinse the right shoulder joint thoroughly. The soreness was noticeably relieved. After changing into home clothes, she poured medicated oil into her palm and massaged her shoulder until the skin became slightly warm.
location: Bathroom, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Replying to messages and contacting family
description: Curled back on the living room sofa and checked her phone. The Shenghuali Pottery Studio WeChat group sent photos of the bisque-fired pieces from the last class. She found the vase body she had made—rough but beginning to take shape—and replied with anticipation: "Looking forward to seeing the glazed result!" Then she saw a voice message from her mother in the family group. Her mother wanted to video call in the evening, so she replied and agreed to call at eight o'clock.
location: Living room sofa, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and family video call
description: You scooped out the cooked millet and pumpkin porridge, and served it with cucumber salad as dinner. While drinking the porridge, you had a video call with your parents in Luoyang. Your father asked about work, and you reported on the day, mentioning Teacher Li's praise and the badminton session. Your mother reminded you not to push through the shoulder pain. You smiled and replied, "Don't worry, I'm a professional!" You chatted for half an hour before hanging up.
location: Dining room, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Evening reading and organizing professional materials.
description: After the video call ended, she returned to the study, reopened the community rehabilitation article in Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine, and organized a few key points and reflections in her notebook, preparing to discuss them with Dr. Li next time. She then read a chapter from the essay collection Still Walking, sensing the family affection and nostalgia between the lines.
location: Study, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Washing up and diary
description: Performed evening care: washed her face, brushed her teeth, used mouthwash, and applied a moisturizing mask. While wearing the mask, she did 5 minutes of neck relaxation exercises in the bedroom. Then she sat on the bed, took out her diary, and wrote the day's journal entry: "Weekend relaxation day, very productive. My shoulder is much better than this morning. I'll continue with hot compresses tomorrow. The vase came out of the bisque firing, and I'm really looking forward to the color of the finished piece. I video-called Mom and Dad; everything is fine."
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: She changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, reading the stroke rehabilitation case analysis in the *Rehabilitation Medicine* attending physician exam study guide bought from Xiyuan Plaza. After half an hour, feeling drowsy, she closed the book, turned off the main light, and left only a dim bedside lamp on. She closed her eyes and listened to the sounds of traffic and crickets outside the window, gradually drifting off to sleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Room 302, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning exercise and breakfast
description: When the alarm went off, Yu Xiaowen got up and weighed herself first, then laid out a yoga mat in the living room and completed 15 minutes of morning stretching and cervical spine exercises, focusing on her right shoulder, which was still a little sore. After exercising, she washed up, changed into comfortable athleisure wear, and applied some medicated oil to ease the shoulder discomfort. Then she enjoyed a breakfast of oat milk, banana, and blueberries. While eating, she opened the rehabilitation assessment record template on her phone and went over the key indicators she needed to record for her father today. Finally, she put a power bank, a backup phone, a notepad, and a pen into her bag.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Community, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Accompany father for rehabilitation assessment and share the joy
description: Yu Xiaowen drove from home along Nanyang Road, Huanghe Road, and Tongbai Road for about 11 kilometers, taking about 25 minutes, and parked in the staff parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. At 8:40 she met her parents Yu Jianguo and Li Xiuying, who had been waiting on the first floor of the outpatient building, and the three of them went to the rehabilitation assessment room together. The therapist, Dr. Wang, evaluated her father using the Berg Balance Scale and the Fugl-Meyer Scale. Encouraged by Yu Xiaowen, her father walked 15 meters independently while holding the parallel bars, and Yu Xiaowen recorded this breakthrough progress in full on her phone. The assessment results showed that her father's lower limb muscle strength had reached grade 4 and his balance had significantly improved; Dr. Wang spoke highly of him. After the assessment, the three shared their joy in the rest area. Yu Xiaowen sent the video of her father walking independently to the family group and to friends, and congratulations from relatives and friends kept coming. Her mother was so moved that she wiped away tears, and her father smiled while scrolling through family voice messages of praise.
location: Rehabilitation Assessment Room, 3rd Floor, Outpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Go home for a celebration lunch and prepare pottery tools
description: Yu Xiaowen drove her parents back. When passing by Dennis (Fengle Life Plaza store) on Nanyang Road, she parked and let her parents wait in the car while she quickly went into the supermarket and picked out a bag of Fuji apples, a bunch of Shine Muscat grapes, and a Yellow River carp, planning to add a dish to celebrate at lunch. After arriving home, her mother Li Xiuying cooked while Yu Xiaowen assisted, and the kitchen filled with the aroma of braised carp and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. The family sat around the dining table. Yu Xiaowen took out the assessment report and analyzed her father's progress item by item. Her father confidently said he would strive toward the goal of walking without a cane. After the meal, Yu Xiaowen simply cleared the dishes, then returned to her room to inventory the pottery tools she needed to bring to the nursing home that afternoon: clay, a small spray bottle, basic shaping tools, cotton cloth, and disposable tablecloths, and packed them into a portable storage box.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 7, Qunying Community, Nanyang Road Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Went to the nursing home for pottery volunteer service and returned.
description: Yu Xiaowen drove off at 13:10, going south on Nanyang Road, then turning onto Nongye Road and then north on Dongsan Street, arriving at Wutongshu Convalescent Home in less than 20 minutes. With the help of caregiver Xiao Zhao, she set up a worktable in the activity room, explained the steps for making small clay bowls, and personally taught Grandma Wang, whose fingers were not nimble, to knead and pat the clay into shape, while encouraging Grandpa Li to boldly trim the bowl rims. Yu Xiaowen felt that this idea matched her father's rehabilitation process, gladly accepted the order, collected a 20% deposit, and recorded the customer's detailed requirements.

In the center of the plate, she drew a spirited rooster, with tail feathers outlined to resemble a running motion, and gentle auspicious clouds dotted around it. She put away the loose change and small items brought back from yesterday's market, put the laundry into the washing machine, and wiped the bedroom desk and balcony flower stand with a cloth. She felt cozy and relaxed. After taking a break, she took out her diary and carefully recorded yesterday's market experience: the nervousness of setting up a stall for the first time, the joy of selling her works, and the surprise and sense of responsibility that came with receiving a custom order. She wrote: 'Life in Zhengzhou has become more rooted because of these concrete experiences. My father's support also makes me feel very reassured.'

While preparing the ingredients, she talked with her father, who was doing simple upper-body stretches in the living room; he encouraged her to participate actively in the multicenter research project that the hospital launches on Monday.

Yu Xiaowen served rice for her father, and the two ate and chatted, discussing how to pair underglaze colors with the base color when firing custom porcelain. Her father gave simple and elegant suggestions from an artistic perspective, and Yu Xiaowen felt he made a lot of sense.

Yu Xiaowen showed her mother a short video of her father's rehabilitation training from today. Her mother was gratified and urged Xiaowen to take care of herself and her father. The mother and daughter exchanged words of care, and the mood was warm.

location: Rehabilitation Department doctor's office and ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

Around 15:00, she returned to the inpatient department to handle the initial admission notes and medical orders for newly admitted patients. location: Rehabilitation Department Outpatient Clinic and Inpatient Unit, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

First she went to the package pickup point at the community gate to collect the electric massage cushion she had bought for her father yesterday, and asked the staff to wrap it and ship it directly to her hometown in Luoyang. Then she walked east along Jianshe Road to the entrance of the Jinshui River trail, put on her earphones to play Chopin's Nocturnes, and strolled along the river admiring the autumn sunset and the yellowing plane leaves, feeling relaxed in body and mind. She went into Moxiang Bookstore, browsed in the handicraft section, found An Introduction to the Art of Clay Modeling, bought it without hesitation, and chatted with the owner about pottery studios in Zhengzhou. Then she walked home along Jingsan Road. Passing the grain and oil store on Qunying Road, she bought tomatoes, eggs, greens, and autumn moon pears, and chatted with the owner's wife about tomorrow's supermarket membership day event. Carrying the new book and groceries, she returned home.

The instructor announced on the spot that she passed the assessment with a perfect score, and a strong sense of achievement welled up inside her.

The two of us chatted while eating; the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, briefly dispelling work fatigue.

Meanwhile, I also went to give discharge education to a patient who was about to be discharged and answered family members' questions about home rehabilitation.

Afterwards, she tidied the bedroom, wiped the living room furniture, checked the fridge stock, folded the thin blanket her father often used, and watered the potted plants on the balcony, trying to make the home clean and cozy for her mother's return.

I sketched several pattern drafts combining chicken shapes and tender sprouts in my notebook with a pencil, thinking about how to incorporate these inspirations when I glaze at the studio next time.

name: Contacted friends online

Wang Fang quickly replied that she really liked the cup and bowl, and even took photos. Then briefly chatted with Zhang Jing about family matters and thanked her for her concern.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

After lunch, I rested briefly, leaned against the headboard and flipped through the Chinese Journal of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, paying attention to the latest research progress. Around 13:00 I started packing my things to go out: checked the car keys and phone battery, and put the thermos, tissues, and mint candies into my bag.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Traffic was fairly smooth at noon on Sunday, and she arrived at the underground parking lot of the West Square of Zhengzhou East Station at around 13:28.

Her mother took out Luoyang specialties, peony cakes and silver strips, from her bag and said she loved them.
location: Zhengzhou East Railway Station, No. 199 Xinyi Road, Zhengdong New District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

After arriving, she accompanied her mother upstairs and watched her sort and put away the local specialties she had brought back.

location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

She soaked the Luoyang specialty silver strips to make a cold dressed dish, while I was responsible for washing vegetables, cutting vegetables, and beating eggs. Mother did the cooking, making tomato scrambled eggs, Henan-style mixed stew, and garlic broccoli. The kitchen was filled with a warm, cozy atmosphere as we chatted about family things while cooking.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: While mother was simmering soup, I made a video call to father Yu Jianguo. Father was sitting in the living room watching the news. I told him that mother and I were both looking forward to seeing him walk fifty meters tonight. He straightened his back and agreed with confidence.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Father arrived, showing the 50-meter milestone.
description: At about 18:00, my father took a taxi and arrived by himself. Under the encouraging gaze of my mother and me, he walked from the living room to the balcony holding on to the wall. His steps were slow but steady, and he successfully walked the full fifty meters. My mother clapped excitedly, and I recorded this precious whole process on my phone.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: A reunion dinner for the family of three.
description: The whole family sat around the dining table, enjoying the home-style dishes made by mother. The atmosphere was warm. Father shared his rehabilitation experience, and mother kept serving me food. I told them that on October 8 I would give a first aid key points presentation in the department, and they encouraged me to prepare well. I sent a video of father walking to the family group, and my elder brother Yu Xiaofeng sent a clapping emoji.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Rest after dinner and casual family chat
description: After the meal, my father rested on the sofa while my mother and I cleared the dishes. Then we watched TV together, and my mother peeled apples for everyone. Father talked about a health program, mother talked about interesting things in Luoyang, and I enjoyed the long-missed warmth of family.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Accompanied my mother downstairs, and walked slowly along Qunying Road to the Jinshui River trail. In the evening a gentle breeze was blowing, the lights along the riverbank were bright, and we chatted while enjoying the tranquility of the city. On the way we passed a flower shop, and my mother praised the daisies on the windowsill. I plan to buy a bunch for home tomorrow.
location: Jinshui River walking path, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (section from Jingsan Road to Huayuan Road)

description: After walking, I called a Didi Chuxing car for my father to take him back to his place. My mother decided to stay overnight, so I prepared the guest room and changed the sheets and duvet covers. After my mother washed up and went to rest, I did my evening skincare routine, using the new hydrating mask I bought, while also organizing my briefcase for work the next day and confirming my access card and employee badge.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Write in diary and go to sleep
description: At the desk, she turned on the desk lamp and recorded this special day in her diary: "September 28, sunny. Mom is back, Dad successfully walked 50 meters, and it's been a long time since home has been this lively. The stress seems to have lightened a lot all at once. I have to go to work tomorrow—a new week again, let's go!" Then she set her phone alarm, turned off the light, and went to bed, falling asleep peacefully.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: After being woken by the alarm clock in the morning, Yu Xiaowen practiced Baduanjin and neck and shoulder stretches in the living room, then washed up and did basic skincare. Her mother, Li Xiuying, had prepared spicy soup and fried dough sticks. The mother and daughter ate breakfast together, chatting about everyday things in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home, 5th floor, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She then continued walking for about 15 minutes to the Rehabilitation Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, changed into her white coat, temporarily placed the daisies in a corner of the nurse station, and prepared the handover log while waiting for the morning meeting.
location: From Huajianji Flower Shop, Building 4, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to the Rehabilitation Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Yu Xiaowen made a key note about a stroke patient in the rehabilitation period who experienced transient dizziness. Then Teacher Li Wei led the team on a major ward round. At the patient's bedside, Yu Xiaowen reported the condition and performed a physical examination, and the teacher guided adjustments to the physical therapy plan. During the ward round, she also recorded new requirements for joint range-of-motion training for a patient with spinal cord injury.
location: Rehabilitation Department Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

Then she received the multicenter research data package sent by the community health center, checked the format and completeness of 15 patients' information line by line, and marked missing items. Afterwards, she reported the data reception to Teacher Li Wei and consulted him about abnormal scale scoring issues. The teacher suggested rechecking according to the operating standards and discussing by email.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: From the cafeteria of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Qunying Community, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

Holding the wall for support, he walked about 60 meters with fairly steady steps. Yu Xiaowen recorded a video with her phone and sent it to the family group to share with her brother. location: Home, 5th floor, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: Living room of the home on the 5th floor, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

At the same time, she kept an eye on the department group chat and replied to the arrangement about ward rounds the next afternoon.

Zhang Jing mysteriously asked her to keep tomorrow evening free. Yu Xiaowen knew a birthday surprise was brewing, so she pretended to be curious and played along.
location: Living room of the home on the 5th floor, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Removing the face mask, Yu Xiaowen opened her diary app to record today's life: her father's progress in walking, the smooth verification of multicenter research data, and the warmth of her mother cooking by her side. location: Bedroom at home, 5th floor, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

Then she went back to her room and picked out a knit cardigan and a dress as her outfit for the next day's dinner gathering. Before going to bed, she hugged her mother and they said goodnight to each other. She wished her mother a smooth trip, and her mother also told her to go to bed early.
location: Home, 5th floor, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

When she felt sleepy, she closed the book, turned off the light and kept only the nightlight, set the alarm for 6:35 the next morning, put on her eye mask, and gradually fell asleep listening to the wind outside the window.
location: Bedroom at home, 5th floor, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-shift preparation and handover review.
description: Arrived at the office ahead of time, quickly glanced through today's work memos and the medical records of key patients. Colleague Wang Fang had also arrived, and the two nodded to each other and quietly discussed the questionable data points from yesterday's preliminary review of the research data.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

description: I attended the department morning meeting on time. After the night-shift doctor completed the handover, I carefully recorded the new patients' conditions and key medical orders. After the meeting, I briefly discussed with my supervising teacher Li Wei the overnight analgesia plan for a stroke patient, and the teacher approved my idea.
location: Rehabilitation Department Meeting Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

At the bedside of a patient with post-stroke hemiplegia, she actively assisted in assessing sitting balance response and the degree of shoulder subluxation, and listened carefully as Dr. Li explained the essentials of home rehabilitation to the family. The rounds ended at 10:00 and she returned to the office.
location: Ward of the Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handling medical orders and verifying data
description: Adjusted medical orders in the system based on the ward round. Then I took out yesterday's questionable data and checked it item by item against the hard copy. Finally, I found a data entry error and marked it, ready to report to Teacher Li Wei in the afternoon. During this period, I had necessary exchanges with my colleague Liu Qiang.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Outpatient consultations and medical record organization
description: At 10:45, I received notice and went to the outpatient clinic early to see 2 follow-up patients. One was recovering well after lumbar surgery, and I guided him in strengthening core training; the other was a cervical spondylosis patient receiving conservative treatment, and I prescribed a new physical therapy plan. After returning at 11:30, I organized the admission records of a newly admitted patient after knee replacement surgery and briefly chatted with Dr. Chen Mingyuan from the dentistry department in the corridor.
location: Rehabilitation Department consultation room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and pottery knowledge boost.
description: Had a simple meal with Wang Fang at the staff canteen, then walked about 5 minutes by herself to the coffee shop at Xiyuan Plaza. She ordered a hot latte, took out the book "Introduction to Clay Sculpting" she had brought along, and carefully read about the color development characteristics of "bean-green glaze" and "sky-blue glaze" at different kiln temperatures, preparing for the afternoon glazing.
location: Coffee shop at Xiyuan Plaza near Tongbai Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Midday nap
description: Returning to the office, she took a 20-minute nap on the duty bed and quickly recovered her energy.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon outpatient clinic and treatment plan communication.
description: In the afternoon, she handled two first-visit patients and one follow-up patient. At 14:00, she returned to the office. Taking advantage of Teacher Li Wei's free time, she reported her questions about research data verification and asked for details of a patient's rehabilitation plan. The teacher patiently answered.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Work wrap-up and leave request
description: Complete all of today's medical record writing and uploading, organize tomorrow's memo, then ask her instructor Li Wei for leave, explaining that there is a family dinner in the evening and she needs to leave an hour early. The instructor readily agreed.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

After discussing with Master Zheng and combining what I learned at noon, I decided to use bean-green glaze as the base, then outline the comb and feathers with sky-blue glaze in fine strokes. I focused on finishing the glazing, handed the piece to the studio for firing, and agreed to check the finished work in a week.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, Building 2, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province
