Around 17:00, she received a WeChat reminder from Zhang Jing: "Seven o'clock at XX Hunan Restaurant, don't be late~" She replied "Okay~", feeling full of anticipation.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She sent Zhang Jing a message saying "I'm here" but did not go straight to the private room. Instead, she found the front desk staff and asked them to deliver the bouquet to the "Xiaoxiang Pavilion" private room later.
location: Yixiang Hunan Cuisine, near the intersection of Guoji Road and Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Waiting outside the private room

location: Corridor outside the private room of Yixiang Hunan Cuisine, near the intersection of Guoji Road and Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Surprise birthday dinner
description: The moment she pushed open the door, streamers and balloons came into view, and family and friends shouted 'Happy birthday!' in unison. Seeing her mother, who had come all the way from Luoyang, Yu Xiaowen burst into tears. During the meal, everyone shared updates on their lives; Zhang Jing told the story of how she planned it, and Wang Fang's blessing video played at just the right moment. The atmosphere was warm. At 21:00, the server brought over that bouquet of flowers, moving everyone again, and they took a group photo. At about 21:15, they reluctantly ended the gathering.
location: Private room at Yixiang Hunan Cuisine Xiaoxiang Pavilion, near the intersection of Guoji Road and Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Mother-daughter stroll and return home
description: Walking home side by side with her mother, the night breeze gently blowing. Her mother asked about her work and health, while she shared the joy of today's pottery glazing. The mother and daughter slowly enjoyed the rare quiet time. They got home at about 21:45, and she prepared toiletries for her mother in the guest room.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bedtime wrap-up and gratitude journal
description: After washing up, I changed into comfortable pajamas, sat at my desk, opened my diary, and recorded what moved me today: the freshness of the morning run, the focus of pottery making, and the warmth of family and friends. At 22:30 I said goodnight to my mother, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up and family greetings
description: After waking naturally in the morning, I put on loungewear and saw my father in the living room walking to the bathroom while steadying himself against the wall, which made me feel at ease. Then I softly greeted my mother, who was busy in the kitchen, and savored the aroma of breakfast and the quiet.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning stretching and Baduanjin
description: She spread the yoga mat in the living room and first did 5 minutes of neck stretches to address the straightening of the cervical spine's natural curve caused by work. Then she completed a full set of Baduanjin, moving slowly and focusing on breath control. Afterward, she used a foam roller to relax her calves and lower back to maintain good energy and posture.
location: Living room of the home in Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Simple family breakfast
description: Mother prepared millet porridge, boiled eggs, steamed pumpkin, and sweet potatoes. The family of three sat together; father mentioned he wanted to eat something with a sweet and sour flavor, and mother noted it down. I used my phone to take photos of my parents as a memento, capturing the warm National Day morning.
location: Dining room at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Create an outline for a first aid knowledge sharing PPT.
description: In the study, using a laptop, I created a new PPT document. Based on the sharing topic I applied for with Teacher Li Wei, I set the framework as "Preliminary Recognition of Common Emergency Conditions and Family Cooperation" and kept it to around 15 pages. I retrieved typical rescue cases from the department, such as a case where a family member reported chest tightness but it was actually a painless myocardial infarction, and filled the warning signs and key points of family cooperation into the outline. I also used my father's rehabilitation process as material for the "Family Education Tips" section, and completed the whole conception at around 10:15.
location: Study at home in Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Discuss lunch and order food by phone
description: Discussed National Day celebration plans with my mother, and we decided to dine at Kang Family Kitchen near the entrance of the residential community so my father could get some exercise. Mother booked private room No. 2 by the window over the phone and ordered my father's favorites: sweet and sour pork tenderloin, braised noodles, and vegetable tofu with black fungus soup. I added a roast duck.
location: Living room of the home in Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Confirm the visit arrangements with an old neighbor from Luoyang.
description: Contacted Aunt Li, an old neighbor from Luoyang, via WeChat voice call, confirmed that she would arrive at Zhengzhou East Railway Station at around 2 p.m. the next day, and agreed that we would pick her up. Afterwards, she discussed reception arrangements with her mother and suggested taking her father to the Qunying Road grain and oil shop tomorrow morning to buy snacks and fruit for entertaining the guest.
location: Living room of the home in Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Walk to the restaurant
description: Helped my father put on a thin jacket, and the three of us slowly walked out of the building. Father insisted on walking by himself; I held his arm on the right and told interesting stories from the department as we walked, while mother smiled gently. The walk of about 400 meters took 15 minutes, bearing witness to father's recovery.
location: Internal road of Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (from home to the community gate).

name: National Day reunion lunch
description: Had a meal in Private Room 2 at Kangjia Kitchen, and the dishes were served one after another. After tasting the sweet and sour pork, my father's eyes turned slightly red. I raised my teacup and toasted my father with tea instead of wine, saying that his recovery was the best gift for the family. Father said it was the most delicious thing he had eaten this year. Mother quietly wiped away tears, and I wrapped roast duck in pancakes for my parents.
location: Private Room 2, Kang Family Kitchen, at the entrance of Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pay the bill, go home, and settle father down for rest
description: After the meal, they paid the bill, and the three of them walked home again. Father was a bit tired but in excellent spirits. When they got home, she and her mother settled him on the living room sofa, adjusted the cushions, and turned on the TV. Her mother handed him warm water, and Father soon began to snore.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Mother and daughter collaborated on housework and shared updates in real time.
description: While Father was resting, Mother and I quietly cleared the dining table. Mother washed the dishes; I wiped the table and packed up the leftovers. Mother happily mentioned what Father said during lunch, and I also sent the photos to the family group and tagged my brother to share how handsome Father looked.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Qunying Xiaoqu, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Father rests and fine-tunes PPT details.
description: Father was sound asleep. I returned to the study, went through the PPT outline completed in the morning from the beginning, added a page titled "Family Members' Potential Symptom Observation Checklist", and included the positive feedback on Father's recovery as a positive case in the module "The Importance of Family Encouragement". In the meantime, I went back to the living room twice to cover Father with a blanket and confirmed that his breathing was steady.
location: Study and living room at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Plan a City Walk route
description: Father was resting, and Mother was tending the plants on the balcony. In the study, I browsed the old-street walking routes in Zhengzhou that I had saved in my phone memos, checking out the Zhengzhou Memory Oil and Chemical Plant Creative Park, the old city wall ruins in Guancheng Hui District, the graffiti wall and second-hand bookstores on Xili Road, and so on. I noted down the shops I was interested in on a sticky note pad, preparing for the upcoming City Walk on my day off next week.
location: Study at home in Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Wake father and enjoy tea on the balcony.
description: After father woke up, she brewed a pot of his favorite Xinyang Maojian tea and sat with her mother on the rattan chairs on the living room balcony. The three of them drank tea and chatted in the afternoon sun. Father talked about his younger days making blackboard posters at the factory during National Day. My mother and I listened with great interest, laughing softly.
location: Balcony and living room at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Evening walk around the community and running into a neighbor
description: The weather was fine and sunny. I accompanied my father on a walk around the community again. He was in better spirits and walked a little faster. At the central garden, we met Uncle Liu from Unit 2. He praised my father's recovery, and our eyes were filled with pride. We walked two laps around the garden for about 20 minutes. Father said he really enjoyed the walk today.
location: Central garden and walking paths of Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Preparing and enjoying the family dinner
description: After the walk, my father was watching TV in the living room. I went to the kitchen to help my mother, washing vegetables and peeling garlic, while she made dressed beef and tomato-egg dough drop soup. The dinner was simple and warm; my mother's specialty dish was accompanied by leftover roast duck from noon, and my father had two bowls of soup with a good appetite. The TV was replaying the National Day gala, and I hummed along out of tune, amusing my parents.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Qunying Xiaoqu, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Family video call and online interaction
description: After the meal, I cleared the table and used the dishwasher to clean the dishes and utensils. I started a video call in the family WeChat group. My brother Yu Xiaofeng had just gotten off work in Shenzhen and was very happy to see our father in high spirits. The four of us chatted across the screen for 40 minutes. My brother talked about his business trip plans and said he would come back to Zhengzhou for a visit. I also shared today's photos.
location: Living room of the home in Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Shared her day with her best friends and interacted with them.
description: After hanging up the video call, she curled up in the corner of the sofa and sent a WeChat message to her best friend Zhang Jing, wishing her a happy National Day, sharing the joy of spending the day with her parents, and asking what the "birthday rehearsal" Zhang Jing had mentioned yesterday was, looking forward to her reply.
location: A corner of the sofa in the living room at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Personal hygiene and cervical spine care.
description: After saying goodnight to her parents, she washed her face with warm water in the bathroom and applied nighttime skincare. Feeling that her cervical spine was fine, she did a simple version of the 'mi' exercise before bed, applied a warming massage balm to her neck to relax, and then changed into comfortable pajamas.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Read before bed and turn off the light to sleep
description: Leaning back against the headboard, she read the chapter “Rehabilitation of Cerebrovascular Diseases” in Rehabilitation Medicine (6th edition) for about 15 minutes and noted the key points under “Community Rehabilitation and Family Support.” Then she turned off the light, recalled the good things of the day in the dark, and fell asleep peacefully with a sense of fulfillment.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up, jogging along the Jinshui River, and breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 6:30 in the morning, drank warm water after getting up, and did a 10-minute full-body stretch on the yoga mat in the bedroom, focusing on the neck, shoulders, and lower back. Changed clothes and left at 6:50, jogged 3 km along the Jinshui River trail (round trip from Nongye Road to North Third Ring Road section) at a pace of 7:30 per kilometer and a heart rate of 130-145 bpm. After the run, did 5 minutes of mindful breathing on a riverside bench. Returned home, took a hot shower, changed into home clothes, and prepared milk, whole wheat bread, boiled egg, and an apple for breakfast. While eating, watched the news and felt the festive atmosphere of National Day.
location: Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and the Jinshui River Walkway

name: Morning work in the study and sharing with family
description: In the study, she opened her work email and unexpectedly received the official acceptance letter from the editorial office of Henan Medical Research. The paper "Analysis of the Influence of Family Factors on Rehabilitation Compliance in Stroke Patients" will be published in the December issue. She was very excited. She immediately told the good news to Teacher Wang Fang, who helped with statistics, and her collaborator Zhou Haoran, via WeChat, and shared it in the family group "Yu Family Courtyard." Her mother replied with a proud emoji. After that, she continued to polish the first aid knowledge sharing PPT, adding diagrams and case examples from her father's rehabilitation experience, and made a quick-reference table for emergency medication dosages. At 11:30, she had a video call with her parents, sharing the details of the paper acceptance. Her mother reminded her to pick up Aunt Li in the afternoon. After hanging up, she simply heated up some mutton noodles and stir-fried seasonal vegetables for lunch.
location: Study and living room at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and a short lunch break.
description: Heated up the mutton stewed noodles, paired with stir-fried seasonal vegetables for lunch, and listened to the podcast "Stories of Old Streets in Zhengzhou" while eating, building up cultural background for city walks. After the meal, she leaned on the sofa scrolling through Xiaohongshu, browsing new works from a pottery studio, enjoying a quiet midday moment.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Went out to pick up Aunt Li, visited an independent bookstore, and shopped at the market.
description: At 12:50 she left home, rode a shared bike to the Provincial People's Hospital metro station, took Line 5 to Zhengzhou East Railway Station, and met Aunt Li, an old neighbor from Luoyang, on time at 14:00. Aunt Li had brought local specialties from her hometown. Yu Xiaowen helped carry her luggage, and they took a taxi together to her daughter's residence near the intersection of Huayuan Road and Nongke Road in Jinshui District. After seeing Aunt Li off, she walked alone to the 'You Ge Ji Hua' independent bookstore on Nongke Road and leafed through photographic albums of old Zhengzhou, feeling the city's history. After leaving the bookstore, she rode a shared bike back to Qunying Road. First she went to the Qunying Road grain and oil store to buy flour and sesame paste, then she selected red sweet potatoes, Shanghai greens, and oranges at a roadside vegetable stall.
location: Depart from Qunying Residential Complex, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, pass through Zhengzhou East Station, to the vicinity of the intersection of Huayuan Road and Nongke Road in Jinshui District and the surrounding area of 14-10 Qunying Road.

name: Return home to rest and professional work
description: After returning home, I organized the purchased items, charged my phone, and drank some water to rest. Checking WeChat, I found that my elder brother Yu Xiaofeng had sent an 888 yuan congratulatory red packet in the family group; I happily accepted it and thanked him. Then I went to the study and continued optimizing the first-aid knowledge PPT, adjusting the layout and adding example images of rehabilitation training. Finally, I opened Rehabilitation Medicine to study the post-stroke depression chapter, annotated the clinical assessment scales, and prepared for next year's attending physician exam.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Video call with parents
description: Video-called Mom and Dad, sharing the details of picking up and seeing off Aunt Li in the afternoon and the local specialties received. Dad was in good condition and also asked how to use the upper-limb rehabilitation trainer purchased online. I patiently demonstrated and explained over video. The call made me feel grounded and warm.
location: Living room of the home in Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Homemade dinner
description: Using the leftover braised noodle soup from lunch, she added fresh greens and tomatoes and cooked a nutritious, balanced green vegetable and tomato braised noodles. Simple and delicious.
location: Kitchen at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening leisure and organizing
description: After dinner, I played Dvořák's 'From the New World' on the speaker, packed my backpack for work tomorrow, and changed into a clean uniform. Then I chatted with my close friend Zhang Jing on WeChat, sharing the joy of my paper being accepted and a short video of picking up Aunt Li, and mysteriously discussed confidential matters, enjoying a relaxed evening of socializing.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Ceramic Art Inspiration Collection and Relaxation
description: In the study, use Bilibili to search for teaching videos on marbled porcelain and underglaze painting to gather inspiration for next week's pottery class. Then do a 15-minute bedtime stretch and cervical spine 'mi' character exercises on the yoga mat in the living room to relieve the day's fatigue.
location: Study and living room at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Turning off the light and lying in bed, she opened the Tide app and chose the "National Day Mountains and Rivers" theme for a 10-minute breathing meditation to let her mind and body settle. Afterward, she read about 20 minutes of Haruki Murakami's "What I Talk About When I Talk About Running" on Kindle, feeling the power of persistence and self-discipline, then turned off the light at 21:30 and fell asleep, ending a full and balanced day.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Quarter, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning preparation and simple breakfast.
description: Morning light filtered through the curtains, and Yu Xiaowen was woken by her alarm clock. After washing up briefly, she did ten minutes of stretching on the living room floor to wake up her body. She made herself a bowl of oatmeal, paired with the pre-sliced bread she had bought last night and a banana, enjoying a moment of peace.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

description: Yu Xiaowen opened her laptop and focused on polishing the first-aid sharing PPT. First, using the drawing tools, she turned the timeline of the rescue case she had conceived yesterday into a chart, and marked the time points of each key decision and rescue measure. Next, she drew a flowchart of cardiopulmonary resuscitation. Finally, she spent nearly an hour organizing and writing the "Family Observation Checklist" section, weaving in her recent observations of her father's rehabilitation in a genuine and empathetic tone. She successfully completed the main part before 9:15, saved it, and synced it to her phone.
location: Study, Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Packing and confirming the itinerary.
description: Yu Xiaowen put the pre-prepared thin jacket, power bank, toiletries bag, and other items into her backpack. She checked her ID card and high-speed rail ticket, and took screenshots saved to her phone album to ensure all travel plans were correct. She also took out the apple and tangerines she had cut up in the morning from the fridge, planning to eat them as snacks on the way.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Qunying Residential Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Bike ride to shop for almond tea and black sesame.
description: Yu Xiaowen put on her helmet, got on a shared bike, and set off. First, she bought 500 grams of fresh black sesame seeds for her parents at the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road. Then, following the recommendation of her best friend Zhang Jing, she deliberately detoured by bike to the old Zhenji Eight-Treasure Almond Tea shop in Erqi District. She queued for 8 minutes and bought two servings of the signature almond tea: one wrapped in an insulated bag to take to Zhang Jing, and the other to drink along the way.
location: Zhenji Eight-Treasure Almond Tea (Yong'an Street Old Shop), Building 15, Yong'an Street, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Take the subway to Zhengzhou East Station
description: Yu Xiaowen rode from near Zhenji Eight-Treasure Almond Tea to the nearest subway entrance, transferred to Metro Line 5, and went directly to Zhengzhou East Station. After exiting the station, she bought a bottle of mineral water at a convenience store inside.
location: Zhengzhou East Railway Station, No. 199 Xinyi Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Waiting for the bus and online communication
description: With 20 minutes before departure, Yu Xiaowen found a window seat in the waiting hall, sent a message to her parents about the itinerary, and attached a photo of the train ticket. Then she briefly browsed the class reunion WeChat group to check everyone's updates.
location: Waiting hall of Zhengzhou East Railway Station, No. 199 Xinyi Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Took the high-speed rail back to Luoyang and did neck exercises.
description: Yu Xiaowen boarded the clean and tidy G852 high-speed train and found a window seat. After the train departed, she slowly sipped the almond tea she had just bought through a straw. Then, using the seat back for support, she carefully did a 15-minute neck exercise routine: gently nodding forward and backward, bending left and right, rotating the neck, etc., each movement slow and controlled. Along the way, she enjoyed the scenery of the plains during the autumn harvest season through the window and felt relaxed.
location: Train G852 on the Zhengzhou-Xi'an High-Speed Railway

name: Arrived at Longmen Station and took a taxi back to the old house.
description: Yu Xiaowen arrived at Luoyang Longmen Station on time. After leaving the station, she followed the signs to the taxi pickup area and took a taxi back to the old house on Kaixuan Road, Xigong District. On the way, she chatted with the enthusiastic taxi driver about Luoyang's National Day attractions, and sent a WeChat message to her best friend Zhang Jing to say she would arrive in the afternoon, receiving a grateful and expectant emoji from her.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Old house tidying and lunch on Xigong Small Street
description: Yu Xiaowen unlocked the gate of the old house, put down her luggage, opened all the windows for ventilation, and quickly wiped the living room table and the bedroom bed. Then she changed into comfortable flat shoes, went out, and strolled along Xigong Street near the old house. She walked into an old Luoyang beef soup shop she remembered, ordered a portion of sliced boiled beef, a youxuan pastry, and a small bowl of soup. Sitting by the street, she watched the coming and going of pedestrians and felt the familiar, down-to-earth atmosphere of her hometown.
location: Old Luoyang Beef Soup Restaurant, Xigong Small Street, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Resting at the old house and going through old belongings
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the old house and, taking advantage of the quiet afternoon, strolled to her parents' study. She pulled her father's teaching reference books and literature and history works from the bookshelf, leafed through the picture album "Five Thousand Years of Luoyang", and saw images of Longmen Grottoes and White Horse Temple, evoking childhood memories. Then she found her high school diary and read a few pages of the immature writing from ten years ago, smiling knowingly.
location: Home study, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Walk to the former site of her alma mater
description: Yu Xiaowen changed into lightweight sneakers, left the old house, and walked slowly east along Kaixuan West Road toward the old site of her alma mater, Luoyang No. 1 High School. This road was the one she took every day in high school; the plane trees by the roadside, the old bookstore on the corner, and the rice noodle shop she often ate at as a student were all still there. Forty minutes later, she stood at the gate of her alma mater.
location: Former site of Luoyang No. 1 High School, Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Strolling at the alma mater's gate and feeling nostalgic.
description: Yu Xiaowen paused for a moment outside the school's main gate, took a photo of a plane tree and sent it to her best friend Zhang Jing, with a caption recalling the old days of waiting for the school bus. Zhang Jing immediately replied with an emotional emoji. Then she walked into an old-town bookstore at the school gate, browsed the latest supplementary teaching materials, and chatted with the owner.
location: School gate and surrounding area of the former site of Luoyang No.1 High School, Middle Zhongzhou Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: In-depth exploration of the old city
description: Yu Xiaowen took a taxi from Xigong District to Laocheng District, got off near Lijing Gate, and began an in-depth city walk. She deliberately avoided the main roads, turned into alleyways on one side of East Street, and explored workshops selling traditional handicrafts. At an alley entrance, she found a Sancai Art Experience Center, went in to see exquisite Tang sancai works, listened to the shopkeeper explain the crafting techniques, and lingered for a while.
location: Lijing Gate to East Street and West Street, Laocheng District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Visiting Cross Street and confirming the gathering location.
description: Yu Xiaowen continued east to Cross Street. Although it was not yet evening, many night market stalls were already preparing. She bought a candied hawthorn stick from Old Ma's to taste. Then she found the reunion venue, Mapo BBQ Old City Hand-Pulled Noodle Restaurant, on Xinghua Street, confirmed the specific seats and private room location in advance, and took photos to send to the group.
location: Mapo BBQ Old Town Huimian Noodle House, Xinghua Street, Old Town District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: High school reunion
description: The gathering started right on time. More than a dozen old classmates who had not seen each other for years sat around together, and the atmosphere was lively. Everyone talked about their recent situation. Yu Xiaowen shared her experiences at work in the hospital and the good news about her father's recovery. During the meal, in her capacity as a doctor, she gave a few classmates simple advice about problems like insomnia and cervical spine issues. They took turns raising toasts, recalling funny high school stories, and laughter never stopped. She pulled out a video of her father walking independently and shared it with the friends at the table.
location: Mapo BBQ Old Town Huimian Noodle House, Xinghua Street, Old Town District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Take a taxi back to the old house
description: After reluctantly saying goodbye to her classmates, Yu Xiaowen took a taxi back to the old house on Kaixuan Road. On the way, she had a video call with the family group chat, briefly showed the lively scene of the gathering, said she was very happy, and told her parents to rest early.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Video-called parents to share daily life
description: Back at the old house, she changed into pajamas, lay down comfortably on the bed, and made a video call to her parents in Zhengzhou. Yu Xiaowen recounted the interesting stories from the gathering in detail and shared the black sesame and candied hawthorn skewers she had brought back. Her mother earnestly told her to cover herself with a quilt at night and not catch cold. Finally, she asked with concern about her father's rehabilitation over the past two days, and was very relieved to learn that he was doing well.
location: Home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and cervical spine relaxation
description: After hanging up the video call, Yu Xiaowen went to the bathroom to wash up, using warm water to wash away the day's fatigue. Back in the bedroom, she did a full-body pre-sleep stretch on the floor and carefully did a set of cervical spine exercises to relax her neck and shoulder muscles.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Bedtime reading
description: Yu Xiaowen leaned against the headboard, picked up an old issue of Story Club magazine and casually flipped through a few pages, enjoying the relaxation brought by the text. At 23:00 she turned off the lights on time, and with the sound of a few dog barks outside the window and the faint, distant whistle of a train, she fell into a deep sleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: The phone alarm rang at 07:28. After turning it off, I stayed in bed for two more minutes, feeling the warm sunlight through the old house's curtains on my face. Remembering that I had slept well the night before, I stretched and got up, then did five minutes of simple stretching and eight-direction cervical spine exercises on the floor to loosen up.
location: Bedroom, old residence, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Washing up and morning preparation
description: After washing up, I changed into comfortable loungewear. Opening the window, I took a deep breath of the cool early October air in Luoyang. It's a bright sunny day, and my mood feels refreshed too.
location: Bathroom of the old residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Mom had already prepared breakfast: millet porridge, homemade pickled radish, boiled eggs, and steamed buns. The family sat around the dining table. Dad had a good appetite today and drank a bowl of porridge. Yu Xiaowen reminded her dad to take his medicine on time. Mom jokingly said she was more nagging than a nurse. They chatted about the day's plans while eating, and Mom was looking forward to the morning pottery class.
location: Old residence at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, dining room

name: Setting up the pottery workspace
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen and her mother cleared off the small table on the balcony, spread old newspapers on it, and set out the pottery clay, small scraping tools, wooden sticks, and a small turntable they had bought online in advance. Father also brought a chair over and sat at the balcony door, basking in the sun and beaming as he watched the mother and daughter work.
location: Balcony of the old house at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Teaching mother pottery hand-building
description: Yu Xiaowen first demonstrated to her mother how to roll clay coils and how to pat out a clay slab. It was her mother's first time trying, and her movements were clumsy, but she was very earnest. Following her daughter's instructions, she slowly rolled out a crooked clay coil, then carefully coiled it up, trying to shape a small dish. Yu Xiaowen patiently guided her, helped her fix the shape, and taught her to press a simplified version of the interlocking branch pattern she had seen at Lijing Gate the day before onto the rim of the dish. Her father watched with great interest and occasionally offered “suggestions” like “Make the rim of this bowl a little higher,” which made the whole family laugh. The mother and daughter chatted while working the clay, from the price of vegetables to the big matter of her brother's marriage.
location: Balcony of the old house at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Tidy up pottery tools.
description: Finished pieces—a slightly irregular small plate "mother-daughter co-branded" and a barely formed cup—were carefully set aside to air-dry naturally. Mother and daughter cleaned up the tools and newspapers together and wiped the clay spots off the table.
location: Balcony of the old house at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen and chatting
description: Yu Xiaowen helped her mother pick vegetables and peel garlic to prepare lunch. Her mother was in high spirits and kept talking about her pottery experience just now, saying she hadn't expected kneading clay to be so stress-relieving and that next time she could try making a flowerpot. Yu Xiaowen smiled and said yes, thinking that after returning to Zhengzhou she could buy her mother a set of tools and mail them back.
location: The old house at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, kitchen and living room

name: Family lunch.
description: Lunch was home-style Luoyang dishes made by Mom: braised eggplant, garlic stir-fried greens, and tomato and egg soup. The family chatted while eating. Dad brought up the pottery class from the morning again, saying the saucer Mom made could be used as an ashtray, and Mom scolded him playfully. Yu Xiaowen felt that such plain companionship was the best happiness.
location: Old residence at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, dining room

name: Noon break
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowen helped her mother clean up the dishes and chopsticks, then returned to her own room for a nap. Drawing the curtains, she savored the warm time spent with her family that morning while drifting between sleep and wakefulness, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, old residence, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Afternoon preparation and refresh.
description: After waking up, she washed her face with cold water and felt full of energy. She saw that Dad was still napping in the bedroom, and Mom was knitting a sweater on the living room sofa. She made a cup of tea, then walked to her desk, opened her laptop, and prepared to start the afternoon's work.
location: Old residence at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province: balcony and living room

name: Completed the first draft of the first-aid PPT.
description: Yu Xiaowen focused on finishing up the PPT. The main framework had been completed yesterday, and now she mainly needed to design content for the "interactive Q&A" section. Drawing on her experience from hospital internships and her father's rehabilitation period, she designed three scenario-based multiple-choice questions: "1. If a family member suddenly faints, what should you do first? (A. Give water B. Pinch the philtrum C. Check consciousness and breathing)", "2. What is the correct compression rate when performing chest compressions? (A. 60/min B. 80/min C. 100-120/min)", "3. During stroke rehabilitation, if the patient becomes depressed and unwilling to cooperate with training, how should family members handle it?" She set up animation effects for each option, and clicking the correct answer would show encouraging feedback and knowledge explanations. After completing it, she played the entire PPT from beginning to end, checked the layout, fonts, and animation smoothness, and after confirming everything was correct, renamed the file "20251004_First Aid Knowledge Sharing_First Draft" and saved it.
location: Study, old house, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Rest, change clothes, and take a walk with mother
description: After finishing the PPT, Yu Xiaowen felt relaxed. She closed her laptop, walked to the balcony, stretched, and rolled her neck. Then she changed into sneakers and called her mother to go out for a walk. The two went out together and strolled slowly along the residential area where the old house was located toward Kaixuan Road. The afternoon sun was warm but not scorching, and the plane tree leaves along the way were beginning to turn yellow, with autumn growing stronger. They passed Kaixuan Road Primary School at the corner, and her mother mentioned that this was the school Yu Xiaowen had almost attended as a child. Mother and daughter walked slowly and arrived at the entrance of Wangcheng Park after about fifteen minutes. They stopped for a while in the small square at the park gate to watch citizens doing ballroom dancing, then walked back along the same route. The round trip was about 6,000 steps. Her mother talked about the recent lives of old neighbors, and Yu Xiaowen also shared some interesting stories from the hospital.
location: Starting from No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, walk along West Kaixuan Road to Wangcheng Park (No. 312 Middle Zhongzhou Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province), and return by the same route.

name: Return home and help with dinner.
description: After the walk, her mother began preparing dinner. Yu Xiaowen helped out by taking out the black sesame seeds she had brought back from Zhengzhou, washing them, and getting ready to cook some black sesame paste for her father as a nutritious extra meal.
location: The old house at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, kitchen and living room

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner was simple and delicious soup noodles made by Mom, served with peanut butter Mom had made herself. Yu Xiaowen made a bowl of black sesame paste for Dad. After dinner, Dad patted his belly and said, "Mm, eating at home is still the most comfortable."
location: Old residence at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, dining room

name: Cleared the dishes and had parent-child interaction.
description: Yu Xiaowen cleaned up the kitchen with her mother. Her father sat on the sofa and turned on the TV. After the cleanup, Yu Xiaowen sat down beside her father, and her mother also put down the knitting in her hands. The family was ready to watch TV and chat together.
location: The old house at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, kitchen and living room

name: Accompanied father watching TV and discussed the rehabilitation plan.
description: A wartime drama was playing on TV, and her father was watching with great interest. Yu Xiaowen sat beside him. During the commercial break, she took out her phone, opened the previously saved rehabilitation training video, and discussed the next rehabilitation plan with her father. 'Dad, look at this sit-to-stand exercise. We can try adding two more sets a day.' 'I've been practicing it already; you think only you understand?' Although her father wouldn't admit defeat verbally, he still watched the video seriously and nodded. Her mother added from the side: 'I'll supervise him. Without walking a full half hour a day, he's not allowed to look at his phone.' The family chatted and laughed, the atmosphere relaxed and warm.
location: Living room of the old house at 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Personal washing and preparation
description: After watching TV with her parents, Yu Xiaowen returned to her room and changed into pajamas. She went to the bathroom to wash up, and plugged in the cervical neck massager she had brought back from Zhengzhou.
location: Old residence at No. 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, bedroom and bathroom

name: Pre-sleep stretching, cervical spine care, and reading
description: After washing up, Yu Xiaowen did ten minutes of full-body stretching on the floor by the bed and a complete set of mi-character neck exercises, feeling her neck muscles much more relaxed. Then she leaned against the headboard and opened Haruki Murakami's What I Talk About When I Talk About Running, which she had not finished reading last time, and became immersed in the book's account of perseverance and self-challenge.
location: Bedroom, old residence, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Phone leisure and diary
description: Before going to bed, Yu Xiaowen picked up her phone and browsed WeChat Moments. Seeing that Zhang Jing had posted a photo of eating snacks at a night market in Zhengzhou, she liked it. Then she opened the notes app and jotted down a few thoughts from today: "Teaching Mom pottery made her as happy as a little kid; the PPT is finally wrapped up, giving me a great sense of accomplishment; accompanying Dad on a walk and chat—the road to recovery is taken slowly. Four days of the National Day holiday have passed, and it's been very fulfilling."
location: Bedroom, old residence, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and turning off the lights to sleep
description: She put down her phone, placed the bookmark, and turned off the bedside lamp. With her eyes closed, Yu Xiaowen listened to the occasional chirping of insects from the courtyard of the old house outside the window, feeling peaceful and content. Thinking that she could stay home for one more day tomorrow and would have to return to Zhengzhou the day after, she felt a little reluctant. Carrying this attachment to home, she soon fell into a deep sleep. At 10:50 p.m., she turned off the lights and went to bed on time.
location: Bedroom, old residence, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up, washing up, and preparation for the morning run.
description: Yu Xiaowen woke naturally in the morning light, first stretched in bed, rotated her ankles and wrists, then lay flat, hugged her knees, and took deep breaths. After getting up, she spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 15 minutes of cat-cow poses and neck-shoulder stretches to relax her stiff cervical spine. After washing up, she splashed cold water on her face to wake up, changed into quick-dry sportswear and running shoes, put her phone into an armband and put on sports earphones, getting ready for a morning run.
location: A residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Morning run in Luopu Park
description: Yu Xiaowen walked to the entrance under Kaixuan Bridge in Luopu Park, opened the fitness app, and jogged 3 kilometers south along the Luohe Greenway at a pace of about 6:30 per kilometer. In the early morning, a thin mist lingered on the surface of the Luo River, and the air was fresh. Along the way she met elderly people exercising; an old man was doing tai chi. She kept her heart rate at 135-145 bpm and walked slowly for 5 minutes to recover after the run.
location: Luopu Park, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province (riverside greenway, entrance under Kaixuan Bridge)

name: Shower, breakfast, and family interaction.
description: After returning home from her morning run, Yu Xiaowen quickly took a hot shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. Her mother, Li Xiuying, had prepared breakfast: hot hulatang, scallion pancakes, boiled eggs, and Hami melon. The family sat down to eat. Her father looked forward to her rehabilitation training guidance in the morning, while her mother talked about the small ceramic dish she would fire in the afternoon. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: A residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Polished and sent the first aid training PPT
description: Yu Xiaowen read through and optimized the first-aid training PPT on her laptop in the study, making sure the steps were clear and free of typos. At the end, she added a suggestion: during teaching, invite trainees to play the role of family members in simulated practice to increase interaction. At exactly 10 o'clock, she sent the final PPT and a detailed email explanation to the teaching secretary, Ms. Wang Hui, asking for a reply before the feedback deadline.
location: Study in a residence, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Trimming the semi-finished pottery
description: Yu Xiaowen went to the balcony, put on a mask, and focused on trimming the semi-finished small plates and teacups she had made with her mother the previous day. She used trimming tools and fine sandpaper to remove burrs from the edges and sanded the handles until they fit the hand. The whole process demanded great patience; she carefully felt along the curves of the cup body, striving for perfection.
location: Balcony of a residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen, video discussion with brother, and family lunch
description: Yu Xiaowen went to the kitchen to help her mother wash vegetables, peel garlic, and chop scallions. At 11:45, her brother Yu Xiaofeng made a video call, and the whole family gathered around the screen to discuss buying a massage chair for their parents. Yu Xiaowen showed several models she had saved, and based on their father's rehabilitation needs and their mother's preferences, they initially settled on the model and budget for the Double 11 order. Lunch was the Luoyang braised noodles and light egg drop soup her mother had made, and the family ate and chatted happily together.
location: A residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Midday rest and neck relaxation.
description: After tidying up following the meal, Yu Xiaowen returned to the bedroom, leaned against the headboard, and used the cervical massager for a 15-minute massage while resting her eyes. Then she set an alarm and took a 15-minute nap to recharge for the afternoon activities.
location: Bedroom of a residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Glazed the ceramic plate and loaded it into the kiln for firing.
description: After the lunch break, Yu Xiaowen, full of energy, came to the balcony and used a damp sponge to wipe dust off the repaired clay bodies, then checked her mother's idle small electric kiln. She chose a matte wood-ash glaze, used a brush to apply two coats of the base glaze to the small saucer and small cup, and used a needle tip to draw simple leaf-vein textures on the cup body. Finally, she carefully placed the pieces in the electric kiln, set the firing curve and temperature according to the manual, and started the firing program.
location: Balcony of a residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Accompany her father in upper limb rehabilitation training
description: While waiting for the electric kiln firing, Yu Xiaowen helped her father in the living room perform upper-limb rehabilitation exercises such as shoulder abduction and elbow flexion/extension. According to the doctor's plan, each set had 20 repetitions, and they completed 3 sets in total. During the break, she watched the sports channel with her father and talked about his sports hobbies when he was young, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: Living room of a residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Unloaded the kiln to admire the finished pottery.
description: After the electric kiln program ended and cooled naturally, Yu Xiaowen put on heat-resistant gloves and took out the warm small dish and teacup. The matte plant-ash glaze presented a warm, jade-like texture, and the leaf-vein patterns on the cup body were clear. She excitedly called her parents over to show them. Her mother could not put it down, put a thimble and silver earrings into the small dish, and laughingly called it a “treasure storage box”.
location: Balcony of a residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Enjoying flowers, drinking tea, and playing chess on the balcony
description: In the soft evening sunlight, Yu Xiaowen brewed black tea for her parents with the new teacups and placed snacks on small plates. The family of three sat in rattan chairs on the balcony, sharing the joy of the successful firing while sipping tea. She also played two games of Chinese chess with her father, each winning one, fully enjoying the quiet and warm family happiness.
location: Balcony of a residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Family dinner and housework assistance
description: Dinner was stewed lamb with radish, stir-fried baby bok choy, and rice made by her mother. Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to serve rice and set the table. After the meal, she rushed to wash the dishes, wipe the table, and take out the trash so that her mother could rest and watch TV. The family had dinner together in a harmonious atmosphere.
location: A residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: In the evening, walked to Wangcheng Park.
description: As dusk fell, Yu Xiaowen suggested going out for a walk. Her mother readily agreed, and her father walked along with them using a walker, accompanied by the family. The three strolled slowly along Kaixuan Road to the north gate of Wangcheng Park, enjoying the post-National Day night scene and talking about the newly opened mutton soup restaurant by the roadside. They rested on a bench at the park gate, watched the square dancing, and then returned the same way, covering about 7,000 steps in total.
location: Wangcheng Park and the route along the way, No. 312 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Bedtime reading, journaling, and packing luggage
description: After returning home and washing up, Yu Xiaowen leaned against the headboard and read Haruki Murakami's "What I Talk About When I Talk About Running" for about half an hour. Then she took out her diary and wrote about her morning run, the successful pottery making, the plan discussed with her brother about a massage chair, and the warm details of walking with her parents. After 22:00, she packed for the return trip, confirmed her high-speed rail ticket, and sent a voice message to her best friend Zhang Jing to share her sense of accomplishment from the pottery. They chatted briefly and made plans to meet for a meal.
location: Bedroom of a residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Preparing for bed and falling asleep.
description: Yu Xiaowen set her phone to airplane mode and turned off the desk lamp. With the faint moonlight outside the window and the occasional sound of a train whistle in the distance, she quickly fell asleep, filled with satisfaction from a fulfilling day of vacation.
location: Bedroom of a residence at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Morning stretching and Baduanjin
description: I spread the yoga mat on the second-floor balcony, did a 15-minute full-body stretch, and then completed a full set of Baduanjin accompanied by the fragrance of jasmine. The movements were smooth and my breathing was steady, feeling the vitality of my body awakening, starting a serene and ritual-filled day for the Mid-Autumn Festival.
location: Second-floor balcony, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: After washing up and doing skincare, had breakfast with mom.
description: Back in her room, she washed her face with a new towel, did basic skincare, tied her hair into a ponytail, and changed into loungewear. Then she went downstairs, where Mom had already prepared hulatang and scallion pancakes. The mother and daughter chatted while eating, and Mom talked about the shopping plan, saying she wanted to buy pomegranates and five-kernel mooncakes, which Dad loves.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province: first-floor dining room and second-floor bathroom

name: Walked with her mother to the supermarket to buy Mid-Autumn Festival supplies.
description: Carrying a canvas bag, she walked with her mother about 16 minutes to the Wangfujing Department Store supermarket. The autumn sun was bright on the way, and her mother suggested buying osmanthus. In the supermarket, they picked five-nut and egg-yolk lotus-seed paste mooncakes, pomegranates, Shine Muscat grapes, Xinyang Maojian tea, and snacks her father loved, such as peanuts and broad beans. It took about an hour and a half.
location: Wangfujing Department Store (Xigong Branch), No. 429 Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Returned home, organized belongings, and prepared lunch
description: Walked home with Mom carrying bags and packages, sorted and put away the purchased items, and washed and arranged the fruit on plates. Then she helped Mom prepare lunch in the kitchen. Today's main dish was Luoyang braised noodles, which Dad had wanted to eat. Under Mom's guidance, she cut pork belly, green beans, and soybean sprouts, and learned the heat control techniques for stir-frying and braising the noodles. Dad, leaning on his walker at the doorway, smiled and recalled the tricks of the canteen chefs from his youth. The kitchen was filled with laughter and cheerful conversation.
location: Kitchen and living room, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan

name: Family lunch.
description: The family of three sat around the dining table, enjoying a hearty lunch: Luoyang braised noodles, mushrooms with greens, and tomato and egg soup. During the meal, Dad recalled memories of celebrating Mid-Autumn Festival at Luoyang No. 1 High School in his youth; everyone listened intently, savoring the flavor of the old stories.
location: First-floor dining room, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Noon break
description: She went to the study on the second floor, opened the window to let in the fragrance of osmanthus, and lay down on a bamboo recliner with a thin blanket for a nap. From downstairs came the sound of her mother clearing the dishes and the Mid-Autumn Festival program on TV. She felt peaceful, and about 45 minutes later she woke up full of energy.
location: Study, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Revise the first aid PPT and send it to the teaching secretary.
description: She made a cup of green tea, sat down at her desk, and turned on the computer. Based on the three revision comments from Wang Hui, the teaching secretary, she adjusted the font size of the CPR medication dosage to 20 point, added the missing content about atropine 0.5 mg intravenous injection, and rearranged the six flowchart diagrams according to the Recognize–Call for Help–Rescue logic. After revising each item and checking the layout and colors, she named the PPT First_Aid_Knowledge_Sharing_Yu_Xiaowen_Final.pdf and sent it to Wang Hui from her work email.
location: Study desk, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Prepare a Mid-Autumn moon viewing music playlist and rest
description: After sending the email, she felt light-hearted. She created a new playlist “2025 Mid-Autumn Old House Bright Moon” and picked tracks such as “Moonlight Sonata,” “A Moonlit Night on the Spring River,” and “Song of a Fine Night.” She stood up to stretch, looked at the autumn scenery of Wangcheng Park, and sent a WeChat message to her best friend Zhang Jing to arrange sharing moon-viewing photos that evening.
location: Study, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Set up the balcony table for moon viewing with Mom.
description: Together with her mother, she went to the second-floor balcony and divided the tasks: they wiped clean the small round table and laid out a linen tablecloth, set out a white porcelain tea set and bamboo coasters, arranged pomegranates, grapes, and mooncakes on a plate, and brewed light tea; adjusted the cushions on the rattan chairs to make sure her father was comfortable; turned on the decorative light string, and the warm yellow light created a cozy atmosphere. Her mother nodded with satisfaction.
location: Second-floor balcony, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Accompanied Dad in watching a TV drama and performed leg rehabilitation massage.
description: After arranging the balcony, she went to the living room on the first floor, where Dad was watching The Qin Empire. She sat beside him, watching and discussing the plot while using a cushion to elevate his legs and giving him a relaxing leg massage, from thigh to calf, with well-measured pressure. Dad sighed that she was thoughtful.
location: First-floor living room, 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Helping father to the balcony after a simple dinner
description: Dinner was sweet potato and millet porridge with vegetable dishes, saving room for moon gazing. After the meal, she quickly cleaned up the dishes. As the sky darkened, she and her mother carefully supported her father, one on each side, as he climbed the stairs to the second-floor balcony with his walker. Her mother turned on the light strip, and her father sat down in the rattan chair and let out a sigh of relief.
location: No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, from the first-floor dining room to the second-floor balcony.

name: Enjoyed the moon with the whole family on the balcony and had a video call with her older brother
description: On the balcony, the aroma of tea lingered. Mom told the story of Chang'e and Wu Gang. I took photos, photographing the moon, and ate five-nut mooncakes. I called my brother Yu Xiaofeng on video and pointed the phone at the moon. He sighed that the moon in Luoyang was rounder than the one in Shenzhen. Mom told him to rest well, and Dad's eyes were full of longing. Though the family was separated in two places, we enjoyed the moon together through the screen. Dad said the moon over the old house felt familiar, but as long as the family is together, home is wherever we are. I sent the photos to the family group.
location: Second-floor balcony, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Clearing the moon-viewing table and washing up
description: Together with my mother, I packed the leftover food into food storage containers and put them in the refrigerator, washed the tea set and put it back, and wiped the balcony clean. My father was helped downstairs first. After everything was tidied up, I went back to the second-floor bathroom and washed up with hot water, washing away the fatigue.
location: Balcony and second-floor bathroom, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Pre-bedtime personal activities.
description: She changed into pajamas, did pre-sleep stretches and the cervical spine 'mi' exercise on the bedroom floor to relax her muscles and joints. She sat at her desk and wrote in her diary, recording warm moments with family at Mid-Autumn Festival. She sent her best friend Zhang Jing voice messages and photos of moon-gazing from the balcony. Then she leaned against the headboard and read the last two chapters of Haruki Murakami's 'What I Talk About When I Talk About Running,' resonating with the thoughts in the book and feeling calm and empowered.
location: Bedroom on the second floor, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Packed luggage for the return trip and confirmed the high-speed rail ticket
description: After reading, she remembered her backpack was not packed. She checked her phone to confirm tomorrow's high-speed rail ticket to Zhengzhou, train G852 (Luoyang Longmen 14:21 - Zhengzhou East 15:13), carefully put a change of clothes, charger, and two packs of peony cake specialties her mother had stuffed into her bag into the travel bag, and set an alarm for 7 a.m. tomorrow.
location: Bedroom on the second floor, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: Turned off the bedside lamp. The room was quiet, and moonlight spilled across the floor through the curtains. Carrying the fullness and warmth of the day, I quickly fell asleep, recharging for tomorrow's return trip and post-holiday work.
location: Bedroom on the second floor, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: Xiaowen woke up to the morning alarm. She first checked messages in the family group chat. Her father shared an article on 'Autumn Heart Care'; her mother liked it, and she replied with an emoji. Then she responded to a voice message from her cousin Li Yaqin, and replied to her best friend Zhang Jing about the ceramic cup and saucer. After that, she quickly washed up, changed into loungewear, did 10 minutes of stretching and 'mi' character neck exercises in the living room, and finally packed items such as charging cables into her suitcase.
location: At home, Luoyang Library Family Courtyard, 13 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Morning walk with parents
description: Xiaowen accompanied her parents for a walk, heading west along Kaixuan West Road, turning onto Zhongzhou Middle Road, and walking toward Wangcheng Park. Her mother mentioned that the osmanthus in the courtyard had bloomed, and her father pointed at the goldenrain trees by the roadside. The three of them walked about 4,000 steps round-trip. Her father walked more steadily than in previous days, and Xiaowen felt much more at ease.
location: Along Zhongzhou Middle Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province (outside Wangcheng Park)

name: Packing luggage and chatting with family.
description: After walking home, her father was watching the morning news in the living room. Xiaowen went to the bedroom to pack her luggage. She sorted and bagged her coat, peony flower cakes, and ceramic cups and saucers. Her mother came in to help and put a bag of sesame salt into her bag, reminding her to eat breakfast on time when she returned to Zhengzhou. Xiaowen felt a warmth surging in her heart.
location: At home, Luoyang Library Family Courtyard, 13 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Helped in the kitchen to prepare a farewell lunch
description: Xiaowen and her mother were preparing Luoyang braised noodles in the kitchen. She was responsible for trimming the green beans and slicing the pork into strips, while her mother stir-fried the vegetables and braised the noodles. Her father sat nearby peeling garlic and talked about his memories of eating braised noodles at the staff canteen when he was young. The kitchen was steaming hot and filled with the smell of home.
location: Home kitchen, Luoyang Library Family Compound, No. 13 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Farewell lunch
description: The family of three sat around the dining table, enjoying the Luoyang braised noodles, seaweed egg drop soup, and cucumber salad made by her mother. Xiaowen ate slowly, trying to remember the taste. Her parents reminded her to take care of herself and not stay up late. After the meal, she proactively cleaned up the dishes and the kitchen.
location: Home dining room, Luoyang Library Family Compound, No. 13 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Departure and commute to Luoyang Longmen Station
description: Before leaving, Xiaowen checked her luggage again and helped her father put on his lumbar support. The family of three dragged their suitcases out and took a taxi from the community gate to Luoyang Longmen Station. Her mother held her hand. They arrived about 40 minutes later, picked up tickets, entered the station, and found the ticket gate in the waiting hall.
location: Luoyang Longmen Station, No. 19 Tongqu Road, Luolong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Waiting for the train and returning by high-speed rail
description: While waiting, Xiaowen used her phone to browse Tencent News and read a few articles about AI in healthcare. Feeling they were relevant to her profession, she saved them. She chatted with her parents about next week's weather and reminded her father to dress warmly. At 13:41, train G1918 departed on time. Along the way, she posted a Moments update: “Holiday balance cleared, returning to Zhengzhou full of family love and food! [Striving] [Love]” Then she leaned back in her seat to rest, occasionally scrolling her phone to adjust her mindset for work the next day.
location: Waiting hall of Luoyang Longmen Station and carriage of G1918 train

name: After arriving in Zhengzhou and settling her parents in, she returned to her residence.
description: At 14:50, arrived at Zhengzhou East Railway Station. Xiaowen booked a ride-hailing car and took her parents to the rental apartment on Huayuan Road, Jinshui District. After arriving, she helped her parents move luggage, checked that the radiator in the bathroom was working, reminded them about water, electricity, gas, and medication, and poured warm water for her father. Then she said goodbye to her parents, took a taxi back to Qunying Community, and entered the door at 15:45.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tidying up the house and cleaning.

description: After parking the car, she walked to the physical examination center on the third floor of the outpatient building. During the blood draw, she mentioned to the nurse that she had been experiencing occasional dizziness and fatigue recently; the nurse noted it and advised keeping an eye on the complete blood count results. Then, following the nurse's guidance, she completed urine sample collection, electrocardiogram, internal medicine auscultation, and body composition analysis. After finishing all the items, she printed the preliminary results at the self-service report machine and saw values of 24% body fat and 105 g/L hemoglobin, suggesting mild iron-deficiency anemia. Sitting on a chair in the waiting area, she studied the report carefully, felt deeply moved, and realized she could no longer ignore her body's warning signs.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Physical Examination Center, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

At the bedside of a hemiplegic patient, she patiently guided the family in positioning the affected limb and gently comforted the patient. After the rounds, she returned to the office to help handle medical orders and write examination orders for new patients.
location: Doctor's office and wards, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and catching up with friends.
description: She went to the cafeteria with Wang Fang. While waiting in line, she told Wang Fang about this morning's physical examination results (body fat, anemia). Wang Fang was worried and suggested adjusting her diet and daily routine, and offered to help her find iron-rich recipes. The two found a corner seat and chatted about family matters while eating stir-fried vegetables and tomato beef brisket rice. After the meal, Wang Fang returned to the department first. Yu Xiaowen sat alone for a while, then quickly jotted down a list of ingredients she needed to buy in her phone's memo.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and work preparation
description: Returned to the department break room, lay down on the sofa, and rested with my eyes closed for about 20 minutes. Got up at 13:00, washed my face, tidied the desk, and jotted down a simple to-do list for the afternoon's work in the duty log.
location: Rehabilitation Medicine Department lounge, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon work and thankful reflection
description: In the afternoon, I worked on the medical records for newly admitted patients and called the radiology department to confirm several important imaging reports. Around 15:00, I had an in-depth conversation with the family member of a patient who had undergone tracheostomy, lasting about 15 minutes, and carefully answered questions about subsequent rehabilitation training and home care. Just after hanging up, Head Nurse Wu Min walked to her desk with a thank-you letter and handed it to her with a smile, saying it was a handwritten thank-you letter from Grandma Li, a discharged patient. She opened it on the spot, and the warm words in the letter made her eyes redden instantly. At the same time, she noticed that Director Zhang Lei had sent several messages in the WeChat work group, along with a screenshot of the thank-you letter, publicly praising: "Dr. Yu Xiaowen exemplifies the benevolence of a doctor." Colleagues in the department gave thumbs-up one after another. A warmth welled up in her heart, and she replied, "Thank you, Director. I will continue to work hard." Then she carefully folded the letter and tucked it into her work notebook. Afterward, she tidied her desk, completed the final progress notes and shift handover records, and prepared to leave work.

participant.name: Family member of a post-tracheostomy patient.

location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Instead of going straight home, she turned into the Qunying Road grain and oil shop at the entrance of the community (14-10 Qunying Road). In the meat and poultry section, she picked out 300 grams of fresh pork liver and 500 grams of lean beef; in the vegetable section, she bought a bunch of spinach and a box of tomatoes. After paying, she cycled back home in Qunying Community.

participant.name: Grain and oil shop stall owner.

She sliced the pork liver and soaked it in water, then simmered it with lean meat and ginger slices over low heat to make pork liver and lean meat congee. When the congee was almost ready, she boiled water, made a cold spinach salad, and fried a tender sunny-side-up egg. At 18:15, she began to enjoy dinner. The warmth of the food made her feel much more settled in both body and mind.
