name: Systematically study sports rehabilitation knowledge
description: After washing the dishes, she opened her laptop and began systematically searching for knowledge about exercise rehabilitation. She cross-compared information on platforms such as Zhihu and DingXiang Doctor, browsing articles such as "Integrating Exercise Anatomy into Rehabilitation Training" and "How Women with Mild Iron-Deficiency Anemia Can Exercise and Supplement Iron." She emailed herself several high-quality articles and noted some low-intensity yoga and stretching exercises suitable for the early stage of anemia. At the same time, she also found a few simple core-activation videos for her father, who was far away in Luoyang, and planned to send them to him on the weekend.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Improved neck exercise routine
description: Due to her physical condition, she did not do intense exercise. Based on newly searched materials, she redesigned a modified version of the health exercises that included shoulder and neck relaxation, thoracic spine mobility, and low-intensity core activation, lasting about 20 minutes. Throughout the exercise, she paid attention to her breathing and heart rate, moving slower and more gently than usual. After finishing, she rolled up the yoga mat, returned to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, and made the bed.
location: On the yoga mat in the living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Write reflection diary
description: She took out her diary and recorded the bits and pieces of the day. On the first page, she pasted a photo of the physical examination report she had taken in the afternoon. In the diary, she wrote seriously: "After searching for information tonight, I realized that health management is not something to be taken lightly. Grandma Li's letter and the director's affirmation moved me, but my body's warning signs cannot be ignored. 'I can no longer pass off walking as exercise; I need to find a way to keep at it.' This is also being responsible for myself. For myself and for my father, I will make a truly feasible recovery plan." Then she turned on the bedside lamp and read a few pages of "My Body: Everything About the Remarkable Female Body."
location: At the desk in the bedroom of her home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep meditation and mindful breathing
description: She turned off the lights and set a 10-minute meditation timer. Following the guided audio, she began a body scan meditation. With each breath, she noticed the soreness in her shoulders, the warmth in her abdomen, and the rhythm of her heartbeat. Her thoughts occasionally drifted to the physical examination report, but after a moment returned to the breath itself. At the countdown chime, she said softly to herself, "Rest well, with determination and serenity."
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Did a simple skincare routine and set the phone alarm for tomorrow (Thursday) at 6:45. Put the water cup on the nightstand, turned off the main light, and turned on the night light. In the last few minutes before bed, she opened WeChat and saw the "Good night" message her mother sent in the family group. She replied with a reassuring sticker and turned off the light to sleep before 23:00.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning self-check and breakfast consultation
description: After the alarm went off, Yu Xiaowen did 5 minutes of gentle stretching on the bed in the bedroom. She then went to the kitchen to boil water and prepare breakfast. She logged into the hospital's internal app on her phone and checked the previous day's electronic physical examination report, confirming a mild anemia result with hemoglobin 105g/L. She reviewed her tendency to feel dizzy and fatigued after shifts in recent months, analyzed her daily diet, which was mostly vegetarian with little red meat, initially attributed it to that, and resolved to adjust it. She then heated milk in the microwave, prepared oatmeal, and added a few red dates. While eating breakfast, she sent a message through the hospital's internal messaging software to Li Ting, a colleague in the nutrition department, to arrange an in-person consultation about dietary adjustments at 10 a.m. Li Ting quickly replied and agreed.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Cycle commuting
description: After breakfast and getting ready, Yu Xiaowen put on her commuter bag, unlocked a shared bicycle downstairs, and rode east along Qunying Road, then south via Nanyang Road, crossed the Nongye Road overpass, and continued along Tongbai Road for about 5.5 kilometers, arriving at Zhengzhou Central Hospital in 15 minutes. On the way, she bought a bottle of room-temperature drinking water at a roadside convenience store, determined to quit coffee.
location: On the cycling route from Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Morning handover, ward rounds, and routine affairs
description: After arriving at the department at 7:50 and changing into her white coat, Yu Xiaowen attended the 8:00 department morning handover, recording the condition of newly admitted patients from the night shift. She then followed Director Zhang Lei and Dr. Li Wei on rounds, focusing on a stroke patient who required rehabilitation assessment, and exchanged opinions with colleague Wang Fang about the patient's muscle strength recovery. After rounds, she returned to her workstation, handled new medical orders that had come in overnight, and began writing the previous day's progress notes.
location: Rehabilitation Department doctors' office and ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-consultation preparation and detailed consultation with the Nutrition Department.
description: Before going to the nutrition department, Yu Xiaowen pulled up the physical examination report screenshot in her office again and wrote down a list of questions in her notebook, such as whether coffee had to be completely stopped, the recommended daily amount of red meat, and whether other nutritional supplements could be taken, to make sure the consultation was efficient. At 10 o'clock she arrived at the nutrition department on time, showed the report to Li Ting, and described in detail her dizziness symptoms and daily diet. After analyzing, Li Ting gave specific advice: consume 100 to 150 grams of red meat daily, eat pork liver 1 to 2 times a week at 50 grams each time, increase dark-colored vegetables, completely give up coffee and strong tea, switch to lemon water or fruit tea rich in vitamin C, and take iron supplements if necessary — but first try dietary supplementation for two weeks and observe. Xiaowen recorded each item one by one in her phone memos.
location: Rehabilitation Department doctor's office and Nutrition Department office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Organizing dietary key points and handling routine medical documents
description: Back in the office, Yu Xiaowen took out her personal health management notebook and neatly copied down Li Ting's suggestions, using a red pen to underline "quit coffee" and "100 grams of pork liver per week" emphatically. She then continued with her current work, including checking the list of patients for tomorrow's examinations and printing discharge summaries.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Iron-rich lunch
description: After getting off work at noon, Yu Xiaowen and her colleague Wang Fang went to the staff cafeteria together. She deliberately avoided the hot and sour vermicelli window she usually loved, and ordered garlic spinach, a small portion of boiled beef slices, and half a portion of rice at the self-selection window, starting to replenish iron with concrete actions. The two chatted while eating. When Wang Fang learned she had anemia, she teased, "You need to replenish yourself too; your face looks pale." Xiaowen felt very warm.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and in-depth preparation for the consultation.
description: After lunch, she returned to the office. Yu Xiaowen put on an eye mask and a U-shaped pillow and took a 20-minute nap on the folding bed. After getting up, she washed her face to refresh herself, and then sat down at the computer to prepare for the 3 p.m. multidisciplinary consultation in neurology. She reviewed the latest electronic medical record and brain MRI images of the complex stroke patient, and also opened the recent review on functional electrical stimulation she had downloaded from PubMed earlier, using a highlighter to mark key points on the printed copy. Then she compared the patient's functional impairment assessment results with the FES indications in the literature, and sketched out a preliminary rehabilitation plan framework on paper. In particular, for the patient's wrist dorsiflexion dysfunction, she decided to recommend adding neuromuscular electrical stimulation to conventional exercise therapy to promote neural functional reconstruction, and prepared to cite key references to support her view.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Participated in the neurology multidisciplinary consultation
description: At 3 p.m., Yu Xiaowen was in place on time with the prepared materials. The consultation discussion was intense. When the rehabilitation plan was being discussed, the director of the neurology department specifically asked for the rehabilitation department's opinion. Taking a deep breath, Xiaowen made a clear and well-organized suggestion: on the basis of routine exercise training, early introduction of neuromuscular electrical stimulation targeting the wrist extensor muscles could effectively induce cortical reorganization. She cited a 2023 article in Neurorehabilitation and Neural Repair supporting that early FES intervention can significantly improve the speed of hand function recovery. Her suggestion was well-reasoned and evidence-based, won approving nods from the director and the rehabilitation therapists, and was decided to be incorporated into the final rehabilitation pathway.
location: Department of Neurology Conference Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Consultation notes organization and work wrap-up
description: After the consultation ended, Yu Xiaowen returned to her office, filled with a sense of accomplishment. She immediately organized the opinions from all sides and the final comprehensive rehabilitation plan into clearly structured electronic notes. In her personal work log, she reflected: “Today I was more composed than before during the consultation. Multidisciplinary collaboration made me see my value in the rehabilitation department, especially being able to actively use evidence-based medicine to influence clinical decisions. In the future, I should pay more attention to the timing and necessity of early rehabilitation intervention.” After that, she completed the last progress note of the day.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After work, shopping and preparing an iron-rich dinner
description: After clocking out at 5:30, Yu Xiaowen rode a shared bike home. She stopped at the Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store at the Qunying Road intersection and, following Li Ting's advice, carefully selected a piece of fresh beef brisket (about 150 grams), a box of pork liver (packed in portions to eat twice), a bunch of spinach, and a few carrots. After checkout, she rode for one minute to get home, changed into loungewear, and started preparing dinner. She planned to make stir-fried spinach with pork liver (the liver was soaked in advance to remove blood) and stir-fried shredded carrots. The sounds of washing and chopping vegetables came from the kitchen. Although the heat control for the pork liver wasn't perfect, as her first attempt at making this iron-rich dish, she felt it was a good start.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province and Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Dinner and online search for iron-rich recipes.
description: Sitting alone at the dining table, she slowly enjoyed her homemade iron-rich dinner with a glass of warm lemon water, while opening her tablet to watch two episodes of a documentary on Tang and Song dynasty aesthetics to relax. After clearing the dishes, Xiaowen sat on the sofa and opened Xiaohongshu and Bilibili on her laptop, systematically searching for "iron-supplementing recipes for anemia". She not only saved the methods for spinach and pork liver porridge and braised beef brisket with radish, but also discovered new dishes such as red date, goji berry, and black-bone chicken soup and duck blood vermicelli soup, adding them one by one to the "Want to Make" folder in her phone memo.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, Yu Xiaowen initiated a video call with her mother Li Xiuying, who was far away in Luoyang, to tell her about the physical examination results and her visit to the nutrition department. Her mother nagged with concern about her not eating properly at ordinary times, then asked in detail about Li Ting's suggestions, and gave a live demonstration of how to make a more delicious beef hulatang, from cutting the beef into small pieces and blanching it to the finer points of seasonings. Xiaowen fixed her phone with a phone stand and carefully took notes in the kitchen following her mother's verbal guidance. The nearly 45-minute call conveyed her mother's care through the screen and made her feel reassured.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening relaxation and body health care
description: After hanging up the phone, Yu Xiaowen changed into sportswear, laid out a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, and followed a course on Keep to do 20 minutes of modified cervical spine exercises and 10 minutes of bedtime meditation. The movements were gentle, and she focused on her breathing; the fatigue in her body and the worries in her mind were both released to some extent.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Write a diary and make a plan for tomorrow
description: Sitting at her desk, Yu Xiaowen opened her diary and recorded the day's key events: the small ripple brought by the physical exam results, the useful substance from the nutrition consultation, her standout performance in the consultation, and her mother's warm care. Finally, she listed tomorrow's to-dos, including preparing breakfast according to the nutrition plan, replying to Wang Fang's question from the afternoon, and printing today's consultation form.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up and getting ready for bed
description: Brushed teeth, washed face, applied skincare products, and changed into pajamas. Set the alarm for 6:40, then turned off the light and lay down. Reflecting on the fulfilling day, I felt that I was truly taking control of my health and career, and slowly drifted off to sleep with a trace of tiredness and satisfaction.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: When the alarm clock rang in the morning, I first took deep breaths in bed and recalled the physical exam results and nutritional advice. After drawing the curtains, I put on loungewear and did five minutes of gentle joint mobility and neck stretches on the yoga mat. Then I went into the kitchen and prepared an iron-rich breakfast to improve my iron-deficiency anemia: I blanched spinach in boiling water to remove oxalic acid and quickly stir-fried it with fresh pork liver, while putting the soaked brown rice into the rice cooker. At breakfast, I slowly enjoyed the spinach with pork liver and multigrain porridge, and confirmed the day's work plan. After the meal, I quickly washed the dishes, changed into my white coat and flat shoes, checked that my commuter bag contained my work notebook, phone, power bank, and the pre-printed "Stroke Patient Rehabilitation Assessment Form," then grabbed my helmet and folding umbrella, ready to leave.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting and departmental morning handover
description: I rode my electric bike from home along Jingsan Road toward Tongbai North Road in Zhongyuan District, listening to Bach cello music on the way, feeling calm. About ten minutes later, I arrived at Zhengzhou Central Hospital. After parking, I changed into work clothes and entered the doctors' office in the rehabilitation department. The 8 a.m. morning handover started on time. The on-duty doctor reported the overnight patient conditions, and Director Zhang Lei emphasized the key patients. I reported the basic information of today's three patients for assessment to my supervising teacher Li Wei and confirmed the assessment process.
location: Rehabilitation Department doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning patient assessment.
description: After the morning handover, my instructor Li Wei and I went to the rehabilitation treatment hall to assess three patients in the recovery phase of stroke. For the first, Grandpa Zhang, who had left-sided hemiplegia, I guided him through active range-of-motion tests for shoulder flexion and abduction. For the second, Auntie Wang, I stood behind her as a safeguard during the Berg Balance Scale assessment. For the third, young Mr. Li, I assisted with the Barthel Index assessment, recording the time and difficulties involved in dressing and washing. I accurately recorded the data on the assessment forms and, under Instructor Li's guidance, made additional notes on one patient's ankle control problems.
location: Rehabilitation Department Treatment Hall, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and health consultation
description: After the assessment, I went to the hospital staff cafeteria to heat up the brown rice and spinach with pork liver I had brought as lunch. While eating, I used my phone to contact Dr. Wang in internal medicine through the hospital app, sent a screenshot of the physical examination report, and described the symptoms of dizziness, fatigue, and worsening after activity over the past two weeks. Dr. Wang made a preliminary diagnosis of mild iron-deficiency anemia and recommended taking oral ferrous sulfate tablets once a day, as well as having blood drawn to check serum ferritin and total iron-binding capacity. I noted down the advice and thanked him. After lunch, I returned to the doctors' office and, during the lunch break, used my phone to search for keywords such as "sports anemia and resuming exercise intensity". I learned that I should start at low intensity and ensure adequate nutrition, and noted down the key points in my memo. After that, I went to the doctors' duty room, put on an eye mask, listened to white noise, and closed my eyes to rest for forty minutes to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Staff cafeteria and doctor's office and duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon rehabilitation work.
description: After the lunch break, I washed my face to wake up, turned on the computer, and reviewed the rehabilitation plans for the inpatients I needed to follow up on that afternoon, sorting them by urgency and printing new training record sheets. Then I went to the wards to visit three patients. One patient with cerebral infarction reported improved strength in his left leg; I encouraged him and slightly adjusted his treatment plan. Next, I guided another patient in standing training inside the parallel bars and recorded weight-bearing time. In the treatment area, I used the spare moments to write up the next day's rehabilitation orders for Mr. Li, whom I had assessed that morning. The whole afternoon was fulfilling and well-organized.
location: Rehabilitation Department ward and treatment area, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After work, bought medicine and went home.
description: After work, instead of going straight home, I rode my e-bike onto Zhongyuan Road beside the hospital and found the Laobaixing Pharmacy on Zhongyuan Road. After entering the store, I bought a box of ferrous sulfate tablets from the pharmacist. The pharmacist told me the instructions: take one tablet once a day after a meal, and avoid taking it with tea or coffee. Satisfied with the purchase, I left, got on my bike, and rode home. The early autumn streetlights were already on. I put on my earphones, played Chopin's nocturnes, and rode home relaxedly for about fifteen minutes to my home on Qunying Road in Jinshui District.
location: No. 42 Zhongyuan West Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, Laobaixing Pharmacy (Zhongyuan Road Store) and along the way home.

name: Dinner
description: After arriving home, she changed into loungewear, took out the beef hulatang that her mother had taught her over video the night before, heated it up, and also stir-fried a plate of baby bok choy. She set the heated hulatang and rice on the table, enjoyed the meal alone, and then washed the dishes and cleaned the kitchen.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading rehabilitation medicine literature
description: After the meal, I made a cup of lemon water, sat down at the desk in the study, and focused on reading the chapter "Rehabilitation Treatment of Limb Spasticity After Stroke" in Practical Rehabilitation Medicine. I highlighted key points with a marker and wrote down my thoughts in my notebook, accumulating knowledge for the attending physician exam.
location: Study at Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Taking medication and evening stretching
description: At the time to take the medicine, I poured a glass of fresh orange juice, took out the newly bought ferrous sulfate tablets, and swallowed the first one with orange juice (orange juice is rich in vitamin C to promote iron absorption), then recorded in my phone memo: 'October 17, 20:35, first iron tablet, taken with orange juice, no discomfort.' Afterward, I went to the living room balcony, opened the window for ventilation, and followed a mobile app to complete a 15-minute shoulder-and-neck relaxation routine and full-body stretching, relieving the stiffness from a day of work.
location: Living room and balcony, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Phone call with family and friends
description: I first made a WeChat video call to my mother and reported the situation about consulting the doctor and buying medicine to start iron supplementation. Mom was a little relieved and told me to eat on time and not stay up late, and said she would send some red dates and millet. I shared my feelings about learning to make hulatang. After hanging up, I saw my best friend Zhang Jing @mention me in the three-person group chat, so I called her directly. Zhang Jing said she had just finished dinner with friends at Zhenghong City. I shared my experience with the physical exam, dietary adjustments, and buying medicine. As usual, she reminded me not to always eat takeout and to rest more. We chatted for about half an hour and agreed to go see a pottery studio together next week.
location: Living room and bedroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Write a journal entry to review the day
description: After hanging up, I sat down at the desk in the study, took out the locked diary, and wrote down today's three key points: Dr. Wang from Internal Medicine suggested rechecking ferritin; I bought ferrous sulfate tablets and took them on the first day; I walked about 7,000 steps in total today. I wrote my feelings: 'Although it's not a big problem, it feels good to start taking action. I hope to get my body back in shape soon and resume morning running.'
location: Study at Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Relaxing and reading before bed
description: After washing up, I changed into pajamas, turned off the main light and left only the small bedside nightlight. Lying in bed, I opened the meditation app and did a ten-minute body scan exercise, and my breathing gradually became steady. After the meditation, I pulled open the curtains to check tomorrow's weather, checked the door lock, then set two alarms at 6:40 and 6:45, and wrote in my memo that tomorrow's breakfast would be boiled eggs and oatmeal with milk. Then I picked up the book "Still Walking" from the bedside, read a few pages of short stories, and before 11:30 drowsiness set in, so I closed the book, turned off the light, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Wake up, morning stretching, and breakfast
description: After the alarm rang, Yu Xiaowen first did neck stretches and gentle full-body stretches to feel the state of her body. She washed up, did simple skincare, and changed into comfortable home clothes. Then she heated the red date milk prepared the night before, and had breakfast with two slices of whole-wheat bread and a boiled egg. Meanwhile, she checked the items she was bringing: phone, wallet, power bank, bridesmaid dress, and gift box.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Purchase iron-rich foods and buy iron supplements
description: Yu Xiaowen set out on her electric bike and first went to Goule Supermarket (Xinglong Street branch) to buy iron-rich foods such as pork liver, lean beef, spinach, red dates, and oranges, and also grabbed the promotional Yunnan small yellow ginger and traditional brown sugar. Then she rode to LBX Pharmacy on Fengle Road and bought the specified brand of ferrous sulfate tablets from the clerk, who reminded her to take them after meals.
location: Goule Supermarket, No. 8 Xinglong Street, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province; then go to Laobaixing Pharmacy (Provincial Medical Supermarket Fengle Road Branch) at the intersection of Fengle Road and Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Go home, change clothes, and double-check the gifts
description: Yu Xiaowen returned home, sorted the purchased ingredients into the refrigerator, portioned and froze the pork ribs, and washed and drained the spinach. She changed into the pre-ironed champagne-colored bridesmaid dress, applied light makeup, put her hair up in a bun, and put on pearl earrings. She opened the gift box again, confirmed that the ceramic cup engraved with the initials of 'Zhang Jing & Wang Fang' and the double-happiness small bowl were intact, and put them back in the gift bag.
location: Room 501, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Go to the hotel for Zhang Jing's wedding
description: Yu Xiaowen set off from home on her electric bike, along Qunying Road - Jingsan Road - Jinshui Road, to Zhengzhou International Convention and Exhibition Center. On the way, she sent Zhang Jing a WeChat message to let her know she was leaving, and arrived at 08:40.
location: Cycling route: Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, via Jingsan Road and Jinshui Road to Zhengzhou International Convention and Exhibition Center

name: Attend Zhang Jing's wedding as a maid of honor
description: After Yu Xiaowen arrived at the banquet hall of Zhengzhou International Convention and Exhibition Center, she first went to the bride's lounge to meet Zhang Jing and helped her adjust her veil and wedding dress and confirm the procedure. The wedding officially began at 10:18, and she stayed by her side throughout, passing the rings, adjusting the train of her dress, and accepting red envelopes. During the toasts, Yu Xiaowen said: Today is also the wedding day of my other close friend Wang Fang. Although I can't be in two places at once, the sentiment can bridge the distance. Zhang Jing was moved to tears. Because the ceremony ran long and there were photos with relatives and friends, the wedding banquet lasted until 13:00 before ending. Yu Xiaowen hastily ate some steamed fish and vegetables.

She parked in the staff parking lot. She went to the rehabilitation medicine department office, where her colleague Wang Fang smilingly handed her a courier package — it was the sample issue sent by the editorial department of Henan Medical Research. Yu Xiaowen happily opened the package and, seeing the brand-new sample issue, felt a great sense of achievement.

The colleagues present applauded warmly. Yu Xiaowen, both surprised and moved, stood up to thank them and said she would go all out to prepare her speech.

She took photos of the cover and the first page of the paper with her phone and sent them to her supervising teacher Li Wei and her parents in Luoyang via WeChat, expressing gratitude to Teacher Li and sharing the joy with her parents. Then she put the sample issue into her folder and recorded the publication date in her work log.

Afterwards, she organized the progress notes of several key patients to prepare for the afternoon leave handover.

After the break, she continued on the road and arrived in downtown Luoyang a little after 12 noon.

Throughout the session, she patiently corrected his posture and encouraged him. After the training, her father took a midday nap.

Yu Xiaowen shared funny things from the hospital, the surprise and responsibility of being selected as a youth representative, and her work and financial plans. Her mother urged her to take care of herself and said with feeling that her daughter had really grown up.

Then she recorded her feelings about the day in a notes app on her phone: the paper was published, she was selected as a youth representative, her family's warmth was healing, and the first draft of her speech was done—she felt a grounded satisfaction.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

I happened to reach the stage where the protagonist gives up everything to pursue art, and I was quite moved. Around 13:10, I felt a little sleepy, so I closed my eyes and took a 20-minute nap.
location: Living room sofa at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Communicated online with Zhou Haoran and offered encouragement.
description: Just waking from a lunch break, she picked up her phone and saw a WeChat message from college classmate Zhou Haoran. He told her that his application to the National Natural Science Foundation of China's Young Scientists Fund had not been approved, and his words carried obvious disappointment and fatigue. Yu Xiaowen's heart tightened. She immediately became fully awake and quickly thought about how to respond. She walked briskly to the bookshelf, took out Better: A Surgeon's Notes on Performance, turned to the last chapter, and reread the passage about "perseverance and growth," confirming that these words could inspire Zhou Haoran at this moment. She took clear photos of the passages with her phone and sent them one by one via WeChat, with a sincere message: "Being better isn't just about winning a grant once; it's about choosing to keep going every time. These words have always been my strength, and I hope they can give you some encouragement." After sending it, she let out a long breath. A few minutes later, Zhou Haoran replied, "Thank you. You're much stronger mentally than last year." This made her deeply relieved, and she immediately replied with a "Go for it" emoji. The two briefly exchanged updates online and agreed to collaborate academically when the opportunity arose, turning their supportive relationship into a research partnership.
location: Study at home in Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

After skincare, she took out the uniform and sweater she would wear tomorrow from the wardrobe and hung them on the clothes rack; checked her commuter bag to make sure her employee ID, keys, and everything else were there; plugged her phone in to charge, and placed the cup of hot water and ferrous sulfate tablets she would need tomorrow morning on the bedside table. Finally, she set the alarm for 6:40 tomorrow morning, turned off the bedside lamp, listened to the faint sound of the wind outside the window, and slowly drifted off to sleep in the warm, cozy quilt.

After the morning meeting, she followed her mentor Li Wei on ward rounds and reported on the rehabilitation progress of the patients under her care. Li Wei suggested adjustments to the occupational therapy plan for a patient with left-sided hemiplegia, adding fine motor training for the hand. After rounds, she handled new medical orders in the office, supplemented progress notes, and found time to familiarize herself with the speech draft for the next day's hospital anniversary. She then opened the packaging of the CPR manikin to inspect it, confirmed it was intact, and put it back in the cabinet. Next, she printed out the speech draft, marked key pauses and stresses with a pen, and mentally practiced her stage manner and gestures. Head nurse Wu Min passed by, saw the manikin, talked about her experience in the emergency skills competition years ago, and praised her for being so dedicated.
location: Rehabilitation Department Ward (Building 7, Floors 2-4) and Doctor's Office (Building 7, Floor 3), Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch socializing
description: At noon, Yu Xiaowen and her colleague Wang Fang had lunch together in the hospital staff cafeteria, ordering braised eggplant, stir-fried broccoli, and rice. They chatted while eating about departmental anecdotes and the year-end assessment. After lunch, Yu Xiaowen sent a WeChat message to Teacher Li Wei, thanking him for his suggestions on the speech draft and letting him know about the afternoon rehearsal. Wang Fang joked that if she was nervous, she should imagine the audience as potatoes.
location: Staff cafeteria, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (Level B1, Building 1)

name: Noon break and rehearsal preparation
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowen closed her eyes and rested for 20 minutes to regain her energy. She took the revised speech, a bottle of water, and her phone, and headed to the conference center early to attend the full rehearsal for the hospital anniversary celebration at 2 p.m. Passing the nurse station, she greeted the head nurse.
location: Doctor's office of the Rehabilitation Department and Conference Center of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (Multi-function Hall, 3rd Floor, Building 2).

name: Hospital anniversary rehearsal
description: Yu Xiaowen arrived at the venue half an hour early and confirmed the blocking and on/off-stage order with the staff debugging the equipment (she would enter from the left side of the stage, and the podium was slightly right of center). During the formal rehearsal, she walked onto the stage and delivered a simulated speech. The lights were a bit glaring, so she adjusted her mindset, controlled her speaking pace, and incorporated the rehabilitation case of a cerebral hemorrhage patient as planned (when she said, 'The patient held my hand and said thank you,' she deliberately slowed down and added a two-second pause). The sound engineer adjusted the microphone volume, and the host instructed her on the handover process. Afterward, she reviewed the speech pacing with the host and made fine adjustments to a few pauses. She then sent her mother a message reporting that the rehearsal went smoothly.
location: Conference Center, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (Multifunction Hall, 3rd Floor, Building 2)

name: After-work commute and shopping
description: After the rehearsal ended, Yu Xiaowen returned to her office to pack up, taking her bag and the courier packaging paper. She left work by car, driving along Tongbai Road, then Nongye Road, then Qunying Road, and arrived at the Qunying Road grain and oil shop at about 16:45. In the shop, she bought bananas to take back to Luoyang, tomatoes and green vegetables for dinner, and also picked out fresh tangerines for her parents, spending 38 yuan in total.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Dinner and rest
description: Yu Xiaowen drove back to her home in Qunying Community, carried the ingredients upstairs, and changed out of her work clothes. She steamed the multigrain rice, washed the tomatoes and green vegetables she had bought, and made scrambled eggs with tomatoes and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. The dinner was light and nutritious. After the meal, she quickly tidied up the kitchen and washed the dishes and utensils.
location: Room 601, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Rest and informal video call with parents.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen relaxed on the sofa listening to Brahms' piano music. Then she went to the study, opened her laptop, pulled up her father's cardiac rehabilitation weight-shift training plan, reviewed the safe positions, movement details and key task breakdown points, set up the phone stand, adjusted the camera angle, and saved the movement breakdown diagrams to the desktop. Half an hour beforehand, her mother Li Xiuying called via video, and her father Yu Jianguo was also sitting beside her. She asked what they had eaten for lunch (her mother had made Luoyang meat slices in soup), confirmed that her father was in good spirits, and encouraged him not to be nervous—just to find the feel as when doing normal activities.
location: Study, Room 601, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading and remote rehabilitation training.
description: With one hour left before the formal training session, Yu Xiaowen read Chapter 8 of Still Walking. When she came to the passage where Ryota reconciles with his father, she couldn't help thinking of her home in Luoyang. At exactly eight in the evening, she made the video call on time. On the screen, her father stood very straight, looking a little nervous. She first reassured him, restated the principle of gradual progress, and stressed that safety came first. With her mother helping to protect him, her father began the weight-shift training: feet shoulder-width apart, arms hanging naturally at his sides. First, he slowly shifted his weight to his left foot and held it for 10 seconds, then moved it back to center, then shifted to his right foot. She watched carefully and noticed that when he shifted to the left, his body tilted slightly to the right by about 5 degrees. She immediately stopped him and corrected his posture, asking him to slightly bend his knees, keep his upper body straight, and look forward. One set was 10 repetitions. After completing 3 sets, her father broke out in a sweat on his forehead. She recorded that the initial completion rate was about 65% (the left-shift movement was deformed twice, and the hold time was insufficient 3 times), encouraged her father that he had done very well, and told him that tomorrow was a rest day, so he could sit by the bed and get a better feel for the movement. Her mother was recording on the side, and her father promised that the whole family would watch tomorrow's hospital anniversary live stream. After the training ended, she continued reading for a few minutes.
location: Study, Room 601, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (remote connection to the home in Luoyang)

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: After the video call, Yu Xiaowen took a hot shower, applied a hydrating mask, then did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching on the yoga mat to relieve the soreness from sitting for long periods and tension during the day. Then she recorded two things in her diary: the rehearsal went smoothly, and her father's first rehabilitation training met the standard, but he leaned left by about 5 degrees, and the pass rate for maintaining the position was 60%. She placed the white coat, speech draft, and hospital badge she would wear the next morning by the bedside, and sent a WeChat message to Wang Fang to encourage each other. Lying on the mattress, she dimmed the light and did 10 minutes of mindful breathing meditation, focusing on her breath and emptying her mind. Then she picked up "Still Walking" again and read a few pages of Chapter 9 until she felt sleepy, and finally turned off the light at 22:30 and fell asleep, looking forward to the hospital anniversary celebration the next day.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, Room 601, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, 14 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning exercise, breakfast, and speech preparation.
description: After waking up early on Saturday, she changed into loose sportswear and practiced the modified Baduanjin in the living room for 25 minutes, focusing on the movements “Two Hands Holding Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner” and “Looking Back to Heal Five Strains and Seven Injuries” to stretch her body. After washing up, she had breakfast with warm milk, whole wheat bread, and a boiled egg, and took her ferrous sulfate tablets on time. Then she quietly rehearsed the opening of the hospital anniversary speech in front of the mirror, checked that the collar of the dark blue shirt under her white coat was neat, made sure the hospital badge was worn properly, and carefully placed the printed speech into a folder.
location: At home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Drove to the hospital and delivered a speech at the celebration of the hospital's 65th anniversary
description: She changed into commuting flats and drove along Jingsan Road and Jianshe West Road, playing Dvořák's “From the New World” overture on the way. After 15 minutes, she arrived at the underground parking garage of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. She then went backstage at the academic lecture hall and confirmed the program flow, stage positions, and PPT slide switching pace with the host. The celebration began at 8:30. After all hospital staff sang the hospital anthem, at 9:00 she came on stage as a representative of young physicians. Using her father Yu Jianguo's recovery story as an introduction and combined with clinical cases, she sincerely shared her journey and insights as a physician. Her speech received warm applause many times. The hospital anniversary celebration concluded successfully at 11:00 after the president's closing remarks.
location: Academic Lecture Hall, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Taking a photo with mother and sharing the joy
description: After the event ended, she found her mother, who was wearing a maroon coat, in the crowd and hugged her excitedly. Her mother praised her with red-rimmed eyes. She asked her colleague Wang Fang to take a precious group photo in front of the backdrop reading “65th Anniversary of the Hospital: Benevolent Heart, Skilled Healing, Wholehearted Service to the People,” then sent it to the “Happy Family” family group and made a video call to her father Yu Jianguo. On the call, her father grinned from ear to ear and praised her repeatedly.
location: In front of the celebration backdrop outside the academic lecture hall of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Went home, made lunch, and rested in the afternoon
description: Drove home. On the way, her mother shared the fresh walnuts and special homemade chili sauce she had brought from Luoyang. After arriving home, she used available ingredients to make a tuna avocado salad and garlic broccoli stir-fried shrimp. Mother and daughter chatted while eating about the details of the morning speech and the praise from colleagues. After the meal, she settled her mother for a nap in the second bedroom, went back to her own room, drew the curtains, noted her morning feelings in her phone memo, put on an eye mask, and napped for about 40 minutes to regain energy.
location: At home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Took an afternoon walk around the community with my mother.
description: After the noon break, the autumn sun was perfect. She changed into a coat with her mother and took a walk in Qunying Community. Sitting on a bench in the central garden, sunlight filtered through the leaves and cast dappled shadows. She reported in detail to her mother about her father's recent rehabilitation progress, such as steadier weight-shift training and a reduced left-leaning angle. Her mother nodded with relief, feeling much more relaxed.
location: Central garden inside Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Reading at home and reflecting on feelings
description: After walking home, her mother watched TV in the living room, while she went to the study to brew a pot of Jinjunmei tea, opened the essay collection "Still Walking," and read the chapter "The Unfinished Road." She was deeply moved, reflecting on her dual identity as a doctor and a daughter. With a fountain pen, she recorded in her diary the glory of the day and the warmth of family love, and wrote down her confidence in her father's recovery.
location: Home study, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Get ready and drive to Malt Badminton Hall.
description: Putting Still Walking back on the bookshelf, he changed into a royal blue quick-dry sports T-shirt and black sports shorts, put on professional badminton shoes, carefully organized his racket bag, confirmed the racket, water bottle, towel, and change of clothes, and sent a message to his badminton partner Lin Wei. Then he drove along the North Third Ring Road and Wenhua Road, arrived near the Maiya Badminton Hall in Jinshui District about 25 minutes later, parked, and walked briskly toward the hall in the autumn wind.
location: Maiya Badminton Hall, 130 meters southwest of the South Gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Played badminton doubles with playing partner Lin Wei
description: In Court C2 of Maiya Badminton Hall, she high-fived Lin Wei, who had already warmed up, to celebrate the success of her speech. They warmed up for 15 minutes with high clears and net shots, then formed doubles with two other players. With active movement and good coordination, Yu Xiaowen continuously hit beautiful precision smashes, winning loud applause. The intense one-and-a-half-hour match completely relieved her stress; she was drenched in sweat and radiant.
location: Court C2, Maiya Badminton Hall, 130 meters southwest of the south gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After showering, share a night-market dinner.
description: After exercising, she rinsed off and changed into dry clothes, then drove about 15 minutes to Yaozhai Night Market. With Lin Wei at the popular 'Luoyang Small Bowl Beef Soup' shop, she ordered two bowls of beef soup, two oil swirls, and a serving of grilled lamb skewers. They ate and chatted about work, life, and gossip. She shared the moment when her mother teared up during her morning presentation, and Lin Wei also joked about fun department anecdotes. Their friendship warmed over the good food.
location: Yaozhai Night Market Food, Seafood BBQ and Music Plaza (Jincheng Times Square Branch), Building 14, Yaozhai Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove home and received an encouraging phone call from my father.
description: Saying goodbye to Lin Wei at the night market entrance, she drove home alone along neon-lit streets, with soothing piano music playing in the car. After arriving home, she changed into loungewear and immediately answered a video call from her father, Yu Jianguo. Her father praised her speech again and proudly mentioned that colleagues who saw the hospital news all complimented his daughter. He also reported that the day’s weight-shift training made his right leg feel stronger. Yu Xiaowen asked for details, corrected his shoulder-shrugging problem, and agreed to continue video-guided rehabilitation at 8 p.m. the next evening. The call lasted nearly 50 minutes, and her heart was filled with warm love.
location: At home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Evening relaxation, reading, and bedtime preparation.
description: After the call, she organized the photos from the celebration that day, selected some, and uploaded them to the family cloud album. She took fruit out of the refrigerator, sat at her desk, and continued reading Still Walking. When she reached the final chapter, she wrote in her diary: “The best celebration is the smiles of family and the company of friends.” Then she did her evening skincare routine, applied face cream, and did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation, grateful for the wonderful day. Afterwards, she put the dirty clothes from her sports backpack into the washing machine, packed her commuting bag, and left only the warm yellow bedside lamp on. Seeing her father's message “Good night, you are our pride,” she replied with a hug emoji. At 22:30, she turned off the lights on time and fell asleep peacefully in the moonlight.
location: At home, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning: getting up, washing, and preparing breakfast
description: At 7:20, her phone alarm went off. Yu Xiaowen turned it off, stretched in bed, and enjoyed the leisurely pace of Sunday. After getting up, she weighed 49.3 kg, which was stable. After washing up, considering that it was cloudy and windy, she put on a hoodie and a windbreaker. Then she walked into the kitchen and saw her mother, Li Xiuying, heating up the leftover pepper soup from last night and frying dough sticks. Her mother smiled and said she knew Yu Xiaowen loved this, so she had gotten up early specially to make it. Yu Xiaowen washed some red dates and put them into the porridge, and chatted with her mother while bringing breakfast to the table.
location: Bedroom, bathroom, and kitchen, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Having breakfast with parents and clearing the dining table
description: During breakfast, her father Yu Jianguo sat at the dining table and skillfully drank hulatang with his left hand, showing he was recovering well. The family chatted while eating. Her mother mentioned the lively hospital celebration last night, and her father, uncharacteristically, praised Yu Xiaowen a few times; the atmosphere was relaxed and warm. After the meal, Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to gather the dishes and wash them in the kitchen, while her mother wiped the table. She casually mentioned wanting to take a walk along the Jinshui River in the afternoon; her mother echoed the idea, and her father nodded silently.
location: Dining room and kitchen, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Edited and published a gratitude Moments post for the hospital anniversary.
description: Yu Xiaowen leaned on the living room sofa, opened her phone album to organize photos from yesterday's hospital anniversary celebration, and selected a group photo with her mother in front of the backdrop, a close-up of her speech, and a photo of the 'Zhengzhou Central Hospital 65th Anniversary' logo. She carefully edited the text, sharing how honored she was to speak as a young doctor representative, and thanked the hospital for its trust and her family for their support. After posting, her friends Zhang Jing, Sun Yue, Wang Fang, and others liked and commented one after another. She sat on the sofa replying to each one, feeling delighted.
location: Living room, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Accompanying father in rehabilitation exercises and chatting with family
description: Father Yu Jianguo was doing his daily stretching exercises in the rehabilitation corner of the living room. Yu Xiaowen walked over and guided him through fine hand movements and shoulder relaxation. She played soothing classical music on her phone to help him focus, and kept encouraging him: 'Dad, you're doing great, a little better than yesterday.' After the exercise, the family rested and chatted in the living room. Mother Li Xiuying mentioned how Yu Xiaowen had spoken at the hospital anniversary celebration, her eyes full of pride. Father listened quietly, nodding occasionally, enjoying the peaceful Sunday late morning.
location: Living room, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Made a small pottery gift for a colleague's son.
description: Yu Xiaowen took out her tablet to play a pottery tutorial video, and also took out polymer clay and tools to make a three-dimensional little sheep pottery ornament for her colleague Wang Fang's son. Although her technique was unpolished, she enjoyed the focused creative process.
location: Living room, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Lunch and a brief music break at noon
description: At lunch, her mother prepared stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised fish, and tomato and egg soup. At the dinner table, Yu Xiaowen shared amusing stories from her department, and the family enjoyed the meal happily. After the meal, she turned on the stereo to play Paganini's violin pieces, curled up on the sofa, and took a short nap of about 20 minutes to store up energy for the afternoon activities.
location: Dining room and living room, Building 2, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Autumn afternoon stroll along the Jinshui River
description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen returned to her room, changed into white sneakers, took her thermos cup and noise-cancelling headphones, checked her phone, and said goodbye to her parents before leaving. She walked along Qunying Road via Jingqi Road for about 20 minutes to reach the Jinshui River trail at the intersection of Jinshui Road and Jingqi Road. Sunlight streamed through the clouds, the autumn breeze was slightly cool but the air was fresh, and the plane trees on both banks of the river were golden, full of autumn atmosphere. She strolled eastward along the trail for about 1 kilometer, pondering plans such as the attending physician exam, paper revision, and next month's volunteer activities, and felt that her life was fulfilling. Then she walked back home slowly along the same route. The whole trip took about 1.5 hours, covering about 5 kilometers.
location: Jinshui River footpath at the intersection of Jingqi Road and Jinshui Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Family dispute: Father wanted to return to Luoyang; discussion and reconciliation via video.
description: After her walk, Yu Xiaowen returned home and saw her father sitting alone in the living room, lost in thought. Her father suddenly suggested that he and her mother wanted to go back to their hometown in Luoyang for a while. Her heart sank, and she felt the loneliness of being abandoned. She hurried back to her room, closed the door, and called her brother Yu Xiaofeng on WeChat video, anxiously telling him about it, her voice choked with tears, worried that she could not handle work and exam preparation alone. Her brother comforted her and promised to help persuade their parents. After hanging up, Yu Xiaowen returned to the living room, squatted in front of her father, and gently begged him to wait a little longer—until she passed the attending physician exam. Her father's eyes turned red, and he finally nodded in agreement not to mention going back to their hometown for now. Her mother also breathed a sigh of relief. When the atmosphere eased, Yu Xiaowen went into the kitchen, cut up Fuji apples, put them in a glass bowl, and brought them to her parents. Her father finally smiled.
location: Living room, bedroom, and kitchen, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Helping my mother prepare dinner
description: After the family dispute subsided, Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to go into the kitchen to help her mother pick and wash vegetables and prepare ingredients for dinner. Her mother planned to make oil-splashed noodles and cucumber salad. The mother and daughter chatted about everyday things while working, and her mother reminded her not to overwork herself.
location: Kitchen, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Have dinner with the family
description: At dinner, the family sat around the table in a harmonious atmosphere. Yu Xiaowen deliberately put food on her father's plate, and her mother had made a soup he loved to drink. At the table they talked about her work schedule for next week and funny stories about her brother. Her father spoke little but had a good appetite, which made her feel much more at ease.
location: Restaurant, Building 2, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Browsing medical information in the evening.
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen helped her mother clear the dishes, then returned to the living room and turned on the TV, but her mind was not on the program. She browsed medical forums and read two latest papers from Henan Medical Research, mentally warming up for the evening study session.
location: Living room, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Focused on preparing for the attending physician exam.
description: At eight o'clock in the evening, Yu Xiaowen sat down at her desk in the bedroom on time, opened the review materials for the attending physician exam in Internal Medicine, and focused on reviewing the differential diagnosis of pulmonary infections. While reading, she drew a mind map in her notebook and marked key points. She took a five-minute break in the middle, stood up to drink water and stretch her neck, then continued studying with concentration.
location: Bedroom, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Wrote a diary entry to record today's mood.
description: After studying, Yu Xiaowen took out her diary and recorded the day's feelings: the lingering warmth of the hospital anniversary speech, the interactions on Moments, the autumn tranquility of the Jinshui River, and the not-so-small family disturbance and reconciliation. At the end of the diary, she wrote: 'Life may have ups and downs, but home is always my harbor.'
location: Desk in the bedroom, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening stretching and relaxation
description: Before going to bed, Yu Xiaowen did a simple full-body stretching routine on the yoga mat in her bedroom, focusing on her neck, shoulders, and lower back to relieve the fatigue from sitting for long periods and walking. While stretching, she listened to a soothing piano piece, gradually relaxing her body and mind.
location: Bedroom, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Skincare before bed
description: After brushing her teeth and washing her face, Yu Xiaowen put on a hydrating mask. Lying on the sofa with the mask on, she replied to a few messages from friends. The fatigue in her body gradually eased under the cool mask, making her feel at ease.
location: Bathroom and living room, Building 2, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Went to bed and fell asleep.
description: At nearly 11 p.m., Yu Xiaowen lay in bed and, in the darkness, recalled the emotional ups and downs of the day: from joy to anxiety to reassurance, and ultimately the love and support of her family. She silently said to herself, 'Xiaowen, keep going, everything will be fine.' With this gratitude, she gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning warm-up jog, stretching, and breakfast preparation
description: The 6:30 alarm went off. Considering the low outdoor temperature (5-14), Yu Xiaowen put on a windbreaker and gloves and jogged for 25 minutes on the walking path in Qunying Community to keep warm. After finishing, she returned home, stretched for 10 minutes, boiled water, and made a cup of warm ginger tea to ward off the cold. Then she took a quick shower, changed into work clothes, ate a bowl of oatmeal and a boiled egg for breakfast, put her work badge, lunch box, and review materials into her commuter bag, checked the car keys, and got ready to leave.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting by car while reviewing exercise anatomy
description: Yu Xiaowen drove from Qunying Residential Area to Zhengzhou Central Hospital at 7:30, taking about 16 minutes. In the car, she played her own recording from the ACE Health Coach course about "post-stroke rehabilitation training," and focused on reviewing the anatomical basis of ankle control to prepare for the day's work.
location: On the way by car: Qunying Road, Tongbai North Road, Zhengzhou Central Hospital

name: Getting ready for work and department morning shift handover.
description: After arriving at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Yu Xiaowen parked the car, changed into her white coat, quickly went through the night shift handover records, focusing on the overnight conditions of several patients including Grandpa Wang, and marked with a red pen the muscle strength and balance functions that needed focused assessment today. She then attended the department morning meeting on time. The doctor on duty reported on the department's patients, and attending physician Li Wei highlighted the key cases of the week. Yu Xiaowen took careful notes and, after the meeting, briefly reported to Teacher Li her new ideas about Grandpa Wang's rehabilitation plan, which were recognized.
location: Rehabilitation Department doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning rounds and assessment of key patients
description: Following attending physician Li Wei on morning rounds, Yu Xiaowen proactively performed a physical examination on Uncle Wang at his bedside, focusing on assessing sitting balance and weight-bearing capacity of the affected lower limb. She found that insufficient ankle dorsiflexion and eversion strength were the key factors affecting weight-bearing stability.
location: Bed 15, Rehabilitation Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Plan adjustment and rehabilitation prescription communication and entry
description: After ward rounds, Yu Xiaowen, in the doctors' office, added elastic band resistance training to Uncle Wang's rehabilitation plan based on what she had learned in the ACE course, to strengthen ankle dorsiflexion and eversion control, and adjusted the angle of the weight-shift training. She then went to the rehabilitation therapy room, found therapist Zhang Xiaodong, took out an anatomical atlas, and explained in detail the anatomical principles and key points of the new exercises. Zhang Xiaodong said the plan was very professional. After returning to the office, she entered the new prescription in the electronic medical record and noted the basis for the adjustments.
location: Rehabilitation department doctor's office and rehabilitation treatment room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch and handling financial matters
description: Yu Xiaowen went to the cafeteria on the basement level of the hospital and chose a light set meal. During the meal, she called her financial advisor Wang Mingyuan, clearly expressed her intention to adjust the monthly automatic fund investment plan (adjusting the monthly amount and adding a stable fund), and asked about the feasibility and operational details of setting up a dedicated savings account for a 500,000 yuan housing fund. The two parties reached a preliminary agreement.
location: Basement level 1, cafeteria, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and medical literature reading
description: After lunch, Yu Xiaowen returned to the department lounge. She first spent half an hour reading a study on functional electrical stimulation for post-stroke ankle motor control impairment, comparing it with her own new plan and finding it very inspiring; then she closed her eyes and rested for 30 minutes.
location: Department break room, 10th floor, Surgical Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Observe the training effect of the new plan.
description: After starting work in the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen went straight to the rehabilitation therapy room, where therapist Zhang Xiaodong was training Uncle Wang. After completing two sets of new movements, Uncle Wang said his affected leg felt stronger and his sitting transfers were steadier than yesterday. Yu Xiaowen and the therapist exchanged thoughts, agreeing that the effect was positive, and she noted in her notebook: "The first application of sports anatomy has proven effective."
location: Rehabilitation Treatment Room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon: medical record documentation and case discussion.
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the office and began handling other patients' medical records. During this time, she consulted Dr. Liu Qiang about neural mobilization for a patient recovering from cervical spine surgery.
