location: Room 203, Building 6, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commuting to the hospital by car
description: She picked up her commuting bag and the USB drive containing the PPT for today's sharing session, went downstairs, and drove off. Friday morning rush hour traffic was slightly heavier than usual, but she was used to it. She drove west along Qunying Road, Jingsan Road, and the Nongye Road elevated road, arriving at the hospital staff parking lot smoothly in about 15 minutes.
location: From Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Department morning meeting and pre-round preparation
description: Yu Xiaowen arrived at the department on time and changed into her white coat. At the morning meeting, the doctor on duty reported on newly admitted patients and key patients during the night. After the meeting, she quickly reviewed the medical records of all patients under her care, briefly discussed the focus of today's ward rounds with her supervising teacher Li Wei, and made preparations in advance.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Routine ward rounds
description: Followed Dr. Li Wei on routine ward rounds. Yu Xiaowen carefully reported the overnight status of each patient (including Uncle Wang) and today's rehabilitation assessment data. Dr. Li Wei gave detailed guidance on treatment plans. She noticed that Uncle Wang's ankle dorsiflexion range of motion had improved significantly compared to last week, and she felt happy for him.
location: Rehabilitation Medicine Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Department professional learning sharing session: The doctor's pursuit of excellence
description: After the ward rounds, Yu Xiaowen used the 10 minutes before the sharing session to go to the meeting room and check the projection equipment, the slide clicker, and the computer connection. She plugged the USB drive into the computer, opened the carefully prepared PPT, and confirmed that the content and animations on every page were flawless. Then the monthly professional learning meeting started on time. She calmly stepped onto the podium and, with the book "Better" as its core, combined with her father Yu Jianguo's rehabilitation experience and the changes in her mindset along her medical career, gave a talk titled "How Doctors Protect Themselves While Protecting Others." She elaborated from three dimensions: identifying and coping with professional burnout, building a self-care system, and balancing doctor-patient relationships. Her language was sincere and her cases were vivid. After the sharing, Director Zhang Lei commented on the spot: "This is the warmest professional learning sharing this year." Her colleagues gave warm applause. After the meeting, her supervising teacher Li Wei said to her privately, "You have changed a lot. Last year you were still asking me whether you should change departments, and now you can teach others how to balance."
location: Conference Room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning medical work
description: After the sharing session, Yu Xiaowen returned to her workstation and began handling the medical orders after ward rounds and writing progress notes. During this time, she received the family member of a newly admitted patient and patiently explained the initial rehabilitation plan and precautions. Around 11:30, she received a WeChat voice message from her mother, Li Xiuying. Taking advantage of the time while getting water, she briefly replied with the good news that the morning sharing session had been very successful.
location: Doctor's office and wards, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch at the hospital cafeteria and chatting with colleagues
description: She ran into Wang Fang, who was also off work, in the cafeteria, and they ate together. They took their trays and sat down in a corner. Wang Fang excitedly congratulated her again on the success of her morning presentation. Yu Xiaowen smiled in response, feeling relaxed. After the meal, they took a walk in the hospital's small garden to help digestion.
location: Staff cafeteria and small on-site garden, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Noon break and ACE Health Coach course review
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the duty room and rested on the folding bed for about 20 minutes. After recharging her energy, she took out her phone, opened the ACE Health Coach course app, and systematically reviewed the models and strategies related to 'behavior change' from Unit 2 that she had studied yesterday, building up her knowledge for the upcoming exam.
location: On-call Room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon medical work and difficult case discussion
description: In the afternoon, she began processing discharge medical records and participated in a difficult case discussion hosted by Dr. Liu Qiang. The case was a rehabilitation patient after complex fracture surgery. She took careful notes and offered her own insights. Afterwards, she went to the rehabilitation treatment area to observe the treatment process of several patients and briefly communicated with rehabilitation therapists about the patients' recent rehabilitation progress.
location: Doctor's office and rehabilitation treatment area, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-work commute and buying flowers
description: Yu Xiaowen briefly tidied her desk, said goodbye to the colleagues who were still working overtime, and left work. Instead of going straight home, she drove near the community, parked in front of a flower shop on Qunying Road, got out, and carefully picked a bouquet of chamomile with a faint fragrance, hoping this small gift would ease the atmosphere when meeting Wang Fang in the evening and show her sincerity.
location: From Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to the flower shop on Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return home to freshen up and change clothes.
description: After arriving home, she changed into more comfortable casual clothes, put the chamomile in a vase, and took a photo. Meanwhile, she sent a WeChat message to her father Yu Jianguo, telling him that she would video call him later that night. Then she confirmed the restaurant location Wang Fang had sent, which was a Sichuan restaurant they had often visited before.
location: Room 203, Building 6, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drive to the restaurant to keep the appointment
description: Yu Xiaowen went downstairs a bit early and drove off to the restaurant she had agreed on with Wang Fang. Because it was Friday evening rush hour, although the distance was not far, traffic lights and traffic flow made the drive take about 25 minutes.
location: From Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Shuxiangyuan Sichuan Restaurant at the southeast corner of the intersection of Yihe Road and Wenhua Palace Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reconciliation dinner with Wang Fang
description: Yu Xiaowen arrived at the Sichuan restaurant a few minutes before the agreed time. As soon as the two met, the atmosphere was more relaxed than expected. Wang Fang took the initiative to bring up last month's argument over scheduling, candidly saying that she had been a little impulsive at the time and apologizing to Yu Xiaowen. Yu Xiaowen replied that she had also been somewhat stubborn, and gave Wang Fang the bouquet of chamomile she had brought. The two instantly broke the barrier, hugged warmly, and completely reconciled. During the meal, Yu Xiaowen talked about her preparation plan for the attending physician exam. Wang Fang listened seriously and solemnly promised to serve as her accountability partner, saying with a smile that she wanted to be part of all Yu Xiaowen's major events. The two ate and chatted, and the atmosphere was warm and precious.
location: Shuxiangyuan Sichuan Restaurant, southeast corner of the intersection of Yihe Road and Wenhua Palace Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Returning home
description: After saying goodbye to Wang Fang, Yu Xiaowen drove home. She felt especially relaxed and content because the friendship had been repaired, and she even hummed a tune. After arriving home, she drank some water and rested for a while, then adjusted her mindset to prepare for a video call with her father.
location: From Shuxiangyuan Sichuan Restaurant at the intersection of Yihe Road and Wenhua Palace Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Room 203, Building 6, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Remotely guiding her father's rehabilitation training
description: She immediately made a video call to her father, Yu Jianguo. Seeing that he looked in good spirits on the screen, she first asked how today's "wall-supported heel raises" had gone. Father proudly demonstrated them and said it felt steadier than yesterday. She patiently corrected a small problem with his center of gravity slightly off while standing, encouraged him to keep it up, and agreed to check again tomorrow evening.
location: Room 203, Building 6, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (video call)

name: Review for the attending physician exam and write diary entries
description: She made a cup of hot tea and sat down at the desk. She first focused on reviewing the latest guideline chapter on stroke rehabilitation from the attending physician exam materials, and did a few practice questions to consolidate her memory. Afterward, she opened her diary and wrote about the day's work and reflections, especially recording the comments from Director Zhang and Teacher Li after the sharing session, as well as the joy of repairing her friendship with Wang Fang. She wrote down the day's mood keywords: "recognized, reconciled, fulfilled, new beginning."
location: Study, Room 203, Building 6, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Relax before bed and prepare for sleep.
description: She did a simple evening skincare routine and used a foam roller to relax her calves after this morning's run. Once in bed, she scrolled through the WeChat messages from her best friend Sun Yue about tomorrow's City Walk plan and replied briefly. Then Yu Xiaowen turned off the bedside lamp and, feeling recognized, with her friendship repaired and her heart full of warmth and a sense of accomplishment, soon fell into a sweet sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 203, Building 6, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning Baduanjin, assistance with settling in, and breakfast
description: Woke up at 7 in the morning. Since there was frost outside and the temperature was low, she decided to practice Baduanjin in the living room. While practicing, Yu Xiaowen chatted with her father Yu Jianguo, asked how he was resting, and guided him through upper-body stretching exercises. Afterward, she helped her mother organize her father's clothes and books into the guest room and adjusted the bedside lamp. The family sat around the table for breakfast; her mother had made millet porridge, poached eggs, and side dishes. Yu Xiaowen suggested taking her parents to get familiar with the neighborhood, and her father readily agreed.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Inspection of heating facilities and adjustment of the rehabilitation environment.
description: Yu Xiaowen checked the radiator valves in the living room and guest room, confirmed normal heating, room temperature 22 and humidity 45%. She adjusted the humidifier in her father's rehabilitation area to ensure a comfortable training environment. Her father praised her for being thoughtful.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Answer the exhibition invitation and complete ticket purchase and financial confirmation
description: Just as Yu Xiaowen was about to buy tickets, she received a call from her pottery teacher Zheng Guodong, who warmly invited her to participate in the annual works exhibition Between the Earth and proposed creating a series of works. Surprised and delighted, she accepted and agreed to discuss it in person that afternoon. Later, in her study, she selected Area A, Row 8, Seat 6 for the Beethoven special concert through the Henan Art Center platform, paid 380 yuan, and saved the e-ticket. She then confirmed that her November salary had been credited and that 2,000 yuan had been automatically transferred into her housing fund, recording the first housing fund deposit.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Guiding father through brief rehabilitation adaptation
description: Yu Xiaowen demonstrated and guided her father through seated balance and ankle pump exercises in the living room, repeating each movement 10 times as a warm-up before going out. Her father performed the movements correctly without discomfort. Xiaowen praised his improvement and encouraged him for the afternoon walking training.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drive to the pottery studio
description: Yu Xiaowen put on a thick coat, took her handbag and studio keys, and drove to the Artists' Park on Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District. The roads were clear, and after about 25 minutes she parked in the public parking lot outside the park and walked to the “Between the Clay” pottery studio.
location: Between Clay Pottery Studio, 1st Floor, Building 2, Artist Park, Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Discussed the exhibition plans with Teacher Zheng and began making the zodiac ceramic plate.
description: Yu Xiaowen discussed the zodiac series exhibition plan in detail with Teacher Zheng Guodong and showed him the design sketches for the rabbit and dog zodiac ceramic plates. Teacher Zheng suggested adding traditional scrolling grass patterns, and they scheduled Monday, Wednesday, and Friday afternoons to work in the studio. She then began making the first rabbit zodiac ceramic plate: she threw and kneaded the clay, shaped the plate on the wheel and trimmed the edge, and outlined the rabbit with a carving knife, with Teacher Zheng guiding beside her. After finishing, she covered it with plastic sheeting to air-dry naturally.
location: Between Clay Pottery Studio, 1st Floor, Building 2, Artist Park, Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch
description: Yu Xiaowen had lunch at 'Jianweifang', a small restaurant outside the campus, ordering mushroom chicken rice and seaweed egg drop soup, costing 20 yuan. During the meal, she sent a WeChat message to her best friend Su Ya to discuss the meeting time for next weekend's pottery market.
location: Jianweifang Bistro, outside the Artists' Park, Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Complete the drying of semi-finished pieces and discuss the next steps for the creation
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the studio, sprayed the surface of the ceramic plate with a spray bottle, and covered the edges with a damp towel to control the drying speed and avoid cracking. She made a creation schedule in her phone memo: trimming the clay body on November 16, glazing on November 18, and so on, and briefly discussed with Teacher Zheng to confirm the follow-up arrangements.
location: Between Clay Pottery Studio, 1st Floor, Building 2, Artist Park, Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Walk home, check the heating upon arrival, and keep mother company.
description: Yu Xiaowen changed into sneakers and walked home from the studio, passing through an old residential area and resting briefly on a bench in a neighborhood park to enjoy the winter sunshine; the walk was about 3 kilometers. At home, she changed into loungewear, checked the heating valve and humidifier water level, then went to the kitchen to help her mother pick greens. They chatted as she asked how her mother felt about living there. Her mother said she was used to everything, but missed Luoyang fermented soybean noodles.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Guiding my father in comprehensive rehabilitation training.
description: Yu Xiaowen laid out a rehabilitation mat in the living room and guided her father through weight-shift exercises and resistance band training (three sets each of standing rows and seated rows), correcting shoulder external rotation compensation. Then she took her father's arm and went with him to the open area in the community downstairs, encouraging him to walk independently. Her father walked about 120 meters without assistance, slightly breathless but happy. Xiaowen recorded the data: independent walking distance increased to 120 meters, weight shifting 90%, balance improved.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Rest, prepare dinner, and have dinner together
description: After the training, Yu Xiaowen let her father rest on the sofa and handed him warm water. She watered the small potted plants in the balcony rehabilitation area and sorted through photos. Her mother cooked, and Yu Xiaowen helped prepare. For dinner, her mother made hulatang, pan-fried hairtail, hand-torn cabbage, and steamed buns. The family ate and chatted. Her father mentioned that the tenant in the old house in Luoyang had moved out, and her mother needed to go back next week to clean up. Xiaowen offered to drive her, but her mother politely declined and decided to take the high-speed rail. The meal was filled with laughter.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Writing a diary and reading for study
description: Yu Xiaowen made some lemon water and wrote in her diary in the study. She recorded the financial details: concert ticket 380 yuan; first installment of 2,000 yuan into the home-buying fund received; and her father's rehabilitation data. She reflected that both art and medicine require careful crafting. Afterwards, she read the chapter “Please Slow Down When Parting” from the essay collection “Still Walking” and was deeply moved.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with best friend Zhang Jing.
description: Yu Xiaowen video-called her best friend Zhang Jing, sharing her feelings about her parents' temporary stay and her father's walking progress. Zhang Jing teased her, telling her to treat her parents to a nice meal, and suggested going to Bishagang Park tomorrow afternoon to see the ginkgo leaves, agreeing to a City Walk. The two chatted for half an hour.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Soaking feet to relax, recording expenses, and washing up
description: Yu Xiaowen poured hot water and added bath salts to soak her feet, wore Bluetooth earphones to listen to Debussy's "Moonlight", and rested with her eyes closed. Her mother helped pull the door shut. After soaking her feet, she took out her accounting book to update the home-purchase fund details, and wrote in her phone memo the plan for tomorrow: review Chapter 5, Coronary Heart Disease, for the attending physician exam in the morning, and go on a City Walk with Zhang Jing to see ginkgo trees in the afternoon. Then she washed up, applied night cream, and changed into pajamas.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Yu Xiaowen leaned against the headboard and continued reading the remaining chapters of 'Still Walking'. After closing the book, she reflected, 'Life always has that little bit of too late.' She charged her phone, set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, and marked the afternoon City Walk on her calendar. Turning off the light and adjusting her sleeping position, she reviewed the day's images: her father's back, the rough shape of the clay pot, her mother working, and silently said to herself, 'Today was a full and loving day,' and gradually fell asleep.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning home routine
description: Early Sunday morning, Xiaowen woke to the sound of her alarm. Outside the window, the sky was faintly light and the air was crisp and cold. She first drank a cup of warm honey water, then washed up and said "Good morning" to herself in the mirror. Then she spread out her yoga mat in the living room, opened her phone and followed along with a Baduanjin video. The movements were slow and stretching, and after finishing the set, her body felt slightly warm. Next, she used a foam roller to carefully roll and relax the front and back of her thighs, calves, and back to ease muscle tension. After exercising, she cooked oatmeal with milk, paired it with a boiled egg and a kiwi. After a simple and nutritious breakfast, she changed into comfortable casual sweatshirt and jeans, checked her bag, and brought a thermos, power bank, first-aid training teaching aid list, and a collection of essays, preparing for the day's activities.
location: Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove to Dongming Community
description: Xiaowen drove her white sedan from her home on Jingsan Road, headed north on Jingsan Road, turned left onto Hongqi Road, and with smooth traffic and the morning news on the radio, arrived at the Dongming Community Party-Mass Service Center building in about 15 minutes.
location: Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province; Dongming Community Party-Mass Service Center, 100 meters west of the intersection of Dongming Road and Hongqi Road, Jinshui District

name: Community first aid training
description: In the activity room on the third floor, Xiaowen set up two manikins and explained in detail to more than thirty elderly community residents the hand position, depth, and rate (100–120 compressions per minute) for CPR, as well as the key points of the Heimlich maneuver using the 'scissors, rock, paper' method. After the theoretical explanation, she guided residents in small groups to practice on the manikins. One elderly man was pressing too fast; Xiaowen smiled, held his hand, and chanted the rhythm to help him find the pace. At the end of the training, Aunt Li, the community director, presented her with a bouquet of handmade crepe-paper flowers on behalf of the residents, thanking her for her professionalism and patience.
location: Activity Room, 3rd Floor, Dongming Community Party-Mass Service Center, 100 meters west of the intersection of Dongming Road and Hongqi Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return home after training and lunch break
description: After the training, Xiaowen and Aunt Li exchanged WeChat contacts and agreed to hold a chronic disease management health lecture next month. Then she carefully put away the mannequins and teaching materials and drove back to her home on Jingsan Road. After arriving home, she quickly cooked a bowl of sour soup dumplings, using the method her mother taught her of stir-frying seasonings in oil to make the soup base, and adding seaweed and dried shrimp; it was delicious. After eating, she rested briefly on the sofa, scrolled on her phone for a while, and stored up energy for the afternoon activities.
location: Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Trip to the pottery workshop.
description: After the afternoon nap, Xiaowen drove along the east section of Longhai Expressway, turned onto Shangcheng Road, and went to the 'Between the Clay' pottery studio in the Artist Park on Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District. After arriving, she changed into a work apron, took the 'Rabbit No. 1' bisque piece she had made the day before from the drying rack, first used a trimming knife to carefully trim the edge of the plate bottom to make its curve smooth and regular, then switched to a fine needle pen and, concentrating with bated breath, carved fur textures on the rabbit's body. Su Ya next to her was making a wheel-thrown vase, and the two quietly exchanged views on glaze effects. Midway, Teacher Zheng Guodong came over to check, praised the lines as lifelike, and suggested making the ears more three-dimensional. During this, Xiaowen received a call from her good friend Sun Yue. She walked to the rest area to answer it. Sun Yue shared funny stories from the children's hospital and her busyness writing medical records. Xiaowen responded jokingly, and they chatted for about 20 minutes. After finishing trimming, Xiaowen placed the piece back on the drying rack, marked '1116-Rabbit' on the bottom with a marker, carefully cleaned the trimming knife and the clay slurry on her hands, packed up her belongings, and drove to Bishagang Park to meet her friends.
location: Between Clay Pottery Studio, Building 2, Artists' Park, Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Visited Bishagang Park with Zhang Jing.
description: Xiaowen met Zhang Jing at the north gate of Bishagang Park and gave her a big hug. The 4 p.m. sunlight cast dappled shadows through the golden ginkgo leaves, and the ginkgo forest on the south side was breathtakingly beautiful. The two strolled along the woodland path, stepping on the thick layer of fallen leaves, and took many goofy photos. Zhang Jing shared amusing stories about the kids in her class, while Xiaowen talked about her feelings about learning pottery and the community training that day. When they got tired of walking, they sat on a bench by the lake, shared the hot milk tea Zhang Jing had brought, and enjoyed a leisurely weekend moment.
location: Inside the north gate of Bishagang Park, 31 Jianshe East Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Take Zhang Jing home and buy groceries.
description: As it was getting late, Xiaowen and Zhang Jing left the park. She drove Zhang Jing to the entrance of her community on Ruhe Road, Zhongyuan District, and they agreed to meet again next week. Then, Xiaowen remembered there were not many vegetables left in the fridge, so she drove to the Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store at 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, and bought fresh garlic sprouts, spinach, a piece of soft tofu, and a bag of her mother's favorite Luoyang local brand hairtail fish, spending about 35 yuan in total.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Go home for dinner and have a video call with parents.
description: Xiaowen returned to her home in Qunying Community, changed into loose loungewear, put the groceries into the refrigerator by category, and sent her mother a voice message saying she had bought hairtail. She tied on an apron and started making dinner: stir-fried spinach with garlic, and hairtail pan-fried until golden and crispy on both sides, served with rice—all home-style dishes she had grown up eating. While eating dinner, she opened WeChat to video call her parents and reported that the community training had finished smoothly and that the pottery rabbit plate had completed trimming. She deliberately held up the fried hairtail to the camera, and her mother praised her for frying it better than she herself could. Her father chimed in from the side that his rehabilitation training had improved again today. Seeing her father looking so hale and hearty, Xiaowen felt at ease.
location: Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening study and home-buying planning.
description: After dinner, Xiaowen opened her laptop in the study, logged into the Beike app, and entered the information on several small apartment listings in Jinshui District she had saved over the past few days into an Excel spreadsheet by price, area, and layout. She focused on comparing two listings with similar total prices, and used a calculator to simulate the monthly payment for a 30-year commercial loan. She decided to save an extra 500 yuan per month into her home-buying fund starting next month. Then she closed the spreadsheet, took out the "Internal Medicine" attending physician exam study guide, and turned to the section on "Classification and Treatment of Coronary Heart Disease." She carefully reviewed the key points for distinguishing stable and unstable angina, made brief notes, and completed 10 multiple-choice questions from the accompanying exercise book. After checking the answers, she corrected her mistakes and prepared to ask her colleague Wang Fang about a test point on thrombolytic therapy for myocardial infarction on Monday at work.
location: Study room, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime
description: After the class ended, Xiaowen sat at her desk and opened her diary to record the day's weather, the sense of accomplishment from the community training, the flow experience while trimming the clay, and the joy with Zhang Jing under the ginkgo tree. She ended by writing: "I'm very tired today, but very satisfied. It feels great to work hard for life. Good night." Then she filled a basin with hot water, added lavender essential oil, and soaked her feet while playing Debussy's "Clair de Lune" on her phone, closing her eyes to feel the warmth. Afterward, she did some simple leg stretches and carefully applied moisturizing face cream and eye cream. Leaning against the headboard, she browsed the essay collection "Still Walking" and read a delicate passage about family and time. She also browsed Xiaohongshu for pottery bloggers' glaze pairing ideas and saved a screenshot of the "ice crack glaze + sky-blue" combination she liked. Near 11 PM, she turned off the main light, leaving only a warm yellow night light. She reflected on the fulfilling day, adjusted her sleeping position, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Morning warm-up and morning jog.
description: After the alarm went off at 6:25, I did a 5-minute dynamic warm-up at home in Qunying Residential Community, including ankle circles, shoulder stretches, and lunge leg presses. Then I walked to Zhuchunyuan Park, jogged 3 kilometers at a pace of 7 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer, keeping heart rate around 145 bpm. After running, I used a foam roller to relax the back of my right calf.
location: Zhuchunyuan Park, intersection of Qunying Road and Suoling Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Go home, wash up, and have a quick breakfast
description: Returned home in Qunying Residential Community, quickly took a hot shower, and changed into a white coat and uniform. For breakfast, ate a prepared whole-wheat bread sandwich with cheese slices and hot milk. Meanwhile, replied to two WeChat messages on her phone and confirmed that the Heimlich maneuver teaching PPT for the evening at Nanyang Road No. 2 Primary School was error-free.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Driving commute and online learning.
description: Drove from Qunying Community to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. On the way, I listened to the ACE Health Coach course audio via Bluetooth in the car, focusing on the content combining exercise nutrition and anemia management.
location: En route from Qunying Road in Jinshui District to Tongbai North Road in Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Department morning meeting and fire safety training sign-in.
description: Attended the department morning meeting in the rehabilitation department's doctors' office, listened to the night shift handover report, and noted the conditions of key patients. Teacher Li Wei informed her that the originally scheduled rehabilitation assessment for the key patient had been rescheduled to tomorrow. Then she went to the entrance of the first meeting room on the third floor of the administrative building, signed the paper attendance sheet for fire safety training together with colleague Wang Fang, and received the Fire Safety Knowledge Handbook.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Rehabilitation Department doctors' office and the entrance to the First Conference Room on the third floor of the administrative building, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Fire safety knowledge lecture
description: Attended a fire safety knowledge lecture in the first conference room on the third floor of the administrative building of Zhengzhou Central Hospital. The hospital safety officer systematically explained the characteristics of hospital fires, electrical fire prevention, initial fire suppression theory, and key points of evacuation and escape. While listening with Wang Fang, they marked key points in the manual and agreed to hold the first formal report of the study supervision plan that evening.
location: First Meeting Room, 3rd Floor, Administration Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and teaching preparation
description: I ate tomato and egg noodles and stir-fried vegetables alone in the staff cafeteria for lunch. After the meal, I used a tablet to do a final review and fine-tuning of the Heimlich maneuver teaching PPT for Nanyang Road No. 2 Primary School, focusing on optimizing the interactive steps of the 'rock-paper-scissors' mnemonic in the demonstration section.
location: Staff Canteen, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday nap
description: During the lunch break, she rested with her eyes closed on the sofa in the rehabilitation department doctors' on-call room for half an hour. Although she did not fall asleep, she felt her spirits and physical strength recover, storing up energy for the afternoon drill and evening teaching.
location: Doctor's on-duty room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Hands-on fire drill
description: She walked ahead of time from the administration building to the square in front of the outpatient building to meet up with Wang Fang and colleagues taking part in the drill. Starting at 14:00, the instructor first demonstrated how to use a dry powder fire extinguisher. Yu Xiaowen was the first to step forward and operate it, successfully putting out the simulated oil pan fire and earning approval. Then a fire evacuation drill was held; covering her mouth and nose and bending low as instructed, she quickly and orderly evacuated to the safe area.

name: Glaze adjustment at the pottery studio.
description: She drove from the hospital to the Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio in Guancheng Hui District. On the way, she told Su Ya via WeChat that she would arrive around 16:40. After arriving, under the guidance of teacher Zheng Guodong, she fine-tuned the glaze formula based on the water absorption rate of the rabbit plate bisque, adding a little milky white glaze to the sky-blue glaze, and repeatedly tested the thickness and running effect to achieve a warm, matte finish.
location: Building 2, Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Elementary school first aid teaching
description: Drove from the pottery studio to Nanyang Road No. 2 Primary School in Jinshui District, arriving at 17:25. Met with the director of academic affairs and went to the multifunction hall to debug the PPT and props. At 17:35, began teaching fourth-grade students the Heimlich maneuver, opening with questions, using the "scissors-rock-paper" mnemonic to break down the movements, inviting students to the stage to practice on the mannequin, and rewarding a girl who performed well with cartoon band-aids. The principal observed the entire class and later invited her to teach wound dressing to fifth-graders next month.
location: Multifunction Hall, First Floor, Teaching Building, Nanyang Road No. 2 Primary School, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and returning home
description: After the teaching ended, I quickly ate a bowl of beef flat noodles and two sesame flatbreads at the Xiao Li Family Noodle House near the school to replenish my energy. After the meal, I drove back to Qunying Community, arriving in a few minutes.
location: “Xiao Li’s Noodle House” at the intersection of Nanyang Road and Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Health management summary and sharing
description: After returning home and changing into pajamas, she opened her laptop to organize three weeks of diet diary and iron supplementation records. In Excel, she summarized the conclusion that energy improved by about 30%, dizziness basically disappeared, but there was occasional stomach discomfort from the iron supplement. She made a simple chart, took a photo, and sent it to her best friend Zhang Jing, receiving a warm reply. Then, as agreed, she sent a voice message to Wang Fang, reporting that she had completed the Coronary Heart Disease chapter in this week's attending physician review plan.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Guide her father through rehabilitation via video call.
description: Had a video call with her father Yu Jianguo, shared group photos from the day's fire drill and first aid teaching, guided her father through 15 minutes of seated balance and elastic band resistance training, praised his progress, reminded him to take his medication on time, and decided to change the iron supplement to every other day to observe whether the stomach discomfort improved.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (video call)

name: Review for the attending physician examination
description: At the desk at home, reviewed the "Coronary Heart Disease" chapter of Internal Medicine, marked key points with a highlighter, drew the diagnostic flowchart from memory, completed 15 supporting practice questions with an accuracy rate of about 87%, and conducted focused analysis and note-taking on the unstable angina knowledge points involved in the wrong questions.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Reading to unwind
description: After finishing her studies, she read the novel "Still Walking" in the bedroom recliner for about half an hour, enjoying the plain but healing daily life narrative of a family, and relaxing her body and mind.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Washing up, skincare, and going to bed
description: Before bed, soaked her feet in hot water with a few drops of lavender essential oil to relieve fatigue, and applied a sleeping mask for facial care. After getting everything ready, she set her phone alarm for 6:25 the next morning, turned off the lights and went to bed, and fell asleep peacefully after reviewing her fulfilling day.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Building 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Morning wake-up and reading
description: The alarm rang. Feeling her body slightly heavy from the residual iron supplement from the previous day, she completed Baduanjin as planned on the living-room mat and used a foam roller to carefully relax her right calf and back. She heated milk, toasted two slices of whole-wheat bread, and scrolled through her phone while eating breakfast. Seeing an article about wearable rehabilitation devices on the 'Frontier Rehabilitation' official account, she was drawn to a new gait-monitoring insole and immediately thought of her father. She read the article carefully and forwarded it to her friend Zhou Haoran, a rehabilitation therapist, with the note: 'This gait monitoring might be usable for my father—can you help me take a look?' Then, remembering the new routine of taking the iron supplement every other day, she took a ferrous sulfate tablet with a glass of orange juice, hoping to ease her stomach discomfort.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Commute Preparation and Driving to Work
description: After changing into the neatly ironed winter white coat and dark trousers, she put on a thick down jacket and checked her commuter bag (wallet, keys, phone, power bank, and an apple). Seeing light fog outside the window, she decided to go downstairs early to warm up the car. Driving west along the Nongye Road elevated road, she connected her phone to the car stereo via Bluetooth and played the audio "Attending Physician Exam Intensive Lecture: Cardiovascular System" stored on Ximalaya, focusing on the section "Pharmacological Treatment of Arrhythmias." While listening, she reviewed the coronary heart disease content from yesterday's study. After about 20 minutes of driving, she arrived at the hospital parking lot.
location: Driving from Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, along the Nongye Road elevated road, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Department morning meeting and shift handover.
description: She walked quickly into the rehabilitation department doctors' office in Building 6 for the 8 a.m. morning meeting. The night-shift doctor reported the overnight ward situation, and she carefully took notes. Teacher Li Wei emphasized that cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases are more common in autumn and winter, so attention should be paid to the assessment of newly admitted patients. After the meeting, she exchanged a glance with her colleague Wang Fang, silently sensing that a busy day was about to begin.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation, Building 6, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Key ward rounds and patient assessment
description: I followed Teacher Li Wei on ward rounds; the core task was to assess Uncle Wang, a patient with sequelae of cerebral infarction. I carefully reviewed his past medical records, imaging, and assessment reports, assisted with bedside evaluations of muscle strength, balance, and ADL ability, reassured the somewhat anxious family members in a gentle tone, and recorded Uncle Wang's chief complaint of numbness in his right limbs. The entire assessment lasted nearly two hours, and I took three pages of detailed notes. I plan to formulate a rehabilitation plan based on this in the afternoon.
location: Rehabilitation Department Ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Handled paperwork and communicated with newly admitted patients.
description: Back in the office, she opened the HIS system to enter Uncle Wang's assessment results and also backfilled the daily progress notes for the other inpatients. She briefly discussed with Wang Fang the diagnostic approach for the patient with suspected vestibular dysfunction she had seen in the morning. At 10:50, she went to the bedside to give admission counseling to a newly admitted patient after rotator cuff surgery, taking a medical history and explaining the postoperative rehabilitation process and its importance.
location: Rehabilitation Department doctors' office and ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: She went with Wang Fang to the staff cafeteria, chose braised beef noodles with greens, and ate quietly by the window. After the meal, she walked alone in the small garden in the hospital compound, breathing the cool, overcast air and letting her mind briefly go blank. At 12:40 she returned to the duty room, put her phone on silent, lay on the cot, reviewed the morning's assessment details and the afternoon work list, and gradually fell into a light sleep with a sense of planning.
location: Staff cafeteria, in-hospital garden, and rehabilitation department duty room at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon work: rehabilitation guidance and document sorting
description: After the alarm rang, she washed her face with cold water. She first went to the treatment hall and, under the guidance of Dr. Liu Qiang, assisted a patient after knee replacement surgery with passive motion on the CPM machine and quadriceps isometric contraction training. She then returned to the office and focused on completing the initial rehabilitation assessment report and rehabilitation goal setting for Uncle Wang, printed it out, and prepared to discuss it with his family the next day. In between, she answered several calls from family members asking about patients, and also processed some examination orders for newly admitted patients. At 17:00, she organized and archived the medical records of the patients discharged that day.
location: Rehabilitation Department treatment hall and Rehabilitation Department doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Bought groceries on the way home from work
description: Changed into a down jacket, said goodbye to Wang Fang who was still working overtime, and drove home. In the light fog, the evening darkened faster. Detoured to the Qunying Road convenience vegetable store at the entrance of the community, bought two tomatoes, a box of soft tofu, and a bunch of scallions, planning to make tomato tofu soup for dinner.
location: Drove from No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, back to Jinshui District, shopped at the Qunying Road Convenience Vegetable Store at No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and then returned to Qunying Community.

name: Complete critical illness insurance enrollment online
description: After arriving home, she changed out of her work clothes into a casual hoodie, opened her phone, and checked once more the plan recommended by financial advisor Wang Mingyuan: 500,000 yuan in coverage, with an annual premium of 4800 yuan paid in 12 installments. Sitting at the desk, she opened the insurance company's official app, read the health declaration line by line, confirmed that conditions such as thyroid nodules and occasional stomach discomfort were not among the items asked about, and selected 'No' for all. After entering her personal information and bank card number, she wrote her father Yu Jianguo's name without hesitation in the designated beneficiary field. After paying the first month's premium of 400 yuan, she received the electronic policy, effective at midnight the next day. She took a screenshot and sent it to the family group 'Yu Family Courtyard' to inform her parents; her mother replied with a thumbs-up emoji, and her father replied, 'Okay, got it.'
location: At her desk at home in Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening yoga class and the trip to and from
description: Changed into a sports bra and leggings, with a loose trench coat over the top, and walked about 5 minutes as a warm-up to Jingxin Yoga Studio. Wang Fang had already saved a corner spot. The class began with 10 minutes of abdominal breathing and meditation, followed by shoulder and neck stretches; the stiffness from sitting at a desk all morning gradually melted away. During the final relaxation, she briefly 'dozed off' for a few seconds. After class, she talked with Wang Fang and shared how breathing techniques helped stabilize her emotions. Wang Fang jokingly called her the 'meditation ambassador.' They left the studio together, said goodbye at the intersection, then she wrapped her coat tightly and walked back through the night.
location: Walked from Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Jingxin Yoga Studio on the second floor at the northwest corner of the intersection of Jingsan Road and Fengchan Road, and returned along the same route after class.

name: Evening studying, family phone calls, and relaxing before bed.
description: After getting home, she quickly removed her makeup, took a hot shower, and changed into fleece pajamas. Sitting down at her desk, she opened the 'Yikaotong' question bank app, selected 25 cardiovascular system practice questions, and completed them in 15 minutes with full concentration, scoring 72%. She copied the 3 wrong questions related to 'arrhythmia medication' into her mistake notebook and marked them with '?' to remind herself to ask Teacher Li Wei the next day. At 21:30 she made a WeChat video call to her father, Yu Jianguo. Seeing that he looked well, and learning that in the afternoon, accompanied by her mother, he had walked 150 meters with a cane in the residential complex—30 meters more than yesterday—she was very pleased. She encouraged him to keep it up and reminded him to do ankle pump exercises. Her father briefly asked about the insurance matters. After hanging up, she boiled hot water for a foot soak, added a mugwort foot bath bag, curled up on the sofa, and quietly read Still Walking. When the water cooled, she poured it out, applied a hydrating mask, checked tomorrow's commute bag, and put in an umbrella. She turned off the main light, leaving a bedside lamp on, reviewed the day's work achievements, the reassuring feeling of adding protection for her family, and the relaxation of her body, and fell asleep peaceful and calm.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Wake up, wash up, have breakfast, and get ready to go out.
description: After the alarm went off in the morning, Yu Xiaowen felt drowsy because she had gone to bed too late the night before, so she canceled her morning run. She got up, washed up, applied moisturizer, put on casual pants and a knit top, and checked her backpack to make sure the umbrella, power bank, and mistake notebook were all there. Then she microwaved milk and frozen buns, and boiled an egg. While eating, she checked the weather on her phone (cloudy turning clear, 4–13°C), and jotted down "slow jog along Jinshui River in the evening" in her memo. After eating, she put on her coat, picked up her car keys and commuter bag, and got ready to leave.
location: Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Listened to course audio while commuting by car.
description: Yu Xiaowen drove from Qunying Community, taking the Nongye Road elevated road to Zhengzhou Central Hospital. In the car, she played an ACE health coach course audio on "Mechanical Analysis of Running Posture". She paid special attention to the concepts of "vertical oscillation" and "ground contact time" and decided to put them into practice during her evening run.
location: Along the route from Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou.

name: Attend the department's morning shift handover meeting
description: After arriving at the hospital, Yu Xiaowen changed into her white coat and attended the rehabilitation department morning meeting on time. The doctor on duty reported on the condition of all patients overnight, and Director Zhang Lei emphasized focusing on the newly admitted patients with post-stroke sequelae in the morning. Yu Xiaowen quickly noted down the precautions for the patients in the beds she was responsible for.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning ward rounds and handling medical orders
description: After the morning meeting, Yu Xiaowen followed Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds, focusing on evaluating Uncle Wang, a patient in the recovery phase of cerebral infarction, observing limb function and speech recovery, and communicating the day's rehabilitation plan with the family. After rounds, she returned to the office, placed examination orders and adjusted medications in the HIS system according to the doctor's orders, and wrote the admission record for the newly admitted patient.
location: Rehabilitation Department Ward and Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and inform family of the insurance decision.
description: At the hospital cafeteria, Yu Xiaowen ordered a tomato and egg rice bowl and seaweed egg drop soup. While eating, she replied to friend Zhang Jing's messages and scrolled through her Moments. After lunch, she sent screenshots of the key clauses of the critical illness insurance electronic policy she had purchased last night to the family group chat to inform her parents and older brother. Her mother Li Xiuying replied with a hug emoji, her father Yu Jianguo gave a thumbs-up, and her older brother Yu Xiaofeng shared a smart door lock link reminding her to be safe. Seeing her family's interaction, she felt warm.
location: Staff cafeteria and office of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Lunch break and review of wrong questions
description: After returning to the office, Yu Xiaowen rested with her eyes closed for 15 minutes on the camp bed in the on-duty room. After the alarm went off, she took out her mistake notebook, quickly reviewed the cardiovascular practice questions she had gotten wrong last night, marked the confusing points next to the questions, and prepared to ask Teacher Li Wei in the afternoon.
location: Doctor's duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: In the afternoon, handled newly admitted patients and organized medical records.
description: In the afternoon, she first performed a rehabilitation assessment on a patient after knee replacement surgery, then completed the medical record documents left unfinished in the morning. Around 15:00, she seized a free moment to ask Teacher Li Wei about a difficult issue regarding the use of ACEI drugs in cardiovascular diseases. After the teacher explained, it all became clear to her, and she quickly noted the key points.
location: Department of Rehabilitation, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Left the hospital to go to the pottery studio
description: Yu Xiaowen tidied her workstation, changed into casual clothes, and drove away from the hospital. She went east along Jinshui Road, turned onto Shangcheng Road, and headed to the pottery studio in Guancheng District. Soft classical guitar music played in the car as she organized her thoughts for her pottery creation, preparing to fine-tune the consistency of the glaze.
location: Along the route from Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Artists' Park, Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pottery creation: glaze testing and greenware trimming
description: After arriving at the Nitu Zhijian Ceramics Studio, Yu Xiaowen greeted Teacher Zheng Guodong and put on an apron. She checked the bisque pieces of her parents' zodiac ceramic plates, continued mixing sky-blue glaze and milky-white glaze, testing the blend ratios on test pieces and recording the formulas. Then she used a small carving knife to refine the fur texture on the rabbit plate, making it finer and softer.
location: Nitu Zhijian Pottery Studio, Artists' Park, Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove back home
description: After cleaning up the tools and saying goodbye to Teacher Zheng, Yu Xiaowen drove back to Qunying Community in Jinshui District. There was some traffic on the way, but she felt calm. After arriving, she parked the car downstairs.
location: Along the route from Artists' Park, Shangcheng Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Changed clothes, got ready, and walked to Jinshui River.
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen changed into a quick-dry sports T-shirt, leggings, running shoes, and a windbreaker, drank some water, put on a sports armband and wireless earphones, and after a little preparation walked to the start of the Jinshui River Trail (Jingsan Road to Huayuan Road section).
location: From Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to the starting point of the Jingsan Road section of the Jinshui River Trail.

name: Jogging along the Jinshui River to practice running form
description: After doing some simple dynamic stretches on the Jinshui River trail, Yu Xiaowen started jogging. She deliberately slowed her pace and consciously focused on cadence and core stability, applying key points from the 'Pose Method' she had learned from the audio this morning, and felt less impact on her knees. The air by the river was fresh. She ran for about 35 minutes, worked up a light sweat, and felt relaxed in both body and mind.
location: Jinshui River Trail, from Jingsan Road to Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Met a colleague during post-run stretching and bought fruit together.
description: After the run, Yu Xiaowen stretched beside a bench on the riverbank and ran into her colleague Wang Fang. The two chatted about interesting things in the department and next week's schedule, then went together to the nearby Chengxin Fruit Supermarket. Yu Xiaowen picked tangerines and red-fleshed dragon fruit, while Wang Fang bought cherry tomatoes and apples. At checkout, they agreed to take a yoga class together next week, then said goodbye at the store entrance, and Yu Xiaowen walked home.
location: Beside the bench on the Jinshui River trail, Jingsan Road section, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, and near the adjacent Chengxin Fruit Supermarket

name: Prepared dinner and guided her father's rehabilitation via video.
description: After returning home, Yu Xiaowen made tomato and egg noodles. While waiting, she made a video call to her father. She watched her father practice heel raises against the wall, carefully explained the key points of slowly lowering his heels, and encouraged him. Her father reported that he had walked 160 meters with a cane that day, 10 meters more than yesterday. She was very happy. After hanging up, she enjoyed her dinner.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Organizing rehabilitation department medical records in the evening
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowen cut an orange and brewed rose tea, then sat at her desk and opened her computer to organize the admission assessments of two post-stroke rehabilitation patients. She pulled up the imaging reports and assessment scales, cross-referenced the review "Timing of Early Rehabilitation" in the Chinese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine, highlighted key conclusions and data points with a highlighter, and wrote a clearly structured case analysis to prepare for tomorrow's group discussion.
location: Study at home in Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up, soaking feet, and relaxing
description: After finishing work, Yu Xiaowen took a hot shower and changed into loungewear. She boiled hot water, poured it into a foot bath bucket, and added a mugwort foot bath bag. While soaking her feet, she used a massage gun to relax her calf muscles and applied a hydrating facial mask, letting both her body and mind fully unwind.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Reading and preparation before bed
description: After soaking her feet, Yu Xiaowen applied body lotion, turned off the main light, turned on the bedside lamp, and leaned against the headboard to read a short passage from 'Still Walking'. The story was quiet and warm, and she felt at peace. Then she set the alarm for 6:40 the next morning and put her phone on the nightstand.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Quarter, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drifting off to sleep.
description: After turning off the bedside lamp, Yu Xiaowen did abdominal breathing and reflected on the fullness of the day: smooth work, the insurance policy settled, progress in pottery, a refreshing run, and completed medical records. Her heart was filled with peace and contentment. In the faint light from the window and the slowing rhythm of her heartbeat, she gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Quarter, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning activities: getting up, Baduanjin, breakfast, and preparing to go out.
description: At 6:40 in the morning, your phone alarm went off. You got up quickly, washed up, changed into sportswear, and practiced Baduanjin attentively for 30 minutes in the living room to stretch your body. Afterwards, because you hadn't prepared ingredients in advance, you could only quickly have breakfast with the pork floss bread and plain milk from the fridge. Then you checked your commuting bag (medical records, power bank, earphones, and literature materials), changed into a dark blue knit top and casual pants, grabbed the car keys, and headed out.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Commute and arrival at the hospital
description: Drove a white Volkswagen Polo from Qunying Community, heading through Jinshui District to Zhengzhou Central Hospital; traffic conditions were acceptable. On the way, continued listening through the car's Bluetooth to the ACE Health Coach course audio 'Motivational Interviewing Techniques for Patients.' location: Driving from Jinshui District to Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (Qunying Road to Tongbai North Road)

name: Department morning meeting and routine ward rounds.
description: Attended the department morning meeting on time and listened to the night shift handover report. Then followed the supervising teacher Li Wei and other residents to begin routine ward rounds, focusing on the rehabilitation progress of several stroke patients with hemiplegia, and noted Teacher Li's new treatment plan for a patient with aphasia after cerebral infarction.
location: Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Returned to the doctor's office to process medical orders and write medical records for newly admitted patients. Took out two papers on “gait analysis of walking rehabilitation after stroke,” and organized thoughts in a notebook based on the case records sorted out yesterday, preparing for the afternoon group discussion. During this time, consulted the experienced Dr. Liu Qiang about medication dosage adjustment.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Went to the staff cafeteria with Wang Fang, specifically got stir-fried pork with black fungus and sautéed spinach, and chose fruit yogurt. Because the spinach was greasy, she rinsed it in hot water before eating. While eating, she used the 'Food Diary' app on her phone to take photos and record. Today was the day to take the iron supplement on alternate days, and after the meal she took out the small pillbox from her bag.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After lunch, bought a drink and talked with her father on the phone
description: Walked about 7 minutes to the Yuelai Yuexi convenience store near the hospital (Zhongyuan Middle Road branch), and took the iron supplement with the orange juice she had brought. Then she sent a WeChat message to her father to let him know she would be playing ball with colleagues tonight, and mentioned that a friend from Shenzhen working on AI algorithms might be able to give advice on smart devices for his postoperative recovery. Afterward, she walked slowly back to the hospital duty room.
location: Yuelai Yuexi (Zhongyuan Middle Road Branch) beside the south gate of Bo'ao Building, Zhongyuan Middle Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and on the way back to the hospital

name: Lunch break and relaxing to music
description: Returned to the quiet on-duty room, put on Bluetooth earphones to play Debussy's "Clair de Lune," and rested with eyes closed for about 30 minutes to conserve energy for the afternoon's work.
location: Duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Afternoon work, case discussion, and end-of-day wrap-up
description: In the afternoon, I made rounds on the key patients again and checked their training progress. After that, I returned to the office and imported the new literature into the rehabilitation AI research literature management software, tagging it 'Gait Analysis_2025'. At 15:25, the department group discussion began. When Teacher Li called on you, you walked to the whiteboard and clearly presented the stroke rehabilitation case, including admission assessment, goal setting, bottleneck analysis, and literature-based adjustment plans, which was well received. After the discussion, I handled miscellaneous tasks, checked fund gains to confirm this month's expenses were within budget, organized materials for tomorrow, and added a note in my work journal: 'Be mindful of viewing the combination of AI assistance and subjective assessment dialectically.'
location: Rehabilitation Medicine Department study room and doctors' office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After work, commuted to Qiaofei Badminton Hall.
description: Left the hospital on time after work and drove away. The evening rush hour was just beginning, so I chose the optimal route via navigation to Qiaofei Badminton Hall. On the way, I sent a WeChat message to Wang Fang to confirm whether Xu Tao had arrived.

name: Qiaofei Badminton Hall activity: warm-up, competition, and a lively discussion on rehabilitation AI
description: After arriving at the court, you changed into sportswear and stretched alone to warm up. Wang Fang and Xu Tao arrived one after another, and the three of you took turns playing doubles, with intense rallies. At one point, you made a diving save and won applause. After the game, you drank electrolyte water in the rest area beside the court. Xu Tao shared a project from a Shenzhen AI company that uses wearable devices for postoperative gait rehabilitation, saying that 'rehabilitation doctors will be in high demand in the future, and AI implementation needs clinical oversight.' You immediately recorded the inspiration in your phone memo: [2025.11.20 Sharing from sports buddy Xu Tao] Rehabilitation + AI: gait analysis, neurofeedback; recommend focusing on the combination of gait recognition and wearable devices.
location: Qiaofei Badminton Hall, near No. 56 Songshan South Road, Erqi District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Drove home
description: After saying goodbye to Wang Fang and Xu Tao, drove about 25 minutes and returned safely home to Qunying Community.
location: While driving from Songshan South Road, Erqi District, to Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Evening home tidying and socializing
description: After showering, she sat at her desk and transcribed the rehabilitation AI inspirations from her phone memos into her professional notebook, adding 'pay attention to the combination of gait recognition and wearable devices'. She sent a WeChat message to thank Xu Tao for sharing, and Xu Tao replied to keep in touch. Then she opened a real estate app to browse and save listings. She added a small apartment near a subway station in Jinshui District, with a total price of 780,000 yuan, to her favorites, took a screenshot, and sent it to her close friend Zhang Jing to discuss the location and environment of the community.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Soaking feet before bed, journaling, and reading to fall asleep
description: She boiled hot water to soak her feet and relieve fatigue, and at the same time wrote in her diary to record the fulfilling day and rehabilitation AI inspiration, emphasizing the groundwork for CPH exam preparation and her father's support. She planned to go teach at a primary school tomorrow Friday afternoon and set the alarm for 6:40 the next morning. After soaking her feet, she lay in bed flipping through a magazine, recalling the intersection of the badminton court and AI. After turning off the light, she gradually fell asleep with confidence in her career direction.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning run and stretching
description: The alarm went off. The weather forecast outside the window showed sunny with some clouds, 6–17°C, light breeze, a good day for morning exercise. Yu Xiaowen changed into sportswear, walked 5 minutes to Zhuchunyuan Park, and jogged 3 kilometers along the park trail. Her heart rate stayed at around 145 bpm, pace 7:35 per kilometer, and she felt good. After running, she did a serious 5-minute stretch, focusing on relaxing the back of her thighs, and felt her flexibility had improved compared with yesterday.
location: Zhuchunyuan Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Washing up, breakfast, and iron supplement
description: When she got home, she took a warm shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. Yesterday's breakfast had been too rushed, so today she was determined to make up for it. She took pre-sliced cooked beef, tomatoes, and tofu out of the fridge and made herself a steaming bowl of beef hulatang soup, sprinkled with chopped scallions and full of aroma. Since she had taken an iron supplement the day before, she skipped it today according to her habit of taking it every other day. While eating breakfast, she played the audio chapter on "client motivational interviewing" from the ACE Health Coach course on her phone to prepare for the upcoming exam.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Commute by car
description: She left on time at 7:50 and drove to the hospital. Traffic was smooth along the way, and the radio played light morning news. As she drove, she reviewed the several key patients she needed to focus on during today's ward rounds, especially the traumatic brain injury patient she had discussed with Teacher Li Wei yesterday.
location: On the way from Qunying Residential Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District.

name: Daily diagnosis and treatment in the rehabilitation department.
description: After arriving at the department, she first changed into a white coat in the changing room. At 8:00 she attended the department morning meeting on time. After the handover, she followed Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds. They focused on a patient with sequelae of traumatic brain injury. Based on the changes in the patient's muscle tone over the past two days, she discussed with Dr. Li and made fine adjustments to the gait training parameters; Dr. Li nodded in approval of her approach. After the rounds, she returned to the office to handle medical orders and wrote the admission record and rehabilitation assessment for a stroke patient admitted that morning.
location: Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prelude to midday rest
description: After finishing the medical records at hand, she glanced at her phone. Her mother had shared in the family group the mutton soup recipe she had just learned yesterday, along with several photos of rich white broth. She smilingly replied with a “want to eat” sticker and left a message: “I must try it when I come home this weekend!” Then, remembering the AI rehabilitation project she discussed with Xu Tao yesterday, she quickly jotted down a few key inspirations in her phone's memo.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: At lunchtime, she queued up in the cafeteria, chose a plate of stir-fried seasonal vegetables and tomato beef brisket, and sat down across from Wang Fang. As they ate, they chatted about the rehabilitation medicine AI forum to be held that evening. Wang Fang was very interested in the forum and asked her whether she would share notes afterward. Xiaowen readily agreed and shared some new trends she had heard from a friend the night before about wearable devices in gait analysis, which Wang Fang found fascinating.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital staff cafeteria, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Complete the ACE quiz.
description: Back in the break area, she didn't rest right away. Instead, she took out her tablet, opened the ACE course app, and quickly completed the after-lesson quizzes for two chapters. The questions covered exercise physiology and health behavior change models, 20 questions in total. She finished in 15 minutes and saw a score of 85 after submitting. Most of the wrong answers were concentrated on knowledge points about nutritional supplements. She took a screenshot and saved it, planning to focus on them during weekend review.
location: Rest area at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Going to the primary school.
description: Considering the parking problems near the school, she chose to ride her own electric bike. She changed out of her white coat, put on a light jacket, wore her helmet, and set off from the back gate of the hospital. After riding for about 15 minutes, she arrived at the gate of Nanyang Road No. 2 Primary School, twenty minutes earlier than the agreed time.
location: On the way from Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Nanyang Road No. 2 Primary School, Jinshui District

name: Pre-class preparation.
description: Found the coordinating head teacher, and under her guidance came to an empty classroom. She set out the teaching props she had brought, such as bandages, triangular bandages, and simulated wound stickers, and confirmed the teaching process again with the teacher to ensure that the children could master the most essential trauma bandaging skills within the limited 45 minutes.
location: Nanyang Road No. 2 Primary School, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (near the intersection of Nanyang Road and Qunban Road)

name: Trauma bandaging instruction.
description: The class bell rang, and the children were full of curiosity. Xiaowen first used vivid metaphors to explain the applicable scenarios and differences among circular bandaging, spiral bandaging, and figure-eight bandaging, and personally demonstrated simple fixation bandaging for hand bleeding and forearm fractures. Then she had the children practice in pairs, handing out bandages for them to wrap each other. The classroom immediately became lively; she moved among the desks, patiently correcting each student's technique and encouraging groups that did well to present on stage. The entire lesson ended amidst laughter and joy, and the children were still eager for more.
location: Classroom of Class 3, Grade 5, Nanyang Road No. 2 Primary School, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return to the hospital and wrap up work.
description: After saying goodbye to her supervisor, she rode her bike back to the hospital. Back in the office, she spent half an hour entering the medical records of the newly admitted patients from the morning into the system, and tracking the records of several patients whose treatment orders had been adjusted during rounds, ensuring no critical information was missed before leaving work.
location: From Nanyang Road Second Primary School, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to the Rehabilitation Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital at No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Personal growth and planning

Then she opened her phone to look at tonight’s forum guest list and agenda, and created a new folder named 'AI Rehabilitation Forum - 20251121' in her note-taking app in advance for later notes.
location: Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province
