Passing the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road, she stopped, quickly went in and bought a bunch of baby bok choy, half a jin of fresh shrimp, and a bunch of cilantro, planning to make a light bowl of shrimp and vegetable noodles for dinner.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, and then to home in Qunying Community

name: Dinner and equipment setup
description: Back home, she simply cooked a bowl of noodles with shrimp and greens. After eating, she moved her laptop to the desk in the living room, plugged it in, opened the meeting software to test it, and made sure the camera and microphone were working. Then she poured herself a glass of warm water and set her phone to Do Not Disturb mode, fully preparing for the upcoming online forum.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

description: At 19:00 sharp, the forum started on time. She listened attentively to the expert reports. When she heard the Tsinghua University team share the "fall risk prediction model based on gait recognition technology, with an accuracy rate as high as 92%," she immediately annotated in her notes "gait recognition + fall risk = high-value topic" and recorded in detail the model's accuracy, sample size, and core algorithm. Throughout the forum, she paused frequently to think and quickly jotted down her questions and inspirations.
location: Living room of the home in Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: After the forum, she was still eager for more and immediately organized her electronic notes into a structured format, extracting three research directions she was most interested in. Among them, she felt the direction of "using gait data to predict fall risk in Parkinson's patients" could be combined with the project Xu Tao had mentioned yesterday. She sent the organized key points and this idea via WeChat to Zhou Haoran, who was in Beijing. A few minutes later, Zhou Haoran replied that he thought the direction was very feasible and suggested designing a small observational study for initial validation. The two agreed to have a detailed voice discussion over the weekend.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Keeping in touch with family
description: Seeing her mother thinking of her in the group chat, she made a voice call to her mother. First she praised her mother's newly learned lamb soup, saying it looked especially great, and then chatted about today's interesting moments teaching elementary school students. At the end of the call, she asked about her father's recovery as usual. Learning that he had managed to walk another 200 meters today, she was very relieved and told him not to overdo it.
location: Home, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep stretching and skincare
description: After hanging up the phone, she felt some soreness in her shoulders and neck, so she did a 10-minute focused stretching session on the yoga mat in her bedroom, paying special attention to relaxing her upper back, shoulders, and neck. After stretching, she took a hot shower and then carefully completed her evening skincare routine, applying eye cream and moisturizing face cream.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Quarter, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Personal reading and rest
description: Lying in bed, she took out the book Still Walking and continued reading, enjoying the peaceful time before sleep. When she read something moving, she couldn't help thinking of her own parents, and a warmth surged in her heart. At 23:15, she turned off the bedside lamp, set the alarm for tomorrow morning, and slowly fell asleep while savoring the day's fulfillment and new knowledge.
location: On the bed at home, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning preparations and breakfast
description: Waking up to the alarm clock on Saturday morning, I opened the curtains to welcome the warm autumn sun and decided to skip the morning run to conserve energy. On the yoga mat in the living room, I did a 10-minute full-body stretch to wake up my trunk and joints. After washing up, I did a simple skincare routine and checked the items in my backpack: the pork floss cakes for my father, a thermos cup, and concert tickets. In the kitchen, I made a cup of warm milk oatmeal and ate it quickly with whole wheat bread. I double-checked that the car keys, phone, and emergency tools were all packed, turned off the water, electricity, and gas at home, and then headed out.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Driving to my parents' home in Luoyang.
description: At 7:30, she set off from Qunying Community, drove via the North Third Ring Road onto the Lianhuo Expressway, and headed toward Luoyang. Along the way she listened to local traffic radio, and her mood was as bright as the sunshine outside the window. After about 95 minutes of driving, she exited the expressway at Luoyang at 9:05 and drove into the familiar streets of Xigong District.
location: Lianhuo Expressway (Zhengzhou–Luoyang section)

name: Arrived at hometown in Luoyang and reunited with family
description: Pushing open the gate to her parents' small courtyard, she saw her father pacing under the persimmon tree with a walker, and her mother peeking out from the kitchen. She quickly stepped forward to hug her father and handed them the pork floss cakes she had brought. Her parents' faces showed gratified smiles. The house was warm and cozy, and the family had a brief, happy chat together.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Family Courtyard, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Lead father in rehabilitation exercises
description: She spread a yoga mat in the living room, played Baduanjin music, and led her father through slow practice starting with 'Two Hands Holding Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner.' Though his movements were slow, he tried hard to keep up and was very interested in 'Regulating the Spleen and Stomach by Raising One Hand.' After a short rest, she guided her father through lower-limb stretches for stroke rehabilitation, gently stretching his quadriceps and hamstrings while holding his legs, and exchanging feedback as they went. Her father said his legs felt much lighter and his spirits had clearly improved.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Family Courtyard, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Helping in the kitchen, family lunch, and saying goodbye.
description: I went into the kitchen to help my mother pick vegetables and peel garlic. As she chopped side dishes for the Luoyang water banquet, she grumbled about the trivial details of renting out the old house. I shared what I had heard at yesterday's online rehabilitation forum. My father was reading the newspaper on the living room sofa and occasionally joined in. The atmosphere was warm. At noon, my mother brought out sweet and sour pork tenderloin, a simplified Luoyang water banquet, and mutton stewed noodles. The three of us sat around the table and enjoyed the meal. My father actively picked up food for us. I kept my portions small to save room for dinner. After the meal, I rushed to clear the table and wash the dishes. My mother peeled an apple nearby and offered her reminders. We hugged goodbye and agreed to come back next week.
location: Room 101, Building 2, Family Courtyard, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Hit a tire problem unexpectedly on the way back
description: At 13:30, she set off by car from her parents' home, preparing to enter the Lianhuo Expressway. On Kaixuan Road, the right rear tire pressure warning light suddenly came on the dashboard. She calmly pulled over and turned on the hazard lights. Getting out to check, she found that the tire had been punctured by a screw and was obviously losing air; she confirmed that she could not replace the spare tire herself.
location: Service road of Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang

name: Waiting for and accepting roadside assistance
description: Called the insurance company to request roadside assistance, parked the car in a safe area and waited. In the meantime, drank a few sips of warm water and sent a message to a friend on her phone to let them know about the breakdown. About 45 minutes later the rescue vehicle arrived; the staff quickly replaced the spare tire and reminded her to drive at reduced speed.
location: Service road of Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang

name: Continued the journey back to Zhengzhou
description: Got back on the road at 14:45. Because the spare tire was speed-limited, I drove carefully at 80 km/h on the Lianhuo Expressway. Arrived home in Zhengzhou at 16:30, about an hour later than expected; fortunately, it was a close call but everything went smoothly.
location: Lianhuo Expressway (Luoyang-Zhengzhou section)

name: Returning home to rest and prepare for the concert
description: After entering, she took a hot shower to wash away the fatigue and dust of the journey. She changed into a dark blue dress, a white cardigan, and flat loafers, made a cup of honey water, had a few soda crackers for energy, then sat on the sofa and browsed the concert program on her phone, getting ready to leave with excitement.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

location: Grand Theater, Henan Art Center, 1 CBD, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Enjoying a Beethoven special concert.
description: The concert began on time. Under the highly intense performance of the Zhengzhou Philharmonic Orchestra, the courage and tragedy of the Coriolan Overture left one breathless; the deep and sorrowful melody of the slow movement of the Eroica Symphony made her eyes well up involuntarily. Images flashed through her mind of her father working hard at rehabilitation and the patients in the department fighting to live. When the piece ended, she stood up and applauded for a long time in tribute.
location: Henan Art Center Grand Theater Concert Hall, No. 1 CBD, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Returning home and relaxing with pre-bedtime memories
description: Walking out of the concert hall, the cool autumn night air hit, but the warmth in her heart lingered. After sitting alone in the car for a while, she drove home, softly humming a passage from Hero along the way, and arrived home safely at 22:35. After washing up, she lay in bed still not sleepy, opened the memo on her phone and wrote the reflection 'life itself is a hero,' posted it on Moments with a photo taken under the dome of the art center, recording this precious artistic baptism. She set tomorrow's alarm, reviewed the warmth and emotion of the day, and gradually fell asleep with satisfaction and peace.
location: Room 502, Unit 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning Baduanjin and a walk around the neighborhood.
description: After getting up in the morning, I did a session of Baduanjin at home, with gentle and focused movements. Then I put on a jacket and took two slow laps on the roads inside the residential community, breathing in the cool air to wake up my body.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Breakfast and professional reading
description: Returned home and made a simple breakfast with ingredients bought last night: millet porridge, boiled eggs, whole-wheat bread, and hot milk. While eating, she read the book Rehabilitation Medicine to prepare for tomorrow's work.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Went to Ruyi Lake for the appointment

We walked and chatted along the lakeside path, sharing my father's progress in Luoyang, the scary flat tire on the way back, and the overwhelming experience of the Beethoven concert. Zhang Jing talked about funny stories from her students and the pressure of exam preparation. When we got tired, we had hot lattes at the Paper Age Bookstore Café. Zhang Jing wants to get a cat, and you used your professional knowledge to help her analyze the habits, costs, and care issues of British Shorthairs and Ragdolls, and you were deeply engaged in the conversation.

name: Lunch with Zhang Jing.

location: Yufeng Bianjing Roast Duck (Fucai Road Branch), No. 9-1 Chenxu Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

After comparing three brands in detail, she copied the specifications and prices into an Excel spreadsheet. In the end, she fancied an OGAWA massage chair priced at 8,999 yuan, which had one-touch stretching and waist-and-back heating functions and was suitable for her parents. After hesitating, she added it to the shopping cart, planning to enjoy the discount on Double 12, and saved the link.

Then I took the plate to Su Ya to discuss the glaze color options for the cloud pattern at the center (sky-blue glaze or shadow-blue glaze), and we had an enthusiastic discussion about glaze combinations and the follow-up plan for the exhibition.

name: Morning run along the Jinshui River
description: Yu Xiaowen started from home and went to the trail along the Jinshui River for a slow jog of about 3 km, with a pace of 7 minutes 50 seconds and a heart rate of 142 bpm. Her colleague Liu Qiang handed her a cup of water and chatted briefly to help ease her nerves.

Yu Xiaowen confidently reported the diagnosis and treatment progress on behalf of the team and, inspired by last Friday's online forum, proposed the suggestion of "conducting a comparative study between existing assessment data and the AI gait assessment system." Director Wang Zhenhua thought the idea was forward-looking and valuable, but said the research sample and evaluation criteria needed to be clarified, and encouraged her to write a research plan first. Yu Xiaowen carefully noted down all the suggestions.

location: Ward 301, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

She ordered tomato beef brisket noodles with a fried egg, and the two chatted about research ideas while eating. After the meal, she bought a cup of sugar-free yogurt and returned to the duty room.

The training ended at 19:50, and the person in charge gave her a small pothos plant as a token of thanks.

participant.relation: Employee of the public welfare target unit

Her mother smiled and said, "Your father will definitely like it," and urged her to keep warm. Then at 11:50 she changed into a white coat and comfortable flat shoes, put a power bank, notebook, pen, and water bottle into her backpack, checked her father's medication records, and set an alarm for 1 p.m.

Then went to the rehabilitation therapy room and assisted Instructor Li Wei in guiding two stroke patients through upper-limb strength training and balance training, recording patient feedback. In between, briefly exchanged details about the yoga class with Wang Fang; Wang Fang said she would bring the meditation book.

After class, she shared her feelings with Wang Fang. Wang Fang showed her the newly bought 'The Miracle of Mindfulness,' and the two agreed to come and check in together.

The two agreed to do yoga and have late-night snacks together next week.

I felt warm-hearted.

name: Breakfast and sending gratitude messages
description: Cooked breakfast: made simple spicy soup (using instant soup mix plus tofu skin, vermicelli, peanuts, garnished with chopped scallions) and fried a poached egg. While eating, edited gratitude messages: first sent a long voice message to my parents, recalling their strength when my father was ill and expressing thanks; then sent a text message to my older brother Yu Xiaofeng in Shenzhen, thanking him for years of care and professional advice, mentioning the mini waterfall chart idea that came to me while running last night. After sending, drank a few sips of hot soup and felt my heart filled with love.
location: Dining room, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commute to the hospital
description: Packed her commuter backpack (with white coat, power bank, and lunch box), and took a folding umbrella. She went downstairs and drove from Qunying Road in Jinshui District, along Nongye Road and then turned onto Tongbai North Road, taking about 15 minutes in total. Light music was playing in the car. While waiting at a red light, she caught a glimpse of the heart emoji her parents had replied with on the phone screen, and smiled.
location: Drive from Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Morning meeting handover and WeChat thank-you to Teacher Li Wei
description: After arriving at the hospital, she changed into her white coat and entered the doctors' office. At 8:00 she attended the morning meeting on time. The night-shift doctor reported that a 76-year-old patient with hemiplegia after cerebral infarction had mild choking cough at night and had been treated. Yu Xiaowen noted the key points and confirmed the day's work schedule on the duty roster. After the morning meeting, she briefly chatted with her colleague Wang Fang. Wang Fang asked how she had slept last night, and she nodded and said fine. Then she opened WeChat and sent a thank-you message to her supervising doctor, Dr. Li Wei: "Dr. Li, Happy Thanksgiving! Thank you for your patient guidance in my research and clinical work all along. Last week you helped me optimize the case record format, which greatly improved my efficiency. Today I also want to show gratitude through action—this afternoon I will organize that batch of rehabilitation data. Thank you again!" A few seconds later, Dr. Li Wei replied with a thumbs-up emoji.
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Ward rounds and thanking Director Zhang Lei in person
description: She joined Director Zhang Lei and Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds. They focused on the spinal cord injury patient who had been agitated yesterday; the patient was emotionally stable, and Yu Xiaowen encouraged the patient to complete today's upper limb training. During the rounds, at 9:30, she met Director Zhang Lei in the corridor. She took the initiative to approach and said, 'Director Zhang, Happy Thanksgiving! Your recognition last Monday of my AI gait assessment proposal gave me more confidence to pursue in-depth research. I am truly very grateful to you.' Director Zhang Lei smiled and patted her shoulder, saying, 'Keep it up. Your ideas are very good.' She nodded, feeling encouraged.
location: Wards and corridors of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Medical record processing and paper data organization
description: After ward rounds, I returned to the office and turned on the computer. First, I handled medical orders: updated the medication plans for Bed 3 and Bed 5, and wrote two discharge summaries. Then I retrieved the detailed data of the 14 rehabilitation cases (8 stroke, 4 spinal cord injury, 2 post-fracture surgery) screened yesterday from the HIS system, classified and annotated them by Barthel Index in Excel, and prepared to insert a mini waterfall chart. During this, Wang Fang passed by; I asked her in a nosy way what her plans were for the evening, and she smiled and replied, "I'll be at home writing the chapter plan for my paper and will call you tonight."
location: Doctor's Office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Hospital Thanksgiving event, family group chat communication, and lunch
description: At 12:00 during the lunch break, Head Nurse Wu Min walked into the meeting room carrying a large bunch of carnations and said to everyone, "Happy Thanksgiving! One for each of you, thank you for all your hard work!" Yu Xiaowen took the pink carnation, was very moved, and immediately held Wu Min's hand and said, "Sister Wu Min, thank you for taking care of me all this time. This bouquet is so heartwarming!" Wu Min smiled and said she was glad she liked it. Afterward, Yu Xiaowen opened her phone and sent a 166 yuan red envelope (meaning everything goes smoothly) in the family group chat with the message "Grateful for family." Her mother replied instantly and initiated a video call. Yu Xiaowen held the carnation close to the camera; her mother praised how beautiful the flower was, and her father also waved happily. After talking for about 5 minutes, her mother said, "Go eat quickly." After hanging up, she walked to the cafeteria with Wang Fang. Today was Thanksgiving, and the cafeteria offered special dishes: beef stew with potatoes, stir-fried broccoli, and multigrain rice. Yu Xiaowen ordered one serving plus an egg drop soup. While eating, she praised Wang Fang for the helpful advice she had given yesterday, and Wang Fang waved her hand and said not to mention it. During that time, she also sent a separate WeChat message to her older brother Yu Xiaofeng: "Brother, Happy Thanksgiving! I already sent a voice message this morning, but let me add: thank you for accompanying me through this period at the hospital!" Yu Xiaofeng replied, "We support each other. Keep going, little sister."
location: Department meeting room and basement floor 1 of the hospital cafeteria, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon work: rehabilitation training, data organization, and new patient handling
description: At 13:30, I returned to the office to handle the afternoon's medical orders. From 14:00 to 15:00, in the rehabilitation training hall, I guided two stroke patients: for the hemiplegic patient, I did upper-limb training (shoulder flexion and extension) and balance training (sitting weight shifting), and recorded changes in the Barthel Index. From 15:00 to 15:40, I returned to the office and used the HIS to insert mini waterfall chart sketches for 14 cases; because time was tight, I decided to fine-tune them tonight. From 15:40 to 16:30, I handled a newly admitted patient's muscle strength assessment and medication, and finished writing the handover records. I tidied my desk, saved the unfinished paper's data files to a USB flash drive, and backed them up to the cloud.
location: Rehabilitation training hall, doctor's office, and ward, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Commute home from work and buying grain
description: She took off her white coat, picked up the carnations and her backpack, and set off from the hospital. She drove along Tongbai North Road, turned onto Longhai Expressway and Qunying Road, and arrived at the grain and oil store on Qunying Road after about 23 minutes. After entering the store, she confirmed that Wuchang rice had arrived, bought a 10-jin bag (39 yuan), and also bought a cucumber and a jin of tomatoes for fresh use at dinner. She chatted briefly with the shopkeeper about Thanksgiving, then carried the bags to the car, drove into the residential area, and parked.
location: Drove from 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, to the grain and oil shop at 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, and then to Qunying Community.

name: Dinner and rest
description: After returning home, she washed her hands and first made a fruit salad (cut the kiwi, banana, and half an apple bought yesterday, add a spoonful of yogurt and mix well). Then she cooked tomato and egg noodles: beat the eggs and add shredded ginger, quickly stir-fry the cut tomatoes until they release juice, add water, and put in the noodles. At the dining table, she turned on the speaker to play Bach's Cello Suite No. 1 (BWV 1007). While eating, she recalled today's little blessings of Thanksgiving. She finished eating around 17:45, cleaned up the dishes, then leaned back on the living room sofa with her eyes closed, listening to the complete BWV 1006 (first movement), while reviewing today's gratitude list in her mind: parents, brother, Li Wei, Zhang Lei, Wu Min, Wang Fang... She smiled unconsciously. She took out her phone and scrolled through social media for a while, saw a colleague from the same department post "Thanksgiving, the fairies of the department," with a picture of the carnations from noon, and gave it a like. Then she turned off her phone and prepared to move on to the next task.
location: Dining room and living room, Unit 501, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drafting the chapter outline for the paper's first draft
description: Opened the laptop and created a new Word document titled: Chapter Outline of Review of Typical Cases in Rehabilitation Medicine: Clinical Observations of AI Gait Assessment Based on the Barthel Index in Post-Stroke Rehabilitation. Wrote down: 1. Introduction/Literature Review (complete in the first week of December), 2. Methods and Subjects (second week of December), 3. Results (first week of December), 4. Discussion (second week of December). Then set weekly progress milestones (December 1: complete introduction and results; December 8: complete methods and discussion), and backed it up to the cloud.
location: Study room, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Communicated with Zhou Haoran on WeChat about the paper.
description: Sent Zhou Haoran a WeChat message: "Brother Haoran, Happy Thanksgiving! I just drafted the thesis chapter plan (screenshot attached). Could you see if the pacing works? Also, the mini waterfall chart idea I had during my run last night is embedded in Excel (I'll send you the raw data tonight). Do you think the key chart should go in the Results section or before the Discussion?" Zhou Haoran replied 15 minutes later: "The arrangement is reasonable. The mini waterfall chart fits in the Results section; presenting it sequentially would be more convincing. The plan is fine, so start writing - I'll wait for your first draft." After reading the reply, Yu Xiaowen copied it into the planning table.
location: Study room, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Read The Moon and Sixpence.
description: Switched to leisure mode. Took Maugham's "The Moon and Sixpence" from the bookshelf and turned to the bookmarked page, page 137, reading the passage about Charles painting in Paris. Immersed for 30 minutes, reading the story of the protagonist who was destitute yet determined in pursuing his dream. While reading, pondered: medicine and art share the same need for single-minded dedication. After finishing, placed the bookmark back and got up to prepare for bed.
location: Sofa in the living room, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: A grateful phone call with Wang Fang
description: She called Wang Fang. After the two exchanged greetings, Yu Xiaowen said, “Wang Fang, Happy Thanksgiving! That pottery cup I gave you (the trimmed piece made on November 23)—are you still using it now? Every time I see you drinking from it in the department, I feel it's my blessing to have made a friend like you.” Wang Fang laughed, “Of course I still use it! I look at it every day. Oh, by the way, influenced by you, I've recently started meditating 15 minutes every day too. My thoughts really are much calmer. Thank you for sharing such a wonderful method with me!” The two then chatted about hospital gossip. Wang Fang said the schedule showed they would be on the same night shift next week, and Yu Xiaowen said, “Then we'll bring late-night snacks.” At 20:30, they agreed to try the newly opened sour soup fish restaurant on the weekend (address: Jianshe East Road, Guancheng District). The call lasted until 20:38, and they said goodnight to each other.
location: Yu Xiaowen was in the bedroom of Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province; Wang Fang was at another location (communicating by phone).

name: Writing a diary and stretching before bed
description: After hanging up the phone, I opened the diary and recorded today's gratitude event list (parents' voice messages, Li Wei's praise, Zhang Lei's encouragement, Wang Fang's call, etc.). After writing, I stood up and did neck stretches on the yoga mat (15 seconds each in front, back, left, and right) and waist twisting exercises. Finally, I ended with three minutes of Baduanjin (only doing the Behind-the-Back Seven Tremors to Dispel All Diseases movement and the closing posture) to calm my emotions.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Study English terminology for rehabilitation medicine.
description: Took out the Anki flashcards (Neuroscience rehabilitation vocabulary) and learned 10 new terms: Proprioception, Kinematics, Gait cycle, Spasticity, Brace, Neuroplasticity, Myopathy, Contracture, Synovitis, Prognosis. Self-tested with the flashcards, accuracy rate 90% (missed 1: Kinematics). Recorded in the study notebook.
location: Study room, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Gratitude reflection and meditation
description: Sitting on the meditation cushion with eyes closed, she recalled every gratitude received or expressed today, from her parents' last voice message to Wang Fang's laughter. Scenes surfaced in her mind: her father's "Get well soon" sticker sent from Luoyang. She meditated for 10 minutes (Flux meditation app, audio guide "Gratitude Meditation"), then opened her phone photo album, sorted the carnation photos taken today, and set one as her phone lock screen.
location: Quiet corner, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up and skincare.
description: While squeezing toothpaste and brushing my teeth, a smile still lingered at the corners of my mouth. I took a quick shower, wiped my face with warm water, and applied essence water and face cream. While blow-drying my hair, I checked the items to bring tomorrow (MRI report, medical record template USB drive) and washed my lunch box. Then I changed into pajamas.
location: Bathroom, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, she read the section 'Washing dishes is washing dishes' (about 5 pages) from The Miracle of Mindfulness by Thich Nhat Hanh, and reflected on the small things to be grateful for in this day. After reading, she closed the book, turned off the light, set the alarm (6:40), and closed her eyes to sleep. She felt content and peaceful.
location: On the bed in the bedroom, Room 501, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Get up, wash up, and do some light activity.
description: Woke up naturally at 6:35 in the morning; the sky outside the window was faintly bright, and the heating brought a cozy feeling. After getting up, I washed up in the bathroom and, in front of the mirror, moved my neck that had become stiff from writing medical records. I felt light, and last night's sleep had been good.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Riverside morning run and stretching
description: Changed into sportswear and walked 5 minutes to the Jinshui River riverside trail. Ran 3 kilometers from the Weiwu Road Bridge to the Huanghe Road Bridge section, with a pace of about 7 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer and heart rate maintained at 140bpm. The air was crisp and the river reflected the morning sun. After the run, she stretched for 10 minutes on the viewing platform, focusing on relaxing her legs and shoulders and neck, which were tense from prolonged sitting.
location: Jinshui River Promenade along Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (section from Weiwu Road Bridge to Huanghe Road Bridge)

name: Shower, breakfast, and drive commute.
description: Returned home at 7:35, took a hot shower, and changed into a clean white coat and casual clothes. For breakfast, prepared milk oatmeal and kiwi, standing in the kitchen while eating and browsing medical news push notifications on my phone. Departed by car at exactly 8:00, heading to Zhengzhou Central Hospital via Jingsan Road, Jinshui Road, and Tongbai North Road, successfully avoiding the morning rush hour, and parked before 8:20.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: Morning shift handover and department preparation
description: After putting on the white coat, attended the morning handover in the rehabilitation department doctors' office. The night-shift colleague reported on the ward patients' conditions, and Director Zhang Lei emphasized the key matters of the day. After the meeting, organized the medical records of newly admitted patients and mentally reviewed the assessment process.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: New patient assessment in the Rehabilitation Department
description: At 8:50, I took the assessment scale to Bed 5 and measured the range of motion and muscle strength grade of a 62-year-old woman who had undergone knee replacement surgery, explaining the importance of early rehabilitation exercises in plain language. Then I went to Bed 7 to assess a middle-aged man after glioma surgery, focusing on limb function and cognitive status, comforting the anxious family members, and giving detailed instructions on the rehabilitation plan.
location: Rehabilitation Ward (Bed 5, Bed 7), Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Organize assessment records and write medical records.
description: Returned to the office, opened the HIS system, entered the first assessment data for two new patients, wrote admission records and rehabilitation treatment recommendations, and worked focused at the computer for an hour.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Hospital lunch and socializing with colleagues
description: At 12 o'clock, she sent a WeChat message to Wang Fang to meet at the staff canteen. They each picked their meals; Yu Xiaowen ordered the tomato beef brisket set meal. As they ate and chatted, Wang Fang again confirmed the weekend dinner time. Yu Xiaowen smiled and said it was set for tomorrow at 11:30 a.m. at the sour fish soup restaurant — be there or be square.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital Staff Canteen, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch Break and Research Data Organization
description: After lunch, she went to the teaching room to rest. Instead of taking a nap right away, she took out her tablet, opened the reference management software, entered the preliminary data of the new patient into an organized Excel spreadsheet, and quickly browsed the abstract of a recent article on the Barthel Index, finding it very inspiring for her research ideas.
location: Demonstration Room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Prepare materials for the orthopedic consultation
description: After a short rest, she returned to the office to organize the materials needed for the afternoon orthopedic consultation. She printed the imaging reports and medical record excerpts for the fracture patient, and marked in her notebook with a red pen the anatomical questions she wanted to ask the orthopedic doctor, hoping time would allow.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Orthopedic cross-department consultation.
description: At 13:50 sharp, she arrived at the orthopedic ward for the multidisciplinary discussion and listened to Dr. Liu analyze the healing status and surgical condition of the multiple fractures (pelvis and femur). When it was her turn to speak, she asked about the anatomical mechanics of passive ankle and hip motion after internal fixation surgery for fractures. Dr. Liu answered in detail and affirmed the depth of her thinking. It was very rewarding.
location: Doctor's office and patient bedside in the orthopedics ward of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Completed medical record sorting and shift handover preparation
description: After the consultation, she returned to the rehabilitation department and continued organizing and signing the remaining medical records. She reviewed the day's work, prepared the brief handover content for the next day, and confirmed the evening pottery studio reservation on her phone.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove home after work and bought groceries on the way
description: Left work on time at 4 p.m. without overtime. On the way home by car, I stopped at the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road and bought tomatoes, eggs, and fine dried noodles, planning to make a hot bowl of noodle soup. Arrived home around 4:40 p.m.
location: From Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road

name: Go home to rest, have dinner, call family, and head to the pottery studio.
description: After returning home, she changed into home clothes and made a bowl of tomato and egg noodles with the ingredients she had just bought. While cooking the noodles, she sent a WeChat voice message to her mother, talking about the day's work and the plan to eat sour soup fish tomorrow. Her mother happily said that her father had walked about 20 steps independently today with a walker, and she was delighted at her father's progress. After eating the noodles and washing the dishes, she rested for a while, then changed into an old T-shirt and trousers, put on a crossbody bag, took out a reference picture of a coiled snake, and took a taxi to the Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio in Guancheng District. The ride took about 20 minutes, and she replied to departmental group messages during the traffic jam.
location: From Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, 3rd Floor, Building 2, Shenghuali Shopping Center, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District

name: Pottery creation: shaping a zodiac snake pattern plate
description: Arrived at the studio, changed into an apron, opened a reference image of a coiled snake, and used the coil-building technique to shape the snake body into an S-curve. Su Ya came over and praised her artistic talent; she smiled and modestly brushed it off. While concentrating on carving the scale texture, she accidentally knocked over a white glaze bottle. It took her 10 minutes to clean up, and she joked about being clumsy. Teacher Zheng Guodong then guided her in using tools to deepen the details of the snake's eye expression.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, 3rd Floor, Building 2, Shenghuali Shopping Center, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Took a taxi home and replied to friends' messages.
description: After finishing the wet clay shaping, she took a taxi home at 8 p.m. In the car, she saw a WeChat message sent by her childhood friend Zhang Jing in the afternoon about the decision to get a cat. She replied that they would go together to see a blue cat on the weekend, and arranged for Sunday.
location: In a taxi from Shenghuali Shopping Center, East Hanghai Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District

name: Supplementing medical record data, conducting statistical analysis, and doing practice questions for exam preparation
description: After arriving home and changing into loungewear, she went to the study, opened her laptop, added the case characteristics of the two newly admitted patients to the data table, and used Excel functions to perform preliminary descriptive statistics on the previous 14 typical cases, finding that the Barthel index improved by an average of 35 points, giving her a strong sense of achievement. Then she took out the practice book for the attending physician exam, timed herself on 10 orthopedic rehabilitation multiple-choice questions, checked the answer explanations one by one, and recorded the wrong answers in her mistake notebook, with an accuracy rate of 80%.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Evening relaxation: diary, Baduanjin, reading, and mindfulness meditation.
description: After taking a hot shower, she wrote in her diary under the bedroom desk lamp, recording the gains from the consultation and the little pottery accident. Then she spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of Baduanjin, with extra neck stretches to relieve tech neck. At 10 p.m., she sat up in bed reading The Miracle of Mindfulness, followed the guidance for a 5-minute mindfulness meditation, and after relaxing her whole body, she turned off the light and went to sleep at 10:30 p.m.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, No. 89 Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning Baduanjin exercises and breakfast
description: At 7 a.m. on a weekend morning, Yu Xiaowen woke up, changed into her workout clothes, laid out her yoga mat in the living room, and followed an audio clip on her phone to complete a full set of Baduanjin. She then used a foam roller to relax her neck, shoulders, and back, relieving the muscle tension from last night's pottery activity. Afterward, she prepared a nutritious breakfast for herself: hot milk, toasted whole-wheat bread, and boiled eggs, enjoying it while listening to classical music. After breakfast, she checked her backpack and packed her sketchbook and fountain pen, getting ready for today's art exhibition.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Visited the "Digital Future" art exhibition and exchanged ideas with Zhao Ming.
description: At 8:20, Yu Xiaowen drove from home along Jinshui Road heading east to the Henan Provincial Art Museum, with piano music playing in the car, and arrived about 19 minutes later. After picking up a guide brochure, she walked into the exhibition hall and quietly experienced the motion-capture interactive installation "Life Atlas". When her figure turned into flowing points of light, inspiration struck, and she immediately wrote in her sketchbook: "Visual feedback + motor imagery can serve as the interactive core of upper-limb rehabilitation games." During the visit, she ran into her college classmate Zhao Ming, and the two briefly discussed the cross-disciplinary potential of digital art and rehabilitation medicine. Near noon, they moved to the cafe on the first floor of the art museum. Yu Xiaowen ordered a hot latte and shared the 8 key inspiration points from her exhibition notes with Zhao Ming. Zhao Ming offered suggestions from a computer vision perspective, and the half-hour conversation made her thinking clearer.
location: Henan Art Museum, No. 1 CBD, Inner Business Ring Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Had a dinner gathering with colleague Wang Fang at Longhuli.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Ming, Yu Xiaowen drove to Longhuli Commercial District, arriving about 14 minutes later. She had arranged to meet her colleague Wang Fang for lunch at the Qian Wei Sour Fish Soup restaurant. They enjoyed the signature sour fish soup. Yu Xiaowen excitedly shared her morning at the art museum and her creative idea of using digital art in rehabilitation. Wang Fang also talked about fun weekend stories from the department and asked about the progress of her paper collaboration with Zhao Ming. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. After lunch, Yu Xiaowen drove back home.
location: Qianwei Sour Soup Fish Restaurant, Longhuli Commercial Block, Jiuru Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Returned home in the afternoon for a short rest and to brew tea.
description: After driving for about 17 minutes, Yu Xiaowen returned home in Qunying Community around 1 p.m., changed into loungewear, and felt the morning's excitement gradually subside. She brewed a pot of newly purchased Tieguanyin, leaned back on the sofa to savor the tea, and leafed through the exhibition brochure she had brought back, letting her mind and body relax from the immersive experience of the morning.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Organize exhibition inspiration and draw a mind map
description: After a break, Yu Xiaowen went to the study, opened her computer and sketchbook, and systematically organized the inspirations she had recorded in the morning. She created a mind map named “Rehabilitation Digital Art Integration,” with its main branches divided into four directions: “Visual Feedback,” “Biofeedback,” “Motor Imagery Reshaping,” and “Interactive Game Design.” After finishing, she sent a screenshot of the mind map to Zhao Ming with the message: “Some takeaways from the exhibition. Sharing with you. Which points do you think are most likely to be implemented?”
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Financial review and budget adjustment
description: Switching to the finance page, Yu Xiaowen logged into the mobile banking app to check November income and expenses. This month, because of paying for a massage chair and critical illness insurance, total expenses exceeded 20,000 yuan. After calculating, she cut the December budgets for clothing/shoes/hats and entertainment/dining by 300 yuan each, and manually transferred 2,000 yuan to the housing fund account to ensure the savings plan stayed stable.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Balcony reading time
description: After taking care of the accounts, Yu Xiaowen picked up the novel *The Moon and Sixpence* and went to the lounge chair on the balcony. The winter afternoon sunlight slanted in, warm and peaceful, and she immersed herself in the story of chasing dreams and struggling with reality, savoring the pleasure of being alone.
location: balcony at home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Prepared and enjoyed a light dinner.
description: After reading, Yu Xiaowen made a light tomato and egg salad meal with tomatoes, eggs, lettuce, and whole wheat bread, paired with sugar-free yogurt. While eating dinner, she scrolled through her Moments and the 'Badminton Trio' WeChat group on her tablet. Seeing Lin Wei asking about playing badminton on Wednesday, she immediately sent photos of the exhibition and signed up.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Confirmed a badminton match with a fellow player
description: After dinner, Yu Xiaowen discussed with her badminton buddies Lin Wei and Xu Tao in the group chat 'Badminton Trio' in the living room via WeChat, and they finally decided to play badminton at Maiya Badminton Hall next Wednesday (December 3) from 19:00 to 20:30. Director Li Yan affirmed the approach and suggested adding a family caregiver education module to extend cognitive training into the home environment. Had an in-depth discussion with colleagues about training frequency and intensity. After the discussion ended at 11:45, returned to the office, quickly organized my notes, and highlighted Director Li Yan's suggestions to prepare for the afternoon work.

I quickly joined the resuscitation team, assisted in guiding the use of anticoagulants, and monitored the patient's vital signs at all times. After an intense hour and a half of management, the patient's oxygen saturation gradually stabilized, and at 22:40 the patient was transferred to the ICU for further observation. This emergency, which required integrating multiple resources and making rapid clinical judgments, honed my clinical ability.

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: Yu Xiaowen checked the doors and windows, then washed up. She turned off the lights at exactly 23:00. City lights from outside the window filtered in, and she soon fell into a peaceful sleep.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Morning activities and preparations
description: Woken by the winter weekend sunshine, I lingered in bed before checking the weather and news. Then I laid out the yoga mat in the living room, practiced Baduanjin to music, and used a foam roller to relax my shoulders, back, and legs. After a quick wash, I had breakfast with whole-wheat bread, boiled eggs, and warm milk. I opened the delivery box signed for the previous evening, carefully took out the white porcelain tea set and Jinjunmei tea leaves, rinsed them with warm water, and left them to dry, full of anticipation. Finally, I changed into a warm down jacket and scarf, ready to go out.
location: Qunying Community, Building, Unit, Room, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Went to her parents' home, visited her father, and accompanied her mother to buy groceries.
description: She drove from Qunying Community, taking Qunying Road, then Jingsan Road, then Huayuan Road, and arrived at the Huayuan Road-Huanghe Road community in about 15 minutes. After entering, she visited her father, Yu Jianguo, checked his training records on the rehabilitation exercise bike, and praised him for persisting with the required duration and improving his knee angle. Her father asked about the massage chair, and she said it was well worth the money. Then she accompanied her mother, Li Xiuying, on foot to the Huayuan Road vegetable market to buy ingredients such as pork ribs, lotus root, winter bamboo shoots, and Chinese cabbage, chatting along the way and sharing interesting hospital stories.
location: Huayuan Road-Huanghe Road Community and Huayuan Road Vegetable Market, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Helped prepare lunch and had a family lunch.
description: Back at her parents' home, she helped her mother in the kitchen wash and cut lotus root and pork ribs, preparing the ingredients for soup. Her mother did the main cooking, making braised pork ribs, lotus root and rib soup, and stir-fried winter bamboo shoots. The family of three sat around the dining table for lunch, enjoying her mother's cooking while listening to her parents talk about the new changes in the community property management. The atmosphere was warm and grounded. After the meal, she helped clear the dishes.
location: Building and room, Huanghe Road Community, Huayuan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Drove back home
description: After reminding my father to take his medication on time and my mother to rest, I took the homemade pickles and fruit that my mother had packed, and drove back home to Qunying Community.
location: Returned from the Huanghe Road Community on Huayuan Road to Qunying Community (Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province)

name: Lunch break and quiet time alone.
description: Changed into loose loungewear, lay on the living room sofa with a thin blanket and rested with eyes closed. The winter sunlight streamed through the window onto the floor, and half an hour of quiet mental emptying relaxed both body and mind.
location: Qunying Community, Building, Unit, Room, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Enjoying tea and reading with the new tea set for the first time.
description: Using the white porcelain lidded bowl washed this morning, I warmed the cup and set with 80-degree hot water and added about 5 grams of Jin Jun Mei. After pouring water with a high flush and low decant, the amber tea liquor was clear and bright in the white porcelain cup. Taking a sip, the tea was mellow and smooth, with a floral, fruity honey fragrance. Carrying the teacup to the desk, I leafed through the Chinese Medical Journal and enjoyed the quiet afternoon.
location: Qunying Community, Building, Unit, Room, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Midday brisk walk in the park
description: Feeling a bit tired after reading, changed into sports shoes and went downstairs, and walked briskly for about 30 minutes along the community garden and the nearby Zhuchunyuan Park. The warm winter sunshine and crisp air made me sweat slightly and feel refreshed.
location: Zhuchun Park and Qunying Community Garden, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner preparation, meal, and a brief rest
description: After returning home, she turned on the stereo and played piano music. While listening, she washed and cut the fruit her parents had given her and prepared the ingredients for tomato egg noodles. She cooked the noodles, blanched the greens, and fried an egg, then quickly finished a light dinner. After tidying the kitchen and washing the dishes, she rested briefly in the living room, enjoying a moment of tranquility brought by the music.
location: Qunying Community, Building, Unit, Room, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: City walk and appointment with Sun Yue
description: As it was getting dark, I changed into a light down jacket and went out, walking north along Jingsan Road to soak up the lively everyday atmosphere of Zhengzhou on a Saturday evening. When I passed a fruit shop, I sent a WeChat message to my friend Sun Yue to arrange a visit to an independent bookstore together next Wednesday evening. Sun Yue replied quickly and confirmed the time.
location: The neighborhood near Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Deep tea tasting and evening reading.
description: Back home, she reheated water to 80 degrees, warmed the cups and cleaned the tea set again, put in Jinjunmei, and brewed it with the high-pour, low-serve technique. In the overflowing tea fragrance, she held the teacup and continued reading the medical article she had not finished in the afternoon, immersed in tranquility.
location: Qunying Community, Building, Unit, Room, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Write diary
description: Opened her beloved leather notebook and used a fountain pen to record the day's feelings: a sunny weekend officially kicked off the new ritual of substituting tea for coffee; the white porcelain tea set was warm and smooth, and the Jin Jun Mei tea was sweetly fragrant and calming; her parents were in good spirits, and her father's rehabilitation training was proceeding in an orderly manner; she and Sun Yue agreed to explore a trendy spot next week. Peaceful and grounded.
location: Qunying Community, Building, Unit, Room, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with elder brother
description: Received a WeChat video call request from my older brother Yu Xiaofeng, who was in Shenzhen. On the balcony of his apartment, he shared about his hike along the Yantian Coastal Boardwalk last weekend. I also told him about my decision to replace coffee with tea and my plans for the day. He encouraged me, "Rest when you're tired; keep going if you love it." After hanging up, I felt warm inside.
location: Sofa in the living room, Building, Unit, Room, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening washing up and skincare
description: She put down her phone, washed her face and brushed her teeth, and did her evening skincare routine: she used facial cleanser to wash away the day's dust, applied toner and moisturizing lotion, and then looked at herself in the mirror with satisfaction, pleased with her good complexion.
location: Bathroom, Room, Unit, Building, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: Got into bed, turned off the main light, and kept only the warm yellow bedside lamp on. Closing her eyes, she recalled the beautiful moments of the day: her father's smiling face, her mother's cooking, the fragrance of tea, and her brother's voice. She set the alarm, drew the curtains tight, and set the smart speaker to play soft rain white noise, slowly drifting off to sleep in peace.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, Building, Unit, Room, bedroom

name: 4 km morning run
description: At seven in the morning, with the temperature near zero, Yu Xiaowen wore a fleece-lined running jacket and gloves and walked from home to the Dongfeng Canal Ecological Culture Park, starting a 4-kilometer jog. She ran along the Dongfeng Canal riverside trail while her earphones played Bach's cello suites. The winter sunlight cast dappled light through the sparse metasequoia forest. After finishing the run, she did ten minutes of stretching on the observation deck, moving her hips and shoulders. Her heart rate gradually stabilized, and she felt refreshed.
location: Dongfeng Canal Ecological Culture Park, near the intersection of Dongfeng Road and Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Pick up groceries along the way
description: After finishing her morning run, Yu Xiaowen stopped by the familiar grain and oil shop on Qunying Road on the way. She bought two yuan of fresh scallions, three eggs, a bunch of Shanghai bok choy, and a box of tofu to prepare ingredients for cooking noodles for dinner. While paying, she chatted with the shop owner's wife about the weather; the owner's wife joked that young people should dress more warmly. She walked home carrying a light shopping bag.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Returned home to wash up, have breakfast, and prepare for the commute.
description: Back home, Yu Xiaowen first took a hot shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. Then she fried an egg in a frying pan, toasted whole wheat bread, heated a glass of milk, and had a simple breakfast with pickled vegetables. Afterward, she organized her pottery tool kit, took the clay slab with a grip-ball texture she had made for her father, checked the food in the fridge, and confirmed that she would not have time to come home at noon but could cook noodles in the evening. At 9:15, she put on a thick coat, picked up her car keys, and went downstairs.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Drive to the pottery studio
description: Yu Xiaowen drove from Qunying Community, turned on the radio to listen to traffic conditions, and after a journey of a little over twenty minutes, passing several traffic lights and intersections, arrived around ten o'clock at Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio on Hanghai East Road in the Economic Development Zone. She parked in the underground garage and entered carrying her tool bag.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, Building 2, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Refine the pottery exhibits
description: The studio was very warm, and Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya immediately threw themselves into revising their pieces. Su Ya used fine sandpaper to sand the rim of the zodiac rooster ceramic plate, while Yu Xiaowen focused on applying an even transparent glaze to the textured clay board for her father's grip ball, using gentle strokes and aiming for clear texture. At 12:30, Master Zheng Guodong inspected the pieces and suggested not making the glaze too thick so the texture wouldn't blur, and raising the firing temperature by five degrees as appropriate. The three discussed the firing details, and other students also came over to exchange ideas. Yu Xiaowen kept working until nearly 2 p.m. and only stopped when she felt hungry.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, Building 2, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Barbecue lunch
description: After the pottery work came to a pause, Yu Xiaowen felt sore in the lower back and went to lunch with Su Ya and Master Zheng at the nearby Wanjia Charcoal Grill BBQ Restaurant. The three ordered mutton huimian noodles, several skewers, and a cold dish platter. During the meal, they continued discussing the layout details of next month's pottery exhibition and the meanings of their respective works. Yu Xiaowen ate until she was full and felt very satisfied.
location: Charcoal Grilled Wanjia BBQ Restaurant, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China

name: Rest and drive to the badminton hall
description: After eating, Yu Xiaowen drove to Malt Badminton Hall, a trip of about fifteen to twenty minutes. While waiting at a red light, she sent a WeChat message to Lin Wei asking if she had set off. She had originally planned to warm up early, but she was going directly from the studio.
location: Maiya Badminton Hall, 130 meters southwest of the South Gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan, Dongfeng Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China

name: Badminton showdown
description: The court was buzzing with activity. After a brief warm-up, Yu Xiaowen and Lin Wei started a fierce match. Lin Wei's backhand had improved significantly, and several long rallies forced Xiaowen to run at full speed. Both played heartily and were drenched in sweat. After the match, they stretched and rehydrated at the courtside. Xiaowen remarked on Lin Wei's progress, and they agreed to play again at the usual time next week.
location: Maiya Badminton Hall, 130 meters southwest of the South Gate of Qianxiang Qinyuan, Dongfeng Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China

name: Returned home and bought dried noodles and black vinegar on the way.
description: After playing ball, Yu Xiaowen drove back. Passing Qunying Road, she remembered that she had only bought some ingredients in the morning, so she pulled over, entered the Qunying Road grain and oil shop again, and bought a bundle of dried noodles and a bottle of aged vinegar to prepare for the evening's 'prize noodles'.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Dinner and rest
description: After arriving home, Yu Xiaowen took a shower, changed into dry loungewear, tied on an apron, and used the greens, tofu, eggs, and homemade meat sauce bought that morning to cook a steaming bowl of noodles. After a simple meal, she washed the dishes and then sat on the sofa to rest for ten minutes.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Evening tea, music, and reading
description: At 6:30 p.m., Yu Xiaowen boiled water with her new white porcelain tea set to brew ripe Pu-erh, and turned on the Bluetooth speaker to play Bach's "Air on the G String." In the soothing music, she leaned back on the sofa, sipped tea slowly, and savored its aroma. She then picked up "A History of Chinese Ceramics" and read the section on Song dynasty Jun porcelain's "kiln transmutation" glaze colors, seeking inspiration for the color schemes of her pottery works.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Video call with parents
description: The music was still playing. Yu Xiaowen picked up her phone and initiated a WeChat video call with her parents. She saw her father watching the news in the living room and her mother busy in the kitchen. She talked about her plans for the day and asked in detail about her father's lower-limb rehabilitation training. When she learned that he had walked fifty steps, she repeatedly praised him, saying, “Dad, you're great!” Her mother interjected to remind her to dress warmly as the temperature dropped. The call atmosphere was warm and pleasant.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Contacting friends and writing diary
description: After ending the call, Yu Xiaowen sent a WeChat message to her friend Sun Yue to confirm the plan to visit an independent bookstore on Wednesday evening, and agreed to meet at the bookstore entrance at seven o'clock in the evening. Then she took out her diary and recorded the day's experiences and feelings: the riverside scenery during her morning run, progress in pottery, Lin Wei's improvement, the taste of Pu'er with the new tea set, and the relief brought by her father's recovery.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Evening relaxation
description: After writing her diary, Yu Xiaowen spent a while on her phone watching short videos of colored-glaze underglaze painting tutorials. Then she washed up, did a facial skincare routine and body stretching, set her phone to silent, placed it in the living room to charge, and left only a bedside lamp on.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Pre-Bedtime Preparations
description: Yu Xiaowen changed into pajamas and lay in bed. She dimmed the bedside lamp, opened the white noise app on her phone, and played the "crackling campfire" sound. She closed her eyes and rested for a moment, falling asleep naturally in a warm, relaxed state, ending a fulfilling and satisfying Sunday.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Getting up and indoor morning exercise
description: After the alarm went off, she opened the curtains and saw the gloomy sky and wet roads outside, so she decisively gave up the morning run. She unrolled a yoga mat in the living room and followed a video on her phone for a full 20-minute session of Baduanjin, focusing on stretching her shoulders, neck, and lower back. Then she used a foam roller on the front and back of her thighs and calves for about 10 minutes of deep rolling relaxation. She felt her body loosened up and her spirits lifted.
location: Living room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Breakfast and getting changed
description: After washing up quickly, I made a cup of warm water in the kitchen and drank it. Breakfast was milk oatmeal porridge, a boiled egg, and two slices of whole wheat bread. Considering the strong north wind today, I found a thick wool coat, cashmere scarf, and mask, and put on fleece-lined work pants to stay warm during my commute.
location: Kitchen and bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Commute to the hospital by car.
description: She took her commuter bag and folding umbrella, went downstairs, and drove off. Because of the light rain, the roads were slippery and traffic was a bit heavier than usual, but the whole trip took about 17 minutes. She arrived at the hospital's underground parking garage at around 08:07, parked, and walked to the changing room of the rehabilitation medicine department.
location: From the underground parking lot of Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to the underground parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Department morning meeting handover.
description: After changing into my white coat, I attended the morning meeting. The doctor on duty reported that a traumatic brain injury patient over the weekend had become restless and delirious at night, and had been properly managed with medication and restraints. Dr. Li Wei emphasized this week's key surgical arrangements (a rotator cuff repair) and the points of concern for several critically ill patients. I used my notebook to write down the patients and lab results that need close attention today.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province (2nd Floor, Building 3)

name: See patients in the rehabilitation outpatient clinic.
description: Monday morning outpatient clinic was busy and orderly. I saw about 10 patients, mainly including: for a 32-year-old patient with spinal cord injury (T10 incomplete injury, 3-month course), I conducted a detailed assessment using the Berg Balance Scale, found that his sitting balance reached level 3 but standing balance was only level 1, adjusted his recent rehabilitation goals, and prescribed a new physical therapy plan; for a 60-year-old woman with stroke sequelae, I developed a home training plan, focusing on teaching her family members how to assist with proper limb positioning and simple passive range-of-motion exercises. The woman repeatedly thanked me, and I urged her to persist every day; the other patients mainly received conservative treatment for neck, shoulder, back, and leg pain, and I issued physiotherapy orders and exercise prescriptions.
location: Outpatient Room 2, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Lunch and Chat with Colleagues
description: I went to the cafeteria with Wang Fang. Wang Fang ordered braised noodles with beans, and I chose braised beef noodles with an added fried egg. We chatted while eating. She shared her thoughts on binge-watching shows at home over the weekend, while I excitedly told her about the details of finishing my piece at the pottery studio (Shenghuali) yesterday, and whispered to her, “On Wednesday afternoon I plan to take leave to go see our 'Between Clay' ceramic exhibition—do you want to come?” She happily agreed.
location: No. 65 Wenhuagong Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, Staff Cafeteria of Zhengzhou Central Hospital (Main Campus)

name: Lunch break and short reading.
description: Returning to the duty room, she put on an eye mask and earplugs and took a short nap of about 30 minutes on the folding bed. After waking up, she felt much refreshed. She picked up her phone again and opened the attending physician exam question bank app, spending 10 minutes on key questions in the "Arrhythmia" chapter and reinforcing her memory of several principles for anticoagulation therapy in atrial fibrillation.
location: Doctors' duty room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province (Building 3, 2nd Floor)

name: Afternoon Outpatient Paperwork (I)
description: The afternoon outpatient clinic was relatively relaxed. First, I processed the morning's medical records, entered the assessment results and prescriptions into the system, and completed medication order adjustments for several patients.
location: Outpatient office of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Call mother
description: The overcast rain outside made me feel a bit gloomy, so I called my mother. We chatted about everyday things for about 15 minutes. Mom said she was in Luoyang making my favorite pork and cabbage dumplings, and reminded me that it was cold in Zhengzhou and to drink more hot water and not catch a cold. Hearing her familiar, warm voice, my mood suddenly brightened.
location: Outpatient office of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon outpatient clinic paperwork (2)
description: Continued processing medical orders, and prepared discharge summaries and detailed home health education booklets for the two patients who were to be discharged tomorrow.
location: Outpatient office of the Rehabilitation Medicine Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Went home after work to pick up a package.
description: Left work on time and drove home. Traffic was smooth. After parking around 16:55, I stopped by the Cainiao Station at the entrance of the community. I gave the pickup code and received the pottery book ‘Ceramic Decoration Techniques’ that I had purchased online a few days ago.
location: From the underground parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Cainiao Station (Plastic Factory No. 1 Family Building Store), No. 60 Tianming Road, Nanyang Xincun Subdistrict, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, then to Qunying Community

name: Dinner preparation and dining.
description: Returned home and changed into loungewear. Tonight I made simple and nutritious clear soup noodles: using the Shanghai greens and tender tofu bought yesterday, with dried noodles and eggs, and added a little dried shrimp and seaweed to enhance the flavor. While cooking the noodles, I opened the newly arrived book and flipped through a few pages, quite cozy. I ate the hot noodles at about 17:35, and the chill of the rainy day was largely dispelled.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening review for exam (arrhythmia)
description: After tidying up the kitchen, she brewed a pot of Jin Jun Mei tea with the new white porcelain tea set. She opened Internal Medicine (9th Edition) and focused on reviewing the "Arrhythmia" chapter. First, she systematically sorted out the key differential points and management principles for tachyarrhythmias (atrial fibrillation, supraventricular tachycardia, ventricular tachycardia, etc.) and bradyarrhythmias (sick sinus syndrome, atrioventricular block, etc.), and drew a clear ECG differential diagnosis mind map on an A4 sheet. Finally, she spent 30 minutes on the accompanying practice questions, with an accuracy rate of about 82%, and marked some wrong questions (especially the anticoagulation indications for atrial fibrillation) as key points.
location: Study/Living Room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: A short rest and plant care
description: After finishing a study session, I got up, walked around the living room, looked out at the rainy night street scene, and stretched my stiff neck. I also watered the pothos and aloe vera plants on the balcony, taking in the feel of daily life and giving my eyes and mind a break.
location: Living room and balcony, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening review and reflection on wrong questions.
description: Returning to the desk, she carefully reviewed the mistakes from the previous practice. In particular, she made key notes and fluorescent highlights in the book on how to calculate the CHA2DS2-VASc score for patients with atrial fibrillation and the choice of anticoagulant drugs (the pros and cons of warfarin versus novel oral anticoagulants), as well as the principles of drug therapy for ventricular tachycardia (the timing of amiodarone and lidocaine).
location: Study/Living Room, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up, skincare, and preparing clothes
description: After finishing studying, she washed her face with a gentle cleanser and put on a hydrating mask. At the same time, she took out tomorrow's clothes from the wardrobe—a turtleneck sweater and a pair of jeans—folded them, placed them by the head of the bed, and set the alarm for 6:45 tomorrow morning.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Mindfulness meditation before bed.
description: I turned off the main light, leaving only a warm-yellow bedside lamp. Leaning against the headboard, I opened the meditation app on my phone and chose a 10-minute 'mindful breathing' exercise. Following the guidance, I focused on each breath in and breath out, letting the day's busyness and the fatigue from studying slowly dissipate with each exhale, and my body and mind gradually calmed down.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Read pottery books before bed
description: After meditation, she lay down and opened the newly arrived "Ceramic Decorative Techniques", focusing on the introduction to the "Twisted Clay" chapter. Looking at the photos of ceramic works with cloud-like and water-like textures, she gained new inspiration for the exhibits at the ceramic exhibition she would visit next weekend, and felt fulfilled and calm.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep
