description: She turned off the bedside lamp, listened to the pitter-patter of rain outside the window, and fell asleep peacefully, feeling fulfilled and calm.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at Room 502, Unit 3, Building 1, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Getting up and washing up.
description: The alarm rang at noon. She woke up from her catch-up sleep after the night shift, assessed how her body felt, drank some water, and opened the curtains to see a light rain outside. She then went into the bathroom, washed her face with warm water and mint facial cleanser, reviewed last night's cases while brushing her teeth, changed into loungewear, and pinned up her hair with a hair clip, completing her mental refreshment.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prepare and enjoy a scallion-oil noodle lunch
description: She went into the kitchen and made scallion oil noodles using the scallions and eggs prepared in advance: cut the scallions into sections and made the sauce, boiled the noodles and rinsed them in cold water, fried the scallion oil over low heat, then poured the oil over the noodles and topped them with a sunny-side-up egg and white sesame seeds. She then carried the noodles to the living room, opened her phone and played a European classical music playlist, and enjoyed lunch while listening to music.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Tea break, case reflection, and contacting family and friends
description: After lunch, she rinsed the dishes and chopsticks, took out the white porcelain tea set, and brewed Jin Jun Mei black tea. Sitting in a rattan chair on the balcony, she sipped tea while opening the December issue of the Chinese Medical Journal. Using a fountain pen, she recorded in detail in her diary the management and reflections on the two cases from last night: the thrombolysis decision for stroke and the postoperative fever after fracture surgery. After a short rest, she sent a WeChat message to her friend Sun Yue to arrange a meeting at the bookstore tomorrow evening, and decided to have a video call with her parents earlier than planned.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with parents
description: Connected with her parents via WeChat video. Her mother Li Xiuying answered, and her father Yu Jianguo was walking in the living room holding a walker. Yu Xiaowen happily praised her father's progress and asked in detail about his rehabilitation training. Her father said he had walked nearly 60 steps and completed upper limb resistance training. She suggested leg massage after training, and her mother told her to rest well. The video call lasted more than 40 minutes. Seeing her parents in good spirits, she felt reassured.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Noon break
description: After the video call ended, drowsiness hit her. She drew the bedroom curtains to darken the room, set the alarm for 16:00, covered herself with the blanket, and fell asleep, recharging her body through deep sleep.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Getting up and preparing to go out
description: After waking up feeling energetic, she changed out of her pajamas, put on thermal underwear, a turtleneck sweater, and fleece-lined jeans, then wore a long black down jacket, wrapped a scarf around her neck, and put on a knitted hat. She checked her backpack for her phone, keys, thermos, and folding umbrella, getting ready to go out in the rain properly bundled up.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Walk in the rain in Zhuchun Garden
description: Walking east along Qunying Road with an umbrella for about 30 minutes to Zhuchunyuan Park, she power-walked along the circular trail for half an hour in the chilly north wind and drizzle. With few pedestrians on the road and classical guitar music playing from her phone, she took deep breaths of the damp, fresh, cold air, dispelling the gloom of the night shift.
location: Zhuchun Garden Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Buying dinner ingredients
description: Walked south from the park along Suoling Road to the Qunying Road grain and oil store. Under the warm yellow lights and the aroma of grains, bought fresh cut noodles, Shanghai bok choy, scallions, and eggs. Had a brief chat with the familiar owner and told him that I was off duty tonight and would cook noodle soup myself.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Prepared and enjoyed hot noodle soup with greens and egg
description: After walking home from the grain and oil shop, she took off her down jacket, went into the kitchen, washed the greens, chopped scallions, boiled water, added noodles and poached eggs, then added the greens and seasoned with salt, white pepper, and sesame oil, cooking a large bowl of hot noodle soup with chewy noodles and bright green vegetables. Sitting at the dining table, she ate noodles while watching the medical documentary "Life at Full Speed" on her tablet, enjoying dinner while gaining knowledge.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After dinner, tidy up and finish the pottery pieces.
description: After washing the dishes and utensils, I walked to the simple workbench on the balcony, took out the semi-finished texture board for my father's grip-strength ball made the day before yesterday, put on gloves, and used a small spatula and a sponge to carefully clean the clay burrs around the edges and smooth the bottom. Then I sent a WeChat voice message to Master Zheng at the pottery studio, telling him the bottom edge of the piece had been repaired, and asked whether it could be coated with transparent glaze tomorrow.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening novel reading.
description: Brew a cup of jasmine tea, curl up on the living room sofa, and continue reading Haruki Murakami's Hard-Boiled Wonderland and the End of the World. Accompanied by soft piano music and intermittent rain, you are immersed in the strange world built by the dual narrative, letting your mind escape from medical cases and work and fully rest.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Packing for tomorrow's trip
description: After closing the book, she walked to the entrance, prepared the sneakers to wear tomorrow, placed the down jacket, scarf, and canvas bag containing the grip ball and ceramic plate together, and checked her phone and power bank to make sure they had enough battery. Then she paced slowly in the living room for 10 minutes to stretch her body after sitting for a long time.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Wash up and soak feet.
description: Went into the bathroom, cleansed my face with makeup remover and amino acid facial cleanser, then applied a hydrating mask. Soaked my feet in the 42 electric foot bath for 30 minutes, enjoying the water flow and vibrating massage, warming my body and relieving fatigue. After soaking, removed the mask, washed my face with water, and applied night cream.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Meditating, reading, and falling asleep before bed.
description: Changed into cotton pajamas and leaned against the headboard, dimmed the lights, and used a meditation APP on her phone for a 10-minute body scan, from the top of her head to the soles of her feet, feeling and relaxing. Afterward, she picked up her Kindle and continued reading a Murakami novel for about 20 minutes. When drowsiness came, she closed the cover, adjusted her pillow, and fell asleep peacefully, fully recharged for tomorrow's bookstore date with Sun Yue and the pottery exhibition.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning relaxation and breakfast
description: Got up at 6:50 in the morning. Because she was tired from the night shift, she canceled the morning run and did 20 minutes of Baduanjin in the living room, focusing on stretching her shoulders, neck, and lower back. She then used a foam roller to relax her calves and back. After exercising, she took a quick shower, changed into her white coat and casual shoes, and had whole-wheat bread, hot milk, and a boiled egg for breakfast. At the same time, she checked that the ceramic plaque, for which she had repaired the bottom edge for her father, was intact in the canvas bag. Outside, the sky was already bright; the forecast was cloudy turning sunny, with temperatures from minus one to seven degrees Celsius, so she decided to wear more clothes.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Commute by car
description: Put on a thick down jacket and wrapped a scarf. She walked from the community to the underground garage, drove along the Nongye Road elevated highway, and arrived at the hospital staff parking lot in about 14 minutes. She parked the car and got ready for work.
location: From the underground garage of Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road and Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to the staff parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Morning work: ward rounds and medical record processing
description: Attended the department morning meeting at 8:00. After handover, she followed Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds, focusing on Grandpa Wang in bed 42 with fluctuating blood pressure and the newly admitted patient in bed 21 with a spinal cord injury, and adjusted some medical orders. Afterwards, she processed the medical records of discharged patients, prepared discharge summaries and home rehabilitation guidebook, and the work continued until nearly noon.
location: Department of Rehabilitation, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Went to the studio during lunch break to deliver clay slabs and exchange ideas.
description: After the morning's work, she drove to Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio during her lunch break. On arrival, she took the grip-ball-textured clay slab she had made for her father out of her canvas bag and handed it to Master Zheng. Master Zheng examined it and was satisfied with the glaze sheen, suggesting that anti-slip massage bumps could be added after firing. They briefly discussed her father's rehabilitation and then said goodbye.
location: Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, 2nd Floor, Building 3, Shenghuali Commercial Street, southeast side of the intersection of Mingli Road and Qihang Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return to the hospital and have lunch with colleagues
description: Drove back to the hospital from the studio. After getting a bowl of braised beef noodles at the staff cafeteria, ran into colleague Wang Fang, and the two sat together eating and chatting. Yu Xiaowen told Wang Fang that the ceramic slab had been sent to the studio, and mentioned that she had taken the afternoon off to take her parents to get vaccinated, so she could not go to the pottery exhibition with her for now. They agreed that Wang Fang would look around first, and Xiaowen would find her after finishing.
location: Employee cafeteria at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon work organization and compensatory leave reporting
description: After lunch she returned to the office, checked the afternoon treatment schedule, and used the quiet time to finish the medical records left incomplete in the morning and a draft of next week's treatment plan. Meanwhile, she received a message from her mother saying she was almost in Zhengzhou; she replied that they would meet at the community health service center at 3 p.m. At 2:50 p.m., she reported her compensatory time off to head nurse Wu Min and got approval.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove to the community and accompanied parents to get vaccinated.
description: She changed out of her white coat and drove to Yuantian Community Health Service Center on Dongfeng Road. On the way, she called her mother to confirm the location. She met her parents at the entrance of the community center and took them to register. Her mother was a bit nervous, and Yu Xiaowen gently held her arm to reassure her. Her father was calm. After the vaccination, they rested for 30 minutes in the observation area. After confirming there were no adverse reactions, her mother felt relieved after drinking hot water.
location: Vaccination Hall, Dongfeng Road Yuantian Community Health Service Center, 100 meters north of the intersection of Dongfeng Road and Yuantian Road on the east side, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Family lunch.
description: After the observation period ended, she took her parents to the nearby Old Luoyang Noodle House and ordered a steaming bowl of lamb stewed noodles for each person, plus two cold dishes. Her mother reminded Yu Xiaowen to eat more pork liver and red meat to improve her anemia, and her father asked about her life. The atmosphere during the meal was warm.
location: Old Luoyang Noodle Restaurant, southeast corner of the intersection of Dongfeng Road and Yuantian Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Take parents home and return to the hospital to handle follow-up work
description: After finishing the meal, she drove her parents home and carried their bags upstairs for them. She told them she would be back for dinner in the evening, then immediately drove back to the hospital. Returning to the rehabilitation department office, she checked the backlog of medical order sheets, called the families of patients to be discharged tomorrow to confirm the procedures, tidied her desk, and prepared to leave work.
location: From the southeast corner of the intersection of Dongfeng Road and Yuantian Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Qunying Residential Quarter, Qunying Road, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, then to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

name: After-work commute and grocery shopping
description: At 17:00 I left work on time. On the way home, I stopped by the grain and oil store on Qunying Road. I bought Shanghai bok choy, soft tofu, and fresh cut noodles, planning to make a light vegetable-tofu soup noodle dish for my parents in the evening, along with the spiced beef I had bought. Then I drove into the underground garage of the residential community.
location: From Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Qunying Road Grain and Oil Store, No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, and then to the underground garage of Qunying Community.

name: Go home and have dinner with parents.
description: Returned home and changed into loungewear. Her mother had already made an extra dish of scrambled eggs with tomatoes in the small kitchen using eggs and tomatoes from the fridge. Yu Xiaowen was in charge of cooking the noodles. The three of them sat around the table eating green vegetable and tofu soup noodles and scrambled eggs with tomatoes, chatting about funny moments from the day's injections and recent news from their hometown in Luoyang. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Drove to an independent bookstore
description: After dinner, she told her parents she had an appointment with Sun Yue, then drove to the Paper Light and Shadow Independent Bookstore on Zhendong Street, Guancheng District.
location: From the underground garage of the Qunying Residential Community at Jingsan Road and Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to No. 120, Zhendong Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Browsing independent bookstores with Sun Yue
description: Arriving at the newly opened Paper Light and Shadow Bookstore, Sun Yue was already flipping through a city street photography collection under the warm yellow light. The two walked among the bookshelves, and Yu Xiaowen selected "Neurology Bedside Examination Manual" and the essay collection "The Corner of Altai". Afterwards, they each ordered a hot yuzu tea at the counter, chatted about amusing work stories, and left near eight o'clock.
location: Light and Shadow on Paper Independent Bookstore, 120 Zhendong Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Driving home
description: After saying goodbye to Sun Yue, she drove back to the residential community listening to gentle folk music. In the night, there were fewer pedestrians on the streets, and the car was warm and cozy.
location: From No. 120 Zhendong Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to the underground garage of Qunying Residential Community, Jingsan Road and Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Evening household chores, medicine cabinet cleanup, and family communication
description: I returned home, changed into loungewear, and did the weekly deep cleaning: vacuuming, wiping down the bookshelf and windowsills. I focused on cleaning out the family medicine cabinet and checking drug expiration dates. I found three boxes of expired cold granules, half a bottle of iodophor that had been opened for more than three months, and two boxes of my father's expired neurotrophic drugs. I made a shopping list: ibuprofen, Vitamin C Yinqiao tablets, new iodophor, band-aids, gauze and medical tape, and mecobalamin tablets that my father needed to prepare himself. I took a photo of the list and sent it to the family group chat to explain the situation. My father replied by voice message saying he had already bought Vitamin B12 and Neurotropin himself, and my mother sent a thumbs-up emoji.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Nightly wash-up and reading before bed
description: Washed her face with a gentle facial cleanser and applied a hydrating mask, carefully applied body lotion and hand cream, and did five minutes of leg stretches on the exercise mat to relieve soreness. She changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, and read a chapter of Haruki Murakami's "Hard-Boiled Wonderland and the End of the World" on Kindle. She set the alarm for 6:50 the next day, turned off the light and went to sleep, feeling reassured knowing that everything for the day—accompanying her parents for vaccinations, delivering the pottery board, and cleaning out the medicine cabinet—had been done.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jingsan Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Yu Xiaowen was woken by the alarm. She opened the curtains and felt the cold but bright morning. She first weighed herself, recording 48.6 kg, then washed up and checked her skin condition, which felt good because she had applied a facial mask the night before. She put on warm clothes and got ready to start the day.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning run
description: Yu Xiaowen put on her sports gear and went for a morning jog at Zhuchunyuan Park near her home. The temperature was low but the air was fresh. She ran an easy 3 kilometers in about 20 minutes, then did simple stretching in the outdoor fitness equipment area.
location: Zhuchun Garden Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prepare and enjoy breakfast
description: After returning home, she showered and made a light breakfast with ingredients bought yesterday: boiled noodles with blanched Shanghai bok choy and a boiled egg. While eating, she read “The Corner of Altay” on her Kindle, enjoying the tranquil winter pasture in the book.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove to the hospital and did morning work.
description: Yu Xiaowen picked up her commuter bag and medication purchase list, drove from home to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, listening to the morning news on the way. She arrived about 10 minutes later and changed into her white coat. She attended the department's morning handover meeting, listened to the night shift report, applied to Director Zhang Lei for a half-day leave in the morning and got approval, and handed over to her colleague Wang Fang the situation of the rehabilitation patients who needed care in the morning. She then quickly handled the temporary medical orders for inpatients, reviewed the medical records of newly admitted patients, and confirmed the details of the iron-rich diet plan with nutrition department colleague Li Ting, preparing to leave. The whole morning's work was tight and well-organized.
location: Department of Rehabilitation, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Purchase medicines at the pharmacy
description: Drove from the hospital back to Jinshui District and went to Zhang Zhongjing Pharmacy near Jingyi Road. Following a carefully prepared list, she purchased over-the-counter medicines and supplies including ibuprofen sustained-release capsules, cold-relief granules, An'er iodine skin disinfectant, breathable adhesive bandages, and medical elastic bandages. She also used her father's medical insurance card and the diagnosis certificate to buy a one-month supply of mecobalamin tablets. After checking that all the medicines were bagged, she paid and had an electronic invoice issued.
location: Zhang Zhongjing Pharmacy (Xinjiayuan Community Branch), No. 1 Courtyard, Jingyi Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Went home and organized the family medicine cabinet
description: Carrying the purchased medicines home, she emptied the entire family medicine cabinet, checked the expiration dates one by one, and sorted out and discarded three expired boxes of cold granules, half a bottle of iodophor, and two tubes of ointment. After wiping the cabinet, she reorganized the old and new medicines by category—topical, oral, chronic disease, and first-aid—and marked the opening date and expiration date on the new medicine packages. Finally, she placed a handwritten “Family First-Aid Tips” card on the top layer of the medicine cabinet, keeping the family medicine cabinet neat and orderly to handle emergencies.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Hospital lunch and midday rest
description: After organizing the medicine cabinet, Yu Xiaowen immediately drove back to the hospital (about a 15-minute drive). At the staff cafeteria, she ordered an iron-rich lunch: stir-fried pig blood, black fungus salad with multigrain rice. She took a photo and sent it to her friend Sun Yue to discuss their meals. After lunch, she returned to the office, leaned back in her chair and rested for a while, then browsed the Manual of Bedside Neurological Examination, focusing on reviewing examination methods for cerebellar ataxia and dystonia, preparing for the afternoon clinic.
location: Employee cafeteria and Rehabilitation Department office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon rehabilitation department work and after-work organizing
description: In the afternoon, she returned to her post on time and saw two newly admitted patients (one in the recovery period of cerebral hemorrhage and one in the sequelae period of spinal cord injury). She performed detailed rehabilitation assessments, including muscle strength, joint range of motion, balance function, and ADL evaluation, and formulated initial plans. During this time, she worked with her colleague Wang Fang to triage a patient with neck and shoulder pain and referred the patient to the physical therapist. At around 14:30 in the afternoon, the family member of a former stroke patient with hemiplegia brought a thank-you letter and a silk banner. The letter was handwritten by the patient, expressing gratitude for the patient guidance provided last month, which deeply moved Yu Xiaowen. After work, she completed the medical records and rehabilitation notes, posted the next day's work plan on the edge of the monitor, confirmed the discharge instructions for the discharged patient, and completed the handover.
location: Department of Rehabilitation, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan

name: Buy groceries on the way and go home to prepare dinner
description: After work, I drove home, stopping at the grain and oil shop on Qunying Road along the way to buy a bunch of fresh spinach and a white radish. The shopkeeper chatted with me for a bit. Then I returned home, changed into comfortable loungewear, put the vegetables in the refrigerator, and started preparing a simple dinner: I made a bowl of plain noodle soup with scallions and the noodles bought yesterday, blanched the spinach, and fried a sunny-side-up egg, adding warmth to a solitary evening meal.

participant.name: The proprietress of the grain and oil shop.

location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Dinner and family video call
description: While enjoying her homemade yangchun noodles, Yu Xiaowen used her tablet to make a video call to her parents in Luoyang. She showed them the organized medicine cabinet, shared her joy at receiving a thank-you letter from a patient, and read the letter aloud. Her mother praised her repeatedly, and her father told her to be patient at work. She also asked about her father’s rehabilitation progress and was very happy to learn that he could now walk 80 steps. The call lasted nearly 40 minutes, full of family warmth and support.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening study, reading, and diary writing
description: After dinner, she brewed a pot of Jin Jun Mei tea in her new white porcelain tea set to warm herself, sat on the sofa, and first read The Corner of Altay for about half an hour, immersed in the vast world depicted by Li Juan. Then she switched to review mode, took out the attending physician exam materials, focused on reviewing the wrong questions in the Arrhythmia section of the Cardiovascular System chapter, and drew a new mind map to deepen her memory. Finally, she moved to the balcony, sipped warm lemon water while listening to classical music (Debussy's Clair de Lune), and used the memo app on her phone to write her diary for the day, recording how moving the thank-you letter was, the sense of achievement from organizing the medicine cabinet, and her work insights. She felt fulfilled and content.
location: Living room and balcony, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: After finishing her evening study, Yu Xiaowen began her bedtime routine: she followed a careful skincare regimen, applied a moisturizing mask, and after washing up, laid out a yoga mat in the bedroom and did 15 minutes of neck, shoulder, and waist stretches. Then she turned off the light and used the Tide app for a 10-minute body scan meditation to release fatigue. Afterward, she turned on the bedside lamp and read the last two chapters of Hard-Boiled Wonderland and the End of the World, gradually calming down in Haruki Murakami's prose. Around 22:00, she set the alarm for the next morning's 6:30 run, checked the weather forecast, turned off the light, and slipped into sleep feeling fulfilled and peaceful.
location: Bedroom, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Early morning Baduanjin and stretching
description: The alarm went off on time, and Yu Xiaowen didn't linger in bed. She drank the warm water prepared the night before and spread out her yoga mat in the living room. She opened the Baduanjin video saved on her phone and, following the soothing music, carefully completed all eight movements, including "Pushing Up the Heavens with Both Hands" and "Drawing the Bow to Shoot the Arrow." The morning stretching relaxed her shoulders and neck, which had been a bit stiff after catching up on sleep following the night shift, leaving her refreshed and energized.
location: Building 6, Unit 3, Apartment 1**, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up, changing clothes, and a quick breakfast
description: After finishing her morning exercise, she took a quick warm shower. Today she wore an off-white turtleneck sweater with a long black down jacket over it, which was both warm and convenient for working in the evening. Breakfast was simple: two slices of whole-wheat bread with a fried egg, accompanied by a glass of hot milk. Standing by the window eating breakfast, she saw that it was overcast outside and remembered that yesterday's forecast had said it would be cloudy today, so she put the blue portable folding umbrella into her commuter bag.
location: Building 6, Unit 3, Apartment 1**, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Commute to the hospital by car.
description: She took her car keys and went downstairs briskly; her small car was parked in its usual spot. She started the car and, out of habit, turned on the radio, and classical music flowed out. She drove onto the Nongye Road elevated road, where traffic was smooth, and reached familiar Tongbai North Road in about 12 minutes—a bit faster than the 16 minutes the navigation had estimated.
location: From Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Routine clinical work and research communication in the rehabilitation department
description: Attended the department morning handover meeting at 08:00 sharp. Subsequently, Yu Xiaowen accompanied her supervising teacher, attending physician Li Wei, on ward rounds, focusing on Mr. Liu, a spinal cord injury patient admitted yesterday. After rounds, she returned to the office to process medical orders and complete the medical records for the new patient. Around 10:00, Teacher Li Wei came to her with a stack of data on patients' compliance with rehabilitation training. The two discussed how to draw comparison charts. Teacher Li suggested using a bar chart and marking the differences before and after discharge. Yu Xiaowen carefully recorded the key points and said she would start revising in the afternoon.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handling medical orders, medical records, and department affairs.
description: After finishing the communication with Teacher Li, Yu Xiaowen returned to her workstation and checked the treatment plans for tomorrow's discharged patients one by one. Her colleague Wang Fang passed by, handed her a piece of dark chocolate, and whispered, 'Don't forget our coffee date at noon!' She smiled and nodded. At 11:30, she used spare moments to send a 'good afternoon' sticker to her mother in Luoyang via WeChat on her phone, sharing the message: 'Teacher Li taught me how to make charts — pretty impressive.'
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and coffee time.
description: As soon as lunch break started, Yu Xiaowen and Wang Fang walked out of the hospital together. After walking about 7 minutes, they arrived at Xiyuan Plaza on the west side of the hospital. They chose an independent coffee shop they often visited, with warm yellow lighting. Yu Xiaowen ordered a hot Americano, and Wang Fang had a latte. The two chatted about interesting things from today's ward rounds. Wang Fang asked about her weekend plans, and Yu Xiaowen excitedly shared her plan to set up the exhibition tonight and invited Wang Fang to come see the exhibition at the "Between Clay" studio on Saturday if she was free.
location: A coffee shop on the first floor of Xiyuan International Plaza, at the intersection of Jianshe West Road and Tongbai Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Returned to the hospital cafeteria for lunch
description: After chatting, the two parted at the intersection. Yu Xiaowen went back to the hospital cafeteria alone; lunchtime had already passed its peak. She ordered a serving of stir-fried choy sum and a serving of braised pork ribs with a small bowl of rice, and ate quietly. She used her phone to quickly browse articles on new rehabilitation advances pushed by a professional WeChat public account.
location: Staff Cafeteria, Basement Level 1, Building 1, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon work: medical record verification and revision of research figures
description: At 14:00 in the afternoon, the department held a brief case discussion. After the meeting, Yu Xiaowen returned to her workstation and, following Teacher Li's advice, began revising the "rehabilitation training compliance comparison chart" in her paper. At 16:00, she organized and archived all the discharge medical records, and checked the treatment plans for all patients for the next day. Only after confirming that everything was correct did she shut down the computer. Then she returned to the changing room.
location: Doctor's office, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: After-work preparation and changing clothes
description: Yu Xiaowen quickly took off her white coat, took out the gray loose sweatshirt and dark brown casual cargo pants she had prepared for the evening, and changed out of her shirt and trousers. She put on a pair of light white sneakers and checked her canvas bag once more: spare spotlight batteries, exhibition label stickers, a roll of alcohol adhesive, and a tape measure—all there. She adjusted her collar in the mirror and set off with anticipation.
location: Locker room, 3rd floor, Building 2, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drive to the pottery studio
description: Yu Xiaowen drove out of the hospital and headed east along the Longhai Expressway. The navigation showed a drive of about 28.7 minutes, but because the evening rush hour was just beginning, it actually took about 30 minutes. She listened to a downloaded podcast on her phone, feeling both calm and excited.
location: No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province to Shenghuali, at Hanghai East Road and Jingkai 6th Street, Guancheng Hui District.

name: Setting up the "Time Heals" pottery exhibition
description: Arrived at the studio on time; her good friend Su Ya was already there. The two exchanged smiles and immediately got to work. They arranged the displays according to the theme "Time Heals": everyday vessels on the left display stand, and the series of twelve Chinese zodiac animal ceramic plates around the central pillar. The centerpiece, the "Tactile Memory" ceramic slab, was placed directly in front of the entrance in the most visible spot, following Master Zheng's guidance. The three of them divided the tasks, adjusted the spotlight angles, carefully glued the handmade exhibit labels with alcohol glue, and Master Zheng, drawing on his experience, helped adjust the spacing of several large pieces to make the whole space feel more rhythmically arranged. They worked until nearly 9 p.m. When all the pieces were properly in place, the ceramics gave off a soft, warm glow under the lighting.
location: "Between the Clay" Pottery DIY Studio, 2nd Floor, Building 2, Shenghuali, Hanghai East Road & Jingkai Sixth Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Talked with family on the way home while driving.
description: After the exhibition setup was complete, Yu Xiaowen said goodbye to Su Ya and Master Zheng and drove back. On the way, she called her parents via WeChat voice through the car's Bluetooth. The call was quickly answered, and her mother's voice carried a smile. She excitedly reported the exhibition setup to her parents, saying that "Tactile Memory" was placed in the center position, and took several photos of the exhibition area to send to the family group. Her father happily praised her and reminded her to pay attention to safety.
location: Shenghuali, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District

name: Returned home, drank tea, and rested.
description: It was almost ten o'clock when she got home. Yu Xiaowen changed into comfortable loungewear and first soaked her feet in hot water to relieve fatigue. Then she took out her newly purchased white porcelain tea set and brewed a pot of ripe Pu-erh tea. She sat on the sofa, sipping slowly, opened the memo on her phone, and did a final check of the process list for tomorrow's ceramic art exhibition opening ceremony, from check-in time to artwork care, confirming that everything was foolproof. Then she picked up the book 'The Corner of Altay' from her bedside and flipped through a few pages, feeling completely relaxed.
location: Building 6, Unit 3, Apartment 1**, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: It was getting late, so she put down her book and went to the bathroom to wash up. After carefully completing her evening skincare routine, she lay in bed and did a body scan meditation with a phone app. Before sleeping, she remembered that she still needed to reply tomorrow to the stroke patient's thank-you letter, so she wrote "write thank-you letter" on a sticky note and stuck it by her desk.
location: Building 6, Unit 3, Apartment 1**, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: She set her alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning. As she closed her eyes, the last thing that flashed through her mind was the pottery in the exhibition hall under the soft lights. With satisfaction and anticipation for tomorrow, she quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Building 6, Unit 3, Apartment 1**, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning exercise and breakfast preparation
description: At 6:30 in the morning the alarm went off. Yu Xiaowen took a few deep breaths under the quilt to shake off fatigue, opened the curtains to see the faint winter light, temperature -1 to 10 degrees Celsius. She changed into sportswear, laid out a yoga mat in the living room, and practiced Baduanjin for 15 minutes, focusing on stretching her sore neck, shoulders, waist, and back from yesterday's exhibition setup. After washing up, she prepared breakfast: she made soup from the Luoyang hulatang seasoning packet her mother had brought, and served it with warm milk, whole wheat bread, and a boiled egg, while mentally going over the exhibition process. Then she changed into a dark green sweater and dark gray trousers, tied a linen-cotton scarf, and checked the handwritten price tags, change purse, spare pen, notebook, and portable Jin Jun Mei tea set in her shoulder bag. Once everything was in order, she smiled at herself in the mirror for encouragement.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drove to the exhibition venue
description: Yu Xiaowen carried her bag downstairs and drove to Shenghuali Shopping Center, about 25 minutes away. Outside the window were Zhengzhou's winter streetscape. She felt excited and slightly nervous; the car music played a light melody to help adjust her mood.
location: Along the route from Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Shenghuali Shopping Center, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District.

name: Pre-exhibition opening preparation and delivery of the custom ceramic plate
description: Arriving nearly two hours early at the "Between the Clay" pottery studio on the 3rd floor of Shenghuali Shopping Center, she met up with Su Ya, who had arrived earlier, and made a final check of the exhibition area: Master Zheng Guodong helped fine-tune the angle of the spotlights near the "Tactile Memory" clay panel; Yu Xiaowen placed handwritten price tags one by one next to the corresponding works, and checked the guestbook and pens at the entrance; she boiled water and set up the Jin Jun Mei tea set on the low table in the rest area. At 9:45, the customer who had customized the zodiac rooster ceramic plate in September arrived as promised. Yu Xiaowen warmly received her, took out four perfectly fired pieces from the display stand, and the customer couldn't put them down. The two took a group photo in front of the "Time Heals" themed area, and the customer happily said she would invite friends to visit the exhibition.
location: Between Clay Pottery Studio, 3F, Shenghuali Shopping Center, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning exhibition opening and exchange visit
description: At ten in the morning, the exhibition officially opened. Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya greeted visitors at the entrance, introducing the creative concept and the journey behind it. Teacher Zheng Guodong took time to come, looked through the works carefully, and praised the “Tactile Memory” series. At about 10:30, Sister Zhao Min arrived. She examined each piece closely and was deeply interested in the stories behind the crooked tea cup and the zodiac rooster plate, suggesting that the stories be written on small cards and placed beside the works to enhance the emotional transmission. Yu Xiaowen agreed completely and immediately sat down on a low stool to take out her notebook and pen to note down ideas. Gazing at the ceramic plaques, Zhao Min was struck by inspiration and named the series “Tactile Memory.” During this time, the regular customer who had ordered a custom zodiac rooster plate returned with two friends. They were greatly interested in the “Tactile Memory” ceramic plaques and stopped to discuss them. The exhibition hall was lively that morning; the works were sincerely appreciated, and Yu Xiaowen felt deeply fulfilled.
location: Between Clay Pottery Studio, 3F, Shenghuali Shopping Center, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and Exhibition Adjustment
description: During the lunch break, when the crowd thinned, Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya went to the 'Old Taste Bun Shop' in the B1 food court of the mall and bought pork and scallion buns and millet porridge, and ate them quickly while standing. Back at the exhibition hall, taking advantage of the few visitors, Yu Xiaowen took photos of the scene and sent them to the parents' family group, adding a message to report that she was safe and to tell them that Sister Zhao Min had come and given suggestions. She then organized the sketches she had conceived in the morning in her notebook based on Zhao Min's suggestions, preparing to formally write out the story cards in the afternoon.
location: Food court on B1 and ceramic art studio on 3F, Shenghuali Shopping Center, East Hanghai Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch break and letting inspiration settle
description: Yu Xiaowen sat on the low stool beside the 'Tactile Memory' ceramic slab, brewing a pot of Jin Jun Mei tea; the tea aroma soothed her fatigue. Gazing at the work, she recalled its creation story: the crooked teacup was a memento of her first time throwing clay, the zodiac rooster pattern came from a neighbor's big rooster on Luoyang Old Street, and the 'Old Objects' series was inspired by her mother's enamel basin that had been dropped and patched up many times. These ideas were recorded in more detail in her notebook.
location: Rest area of the 'Between the Clay' Pottery Studio, 3F, Shenghuali Shopping Center, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: In the afternoon, write story cards and continue receiving visitors
description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya leaned over the main exhibition table. Yu Xiaowen used her favorite fountain pen to carefully transcribe the stories she had conceived onto blank cards. After finishing each card, she stood up and stood beside the corresponding work. Visitors paused to read the cards carefully; some smiled knowingly, some fell into deep thought. In between, they also received new visitors, patiently answering questions about ceramic techniques and creative inspiration. The exhibition atmosphere was warm and fulfilling.
location: Main display stand at Between Clay Pottery Studio, 3F, Shenghuali Shopping Center, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Exhibition wrap-up and tidying up.
description: At 4:30 in the afternoon, the audience gradually dispersed. Yu Xiaowen and Su Ya began to clean up the booth, carefully placing unsold works back into storage boxes, sorting through the touching messages in the guestbook, and giving the studio a simple cleaning. The busy first day of the exhibition came to an end, and although they were tired, they felt fulfilled.
location: Between Clay Pottery Studio, 3F, Shenghuali Shopping Center, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: A simple meal after the exhibition to celebrate.
description: After the exhibition closed in the evening, Yu Xiaowen invited Su Ya, and also contacted Sister Zhao Min and Master Zheng Guodong to join her for a meal at the "Old Luoyang Noodle House" near the shopping mall. The four sat around the table and ordered Henan specialties such as mutton stewed noodles and cold dishes, toasting to the success of the opening day with tea instead of wine. As they chatted about interesting moments from the exhibition, Yu Xiaowen sincerely thanked Zhao Min for the creative ideas of the "handwritten story cards" and naming the exhibition "Tactile Memories". Zhao Min again praised the works and agreed to explore future cross-disciplinary collaboration between art and writing.
location: Old Luoyang Noodle Restaurant, 100 meters south of the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Shangying Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Return trip and city night lights
description: After saying goodbye to her friends, Yu Xiaowen drove home. Passing by Xiyuan Plaza, she saw bright Christmas decorations already lit up in the shop windows, adding warmth to the winter night. She slowed down for a few seconds, the corners of her mouth unconsciously turning up, and thought that the exhibition had gone smoothly—today was a really good day.
location: En route from Old Luoyang Noodle Restaurant to Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Evening relaxation and journaling
description: After returning home and changing out of her coat, Yu Xiaowen brewed a pot of raw Pu'er tea and sat on the sofa scrolling through the photos she had taken that day. She made a video call with her father, Yu Jianguo, and described the exhibition in detail, mentioning Zhao Min's suggestion and Teacher Zheng's comments. Her father was deeply gratified and said that he would definitely come to see the exhibition with her mother during the year-end holiday. After hanging up the video call, she took out her diary and solemnly recorded the story of the crooked teacup and the rooster zodiac plate, as well as Zhao Min's naming of "Tactile Memory" and Teacher Zheng's expectation that "there will be stories next year." She wrote down her full feelings and gains.
location: Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Reading and quieting the mind
description: After washing up and changing into comfortable pajamas, Yu Xiaowen put on a hydrating mask. She did not look at her phone, but picked up Li Juan's 'A Corner of Altay' and read for half an hour. The stories in the book allowed her to temporarily pull away from the excitement of the day, and she felt calm and peaceful.
location: Study room, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: Yu Xiaowen turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on, then began a body-scan meditation, relaxing every part of her body one by one from the top of her head to the soles of her feet. The noise of the day receded, and a sense of accomplishment and gratitude welled up in her heart. After the meditation, she set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, turned off the light, and lay down. With beautiful memories of a fulfilling day and hopes for the future, she soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Unit 2, Building 3, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning wake-up.
description: At 6:30 in the morning, she was woken by the alarm clock. The sky outside was overcast and the temperature was low. Considering that she had stood too long at the exhibition on its first day yesterday, leaving her ankles sore and swollen, and that today was a special workday requiring her to juggle the exhibition and shift duty, she decided to skip her usual morning run and instead do gentle Baduanjin indoors to wake up her body.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Morning Baduanjin exercise
description: She changed into loose loungewear, spread a yoga mat on the living room floor, and with soothing morning music played a full set of Baduanjin. She focused on movements such as 'Both Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner' and 'Seven Bounces Behind the Back to Eliminate All Diseases,' mainly stretching and relaxing, which relieved the stiffness in her back and ankles caused by standing for long periods.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After washing up, she prepared a balanced breakfast for herself: slowly simmered millet porridge on the stove over low heat while boiling an egg. After breakfast, she brewed a cup of fragrant jasmine tea with the new white porcelain tea set and drank it while hot. It dispelled the morning chill, and her mood calmed along with the scent of the tea.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Going out and preparing to call Father.
description: She carefully packed the several new “Tactile Memory” story cards written in advance last night into the canvas tote bag, along with small souvenirs prepared for close friends. Before going out, she made a video call to her father, Yu Jianguo, briefly chatting about the grand opening of yesterday's exhibition. Her father laughed happily on the other end and once again confirmed the plan to go to Zhengzhou with her mother at the end of the year to see the exhibition.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Driving to the exhibition hall
description: Put on a warm down jacket and drove to the Shenghuali Shopping Center in Guancheng District. On the way, Bach's Cello Suites played through the car's Bluetooth. The melodious cello blended with the street scenes outside the window, and my thoughts shifted between the success of yesterday's exhibition and the upcoming arrival of today's friends, leaving me feeling warm and fulfilled.
location: While driving from Qunying Residential Area on Qunying Road in Jinshui District to Shenghuali Shopping Center on Hanghai East Road in Guancheng Hui District

name: Hosted friends at a pottery exhibition.
description: After arriving, her four close friends Wang Fang, Zhang Jing, Sun Yue, and Lin Wei had already come one after another. As soon as they entered, they were moved by the warm atmosphere of the “Tactile Memory” series. Yu Xiaowen accompanied them around the exhibition, explaining the story behind each work. Wang Fang couldn't put down the crackle-glaze teacup and immediately bought it as a bridesmaid gift for next month's wedding; Zhang Jing and Sun Yue each reserved an exquisite ceramic piece. Lin Wei excitedly took photos of every work she liked, posted them on Moments with the caption “A weekend healed by art and stories.” The exhibition hall was filled with laughter and cheerful conversation.
location: Exhibition hall of the Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, Shenghuali Shopping Center, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Handed over booth duties to a colleague
description: After her friends left, Yu Xiaowen had a detailed handover with Su Ya, who was in charge of the booth that day. She gave Su Ya the newly written story cards and specifically reminded her to pay attention to visitors' reactions to the two stories "The Crooked Teacup" and "Holding a Round Ball." The two also briefly reviewed the morning's visitor flow and felt confident about the afternoon exhibition.
location: Exhibition hall of the Shenghuali Pottery DIY Studio, Shenghuali Shopping Center, Hanghai East Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Quick lunch
description: Using her lunch break, she found a noodle shop in the food court on floor B1, ordered a steaming bowl of beef noodles, and ate it quickly. She used these ten minutes to send a WeChat message to Sun Yue, confirming the video tea chat for around 3 p.m.
location: Food court, B1, Shenghuali Shopping Center, East Hanghai Road, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Drive to the hospital and buy groceries on the way.
description: Driving away from Shenghuali. Following the planned route, she turned onto Qunying Road along the way and, at the familiar grain and oil shop there, skillfully picked out half a jin of dried shiitake mushrooms and a small bag of red dates, planning to make a nourishing soup at home in the evening. After shopping, she continued driving toward the hospital in Zhongyuan District.
location: On the drive from Shenghuali Shopping Center in Guancheng Hui District, passing by the Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop on Qunying Road in Jinshui District, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital on Tongbai North Road in Zhongyuan District.

name: Hospital duty check-in and preparation
description: Arrived at the department at 1 p.m. sharp, changed into my white coat and signed in. I had a brief conversation with my colleague Liu Qiang, who was on the morning shift, to learn about the rehabilitation training progress and emotional changes of a stroke patient previously under my care, and reviewed the paperwork that needed to be handled in the afternoon.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Afternoon duty, handling paperwork.
description: In the office, she quietly handled routine paperwork, checked patient medical records, and sorted out the rehabilitation assessment data. Meanwhile, she took a moment to tidy her canvas bag, taking out the exhibition brochure and the small tea-break cookies prepared earlier, to get ready for the upcoming video tea chat.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video tea chat with her good friend Sun Yue
description: She brewed a pot of ripe Pu'er tea and had a video call with Sun Yue in the rest area via WeChat. Across the screen, the two raised their cups in a “toast.” Yu Xiaowen shared an abstract of a study she had just read about the antioxidant function of tea polyphenols, and Sun Yue repeatedly exclaimed, “So drinking tea is this healthy!” Then she mysteriously told Sun Yue she had prepared a special gift—the small pottery cup Sun Yue had admired at the exhibition hall yesterday, kept especially for her. They chatted for nearly forty minutes in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere, and much of the work fatigue melted away.
location: Break room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Continue the on-duty shift in the afternoon
description: Continued to work energetically, efficiently processed several discharge summaries, and completed filing. At 5:30 pm, I finished the handover with the evening shift colleague, packed up my personal belongings, and got ready to leave.
location: Rehabilitation Department Office, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Driving home
description: While driving home, she received a message from Su Ya from the exhibition hall: in the afternoon, an elderly couple was moved by the "filial devotion story" and wrote warm messages in the guestbook, and by closing time, most of the small pottery pieces on the display case had been sold. Yu Xiaowen felt warm at heart and felt that the day's running around was worth it.
location: On the drive from Zhengzhou Central Hospital, Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Qunying Community on Qunying Road, Jinshui District.

name: Return home for dinner
description: Back home, she changed out of her heavy work clothes. Using the shiitake mushrooms she bought at noon, she made herself a steaming pot of noodle soup with greens, egg, and shiitake mushrooms. It was a simple dinner, but she ate it with extra satisfaction because it was a reward to herself for the day.
location: Home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

name: Evening reading and music time.
description: After dinner, on the living room sofa, she used a Bluetooth speaker to play Mozart's piano sonatas. She opened Li Juan's The Corner of Altay and immersed herself in her delicate world of words, enjoying this quiet and luxurious evening time that belonged only to herself.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Video call with mother.
description: She called her mother via video and excitedly shared the good news from the second day of the exhibition: not only did friends come to support, but there were also warm messages from strangers. She asked her mother to tell her father that she was looking forward to them coming to Zhengzhou together to see the exhibition at the end of the year, and that the whole family could take a nice stroll.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Writing in her diary and looking ahead.
description: In her diary, she recorded the day's warmth and touching moments: Wang Fang's happy expression while shopping, Sun Yue's laughter on the video call, and the elderly couple's message. At the same time, she wrote down the preliminary idea of “cooperating with Sister Zhao Min next year” and planned to start organizing the photos and visitor messages from the exhibition into a commemorative album next week.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Washing up and meditative relaxation before bed
description: Washed up carefully and did a skincare routine. After that, I did a few simple stretches, focusing on relaxing my ankles, which were still a little sore. Then I went to the bedroom, closed my eyes, and did a ten-minute body scan meditation. Starting from the top of my head, I slowly scanned down to the soles of my feet, feeling every part of my body. The smiling faces of today's friends, parents, colleagues, and strangers appeared in my mind, filling my heart with gratitude and contentment, and a sense of happiness welled up.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Bedtime reading
description: Lying in bed, she did not replay the events of the day but picked up her Kindle and read Haruki Murakami's essay collection. Reading his accounts of running, travel, and music, she let her thoughts drift along another rhythm of life, helping herself calm down from the day's excitement and adjust her sleep cycle. At 22:00, she turned off the light and, in the quiet night, slowly fell asleep with satisfaction and anticipation.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Getting up, washing up, and morning exercise
description: The alarm went off. Outside the window, the sky was gray, and the forecast light snow had not yet fallen. After washing up quickly, she spread out her yoga mat in the living room and, following the app's guidance, completed a full set of Baduanjin. The shoulder and lower back soreness accumulated from Sunday duty was noticeably relieved, and her body gradually warmed up.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out
description: I toasted two slices of whole wheat bread and paired them with milk and a boiled egg. While eating breakfast, I checked the weather on my phone and, after confirming 'cloudy turning to light snow, 0–4', took out a thick dark blue down jacket and put it on. I checked again that the car insurance electronic documents saved on my phone were intact, and at 8:00 sharp I put on my backpack, grabbed my car keys, and headed out.
location: Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Commuted to work by car.
description: Started the car, and the warm air slowly dispelled the chill. There weren't too many cars on the road. Driving smoothly, I entered the hospital parking lot after about 16 minutes.
location: From Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

name: Morning work: morning meeting and clinical care
description: Arrived at the department at 8:16 and changed into a white coat. At 8:20, attended the department morning meeting and listened to the night shift colleague's handover. Then joined Dr. Li Wei on ward rounds, focusing on the recovery of Grandpa Wang in Bed 42, and discussed the adjusted rehabilitation plan with Dr. Li. Returned to the office to handle new patients' medical records and orders. At 11:30, had a brief meeting with Wang Fang at the nurse station; she asked if I was going to the exhibition in the afternoon, and I told her I would go over in the evening to wrap things up.
location: Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Lunch and exchange with colleagues
description: She went to the staff cafeteria with Wang Fang, ordering a bowl of braised pork rib noodles and a plate of greens. While eating, Wang Fang asked about the pottery exhibition sales, so she shared the results from the previous day and mentioned that she would go wrap things up in the evening.
location: Employee cafeteria at Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Renew car insurance and record the expense.
description: Back in the quiet office, I opened the Ping An Auto Insurance app and the China Merchants Bank credit card app on my phone. After checking the coverage details, I confirmed the total amount was 3,870 yuan, chose to pay it in one payment with the CMB credit card, and set it as repayment over 3 installments (1,290 yuan per installment). After completing the operation, I downloaded the electronic insurance policy and saved it to the 'Important Documents' folder on my phone. Then I opened the monthly expense sheet in my phone memo and recorded this liability, preparing the data for discussing car maintenance costs with my parents in the evening.
location: Office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Afternoon work: processing medical records and creating a car maintenance checklist
description: The afternoon work began. She first handled a few progress notes that had piled up in the morning and checked the medical orders for tomorrow's surgical patients. Starting at 14:30, she prepared the "car maintenance cost list" to discuss with her parents in the evening. Using Excel, she itemized and totaled insurance (converted to monthly), fuel, maintenance, parking, tolls, and other expenses, and made sure key data were synced to her phone memo.
location: Office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Contact Su Ya to confirm the details about the exhibition hall.
description: During a work break, I walked to the rest area and called Su Ya to ask about the afternoon visitor flow at the exhibition hall. I learned that a few visitors were still interested in the works, so I told Su Ya to look after them for now and said I would go over after work.
location: Rest area of the Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Completed work handover and prepared to leave work
description: Returned to my workstation and finished organizing the last discharge summary. Left a message for Dr. Li in the department group chat, explaining that I needed to leave early to handle the exhibition wrap-up. At 17:15, changed out of my white coat, grabbed my backpack and car keys, and left.
location: Office, Inpatient Department, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Drove to the Shenghuali Pottery Exhibition Hall.
description: Driving out of the hospital, she turned south on Tongbai Road and then onto the Longhai Expressway heading east. As the sky darkened and the streetlights came on, fine snowflakes began to fall. She slowed down and drove carefully, arriving at the underground parking lot of Shenghuali Shopping Center at about 17:44.
location: From Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to the underground parking lot of Shenghuali Shopping Center, at the intersection of Hanghai East Road and 8th Jingkai Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Last day of the pottery exhibition: receiving visitors and taking down the exhibit
description: I walked quickly to the exhibition area and met up with Su Ya. I enthusiastically introduced to the last two visitors the rehabilitation stories behind my father's grip ball texture series works. After seeing the visitors off, Master Zheng Guodong arrived. He affirmed the exhibition results and seriously suggested that next time we could make a complete Chinese zodiac series. The three of us together registered the sold works (2710 yuan in total) and carefully packed the exhibits with bubble wrap and cartons. I was in charge of counting the money, Su Ya took photos for the record, and Master Zheng guided the packing sequence — we worked in good coordination.
location: 'Between Clay' Pottery Exhibition Area, Shenghuali Shopping Center, at the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Jingkai Eighth Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Driving home
description: After finishing the initial exhibition teardown work, she said goodbye to Su Ya and Master Zheng, then drove back to Jinshui District. Although the snow was not heavy, the road was slippery, so she drove more slowly than usual and arrived safely at the community building entrance at 20:23.
location: From the underground parking lot of Shenghuali Shopping Center at the intersection of Hanghai East Road and Jingkai 8th Street, Guancheng Hui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, to Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Discuss car maintenance costs with parents in person.
description: Opening the door, my parents were watching TV in the living room. After changing into slippers, I sat down beside them. First, I shared the wrap-up of the pottery exhibition and Master Zheng's praise for my father's work, which made him very happy. Then I took out my phone memo and, in a relaxed tone, analyzed the car ownership costs item by item, emphasizing how convenient driving is for my father's trips to the rehabilitation center. When I finished, my father said with emotion, 'I always thought owning a car was just wasting money, but now when I think about it, when it comes to your dad's rehabilitation, it really is much more useful than taking a taxi.'
location: Living room at home, Qunying Residential Complex, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

name: Brewing tea, reviewing the day, and keeping a diary
description: Back in the study, she took out her white porcelain tea set and brewed a pot of Jin Jun Mei, filling the room with tea fragrance. She opened her diary and recorded the day's gains: the car insurance had been settled smoothly, the exhibition had come to a successful close, and her father had shown understanding and support. The night-shift doctor reported on the weekend situation, including nighttime heart rate fluctuations of a patient with sequelae of brainstem hemorrhage. Yu Xiaowen took careful notes. She carefully recorded the key points of neurological rehabilitation assessment added by Dr. Li and communicated with the hemiplegic patient's family about the day's rehabilitation training plan. At the end of rounds, she ran into her colleague Wang Fang at the office door. Wang Fang patted her on the shoulder and said they should go together to the department dinner on Friday night. Yu Xiaowen smiled and responded, OK, sure, we'll go together and get in touch on WeChat then. After a brief confirmation, she walked toward the chief physician's office.

Director Wang approved highly. After looking through the materials, he formally suggested that she turn this experience into a research idea, with the topic 'Rehabilitation-stage stroke patients' acceptance of pottery intervention and its influencing factors,' and first conduct a questionnaire survey within the hospital as a preliminary foundation for applying for a Youth Fund. He encouraged Yu Xiaowen to start drafting a plan that very day and agreed that she would report back with her initial draft ideas early the following week. Yu Xiaowen carefully recorded the key guidance.

Based on the turnover rate of stroke patients in the rehabilitation department, she estimated a plan to collect 80-100 valid samples. By noon, she saved the document and completed about 40% of the initial framework.

Afterwards, she leaned against the headboard and carefully read 20 pages of The Birth of the Clinic, marking key sentences.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Everything is great." Then she set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

After drinking a glass of warm water, she spread out her yoga mat in the living room and practiced Baduanjin and cervical spine exercises to stretch her body. After practice, she weighed 49.6 kg and was in good physical condition.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

After washing up, she quickly prepared breakfast: instant oatmeal with hot milk and a boiled egg. While eating, she reviewed the day's work flow. Then, in the bedroom, she changed into her white coat inner layer (an off-white turtleneck sweater), packed the camel cashmere sweater and dark-blue jeans she would wear in the evening, lip balm, and moisturizer into her commuter bag, and checked the printed speech draft and a pen.

Afterwards, Teacher Li Wei led the group on grand rounds. Yu Xiaowen carefully recorded patients' progress and changes to medical orders, paying special attention to the condition of a patient with dysphagia after a brainstem infarction.

description: After ward rounds, Yu Xiaowen entered the progress notes in the doctors' office, wrote medical orders (adjusting the nutritional fluid ratio), and arranged a neurosurgery consultation for the traumatic brain injury patient. She checked data analysis details with Liu Qiang. Wang Fang invited her to go to the cafeteria together at noon, but she said she had brought her own meal.

After the meal, she took out her speech draft, used a red pen to add details about thanking Wang Fang, and carefully weighed the tone word by word to ensure sincerity. She also searched on her phone for the standard inner page size of an honor certificate and wrote down the A4 dimensions. Then she set an alarm and rested with her eyes closed on the sofa for 15 minutes to regain energy.

description: In the afternoon, Yu Xiaowen handled a newly transferred patient with sequelae of cerebral hemorrhage, taking the medical history and performing the NIHSS assessment. She communicated with the family for 20 minutes, answering questions about the rehabilitation plan and prognosis, and soothing their anxiety. Afterwards, she assisted Liu Qiang in completing the complex discharge summary.

After the handover, she and Wang Fang exchanged a smile, went together to the changing room to take off their white coats, and put on her own camel-colored cashmere sweater and dark blue jeans. She applied lipstick in the mirror, looking sharp and refreshed, ready for the dinner. Wang Fang also changed into a wine-colored wool coat.

The atmosphere was lively, with topics ranging from year-end summaries to Chinese New Year customs. Director Zhang Lei toasted to encourage everyone, and Yu Xiaowen offered tea to Teacher Li Wei to thank him for his guidance. At around 8 p.m., Director Zhang announced that Yu Xiaowen had won the title of "Annual Rising Star in Research". She went on stage, took the certificate and envelope from Director Zhang, and delivered the speech she had polished at noon, sincerely thanking all her colleagues. Then came the lucky draw, in which Yu Xiaowen won the second prize, a branded air fryer, causing laughter among her colleagues. Wang Fang joked that she looked forward to healthy fried chicken. Afterward, everyone continued chatting, sharing cooking ideas and plans for the coming year, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: Private room, Ruihexuan Chinese Restaurant, 4th Floor, Wanda Plaza (Zhengzhou Zhongyuan Store), 171 Zhongyuan Middle Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Walked home with Wang Fang
description: After the gathering, Yu Xiaowen carried the air fryer box and walked home with Wang Fang along the same route. The night wind was cold, but both felt warm inside, chatting and laughing as they shared the evening's amusing moments. At the fork on Qunying Road where it split off toward Wang Fang's neighborhood, they said goodnight and parted.

She excitedly showed off the prize and recounted the evening's award and lottery drawing. Her father listened happily and asked her to show off her cooking skills when she came home for the Chinese New Year. Yu Xiaowen gladly agreed and planned to research low-oil recipes. The call lasted nearly half an hour.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: After hanging up the video call, Yu Xiaowen carefully removed her makeup, cleansed her face, and did her skincare routine in the bathroom. Then she sat at her desk and wrote in her diary about the joy of the day: "Today I was named a rising star in research and also won an air fryer..." After that, she turned off the lights, leaving only the bedside lamp on, and read "The Birth of the Clinic" for about 10 minutes. When drowsiness came, she closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep with a smile.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Resting after the shift
description: Completed the final documentation and checked the handover materials for the next morning. After a quick wash and changing into spare pajamas, she lay down on the camp bed in the on-call room, recalled the breakthroughs and heartwarming moments of the day, and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Doctor's duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

After changing into warm sports gear, I locked the door at 5:45 and walked to Zhuchunyuan Park. In -1°C weather, I started a 5 km morning run, with an average pace of 6 minutes 24 seconds per kilometer, completing the breakthrough in 32 minutes. I stretched on a park bench and took photos of the winter morning to record the moment of self-breakthrough, then walked home.
location: Zhuchun Garden Park, 40 meters northeast of the intersection of Suoling Road and Tianming Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province
