description: After returning home, she quickly showered and changed clothes. For breakfast, she had instant oatmeal, a boiled egg, and an orange, and used an app to review professional English vocabulary for rehabilitation medicine. After the meal, she opened the health record Excel in the study and systematically evaluated the effects of the iron-supplementing diet over the past two months. From the frequency of dizziness, complexion, and fatigue, she confirmed that the anemia had improved. To be precise, she decided to go to the hospital for a complete blood count the next day, and recorded it in her phone memo with a reminder set.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

At the bookstore, she carefully chose birthday reading material and bought Illness as Metaphor and a pocket edition of Introduction to Neuroscience. At checkout, the shop assistant gave her birthday wishes. Then she drove about 12 minutes to the Xiyuan Plaza cafe in Jinshui District, ordered a hot Americano, read the new books in a corner by the window, and wrote down reflections on life in her notebook, enjoying a quiet time.
location: Calligraphy and Painting Society on Bank Street, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and the cafe at Xiyuan Plaza at the intersection of Huayuan Road and Nongye Road, Jinshui District

After getting home, she tied on an apron and cooked the classic stir-fried spinach with pork liver and multigrain rice to Bach's cello suites. After the meal, she quickly cleaned up the kitchen, put the books back in place, and watered the green plants, keeping the living environment fresh and tidy.
location: Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop at No. 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, and home in Qunying Community

location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

She flipped through the air fryer manual she had won in a lottery, imagining making honey-glazed chicken wings for her father on New Year's Day. Then she skimmed “The Birth of the Clinic,” stir-fried the remaining garlic scapes with eggs, washed apples and packed them as her dinner bento, getting ready for the upcoming night shift.
location: Study and kitchen at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province

She drove from Qunying Road to Zhongyuan District; weekend traffic was smooth, and she arrived at the Zhengzhou Central Hospital parking lot in about 15 minutes.
location: From Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District

description: After arriving early, she first sent a WeChat message to her mother to remind her about her father's follow-up documents, then formally handed over with the day-shift attending physician and recorded ward updates: the stroke patient had a low-grade fever, and the next day's rehabilitation assessment after joint replacement surgery. After officially taking over the shift, she made ward rounds, communicated with the low-grade fever patient's family, wrote orders for a blood routine test and physical cooling, reviewed newly admitted patients' records, and wrote the duty log. In between, she found time to eat the homemade garlic chives and scrambled egg bento and an apple.
location: Ward and duty room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

At about 20:45, her father Yu Jianguo called, concerned about her being tired from the night shift, and congratulated her again on winning the award the previous night. Yu Xiaowen had a pleasant chat with her father for about 20 minutes. Feeling encouraged, she opened the notes app on her phone and formulated a 2026 Rehabilitation Medicine Advancement Plan, planning to study for an hour early each morning, organize topics by quarter, and prepare for the senior professional title evaluation. She also set a daily 6:00 alarm.
location: Doctor's duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Returning to the on-duty room, she recorded the rounds in the duty log and finalized her diary draft. Late at night, she continued reading The Birth of the Clinic, thinking about how its theories apply to clinical rehabilitation practice.
location: Ward and duty room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province.

location: Inpatient Department of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province; Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Buy exam preparation books and tidy up the desk
description: After getting up, Yu Xiaowen drank a glass of warm water, then opened the JD app on her phone and placed an order for Internal Medicine Attending Physician Exam Key Points and Neurology Review Notes, using a birthday coupon. Then she went to the study and sorted the scattered college textbooks by subject into the lower drawer of the desk, making room for preparing for the attending physician exam.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

description: Yu Xiaowen walked into the kitchen and cooked a pot of spinach and pork liver soup using the spinach and pork liver she had bought earlier, paired with whole wheat bread, as brunch. She sat quietly at the dining table and finished it, replenishing iron and restoring energy for her body.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Qunying Residential Area, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Prepared and drove to the hospital
description: After eating, Yu Xiaowen quickly tidied the kitchen, changed into a gray thick hoodie and jeans, put on a black down jacket over them, and took her medical insurance card, phone, power bank, and keys. She went downstairs and drove to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, arriving at the hospital parking lot around 12:10.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province to the parking lot of Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

location: Laboratory Department, 2nd Floor, Outpatient Building, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

The shopkeeper recognized her and exchanged a few pleasantries. Then she continued driving back to the residential community.
location: Drove from Zhengzhou Central Hospital, passing the Qunying Road Grain and Oil Shop at 14-10 Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, and returned to Qunying Community

She sent a WeChat message to her mother to tell her the test results had improved, and received a birthday red envelope sent by her elder brother Yu Xiaofeng in the family group chat. After accepting it, she replied with thanks, and they agreed to go home and meet during the Spring Festival.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Everyone quietly prepared a surprise for her.

She unlocked the door with her key, and the room was completely dark. She flipped the light switch, and instantly the lights came on, with streamers, balloons, and friends cheering in unison, “Surprise!” Her mother was also present. Yu Xiaowen froze in surprise, then her eyes reddened with emotion.
location: First take a walk in Youth Park at No. 20 Compound, Nongye Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, then return home to Qunying Residential Community on Qunying Road in Jinshui District.

Then friends gave gifts: Wang Fang gave professional pottery tools, Zhang Jing gave a zodiac commemorative coin collection album, Sun Yue gave a medical English dictionary, Lin Wei gave a badminton racket pendant, and Su Ya passed on a custom-made throwing tool co-gifted by Teacher Zheng Guodong along with his wishes. Yu Xiaowen was moved and hugged everyone. The group enjoyed the noodles and cake, with laughter and joy filling the room.
location: Living room and dining room of Yu Xiaowen's home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Her brother said he planned to come home early for Spring Festival and had brought gifts; then high school classmate Liu Yang also sent a video from Shenzhen, and the two reminisced about funny moments from their sophomore year of high school. Her mother sat nearby smiling and listening, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Her mother Li Xiuying stayed overnight tonight, and the two of them said goodbye to everyone together before returning upstairs.
location: Building entrance, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

Her mother helped wash the dishes from the party, while Yu Xiaowen leaned against the kitchen sink and chatted with her about interesting things in the department, the exam-prep books she had just bought, and her progress in the pottery class. Her mother listened carefully and reminded her from time to time to dress warmly. The scene was quiet and warm.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

description: Yu Xiaowen made a cup of hot tea, sat alone at the desk in her study, opened her newly bought diary, and wrote down the reflections and gratitude of the past year: relief at her father's recovery, the satisfaction of having her paper published, self-sufficiency from steady financial growth, and acceptance of her own growth. She quietly closed the diary, then sat on the sofa and gazed at the starlight outside the window for a while.
location: Study at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

name: Washing up, bedtime reading, and falling asleep
description: Late at night, Yu Xiaowen went to the bathroom to carefully do her skincare routine and brush her teeth. After washing up, she changed into her pajamas, lay in bed, and flipped through a few pages of The Birth of the Clinic. As drowsiness set in, she turned off the light and fell asleep to the quiet rhythm of her mother's breathing, a contented smile on her face.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Waking up and morning preparation

location: Room 501, Unit 2, Building 6, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province

name: Set out for Luoyang.

Today she chose to set off directly from her own place, first driving to Luoyang so that she could reunite with her parents as early as possible. She set the navigation destination to Luoyang Old House.
location: From the underground garage of Qunying Community on Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, to the Zhengzhou Liulin Toll Station on the Lianhuo Expressway.

Yu Xiaowen was responsible for chopping scallions and tomatoes, while her mother kneaded the dough and made the soup. The kitchen was filled with the aroma of food and the laughter of the mother and daughter. Yu Xiaowen also shared with her mother the latest progress of the pottery intervention project in her department, and her mother listened with great interest.

name: Accompanied father for an outdoor walk.
description: Yu Xiaowen returned to the living room to keep her father company. Her father took out the training plan given by the rehabilitation therapist and showed her the results of his recent independent practice, such as standing on one leg and other movements. Yu Xiaowen watched carefully, offering encouragement and suggestions. Then she suggested taking a walk with her father. The two strolled slowly along Kaixuan Road, talking about Xiaowen's plan to prepare for the attending physician examination next year, and her father encouraged her to do her best.
location: On Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: Pre-meal preparation and video call.
description: After returning from the walk, Yu Xiaowen helped her mother bring the cooked dishes to the table and set out the bowls and chopsticks. At that moment, her older brother Yu Xiaofeng called via video from Shenzhen. The family had a brief reunion through the phone screen; her brother showed off the New Year decorations he had just bought and said he would definitely come back during the Spring Festival. The video call ended amid everyone's laughter, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Living room and kitchen of the old house at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province.

name: Family dinner and father's rehabilitation demonstration
description: The sumptuous dinner officially began. The sweet and sour pork fillet was bright red, the hot and sour soup was tangy and appetizing, and the braised noodles were chewy and smooth. After the meal, her father, Yu Jianguo, suddenly put down his cane and slowly walked a few steps independently beside the dining table. Although his movements were slow, they were very steady. Her mother was so moved that she wiped away tears on the side. Her father said to Yu Xiaowen, “Next year, focus on the attending physician exam. Dad can walk on his own now. You should live for yourself.” At that moment, the long-accumulated family pressure vanished the instant her father stood up, replaced by deep emotion and support.
location: Old House Restaurant, 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province

name: After-dinner small talk and New Year outlook
description: The family moved to the living room, and her mother cut up fruit. Her father sat on the sofa chatting with her mother about the Spring Festival arrangements, while Yu Xiaowen took the initiative to clear the dining table and kitchen, washing the dishes clean. After tidying the kitchen, she also returned to the living room. The whole family sat together, discussing the plans for the 31st (helping her mother with a thorough cleaning in the morning, and returning to Zhengzhou in the evening). Her father reminded her to drive carefully and encouraged her for the new year.
location: Living room of the old house, No. 42, Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province

name: Evening activities: reading and journaling.
description: After washing up, Yu Xiaowen changed into comfortable pajamas and sat down at the small desk. She took out her paper diary and wrote down the emotions and warmth of the entire day, especially recording the scene of her father walking independently. Then she opened the copy of The Birth of the Clinic she had brought with her, leaned against the headboard, read a few pages, and savored this long-awaited tranquility.
location: Bedroom of the old house at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Preparing for the next day's tasks
description: She checked her phone memo and confirmed that the tools needed for helping her mother clean the house tomorrow (the 31st) (rags, cleaners, etc.) were ready. She charged her phone, set an alarm for 6:30 the next morning, and planned to put it by the door together with the cleaning supplies.
location: Bedroom of the old house at No. 42 Kaixuan Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province.

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: Yu Xiaowen went to the bathroom again to wash up. Before bed, she quietly walked to her parents' bedroom door, said "Good night," and only after hearing their responses did she return to her own room at ease. She turned off the light, and, bathed in moonlight, slowly fell asleep with a warm and relieved feeling.
location: Henan Province, Luoyang City, Xigong District, No. 42 Kaixuan Road, old house bathroom and bedroom

name: Morning preparation and exercise.
description: Woken by the alarm at 5:30 in the morning, Yu Xiaowen got up, washed up, and tied her hair into a ponytail. She then boiled water for her parents, poured two cups of warm water, carried them to the door of their bedroom, and left a good-morning note. Afterward, she spread out a yoga mat in the living room and followed the phone-guided session to complete a full round of Baduanjin. When finished, she sat cross-legged with eyes closed and meditated for 10 minutes to calm and relax herself.
location: Old residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Family breakfast and brief conversation
description: After her parents got up, her mother Li Xiuying prepared breakfast: millet porridge, pickled vegetables, and meat buns. While eating, Yu Xiaowen chatted with her mother about the morning housework plan, and her mother asked her to help sort and organize her father's rehabilitation equipment.
location: Old residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Household tidying and teamwork
description: After breakfast, Yu Xiaowen threw herself into housework. She first helped her mother clean the high windows, and the two chatted about neighborhood changes. Then she organized her father's rehabilitation equipment, such as resistance bands, grip balls, and balance pads, by frequency of use and category, and labeled them, while her father guided from the side. After that, she helped her mother fold seasonal clothes and tidied a messy storage drawer.
location: Old residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Making dumplings together and chatting about family matters.
description: Yu Xiaowen saw her mother's homemade dumplings in the fridge and suggested wrapping some new ones to freeze. Mother and daughter worked in the kitchen—one rolling wrappers, the other mixing filling—while chatting about hospital anecdotes and the square dance her mother had just learned.
location: Old residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Family farewell lunch
description: Mother made Yu Xiaowen's favorite tomato scrambled eggs and braised pork ribs. The family of three sat together; Father told her to be safe on the road and prepare well for the exam, while Mother kept adding food to her bowl and said the cured meat and sausages had been packed.
location: Old residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang City, Henan Province, China

name: Loading the car and saying goodbye
description: After the meal, Yu Xiaowen checked the items in the car: cured meat and sausages, a backpack, and medical magazines. Her mother had also stuffed in a box of peony cakes. Her father stood at the door waving goodbye and reminded her to send a message when she arrived. She drove away, watching in the rearview mirror as her parents stood side by side.
location: At the entrance to the old residence, No. 42 Kaixuan West Road, Xigong District, Luoyang, Henan Province, China.

name: Drove back to Zhengzhou and settled in.
description: Yu Xiaowen drove onto the Lianhuo Expressway and played a rehabilitation medicine podcast along the way. After about 97 minutes, she arrived at Qunying Community in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou. After parking, she carried her luggage and local specialties upstairs, took out the air fryer, and divided the cured meat, sausage, and peony cakes her mother had given her into portions and put them in the freezer, then changed into home clothes.
location: Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China

name: Midday Nap and Recovery
description: Feeling slightly tired after driving, Yu Xiaowen drew the bedroom curtains, set a 40-minute alarm, lay down to relax and rest, and entered a state of deep rest.
location: Bedroom at home, Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Simple dinner
description: After the alarm went off, Yu Xiaowen got up, took out the dumplings she had wrapped the previous night from the refrigerator, boiled water, and cooked a dozen or so as a simple dinner. After eating, she cleared the dishes.
location: Home kitchen, Qunying Residential Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, Henan, China

name: Preparing for the night shift and changing clothes to go out
description: Yu Xiaowen sat on the edge of the bed to prepare items for the night shift: white coat, stethoscope, small flashlight, diary, pen, a few chocolates, and a thermos filled with hot black tea, and she charged her tablet. Then she changed into a sports bra, a quick-dry T-shirt, and tight workout pants, put on running shoes, wore a sports watch and Bluetooth earphones, placed her phone, keys, and access card into an arm pouch, and went out lightly.
location: Home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China

name: Jogging along the Jinshui River
description: Yu Xiaowen walked from the residential compound to the trail along the Jinshui River, started jogging mode, ran 3 kilometers at a steady pace, and recorded a pace of 7 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer on her phone.
location: Riverside walkway along the Jinshui River, Erqi District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China (Qunying Community section)

name: Bathe and change clothes
description: After finishing her jog, Yu Xiaowen walked home, took off her sweaty sportswear, quickly took a hot shower, and changed into a clean, comfortable cotton loungewear set, feeling refreshed and invigorated.
location: Home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China

name: Video call with parents to ring in the New Year
description: As she was about to leave, she received a video call from her mother and talked with her parents. Her father wished her an early Happy New Year, her mother showed the frozen dumplings and told her to be safe, and Yu Xiaowen reported on her running. The pleasant call lasted 15 minutes.
location: Home in Qunying Community, Qunying Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China

name: Go to the hospital
description: Yu Xiaowen put on her night-shift backpack, checked her keys and phone, locked the door, went downstairs, and drove to Zhengzhou Central Hospital, about a 15-minute drive.
location: Zhengzhou Central Hospital, 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, China

name: Night shift handover
description: After arriving at the hospital, Yu Xiaowen put on her white coat. She gave a verbal and written handover with the day-shift doctor Wang Li, learning about changes in key patients' conditions, newly admitted patients, and tasks to be handled during the night shift.
location: Duty Room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Night shift and study
description: After the night shift began, Yu Xiaowen first made rounds of the ward, checking the key patients with the duty nurse Liu Fang, and handled the medical order from a patient who called about mild discomfort. During a quiet break, she returned to the duty room, took out her tablet, and seriously studied a paper on rehabilitation art therapy, taking careful notes.
location: Department of Rehabilitation Medicine ward and duty room, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Write New Year's goals
description: When the night shift quieted down a little, Yu Xiaowen took out her diary and sticky notes and solemnly wrote down her three major goals for 2026: passing the attending physician qualification exam on the first try, advancing rehabilitation art research and publishing a paper, and exercising at least three times a week to maintain a healthy weight. She stuck the goal note on the back of her phone case.
location: Duty Room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China

name: Tidying up before bed and resting for the night shift
description: Yu Xiaowen tidied up her desk, put her belongings back into her bag, poured herself a cup of hot water, set the alarm for the 2 AM ward check, changed into her pajamas, lay down on the bed in the on-duty room, gradually relaxed, fell into a deep sleep, and built up her energy for the early morning work.
location: Duty Room, Department of Rehabilitation Medicine, Zhengzhou Central Hospital, No. 16 Tongbai North Road, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, Henan Province, China
